A tâphai a rahim lae a rai reira dawk sui laikaw kahni touh a sak teh, a hmo a voivang lah kahni reira koe sak lah ao. Hot hah teh kâkayawtnae acung hrawt nahane doeh.
Hahoi anri thing hoi kâkayawtnae a sak teh suitui hoi hluk e lah ao.
Hahoi kathounge satui hluk e, kathounge hmuitui sawi hanelah hmuitui ka sak thai e patetlah a sak.
Hahoi anri thing hoi hmaisawi thuengnae khoungroe hah a sak. Ayung dong panga touh, adangka dong panga touh, takin pali touh ao. Arasang dong thum touh.
Takin pali touh som vah kinaw hah a sak. Hote kinaw teh khoungroe hoi koung a kâkuet teh, rahum tui hoi hluk e lah ao.
Khoungroe hanelah hno e hnopainaw pueng, hlaam, ampaikei, kawlung, cingco, hmaisaan lanae hah a sak. Hote hnonaw pueng teh rahum hoi sak e seng doeh.
Hahoi khoungroe hanelah rahum cuekkarue hah a sak teh khoungroe keng koe rahim vah a ta.
Kâkayawtnae acung hrawtnae cuekkarue takin pali touh koe bang hanelah rahum laikaw pali touh a hlun.
Kâkayawtnae acung hah anri thing hoi a sak teh, rahum tui hoi a hluk.
Kâkayawt nahane khoungroe rai e laikaw dawkvah, acung hah a hrawt. Khoungroe teh a lûlahei pou a aw thai nahanlah thingphek hoi a sak.
Hahoi rahum kawlung hoi pâhungnae a khok hah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang koe thaw ka tawk awh e napuinaw e hlalang hoi a sak.
Hahoi lukkareiim thongma hah a sak teh, akalae yaphni teh loukloukkaang e hoi dong 100 touh hoi a sak.
Hote yaphni hanelah khom 20 touh, rahum khomkhok pacawp 20 touh a sak teh, khom hetnae, pangkheknaw teh ngun hoi a sak.
Atunglae yaphni teh dong 100 touh a pha. Khom 20 touh, rahum khomkhok pacawp 20 touh a sak teh, khom hetnae, pangkheknaw teh ngun hoi a sak.
Kanîloumlae yaphni teh dong 50 touh a pha. Khom hra touh, pacawpnae hra touh. Khom hetnae, pangkheknaw teh ngun hoi a sak.
Kanîtholae yaphni teh dong 50 touh.
Longkha avoivang lae yaphni teh dong hlaipanga touh a pha.
Khom kathum touh, pacawpnae kathum touh.
Kalupnae yaphni pueng teh loukloukkaang e hoi sak e seng doeh.
Hahoi khom pacawpnae, hetnae, pangkheknaw teh rahum hoi sak e doeh.
Hahoi kalupnae longkha koe e yaphni teh, kamthim, âthi, paling, loukloukkaang e hoi carouk e ayung dong 20, rasang dong panga touh a pha. Kalupnae yaphni hoi rei a kâvan.
Kalupnae takhang khom teh pali touh, rahum khok pacawpnae pali touh, hetnae ngun, pangkhek ngun, ngun hoi sak e khom ramuknae naw ao.
Hahoi Lukkareiim petkâkalup lah hetnae pueng teh rahum hoi sak e lah ao.
Hetheh lukkareiim hnopai, lawkpanuesaknae lukkareiim hanelah hno e, Mosi ni kâpoe e patetlah Aron capa Ithamar hoi Levih miphunnaw ni a touk awh e doeh.
Judah miphun thung e Hur capa Uri, ahnie capa Bezalel ni BAWIPA ni Mosi koevah sak hanelah kâ a poe e naw pueng teh, koung a sak.
Ahni koe Dan miphun Ahisamak capa Oholiab ca thut kathoum, kutsak kathoum, kamthim, âthi, paling, loukloukkaang meikahawicalah ka carouk thai e ni hai a tawk.
Hmuen kathoung a pankinae pueng koe hno hane suinaw pueng, a poe awh e teh hmuen kathoung thung khingnae patetlah pong 2, 195 touh a pha.
Touk tangcoung e tamimaya koe kabawknaw ni a poe awh e ngun hmuen kathoung koe khingnae patetlah pong 7, 550 touh a pha.
Kum 20 lathueng touk tangcoung e tamimaya koe kacetnaw teh 603, 550 touh a pha teh, hmuen kathoung koe khingnae patetlah a poe awh e teh khing tangawn lengkaleng a pha.
Hahoi ngun thung hoi pong 7, 500 touh teh hmuen kathoung khomnaw pacawp hane hoi ung nahanelah a hno awh. Pacawpnae hah 100 touh a pha teh, pacawpnae buet touh ramuk nahanelah hno e teh pong 75 touh a pha.
Ka cawi e ngun pong 50 touh hoi khom dawk bangnae hah a sak teh, khom ramuknae teh ngun tui hoi hluk e lah ao. Hahoi yapnae pangkhek hah a sak.
A poe awh e rahum talen 70 touh hoi shekel 2,400 touh a pha.
Hot teh kamkhuengnae takhang khom pâhungnae khom pacawp hoi rahum khoungroe hoi rahum cuekkarue hoi,
lukkareiim kamkhuengnae thongma petkâkalup lah khom pâhungnae khom pacawp hoi lukkareiim hetnae pueng lah koung a hno awh.
Hahoi kamthim, âthi, paling naw hoi hmuen kathoung thaw tawk nahanelah a meikahawicalah khohna hah a sak teh, BAWIPA ni Mosi koe kâ a poe e patetlah Aron hanelah kathounge khohna hah a sak.
Sui, kamthim, âthi, paling loukloukkaang e hoi carouk e vaihma angki hah a sak.
Sui hah ka rapamcalah a dêi teh ayung lahoi a bawng teh, kamthim, âthi, paling, loukloukkaang e kutsakkathoume ni a carouk teh a sak.
Kâyeng e 20 touh lah a sak teh, angki a lathueng lae a rai roi a kâkuet nahanelah rui hoi a sui sin.
Angki van kâyeng hane taisawm meikahawicalah kawng e hah angki hoi kâvan e lah ao teh, BAWIPA ni Mosi koe kâ a poe e patetlah sui hoi kamthim, âthi, paling, loukloukkaang e carouk e hoi kawng e doeh.
Karnelian talung kahni touh a kata awh teh, sui tabu thung a bet awh. Kuthrawt dawk min thuk e patetlah Isarel miphunnaw e minnaw hah a thut.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe lawk a thui e patetlah Isarel miphunnaw pahnim hoeh nahanelah, hote talung kahni touh hah vaihma angki kâyengnae dawk a bet awh.
Saiphei hah vaihma angki sak e patetlah sui, kamthim, âthi, paling, loukloukkaang e carouk e hoi a sak.
Bawkhni touh lah thep e lah ao teh, takin pali touh lah a o, ayung khap touh, adangka khap touh, takin pali touh hoi rei a kâvan.
Saiphei dawk talung 40 touh lah a pâthit. Apasueke rui dawk Sardius, topaz, emerald doeh.
Apâhni e rui dawk emerald, sapphire hoi diamon doeh.
Apâthum e rui dawk Jacinth, agate hoi amethyst doeh.
Apali e rui dawk beril, onyx, hoi jasper doeh. Hotnaw teh sui tabu dawk a pâthit awh.
Isarelnaw miphun hlaikahni touh e hah noutnae min thut e patetlah, hote talungnaw dawkvah, hote hlaikahni touh e minnaw hah a thut teh, talung buet touh dawk min buet buet touh rip ao.
Hahoi saiphei van vah, tangron patetlae dingyin sui kathoung hoi a sak.
Sui pahla vei e kahni touh hoi sui laikaw kahni touh a sak teh, saiphei dawk laikaw kahni touh hah a bang.
Hahoi suibawtarui vei e kahni touh hah saiphei a tâphai lae rui dawk e laikaw dawkvah a sui.
A meikahawicalah vei e dingyin kahni touh avanglae asomnaw teh, sui pahla vei e kahni touh dawkvah, a patawp awh teh, vaihma angki a hma lae kâyengnae dawk a sui.
Sui laikaw kahni touh a sak teh, ephod rahim lah kaawm e saiphei rahim lae taki kahni touh dawk a bang.
Alouke sui laikaw kahni touh hai a sak teh, vaihma angki a hma lae rahimca hoi kâyengnae lathueng patawpnae koe angki hah avangvanglah a bet.
Saiphei sui laikaw kahni touh hah vaihma angki, sui laikaw kahni touh hoi mek sui teh, kamthim e pahlarui hoi a sak. Hottelah BAWIPA ni Mosi koe lawk a thui e patetlah saiphei teh kâyengnae dawkvah bang lah ao teh, vaihma angki hoi reirei pou ao.
Hahoi vaihma angkidung teh kamthim hoi dueng kawng e hoi a sak.
Angkidung lungui vah angki kutkaduem patetlah a aw sak. Ka aw e teh a kâphi hoeh nahanelah, a rai hah pou a yep.
Angkidung dawkvah, tale paw mei hah kamthim, âthi, paling, loukloukkaang e carouk e hoi a sak.
Hahoi sui kathoung hoi dinghlingnaw hah a sak teh, angki pawi dawk e talepaw rahak vah cakhout laihoi a bang.
BAWIPA ni Mosi kâ a poe e patetlah dinghling buet touh hoi tale paw buet touh rip hah angki pawi petkâkalup lah thaw tawk nahanelah kamthoupnae dawk a ta.
Hahoi Aron hoi a capanaw hanelah loukloukkaang e hoi kawng e hah a sak.
Loukloukkaang e hoi sak e vaihma lupawk hoi luhuem, loukloukkaang e hoi sak e hnadung hoi,
loukloukkaang e carouk e hoi kamthim, âthi, paling hoi meikahawicalah em la e hoi kathoumnaw ni em la e taisawm hoi BAWIPA ni Mosi koe kâ a poe e patetlah a sak.

Hottelah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim, thaw pueng teh cum lah ao. BAWIPA ni Mosi koe sak hanelah kâ a poe e naw patetlah Isarelnaw ni a tarawi awh.

Tutan pho kapaling bu e khunae hoi saram pho hoi sak e a kânguenae a kâkapek nahane yaphninaw hai thoseh,
Lawkpanuesaknae thingkong hai kâkayawtnae acung, lungmanae tungkhung hai thoseh,
caboi hoi hnopainaw pueng hoi vaiyei tanae hai thoseh,
suikathoung hoi sak e hmaiimkhok hoi hmaiim hoi, hnopai pueng hoi paang nahane satui hoi thoseh,

apasueke thapa, apasuek hnin vah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim hah na sak han.
A thung vah lawkpanuesaknae thingkong hah na hruek vaiteh, yaphni hoi na ngue sak han.
Caboi hah na kâenkhai vaiteh, avan kaawm e hnonaw hah na hruek han, hmaiimkhok hah na kâenkhai vaiteh, hmaiim hah na hruek han.
Hmuitui hmaisawinae sui khoungroe hah lawkpanuesaknae hmalah na hruek vaiteh, lukkareiim takhang yaphni hah na yap han.
Hmaisawi thuengnae khoungroe hah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang hmalah na hruek han.
Kamkhuengnae lukkareiim hoi khoungroe rahak vah kawlung na hruek vaiteh, hawvah tui na hlun han.
Lukkareiim petkâkalup lah kalupnae thungup thongma na sak vaiteh, kalupnae longkha dawk yaphni na yap han.
Hluk e satui hah la vaiteh, lukkareiim hoi a thung kaawmnaw pueng hah hluk vaiteh, na thoung sak han, hnopainaw pueng hai hottelah a thoung awh han.
Hmaisawi thuengnae khoungroe hoi hnopai pueng hah satui hluk vaiteh, khoungroe hah na thoung sak han. Hottelah khoungroe teh kathoungpounge lah ao han.
Kawlung hoi pâhungnae hah satui na hluk vaiteh na thoung sak han.
Aron hoi a capanaw hah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang koevah, thokhai vaiteh, tui hoi na pâsu han.
Aron hah kathounge khohna hah na kho sak vaiteh, vaihma thaw kai han a tawk thai nahanelah, satui na hluk vaiteh na thoung sak han.
A capanaw hai thokhai vaiteh, angki na kho sak han.
Hottelah vaihma thaw kai han a tawk thai awh nahanelah a na pa satui na hluk e patetlah satui na hluk han. Satui hluk lah ao awh e heh a ca catounnaw totouh a yungyoe vaihma lah ao awh nahanelah pouk pouh e lah pou ao han telah ahnimouh hanlah mitnoutnae lah ao telah a dei.

hot van hmuitui hmai a sawi.
Hahoi lukkareiim takhang yaphni hah a yap.
BAWIPA ni Mosi kâ a poe tangcoung patetlah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang kung koevah, hmaisawi thuengnae khoungroe hah a hruek teh, hot van vah hmaisawi thuengnae hoi canei thuengnae hah a thueng.

Mosi, Aron hoi a capanaw ni haw vah a kutnaw hoi a khoknaw hah a pâsu awh.
Kamkhuengnae lukkareiim thung a kâen han nah hoi, khoungroe teng a cei awh han nah ouk a pâsu awh.
Hahoi lukkareiim hoi khoungroe petkâkalup lah a kalup teh, thongma e longkha dawk yaphni hah a yap teh, hottelah Mosi ni thaw hateh a cum.

Tu, hmae hah hmaisawi thuengnae lah sak han na ngai pawiteh, kacueme a na tongpa na thokhai vaiteh,

A khok hoi a ruenthinnaw hah tui hoi hmaloe a pâsu han. Vaihma ni abuemlahoi a sin vaiteh khoungroe van hmai a sawi han. Hetteh, BAWIPA koe hmaisawi hmuitui thuengnae lah ao.
BAWIPA koe tava hoi hmaisawi thuengnae sak hanlah na ngai pawiteh, bakhu thoseh, âbakhu thoseh, na thokhai vaiteh na poe han.
Vaihma ni khoungroe koe a thokhai hnukkhu, a lahuen a kapen vaiteh khoungroe van hmai a sawi han. A thi teh khoungroe teng a pacâ han.
A yoncapo hoi a cuekcaduen dawk e rawcanaw hah na la hnukkhu hraba tanae hmuen, khoungroe hmalah a tâkhawng han.
A rathei khuehoi tava a sei vaiteh vaihma ni khoungroe van e thing van hmai a sawi han. Hetteh, BAWIPA koe hmaisawi hmuitui thuengnae lah ao.
BAWIPA koe tavai hoi thuengnae sak hanlah na ngai pawiteh, tavai kaneng e na sin han. Tavai e avan satui na awi vaiteh, frankinsen hai na thum han.

Na kanawi tangcoung e cakang youn touh, satui youn touh, frankinsen kaawm e puenghoi vaihma ni hmaisawi han. Hetteh, BAWIPA koe hmaisawi thuengnae lah ao.
Maito hoi roum thuengnae sak hanlah na ngai pawiteh, kacueme atan nakunghai ala nakunghai buetbuet touh BAWIPA koe na sin han.
Maito lû van amae kut a toung vaiteh, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang teng a thei hnukkhu, Aron e capa vaihmanaw ni khoungroe petkâtue lah a thi a kahei awh han.
A ruen ka ramuk e athaw, a ruen hoi kâkuen e athaw, patuen dawk kaawm e kuen kahni touh dawk e athaw,
kuen hoi cungtalah thin van kaawm e maimaranaw hah, roum thuengnae sathei thung e la vaiteh, BAWIPA koe hmai hoi thueng hanelah poe hnukkhu,
Aron e a capanaw ni khoungroe van ta e sathei hoi cungtalah hmai a sawi a han. Hetteh, BAWIPA koe hmuitui hmaisawi thuengnae lah ao.
BAWIPA koe tu hoi hmae hah roum thuengnae sak han na ngai pawiteh, toun kaawm hoeh e atan nakunghai ala nakunghai buetbuet touh na sin han.
Tuca thuengnae lah sak han na ngai pawiteh BAWIPA hmalah na poe hnukkhu,
Tu e a lû van amae kut a toung vaiteh kamkhuengnae lukkareiim hmalah a thei hnukkhu, Aron e capanaw ni thuengnae khoungroe van a thi petkâtue lah a kahei han.
Atak dawk e athaw, a kenghru tâtueng e, a moi abuemlah, a ruen ka ramuk e athaw, a ruen dawk e athaw,
Patuen dawk kaawm e kuen kahni touh dawk e athaw, kuen hoi thin dawk e maimaranaw, roumnae sathei dawk e na la vaiteh BAWIPA koe thuengnae na sak hnukkhu,
Vaihma ni khoungroe van hmai a sawi han. BAWIPA koe hmaisawi thuengnae sak e rawca katuilah ao.
Hmae hoi thuengnae sak han na ngai pawiteh BAWIPA hmalah a thokhai han.
Hmae lû dawk a kut toung vaiteh kamkhuengnae lukkareiim hmalah a thei hnukkhu, Aron e capanaw ni khoungroe petkâtue lah a thi hah a kahei han.
A ruen ka ramuk e athaw, a ruen dawk e athaw,
Patuen dawk kaawm e kuen kahni touh hoi cungtalah athin dawk e maimaranaw, ama ni thuengnae dawk e a la vaiteh, BAWIPA koe hmaisawi thuengnae sak hanlah a poe hnukkhu,
Vaihma ni khoungroe van hmai a sawi han. Hmuitui hanlah hmaisawi thuengnae lah ao. Athaw kaawm e pueng teh BAWIPA e lah doeh ao.
Na miphun catounnaw ni ao na tangkuem koe a thaw hoi a thi hah cat mahoeh telah yungyoe e kâpoe e lah ao telah atipouh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe, nang ni na miphunnaw koe patuen bout na dei pouh hane teh,
Phunglawk panuek awh hoeh, kâlawk a tapoe teh a sak hoeh hane kawi sakpayon pawiteh,
Satui awi e vaihma ni yon sak hanlah taminaw a tacuek teh ama hai yon pawiteh, hote yontha nahanelah yon ka tawn hoeh e maitotanca hah
Rangpui kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang teng, BAWIPA hmalah a thokhai vaiteh BAWIPA koe a poe han. Hahoi, maito lû dawk a kut toung vaiteh BAWIPA hmalah maito a thei han.
Satui awi e vaihma ni maito thi a la vaiteh kamkhuengnae lukkareiim koe a sin hnukkhu,
Amae kutdawn hah thi dawk a ranup vaiteh, kathounge hmuen, lukkarei yap e hmalah, BAWIPA hmalah vai sari touh a kahei han.
Vaihma ni kamkhuengnae lukkareiim thung BAWIPA hmalah kaawm e hmuitui thuengnae khoungroe naw dawk maito thi a hluk vaiteh, kacawie a thi hah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang hmalah kaawm e hmaisawinae khoungroe kung koe a rabawk han.
Roum thuengnae sathei dawk e maito thaw la e patetlah kâmaihawi nahanlah sak e maito ruen ka ramuk e athaw, a ruen dawk kaawm e athaw,
Patuen dawk kaawm e kuen kahni touh hoi thin dawk e maimara, athaw kaawm e pueng a la vaiteh,
Thuengnae khoungroe van hmai a sawi han.
Maito e a lû, a khok, a ruen, a ruen kanem hoi a vuen, a moi kaawm e pueng,
Maito buem hah lukkareiim alawilah hraba rabawknae hmuen kathoung koe a ceikhai vaiteh thing van hmai a sawi han. Hraba rabawknae hmuen koe hmai a sawi han.
Isarel miphun abuemlah ni, phunglawk panuek laipalah sak kawi hoeh e yon hoi kâlawk a tapoe teh yon sakpayon pawiteh,
Hottelah, a sak payonnae yon a kâpanue torei teh, hote yon hanlah tamimaya ni a kum kanaw e maitotan hah, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim hmalah a thokhai han.
Rangpui thung dawk a kum kacuenaw ni BAWIPA hmalah maito lû van kut toung vaiteh a thei han.
Satui awi e vaihma ni kamkhuengnae lukkareiim koe maito thi a sin hnukkhu,
A kutdawn hah thi dawk a ranup vaiteh BAWIPA koe lukkarei yap e hmalah vai sari touh a kahei han.
Vaihma ni kamkhuengnae lukkareiim thung, BAWIPA hmalah kaawm e thuengnae khoungroekinaw dawk thi a hlun vaiteh kacawie thi teh, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang hmalah kaawm e hmaisawi thuengnae khoungroe kung koe a rabawk han.
Maito thaw pueng a la vaiteh khoungroe van hmai a sawi han.
Yontha nahanlah maito hoi thuengnae sak e patetlah vaihma ni taminaw hanelah yonthanae sak pawiteh, ahnimae yontha lah ao han.
Hathnukkhu hoi maito hah rim alawilah a hrawi awh vaiteh, apasueke maito hmaisawi e patetlah hmai a sawi awh han. Hethateh, taminaw yontha nahanlah thuengnae sak e doeh.
Ukkung ni hai phunglawk panuek laipalah, BAWIPA e kâlawk a tapoe teh sak hoeh hane kawi yon, sakpayon pawiteh,
Ama ni a sakpayon e yon a kâpanue torei teh, kacueme hmaetanca thueng nahanelah a thokhai han.
Hmae lû van amae kut a toung vaiteh, BAWIPA hmalah, hmaisawinae, sathei theinae hmuen koe a thei han. Hethateh, yontha nahanlah sak e thuengnae doeh.
Vaihma ni yonthanae sathei thi hah, kutdawn hoi a la vaiteh, hmaisawi thuengnae khoungroe kinaw dawk a hlun hnukkhu, kacawie thi hah, khoungroe kung koe na rabawk han.
Roum thuengnae sathei thaw sak e patetlah athaw pueng, khoungroe van hmai a sawi han. Hot patetlah vaihma ni ukkung e yontha nahanlah sak pawiteh, yontha lah ao han.
Mathoe buetbuet touh ni phunglawk panuek laipalah BAWIPA e kâlawk a tapoe teh sak kawi hoeh e yon sak pawiteh,
Ama ni a sak e yon a kâpanue torei teh, hote yon hanelah, kacueme hmaelaca a thokhai han.
Kâmaihawinae sathei, Hmae lû van, amae kut a toung vaiteh, hmaisawinae sathei theinae hmuen koe hote hmae a thei han.
Vaihma ni a kutdawn hoi a thi a sin vaiteh khoungroe kinaw dawk a hlun hnukkhu, kacawie hah, khoungroe kung koe a rabawk han.
Roum thuengnae sathei thaw la e patetlah athaw kaawm pueng a la vaiteh, BAWIPA koe hmuitui hanlah khoungroe van hmai a sawi han. Hottelah, vaihma ni hote tami hanlah yonthanae sak pouh pawiteh, a yontha lah ao han.
Tuca hoi yonthanae sak hanlah na ngai pawiteh kacueme napui na thokhai han.
Kâmaihawinae sathei tu lû van amae kut a toung vaiteh, hmaisawinae sathei theinae hmuen koe a thei han.
Vaihma ni hote sathei thi a kutdawn hoi a la vaiteh, hmaisawi thuengnae khoungroe kinaw dawk a hlun hnukkhu, a kahei vaiteh, kacawie thi hah khoungroe kung koe a rabawk han.
Roumnae thuengnae tuca thaw sak e patetlah athaw kaawm pueng la vaiteh, BAWIPA koe hmaisawi thuengnae hoi cungtalah, khoungroe van hmai a sawi han. Hottelah, vaihma ni hote tami a sakpayon e yon hanlah yonthanae a sak pouh pawiteh a yontha lah ao han.
Tami buetbuet touh ni a hmu e hoi a panue e hno dawk, kapanuekkhaikung lah ao teh, a pathang e thoebonae a thai nahlangva, dei laipalah awm pawiteh, yonpennae teh ama ni a khang han.
Tami buetbuet touh ni kathounghoehe sarang, saring, vonpui hoi kâva e saring kathoung hoeh e kadout e ro tek pawiteh yonpen lah ao han.
Hot hnukkhu hoi, tami hanelah kathounghoehe, kakhin e lah kaawm e hno, a kâbet payon e hah bout a panue torei teh yon pen lah ao han.
Tami buetbuet touh ni kahawi hno thoseh, kathout hno thoseh, sut pouk laipalah lawkkamnae a sak teh, thoe a bo. Hote lawkkamnae bout a kâpanue torei teh, yon pen lah ao han.
Hetpatete yonpennae buet buet touh ao torei teh, Bangpatete nakunghai ama ni yonpâpho naseh.
A sakpayon e yontha nahanlah tu thoseh, hmae thoseh, a napui ca buetbuet touh yon thueng nahanelah, Cathut koe a thokhai hnukkhu, vaihma ni hote tami hanelah yon thuengnae a sak pouh han.
Tuca tawn hoehpawiteh, a sak payonnae yontha nahanlah sathei buet touh hmai thueng nahanlah buet touh, bakhu kahni touh, hoeh pawiteh âbakhu kahni touh BAWIPA koe vaihma hmalah a thokhai han.
Vaihma ni yonthanae sathei hah hmaloe thuengnae a sak han. A lahuen a kapen vaiteh, a tâtueng han. A tak teh na sei mahoeh.
Hote yon thuengnae sathei thi hah, khoungroe tapang dawk a kahei vaiteh, kacawie a thi teh, khoungroe kung koe a paca han. Hethateh, yon thuengnae doeh.
Apâhni e tava teh a lamthung patetlah hmai thuengnae patetlah thuengnae a sak han. Hottelah, Vaihma ni ahnie a sakpayon e yon hanlah yonthanae a sak pouh pawiteh, ahnie yon teh tha lah ao han.
Bakhu kahni touh thoseh, âbakhu kahni touh thoseh, buetbuet touh coung thai hoehpawiteh, yon ka sak e tami ni yon thuengnae sathei yueng lah tavai ephah pung hra pung touh a thokhai han. Yon thuengnae lah ao dawkvah satui hoi frankinsen na awi mahoeh.
Vaihma koe na thokhai hnukkhu, vaihma ni tavai vai touh kasum a la vaiteh, BAWIPA koe hmai thuengnae hoi cungtalah khoungroe van hmai a sawi han. Hethateh, yon thuengnae lah ao.
Hettelah, vaihma ni hote tami ni a sakpayon e yon hanelah yon thuengnae sak pawiteh ahnie yontha lah ao han. Kacawie teh tavai thuengnae patetlah vaihma hanelah ao han telah Mosi koe atipouh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe bout a dei pouh e teh,
Tami buetbuet touh ni phunglawk panuek laipalah BAWIPA hoi kâkuen e hno dawk payon pawiteh, hote payonnae hanlah yonthanae sathei tie tutan hmuen kathoung koe e patetlah ngun tangka a to vaiteh, BAWIPA koe a thokhai han.
Hottelah, BAWIPA hoi kâkuen e hno dawk, a sakpayon e hanlah, panga touh dawk buet touh a thapsin vaiteh, vaihma koe a poe han. Vaihma ni hai yonthanae sathei lah kaawm e tu hoi hote tami hanelah yonthanae sak pouh pawiteh, ahnie yon teh tha lah ao han.
Tami buetbuet touh ni BAWIPA ni kâ a poe e sakpayon pawiteh, a sak payonnae ama ni a panue hoeh nakunghai a sak hno teh ama ni a khang han.
Yonnae ngaithoum nahanelah, kacueme tutan, vaihma koe a thokhai han. Phunglawk panuek laipalah, a sakpayon nakunghai, amahoima yonnae kâpanuek hoeh e tami hanelah vaihma ni yonthanae sak pouh pawiteh, ahnie yon teh tha lah ao han.
Hettelah, BAWIPA ka taran niteh, kâ kaek katang e kâtapoe thuengnae doeh telah ati.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe bout a dei e teh,
Tami buetbuet touh ni a imri ni hnopai a kuem sak e dawk laithoe dei nakunghai thoseh, ayâ e hnopai a lawp nakunghai thoseh, laithoe a dei teh a imri a dum nakunghai thoseh,
Kahmat e hno a hmu navah laithoe a dei teh thoe ka bo nakunghai thoseh, hot patet lae yonnae buetbuet touh a sak teh BAWIPA koe sakpayon pawiteh,
Hote tami teh a yon kecu dawkvah, a lawphno ayâ dum laihoi a hmu e hnopai, ayâ ni a kuem sak e hnopai, a pâphawng e hnopai,
Kahmanhoeh lahoi thoe a kâbo e hnopai phu, a hmu e a phu hoi cungtalah, yon thuengnae hnin dawkvah katawnkung koe panga touh dawk pung touh, bout a poe sin han.
Yonnae a sak e dawk thueng nahanelah, kacueme tutan hah BAWIPA koe, vaihma hmalah a thokhai han.
Vaihma ni hote tami hanelah, BAWIPA koe yonthanae sak pouh pawiteh, ahnie yonnae pueng teh ngaithoum lah ao han atipouh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe bout a dei e teh,
Nang ni Aron hoi a capanaw koe, na dei pouh hane teh, hmaisawi thuengnae teh, sathei hah khoungroe hmai van karum tuettuet khodai totouh na o sak vaiteh, thuengnae khoungroe hmai teh pou na kamtawi sak han.
Vaihma ni lukkarei khohna a khohna vaiteh, khoungroe van e hraba a kawn vaiteh, khoungroe teng a ta han.
A khohna e bout a kâhleng vaiteh, hote hraba hah alawilah kathounge hmuen koe a sin han.
Thuengnae khoungroe hmai teh dout laipalah pou a kamtawi han. Vaihma ni amom tangkuem hmai a racum vaiteh thing van sathei a hruek han. Hote khoungroe van roum thuengnae sathei hai hmai a sawi han.
Thuengnae khoungroe hmai teh roum sak laipalah pou kamtawi sak han.
Tavai thuengnae teh Aron e capanaw ni khoungroe hmalah BAWIPA koe a thokhai awh han.
Tavai vai touh kasum, satui youn touh, frankinsen abuemlah a la vaiteh, BAWIPA koe hmuitui hanlah khoungroe van hmai a sawi han.
Kacawie naw teh Aron hoi a capanaw ni kamkhuengnae lukkareiim thung hmuen kathoung koe tonphuenhoehe a ca awh han.
Hote tavai dawk ton phuen vaiteh, vaiyei lah na sak mahoeh. Hmai hoi Kai koe thuengnae sak e thung dawk hote vaiyei hah ahnimouh hanlah kai ni ka poe toe. Yontha thuengnae, kâtapoe thuengnae patetlah kathoungpounge lah ao.
Aron hoi a capanaw pueng ni a ca awh han. Hmai hoi BAWIPA koe thuengnae ka tawk e pueng teh a kamthoung awh han, telah nangmae miphun catounnaw totouh a sak hane kâlawk doeh telah ati.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe bout a dei pouh e teh,
Aron hoi a capanaw ni satui a awinae hnin hoi, a yungyoe e thuengnae lah ao thai nahanlah, tavai ephah pung hra pung touh, amom lah tangawn tangduem lah tangawn BAWIPA koe thuengnae a sak awh han.
Hote tavai hah satui a awi vaiteh, ukkang dawk a karê vaiteh, vaiyei lah a sak hnukkhu, a thokhai awh vaiteh, a raen hnukkhu a kanuikapin naw hah BAWIPA koe hmuitui hanlah thuengnae a sak han.
Aron e hmuen dawk satui awi lah kaawm e a capa ni hai hote thuengnae a sak han. BAWIPA hanelah a yungyoe e kâlawk lah ao.
Vaihma hanelah tavai thuengnae kaawm pueng hmai koung a sawi han. Khoeroe cat mahoeh telah ati.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe bout a dei pouh e teh,
Nang ni Aron hoi a capanaw koe na dei pouh hane teh, yon thuengnae teh hmaisawi thuengnae sathei theinae hmuen koe, yonthanae sathei thei han. Hot teh, kathoungpounge lah ao.
yontha nahanlah thuengnae na ka sak pouh e vaihma ni kamkhuengnae lukkareiim thung hmuen kathoung koe a ca han.
Hote moi kâbet e pueng teh a thoung. Thi ni a tâcawn sin e khohnanaw hmuen kathoung koe a pâsu han.
Hote moi thawngnae talai hlaam rek hem han. Rahum hlaam pawiteh, hma vaiteh tui hoi pâsu han.
Vaihma tongpa naw pueng ni a ca awh han.
Kathoung poung e lah ao. Yonthanae sathei thi hah hmuen kathoung koe yontha nahanelah, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim thung a sin vaiteh, hote sathei moi hah cat mahoeh. Hmai a sawi han.
Kâtapoe thuengnae teh kathoungpounge lah ao.
Hmai thuengnae sathei, theinae hmuen koe, kâtapoe thuengnae sathei hah thei vaiteh khoungroe van petkâtue lah a thi kahei han.
A mai hoi cungtalah a ruen ka ramuk e athaw,
Kuen kahni touh dawk e athaw, kuen hoi cungtalah athin van kaawm e maimara dawk e athaw pueng na poe han.
Vaihma ni khoungroe van hmai a sawi vaiteh, Cathut koe hmai hoi thuengnae a sak han. Kâtapoe thuengnae lah ao.
A moi hai vaihma thung e tongpa pueng ni hmuen kathoung koe a ca awh han. Kathoung poung e lah ao.
Kâtapoe thuengnae teh yon thuengnae hoi a kâvan teh thuengnae ka sak pouh e vaihma ni a coe han.
Tami buetbuet touh ni a sak e hmaisawi thuengnae ka sak pouh e vaihma ni sathei e a vuen teh a la han.
A karênae dawk a karê e tavai thuengnae puenghoi ukkang dawk a karê e pueng teh vaihma ni a coe han.
Satui a awi nakunghai thoseh, a awi hoeh nakunghai thoseh, tavai thuengnae naw pueng Aron e a capanaw pueng ni suetalah a kârei awh han.
BAWIPA koe roum thuengnae tie teh,
Lunghawilawkdeinae dâw hanlah, thuengnae na sak pawiteh, lunghawilawkdeinae sathei hoi cungtalah satui kalawt e tonphuenhoehe phen, satui hoi sak e tonphuenhoehe kamrâw, satui kalawt e tavai hoi sak teh karê e vaiyeinaw hah na thueng han.
Hote vaiyei phen hloilah, roum thuengnae hoi kâseng e lunghawilawkdeinae dâwnae sathei hoi cungtalah tonphuenhoehe hai na thueng han.
Thuengnae pueng dawk e vaiyei buet touh BAWIPA koe thuengnae na sak vaiteh hote vaiyei hah roum thuengnae sathei thi kaheikung vaihma ni a coe han.
Lunghawilawkdeinae lah thueng e roum thuengnae sathei moi hah thueng hnin vah na ca han, amom hanelah bout pek mahoeh.
Hoehpawiteh, lawkkam laihoi thueng nakunghai thoseh, malungpouk thuengnae thoseh, thueng hnin vah sathei moi ca vaiteh kacawie moi hai atangtho bout ca han.
Kacawie a moi hah tawkkahnin hmaisawi han.
Roum thuengnae sathei moi, tawkkahnin vah yitca hai na cat payon pawiteh, a lungyouk hoeh e lah na o han. Thuengnae a sak e dâw pouh mahoeh. Panuetkatho e lah ao han. Ka cat e tami teh yon phu a hmu han.
Kathounghoehe hno hoi kâbet e sathei moi cat mahoeh. Hmaisawi han. Kathounge taminaw ni dueng hote sathei moi a ca awh han.
Apihai thoseh, kathounghoehe yon a tawn nahlangva, Cathut hoi kâseng e roum thuengnae sathei moi ka cat e tami teh, a miphun dawk hoi takhoe lah ao han.
Apihai thoseh, tami dawk thoung hoeh e hno, kathounghoehe moi, kathounghoehe pâri patet e hno buetbuet touh a kânep laihoi BAWIPA hoi kâkuen e roum thuengnae sathei moi cat pawiteh, hote tami teh a miphun dawk hoi takhoe lah ao han telah ati.
BAWIPA NI Mosi koe bout a dei pouh e teh,
Maito thoseh, Tu thoseh, hmae thoseh, athaw na cat a mahoeh.
Amahmawk kadout e saring e athaw hoi sarang ni a kei e athawnaw teh alouke hnonaw dawk na hno thai, eiteh na cat mahoeh.
Apihai thoseh, Cathut koe hmaisawi thuengnae sathei thaw ka cat e tami teh, a miphun dawk hoi takhoe lah ao han.
Na onae hmuen tangkuem koe a thi thoseh, tava thi thoseh, thi tie pueng na cat mahoeh.
Apihai thoseh thi kacate tami teh miphun dawk hoi takhoe lah ao han.
Cathut ni Mosi koe, na miphunnaw koe bout na dei pouh hane teh,
Cathut koe roum thuengnae sathei ka thueng e tami ni teh ama ni thueng hane sathei, BAWIPA koe poe hanelah a thokhai han.
Cathut hmalah takuep a sei vaiteh, takuep hoi athaw hah hmai hoi Cathut koe thueng e hah na thokhai han.
Vaihma ni athaw hah khoungroe van hmai a sawi vaiteh, Aron hoi a capanaw ni takuep teh a la awh han.
Roum thuengnae sathei thung dawk e aranglae aphai thueng hanelah. vaihma koe a poe han.
Aron e capanaw thung dawk roum thuengnae sathei a thi hoi athaw thuengnae ka sak e tami ni aphai a ham han.
Isarel miphunnaw ni a sak e roum thuengnae satheinaw thung dawk e rek sei e takuep hoi aphai teh ka la vaiteh Isarel miphun Aron hoi a capanaw, yungyoe e aphung lah ka poe toe telah ati.
Hottelah, Aron hoi a capanaw ni Cathut hmalah vaihma thaw tawk hanelah, ahnimanaw a rawinae hnin dawk BAWIPA koe, hmai hoi canei kawi naw thuengnae thung dawk e ahnimouh ni a ham awh hane doeh.
Isarel miphunnaw dawk hoi e hot patet lae a coe a nahanelah, ahnimanaw teh satui awinae hnin dawkvah BAWIPA ni kâ a poe toe.
Hete lawk teh Isarel miphunnaw ni Sinai kahrawng dawk Cathut koe thuengnae a sak hanelah,
Kâtapoenae hnin nah, Sinai mon dawk Cathut ni Mosi koe a poe e hmaisawi thuengnae, tavai thuengnae, yon thuengnae, kâtapoe thuengnae, thaw poe thuengnae hoi roum thuengnae naw doeh atipouh.
Cathut ni Mosi koe bout a dei pouh e teh,
Aron hoi a capanaw ni a khohna hane naw, kâhluk han satui, yon thueng nahan maitotan, tutan, kahni touh, tonphuenhoehe tangthung buet touh a tho khai vaiteh,
Rangpui kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang hmalah, tamimaya abuemlah kamkhueng sak awh, telah Mosi koe kâ a poe e patetlah,
Mosi ni a tawk teh, tamimaya teh lukkareiim takhang hmalah a kamkhueng awh.
Mosi ni hai tamimaya koe Cathut ni hettelah lawk na thui toe atipouh teh,
Cathut ni lawkthui e patetlah Aron hoi a capanaw a kaw teh tui a pâhluk hnukkhu,
Aron hai angki a kho sak teh, taisawm a kâyeng sak. Angkidung a kho sak teh, vaihma angki a kâkhu sak. Vaihma angkikep khan nahan e a meikahawicalah kawng e angki a kho sak teh a khan pouh.
A lungtabue a ramuk sak teh athung vah, Urim hoi Thummim hah a hruek.
A lû dawkvah lupawk a pawk teh, kathounge sui phen lupawk hmalah a bet.
Cathut ni lawkthui e patetlah Mosi ni a hluk nahane satui a la teh, lukkareiim hoi athung e puengcangnaw pueng hah a hluk teh a thoungsak.
Hote satui hah khoungroe puengcangnaw pueng thoseh, maroi hoi a khok hai thoseh, thoung sak hanelah a hluk.
Hluk nahan e satui hah Aron e lû dawk a awi pouh teh, thoung sak hanelah a hluk.
Aron e a capanaw hai angki a kho sak. Taisawm hai a kâyeng sak teh, bawilakhung a huem sak.
BAWIPA ni a dei pouh e patetlah yon thueng nahanelah maitotan a hrawi teh, Aron hoi a capanaw ni a lû van a kut a toung pouh han.
Maito a thei vaiteh, Mosi ni khoungroe petkâtue lah kinaw dawk thi hah a kutdawn hoi a la teh, khoungroe hah a thoung sak hnukkhu, kacawie a thi hah khoungroe kung koe a rabawk vaiteh, hote khoungroe van yon thueng nahanlah a thoungsak han.
A ruen ka ramuk e ahrei, athin van e maimara, kuen kahni touh dawk e athaw na la vaiteh, khoungroe van hmai na sawi han.
A vuen, a moi, a ei hoi cungtalah maito buem hah alawilah hmaisawi han.
Cathut ni lawk na thui e patetlah hmaisawi thueng nahane hah a thokhai teh, Aron hoi a capanaw ni tu lû van kut a toung sin awh.
Tu a thei hnukkhu, Mosi ni khoungroe petkâtue lah a thi a kahei.
Tu hah koung a raban hnukkhu, a lû, a moinaw hoi athaw hah hmai a sawi.
A von thung e naw hoi a khoknaw tui a pâsu teh, tu buem hah, khoungroe van hmai a sawi. Hmuitui hanlah hmaisawi thuengnae lah ao.
Cathut ni lawkthui e patetlah alouke tu yueng lah, a rawi e tu a thokhai vaiteh, Aron hoi a capanaw ni tu lû van kut a toung pouh awh.
Tu a thei hnukkhu, Mosi ni thi a la teh, Aron e aranglae hnârakong dawk thoseh, aranglae kut pui hoi aranglae khokpui dawk thoseh, a hluk pouh.
Aron e a capanaw hai a kaw teh, ahnimouh e, aranglae hnârakong, aranglae kutpui hoi khokpui dawk hai thoseh a hluk pouh hnukkhu, khoungroe van petkâtue lah a kahei.
A thaw, a mai, a ruen ka ramuk e a hrei, a thin ka ramuk e maimara, a kuen kahni touh hoi akuen ka ramuk e athaw, aranglae aphai,
Cathut hmalah tangthung dawk ta e tonphuenhoehe buet touh, satui hoi sak e vaiyei a phen buet touh, vaiyei karê e buet touh a la teh, satui hoi aranglae aphai van a hruek hnukkhu,
Aron e a kut, a capanaw e a kut dawk, hote hnonaw hah a hruek teh, Cathut e hmalah a kahek teh, kahek thuengnae a sak.
Mosi ni ahnimae a kut dawk e a la teh, khoungroe van, hmaisawi thuengnae sathei hoi cungtalah hmai a sawi han. Hmuitui teh thaw poe thuengnae lah ao. BAWIPA koe hmai hoi thuengnae lah ao.
Hathnukkhu, Mosi ni takuep a la teh BAWIPA hmalah a kahek teh kahek thuengnae a sak. Tu takuep teh Mosi ham lah ao.
Mosi ni khoungroe van kaawm e a thi hoi kâhluk hane satui a la teh, Aron hoi a khohna e dawk thoseh, a capanaw hoi a khohna e naw dawk hai thoseh, a kahei teh, Aron hoi a capanaw, khohnanaw a thoungsak.
Mosi ni Aron hoi a capanaw koe, hote thi moi hah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang teng a thawng awh. BAWIPA ni Aron hoi a capanaw ni hote moi, a ca awh han, telah kai koe lawk na thui e patetlah hote moi thoseh, thawpoe thuengnae tangthung dawk kaawm e vaiyei thoseh, hote hmuen koe cat awh.
Kacawie moi hoi vaiyei teh hmai na sawi han.
Thawpoe thoungnae hnin sari akuep hoehnahlan kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang thung hoi alawilah na tâcawt mahoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, hnin sari touh thung na kamthoung awh han.
Sahnin na sak a e patetlah nangmouh hane yon thuengnae na sak a hanelah Cathut ni lawk na thui awh toe.
Hatdawkvah, nangmouh duenae dawk hoi na hlout a nahanelah, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang teng vah, hnin sari touh thung karum khodai na o awh vaiteh, Cathut ni kâ na poe e na tarawi awh han. Hottelah Cathut ni lawk na thui toe tie patuen ka dei e lah ao teh,
BAWIPA ni Mosi koehoi lawk thui e naw pueng Aron hoi a capanaw ni a sak awh.
A hnin taroe hnin dawk Mosi ni Aron hoi a capanaw, Isarel miphun, kacuenaw a kaw teh,
Aron koe, nang ni yon thueng nahanelah, kacueme maito kum kanaw e buet touh, hmaisawi thueng nahanelah, kacueme tutan buet touh, na thokhai vaiteh, Cathut hmalah thuengnae sak loe.
Isarel miphunnaw koehai thoseh, nangmouh ni yon thueng nahanlah, hmae kum kanaw e buet touh, hmaisawi thueng nahanlah, âvâ ka cawt hoeh rae maitoca buet touh,
Tuca buet touh, BAWIPA koe roum thueng nahanlah, maitotan buet touh, tutan buet touh, satui hoi kalawt e vaiyei thuengnae hah thokhai loe. Sahnin nangmouh koe BAWIPA a kamnue han telah dei pouh loe atipouh.
Mosi ni kâ a poe e patetlah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim hmalah a thokhai hnukkhu, tamimaya naw ni a hnai teh, BAWIPA hmalah a kangdue awh.
Mosi ni hai nangmouh ni BAWIPA ni kâ na poe e patetlah hottelah na sak awh teh, BAWIPA e bawilennae teh nangmouh koe a kamnue han telah atipouh.
Mosi ni Aron koe, khoungroe koe, cet nateh, Cathut ni kâ na poe e patetlah nama e thuengnae, hmaisawi thuengnae sak nateh, nama hoi na taminaw hanelah, yonthanae sak awh. Taminaw ni a thokhai e sathei thuengnae a thueng teh taminaw hanlah yonthanae sak awh, telah atipouh.
Aron ni hai khoungroe koe a cei teh, ama hanlah yon thuengnae maitoca a thei.
A capanaw ni a thi a sin awh teh, Aron ni a kutdawn thi dawk a ranup teh, khoungroe kinaw dawk a hlun hnukkhu, kacawie a thi hah khoungroe kung koe a rabawk.
Yon thuengnae sathei thaw, akuen, athin van e maimara hah khoungroe van hmai a sawi. Hottelah, Cathut ni Mosi koe kâ a poe.
A moi hoi a vuen teh alawilah hmai a sawi.
Hmaisawi thuengnae sathei hai a thei teh a capanaw ni Aron koe thi a poe teh ahni ni khoungroe petkâtue lah a kahei.
Ahnimanaw ni hmaisawi thuengnae sathei moi, takpatinaw hoi a lû hah a poe teh Aron ni khoungroe van hmai a sawi.
A vonthung e naw hoi a khoknaw hah a pâsu teh, khoungroe van kaawm e sathei hoi cungtalah hmai sawi.
Taminaw ni thueng nahanelah a thokhai teh, taminaw e yon thuengnae lah kaawm e hmae a thei hnukkhu, ahmaloe e patetlah yon thuengnae a sak.
Hmaisawi thuengnae sathei hai a thokhai awh teh, hot patetlah a sak.
Tavai thuengnae hai a sin teh, vai touh kasum a la teh, khoungroe dawk amom lah hmaisawi thuengnae khoungroe dawk hmai a sawi.
Taminaw hanelah roum thuengnae maitotan, tutan hai a thei awh teh, a capanaw ni thi a sin hnukkhu, khoungroe van petkâtue lah thi a kahei awh.
A mai hoi a ruen ka ramuk e ahrei, a kuen, a thin van e a maimaranaw, tu hoi maito e athaw hah,
A takuep van a toung vaiteh, khoungroe dawk hmai a sawi.
Takuep hoi aranglae aphai hah BAWIPA hmalah a kahek teh kahek thuengnae a sak. Hottelah, sak hanelah Mosi ni kâ a poe.
Aron ni amae kut a dâw teh, ayânaw yawhawi a poe teh, yon thuengnae, hmaisawi thuengnae, roum thuengnae a sak hnukkhu, a kumcathuk.
Mosi hoi Aron ni kamkhuengnae lukkareiim thung bout a kâen teh a tâco hnukkhu, taminaw yawhawinae a poe teh, BAWIPA e bawilennae teh taminaw koe a kamnue.
Cathut koehoi hmai a tâco teh, khoungroe van kaawm e hmaisawi thuengnae sathei hoi athaw, hmai a kak. Hote taminaw ni a hmu awh navah a hram awh teh a tabo awh.
Aron e a capa Nadab hoi Abihu ni hmai sinnae tawngben a la roi teh, hmai a hruek roi. Hmai dawk hmuitui a phuen hnukkhu, BAWIPA ni kâ a poe hoeh e ka talue e hmai hoi thuengnae a sak roi.
Hatdawkvah, BAWIPA koehoi hmai a tâco teh, BAWIPA hmalah hmai a kak teh a due roi.
Mosi ni Aron a kaw teh BAWIPA ni KAI teh kathounge lah ka o dawkvah, KAI koe kâhnai han kangainaw ni a pâkuem hane teh tami pueng ni ka lentoenae a bari awh han telah ka dei navah, Hot patetlah e doeh ka dei ngai telah ati hnukkhu, Aron teh lawkkamuem lah ao.
Mosi ni Aron e a na pa kanaw, Uzziel e capa Mishael hoi Elzaphan a kaw teh, tho roi haw, na hmaunawngha roi hah, hmuen kathoung koehoi alawilah kâkayawn roi ei telah atipouh e patetlah,
Ahnimouh roi ni a tho roi teh, angki khohna khue hoi rim alawilah a kâkayawt roi.
Mosi ni Aron hoi a capa roi, Eleazar hoi Ithamar a kaw teh, nangmouh hai na due awh han. Taminaw pueng koe lungkhueknae phat payon vaih ti a ngaihri teh, na bawilakhung rading awh hanh, khohna phi awh hanh. Hmaunawngha Isarel miphun abuemlah Cathut ni hmai hoi a kak sak e duengma khuikapkhai awh.
Nangmouh na due awh hoeh nahanelah, tamimaya kamkhuengnae takhang alawilah, tâcawt awh hanh. BAWIPA e satui awinae nangmouh koe ao telah, Mosi ni a dei e patetlah a sak awh.
BAWIPA ni Aron koe bout a dei pouh e teh,
Nang hoi na capanaw ni due awh hoeh nahanlah thoseh, kathoung hoi kathounghoehe, kakhin hoi
Kakhin hoeh e hnonaw, na kapek thai nahanlah thoseh,
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe a dei pouh e kâlawknaw hah, Isarel miphunnaw koe cangkhai thai nahanelah thoseh, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim dawk na kâen awh navah, Misurtui hoi paruithai e naw net awh hanh. Na miphun, catounnaw totouh na tarawi awh han e phung lah ao telah atipouh.
Mosi ni hai Aron hoi kahring rae capa Eleazar hoi Ithamar a kaw teh, BAWIPA koe hmaisawi thuengnae tavai kacawie lat nateh, tonphuenhoehe, khoungroe teng cat awh. Kathoung poung e lah ao.
Cathut koe hmai hoi thuengnae teh nang hoi na capanaw ni coe hane kawi lah ao dawkvah, hmuen kathoung koe na ca awh han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Hottelah kâpoe e lah ao dawk doeh.
Kahek e takuep hoi dâw e kahek e aphai teh, nama hoi cungtalah, na canaw hoi hmuen kathoung koe na ca awh han. Isarel miphunnaw ni roum thuengnae sathei thung dawk e nang hoi na capanaw ni ham hane kawi lah ao.
Hmaisawi thuengnae sathei thaw hoi cungtalah dâw e aphai, kahek e takuep, BAWIPA hmalah a kahek vaiteh, BAWIPA ni kâ a poe e patetlah nama hoi na capanaw ni yungyoe a ham han kawi phung lah ao han telah ati.
Mosi ni yon thuengnae hmae panki laihoi a tawng eiteh, pâphawng hoeh. Hmaisawi thuengnae lah oun a sak toe. Hatdawkvah, Aron e a capa Eleazar hoi Ithamar koe a lungkhuek teh,
Bangkongmaw, yon thuengnae sathei moi teh, a thoungpoung. Hatei, nangmouh ni rangpuinaw e yon na ham teh, BAWIPA hmalah ahnimouh hanelah yon thuengnae sak hanelah, hote sathei moi na poe a eiteh, bangkongmaw hmuen kathoung koe na ca awh hoeh vaw.
Hote sathei thi haiyah, hmuen kathoung koe na thokhai awh hoeh vaw. Kai ni lawk na thui e patetlah hmuen kathoung koe sathei moi ca han na tet awh pawiteh,
Aron ni sahnin ahnimouh ni taminaw hanlah, yon thuengnae sathei, hmaisawi thuengnae sathei, yo a thueng awh han toe. Kai koe hot patetlah e hno a tho dawkvah, sahnin yon thuengnae sathei moi ka cat pawiteh, Cathut lungyouk han na maw telah Mosi koe atipouh.
Mosi ni hote lawk a thai navah a lungkuep.
BAWIPA ni Mosi hoi Aron bout a kaw teh,
Nangmouh roi ni Isarelnaw koe patuen bout na dei pouh hane teh, talai van kaawm e moithang pueng dawk,
A khoksamen samka ni teh a thepkaai e moithangnaw teh ca thainae kâ ao.
Hatei, thepkaai ni teh khoksamen samka hoeh e moithang thung dawk, ca hoeh hane moithangnaw teh Kalauk teh athepai hoeh eiteh khoksamen samka hoeh dawkvah nangmouh hanlah thoung hoeh.
Kovei teh thepkaai eiteh a khoksamen samka hoeh dawkvah nangmouh hanlah thoung hoeh.
Saveh teh thepkaai eiteh a khoksamen samka hoeh dawkvah nangmouh hanlah thoung hoeh.
Vok teh a khoksamen samka eiteh thepkaai hoeh dawkvah nangmouh hanlah thoung hoeh.
Hot patet e moithangnaw e a moi na cat awh mahoeh. Ro haiyah na tek awh mahoeh. Kathounghoehe lah na pouk awh han.
Tuipui hoi sawkca dawk kaawm e moithangnaw thung dawk a rathei hoi a lakep kaawm e teh na ca awh han.
A rathei hoi a lakep kaawm hoeh e tuipui hoi sawkca dawk kaawm e moithang pueng teh nangmouh hanlah thoung hoeh.
A rathei hoi a lakep kaawm hoeh e tui dawk e moithang na cat awh mahoeh.
A ronaw hai panuettho e lah na pouk awh han.
Nangmouh ni panuettho e lah na pouk awh vaiteh na ca awh hoeh hane tavanaw teh: Mataw, Langta, Tawbu,
Mataw phun,
Vonga phun kuep,
Kalauk tava, bukbu phun kuep, batuiling phun kuep,
Kawhna hoi balengek,
Tuicawmpai,
Butakok phun kuep, Bongpi, Bongcakhat phun kuep,
A rathei ka tawn ni teh a khok pali touh hoi kacetnaw pueng teh nangmouh hanlah kathounghoehe lah ao.
Hateiteh, a rathei a tawn teh a khok pali touh hoi ka cet e phun dawk dawkcawk nahanlah a khok kasaw poung naw teh:
Samtong, pâluen, tawktaboe, Tawngkaruetnaw teh na ca awh han.
A rathei ka tawn ni teh a khok pali touh hoi ka cet e alouke moithang pueng teh nangmouh hanlah thoung hoeh.
Hote moithang lahoi nangmae thoungnae hah a khin thai. Hot patet e ro katek e tami teh tangmin totouh thoung hoeh.
Hote kadout e ro ka sin e tami teh khohna a pâsu han, tangmin totouh thoung hoeh.
A khoksamen samka hoeh e, a thepkaai hoeh e saring pueng teh nangmouh hanlah thoung hoeh.
A khoksamen samka hoeh e saring pueng teh nangmouh hanlah thoung hoeh. Hote ro ka tek e tami teh tangmin totouh thoung hoeh.
Hote ro ka phawt e tami pueng teh a khohna a pâsu han. Tangmin totouh thoung hoeh.
Talai dawk a vonpui hoi kâva e saring thung dawk thangbui, moihnam, Insi phun,
Tawkkei, Tawngkang, Cingkadawt, Dekko hoi Khaipadounnaw teh nangmouh hanlah thoung hoeh.
Hotnaw e ro katek e tami teh tangmin totouh thoung hoeh.
Hote kadout e a ro hah thingkawlung, khohna, a pho, cawngko patetlah e im dawk e hno e buet touh van bawt pawiteh thoung hoeh. Tui dawk ranup han. Tangmin totouh thoung hoeh. Hathnukkhu a thoung han.
Talai hlaam buetbuet touh van ro hah bawt pawiteh, Hote talai hlaam teh a thounghoeh dawkvah rek hem han.
Hote talai hlaam dawk e tui cakawi moi van vah, bawt pawiteh moi thoung hoeh. Hote talai hlaam dawk e nei hane tui hai thoung hoeh.
Takhuen dawk thoseh, lunghmu dawk thoseh, hote hno buetbuet touh bawt pawiteh nangmouh hanelah a thounghoeh dawkvah, peng raphoe han.
Hatei, sambuem, tai e tui im teh kathounghoehe lah awm hoeh. Ro ni a bosin e dueng doeh kathounghoehe lah ao.
Cati dawk hote ro bawt pawiteh, Cati teh kathounghoehe lah awm mahoeh.
Tui dawk padung tangcoung e cati dawk hote ro bawt pawiteh cati teh nangmouh hanlah thoung hoeh.
Nangmouh ni na ca han kawi saring dout pawiteh, ro katek e tami teh tangmin totouh thoung hoeh.
Hote ro ka cat e tami teh a khohna a pâsu han. Tangmin totouh thoung hoeh. Hote ro ka phawt e tami hai amae a khohna a pâsu han. Tangmin totouh thoung hoeh.
Talai dawk kâva e saringnaw pueng teh panuettho e lah ao dawkvah na cat awh mahoeh.
A khok tawn hoeh, a von hoi ka cet e thoseh, khok pali touh hoi ka cet e thoseh, khok pali hlak kapap e khok hoi ka cet e thoseh, talai dawk kâva e saring buet touh boehai na cat awh mahoeh. Panuetkatho e lah ao.
Kâva e saring buetbuet touh kecu namahoima kâkhinsak awh hanh. Hotnaw hoi nama kâkhinsak awh hanh.
Kai teh nangmae BAWIPA Cathut lah ka o. Kai teh kathoung dawkvah nangmouh haiyah namahoima kâthoung sak awh nateh thoungnae tawn awh. Talai dawk kâva e saring buet touh boe hoi hai kâkhinsak awh hanh.
Kai teh nangmae Cathut lah ka o nahanlah nangmouh teh Izip ram hoi na ka rasat e BAWIPA lah ka o. Kai teh kathoung dawkvah nangmouh hai thoungnae tawn awh.
Hetnaw teh, kathoung, kathoung hoeh, cakawi hoi cakawi hoeh e saringnaw kapek thai nahanelah,
Moi, tava, tui dawk kaawm e moithang, talai dawk kâva e moithangnaw puenghoi ka kâkuen e phunglawk doeh ati.
Cathut ni Mosi koe bout a dei pouh e teh, nang ni Isarel miphunnaw koe patuen na dei pouh hane teh,
Napui ni camo a vawn teh ca tongpa a khe hnukkhu, Kampheng nah hnin sari touh a thounghoeh e patetlah hnin sari totouh kathoung hoeh lah ao han.
Ataroe hnin nah vuensom a a pouh han.
Hat hnukkhu, thipaling kecu dawk a manu teh hnin sari touh a kâthoung sak lah ao han. A kâthoung saknae hnin akuep hoehroukrak kathounge hno tek mahoeh. Hmuen kathoung koehai cet mahoeh.
Hateiteh, napui khe pawiteh, kamphengnae patetlah yat hni touh thung kathounghoehe lah ao han. Thipaling kecu dawk hnin 66 touh a kâthoung sak han.
Ca tongpa thoseh, napui thoseh, kâthoung saknae hnin akuep torei teh, hmaisawi thueng nahanelah âvâ ka cawt hoeh rae tu ca buet touh, yonthueng nahanelah âbakhu buet touh, hoehpawiteh bakhu buet touh hah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang hmalah, vaihma koe a thokhai han.
Vaihma ni BAWIPA hmalah thuengnae a sak vaiteh, hote napui hanlah yon thuengnae a sak pouh vaiteh, ahni teh thi kârabawknae yon dawk hoi a thoung han.
Tuca coung thai hoehpawiteh, bakhu kahni touh thoseh, âbakhu ca kahni touh thoseh, hmaisawi thueng nahanlah buet touh, yon thueng nahanlah buet touh a thokhai vaiteh, vaihma ni ahni hanlah thuengnae a sak pouh vaiteh ahni teh a thoung han. Hete phunglawk teh ca tongpa, ca napui ka khe e manu hoi kâkuen e phunglawk doeh telah atipouh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi hoi Aron koe bout a dei e teh,
Tami ni a vuen dawk hluetkaco e thoseh, takpatha nakunghai thoseh, bahlaw thoseh, hrikbei mitnoutnae kamnuek pawiteh, hote tami hah vaihma Aron koe thoseh, a capa vaihma buetbuet touh koe thoseh, a thokhai han.
Vaihma ni hote tami e a vuen dawk e patawnae a khet vaiteh, patawnae dawk e a muen pangaw pawiteh patawnae teh vuen thung tak dawk ka phat e patetlah awm pawiteh ka hrikbei e doeh. Vaihma ni hote tami a khet hnukkhu, thoung hoeh telah a pouk han.
Bahlaw teh pangaw pawiteh vuen thung ka phat e mahoeh. Muen pangaw hoehpawiteh vaihma ni ka pataw e tami hah hnin sari touh a paung han.
Asari hnin vaihma ni a khet navah a vuen dawk e patawnae kampai hoehpawiteh hnin sari touh bout a paung han.
Asari hnin bout a khet navah ama paroup ni teh meimei tamang pawiteh hote tami teh a thoung telah vaihma ni a pathang han. Ka pathak rumram e lah doeh ao. Amae khohna a pâsu vaiteh kathounge lah ao.
Thoung sak hanelah vaihma ni a khet hnukkhu, ka pathak e hoehoe lui pawiteh,
Hote tami teh kathounghoehe lah a pathang vaiteh ka hrikbei e tami lah a khoe han.
Ka hrikbei e tami hah vaihma koe a ceikhai awh han.
Vaihma ni a khet navah, a vuen dawk ka pâphu ni teh a muen pangaw pawiteh, pâphu e dawk cawcawyu pawiteh,
Hrikbei karuem e doeh. Kathounghoehe tami telah vaihma ni a pouk vaiteh a paung han.
Ka hrikbei e tami teh atak buemlah a lû koehoi a khok koe totouh, vaihma ni a khet navah hrikbei kingkawi pawiteh,
Hot patet e atak dawk king kakawi e tami teh a thoung telah vaihma ni a pathang han. atak buemlah koung a pangaw dawkvah ahni teh a thoung.
Hateiteh, atak dawk cawcawyu pawiteh thoung hoeh.
Vaihma ni atak dawk cawcawyu e a khet navah, hote tami teh kathounghoehe lah a pathang han. Atak dawk cawcaw ka yu e tami teh thoung hoeh, ka hrikbei katang e doeh.
Cawcaw ka yu e atak kâthung lah bout pangaw pawiteh vaihma koe bout a thokhai han.
Vaihma ni a khet navah patawnae bout pangaw e hah hmawt pawiteh vaihma ni a thoung telah a pathang vaiteh, ahni teh a thoung toe.
Vuen dawk âhlut ao teh a dam hnukkhu,
Âhlut a onae a hmâ pangaw dawk a phing nakunghai thoseh, pangawpanang e hrikbei patetlah kamnuek pawiteh, vaihma ni a khet vaiteh,
Vuen thung lah a pha teh a muen pangaw pawiteh hote tami teh vaihma ni thoung hoeh telah a pathang han. Âhlut koehoi ka hrikbei e lah ao.
Vaihma ni a khet navah a muen ka pangaw e awm hoeh, vuen thung lah phat hoeh, meimei tamang pawiteh vaihma ni hote tami hah hnin sari touh a paung han.
Vuen dawk hmâ hoehoe len pawiteh hote tami teh vaihma ni thoung hoeh telah a pathang han. Hote tami teh ka hrikbei e doeh.
Hateiteh, kâlum e kampuen hoeh, kampai hoehpawiteh âhlut hmâ doeh. Hote tami teh a thoung telah a pathang han.
Tak dawk vuen hmai a kak teh hmaikakhma cawcaw ka yu e dawk ka paling pangaw lah awm pawiteh,
Vaihma ni a khet han. A hmâ dawk e muen a pangaw teh vuen thung ka phat e patetlah awm pawiteh hmai kak dawk hoi ka tho e hrikbei doeh. Hote tami teh thoung hoeh telah vaihma ni a pathang han. Hrikbei patawnae doeh.
Vaihma ni a khet navah a hmâ dawk a muen pangaw e awm hoeh, vuen thung phat hoeh, meimei tamang pawiteh vaihma ni hote tami teh hnin sari touh thung a paung han.
Apa sari hnin vaihma ni a khet navah, vuen dawk e hmâ hoe kampai pawiteh, hote tami teh thoung hoeh, hrikbei ka pataw e doeh telah vaihma ni a pathang han.
Hateiteh, vuen dawk kâlum e kampuen hoeh, kampai hoeh, meimei tamang pawiteh hmaikakhma karado e doeh. Hote tami teh vaihma ni a thoung telah a pathang han. Hmaikak hmâ rumram doeh.
Napui hoehpawiteh tongpa ni lû dawk thoseh, pâkha dawk thoseh, patawnae tawn pawiteh,
Vaihma ni a khet navah, vuen thung ka phat e lah ao teh a muen hai ka samenpanang lah awm pawiteh hote tami teh thoung hoeh telah vaihma ni a pathang han. Lû dawk e hai thoseh, pâkha dawk e hai thoseh raipha patawnae doeh.
Vaihma ni hote patawnae a khet navah, vuen thung lah ka phat e lah awm hoeh, a muen hai tamang hoehpawiteh, hote patawnae ka tawn e tami hah vaihma ni hnin sari touh a paung han.
A hnin sari hnin vaihma ni a khet navah, a hmâ kampai hoeh, a muen hai samen hoeh, vuen thung lah phat hoeh pawiteh,
Hote tami e muen a ngaw pouh han. Hma dawk e muen teh ngaw pouh mahoeh. Hnin sari touh bout a paung han.
A hnin sari hnin vaihma ni a khet navah, vuen dawk e hmâ kampai hoeh, vuen thung lah hai phat hoehpawiteh vaihma ni a thoung telah a pathang han. Amae khohna hah a pâsu vaiteh ahni teh kathounge lah ao han.
a thoung toe telah a pathang hnukkhu, raipha patawnae bout kampai pawiteh,
Vaihma ni bout a khet vaiteh patawnae hoe kampai katang pawiteh vaihma ni a muen ka samen e tawng mahoeh toe.
Hote tami teh thoung hoeh. Hatei, raipha hah ama paroup lah a hmu teh a muen ka tamang e tâcawt pawiteh raipha a kahma teh, hote tami teh kathounge lah ao toung dawkvah, vaihma ni hote tami hah a thoung toe telah a pathang han.
Napui hai thoseh, tongpa hai thoseh a vuen dawk bahlaw awm pawiteh,
Vaihma ni a khet navah phouhou e awm pawiteh a vuen dawk e bahlaw doeh. Hote tami teh a thoung.
Sam ka sarut e tami teh a lû luengpalueng nakunghai thoseh a thoung.
Tampa sam ka sarut e tami teh a tampanga nakunghai a thoung.
A lû luengpalueng e thoseh, tampa ka nga e thoseh, ka pangaw ka paling tâcawt pawiteh, hote bahlaw teh hrikbei doeh.
Hat toteh, vaihma ni a khet vaiteh a vuen dawk hrikbei patetlah kamnuek pawiteh a nganae koe bahlaw pangaw paling lah tâcawt pawiteh,
Hote tami teh thoung hoeh. Hrikbei patawnae ka tawn e doeh. Lû dawk patawnae a tâco dawk thoung hoeh telah a pathang han.
Ka hrikbei e tami teh a kapawn e khohna hah a khohna han. Luhuem laipalah atunglae pahni a huem vaiteh kathoung hoeh, kathoung hoeh telah a hram han.
Hote tami teh pou kathounghoehe, kakhin e tami lah ao. Kathounghoehe tami lah ao toung dawkvah rim hloilah ao han.
Ka hrikbei ni khohna e lukkarei thoseh, tu muen e thoseh,
Kawng e thoseh, phaivuen e thoseh, phaivuen hoi sak e khohna thoseh,
khohna ka kâbet e hmâ kahring ut lah, dukpaling lah kamnuek pawiteh, hrikbei patawnae doeh. Vaihma koe a patue han.
Vaihma ni khohna dawk ka kâbet e a khet vaiteh, hnin sari touh a paung han.
Asari hnin bout a khet vaiteh khohna dawk patawnae teh, kawng e khohna dawk thoseh, phaivuen dawk thoseh, phaivuen hoi sak e khohna dawk thoseh, thoung hoeh hoe kampai pawiteh a patawnae teh tangpha a payang toung dawkvah, thoung hoeh. Hrikbei patawnae doeh toe.
Hote khohna kawng e dawk thoseh, tu muen e thoseh, phaivuen e thoseh, phaivuen hoi sak e khohna thoseh, hmai a sawi han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, a hrikbei toe.
Hateiteh, vaihma ni a khet navah, kawng e khohna, phaivuen hoi sak e khohna dawk patawnae kampai hoeh pawiteh,
Khohna a pâsu hanlah kâ a poe vaiteh hnin sari touh bout a paung han.
A pâsu hnukkhu vaihma ni bout a khet navah, moihna hah kampai hoeh eiteh, patawnae amaparoup lah awm pawiteh thoung hoeh, hmai a sawi han.
Athunglah thoseh, alawilah thoseh hmâ cawcawyu pawiteh, a pâsu hnukkhu vaihma ni a khet vaiteh patawnae teh ka tamangpanang lah awm pawiteh, kawng e khohna, phaivuen dawk kâbet e hma kâlum e vek a phi han.
Kawng e khohna, khohna hanlah sak e phaivuen dawk thoseh, hmâ bout kamnuek pawiteh kampai thai e patawnae doeh.
Hot patet e patawnae kâbet e hnopai hmai a sawi han. Kawng e khohna, phaivuen hoi sak e khohna pueng, a pâsu vaiteh patawnae dam pawiteh apâhni lah bout a pâsu vaiteh a thoung han.
Hete phunglam teh thoung hoi thounghoehnae pathang nahanelah, hrikbei kaman e hni, tumuen e khohna, kawng e khohna, phaivuen hoi sak e khohna kawi hoi kâkuen e kâlawk doeh telah ati.
Cathut ni Mosi koe,
Ka hrikbei e ni kamthoungnae hnin dawk a tarawi hane kawi phunglawk teh,
Hote tami hah vaihma koe a kaw hnukkhu, vaihma ni rim alawilah a tâco vaiteh a khet navah, hrikbei kahmat katang pawiteh,
Hote kathounge tami hanelah, kahring ni teh kathounge tava kahni touh, sidar thing, ka paling e pahla rui, dingsala dawn naw hah thokhai hanlah kâ a poe han.
Vaihma ni tava buet touh e hah tui tanae talai hlaam thung a thei sak hnukkhu,
Sidar thingphek, pahla rui paling, dingsala dawn hoi cungtalah kahring e tava a thokhai vaiteh, tava thi kalawt tangcoung e thi dawk a ranup hnukkhu,
Hrikbei kathoung hane tami dawk vai sari touh a kahei vaiteh, hote tami teh a thoung toe telah a pathang han. Hat hnukkhu kahring e tava hah kahrawngum anganae koe a tha han.
Thoung sak hane tami hah amae khohna a pâsu vaiteh, a sam koung a ngaw hnukkhu, thoung nahanelah tui a kamhluk han. Hathnukkhu, rim dawk a kâen vaiteh, amae rim lawilah hnin sahnin touh ao han.
Asari hnin vah amae sam, pahnimuen, mitmuen, tak dawk kaawm e muen pueng a ngaw vaiteh, amae khohna a pâsu hnukkhu, tui a kamhluk vaiteh, kathounge lah ao han.
Apa taroe hnin dawk hai thoseh, kacueme âvâ ka cawt hoeh rae, tutanca kahni touh, a napui buet touh thoseh, tavai thueng hanelah, satui kalawt e tavai ephah pung hra pung touh, hoi satuium buet touh a thokhai han.
Kathoungsakkung vaihma ni thoungsak hane tami hah tamimaya kamkhuengnae takhang teng BAWIPA hmalah a thokhai han.
Vaihma ni tutanca buet touh a la vaiteh, kâtapoe thueng nahanelah a thueng vaiteh, BAWIPA hmalah kahek thueng nahanlah satuium buet touh hoi a kahek han.
Tuca hah yon thuengnae sathei, hmaisawi thuengnae sathei theinae hmuen kathoung koe a thei han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, yon thuengnae hai vaihma ni a ham e doeh. Kathoung poung e lah ao.
Vaihma ni kâtapoe thuengnae sathei thi a la vaiteh, thoung sak lah kaawm e tami e aranglae a hnârakong dawk thoseh, aranglae kutpui hoi aranglae khokpui dawk thoseh, a hluk han.
Satui hai youn touh a la vaiteh, amae kuttabei dawk a awi hnukkhu,
Hote satui hah, aranglae a kutdawn a ranup vaiteh, Cathut hmalah vai sari touh a kahek han.
A kut dawk e kacawie satui hah thoung sak lah kaawm e tami e a hnârakong dawk thoseh, aranglae kutpui hoi aranglae a khokpui dawk thoseh, kâtapoe thuengnae sathei thi a hluk han.
A kut dawk kacawi rae satui hah thoung sak lah kaawm e tami e a lû van a awi vaiteh, hote tami hanelah yonthanae BAWIPA hmalah a sak han.
Hothloilah, thoung sak lah kaawm e tami hanelah, yontha nahanlah yon thuengnae sathei a thueng vaiteh, hmaisawi thuengnae sathei hah bout a thei han.
Hmaisawi thuengnae hoi tavai thuengnae hah khoungroe dawk a thueng vaiteh, hote tami hanelah yonthanae a sak pouh vaiteh, hote tami teh a thoung han.
Hote tami teh a mathoe dawk, hottelah totouh coung thai hoeh pawiteh, a kahek vaiteh, kâtapoe thueng nahanelah, yonthanae sathei, tutanca buet touh thoseh, tavai thueng nahanelah, satui kalawt e tavai ephah pung hra pung touh, satuium buet touh hoi a thokhai han.
Hathnukkhu, a coung thai e patetlah bakhu kahni touh, hoehpawiteh, âbakhuca kahni touh hah, yon thueng nahanelah buet touh, hmaisawi thueng nahanelah buet touh, a thokhai han.
Ama kâthoung nahanelah, BAWIPA hmalah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang teng koe, vaihma koe ataroe hnin a thokhai hnukkhu,
vaihma ni kâtapoenae sathei, tuca hoi satuium buet touh a la vaiteh, BAWIPA hmalah kahek thuengnae a kahek han.
Hottelah, tuca a thei hnukkhu, thi a la vaiteh, thoungsak hane tami, aranglae hnârakong dawk thoseh, aranglae kutpui hoi aranglae khokpui dawk thoseh a hluk han.
Vaihma ni satui hai youn touh avoilae kuttabei dawk a awi han.
Hote satui hah aranglae kutdawn hoi vai sari touh BAWIPA hmalah a kahei han.
A kut dawk e kacawie satui hah thoungsak lah kaawm e tami e aranglae hnârakong dawk thoseh, aranglae kutpui hoi aranglae khokpui dawk thoseh a hluk hnukkhu, kaawm e satui hah kâtapoe thuengnae sathei thi dawk thoseh a hlun han.
Ama koe kaawm rae satui hah, hote tami e a lû dawk a awi vaiteh, ahni hanlah yon thuengnae a sak pouh han.
Hote tami ni bakhu thoseh, âbakhu thoseh,
Yon thueng nahanlah buet touh, tavai thuengnae hoi cungtalah, hmaisawi thueng nahanlah buet touh a thokhai vaiteh, Vaihma ni a thueng vaiteh, hote tami hanlah yonthanae BAWIPA hmalah a sak pouh awh han.
Hete phung teh ka hrikbei ni teh a thoung nahanlah ka tawn hoeh e mathoe hoi kâkuen e kâlawk lah ao telah atipouh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi hoi Aron koe bout a dei pouh e teh,
Kai ni na poe e Kanaan ram coe hanlah na kâen awh torei teh, na coe e ram buet touh dawk im buetbuet touh dawk Kai ni ka hrikbei sak pawiteh,
Imkung ni vaihma koe a cei vaiteh, Kaie im dawk ka hrikbei e ao patet telah tetpawiteh,
Hote im dawk kaawm e pueng thounghoehnae koe phat payon vai ti ngaihri ao dawkvah, vaihma ni ka hrikbei e hah a khet hoehnahlan, kaawm e pueng takhoe sak hanelah, kâ a poe han. Hathnukkhu, vaihma ni a khet hanelah imthung a kâen han.
Patawnae a khet nah tapang dawk kahring patet, ka paling patetlah ao teh tapang dawk a hmâ kâbet e patetlah awm pawiteh,
Imthung hoi alawilah a tâco vaiteh, hote im hah hnin sari touh thung tho a khan han.
Asari hnin vaihma ni bout a khet vaiteh, tapang dawk patawnae hoe kampai pawiteh,
Hmâ kâbetnae talungnaw hah a la vaiteh, kho alawilah kakhin e hmuen koe tâkhawng hanelah kâ a poe han.
Hote imthung petkâtue lah a koe sak han. A koe e naw hah kho alawilah a khinnae hmuen koe a rabawk han.
Apasueke talung e hmuen koe alouke talung hah a la vaiteh, a ta hnukkhu, alouke lungphen hoi bout a pathoup han.
Hottelah, talung a la vaiteh, im a koe e naw bout a pathoup hnukkhu, patawnae bout tawn rah pawiteh,
Vaihma ni a khet hanelah bout a tho navah hote im dawk patawnae hoe kampai pawiteh, tak kacate hrikbei doeh. Hote im hah thoung hoeh e lah ao dawkvah,
talung, thing, tangpung kaawm e pueng a raphoe vaiteh, kho alawilah kakhin e hmuen koe a hruek han.
Hothloilah, hote imrakhan dawk kâen e pueng teh tangmin totouh thoung hoeh.
Hote im dawk ka ip e tami, ka catnet e tami teh, amae khohna a pâsu han.
Im teh a pathoup hnukkhu, vaihma ni a khet navah, patawnae kampai hoehpawiteh, a dam toung dawkvah, hote im teh a thoung toe telah a pathang han.
Hote im a thoung nahanelah tava kahni touh, sidarthing, pahla paling hoi dingsala a sin vaiteh,
tui kalawng e tanae talai hlaam thung, tava buet touh e a thei han.
Sidarthing, dingsala, pahla paling hoi kahring e tava a la vaiteh, tava thi hoi kalawt e tui dawk a ranup hnukkhu, hote im dawk vai sari touh a kahei han.
Hottelah, tava thi, kalawng e tui, kahring e tava, pahla paling, dingsala hoi sidarthing hoi im thoung sak hnukkhu,
Kahring e tava hah a ngainae koe kho alawilah a tha vaiteh, hote im hanelah yonthanae a sak vaiteh, a thoung han.
Hete phung heh hrikbei patawnae phunkuep hoi raipha patawnae,
Khohna dawk kâbet e hrikbei hoi im dawk kâbet e hrikbei.
Tak dawk ka pâphu e, ka pathak e, kâlum e hrikbei, hot patet e kong dawk,
athoung hoi athounghoeh e kapek vaiteh, panue thai nahanelah, poe e kâlawk doeh telah atipouh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi hoi Aron koe bout a dei pouh e teh,
Nangmouh roi ni Isarel miphunnaw koe na dei pouh hane teh, tongpa tie pueng atak dawk lacip tâcawt pawiteh, hote lacip teh thoung hoeh.
Pou a tâco nakunghai thoseh, avaivai a tâco nakunghai thoseh, hote tami teh thoung hoeh.
A inae, a tahungnae naw pueng hai thoung hoeh.
Ahnie ikhun kâbet e tami, a tahungnae dawk ka tahung e tami teh,
Ahnie tak kâbet e tami hoi,
Tamtui kâbet e tami teh amae e khohna a pâsu vaiteh tui a kamhluk han.
Hote tami teh tangmin totouh thoung hoeh.
A kâcuinae rangdoun hai thoung hoeh.
Hote tami e rahim kaawm e hno kâbet e tami teh tangmin totouh thoung hoeh. Hote hno buetbuet touh ka sin e tami teh amae khohna a pâsu vaiteh tui a kamhluk han. Tangmin totouh thoung hoeh.
Lacip ka tâcawt e tami ni a kut pâsu laipalah alouke tami a kut hoi tek pawiteh, hote tami teh a khohna a pâsu vaiteh tui a kamhluk han. Tangmin totouh thoung hoeh.
Lacip ka tâcawt e tami ni a kâbet e talai hlaam rek hem han. Thingtongben teh tui hoi pâsu han.
Lacip ka tâcawt e tami a patawnae a dam torei teh, a damnae hnin hoi a kamtawng vaiteh, hnin sari touh aloum hnukkhu, amae khohna a pâsu vaiteh, tui kalawng a kamhluk vaiteh a kamthoung han.
Ataroe hnin vah, bakhu kahni touh thoseh, âbakhu kahni touh thoseh buetbuet touh Cathut hmalah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang koe a thokhai vaiteh vaihma koe a poe han.
Vaihma ni yon thueng nahanelah buet touh, hmaisawi thueng nahanelah buet touh a thueng vaiteh lacip ka tâcawt e tami hanelah BAWIPA hmalah yonthanae a sak pouh han.
Tongpa ni a yangtui tâcawt pawiteh tui a kamhluk han. Tangmin totouh thoung hoeh.
A yangtui kâbet e pueng teh tui hoi pâsu han. Ama hai tangmin totouh thoung hoeh.
Tongpa ni napui hoi ip roi pawiteh tui a kamhluk roi han. Tangmin totouh thoung hoeh.
Napui ni kampheng pawiteh hnin sari touh thung thoung hoeh. Ahni kâbet e tami hai tangmin totouh thoung hoeh.
A kampheng lahun nah a inae hoi a tahungnae naw pueng hai thoung hoeh.
Ahnie a inae hoi a tahungnae ka kâbet e tami teh amae khohna a pâsu vaiteh tui a kamhluk han.
Hote tami teh tangmin totouh kathounghoehe lah ao.
A inae ikhun dawk thoseh, a tahungnae dawk thoseh, a pacâ e thi ka kâbet e tami teh tangmin totouh thoung hoeh.
Ka kampheng e napui hoi ka ip e tami teh hnin sari touh thung thoung hoeh. A inae pueng haiyah thoung hoeh.
A kamphengnae hnin akuep hnukkhu, a thi khap hoeh rah pawiteh, a thikhap hoehroukrak, kamphengnae tueng patetlah thoung hoeh.
A thikui e a dam hoehroukrak ahnie a inae hoi a tahungnae teh a kamphengnae patetlah thoung hoeh.
Hote hnonaw ka kâbet e tami hai a thounghoeh dawkvah amae e khohna a pâsu vaiteh tui a kamhluk han. Tangmin totouh thoung hoeh.
Hote napui teh thikui e a khap hnukkhu, hnin sari touh loum pawiteh a thoung han.
Ataroe hnin vah, bakhu kahni touh thoseh, âbakhu kahni touh thoseh, buetbuet touh kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang koe, vaihma koevah a thokhai han.
Vaihma ni yon thueng nahanelah buet touh, hmaisawi thueng nahanelah buet touh a thueng vaiteh, kampheng nah kathounghoehe napui hanelah BAWIPA hmalah yonthanae a sak pouh han.
Hottelah, Isarel miphunnaw ni ahnimouh koe kaawm e Kaie lukkareiim a khin sak awh teh, a thounghoehnae dawk a due awh hoeh nahanlah a kamthoung awh han.
Hete phung teh tak dawk hoi lacip ka tâcawt e, a yangtui ka tâcawt ni teh kakhin e tami, ka kampheng e napui,
Napui tongpa o inae dawk tarawi hane kawi phung doeh atipouh.
Aron e capa roi ni BAWIPA hmalah thuengnae a sak teh a due roi hnukkhu, BAWIPA ni Mosi koe a dei pouh e teh,
Na hmau Aron ni a due hoeh nahanelah, hmuen kathoung dawk thingkong van, lungmanae tungkhung hmalah nâtuek hai kâen sak hanh. Kai teh thingkong van, lungmanae tungkhung hmalah tâmai dawk hoi ka kamnue han.
Aron ni lukkarei hmuen kathoung thung bangtelah hoi maw a kâen han tetpawiteh, yon thueng nahanelah, a kum kanaw e maitotan buet touh, hmaisawi thueng nahanelah tutan buet touh a thokhai han.
Kathounge lukkarei angki hoi hna a khohna vaiteh lukkarei taisawm a kâyeng han. Lukkarei lupawk hai a pawk han. Hote khohnanaw teh a thoung dawkvah, tui a kamhluk hnukkhu a khohna han.
Isarel miphun tamimaya naw koe e, yon thueng nahanelah hmaeca kahni touh, hmaisawi thueng nahanelah tu buet touh a la han.
Aron ni amae yon thueng nahanelah maito a thueng vaiteh, ama hoi a imthungkhunaw hanelah yonthanae a sak han.
Hmae kahni touh hai a thokhai vaiteh, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang koe, Cathut hmalah a poe han.
Aron ni hmae kahni touh hane kong dawk cungpam a rayu han. Buet touh e Cathut hanelah a rayu vaiteh, bout touh e teh kahrawngum tha hanelah a rayu han.
Cathut e cungpam lah a rayu e hmae teh Aron ni a la vaiteh yon thueng nahanelah a thueng han.
Tha hanelah cungpam a rayu e hmae teh a hring lahoi Cathut hmalah a poe vaiteh, a lathueng yonthanae a sak hnukkhu, kahrawngum a nganae koe a tha han.
Aron ni amae yon thueng nahanelah maito a thokhai hnukkhu, ama hoi a imthungkhunaw hanelah yonthanae a sak vaiteh, amae yon thuengnae maito a thei han.
Cathut hmalah khoungroe hmaisaan hoi kakawi e tongben buet touh a la vaiteh, kanui lah phawm e hmuitui kutvang touh hoi, lukkarei yap e athunglah kâenkhai han.
Aron ni duenae dawk hoi a hlout nahanelah hmuitui e hmaikhu ni lawkpanuesaknae thingkong khuem hmuitui sak hanelah BAWIPA hmalah hmuitui van a phuen han.
Maito thi youn touh a la vaiteh, Kanîtholah thingkong khuem van a kutdawn hoi a kahei han. Thingkong khuem a hmalah hai vai sari touh a kutdawn hoi a kahei han.
Hathnukkhu, taminaw hanelah yon thuengnae hmae a thei vaiteh, a thi hah lukkarei yap e athunglah a kâenkhai hnukkhu, maito thi a kahei e patetlah thingkong khuem van thoseh, a hmalah hai thoseh, a kahei han.
Isarel miphunnaw e thounghoehnae yon dawk thoseh, kâtapoenae yon pueng dawk thoseh, hmuen kathoung hanelah yonthanae a sak han. Hottelah, Isarel miphunnaw thounghoehnaw yon thung kaawm e naw kamkhuengnae lukkareiim hanelah a sak han.
Hmuen kathoung koe yonthanae sak hanelah, a kâen nah, ama hanelah a imthungnaw hanelah, Isarel miphun abuemlah hanelah, yonthanae a sak teh, a tâco hoehroukrak kamkhuengnae lukkareiim thung apihai awm mahoeh.
BAWIPA hmalah khoungroe koe bout a tâco vaiteh, yonthanae a sak hanelah, maito thi, hmae thi, a la vaiteh khoungroe kinaw dawk a hlun han.
Thuengnae khoungroe van hai hote thi hah a kutdawn hoi vai sari touh a kahei vaiteh, Isarel miphunnaw e thounghoehnae a thoung sak han.
Hottelah, hmuen kathoung hanelah, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim hanelah, khoungroe hanelah, yonthanae a sak hnukkhu, hmae a hring lah a thokhai han.
Aron ni kahring e hmae lû van a kut kahni touh hoi a toung vaiteh, Isarel miphunnaw e yonnae naw hoi a sakpayonnae pueng yonpâpho vaiteh, hmae lû van a toung pouh hnukkhu, a rawi e tami buet touh ni kahrawngum a ceikhai han.
Ahnimae yonnae pueng tami ohoehnae hmuen koe ka cetkhai e hote hmae hah kahrawngum a tha han.
Aron ni kamkhuengnae lukkareiim thung bout a kâen vaiteh, hmuen kathoung koe apasuek a kâen navah, a kho e loukloukkaang e khohna a kho e hah a rading vaiteh, hmuen kathoung koe a ta han.
Hmuen kathoung koe tui a kamhluk vaiteh amae khohna a khohna hnukkhu, bout a tâco vaiteh, Ama hoi taminaw hanelah hmaisawi thuengnae sathei hah a thueng vaiteh, Ama hoi ayânaw hanelah yonthanae a sak han.
Yon thuengnae sathei thaw teh khoungroe van vah hmai a sawi han.
Kahrawngum hmae ka tha e tami hai amae khohna a pâsu vaiteh tui a kamhluk hnukkhu, a onae rim dawk bout a kâen han.
Yon thuengnae maito hoi yon thuengnae hmae thi yonthanae sak hanelah hmuen kathoung koe kâenkhai e hah rim alawilah a ceikhai han. A pho, a moi, hoi a ei hah hmaisawi han.
Hmai ka sawi e tami hai amae khohna a pâsu vaiteh, tui a kamhluk han. Hathnukkhu, roenae rim koe a cei han.
Nangmouh ni na tarawi awh hane phung teh Isarelnaw thoseh, nangmouh koe kaawm e imyinnaw thoseh, Asari e thapa, hnin hra hnin vah, thaw na tawk awh mahoeh. Na kâhat awh han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, BAWIPA hmalah nangmanaw yonnae pueng dawk hoi na thoung awh nahanelah, hote hnin dawk vaihma ni nangmouh na thoung a nahanelah yonthanae a sak han.
Hote hnin teh nangmouh na kâhat nahanelah sabbath hnin lah ao dawkvah duem na kâhat awh han.
A na pa e yueng lah vaihma thaw ka tawk hanelah, apasueke vaihma kut dawk hoi satui awi lah kaawm e tami ni yonthanae a sak han. Hote vaihma teh kathounge lukkarei khohna a khohna han.
Hmuen kathoung hanelah, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim hanelah, khoungroe hanelah, vaihmanaw hanelah, tami pueng hanelah yonthanae a sak han.
Hete phung teh Isarel miphunnaw ni a yonnae kaawm pueng dawk, kum touh dawk vai touh, yonthanae sak hanelah, nangmouh ni pou na tarawi a hanelah, kâpoe e lah ao telah Cathut ni Mosi koe lawkthui e patetlah Aron ni a sak.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe,
Nang ni Aron hoi a capa, Isarel miphunnaw koe bout na dei pouh han e teh,
Isarel miphun dawk e tami buetbuet touh ni tu, hmae maito hah rim thung a thei nakunghai thoseh, rim alawilah a thei nakunghai thoseh,
Cathut e lukkareiim hmalah, Cathut koe thuengnae sak hanelah, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang koe thokhai hoehpawiteh, hote tami teh hringnae a thei dawk a yon telah pouk han. Thi ka palawng e hote tami teh a miphun dawk hoi takhoe lah ao han.
Isarel miphunnaw ni kahrawng um vah thueng e satheinaw hah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang hmalah, Cathut koe vaihma hmalah a thokhai vaiteh, roum thuengnae a sak han.
Vaihma ni hote sathei thi hah tamimaya kamkhuengnae takhang teng e khoungroe van a kahei vaiteh, athaw hai Cathut koe hmuitui hanlah hmai a sawi han.
Ahnimouh ni apasueke a kâyo awh e patetlah hmalah kahraituilinaw koe thuengnae bout sak awh mahoeh. Hete kâlawk teh ahnimae miphun catounnaw ditouh a tarawi hane kâlawk lah ao.
Isarel miphun thoseh, nangmouh koe kho ka sak e alouke miphun thoseh, hmaisawi thuengnae hoehpawiteh, alouke sathei buetbuet touh, a thueng navah,
BAWIPA koe thuengnae a sak han navah, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang koe a thokhai hoehpawiteh, hote tami teh a miphun dawk hoi na takhoe awh han telah ahnimouh koe na dei pouh awh han.
Isarel miphunnaw na hoehpawiteh, nangmouh koe kho ka sak e alouke miphunnaw, buetbuet touh ni thi cat pawiteh, hote tami teh kai ni ka maithoe vaiteh a miphun dawk hoi ka takhoe han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, tak hringnae teh thi dawk doeh ao. Nangmae na sak e yontha nahanelah, hote thi hah nang koe thuengnae khoungroe van ka poe toe. Tami e yon katha thai e teh thi doeh.
Hatdawkvah, nangmouh dawk apihai thi na cat awh mahoeh. Nangmouh koe kho ka sak e alouke miphunnaw hai thi cat awh mahoeh telah Isarel miphunnaw koe Kai ni kâ ka poe.
Isarel miphunnaw hoehpawiteh nangmouh koe kho ka sak e alouke miphunnaw buetbuet touh ni a hrampa teh ca hanelah moithang tava man pawiteh, thi a palawng vaiteh talai hoi a paten han.
Thi teh moithang pueng e hringnae lah ao. Hatdawkvah, nangmouh ni moithang buetbuet touh e thi na cat awh mahoeh telah Isarel miphunnaw koe kâ ka poe. Moithangnaw pueng ni a hringnae teh thi dawk ao dawkvah, thi ka cat e tami teh takhoe roeroe lah ao han.
Amahmawk kadout e saring, sarang ni a kei e caha ka cat e, mae miphun, alouke miphun thoseh, amae khohna a pâsu vaiteh tui a kamhluk han. Tangmin totouh kathounghoehe lah ao.
Khohna pâsu hoeh, tui hai kamhluk hoehpawiteh amae a yonnae ama ni a khang han telah BAWIPA ni ati.

nang ni patuen na dei pouh hane teh, Kai teh nangmae BAWIPA Cathut lah ka o.
Nangmouh ni ouk na onae Izip ram e nuencang thoseh, nangmouh na kâen khai nahane ram Kanaan ram e a nuencang thoseh, nangmouh ni na tarawi awh mahoeh. Ahnimae lamthung hai na dawn awh mahoeh.
Kai ni kâ na poe e patetlah na tarawi awh vaiteh, Kaie ka phunglam dawk na hring awh han. Kai teh nangmae Cathut Jehovah lah ka o.
Hatdawkvah, Kaie ka phunglamnaw hah tarawi awh. Hote phung ka tarawi e tami teh hote phung lahoi a hring han. Kai teh BAWIPA doeh.
Nangmouh thung dawk apihai ama hoi kâhnai e tami yonkhai mahoeh. Kai teh BAWIPA doeh.
Nange na pa hoi kâkuen e na manu na ipkhai mahoeh. Na manu lah ao dawkvah na yonkhai mahoeh.
Na pa e yu koe na hnai mahoeh. Na pa hoi kâkuen e lah ao.
Im touh dawk rei khe e thoseh, alouke kho dawk khe e thoseh, na tawncanu na ipkhai mahoeh.

hmaunawngha hoi dueng kâkuen e na hmaunawngha e a yu hai thoseh, na ipkhai mahoeh.
Na yu hoi kâhnai lah kaawm e na yu e canu, na yu e minca na ipkhai mahoeh. Hot patet hateh, kahawihoehe hno doeh.
Na yu a hring navah, runae na poe hoeh nahanlah a nawngha na lat mahoeh.
Na yu a kampheng lahun nah na ipkhai mahoeh.
Ayâ yu na yonkhai mahoeh. Ayâ yu yonkhainae teh mahoima kâkhinsaknae doeh.
Na canaw hah Molek koe thuengnae lah na sak mahoeh. Na Cathut e min na pathoe mahoeh. Kai teh BAWIPA doeh.
Napui hoi rei na i e patetlah tongpa hoi rei na ip mahoeh.
Panuetkatho e hno doeh. Ma kâkhinsaknae doeh. Saring na ka ipkhai mahoeh. Napui hai thoseh, saring hoi na ip sak mahoeh. Panuetkatho e lah ao.
Hot patet e hno hoi namamouh hoi namamouh na kâkhinsak awh mahoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, hete hno a sak awh kecu dawk, nangmae hmalah ka takhoe e miphunnaw ni hottelah a sak awh teh a khin awh toe.
Ahnimae ram hai a khin. A khin kecu dawk Kai ni ka toun awh teh hote ram ni amae canaw a palo awh han.
Nangmouh teh Kai ni ka dei e phunglamnaw hah na tarawi awh han.
Hote ram ni hmaloe kaawm e miphunnaw a palo e patetlah bout na khin awh vaiteh, na palo awh hoeh nahanlah ram thung e tami thoseh, nangmouh koe kho ka sak e alouke miphunnaw thoseh, hot patet e panuettho e na sak awh mahoeh.
Hot patet e hno panuettho e saknae lahoi ahnimae ram teh a khin toe.
Hot patet e hno panuettho e ka sak e tami teh a miphun dawk hoi takhoe lah ao han.
Hatdawkvah, hmaloe a sak a e panuettho e singyoe, nangmouh ni dawn laihoi na kâkhinsak awh hoeh nahanelah, kâlawk tarawi awh. Kai teh nangmae BAWIPA Cathut doeh telah ati.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe,
Nang ni Isarel miphun, rangpuinaw koe bout na dei pouh hane teh, nangmae BAWIPA, Kai teh kathounge patetlah nangmouh hai thoung van awh.
Tami pueng ni na manu hoi na pa na bari awh han. Kaie sabbath hnin hai na ya awh han. Kai teh nangmae BAWIPA Cathut doeh.
Kutsak na bawk awh mahoeh. Ma hanelah hlun e cathutnaw na sak awh mahoeh. Kai teh nangmae BAWIPA Cathut doeh.
Roum thuengnae sathei BAWIPA koe thuengnae na sak pawiteh, BAWIPA lung ka youk lah na thueng awh han.
Thuengnae hnin hoi atangtho hnin dawk na ca awh han. Cawi pawiteh, a tawkkahnin teh hmai na sawi awh han.
Tawkkahnin dawk yitca nakunghai na cat awh pawiteh, panuettho e lah ao. Lungyouk lah awm mahoeh.
Ka cat e tami teh BAWIPA thoungnae a khinsak dawkvah, a yonnae phu teh ama ni a khang han. Hote tami teh a miphun dawk hoi takhoe lah ao han.
Na law dawk e cang na a torei teh, lawrai lae koung na a awh mahoeh. Cabong bout na hrawm a torei hai na pahnim a e bout na hrawm awh mahoeh.
Misur paw hai koung na khi awh mahoeh. Kacawie a paw bout na khi awh mahoeh. Hote a paw teh, kamathoe e tami, hoi imyinnaw hanelah, na pek awh han. Kai teh nangmae BAWIPA Cathut doeh.
Ayâ e hno na parawt awh mahoeh. Ayâ na dum awh mahoeh. Buetbuet touh laithoe na kâdei awh mahoeh.
Kaie min lahoi kahmanhoeh lah thoe na ka bo awh mahoeh. Na Cathut e min mathout sak awh hanh. Kai teh BAWIPA doeh.
Na imri e hno kamsoum hoeh lahoi lawm hanh. Thama lahoi lat pouh hanh. Counnae phu hah karum loum sak hanh.
Hnâpang thoe na bo mahoeh. Mitdawn hmalah kamthui kawi hno na tat pouh mahoeh. Na Cathut hah barih. Kai teh BAWIPA doeh.
Lawkcengnae koe kamsoum hoeh lah lawk na ceng mahoeh. Kamathoe e noutna laipalah awm hanh. Athakaawme tami minhmai khen hanh. Na imri hah kamsoum lah lawk na ceng han.
Ayânaw minhmai mathoenae kamthang hah dei hanelah na taminaw koe na kâhlai mahoeh. Na imri runae kâhmo sak hanlah na kâcai mahoeh. Kai teh BAWIPA doeh.
Na lung thung hoi na hmaunawngha hmuhmanae na tawn mahoeh. Na imri a payonnae hah pak khen laipalah na yue katang han.
Na taminaw ni nang koe payon awh pawiteh, bout pathung hanh. A yonnae hah pâkuem pouh hanh. Na imri hah nama patetlah lungpataw. Kai teh BAWIPA doeh.
Kaie phunglawk na tarawi awh han. Aphun alouklouk e saring a napui, a na tongpa âvâ na yawng sak mahoeh. Cati alouklouk e mak kâkalawt lah law dawk na patue awh mahoeh. Pahla hoi tumuen carouk teh kawng e khohna na khohnat awh mahoeh.
Paluen hanelah sut ham teh ratang hoeh rae a sannu ka ipkhai e tami teh hemnae a khang han. Hote napui teh amae san lah ao dawkvah thei lah awm mahoeh.
Tongpa ni hai kâtapoe thueng nahanelah, tutan buet touh kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang koe BAWIPA koevah a thokhai han.
Hote tongpa ni a sakpayon e yontha nahanelah, kâtapoe thuengnae tutan hah, vaihma ni BAWIPA hmalah a thueng han. Hote tongpa teh yon ngaithoum lah ao han.
Nangmouh koe Kai ni na poe e ram dawk na pha awh toteh, cakawi thingthai aphunphun na ung awh hnukkhu, kum thum touh thung kapaw e a pawnaw hah, vuensoma hoeh e a paw telah na pouk awh vaiteh, na cat awh mahoeh.
A kum palinae kapaw e a paw pueng teh a thoung dawkvah BAWIPA pholen nahanelah pasoum lah ao.
A kum panganae a pawnaw hah na ca awh han. Hottelah na sak pawiteh thingthainaw hoe a paw han. Kai teh nangmae BAWIPA Cathut lah ka o.
A thi hoi bangpatet e a moi hai mek na cat awh mahoeh. Tami na ân mahoeh. Kut na khet hoi khueyue lawk na dei mahoeh.
Na lû kâkalup lah na sam na ngaw mahoeh. Pâkhamuen na ngaw mahoeh.
Kadout e tami hanelah na tak na a mahoeh. Mangkâkhuinae na sak mahoeh. Kai teh BAWIPA doeh.
Na canu kâyawt sak hanh. Hoehpawiteh ram ni kâyawt e koe kâbang vaiteh, kahawihoehe hno hoi akawi han.
Sabbath hnin hah na ya han. Kaie hnin kathoung hah na bari han. Kai teh BAWIPA doeh.
Nama hoi nama kâkhinsak hanelah kahrai khueyue koe, kamlang hanh. Hmaui hai tawng awh hanh. Kai teh nangmae BAWIPA Cathut doeh.
Sam ka po e hmalah kangdout nateh, matawng e minhmai na bari han. Na Cathut hah na taki han. Kai teh BAWIPA doeh.
Nangmouh koe kârayen e imyin hah na rektap mahoeh.
Nangmouh koe kârayen e imyin hah na tami patetlah na pouk han. Nama patetlah na lungpataw han. Nangmouh teh Izip ram vah imyin lah ouk na o awh toe. Kai teh nangmae BAWIPA Cathut doeh.
