Isarel taminaw thoseh, Isarelnaw koe kho ka sak e alouke miphunnaw thoseh, amae canaw Molek koe, ka poe e tami teh thei roeroe han. Khocanaw ni talung hoi a dei awh han.
Kaie hmuen kathoung kakhin sak niteh, Ka min kathoung kamathout sak niteh, amae canaw Molek koe ka poe e tami teh, Kai ni mithmaithung sin vaiteh, a miphun dawk hoi ka takhoe han.
Amae canaw Molek koe ka poe e tami hah, khocanaw ni nout laipalah thet awh hoeh pawiteh,
Hottelah kaawm e tami hoi a imthungkhunaw hah, Kai ni mithmaithung sin vaiteh, ahni hai thoseh, ahni hoi cungtalah Molek koe, ka kâyawtnaw hai thoseh, ahnimae miphun dawk hoi ka takhoe han.
Lam ka phen ni teh kahrai khueyue koe kamlang e taminaw hoi camkathoumnaw koe kâyawt e naw hah, mithmaithung sin vaiteh, a miphun dawk hoi ka takhoe han.
Nangmae BAWIPA KAI Cathut teh kathoung dawkvah nangmouh hai kâthoung sak awh nateh, kathoung lah awm awh.
Kaie ka phunglamnaw hah na tarawi awh han. Kai teh BAWIPA, nangmouh na kathoung sak e BAWIPA doeh.
Apipatethai a manu, hoi a na pa thoe ka bo e tami pueng teh, thei roeroe lah ao han. A manu hoi a na pa thoe a bo dawkvah, a thi phu teh amae lû dawk a bo han.
Ayâ yu yonkhai pawiteh, ka uicuk e napui hoi tongpa hah mek thei lah ao han.
Apihai a na pa e yu yonkhai pawiteh, a na pa kaya sak e lah ao dawkvah, hote napui hoi tongpa mek thei lah ao han. Ahnimae thi phu teh amae lû dawk a bo han.
Apihai amae langa ipkhai pawiteh, ahnimouh roi panuettho e hno hah a sak dawkvah, mek thei lah ao han.
Apihai napui ikhai e patetlah tongpa reira ipkhai pawiteh, ahnimouh roi teh panuettho e hno a sak roi dawkvah, mek thei lah ao han. Ahnimouh roi e thi phu teh amamouh roi dawk a bo han.
Apihai a manu hoi canu a yu lah mek lat pawiteh, Hot teh, kahawihoehe hno doeh. Nangmouh koevah kahawihoehe hno ao hoeh nahanelah, ahnimanaw teh hmai na sawi awh han.
Apihai saring ipkhai pawiteh, ahni teh thei lah ao han. Hote saring hai thei lah ao han.
Napui ni saring koe kâ ipkhai sak pawiteh, hote napui hoi saring teh mek thei lah ao han. Ahnie thi phu teh amae lû dawk a bo han.
Tongpa ni a tawncanu, a na pa e canu, na hoehpawiteh, a manu e canu a yu lah a paluen teh ipkhai pawiteh, hot hateh, kamsoumhoehe hno doeh. Ahnimouh roi teh a taminaw e hmaitung hoi takhoe lah ao han. Hote tongpa teh amae tawncanu a okhai dawkvah a yonnae phu ama ni a khang han.
Tongpa ni kampheng lahun e napui ipkhai pawiteh, thi palawng hanlah a lungkuep roi dawkvah, ahnimouh roi teh a miphun dawk hoi takhoe lah ao han.
Na mani hoi na manta na ipkhai mahoeh. Hottelah, kâhnai e imthung hoi ka ipawm e tami teh amamae yonnae a khang han.
Tongpa ni a na pa e hmaunawngha yu ipkhai pawiteh, a na pa e hmaunawngha hoi dueng kâkuen e a ikhai dawkvah, ahnimouh teh amae yon phu teh amae lû dawk a bo han. Carôe laihoi a due han.
Tami ni a hmaunawngha e yu ipkhai pawiteh, kakhin e hno lah ao. A hmaunawngha hoi dueng kâkuen e a ikhai dawkvah, ahnimouh teh carôe lahoi a due han.
Kai ni nangmouh na hrawi awh teh, kho na sak hane ram ni na palo awh hoeh nahanelah, Kaie phunglawknaw pueng na tarawi awh han.
Nangmae hmalah ka takhoe e miphunnaw e singyoe hah na tarawi awh mahoeh. Ahnimanaw ni hot patet e hno a sak awh dawkvah ka panuet.
Ahnimae ram lah kaawm e sanutui hoi khoitui a lawngnae ram hah, nangmouh ni râw lah na coe awh hanelah, Kai ni khoeroe na poe awh han telah Kai ni kâ na poe awh toe. Kai teh alouke miphunnaw hoi nangmouh na kapek e nangmae BAWIPA Cathut lah ka o.
Hatdawkvah, kathounge moi, kathounghoehe moi, kathounge tava, kathounghoehe tavanaw hah na kapek han. Kai ni kapek e patetlah Kathounghoehe moi, tava, talai dawk a von hoi kâva e saring buetbuet touh lahoi namahoima kâkhinsak awh hanh.
Kai Cathut, kathoung dawkvah nangmouh na panki teh Jentelnaw hoi na kapek dawkvah, Kai hanelah na kâthoung awh han.
Tongpa thoseh, napui thoseh, kahrai khueyue, camkathoum lah kaawm e tami teh thei roeroe lah ao han. Hot patet e tami teh, talung hoi dei lah ao han. Amae thi phu amae lû dawk a bo han.

Hateiteh, kahnai poung e manu napa, canaw, hmaunawngha,
Vâ ka tawn hoeh rae na tawncanu hanelah, khin thainae kâ a tawn.
Na tami khobawinaw hanelah kâkhinsak hanelah awm hoeh.
Vaihma teh lû hoi pâkhamuen ngaw mahoeh. Atak hai kâbouk mahoeh.
Ahni teh amamae Cathut hanelah a thoung han. Na Cathut e min mathout sak awh hanh. Cathut e canei a thueng awh dawkvah, a thoung han.
Ahni teh kâyawt e napui, a nuencang kahawihoehe napui, vâ hoi kamphei e napui hoi na kâyuva mahoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, vaihma teh Cathut hanelah kâthoung e lah ao.
Vaihma teh na Cathut e vaiyei ka poe e lah ao dawkvah, amahoima kâthoung naseh. Nangmouh na kathoung sak e Kai BAWIPA teh kathoung dawkvah, ahni hai nangmouh hanlah kâthoung naseh.
Vaihma e canu ni amae tak a kâyo teh amahoima min mathoenae sak pawiteh, a na pa min kamathout sak e lah ao. Ahni teh hmai hoi sawi lah ao han.
Hmaunawngha thung dawk vaihma kacue lah rawi teh, a lû dawk satui awi lah kaawm e teh, a khohna ravek hanh naseh. A lû dawk e lupawk rading hanh naseh.
Ro koe cet hanh naseh. A manu hoi a na pa hanelah kathounghoehe lah awm hanh naseh.
Hmuen kathoung koehoi tâcawt mahoeh. Amae Cathut e hmuen kathoung khin sak mahoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, amae Cathut ni rawinae satui ahni dawk ao toe. Kai teh BAWIPA doeh.
Tanglakacuem duengdoeh a yu lah a la han.
Lahmai thoseh, Ma e napui thoseh, Min mathoe ka phawt e napui thoseh, kâyawt e napui thoseh, yu lah lat mahoeh. A miphun dawk e tanglakacuem dueng hah a la han.
Amae capa hah a taminaw koe min mathout sak mahoeh. Kai Cathut teh ahnimanaw kathoung sak e doeh telah ati.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe, nang ni Aron koe bout na dei pouh hane teh,
Na miphunnaw, catounnaw dawk yon ka tawn e tami teh vaiyei thueng hanelah tho hanh naseh.
Mitdawn, khokkhem, a hnawng ka uek e, a kutkhok hloi kasaw e taminaw,
kut ka lawt e, a khok ka lawt e,
Hnamkhun, rahnoum, mitmawm, raipha, ngavangrawca, yangmukhe e taminaw teh bawk mahoeh.
Vaihma Aron phun dawk e ka kuepcing hoeh e tami buet touh ni boehai hmaisawi thuengnae hah hnai mahoeh. Tak ka kuepcing hoeh e lah ao dawkvah, vaiyei poe hanelah hnai mahoeh.
Kathounge vaiyei thoseh, kathoungpounge vaiyei thoseh, amae Cathut e vaiyei teh a ca han.
Tak ka kuepcing hoeh dawkvah, hni yap e thung thoseh, thuengnae khoungroe thoseh, cet awh mahoeh. Telah hoehpawiteh, Kaie hmuen kathoung khin payon vaih. Kai BAWIPA ni hote hmuennaw teh kathoung sak toe ati.
Hottelah, Mosi ni Aron hoi capanaw, Isarel miphunnaw pueng koe patuen a dei pouh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe bout a dei pouh e teh,
Aron hoi capanaw ni kai hanelah thoung sak laihoi ka min mathoe hoeh hanelah, Isarel miphunnaw e kathounge hnonaw hoi amamouh hoi kâhla sak hanlah dei pouh. Kai teh BAWIPA doeh.
BAWIPA hanelah Isarel miphunnaw thoung sak nateh, kathounge hnonaw hah, thoung laipalah ka hnai e vaihmanaw teh, Kai koehoi takhoe lah ao han. Kai teh BAWIPA doeh.
Ka hrikbei e hoi lacip patawnae ka tawn e Aron e capanaw teh, a thoung awh hoehroukrak kathounge hno cat awh mahoeh. Ro hoi kâkuen lah kathounghoehe hno ka tek e tami, a yangtui ka tâcawt e tami,
Ama kakhin sak thai e, a von hoi ka kâva e saring ka tek e tami, khinnae buetbuet touh hoi kâkhinsak e tami, hot patet e tami kâbet e taminaw teh,
Tangmin totouh kathounghoehe lah ao awh han. Tui kamhluk hoehpawiteh kathounge cat mahoeh.
Kanî a khup hoi teh kathounge lah ao toung dawkvah, Kathounge hno teh ahnimae rawca lah ao dawkvah bout a ca han.
Ama pouk kadout e saring, sarang ni a kei e caha cat mahoeh. Kai teh BAWIPA doeh.
Vaihmanaw ni ka phunglam a raphoe awh teh, a yonnae kecu dawk a due awh hoeh nahanelah, Kaie phunglam a tarawi awh han. Kai teh nangmouh kathoung sak e BAWIPA doeh.
Alawilae tami ni kathounge hno poe e hah, cat mahoeh. Vaihma im ka luen e imyin ni cat mahoeh. Thaw tawk hanlah hlai e tami ni hai cat mahoeh.
Vaihma ni phoisa hoi a ran e tami, a kawk e taminaw ni hote rawca teh a ca han.
Vaihma canu teh alawilae tami ni a yu lah lat pawiteh, kathounge hno poe e hah cat mahoeh.
Hateiteh, a vâ a due nakunghai thoseh, a vâ hoi kamphei nakunghai thoseh, ca khe laipalah a na pa im bout a ban teh a nawnae patetlah bout awm pawiteh, a na pa ni a ca e bout a ca han. Alawilae tami ni cat mahoeh.
Tami ni kathounge hno panuek laipalah cat payon pawiteh, ca payonnae hno phu hoi pung panga touh dawk pung touh vaihma koe bout a sin han.
Isarel miphunnaw ni BAWIPA koe poe e kathounge hnonaw hah, khin sak mahoeh.
Hote hnonaw ka cat payon ni teh sak payonnae yon teh amamouh ni a khang han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Kai teh nangmouh kathoung sak e BAWIPA doeh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe, nang ni Aron hoi a canaw, Isarelnaw pueng koe patuen na dei pouh han e teh,
Isarel miphun thoseh, Isarelnaw koe kho ka sak e Jentelnaw thoseh, lawkkam e lahoi poe e hno, lungtho lahoi poe e hno lah kaawm e hmaisawi thuengnae Cathut koe thueng han na ngai pawiteh,
Cathut lungyouk nahanelah kacueme tu, hmae, hoi maitotannaw hah na poe awh han.
Toun kaawm e saring na poe awh mahoeh. Poe pawiteh Cathut ni a lungyouk mahoeh.
Lawkkam e lahoi poe e, lungtho e lahoi poe e tu, hmae, hoi maitonaw hah BAWIPA koe roum thuengnae lah poe han na ngai pawiteh, a lungyouk thai nahanlah, akuepcing han. Toun han buet touh boehai awm han naseh.
A mit ka dawn e, A hru ka lawt e, a tak ka kuep hoeh e, a hmâ ka cat e, ka pâphu e, ka raipha e, hot patet e patawnae buet touh awm pawiteh, Cathut koe poe mahoeh.
Ma lungtho hoi poenae dawk teh, maito thoseh, tu thoseh, a takthai ka vout e lahoi poenae dawk teh hot patet e hah a lungyouk mahoeh.
A yangtuen buet touh ka khe e, hoehpawiteh, ka tangpawk e, hoehpawiteh phengcatai e teh Cathut koe poe mahoeh. Nangmae ram thung hot patet e thuengnae na sak awh mahoeh.
Hot patet e saring hah Jentelnaw ni ka poe nakunghai toun ao dawkvah na Cathut e pawi hanlah poe hanh naseh. Poe pawiteh a lungyouk mahoeh telah ati.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe bout a dei pouh e teh,
Tu, hmae hoi maito naw a khe navah, hnin sari touh thung a ca hoi a manu na papek awh mahoeh. A hnin taroe hnin hoi doeh, BAWIPA koe hmai thuengnae hanlah a khout.
Maito thoseh, tu hoi hmae thoseh, a manu hoi a ca hnin touh dawk mek na thet mahoeh.
Hahoi, BAWIPA koe lunghawilawkdeinae thuengnae poe hanlah na ngai pawiteh a lungyouk lah poe haw.
Hnin touh hoi be na ca han. Atangtho ditouh na pek mahoeh. Kai teh BAWIPA doeh.
Nangmouh ni kaie kâpoelawknaw na tarawi awh han. Kai teh BAWIPA doeh.
Ka min kathoung heh na khin sak awh mahoeh. Isarelnaw ni BAWIPA a thoung telah a panue awh han.
Kai teh nangmae Cathut lah ka o nahanlah, Izip ram hoi na ka tâcawt sakkung hoi na kathoung sakkung lah ka o. Kai teh BAWIPA doeh telah ati.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe, nang ni Isarelnaw koe bout na dei pouh hane teh,
Nangmouh ni na sak e kathounge kamkhuengnae, Kai BAWIPA e pawinaw teh; Hnin taruk touh thung thaw na tawk awh han. Hnin sari hnin teh kâhatnae sabbath hnin, kathoung kamkhuengnae lah ao.
Hnin taruk touh thung thaw na tawk awh han. Hateiteh, hnin sari hnin teh kâhatnae, kamkhuengnae hnin kathoung lah ao dawkvah bang thaw haiyah na tawk awh mahoeh, na onae pueng koevah BAWIPA hanlah sabbath hnin lah ao.
Ama tueng nah nangmouh ni na pathang awh hane kathounge kamkhuengnae lah kaawm e Cathut pawinaw teh;
Apasueke thapa, hnin hlaipali, tangmin nateh BAWIPA e ceitakhai pawi doeh.
Hote thapa, hnin hlaipanga hnin teh BAWIPA hanlah tonphuenhoehe pawi lah ao. Hnin sari touh thung tonphuenhoehe na ca awh han.
Apasuek hnin vah kathoung kamkhuengnae na sak awh han. Bang thaw hai na tawk awh mahoeh.
Hateiteh, hnin sari touh thung BAWIPA koe rawca thuengnae na sak awh han. Asari hnin nah kathoung kamkhuengnae na sak han. Hat hnin nah, bang thaw hai na tawk mahoeh telah a ti.
Cathut ni Mosi koe bout a dei pouh e teh, nang ni Isarel miphunnaw koe patuen na dei pouh hane teh;
Kai ni na poe e ram dawk na pha awh toteh, cang na a awh toteh, apasuek na a e cabong buet touh vaihma koe na thokhai awh han.
Nangmouh ni a lungyouk awh nahanlah vaihma ni sabbath hnin atangtho vah hote cabong hah Cathut hmalah a kahek han.
Cabong a kaheknae hnin dawkvah âvâ ka cawt hoeh rae tutanca hah BAWIPA hanlah hmaisawi thuengnae a sak han.
Hote thuengnae hoi ka kâkuen e tavai thuengnae teh Cathut koe hmuitui hanlah hmaisawi thuengnae lah kaawm e satui hoi kalawt e tavai ephah pung hra pung touh kalawt e lah ao han. Awi thuengnae teh misurtui buet touh han.
Na Cathut koe thuengnae hnin a pha hoehnahlan vah, vaiyei, vaicakuem karê e, anhla kahring a pawhik na cat awh mahoeh. Hetteh, na onae hmuen pueng koe na catoun ditouh na tarawi hane phunglam lah ao.
Kahek thuengnae cabong na thokhainae hnin, sabbath hnin atangtho hoi sabbath avai sari totouh na touk awh han.
Sabbath avai sarinae atangtho amom hoiyah hnin 50 touh na touk hnukkhu, Cathut koe tavai thuengnae a tha lah bout na sak han.
BAWIPA hanlah aluepaw, ton ni a po sak e tavai ephah pung hra pung hni hoi sak e kahek hane vaiyei kahni touh na im hoi na sin awh han.
Hote vaiyei hoi âvâ ka cawt hoeh rae tuca sari touh, maitotanca buet touh, hmae kahni touh, tavai thuengnae, awi thuengnae hoi cungtalah BAWIPA koe hmuitui nahanlah hmai hoi sawi e thuengnae lah kaawm e hmaisawi thuengnae sathei hah na thueng awh han.
Yon thuengnae lah hmaeca buet touh thoseh, roum thuengnae hanlah âvâ ka cawt hoeh rae tuca kahni touh thoseh, na thueng han.
Vaihma ni aluepaw, vaiyei hoi cungtalah a kahek vaiteh, tuca kahni touh a sin vaiteh BAWIPA hmalah kahek thuengnae a sak han. Hote hnonaw haiyah vaihma hanlah BAWIPA hmalah kathounge hno lah ao.
Hote hnin dawk kathoung kamkhuengnae hah na sak awh han. Thaw banghai na tawk awh mahoeh. Na onae hmuen pueng koe na ca catoun ditouh na tarawi awh hane phunglawk lah ao.
Na law dawk cang na a awh navah, lawri totouh koung na a awh mahoeh. Cabong na pâhma e hah bout na racawng mahoeh. Hotnaw teh karoedengnaw hoi imyinnaw hanlah na pek pouh han. Kai teh nangmae BAWIPA Cathut doeh telah a ti.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe, nang ni Isarel miphunnaw koe patuen bout na dei pouh hane teh,
Nangmouh ni tha sari, apasuek hnin nah mongka ueng pawi kathoung kamkhuengnae sabbath hnin hah na ya awh han.
Thaw na tawk awh mahoeh. BAWIPA hanlah hmaisawi thuengnae na sak han telah a ti.
Cathut ni Mosi koe bout a dei e teh,
Tha sari, hnin hra navah, yonthanae hnin, kathoung kamkhuengnae saknae hnin lah ao. Khang laihoi BAWIPA hanlah hmaisawi thuengnae na sak awh han.
Hote hnin dawk bang thaw hai na tawk mahoeh. Na BAWIPA Cathut hmalah yonthanae hnin lah ao.
Hote hnin nah, ka ya hoeh e taminaw teh amae miphun dawk hoi takhoe lah ao han.
Hote hnin dawk thaw buetbuet ka tawk e tami teh a miphun dawk hoi a takhoe vaiteh ka raphoe han.
Bang thaw hai na tawk awh mahoeh. Na onae hmuen pueng koe na ca catoun ditouh na tarawi awh hane phunglawk lah ao.
Hote hnin teh yanae hnin lah ao. Atako hnin tangmin lahoi atangtho tangmin ditouh na ya awh han.
Cathut ni Mosi koe, nang ni Isarel miphunnaw koe patuen bout na dei pouh hane teh,
Nangmouh ni tha sari, hnin hrahlaipanga hnin hoi hnin sari touh thung Cathut hanelah lukkarei pawi na sak awh han.
Apasuek hnin dawk kathoung kamkhuengnae na sak awh han. Thaw na tawk awh mahoeh.
Hnin sari touh thung BAWIPA koe hmaisawi thuengnae na sak awh han. A hnin taroe hnin haiyah, kathoung kamkhuengnae hoi BAWIPA koe hmaisawi thuengnae hah na sak awh han. Ka talue e kamkhuengnae lah ao dawkvah thaw na tawk awh mahoeh.
Hotnaw teh, BAWIPA e sabbath hnin, BAWIPA koe pasoumhno,
Lawkkamnae lahoi thuengnae, lungtho lahoi thuengnae hloilah hnin touh hoi hnin touh BAWIPA koe hmaisawi thuengnae, tavai thuengnae, sathei thuengnae hoi awi thuengnae naw sak e lah kathoung kamkhuengnae, BAWIPA e pawinaw lah ao.
Hotnaw hloilah, law dawk e caticamu pâkhueng hnukkhu, tha sari, hnin hrahlaipanga hnin hoi hnin sari touh thung BAWIPA koe pawi na to awh han. Apasuek hnin hoi a taroe hnin vah sabbath na ya awh han.
Apasuek hnin dawk a paw kahawihloe e, samtue kang hoi a hna karung e thingkangnaw hah a sin awh teh, Nangmae BAWIPA Cathut hmalah hnin sari touh thung na lunghawi sak awh.
Hote pawi hah kum kum touh dawk hnin sari touh thung Cathut hanlah na sak awh han. Na miphun na catoun ditouh tarawi hane kawi phunglawk lah ao.
Hote pawiteh thapa ayung sari nah na sak awh han.
Isarel miphunnaw Izip ram hoi tâcokhai navah, thingkang rim dawk o saknae hah na miphun, na catounnaw ni a panue thai nahanelah, Isarelnaw teh thingkang rim dawk hnin sari touh ao han. Kai teh nangmae BAWIPA Cathut doeh a ti.
Mosi ni hai BAWIPA e pawinaw hah Isarel miphunnaw koe na pathang pouh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe bout a dei e teh,
Rangpui kamkhuengnae lukkareiim dawk lawkpanuesaknae lukkarei yap e alawilah, hmaikhom dawk hmai pou a ang nahanlah, Olive paw na phawm vaiteh, na lae olive satui hah Isarel miphunnaw ni nang koe thokhai hanelah patuen dei pouh.
Aron ni hai tangmin hoi amom totouh Cathut hmalah hote thaw a tawk han. Na miphun na catounnaw ditouh tarawi hane kâ poe e lah ao.
Kathounge hmaiimkhok dawk hmaiimnaw hah Cathut hmalah Aron ni pou a rakueng han.
Nang ni tavai na la vaiteh, ephah pung hra pung hni touh e hah vaiyei buet touh lah, vaiyei hrahlaikahni touh na sak hnukkhu,
BAWIPA hmalah kathounge caboi van vah, vaiyei taruk taruk touh hoi pung hni telah na pacoung han.
BAWIPA koe hmaisawi thuengnae lah kaawm e pahnim hoeh nahanelah, hote vaiyei pung hni touh e van vah, kathounge frankinsen na ta han.
Cathut e lawkkam patetlah Isarelnaw e kut dawk hoi dâw e vaiyei hah, Aron ni Cathut hmalah sabbath hnintangkuem pou a rakueng han.
Hote vaiyei teh Aron hoi a canaw e lah ao dawkvah hmuen kathoung dawk a ca awh han. BAWIPA koe hmaisawi thuengnae thung dawk hote vaiyei teh a yungyoe phunglam patetlah Aron hanlah kathoungpounge lah ao telah a ti.
Hahoi Isarel napui e capa, a na pa teh Izip tami, Isarelnaw onae koe a cei teh, Isarel napui e capa hoi Isarel tami e capa teh roenae rim thung a kâyue roi.
Cathut e min a pacekpahlek teh thoe a bo. Ahnie a manu teh Dan miphun, dibri e canu Shelomith lah ao.
Ka payon e tami hah Mosi koe a thokhai awh teh, BAWIPA e ngainae a panue hoehroukrak a paung awh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe,
Thoe ka bo e tami hah rim alawilah a hrawi awh teh, ahnie lawk ka thai naw pueng ni a lû van kut a toung pouh hnukkhu, rangpuinaw ni talung hoi dei awh naseh.
Nang ni Isarel miphunnaw koe patuen na dei hane teh, Cathut thoe ka bo e tami teh ama ni a khang han.
Cathut e min ka pacekpahlek e tami teh thei roeroe lah ao han. Rangpuinaw ni hote tami hah talung hoi a dei katang awh han. A miphun thoseh, alouke miphun thoseh, a min pacekpahlek pawiteh thei lah ao han.
Tami ka thet e tami hai thei roeroe lah ao han.
Saring ka thet e tami hai katawnkung koe buet touh thet pawiteh buet touh aphu a rawng pouh awh han.
Tami ni a imri lungpataw sak pawiteh, ahni koe a sak e patetlah ama ni a khang han.
A hru hanlah a hru, mit hanlah mit, hâ hanlah hâ, ahni koe patawnae na sak e patetlah nama hai patawnae na khang han.
Saring ka thet e tami teh buet touh hanelah buet touh bout a poe han. Tami ka thet e tami teh thei lah ao han.
A miphun thoseh, alouke miphun thoseh, ama dueng lahoi lawkcengnae teh a khang han. Kai teh nangmae BAWIPA Cathut doeh telah Mosi koe atipouh.
Thoe ka bo e tami teh rim alawilah a hrawi awh vaiteh talung hoi dei hanelah Mosi koe patuen a dei pouh teh, Cathut ni Mosi koe lawkthui e patetlah Isarel miphunnaw ni a sak awh.
Sinai mon dawk, BAWIPA ni Mosi koe, nang ni Isarel miphunnaw koe patuen bout na dei pouh hane teh,
Kai ni na poe e ram dawk na pha awh toteh, Hote ram ni BAWIPA hanlah sabbath ayâ han.
Kum taruk touh thung law hoi misur takha na sak awh vaiteh, apawhik na pâkhueng awh han.
Kum sarinae kum teh BAWIPA hanlah sabbath kum, ram thung kaawm e pueng kâhat vaiteh, sabbath yanae kum lah ao. Law na sak mahoeh. Misur takha hai na rasoun mahoeh.
Law dawk ama pouk kapâw e apawhik hai na khi mahoeh. Na rasoun hoeh e misur hai na khi mahoeh. Ram pueng kâhatnae kum lah ao.
Ram thung sabbath kum nah ka tâcawt e apawhik pueng teh namamouh, napui hoi tongpa, na thaw ka tawk e hoi, nang koe kaawm e imyinnaw hoi,
ram thung kaawm e saring pueng ni ca hane kawi lah ao han.
Sabbath kum, kum sari touh na parei vaiteh, kum sari vai sari touh tie kum 49 akuep hnukkhu,
Tha sari, hnin 10, yonthanae hnin dawk mongka hah ram pueng dawk ueng sak han.
Aruipanganae kum hah thoung sak vaiteh, ram pueng dawk khoca pueng koe hloutnae pathang han. Jubili kum lah ao dawkvah tami pueng amae talai, amae phun koe a ban han.
Hote aruipanganae kum teh Jubili kum lah ao dawkvah law na sak mahoeh. ama pouk kapâw e hai na a mahoeh. Rasoun hoeh e misur takha dawk e a paw hai na khi awh mahoeh.
Jubili kum teh kathounge kum lah ao dawkvah law dawk e apawhik dueng ca han.
Jubili kum nateh tami pueng ni amae khoram lah a ban awh han.
Nangmouh ni buet touh hoi buet touh yorannae na sak pawiteh buet touh hoi buet touh kâyue awh hanh.
Jubili kum aloum teh a ngai rae kumnaw apawhik a paw nahan a kum parei vaiteh yorannae na sak han.
Hottelah, a paw paw na kum parei hoi yo e lah ao dawkvah, kum ayoun apap e patetlah aphu payoun, paluen lahoi yoran han.
Nangmouh teh buet touh hoi buet touh kâyue awh hanh. Na Cathut taket awh. Kai teh nangmae BAWIPA Cathut lah ka o.
Nangmouh ni ka phunglam hah na tarawi pawiteh hote ram dawk lungmawng lahoi kho na sak awh han.
Talai ni hai apawhik a tâco sak vaiteh, kaboumlah na ca awh vaiteh, lungmawng lah kho na sak awh han.
Nangmouh ni hai asari kum nah, kaimouh ni bangtelamaw ka ca awh han. Law ka sak awh hoeh. Apawhik hai ka pâkhueng awh hoeh na tet awh pawiteh,
A kum taruk nah, nangmouh yawhawinae na poe vaiteh, hote kum dawk kum thum touh hane apawhik ka tâco sak han.
nangmouh ni a kum taroe nah law na sak teh a kum tako nah apawhik pâkhuengnae totouh a karuem e apawhik na ca awh han.
Talai hah ayâ pou tawn sak hanelah, yawt hanh. Talai teh Kaie doeh. Nangmouh teh Kai koe kârayen e imyin lah na o awh.
Nangmouh ni talai na tawn a e hmuen pueng bout ratangnae kâ na poe awh han.
Na hmaunawnghanaw ni roedeng boilah a tawn e talai yawt pawiteh, kahnai e hmaunawngha ni a yo e talai hah bout ratangnae kâ ao han.
Hote talai hah ka ratang hane buet touh hai awm hoehpawiteh, ka tawn karuem ni ama ni bout ratang thai pawiteh,
A yonae kum hah a touk vaiteh, aphu yit touh bout poe naseh. Hote talai teh bout a coe han.
Bout poe thai hoehpawiteh, a yo e hno hah Jubili kum totouh ka ran e kut dawk ao sak han. Jubili kum nah tha pawiteh, hmaloe e katawnkung e kut dawk bout a pha han.
Khopui dawk e im hah imkung ni yawt pawiteh, kum touh thung ratang thainae kâ ao sak han.
Kum touh thung ratang thai hoehpawiteh, hote im ka ran e catounnaw ni pou a tawn han. Jubili kum ka phat nakunghai tha pouh mahoeh toe.
Rapan ka tawn hoeh e kho dawk kaawm e im hah law patetlah a pouk vaiteh, ratang thainae kâ ao. Jubili kum pha toteh a tha pouh han.
Hat navah, Levihnaw ni a tawn e khopui hoi khopui dawk e imnaw teh nâtuek hai thoseh, ratang thainae kâ ao.
Levih ni a tawn e im hoi kho thoseh, ayâ ni ran pawiteh, Jubili kum a pha toteh a tha han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Isarel miphun dawk Levihnaw teh ama onae kho hoi im hloilah alouke hno tawn hoeh.
Hateiteh, Levih kho dawk kaawm e imlawnaw yawt mahoeh. Pou a tawn awh han.
Nange na hmaunawngha ni a roedeng lawi, imyin patetlah tho pawiteh, nang koe o sak hanlah na kabawp han.
Ahni koe apung na cat mahoeh. Na hmaunawngha hah, nang koe o sak hanelah, na Cathut taket loe.
Apung ngaihawi lahoi ahni koe tangka thoseh, canei thoseh na cawi mahoeh.
Kai ni Kanaan ram na poe awh teh, nangmae Cathut lah ka o nahanlah nangmouh Izip ram hoi na ka tâcawtkhai e nangmae BAWIPA Cathut doeh.
Na hmaunawngha ni a roedeng dawkvah nang koe kâyawt pawiteh, san patetlah na hno mahoeh.
Ahni teh hlai e patetlah thoseh, imyin patetlah thoseh, nang koe ao vaiteh, Jubili kum totouh na thaw a tawk han.
Hat navah, ahni teh a canaw hoi a tâco vaiteh amae a hmaunawngha, a mintoenaw e talai koe lah bout a ban han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, ahnimouh teh Izip ram hoi ka tâcokhai e ka thaw ka tawk e lah ao dawkvah san lah o hanelah na yawt mahoeh.
Ahni teh puenghoi na rektap mahoeh. Na Cathut hah taket.
Nang ni na tawn hane sannu sanpa teh na tengpam kaawm e Jentelnaw koe na ran han.
Hothloilah, nangmouh koe kho ka sak e alouk ram e taminaw thoseh, na ram dawk a khe e a canaw thoseh, na ran vaiteh na tawn han.
Ahnimanaw teh san dawk hoi ka khe e lah ao teh, nang hoi na canaw ni râw lah na tawn han. Na hmaunawngha, Isarel miphun dawk e tho pawiteh, buet touh hoi buet touh puenghoi na rektap mahoeh.
Nangmouh koe kho ka sak e alouke tami ni a tawnta ei teh, ahnie teng kho ka sak e na hmaunawngha a roedeng teh, nang koe kho ka sak e alouke ram e taminaw koe thoseh, a ca catounnaw koehai thoseh, kâyawt awh pawiteh,
Yo hnukkhu, bout ratang thainae kâ ao han. A hmaunawngha lah kaawm e buetbuet touh ni a ratang han.
A na hma, a panga, a hmaunawngha koehoi rei ka tâcawt e imthung buetbuet touh ni a ratang han. Ama ni ratang thai pawiteh a ratang han.
Bawi hoi sannaw teh yorannae kum dawk hoi kamtawng vaiteh, Jubili kum totouh kum a parei hnukkhu, a kum ayoun apap e patetlah thoseh, a hlainae tueng khet lahoi thoseh, aphu teh to han.
Jubili kum a pha hoehnahlan a thawtawknae kum ayoun apap e parei vaiteh,
A ngai rae a kumtha ayoun apap e patetlah ratang nahane aphu hah rannae phu dawk hoi rayu vaiteh bout a pâban han.
Ahni teh kum touh hnukkhu, kum touh hlai e patetlah ao han. Na hmaitung vah rektap lah awm hanh naseh.
Hottelah hoi ratang thai hoehpawiteh, Jubili kum a pha toteh, ahni teh a canaw hoi bawi e kut dawk hoi a hlout han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Isarelnaw teh ka thaw ka tawk e lah ao awh. Izip ram hoi ka tâcokhai e ka thaw ka tawk e lah ao awh. Kai teh nangmae BAWIPA Cathut doeh.
BAWIPA ni bawk hanlah kutsak thoseh, talung ung e thoseh, meilam thuk e talung thoseh, na sak awh mahoeh. Kai teh nangmae BAWIPA Cathut doeh.
Kaie Sabbath hah na ya awh vaiteh ka hmuen kathoung na bari awh han. Kai teh BAWIPA doeh.
Kaie phunglawknaw hoi kâpoelawknaw hah na tarawi pawiteh,
Ama tue nah kho ka rak sak han, talai ni apawhik a tâco sak vaiteh takha thung e thingthainaw ni a paw awh han.
Canganae teh misur paw khinae tueng totouh thoseh, misur paw khinae teh law tunae tueng totouh thoseh, a pha vaiteh, nangmouh ni kaboumlah na ca awh vaiteh, na ram dawk lungmawngcalah kho na sak awh han.
Na ram dawk taran karoum sak vaiteh, katarengkung awm laipalah ihmutui lah na i awh han. Sarangnaw hah na ram dawk hoi ka pâlei vaiteh na ram pueng ni tahloi duenae dawk hoi a hlout awh han.
Nangmouh ni na tarannaw na pâlei awh vaiteh, tahloi hoi na thei awh han.
Nangmouh thung dawk tami panga touh ni taran 100 touh na pâlei awh han. Tami 100 touh ni taran thong hra, touh na pâlei awh vaiteh, tahloi hoi na tâ awh han.
Yawhawinae na poe awh vaiteh na pungdaw awh han. Nangmouh hoi lawkkam ka sak e pou ka caksak han.
Na pâtung e caruem abaw hoehnahlan, catha bout ao toung dawkvah caruem teh na pahoung awh han.
Kai ni panuet laipalah nangmouh koe lukkareiim ka o sak han.
Nangmouh koe ka o vaiteh nangmae Cathut lah ka o han. Nangmouh hai ka tami lah na o awh han.
Izip ram dawk san na tang awh hoeh nahanelah, Kai na BAWIPA Cathut ni na tâcokhai awh toe. Na kahnamrui ka a teh, kalan lah na ceisak toe.
Hateiteh, nangmouh ni ka lawk na ngai awh hoeh, kâpoelawk abuemlah na tarawi awh hoeh,
Ka phunglawknaw na panuet awh teh, banglahai noutna laipalah kâpoelawk na tarawi awh hoeh, lawkkam na raphoe awh pawiteh,
Nangmouh koe ka sak hane hnonaw teh, mit ronae, lungpuennae, kaluekalapnae, kahawi thai hoeh e patawnae hoi patawnae aphunphun ka pha sak han. Cati na kahei eiteh, aphu awm hoeh. Tarannaw ni a ca awh han.
Nangmouh na pahnawt awh vaiteh taran hmalah na sung sak awh han. Nangmanaw teh tarannaw ni na uk awh vaiteh apini na ka pâlei hoeh nakunghai na yawng awh han.
Hottelah na khang a eiteh, ka lawk bout na ngai awh hoehpawiteh, namae yon dawk let sari totouh na rek awh han rah.
Nangmae kâoupnae hah ka khoe han, kalvan hah sum patetlah thoseh, talai hah rahum patetlah thoseh, ka sak vaiteh,
Nangmanaw teh ayawmyin lah tha na patho awh han. Na talai ni rawca tâcawt sak mahoeh. Takha dawk e thingthainaw ni paw mahoeh.
Nangmouh ni ka lawk na ngai awh hoeh, Kai na taran awh pawiteh, na yonnae patetlah let sari touh e runae ka pha sak han.
Nangmouh koe sarang katha vaiteh, na canaw a rakoung awh han, na saringnaw kei awh vaiteh, tami hoe na youn awh han, na lamthung hai kingdi han.
Hottelah, na khang a nakunghai, na ka panuek awh hoeh lah, Kai bout na taran awh pawiteh,
Kai ni hai na taran awh vaiteh na yonnae kecu dawk let sari touh e runae hoi na rektap awh han.
Ka lawkkam na tapoe dawkvah lawkcengnae talai nangmouh lathueng ka pha sak han. Nangmouh ni kho dawk na kamkhueng awh navah, lacik ka pha sak vaiteh, taran kut dawk na poe awh han.
Nangmae rawca hah ka takhoe toteh, napui hra touh ni nangmae vaiyei hah takhuen buet touh dawk a pâeng hnukkhu, hote vaiyei hah a khing pouh teh nangmouh ni na boum awh mahoeh.
Hathnukkhu haiyah, ka lawk na ngai awh hoeh lah, Kai paroup na taran awh pawiteh,
Kai hai ka lungkhuek vaiteh, na taran awh han. Na yon kecu dawk alet sari touh na rek awh han.
Nangmouh ni na canaw e a moi na ca awh han.
Na hmuen karasangnaw hah ka raphoe vaiteh, kutsak cathutnaw hah koung ka rawp sak han. Na ronaw hah hringnae ka tawn hoeh e kutsak cathut van vah, ka tâkhawng vaiteh na panuet awh han.
Nangmae khopuinaw ka raphoe hoi hmuen kathoung ka raphoe vaiteh nangmae hmuituinaw ka pahnuem mahoeh.
Na ram pueng Kai ni ka raphoe e hah hote ram dawk kaawm e na tarannaw ni a hmu navah, kângairu awh han.
Alouke miphunnaw koe na kampek sak awh vaiteh, tahloi hoi na pâlei awh han. Na khopui a rawk vaiteh na ram a kingdi han.
Hottelah, nangmanaw teh na tarannaw e ram dawk na o awh vaiteh, na ram teh tami kingdi lah onae tueng pueng dawk, na ram kingdi vaiteh, Sabbath hninnaw dawk na nawm awh han.
Nangmouh na o nateh, Sabbath hninnaw dawkvah na ram teh kâhat mahoeh. Tami kingdi lah onae tueng dawk na ram teh kâhat lah ao han.
Taran ram dawk kaawm rae nangmae lungthin thung kaluenae ka pakhum vaiteh, thinghna kâhuet pawlawk dawk na taki vaiteh, taran kut dawk hoi na yawng e patetlah na yawng awh han. Apinihai pâlei hoeh nakunghai a rawp han.
Apinihai pâlei hoeh eiteh taran kut dawk hoi ka yawng e patetlah buet touh van buet touh a rawp awh han. Taran hmalah kangdue thainae tawn mahoeh.
Na tarannaw e ram ni na payawp awh vaiteh Jentelnaw koe na sung awh han.
Kacawirae nangmouh ni taran ram dawk nangmae yon hoi mintoenaw e yon hah na khang awh vaiteh, mintoenaw hoi cungtalah na kahma awh han.
Hateiteh, ahnimouh ni kai koe a yon awh teh, Kai na taran awh dawkvah,
Kai ni ahnimanaw ka taran vaiteh, a tarannaw e ram dawk ka thak han. Ma e yon, mintoenaw e yon hah pâpho laihoi kâhet awh pawiteh, vuensom ka a hoeh e amamae lungthin hah kârahnoum awh teh, amamae yon dawk reknae khang awh pawiteh,
Kai ni Jakop, Isak, Abraham tinaw hoi ka sak e lawkkam thoseh, hote ram thoseh pahnim mahoeh.
Hote ram teh ahnimae kut dawk hoi a hlout vaiteh, ahnimouh awm laipalah kingdi lah ao navah, amae Sabbath hninnaw dawk a nawm awh han. Ahnimouh ni ka phunglam a panuet awh teh, banglahai noutna hoeh lah a sak e yon kecu dawk reknae a khang awh han.
Hottelah tarannaw dawk ao awh navah, ahnimanaw ka raphoe vaiteh, ahnimouh hoi lawkkam e raphoe totouh, ahnimanaw Kai ni ka maithoe mahoeh. Ka pahnawt mahoeh. Kai teh ahnimae BAWIPA Cathut doeh.
Kai teh ahnimae Cathut lah ka o nahanelah Jentelnaw hmalah Izip ram hoi ka tâcokhai e ahnimae mintoenaw hoi ka sak e lawkkam hah, ahnimouh hanlah ka pahnim mahoeh. Kai teh BAWIPA doeh telah a ti.
Hote phunglawk hoi kâlawknaw hah Sinai mon dawk BAWIPA ni Isarelnaw hanlah Mosi koe a poe e doeh.
Cathut ni Mosi koe, nang ni Isarelnaw koe patuen na dei pouh hane teh,
Tami ni lawkkam e patetlah BAWIPA koe poe pawiteh, ka poe hane kawi naw, nang ni aphu tâtueng tangcoung e patetlah Cathut e hno lah ao han.
Nang ni bangtelamaw aphu na tâtueng han tetpawiteh, tongpa a kum 20 hoi 60 totouh e teh ngun tangka 50 touh lah aphu na tâtueng han.
Napui teh ngun tangka 30 touh lah aphu na tâtueng han.
Kum panga koehoi kum 20 totouh e tongpa teh ngun tangka 20, napui teh ngun tangka phek hra touh lah aphu na tâtueng han.
Kum panga a rahim e tongpa teh ngun tangka phek panga, napui teh phek thum touh lah aphu na tâtueng han.
Kumrui taruk lathueng e tongpa teh ngun tangka hlaipanga, napui teh phek hra touh lah aphu na tâtueng han.
Nang ni aphu na tâtueng e patetlah poe thai hoehpawiteh, vaihma koe a cei vaiteh, vaihma ni lawkkam ka sak e tami ni a poe thai e patetlah aphu a tâtueng pouh awh han.
Tami ni Cathut koe saring poe pawiteh, a poe e pueng teh a thoung han.
Kahawi thoseh, kahawihoehe thoseh, buet touh hoi buet touh na thung awh mahoeh. Thung han na ngai awh pawiteh, kahni touh hoi roi a thoung han.
Cathut koe poe kawi hoeh e kathounghoehe saring lah awm pawiteh vaihma koe patue vaiteh,
Ahawi hoi hawihoeh e patetlah vaihma ni aphu a tâtueng han. Vaihma ni a tâtueng e patetlah aphu teh ao han.
Kapoekung ni ratang hanelah ngai pawiteh, saring phu hoi pung panga touh dawk pung touh bout a poe sin han.
Tami ni BAWIPA hanlah a im poe pawiteh, im ahawi hoi hawihoeh e vaihma ni a khet vaiteh aphu a tâtueng han. Vaihma ni aphu a tâtueng e patetlah aphu teh ao han.
Im kapoekung ni bout ratang hanlah ngai pawiteh, im phu hoi pung panga touh dawk pung touh bout a poe sin han.
Tami ni a lawhmuen hah BAWIPA hanlah poe pawiteh, Cati patue e patetlah aphu teh a tâtueng han. Cati hmuen touh patue e law hah ngun tangka 50 touh lah aphu tâtueng han.
Jubili kum kamtawng nah a law hah poe pawiteh aphu teh a tâtueng yit touh a poe han.
Jubili kum abaw hnukkhu law hah poe pawiteh, hmalae Jubili kum totouh e a ngai rae kumnaw hah vaihma ni a parei vaiteh, a tâtueng e law phu teh a payoun pouh han.
Law kapoekung ni bout ratang hanlah ngai pawiteh, a law phu hoi pung panga pung touh bout a poe sin han.
Ratang thai hoeh lah alouke tami koe yawt pawiteh, bout ratang han lawi naseh.
Jubili kum akuep toteh, hote law teh BAWIPA e lah ao vaiteh vaihmanaw ni a pang han.
Tami ni a ran e law hah BAWIPA hanlah poe pawiteh,
Jubili kum totouh hane aphu tâtueng e hah vaihma ni a kum a parei vaiteh, aphu a tâtueng e patetlah hote tami ni hote hnin dawk a poe han. Hote teh BAWIPA e doeh.
Jubili kum a pha toteh, hote law hah ahmaloe ka tawn ni teh kayawtkung koe bout a poe han.
Aphu tâtueng e pueng dawk ngun tangka lahoi na tâtueng han. Ngun tangka phek touh e teh gerah 20 touh hoi a kâvan.
BAWIPA e lah kaawm e saring camin pueng teh, apinihai ama hanlah lat mahoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, camin teh BAWIPA e doeh. Maito, tu hoi hmaecanaw teh BAWIPA e lah doeh ao.
Kathounghoehe saring lah awm pawiteh, aphu tâtueng e patetlah a ratang vaiteh pung panga touh dawk pung touh bout a poe sin han. Ratang ngai hoehpawiteh, aphu tâtueng e patetlah a yo han.
Hateiteh, tami thoseh, saring thoseh, mae law thoseh, Cathut koe thoebo laihoi poe e pueng teh, apinihai bout ratang bout yawt nahanh lawi naseh. Thoebo laihoi poe e pueng teh Cathut hanlah kathoungpounge lah ao.
Tami patenghai thoebo laihoi na poe pawiteh, bout na ratang mahoeh, na thei han.
Cakang thoseh, apawhik thoseh, talai dawk hoi ka tâcawt e apawhik pueng hra touh dawk buet touh e teh BAWIPA e hno doeh. BAWIPA hanelah kathounge lah ao.
Hra touh dawk buet touh e hah ratang hanelah na ngai pawiteh, Aphu hoi pung panga touh dawk pung touh bout na poe sin han.
Maito thoseh, tu hoi hmae thoseh, sonron rahim vah kâen e ahranae pueng teh BAWIPA hanelah kathounge lah ao han.
Ahawi hoi hawihoeh e na khen awh mahoeh. Buet touh hoi buet touh na thung awh mahoeh. Thung han na ngai awh pawiteh, kahni touh hoi rei a thoung han. Bout na ratang mahoeh telah na dei pouh han.
Hete kâpoelawknaw teh Cathut ni Sinai mon dawk Isarelnaw hanlah Mosi koe kâ a poe e naw doeh.
Izip hoi a tâco awh hnukkhu, kum hni nah kum, thapa yung pahni, apasuek hnin vah Sinai kahrawngum kamkhuengnae lukkareiim dawk BAWIPA ni Mosi hah a pato teh,
Isarel tamihu pueng hah a miphun lahoi, a imthung lahoi, a min kâtarui lahoi tongpa pueng koung touk haw,
kum 20 lathueng Isarelnaw thung dawk hoi taran ka tuk thai e naw pueng nang nama hoi Aron ni ahuhu lahoi koung na touk awh han.
Nang koe e miphunnaw pueng thung dawk hoi imthung kahrawikung buet touh koung ao awh han.
Hetnaw heh nang koe kaawm hane tami minnaw doeh. Reuben dawk hoi Shedeur capa Elizur,
Simeon dawk hoi Zurishaddai capa Shelumiel,
Judah dawk hoi Amminadab capa Nahshon,
Issakhar dawk hoi Zuar capa Nethanel,
Zebulun dawk hoi Helon capa Eliab,
Joseph casak Ephraim dawk hoi Ammihud capa Elishama hoi, Manasseh dawk hoi Pedahzur capa Gamaliel,
Benjamin dawk hoi Gideoni capa Abidan,
Dan dawk hoi Ammishaddai capa Ahiezer,
Asher dawk hoi Okran capa Pagiel,
Gad dawk hoi Deuel capa Eliasaph,
Naphtali dawk hoi Enan capa Ahira Enan seh, atipouh.
Hetnaw heh tamimaya thung dawk hoi rawi e a na mintoenaw miphun dawk hoi kahrawikung Isarel imthung kahrawikungnaw doeh.
Hot patetlah Mosi hoi Aron ni min a kaw e hetnaw heh a ceikhai awh.
Tamimaya hah thapa yung pahni, apasuek hnin vah koung a kamkhueng awh teh, a na pa hoi, imthungnaw hoi kakhekungnaw, khetsin lahoi yah, kum 20 lathueng pueng teh kakhekungnaw hah ama buet touh min lahoi a kaw awh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe kâ a poe e patetlah Sinai kahrawngum vah a touk awh.
Isarel capa, a camin Reuben casak thung hoi a min kâtarui lah tongpa pueng kum 20 lathueng tarantuknae koe ka cet thai e,
Reuben miphun a touk awh e teh 46, 500 touh a pha awh.
Simeon casak dawk hoi a miphun lahoi imthungkhu lahoi a min kâtarui e patetlah tongpa pueng kum 20 lathueng tarantuknae koe ka cet thai naw,
Simeon casak a touk awh e naw teh 59, 300 touh a pha.
Gad catounnaw dawk hoi a miphun lahoi a imthungkhu lahoi, a min kâtarui e patetlah tongpa pueng tarantuknae koe ka cet thai naw,
Gad miphun dawk a touk awh e teh 45, 650 touh a pha.
Judah catounnaw dawk hoi a miphun lahoi a imthungkhu lahoi, a min kâtarui e patetlah tongpa pueng kum 20 lathueng tarantuknae koe ka cet thai naw,
Judah miphun dawk a touk awh e teh 74, 600 touh a pha.
Issakhar catounnaw dawk hoi a miphun lahoi a imthungkhu lahoi, a min kâtarui e patetlah tongpa pueng kum 20 lathueng tarantuknae koe ka cet thai naw,
Issakhar miphun dawk a touk awh e teh 54, 400 touh a pha.
Zebulun catounnaw dawk hoi a miphun lahoi a imthungkhu lahoi, a min kâtarui e patetlah tongpa pueng kum 20 lathueng tarantuknae koe ka cet thai naw,
Zebulun miphun dawk a touk awh e teh 57, 400 touh a pha.
Joseph catounnaw dawk hoi Ephraim catoun hai imthungkhu lahoi, a min kâtarui e patetlah tongpa pueng kum 20 lathueng tarantuknae koe ka cet thai naw,
Ephraim miphun dawk a touk awh e teh 40, 500 touh a pha.
Manasseh catounnaw dawk hoi a miphun lahoi a imthungkhu lahoi, a min kâtarui e patetlah tongpa pueng kum 20 lathueng tarantuknae koe ka cet thai naw,
Manasseh miphun dawk a touk awh e teh 32, 200 touh a pha.
Benjamin catounnaw dawk hoi a miphun lahoi a imthungkhu lahoi, a min kâtarui e patetlah tongpa pueng kum 20 lathueng tarantuknae koe ka cet thai naw,
Benjamin miphun dawk a touk awh e teh 35, 400 touh a pha.
Dan catounnaw dawk hoi a miphun lahoi a imthungkhu lahoi, a min kâtarui e patetlah tongpa pueng kum 20 lathueng tarantuknae koe ka cet thai naw,
Dan miphun dawk a touk awh e teh 62, 800 touh a pha.
Asher catounnaw dawk hoi a miphun lahoi a imthungkhu lahoi, a min kâtarui e patetlah tongpa pueng kum 20 lathueng tarantuknae koe ka cet thai naw,
Asher miphun dawk a touk awh e teh 41500 touh a pha.
Naphtali catounnaw dawk hoi a miphun lahoi a imthungkhu lahoi, a min kâtarui e patetlah tongpa pueng kum 20 lathueng tarantuknae koe ka cet thai naw,
Naphtali miphun dawk a touk awh e teh 53, 400 touh a pha.
Hotnaw teh Mosi hoi Aron ni Isarel kahrawikung hlaikahni imthung kahrawikungnaw hai a touk awh e doeh.
Hot patetlah Isarel imthung abuemlahoi kum 20 lathueng taranruknae koe ka cet thai e naw pung Isarel lah koung a touk awh teh,
a touk awh e naw pueng teh 603550 touh a pha.
Hatei, ahnimouh thung dawk hoi Levihnaw kakhekung lah touk awh hoeh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koevah,
Levih miphun teh na touk mahoeh. Isarel taminaw lahai na touksin mahoeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Levihnaw teh lawkpanuesaknae lukkareiim hoi, hnopai khenyawnkung, haw e kaawm e naw pueng ka khenyawnkung lah na pouk awh han. Lukkareiim hoi a hnonaw pueng ka kâkayawt awh teh, ka khetyawt awh han. Bawknae rim a tengpam moi ao sin awh han.
Hote bawknae rim teh a tâcokhai hanlah ao toteh, Levihnaw ni a raphoe vaiteh, hote rim bout a thung awh han. Tami alouke miphun bawk pawiteh thei lah ao han.
Isarelnaw ni amamouh o nah tangkuem koe ahuhu lahoi apap e lahoi lukkareiim teh a sak awh han.
Levihnaw a pâlei teh, kamkhueng e Isarelnaw lathueng vah a lungkhueknae ao hoeh nahan, Cathut onae im a tengpam vah a roe awh vaiteh, Levihnaw ni lawkpanuesaknae bawknae im teh, a khetyawt awh han.
Hot patetlah Isarelnaw ni BAWIPA ni Mosi koe kâ a poe e patetlah a sak awh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi hoi Aron a pato teh,
Isarelnaw ni a imthung mitnoutnae koung a vo awh vaiteh, amamae hu lahoi lukkarei rim hah a yap awh han. Kamkhuengnae lukkareiim hmalah koung a kâhmo awh nahanelah, petkâkalup lah a yap awh han.
Kanîtholah hoi kanîloumlah kangvawi sak hoi a imthung mitnout hah a vo awh vaiteh, lukkareiim ka yap kung teh Judah ransahu han doeh. Judah catoun kahrawikungnaw teh Amminadab capa Nahshon han.
A ransahu teh 74, 600 touh a pha.
A hnukthawi lukkareiim kayapkung teh Issakharnaw han. Issakhar catoun kahrawikung teh Zuar capa Nethanel han.
A ransahu teh 54, 400 touh a pha.
A hnukthawi teh Zebulun doeh. Zebulun catoun kahrawikung teh Helon capa Eliab han.
A ransahu teh 51, 400 touh a pha.
A ransahu a pap e lahoi Judahnaw a touk e lahoi 186, 400 touh a pha awh teh, hetnaw heh roenae koehoi ahmaloe a tâco awh han.
Reuben miphunnaw teh akalah ao awh han, a imthung mitnoutnae a vo awh han. Reuben catoun kahrawikung teh Shedeur capa Elizur han.
A ransahu teh 46, 500 a pha.
Hahoi mitnout ka yap hane teh Simeon miphun han. Simeon catoun kahrawikung teh Zurishaddai capa Shelumiel han.
A ransahu teh 59, 300 touh a pha.
Gad miphun doeh. Gad catoun kahrawikung teh Reuel capa Eliasaph han.
A ransahu teh 45, 650 a pha.
Reuben miphun teh a ransahu apap e lahoi, 151, 450 a pha awh. Hetnaw heh a hnuk rekkâbang hane tami lah ao awh.
Hot patetlah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim khue hoi a cei awh han. Levihnaw hah a lungui vah ao awh vaiteh, a onae koehoi kamcunae hmuen koehai a huhu lahoi a cei awh han.
A imthungkhu mitnoutnae a vonae koehoi kanîloumlah, Ephraim miphunnaw ao awh han. Ephraim catoun kahrawikung teh Ammihud capa Elishama han.
A ransahu teh 40, 500 a pha.
Hahoi Manasseh miphun han. Manasseh catoun kahrawikung teh Pedahzur capa Gamaliel han.
A ransahu teh 32, 200 a pha.
Hahoi Benjamin miphunnaw han. Benjamin catounnaw kahrawikung teh Gideoni capa Abidan han.
A ransahu teh 35, 400 a pha awh.
Ephraim catoun a ransahu a pap e lahoi touk e pueng teh, 108, 100 a pha. Hahoi rekkâbang hanelah a tâco awh han.
A imthungkhu mitnoutnae a vonae koehoi Dannaw teh atunglah ao awh han. Dan catoun kahrawikung teh Ammishaddai capa Ahiezer han.
A ransanaw teh 62, 700 a pha.
Hahoi mitnout ka yap hane teh, Asher miphun han. Asher catoun kahrawikungnaw teh Okran capa Pagiel han.
A ransahu teh 41, 500 a pha awh.
Hahoi Naphtali catounnaw han. Naphtali catounnaw kahrawikung teh Enan capa Ahira han.
A ransahu teh 53, 400 a pha awh.
Dan miphun ransahu touk e pueng teh 157, 600 a pha awh. Hahoi ahnimouh teh, a huhu lahoi ka tâcawt e a hnukteng poung lah ao awh han.
Hetnaw heh Isarel catoun a na pa e imthungkhu lahoi a touk awh e naw doeh. A ransahu teh a sumkum lah 603, 550 touh a pha.
Hatei BAWIPA ni, Mosi koe kâ a poe e patetlah Levihnaw teh Isarelnaw koe touksin e lah awm hoeh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe kâlawk a poe e patetlah Isarelnaw ni a sak awh. Amamae ahu kâbang lahoi a roe awh. Hot patetlah a miphun lahoi imthung ao awh e patetlah a tâco awh.
Hetnaw heh, Sinai mon koehoi BAWIPA ni Mosi a pato navah, Aron hoi Mosi se nah a thut e doeh.
Aron capanaw e a min teh, camin lah Nadab. Hahoi Abihu Eleazar hoi Ithamar doeh.
Hetnaw heh vaihma hanlah satui awi e, vaihma thaw tawk hanlah hmoun e, Aron e capanaw e min doeh.
Nadap hoi Abihu teh Sinai kahrawngum vah kathounghoehe hmai, BAWIPA hmalah thuengnae a sak roi navah, BAWIPA hmalah a due roi, ahnimouh roi teh capa tawn roi hoeh. Eleazar hoi Ithamar teh a na pa a hring navah vaihma thaw a tawk roi.
BAWIPA ni Mosi a pato teh,
Levih miphun teh vaihma Aron koe cetkhai nateh, a thaw a tawk thai nahan, ahni koe awm naseh.
Ahnimouh ni lukkareiim dawk thaw a tawk awh vaiteh, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim hmalah ama hoi kamkhuengnaw ni panki e patetlah thaw a tawk awh han.
Hnopai pueng a khetyawt awh vaiteh, Isarel catounnaw ni a ham kawi e lah lukkareiim dawk thaw a tawk awh han.
Levihnaw teh Aron hoi a capanaw koevah, na poe awh vaiteh, Isarel catounnaw thung hoi ahnimouh hah na rawi awh vaiteh, kai koe ahnimouh na poe awh han.
Aron hoi a capanaw hah na pouk vaiteh, vaihma coungnae hah pou a pang awh han. Ahnimouh koe miphun louk bawk pawiteh, thei lah ao han, telah a ti.
BAWIPA ni Mosi a pato teh,
khenhaw! Levihnaw heh Isarel catounnaw thung hoi camin camoim hmaloe ka paawng hanelah kai kama roeroe ni Isarel catounnaw thung hoi ka lae lah ao teh, Levihnaw teh kaie lah ao awh han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, caminnaw pueng teh kaie lah ao han. Izip ram vah caminnaw pueng ka thei navah, Isarelnaw pueng teh camin hoi tami hoi moithang hoi kai kama hanelah ka thoung sak e lah ao. Kai teh Jehovah doeh telah atipouh.
BAWIPA ni Sinai kahrawngum vah, Mosi hah a pato teh,
Levih catounnaw hah a na pa imthung lahoi tongpa pueng thapa yung touh lathueng pueng teh koung na touk han atipouh.
Hot patetlah Mosi koe kâ a poe e BAWIPA lawk patetlah koung a touk pouh.
Levih catounnaw e min teh Gershon, Kohath, hoi Merari naw doeh.
Gershon catoun imthungnaw e teh, Libni hoi Shimei doeh.
Kohath catoun imthungnaw e teh Amram, Izhar, Hebron hoi Uziel doeh.
Merari catoun imthungnaw teh, Mahli hoi Mushi doeh. Hetnaw heh a na pa imthung lahoi Levih catounnaw doeh.
Gershon teh Libni imthung hoi Shimei imthung kakhekung doeh. Hetnaw heh Gershom catounnaw doeh.
Thapa yung touh hoi lathueng tongpa pueng a touk awh e teh 7500 touh a pha.
Gershon catoun imthungnaw teh lukkareiim a hnuklah kanîloumlah a roe awh han.
Gershonnaw e imthung kahrawikung teh Lael capa Eliasaph han.
Gershon catounnaw thaw teh, lukkareiim lemphu ramuk nahane hoi kamkhuengnae takhang dawk hane yaphni hoi,
thongma takhang dawk hane yaphni hoi khoungroe petkâkalup e hnonaw hoi, hawvah hnonaw pueng a tawk awh hanelah ao han.
Kohath teh Amram imthung, Izhar imthung, Hebron imthung hoi Uziel imthungnaw kakhekung doeh. Hetnaw heh Kohath catounnaw doeh.
Tongpa pueng thapa yung touh hoi lathueng hmuen kathoung ringnae koe tawk hanelah a poe e naw a touk awh navah 8600 a pha.
Kohath catoun imthungnaw teh lukkareiim akalah a roe awh han.
Kohath catoun imthung kahrawikung teh Uziel capa Elizaphan han.
Ahnimae thaw teh, thingkong hoi caboi hoi satui hmaiimkhok hoi, thuengnae hoi, hmuen kathoung koe thaw tawk nahane, hlaamnaw, lukkarei yap e hoi haw e thaw tawknae koe e hnopainaw pueng lah ao han.
Hahoi vaihma Aron capa Eleazar teh Levihnaw kahrawikung a lû lah ao han. Hmuen kathoung karingkungnaw hah a hrawi han.
Merari teh Mahlinaw thung hoi Mushinaw imthung kakhekung lah ao. Hetnaw teh Merari imthungnaw doeh.
Tongpanaw pueng thapa yung touh lathueng a touk awh navah 6200 a pha.
Merari catounnaw e imthung kahrawikung teh Abihail capa Zuriel doeh. Hetnaw teh lukkareiim atunglah a roe awh han.
Merari capa hoi a tawk han kawi lah pouk e teh lukkareiim tapang, pangkhek, khom, a tâphai kepnae, a hnopainaw hoi a thaw tawknae hnopai lah ao awh.
Thongma petkâkalup lah khonaw teh, a kangdue nahane cemnaw pueng hoi a hetsinnae ruinaw hai a sak han.
Hothloilah lukkareiim kanîtholah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim hmalah ka roe e naw teh Mosi, Aron hoi a canaw han. Hmuen kathoung ringnae koe teh Isarel catounnaw a pankinae pueng koe a tawk awh han. Hatei alouke tami rek kahnai e awm pawiteh, thei lah ao han.
BAWIPA kâpoe e lahoi Levihnaw e a catoun tongpanaw thapa yung touh lathueng hoi Aron ni touk e naw teh 22, 000a pha awh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koevah, Isarel catounnaw thung dawk camin tongpa thapa yung touh lathueng pueng nâyittouh maw ka phat tie a min lahoi koung touk loe.
Hahoi Levihnaw hah Isarel catoun thung dawk hoi caminnaw yueng lah kai hanelah na la vaiteh, Levihnaw e saring hai, Isarel catounnaw e saring camin pueng e yueng lah kai hanlah na la han. Kai teh Jehovah doeh atipouh.
Mosi teh BAWIPA ni kâ a poe e patetlah Isarel catoun thung dawk caminnaw pueng hah a touk awh
A min phung e lahoi thapa yung touh lathueng tongpa camin pueng a touk awh e teh 22, 273 a pha.
BAWIPA ni Mosi a pato teh,
Isarel catoun camin yueng lah Levihnaw hah lat nateh, a saring yueng lah, Levihnaw e saring lat pouh. Levihnaw teh kaie lah ao awh han. Kai teh Jehovah doeh.
Levihnaw hlak vah, bet kapap e Isarel catoun camin 273 ratang nahanelah,
tami buet touh hane hmuen kathoung khingnae tangka patetlah shekel panga touh rip na la awh han. Hmuen kathoung khingnae shekel teh gerah 20 touh a pha.
Ka cawi e ratang nahan hnopai teh Aron hoi a capanaw na poe han telah a ti.
Hahoi Mosi ni Levihnaw ni a ratang awh hoeh e ratangnae hnopai hah a la.
Isarel catoun caminnaw koehoi hnopainaw a la teh hmuen kathoung shekel 1365 a la pouh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi kâ a poe e BAWIPA lawk patetlah Mosi ni a ratangnae hnopai teh Aron hoi a capanaw a poe awh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi hoi Aron a pato teh,
Levihnaw thung dawk Kohath capanaw a catoun lahoi a imthung lahoi,
kum 30 lathueng kum 50 totouh kamkhuengnae lukkareiim dawk thaw ka tawk hane naw teh koung a touk awh.
Hete kamkhuengnae lukkareiim dawk kathoungpounge hno hoi kâkuen lah Kohath casaknaw e thaw lah ao.
Roenae koehoi a kampuen awh tangkuem vah, Aron hoi a capa a tho vaiteh, hmuen kathoung lukkareiim yap e hah a la vaiteh lawkpanuesaknae thingkong hah a ramuk han.
Hahoi phaivuen hoi a ramuk vaiteh, kamthim hni hoi bout a ramuk han. Hahoi a tâphai hah a hrawt han.
Caboi dawk kamthim hni a phai vaiteh, tongben, pacen, awi nahane kawlungnaw hoi, vaiyei hruek vaiteh.
Hot teh hni paling a ramuk awh vaiteh, saram pho hoi a ramuk vaiteh, a tâphai a hrawt awh han.
Hmaiimkhok hoi hawvah hno hane hmaiim, paitei hoi paitei tanae manang, satuiumnaw hah kamthim hni hoi a ramuk han.
Hote hno hoi a puengcangnaw teh saram pho hoi ramuk vaiteh kâkayawtnae dawk a tâ han.
Sui khoungroe hah kamthim hni hoi ramuk vaiteh, saram pho hoi a ramuk han. Hahoi a tâphai na hrawt han.
Hmuen kathoung koe thaw tawknae hnonaw pueng hah, koung a la vaiteh, kamthim hni hoi a taoung awh han. Saram pho hoi a ramuk awh han, kâkayawtnae a hrawt awh han.
Khoungroe dawk e hraba hah kathoungcalah kawn vaiteh, avan vah hni paling a phai awh han.
Avan vah thaw a tawknae hlaamnaw pueng, hmaisawinae, cingco, tawkso ka kaw e, maroi, hoi thuengnae khoungroe dawk a ta awh han. Saram pho hoi a ramuk awh vaiteh, a tâphai kâkayawtnae a hrawt awh han.
Hahoi Aron hoi a capanaw ni, a hmuen kathoung poung hoi hmuen kathoung hnopainaw koung a ramuk awh vaiteh, a onae hmuen a kampuen awh nah karawitawi Kohath capa ni kâkayawt hanelah a tho awh han. Hatei kathounge hno hah tek awh mahoeh. Tek awh boipawiteh, a due awh han. Hetnaw heh kamkhuengnae lukkareiim hno, Kohath capanaw ni a tawk awh hane doeh.
Hahoi vaihma Aron capa Eleazar capa a tawk hane kawi teh, paang hane satui hoi hmuitui pout laipalah, tavai poenae, awi e satui hoi lukkareiim thung kaawm e hnonaw pueng, hmuen kathoung hoi hnopainaw ring hanelah ao telah a ti.
BAWIPA ni Mosi hoi Aron a pato teh,
Kohath catoun imthungnaw hah Levihnaw thung dawk hoi kahmat sak hanh.
Hatei kathoungpounge hno hah ouk a hnai toteh, dout laipalah a hring awh nahan, hot hoi kâkuen lah het heh sak loe. Aron hoi a capa hah a kâen vaiteh, a tawk awh hane thaw hah amamouh lengkaleng pouk pouh naseh.
Hatei, kathoungpounge hno khet hanlah dongdeng hai kâen hanh awh. Hoehpawiteh a due awh han telah atipouh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi a pato teh,
Gershon capanaw hoi a imthungkhu a catounnaw abuemlah koung a touk awh.
kum 30 hoi a lathueng a lathueng kum 50 totouh, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim koe thaw ka tawk hane naw hah koung a touk awh.
Gershon catounnaw a tawk awh hanelah a kamngai awh e teh,
Lukkareiim dawk lukkarei yap e, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang koe hni yap e hah,
Kalupnae hni yap e, kalupnae longkha koe yap e, bawknae rim thuengnae khoungroe teng kaawm e, arui hoi a hnopainaw pueng a phu awh vaiteh, tawksak a ngai e pueng a tawk awh han.
Gershon capanaw a tawk awh nah tangkuem koe Aron hoi a capanaw ni thaw a poe awh e patetlah a tawk awh han.
Hetheh, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim Gershon capa imthungnaw e thaw a tho. Ahnimae thaw hah, vaihma Aron capa Ithamar kâtawnae rahim ao awh han.
Merari capanaw kong dawk a catounnaw abuemlahoi imthungkhu lahoi koung na touk a han.
Kum 30 hoi a lathueng lah kum 50 totouh kamkhuengnae lukkareiim dawk thaw a tawk awh hanelah ka kâen hane pueng na touk awh han.
Kamkhuengnae lukkareiim dawk, ka ceitakhai han naw e thaw teh, hethah doeh. Bawknae im tapang, thing a tâphai hai, a khom, a kanâ,
thongma tumdumnae khom, a kanâ, cem, hoi ruinaw, hote hnopainaw pueng hoi alouke hnonaw kâkayawt hanelah, a min lahoi amamae ham na pouk pouh han.
Hetheh vaihma Aron capa Ithamar kâtawnnae rahim vah, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim hanelah Merari capa imthungnaw niyah a sak awh hane thaw la doeh ao telah atipouh.
Hahoi Mosi hoi Aron hoi tamimaya kahrawikungnaw ni Kohath capa a catoun abuemlahoi imthung abuemlahoi,
kamkhuengnae lukkareiim dawk a tawk awh hane hah kum 30 touh hoi a lathueng lah kum 50 totouh a touk awh.
A catoun abuemlahoi a touk awh e teh, 2, 750 a pha.
Hotnaw teh kamkhuengnae lukkareiim dawk thaw ka tawk thai e Kohath casaknaw a touk awh e Mosi hno lahoi BAWIPA kâpoe e patetlah Mosi hoi Aron ni a touk roi e doeh.
Gershon capanaw kamkhuengnae lukkareiim tawk ka tawk hane teh, a na pa im hoi imthung abuemlahoi doeh.
Kum 30 touh hoi a lathueng kum 50 totouh touk e lah ao.
A imthung abuemlahoi a napanaw imthung abuemlah a touk awh e teh 2, 630 touh a pha.
Hetnaw teh Gershon capanaw e casaknaw kamkhuengnae lukkareiim thaw katawknaw lah BAWIPA kâpoe e patetlah Mosi hoi Aron ni a touk e naw doeh.
Hahoi Merari capa ni kamkhuengnae lukkareiim dawk thaw ka tawk hane teh a napanaw imthung hoi amamouh imthungnaw seng doeh.
Kum 30 hoi a lathueng kum 50 totouh touk e lah ao.
A na pa hoi imthung abuemlah a touk awh e teh, 3, 200 touh a pha.
Hetnaw heh Merari capanaw a touk awh e teh Mosi hno lahoi BAWIPA kâpoe e patetlah Mosi hoi Aron ni a touk roi e doeh.
Levihnaw thaw tawk hanelah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim phu hanelah, hoi ouk ka phawt e a napanaw imthung lahoi a imthungkhu abuemlahoi
kum 30 lathueng kum 50 totouh Mosi hoi Aron Isarel kahrawikungnaw ni a touk awh.
A touk awh e naw teh, 8, 580 touh a pha
Mosi hno lahoi BAWIPA kâpoe e patetlah tami pueng ni a tawk awh hane teh, a ham awh e hoi ka kâvan lah a touksin awh. BAWIPA ni Mosi kâ a poe e patetlah a touk awh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi a pato teh,
Isarel catounnaw ka hrikbeinaw hoi moihnakathout hoi tami ro kâbet e hoi kakhin e napui tongpa naw hah roenae rim hloilah tâco sak hanelah kâ a poe.
A lungui vah, ka onae roenae hmuen hah a khin sak awh hoeh nahanelah, napui tongpa roenae hmuen lawilah na tâco sak han.
Isarel catounnaw ni hot patetlah a sak awh teh, roenae hmuen alawilah ouk a tâco sak awh. BAWIPA ni Mosi koe a dei e patetlah Isarel catounnaw ni a sak awh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi hah a pato teh,
Isarel catounnaw koe dei pouh loe. Tongpa thoseh, napui thoseh, BAWIPA taranlahoi yon bang patet e a sak awh teh yon pen e lah ao toteh,
a sak awh e yonnae hah pankângai hoi a kâhei awh han. Hahoi a sakpayon e yonnae phu teh ka kuepcalah a patho han. Hahoi a tak dawk hawihoehnae a sak e hah pung panga touh dawk pueng touh a thap han.
Hatei, yon phu kacoekung ni a hmaunawngha tawn hoehpawiteh, BAWIPA koe thueng e yon phu teh vaihma koe a poe han. Yontha nahanlah tutan a thueng e touksin laipalah yonthanae alouke a sak han.
Hahoi Isarel catounnaw ni a poe awh e pueng Isarelnaw hno kathoung pueng vaihma koe a thokhai e pueng teh amae lah ao han.
Tami tangkuem ni a poe awh e hno kathoung poung hah a ahnimae lah ao han. Tami pueng ni vaihma koe a poe awh e teh ahnimae lah ao han, telah a ti.
BAWIPA ni Mosi hah a pato teh,
Isarel catounnaw koe dei pouh loe. Ahnimouh koe, apipatet e a yu nakunghai, a vâ koe yuemkamcu lah awm laipalah alouke a ngai e awm pawiteh,
a payon lahun nah ayâ ni hmawt hoeh, kapanuekkhaikung awm hoeh eiteh, hote hah a pâpha teh, a vâ ni panue hoeh nakunghai thoseh,
ahni lathueng dipmanae muitha a pha hai thoseh, a yu a dipma nakunghai thoseh, hahoi napui a kamhnawng teh dipmanae muitha tongpa koe a tho hai thoseh, a yu hah a dipma ei, a yu kamhnawng hoeh pawiteh,
tongpa ni a yu hah vaihma koe a thokhai han, napui hanlah a panki e poehno catun ephah pung hra pung touh dawk buet touh, satui awi mahoeh, hmuitui hai kalawt mahoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, hethateh dipmanae canei thuengnae, pahnim hoeh nahan canei thuengnae, payonnae panue nahanelah pahnim hoeh nahane doeh.
Vaihma ni napui hah a thokhai vaiteh, BAWIPA hmalah a kangdue sak han.
Vaihma ni talai hlaam dawk hoi tui kathoung a la vaiteh, lukkareiim khom koe e vaiphu a la vaiteh tui dawk a phuen han.
Vaihma ni napui hah BAWIPA hmalah a kangdue sak vaiteh, a sam a rathap sak han. Yu dipmanae tavai thuengnae kâhruetcuet poe nahanelah thuengnae hah a kut dawk a sin sak han. Hahoi vaihma ni thoebonae tui kakhat e hah a sin han.
Vaihma ni napui hah lawk a kam sak vaiteh, napui koe na vâ e kâtawnnae dawk na 0 navah, ayâ ni na ipkhai hoehpawiteh, na kamhnawngnae lam dawk na dawn hoeh boum teh hete thoebonae kaphawtkung kakhat e tui dawk hoi na hlout han.
Hatei, na vâ e kâtawnnae dawk na o navah, nama na kamhnawng teh ayâ ni na ipkhai boipawiteh telah na ti vaiteh,
vaihma ni napui hah thoebonae lawkkam rahim vah ao sak vaiteh, napui koe BAWIPA ni na phai a kamsoe sak teh na von a phing sak toteh, BAWIPA ni na miphunnaw thung dawk thoebonae kaphawtkung lah na awm naseh.
Hahoi, thoebonae kaphawtkung hete tui ni na ruen dawk a kâen vaiteh, na von a phing sak vaiteh, na phai a kamsoe sak han, telah ati han. Hahoi napui ni teh, Amen, hot patetlah thoseh ati han.
Vaihma ni thoebonae lawk hah cauk dawk a thut vaiteh, kakhat e tui dawk a phum han.
Hahoi thoebonae kaphawtkung kakhat e tui hah, napui hah a pânei han. Hot patetlah thoebonae kaphawtkung a von thung a kâen vaiteh a kha han.
Hot patetlah vaihma ni dipmanae canei thuengnae a kahek vaiteh, a poe e napui e kut dawk hoi a la vaiteh, BAWIPA hmalah tavai thuengnae a sin pouh vaiteh, thuengnae khoungroe koe a ceikhai han.
Vaihma ni panuenae tavai thuengnae hah kutvang touh a la vaiteh, khoungroe dawk a sawi han. Hathnukkhu, kakhat e tui hah napui a pânei han.
Tui a nei sak toteh, hettelah han doeh. A la kamhnawng teh a vâ koe yonnae sak boipawiteh, thoebonae kaphawtkung lah ao dawk kakhat e tui teh a von thung a kâen vaiteh a kha han. A von a phing vaiteh, a phai hah a kamsoe han. Hahoi teh, hote napui teh a miphunnaw thung dawkvah, thoebo e lah ao han.
Hatei, napui teh kamhnawng hoeh lah thoung boipawiteh, a hlout vaiteh, camo ka vawn thai e lah ao han.
Hete napui ni a vâ e kâtawnnae rahim ao navah, kho louk lah radoung hoi a vâ hoeh e tami alouke hoi koe ka kamhnawng e thoseh,
tongpa ni dipmanae lungthin ueue tawn pawiteh, a yu a dipma dawkvah, dipmanae kâlawk lah ao han. Hahoi teh napui hah BAWIPA hmalah a ceikhai vaiteh, vaihma ni hete kâlawknaw pueng a tak dawk a sak pouh han.
Hottelah, tongpa teh payonpakainae koehoi a hlout han. Hatei, hete napui ni yonpennae naw heh a khang han, atipouh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi hah a pato teh,
Isarel catounnaw koe dei pouh. Ahnimouh koe tongpa thoseh, napui thoseh BAWIPA koe ama Nazirite lawkkamnae la hanlah, a kâkapek teh a kâhmoun toteh,
misur hoi yamu tek mahoeh. Misurtui hoi yamucang hai net mahoeh. Misurtui nei e hoi misurpaw katha e khumbei dawk vaw teh kamyai e hai cat mahoeh.
A kâkapek nah yunglam pueng teh misurkung dawk hoi a mu thoseh, atui thoseh cat awh mahoeh.
A kâkapeknae lawk a kam nah thung pueng teh, a lû ngaw mahoeh. BAWIPA hmalah a kâpeknae hnin a pha hoehroukrak teh kathounge lah ao han. Hottelah a sam a hlung vaiteh, a sai sak han.
BAWIPA hanlah a kâkapeknae thung pueng teh, tami ro koe hnai mahoeh.
A na pa thoseh, a manu thoseh, a hmaunawngha thoseh, a tawncanu thoseh, a duenae kong dawk hai kâkhinsak hanh naseh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Cathut hanlah a kâkapeknae a lû dawk ao.
A kâkapek yunglam teh BAWIPA hanlah kathounge lah ao han.
Ateng vah, pouk laipalah tami koe dout pawiteh, a kâkapeknae a lû dawk khin sak pawiteh, a kamthoung nah hnin vah, a lû a ngaw vaiteh, a hnin sari hnin vah a pâkhamuen a ngaw han.
A hnin taroe hnin vah, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang koe e vaihma koe bakhu kahni touh thoseh, Âbakhu kahni touh thoseh a sin awh han.
Vaihma ni buet touh teh yon thueng nahanlah a poe vaiteh, alouke buet touh teh hmaisawi thueng nahan, tami kadout kecu dawk a sakpayon e dawk a yontha nahanlah a sak pouh han. Hot hnin vah a lû hah a thoung sak han.
Hahoi kâtapoe thuengnae dawkvah kum touh ka pha e tuca a tan a thokhai vaiteh, kâkapeknae hnin teh BAWIPA koe vah a katha lah a tâcokhai han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, kâkapeknae hah a khin sak toung dawkvah, ahmaloe e teh banglah tho mahoeh toe.
Hahoi Nazirite a kâkapeknae hnin a kuep toteh, a sak awh hane kâlawk doeh. Kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang koe na ceikhai awh han.
Hahoi BAWIPA koe thuengnae hah a poe han. Tutan kacueme hmaisawi thuengnae koe buet touh, yon thueng nahanelah tulaca kacueme buet touh, roum thueng nahanelah, kacueme tutanca buet touh,
tonphuenhoehe tavai hah a kanui e tavai satui hoi kanawk e tavai tueng buet touh satui hluk e tavai ka rapamca e a tabu buet touh, tavai thuengnae hoi lannae thueng hoi na poe awh han.
Hahoi vaihma ni tavai hah BAWIPA hmalah a thokhai vaiteh, yon thuengnae hoi hmaisawi thuengnae hah a poe han.
Hahoi tutan hah tonphuenhoehe tavai tabu dawk hoi roum thuengnae hah Bawipa koe a poe han. Vaihma ni tavai thuengnae, nei thuengnae hoi a poe sin han.
Nazirite tami ni, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang koe a sam hah a ngaw vaiteh, roum thuengnae a saknae koe hmai hoi a sawi han.
Hahoi vaihma ni tutan e a loung a thawng e hoi tonphuenhoehe a tabu dawk a ta e vaiyei buet touh, tonphuenhoehe vaiyei ka rapam e phen buet touh, a la vaiteh, Nazirite niyah a kâhmounnae a sam koung a ngaw hnukkhu hoi a kut dawk a ta han.
Hahoi vaihma ni kahek thuengnae dawkvah, BAWIPA hmalah a kahek han. Hetheh vaihma hmang lah kaawm han. Hetheh vaihma e ham lah kaawm han. Kahek e a takuep hoi a kahek e a phai teh a thoung han, hahoi teh Nazirite tami ni misur a nei thai han toe, telah a ti.
Hetheh Nazirite lawkkam a kâhmounnae hoi poehno e BAWIPA koe lawkkamnae kasakkung e kâlawk lah ao. Hothloilah a ma kut hoi ka dam sak e pueng hah lawkkamnae a sak e patetlah a kâhmounnae kâlawk patetlah a sak roeroe han. ;
BAWIPA ni Mosi hah a pato teh,
Aron hoi a capanaw koevah, het patetlah Isarel catounnaw yawhawi na poe han, ahnimouh koe,
BAWIPA ni yawhawi na poe awh teh, na khenyawn awh naseh.
BAWIPA ni a minhmai nangmouh koe kho lah a sei vaiteh, na pahren awh naseh.
BAWIPA teh nangmouh koelah kangvawi seh, roumnae na poe awh han, telah dei pouh awh telah a dei.
Hot patetlah sak e ni Isarel catounnaw koe ka min a kamnue sak awh han. Kai ni ahnimouh teh yawhawi ka poe han, telah a ti.
Hahoi teh, hettelah doeh. Mosi ni lukkareiim a sak teh, a cum toteh, a hnopainaw hoi a khoungroe hoi hlaam naw pueng hah satui a hluk teh a thoung sak.
Hahoi Isarel kahrawikung, a imthung kahrawikung, a miphun kahrawikungnaw a touk awh e ni poehno hane hah a poe awh.
A poe awh e naw hah BAWIPA hmalah a thokhai awh vaiteh, a lemphu kaawm e leng taruk touh, maitotan hlaikahni touh, kahrawikung kahni touh ni leng buet touh lengkaleng, buet touh ni maitotan buet touh lengkaleng lukkareiim hmalah a thokhai awh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi a pato teh,
kamkhuengnae lukkareiim dawk thaw tawk navah a cungkei han dawkvah, ahnimouh koehoi dâw pouh. Levihnaw koe a thaw tawknae hoi kâkuen lah na poe han, telah atipouh.
Hahoi Mosi ni leng hoi maitotan a la teh, Levihnaw hah a poe.
Leng kahni touh hoi maitotan pali touh hah Gershon capa hah a thaw hoi kamcu lah a poe awh.
Leng pali touh hoi maitotan taroe touh hah vaihma Aron capa Ithamar, Merari capa hah a thaw hoi kamcu lah a poe awh.
Hatei, Kohath capa teh poe awh hoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, hmuen kathoung koe e thaw a ham e lah ao teh, aloung hoi kâkayawnkung lah ao.
Thuengnae khoungroe hah satui awi hanlah ao toteh, kahrawikungnaw ni lungtho lahoi a poe awh e heh khoungroe dawk a ta awh. Hot patetlah pasoumhno a poe han telah ati.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, BAWIPA ni Mosi koevah thuengnae khoungroe dawk poe hanelah, hnin touh dawk kahrawikung buet touh ni pasoumhno hah a poe han telah ati.
Apasuek hnin vah, pasoumhno ka poe e teh, Judah miphun dawk hoi Amminadab capa Nahshon ni a poe.
A poe e teh shekel 130 ka ri e ngun hlaam buet touh, hmuen kathoung shekel 70 touh ka ri e ngun kawlung buet touh, tavai thuengnae hanlah vaiui satui hoi kanawk tangcoung e hote roi dawk ka kawi lah,
shekel hra touh ka ri e hmuitui hoi ka kawi e suipacen buet touh,
hmaisawi thueng nahane maitotanca buet touh, tu buet touh, tutanca kum touh e buet touh,
yon thueng nahane maitotan kahni touh,
roum thueng nahanelah maitotan kahni, tu panga, hmaetan panga, tutanca kum touh e panga touh. Hetnaw heh Amminadab capa Nahshon ni a pasoung e naw doeh.

hmaisawi thueng nahane maitotanca buet touh, tu buet touh, tutanca kum touh ka phat e buet touh,
yon thueng nahane hmaetan buet touh,
roum thueng nahanelah maitotan kahni, tutan panga, hmaetan panga, tutanca kum touh ka phat e panga touh. Hetnaw heh Zuar capa Nethanel ni a pasoung e naw doeh.
