Hot patetlah thuengnae khoungroe satui awi nah hnin vah, Isarel kahrawikungnaw ni a pasoung awh e ngun hlaam hlaikahni touh, ngun kawlung hlaikahni touh, suipacen hlaikahni touh a pha.
Ngun hlaam teh shekel 130 touh a ri teh, ngun kawlung teh shekel 70 touh a ri. Ngun hlaamnaw pueng teh hmuen kathoung khingnae shekel 20,400 touh a ri.
Hmuitui suipacen 12 touh dawk ka kawi e teh, hmuen kathoung shekel 10 tabang hane a ri. Suipacen pueng teh shekel 120 touh a ri.
Hmaisawi thueng nahan maitotanca abuemlah 12, tutan 12, tutanca kum touh e 12, tavai thueng nahanlah a pasoung awh e pueng hoi yon thueng nahanelah hmaetan 12,
tutan 60, hmaetan 60, tutanca kum touh e 60 touh a pha. Hetnaw heh satui awi hnukkhu thuengnae khoungroe dawk thueng nahanlah a poe awh e doeh.
Hot patetlah, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim dawk bawk hanelah, Mosi a kâen navah, lawkpanuesaknae thingkong dawk lungmanae tungkhung a lathueng lavah, cherubim kahni touh e rahak hoiyah, ama hoi lawk kâthai lah a kâpato roi.
BAWIPA ni Mosi hah a pato teh,
Aron hah pato nateh ahni koe, hmaiim hah na paang toteh, hmaiim sari touh ni hmaiimkhok hmalah a ang awh han, telah atipouh.
A dei e patetlah Aron ni a sak. BAWIPA ni Mosi kâ a poe e patetlah hmaiimkhok a hmalah a ang hanlah hmaiim teh a paang.
Hete hmaiimkhok teh sui hoi mek dêi sin e doeh. BAWIPA ni Mosi koe a meilam a kamnue sak e patetlah a sak pouh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi hah a pato teh,
Levihnaw hah Isarelnaw thung dawk hoi aloukcalah hmoun nateh, kamthoung sak.
Ahnimouh a kamthoung nahanelah, hettelah na sak han. Ahnimouh tak dawk thoungnae tui hah kaheisin nateh, a takbuem muen koung ngaw naseh, a khohna pâsu awh vaiteh, kamthoung naseh.
Maitotanca buet touh hoi, tavai thuengnae a kanui e satui hoi kalawt e lat sak loe. Yon thuengnae maitotanca buet touh na ceikhai han.
Levihnaw hah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim koe a ceikhai vaiteh, Isarel catoun tamimaya teh cungtalah pâkhueng.
Hahoi teh, Levihnaw hah BAWIPA hmalah na thokhai awh han. Isarel catounnaw ni Levihnaw lathueng a kut a toung pouh vaiteh,
Aron ni Levihnaw hah BAWIPA thaw a tawk awh thai nahan, Isarel catounnaw koe kahek thuengnae BAWIPA hmalah a poe awh han.
Levihnaw ni maitotanca e a lû dawk a kut a toung awh vaiteh, Levihnaw han yontha nahanlah BAWIPA Cathut hmalah maito buet touh, hmaisawi thueng nahanlah buet touh na sak han.
Levihnaw hah Aron hoi a canaw hmalah a kangdue vaiteh, BAWIPA koe kahek thuengnae patetlah na sak han.
Hot patetlah, Isarel catoun thung hoi Levihnaw hah na hmoun vaiteh, Levihnaw teh kai ka ham lah ao han.
Hathnukkhu hoi teh, Levihnaw ni kamkhuengnae lukkareiim koe a kâen awh han. Nang ni ahnimanaw thoung sak hanlah, kahek thuengnae patetlah na sak pouh han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Isarel miphun thung dawk hoi ahnimanaw hah na rawi vaiteh, kai koe koung na poe han. Isarel miphunnaw ni hmaloe a khe awh e camin yueng lah ka la toe.
Izipnaw e caminnaw kai ni ka thei navah, Isarel miphun dawk teh tami thoseh, saring thoseh, caminnaw pueng hah kai kama hanlah ka thoung sak dawkvah, caminnaw pueng teh kai ka ham doeh.
Hahoi Isarel catounnaw dawk camin hanlah Levihnaw teh kai ni ka la toe.
Ahnimanaw ni kamkhuengnae lukkareiim koevah, Isarelnaw ni a tawk awh hane thaw a tawk awh thai nahan thoseh, Isarel miphunnaw ni kathoungpounge hmuen koe a cei awh toteh, Lacik dawk hoi a hlout awh thai nahan, yontha sak nahan hai thoseh, Isarel miphun thung hoi Levihnaw teh Aron hoi a canaw hah ka poe telah a ti.
Levihnaw hanlah BAWIPA Cathut ni Mosi koe a dei e patetlah Mosi hoi Aron koehoi Isarel miphunnaw abuemlah hanelah Levihnaw ni a sak awh han.
Ahnimanaw ni thoungnae a hmu awh teh, amamae khohna a pâsu awh. Aron ni hai BAWIPA hmalah kahek thuengnae BAWIPA koe yonthanae ahnimouh han a sak teh a thoung awh.
Hahoi teh, Levihnaw hmalah Aron hoi a canaw hmalah a thaw tawk hanlah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim thung a kâen. Levihnaw kong dawk BAWIPA ni Mosi kâ a poe e patetlah ahnimouh koe a sak pouh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi hah a pato teh,
Hetheh Levihnaw a coungnae doeh. Kum 25 touh lathueng ni kamkhuengnae lukkareiim dawk thaw a tawk awh han.
Kum 50 ka phat e ni thaw a kâhat han, tawk awh mahoeh toe.
Hatei, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim khetyawtnae dawkvah, a hmaunawnghanaw a kabawp han. Thaw teh tawk mahoeh. Het patetlah Levihnaw a thaw kong dawk, laideitâtueng pouh loe telah atipouh.
Izip ram hoi a tâco hoi a kum pahni, thapa yung pasuek navah, BAWIPA ni Sinai ram kahrawngum vah, Mosi hah a pato teh,
Isarel catounnaw ni ceitakhai pawi hah ama tueng dawk a sak awh naseh.
Atueng teh atu e thapa hnin hrahlaipali tangmin lah na sak awh han. Ama e phunglam patetlah na hno awh han telah atipouh.
Hahoi teh, Mosi ni Isarelnaw hah ceitakhai pawi hno hanlah a dei pouh.
Sinai kahrawngum vah thapa ayung pasuek hnin hrahlaipali tangmin lah ceitakhai pawi a sak awh. BAWIPA ni Mosi koe kâlawk a poe e patetlah Isarelnaw ni a sak awh.
Hahoi tami bangpatet ni tami ro kecu dawk kathoung hoeh lah awm pawiteh, hot hnin vah ceitakhai pawi dawk bawk thai hoeh. Hot hnin vah Mosi hoi Aron hmalah a cei teh,
ahnimouh ni ama koe tami ro kecu dawk kathoung hoeh toe. Bangkongmaw Isarelnaw koevah, ama tue vah, BAWIPA koe thuengnae dawk na bawk sak hoeh telah ati awh.
Mosi ni duem awm awh ei, nangmouh kong dawk BAWIPA ni bangtelamaw kâ na poe tie hah ka ring ei vai telah atipouh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi hah a pato teh,
Isarel catounnaw koehoi nangmouh thung hoi thoseh, na catounnaw thung hoi thoseh, tami ro kecu dawk kathounghoehnaw thoseh, lamhla vah kahlawng kacetnaw thoseh, na awm payon pawiteh, BAWIPA hanlah ceitakhai pawi hah a hno thai awh.
Thapa yung pahni hnin hrahlaipali hnin tangmin lah a hno thai awh han. Tonphuenhoehe vaiyei hah kakhat e a hna hoi a ca awh han.
Tangtho hanlah bangcahai na tat awh mahoeh. A hru na khoe mahoeh. Ceitakhai pawi saknae lah a pouk e naw pueng a sak awh han.
Hahoi, a thoung ngoun ei, kahlawng hai cet hoeh ei, ceitakhai pawi dawk bawk hoehpawiteh, a miphun koehoi takhoe e lah ao han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, ama tueng dawkvah, BAWIPA koe thuengnae a sak hoeh dawkvah, ama koe yon a kamtue han.
Hahoi, nangmouh koe kaawm e imyin ni BAWIPA hane ceitakhai pawi dawk bawk han ngai pawiteh, ceitakhai pawi dawk pouk e hoi kâlawk patetlah a sak van han. Ram thung e tami hoi imyin naw hanelah kâvancalah phunglam na tawn awh han, telah dei pouh atipouh.
Hot patetlah lukkareiim kangdue sak navah, lukkareiim, lawkpanuesaknae rim hah tâmai, hmai patetlah ka kamnuek e hah lukkareiim lathueng tangmin lahoi amom totouh ao.
Hot patetlah tâmai ni pou a ramuk teh tangmin teh hmai patetlah pou a kamnue.
Lukkareiim dawk e tâmai a kampuen toteh, Isarel catounnaw a cei awh han. Hahoi tâmai a kangdue tangkuem vah, Isarel catounnaw ni rim a sak awh han.
BAWIPA kâpoe e patetlah Isarelnaw hah a cei awh vaiteh, BAWIPA kâpoe e lahoi a roe awh han. Lukkareiim dawk tâmai a kangdue yunglam teh, rim thung vah pou ao awh.
Lukkareiim dawk tâmai kasawlah kaawm nakunghai, Isarelnaw ni BAWIPA e kâ a ngai awh dawkvah, cet laipalah ao awh.
Hahoi teh hettelah doeh. Tâmai teh lukkareiim dawkvah, dongdeng ao navah, BAWIPA kâpoe e patetlah roenae rim dawk pou ao awh han. Hahoi BAWIPA kâpoe e patetlah a cei awh han.
Hahoi teh hettelah doeh. Tâmai teh tangmin lahoi amom totouh dueng doeh ao teh, amom lah tâmai a kampuen toteh, a cei awh han. Kanîthun hai thoseh, amom hai thoseh, tâmai a kampuen boum teh a cei awh han.
Lukkareiim dawk tâmai ni hnin hni touh thoseh, thapa yung touh thoseh, kum touh thoseh koe awm pawiteh, Isarelnaw ni hote hmuen cettakhai laipalah, rim thung roup ao awh. Hatei, a lathueng lah a kâtawm toteh a cei awh.
BAWIPA kâpoelawk patetlah a roe awh teh, BAWIPA kâpoelawk patetlah a cei awh. Mosi hno lahoi BAWIPA kâpoe patetlah ao awh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi hah a pato teh,
ngun mongka kahni touh, dêi lah dêi nateh sak loe. Tamimaya kawnae hoi tâcosak nahanlah na hno han.
Kahni touh hoi na ueng navah, taminaw teh kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang koe a kamkhueng awh han.
Hatei, buet touh dueng na ueng pawiteh, Isarel catoun kahrawikung a hu buet touh dawk kacuenaw hah nang koe a kamkhueng awh han.
Kâhruetcuetnae na ueng pawiteh, Kanîtholae naw ni a kamthaw awh han.
Hahoi kâhruetcuetnae apâhni na ueng toteh, akalae naw ni a roenae koehoi a kamthaw awh han. A kamthaw awh nahanelah, kâhruetcuetnae pou na ueng pouh han.
Maya a kamkhueng nahanelah, hmaloe na ueng awh han. Hatei kâhruetcuetnae teh na ueng mahoeh.
Aron e canaw, vaihmanaw ni mongka teh a ueng awh han. Hete hno heh nangmae se yunglam, yungyoe hanelah phunglam lah ao han.
Na ram dawk namamouh rep kacuengroekung, na taran tuk hanlah na cei navah, kâhruetcuetnae ueng lah na ueng awh han. Hottelah BAWIPA Cathut hmalah, pou na panue e lah pou awm vaiteh, na tarannaw thung hoi rungngang e lah ao han.
Na lunghawinae hnin thoseh, pawi e tueng dawk thoseh, thapareinae dawk thoseh, hmaisawi thuengnae hoi roum thuengnae thoseh, mongka na ueng awh han. Hot patetlah na Cathut hmalah nangmouh han pahnimhoehnae lah ao han. Kai teh Jehovah na Cathut lah ka o telah atipouh.
Hahoi a kum hni, thapa yung pahni, hote thapa 20 hnin teh, lawkpanuesaknae lukkareiim koehoi tâmai hah kahlun lah a kâtawm.
Hahoi hmalah pâtam hoi Sinai kahrawng koehoi Isarelnaw teh a kamthaw. Hahoi Paran ram kahrawng dawk tâmai teh a kangdue.
Mosi hno lahoi BAWIPA kâpoe e patetlah avai pasuek a kamthaw awh.
Ahmaloe poung lah Judah ransanaw hah a imthungkhu mitnoutnae sin hoi a tâco awh. A ransabawi teh, Amminadab capa Nahshon doeh.
Issakhar miphun catounnaw ransabawi teh Zuar capa Nethanel doeh.
Zebulun miphun catounnaw ransabawi teh Helon capa Eliab doeh.
Hahoi lukkareiim hah a raphoe awh teh, Gershon catounnaw hoi Merari catounnaw ni lukkareiim kâkayawt hanlah a tâco awh.
Hahoi Reuben ransanaw teh amamae mitnout sin laihoi a tâco awh. A ransabawi teh Shedeur capa Elizur doeh.
Simeon miphun catounnaw ransabawi teh Zurishaddai capa Shelumiel doeh.
Gad miphun catounnaw ransabawi teh Deuel capa Eliasaph doeh.
Hahoi, Kohathnaw ni kathounge hno a kâkayawt awh teh a tâco awh. Alouke a tho hoehnahlan vah lukkarei hah a rakueng awh.
Hahoi Ephraim ransanaw teh, mitnout a sin awh teh, a tâco awh. A ransabawi teh Ammihud capa Elishama doeh.
Manasseh miphun catounnaw ransabawi teh Pedahzur capa Gamaliel doeh.
Benjamin miphun catounnaw ransabawi teh Gideon capa Abidan doeh.
Hahoi, a hnuktengpoung lah Dan catoun ransanaw hah amamae mitnout a sin awh teh, a tâco awh. A ransabawi teh Ammishaddai capa Ahiezer doeh.
Asher miphun catounnaw ransabawi teh Okran capa Pagiel doeh.
Naphtali miphun catounnaw ransabawi teh Enan capa Ahira doeh.
Isarel catounnaw a kamthaw awh toteh, a ransanaw patuen patuen lahoi a ceinae nuencang la a tho.
Mosi e a napu Midian tami Reuel capa Hobab koevah, Mosi ni nang koe na poe han telah BAWIPA ni ati e hmuen koevah, cei han a kâcai awh teh, kaimouh koe tho van leih, kahawicalah na tak dawk ka sak han, bangdawk tetpawiteh, Isarel koevah, BAWIPA ni hnokahawi a kam toe atipouh.
Ahnimouh ni nangmouh koe ka cet mahoeh. Kamamouh e ram hmaunawngha koe doeh ka cei awh han atipouh awh.
Hahoi teh Mosi ni hrumhram na cettakhai awh hanh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, kahrawngum roe nahan hmuen sak hane koe vah, na panue e patetlah hoi, na panue e yit touh kaimouh hanlah, mit lah doeh na awm awh ti.
Kaimouh koe na cet awh pawiteh BAWIPA ni hnokahawi na sak pouh e patetlah na sak pouh van han atipouh.
Hahoi teh, BAWIPA e mon koehoi hnin thum lamcei dawk a cei awh. Ahnimouh han kâhatnae hmuen tawng hanlah BAWIPA lawkkam thingkong hah hnin thum touh thung a hmalah a cei pouh.
Rim koehoi a kamthaw awh toteh, kanîthun BAWIPA e tâmai ahnimouh lathueng vah ao.
Hahoi thingkong a tâco nah tangkuem vah, Mosi ni oe, BAWIPA kang dout haw. Na taran hah kâkahei awh naseh. Na kahmuhmanaw hah na hmalah yawng awh naseh, telah ouk ati.
Hahoi, thingkong a kâhat nah tangkuem vah, Oe BAWIPA, Isarelnaw a thongsang koe, kamlang haw telah ouk atipouh.
Tamimaya a phuenang awh toteh, BAWIPA lunghawinae awmhoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, hote hah BAWIPA ni a thai toteh, a lungkhuek teh a lungkâan. Hat torei teh BAWIPA e hmai hah ahnimouh rahak vah paluk a to pouh teh, roenae hmuen alawilah, a tangawn koung a kak pouh.
Hahoi teh, tamimaya ni Mosi koe a hram awh teh, Mosi ni BAWIPA koe a ratoum teh, hmai teh bout a roum.
BAWIPA e hmai hah ahnimouh rahak vah paluk a to pouh dawkvah, hote hmuen teh Taberah ati awh.
Hahoi ahnimouh rahak vah, mak kâkalawt e maya koehoi, takthai ngai awh e hah a tâco. Isarel canaw hai bout a khuika awh teh, apinimaw ca hane moi na poe awh han.
Aphu laipalah hoi Izip ram vah tanga moi canae hah ka pahnim thai awh hoeh. Payin paw hoi angkem paw, rasonpaling, rasonpangaw, ankahringnaw hah ka rabuipoung awh toe.
Atuteh ka rakhing koung a ke awh toe, Manna laipalah hoi banghai ka mit ni hmawt awh hoeh toe telah ati awh.
Manna teh songsuen mu patetlah a o, arong teh badellium patetlah ao.
Taminaw ni a racawng awh teh, a roe awhnae koe a phawm awh teh, hlaam dawk a thawng awh, vaiyei lah a sak awh, a ca awh toteh satui hoi karê e patetlah ao.
Tangminlah a roenae rim koe tadamtui a bo toteh manna hai ouk a bo van.
Taminaw pueng teh imthung lahoi roenae rim takhang koe a ka awh tie Mosi ni a thai. Hahoi BAWIPA lungphuennae teh puenghoi a kâan teh, Mosi hai a lunghawi hoeh.
Hot patetlah Mosi ni BAWIPA koe bangkongmaw na san heh runae na poe, bangkongmaw, na mitkhetcawp hoeh e maw, hete maya hnokarinaw heh kai ka van na patue.
Hete taminaw kai ni ka vawn e namaw. A na mintoenaw koe thoebonae ram koe ceikhai hanlah, camo kakhenaw ni sanu ka net lahun a tawm e patetlah na lungtabue dawk tawm awh na ti hanelah ka khe e na ma.
Hete taminaw na poe hane moi teh nâhoi maw ka la han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, ka ca hane moi hah na poe telah khuika laihoi na cusin awh toe.
Hete taminaw pueng hah, kai kamadueng teh ka phawt thai hoeh toe. Kai hanlah a ri poung
Het patet e na sak hane pawiteh, na pahren nateh na thei leih, ka rei na thaisak hanh leih telah a ti.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koevah, Isarel kacuenaw, maya thung dawk kacuenaw hoi bet a lungkaha lah na panue e naw tami 70 touh pâkhueng nateh, kai koe kamkhuengnae koe lukkareiim dawk nang koe a ka due thai nahan thokhai loe.
Hattorei haw vah tho vaiteh na pato han. Na tak dawk kaawm e muitha hah ka la vaiteh ahnimouh lathueng ka hruek han. Nang dueng ni phawt laipalah, maya e hmuenri hah ahnimouh ni na phu khai han.
Nang ni tamimaya koe tangtho hanelah kamthoung awh nateh, moi teh na ca awh han. Moi na ca awh hane apinimaw na poe awh han, bangtelamaw Izip ram vah phu ka nep lah ka o teh telah BAWIPA hnâthainae koe na ka awh vaw. Hatdawkvah, BAWIPA ni moi na poe awh vaiteh na ca awh han.
Hnin touh hnin hni touh laipalah, apanga hnin hra touh laipalah, hnin 20 touh laipalah,
thapa yung touh thung hmawtcei hoi palopalai nunnun a tho toteh, na ca awh han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, nama koe kaawmnaw ni BAWIPA na dudam awh, Bangkongmaw Izip ram hoi kaimanaw na tâcokhai telah a hmalah, na ka awh telah tet pouh ati telah a ati.
Mosi ni kai koe kaawm e khok hoi kacetnaw ting taruk touh a pha teh, thapa yung touh ca hane moi ka poe han telah na ti.
Tuhu hoi maitohu naw hai thet pouh haw a boum awh han vaimoe. Talî dawk e tanganaw pueng man pouh nakunghai a boum awh han vaimoe telah a ti.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koevah, BAWIPA e kut teh a duem maw. Ka dei e hah nang koe a kuep hoi kuep hoeh e na panue han doeh telah a ti.
Hahoi Mosi a tâco teh, BAWIPA lawk hah taminaw pueng koe a dei pouh. Tamihu kacuenaw 70 touh hah a kaw teh, lukkareiim petkâkalup lah a kangdue sak
Hahoi BAWIPA teh tâmai dawk a kum teh a pato. Ahni koe kaawm e muitha hah kacuenaw 70 touh lathueng vah a ta. Ahnimouh tak dawk muitha a pha teh, Lawk a pâpho awh. Hot patetlah ouk sak awh boihoeh ei nan toung mah.
Hatei, roenae hmuen koe tami kahni touh pou ao. Buet touh e a min teh Eldad doeh. Alouk buet touh e min teh Medad doeh, Muitha hah ahnimouh koe ao. Touk e naw dawk ka bawk awh e eiteh, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim koe cet vah hoeh. Roenae hmuen koe lawk hah a pâpho roi.
Hahoi thoundoun buet touh a yawng teh Mosi koe a dei pouh teh, Eldad hoi Medad ni lawk teh pâpho lahun telah atipouh.
Nun capa Joshua a nawsai lahoi yah. Mosi thaw ka tawk pouh e ni a pathung teh, ka bawipa Mosi ahnimouh hah ngang haw ati pouh.
Mosi ni ahni koe, kai na dipma e na ou. BAWIPA ni taminaw pueng heh profet lah koung awm naseh, BAWIPA ni ahnimouh lathueng muitha hah ahnimouh van tat pouh naseh ka tie nahoehmaw.
Hahoi Mosi teh ama hoi Isarel a lungkahanaw hoi roenae hmuen koe a ban awh.
Hahoi BAWIPA koehoi kahlî a tho teh, talî koe lahoi tamuem hrut a palek pouh teh roenae rim avangvanglah hoi hnin touh lamcei reira dawk dong hni touh ka rasang lahoi a pabo pouh.
Hot patetlah tamimaya ni karum tuettuet kanîruirui a tangtho kanîruirui tamuem teh a racawng awh. Kayounpoung ka racawng e ni hai Homer 10 touh a racawng awh (homer teh ephah hra touh, 220 liters a cawng). Rim pueng koe amamouh hane lengkaleng a vaw awh.
Hatei moi teh a la awh lahun nah, be a ca awh hoehnahlan tamimaya lathueng BAWIPA e lungkhueknae a kâan teh, tamimaya koe takikatho poung e lacik hoi BAWIPA ni a rek awh.

BAWIPA ni tâmai khom lahoi a kum teh, kamkhuengnae bawkim takhang koe a kangdue pouh. Aron hoi Miriam a kaw teh, kahni touh hoi hmalah a tâco roi.

Hot patetlah BAWIPA ni ahnimouh roi koe a lungkhuek teh a ceitakhai.
Hahoi lukkareiim koehoi tâmai a kâtawm teh, khenhaw, Miriam teh tadamtui patetlah a pangaw teh hrikbei lah a coung. Aron ni Miriam hah a khet teh, khenhaw a hrikbei toe hei ati.

Ram teh bangtelah vaimoe. Haw e kho ka sak e taminaw hah a thasai awh maw, a thayoun awh maw, tami a pap maw ayoun maw tie hoi,
a onae ram teh kahawi na ou, a onae kho teh bangpatet lae na vaimoe. Rim na ou, rapanim kaawm na ou.
Ram teh ka tawnta na ou, ka takang awh na ou, ratu na ou. Tarankahawilah awm awh nateh, ram dawk e a paw phawt awh telah atipouh. Hote tueng teh misur paw a hminnae tueng hoi a kâvoe.
Hottelah a kamthaw awh teh, a takhang awh. Ram teh Zin kahrawngum hoi Hamath kâennae Rehob totouh, Kanaan ram koung a tuet awh.
Akalah hoi hmaloe a takhang awh teh Hebron vah a pha awh. Hawvah Anakim catounnaw, Ahiman Sheshai hoi Talmai taminaw ao awh. ( Hebron teh Izip ram hoi Zoan kho thawng hoehnahlan kum sari nah thawng e kho lah a o).
Hahoi Eshkol tanghling dawk a pha awh. Haw e misur paw hah abawm khuehoi a bouk awh teh, tami kahni touh ni a kâkayawt awh. Tale paw hoi thaibunglung paw hai a thokhai awh.
Haw e misur bawm Isarelnaw ni a bouk pouh dawkvah, hote hmuen teh Eshkol tanghling ati awh.
Hnin 40 hnukkhu, Kanaan ram tuetnae koehoi a ban awh.
Hot patetlah Paran kahrawng dawk Kadesh vah Mosi hoi Aron hoi a taminaw pueng koe bout a pha awh. Ahnimouh ni tamimaya koe lawk a thokhai awh. Hot ram hoi e a pawnaw hah a patue awh.
Hahoi ahnimouh ni ahnimouh koe, na patounnae ram dawkvah ka cei awh teh, sanutui hoi khoitui a lawngnae tangngak doeh, hetheh haw e ram dawk e a pawnaw doeh.
Hatei, hote ram dawk khokasaknaw teh tami a thasai seng doeh. Khonaw hai rapan ka tawn e khopui seng doeh. Hothloilah Anakim catounnaw ka hmu awh.
Amaleknaw akalah ao awh teh, Hitnaw hoi Jebusitnaw, Amornaw monrui dawk ao awh. Hahoi Kanaannaw teh talî tengpam, Jordan palang rayawk lah ao awh telah a dei pouh awh.
Hottelah, Kalep ni Mosi hmalah taminaw pueng sairasuep lah ao sak teh, pâtam vaiteh lat awh sei. Bangkongtetpawiteh, tâ awh roeroe han telah a ti.
Hatei, ahni hoi rei kacetnaw ni, hotnaw tuk hanlah ka cet thai awh mahoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, maimouh hlak a thasai awh telah ati awh.
Hottelah a tuet awh e ram kong teh Isarel catounnaw koe kamthang mathout lah a pathang awh, ramnaw pueng tuet hanelah ka cei awh navah, amamae a canaw patenghai a thei awh, ka hmu awh e naw teh a rasangpoung awh, a thasai seng doeh.
Hahoi hete hmuen koevah Anakim catoun kalenpoungnaw ka hmu awh. Kaimanaw teh samtong patetlah doeh ka o awh ati awh.
Hahoi teh, kamkhuengnaw pueng ni hote tangmin puenghoi a khuika awh.
Isarel catounnaw pueng Mosi hoi Aron koe a phuenang awh. Kamkhueng e tamimaya koevah, Izip ram vah dout awh ngala pawiteh, hoehpawiteh hete kahrawngum dout ngala pawiteh,
bangkongmaw, tahloi hoi thei vaiteh, yuca pueng taran kut dawk pha sak hanelah maw BAWIPA ni hete ram dawk na ceikhai. Izip ram bout ban pawiteh, maimouh han bet a hawihnawn nahoehmaw telah ati awh.
Hahoi a kamkhueng awh teh kahrawikung rawi vaiteh, Izip ram vah ban awh sei telah ati awh.
Mosi hoi Aron teh kamkhueng e Isarelnaw pueng e hmalah a tabo roi.
Hateiteh, Nun capa Joshua hoi Jephunneh capa Kalep, ram katuetnaw thung dawk ka bawk roi van e ni a hni a phi roi teh,
kamkhueng e Isarelnaw pueng koe tuet hanelah ka cei sin awh e ram teh, kahawi poung tangngak e doeh.
Maimouh koe BAWIPA a lunghawi pawiteh, ama ni na cetkhai awh vaiteh, khoitui hoi sanutui a lawngnae ram teh na poe han doeh.
BAWIPA taranlahoi taranthaw laipalah, hote ram dawk e tami taket laipalah, awm awh sei. Bangkongtetpawiteh, ahnimouh teh maimae rawca lah doeh awm awh ti, ahnimanaw teh a kângue awh e awm hoeh. BAWIPA teh maimouh koe ao. Ahnimouh teh taket awh hanh sei telah ati roi.
Hahoi ka kamkhueng e pueng ni talung hoi dêi han a noe awh. Hahoi BAWIPA bawilennae teh kamkhuengnae lukkareiim dawk hoi Isarelnaw pueng e hmalah a kamnue pouh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koevah hete taminaw pueng nâtotouh maw na pahnawt awh han. Ahnimouh koe mitnoutnae ka sak pouh ei teh, nâtotouh maw yuem laipalah ao awh han.
Lacik hoi ka yue vaiteh, be ka pahma ngala han. Nang dawkvah, ahnimouh hlak ka sungren e hoi hno ka tet thai e miphun ka kangdue sak han telah a ti.
Mosi ni BAWIPA koevah hot teh Izipnaw ni thai langvaih. Bangkongtetpawiteh, hete tamihupui heh na thao e lahoi na tâcokhai e naw doeh.
Hot teh hete ram taminaw koe a dei pou han. BAWIPA nang teh hete taminaw koevah na o teh, BAWIPA nang nama teh minhmai phek kadangka lah na hmu awh kanîthun tâmaikhom hoi karum lah hmaikhom hoi a hmalah na cei pouh tie a panue awh toe.
Hot patetlah hete tamimaya heh tami buet touh e patetlah na thei pawiteh, na min kamthang ka panuek e miphunnaw ni,
BAWIPA ni hete tamimayanaw heh thoebo hoi a kam e ram dawk a hrawi thai hoeh dawkvah, kahrawngum koung a thei telah a dei awh han.
BAWIPA ni a lungsaw teh lungmanae hoi ka kawi e, payonnae hoi kâtapoenae ka ngaithoumkung yonpen e naw kayawicalah hloutsak laipalah,
napanaw yonnae kecu dawk canaw, catounnaw se thum se pali totouh, ouk karekkung doeh na a telah na dei tangcoung e patetlah BAWIPA na hnosakthainae teh, hoe lentoe lawiseh.
Na lungmanae a pap e patetlah hoi Izip ram hoi atu totouh na ngaithoum e patetlah na tamimaya e payonnae naw hah ngaithoum pouh haw telah ka ratoum.
Hat toteh, BAWIPA ni na lawk patetlah ka ngaithoum toe.
Hatei, ka hring e patetlah BAWIPA bawilennae hoi talai heh muen a kawi han.
Izip ram hoi kahrawngum ka sak e naw bawilennae hoi kângairunae a hmuen teh, vai hra totouh na tanouk teh, ka lawk ka ngaihoeh e naw pueng ni,
kakhekungnaw koe thoebo nalaihoi ka kam pouh e ram teh, hmawt awh roeroe mahoeh. Ahnimouh rahak ka lawk banglahai ka ngaihoehnaw ni hmawt mahoeh.
Hatei, ka san Kalep, aloukcalah kaawm e muitha hah tawn teh, atangcalah ka hnuk a kâbang dawk, ahni teh a pâtam e ram koe ka hrawi vaiteh, a catounnaw ni a coe awh han.
Atuvah, Amaleknaw hoi Kanaan taminaw hah ayawn dawk ao awh. Tangtho vah ban awh nateh tuipui paling lam koelah hoi kahrawng dawk kâen awh telah a ti.
BAWIPA ni, Mosi hoi Aron a pato teh,
hete kamkhueng e tamikathoutnaw e phuenangnae heh, nâtotouh maw ka ring han. Kai taranlahoi Isarel catounnaw lai a roe awh e ka thai.
Ahnimouh koe ka hring e patetlah ka hnâthainae koe na dei awh e patetlah nangmouh lathueng ka sak han, telah BAWIPA ni a dei.
Nangmouh ni milu na parei awh teh na touk awh tangcoung e patetlah, kum 20 lathueng kai koe laikaroenaw pueng teh, hete kahrawngum vah ro lah a o awh han.
Kai ni hete ram dawk na o sak awh awh han ka ti e ram dawkvah, Jephunneh capa Kalep hoi Nun capa Joshua laipateh api hai phat awh mahoeh.
Hatei, thei hanelah doeh ao awh, na tie na canaw hah ka kâen sak vaiteh, na ngai awh hoeh ram dawk kho a sak awh han.
Hatei, nangmanaw teh na ronaw ramke dawk koung a kamlei han.
Na capanaw hah kahrawngum vah kum 40 touh a kâva awh vaiteh, ramke dawk a ro hah a pawk awh hoehroukrak, namamouh na kâyo phu na phu awh han.
Ram na tuetnae hnin 40 touh hah, hnin touh yueng lah kum touh telah to lahoi kum 40 touh thung kâtapoe phu na khang awh han. Ka noenae yo a kâthung toe tie na panue awh han.
Kai BAWIPA ni hete tamikathoutnaw kai taranlahoi kamkhueng e maya pueng koevah, hetheh ka sak roeroe han ka ti toe. Hete kahrawngum vah kahmakata vaiteh, hawvah a due awh han ati telah a dei tet pouh loe.
Hottelah ram tuet hanlah Mosi ni a patoun teh ka ban awh e ram kong kamthang kathout lah ka pathang e naw, ama taranlahoi tamimaya lai ka roe sak e hoi,
ram kong dawk kamthangmathout kaphawtnaw roeroe hah BAWIPA hmalah lacik hoi a due awh.
Hatei, ram tuet han kacetnaw thung dawk Nun capa Joshua hoi Jephunneh capa Kalep teh a hring roi rah.
Hat toteh, Mosi ni hote lawk teh Isarelnaw pueng koevah a dei pouh teh, taminaw pueng ni a thai awh teh a lung koung a mathoe awh.
Hottelah amom vah a thaw teh, monsom vah a luen. Khenhaw, ka tho toe. BAWIPA ni na kam pouh e koelah ka cei han. Bangkong, ka payon toe telah a ti.
Mosi ni, bangkongmaw BAWIPA kâpoelawk na ek awh, Bangkongtetpawiteh, hete ni kuepcing sak thai mahoeh toe.
Takhang awh hanh, telah hoehpawiteh, na tarannaw ni na tâ awh han, bangdawk nangmouh koe BAWIPA awm hoeh.
Nangmouh hmalah Ameleknaw hoi Kanaannaw a o, tahloi hoi be na thet awh langvaih. BAWIPA teh na kamlang takhai dawkvah nangmouh koe BAWIPA awm hoeh telah a ti.
Hatei, monsom cei han pou a kâcai awh. Hatei BAWIPA lawkkam thingkong hoi Mosi hai rim dawk hoi tâcawt hoeh.
Hottelah hot mon dawk kaawmnaw Ameleknaw hoi Kanaannaw hah a cathuk awh teh, a tuk awh. Hormah totouh a pâlei awh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi hah a pato teh,
Isarelnaw hah pato nateh ahnimouh koe Na o nahane ram kai ni na poe e ram koe na pha awh toteh,
BAWIPA koe hmai hoi thuengnae, hmaisawi thuengnae thoseh, lawkkam kuep sak nahanelah, ma lungtho lahoi pawito nah na poe awh e thuengnae thoseh, saringhu dawk hoi tuhunaw thung dawk hoi thoseh, BAWIPA hanlah hmuitui hanelah na poe awh toteh,
BAWIPA koe thuengnae ka poe e pueng ni, tavai thuengnae, tavaikanui ephah pung hra pung touh, satui pung pali pung touh kanawk e hoi,
nei hane thuengnae koevah, misurtui hnin pung pali pung touh, hmaisawi thuengnae koevah thoseh, poenae koevah tuca tangkuem hanelah na rakueng awh han.
Telah hoehpawiteh, tutan buet touh dawkvah, tavai thuengnae a kanui e tavai ephah pung hra pung hni, satui pung thum pung touh hoi kanawk e,
BAWIPA hanlah nei thuengnae hmuitui dawk misurtui hin pung thum pung touh na poe awh han.
Hmaisawi thuengnae thoseh, lawkkam kuepsaknae thuengnae thoseh, BAWIPA koe roum thuengnae dawk maitotan na rakueng awh toteh,
maitotan poenae hoi tavai thuengnae, tavaikanui ephah pung hra pung thum, satui hin tangawn hoi kanawk e,
nei thueng nahanelah misurtui hin tangawn, BAWIPA hanlah hmuitui hoi thuengnae na sak awh han.
Hot patetlah maitotan hanlah thoseh, tutan hanlah thoseh, tuca hoiyah hmaeca hanlah na sak awh han.
Ayoun apap e lahoi na rakueng awh vaiteh, ayoun apap e lahoi na sak awh han.
Hote ram dawk hoi ka tâcawt e pueng ni, het patetlah BAWIPA hanlah hmuitui hmaisawi thuengnae a poe awh navah, a sak awh han.
Nangmouh koe kho ka sak e imyin thoseh, nangmouh se nah nangmouh koe kho ka sak e naw pueng ni, BAWIPA hanlah hmai hoi hmuitui thuengnae hah nama ni na sak e patetlah a sak awh van han.
Na se yunglam pueng dawkvah, kamkhueng e maya hoi nangmouh koe kaawm e imyin han haiyah, phung buet touh dueng doeh kaawm han. BAWIPA hmalah imyin teh namamouh patetlah ao han.
Namamouh han hoi nangmouh koe imyin kaawm e hanlah kâlawk buet touh hoi sak kawi buet touh dueng doeh kaawm han, tet pout telah ati.
BAWIPA ni Mosi hah a pato teh,
Isarelnaw pato nateh, ahnimouh koe ceikhai hanelah ka noe e ram dawk na pha awh toteh,
hote ram dawk vaiyei na ca awh toteh, BAWIPA koe kahek thuengnae na sak awh han.
Nangmouh koe hmaloe kanawk e, vaiyei heh kahek thuengnae koe na poe awh han. Kahek thuengnae na sak awh e patetlah na kahek awh han.
Na catounnaw totouh tavai hmaloe kanawk e hah BAWIPA koe kahek thuengnae na poe awh han.
Hete kâpoe BAWIPA ni Mosi koevah, a dei e pueng BAWIPA ni kâpoelawknaw a kamtawngnae koehoi na catounnaw hanelah,
Mosi hno lahoi kâpoelawk a poe e naw pueng hah dâw laipalah, ceknoe e awm laipalah hoi yonnae na sak awh pawiteh,
hot teh tamimaya panuek laipalah ceknoe hoeh hoi yonnae na sak awh pawiteh, tamimaya ni hmaisawi thuengnae, BAWIPA koevah hmuitui hanlah, maitotan kanaw e buet touh a poe vaiteh, tamimaya ni hmaisawi thuengnae, BAWIPA koevah hmuitui hanlah maitotan kanaw e buet touh a poe vaiteh, aphung patetlah tavai thuengnae hoi roum thuengnae hoi yon thueng nahanelah hmaetan buet touh na poe awh han.
Hottelah, vaihma ni, Isarel catoun tamimaya hanlah, yontha nahanlah a sak vaiteh, ngaithoum e lah ao han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, hot teh ceknoe laipalah sakpayon e doeh. BAWIPA koe thuengnae, hmai hoi sak e thuengnae, BAWIPA hmalah yon thuengnae, ceknoe e awm laipalah sakpayonnae hanlah a thokhai awh han.
Isarel catoun tamimaya teh, ahnimouh koe kho ka sak e, imyinnaw pueng hai ngaithoum e lah ao han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, taminaw pueng ni ceknoenae awm laipalah a sak awh e doeh.
Hahoi tami buet touh ni ceknoe laipalah yonnae sak pawiteh, yontha thueng nahanlah hmaela âvâ ka cawt hoeh rae kum touh ka phat e a poe han.
Hahoi, ama hanlah yon thuengnae sak hanlah BAWIPA hmalah, ceknoe e awm laipalah payonnae koe a sak toteh, vaihma ni ceknoe e awm laipalah payonae ka sak e tami hanlah yontha nahan a sak vaiteh, yontha lah ao han.
Ceknoe e awm laipalah ka payonkung hanelah Isarel catounnaw thung dawk, amamanaw hoi ahnimouh koe kaawm imyin hanlah hai reikâvan lah kâlawk a tawn awh han.
Hatei ceknoe hoi yonnae ka sak e teh, ram thung tami thoseh, imyin thoseh, BAWIPA min mathoe sak e lah ao dawkvah, a miphun dawk hoi takhoe lah ao han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, BAWIPA e lawk a dudam teh kâpoelawk a ek dawkvah, hote tami teh pahnawt roeroe lah ao han. Yonpennae lah a onae phu hah a phu han, tet pouh telah ati.
Hottelah Isarel catounnaw kahrawngum ao awh navah, sabbath hnin thing a ei e hmawt pawiteh,
thing a ei e kahmawtkung ni Mosi hoi Aron tamimaya koe a ceikhai han.
Ahni hah bangtelamaw ti han tie deipan hoeh rah dawkvah thongim a pabo awh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe hote tami teh thei han roeroe lah ao, rapan alawilah taminaw pueng ni talung hoi dêi roeroe hanlah ao telah atipouh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koevah, kâ a poe e patetlah taminaw pueng ni rapan hloilah a ceikhai awh teh, talung hoi koung kadout lah a dei awh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi hah a pato teh,
Isarel catounnaw pato nateh, na catounnaw totouh, khohna pawi koe akana na sak awh vaiteh, kamthim e ralui hoi na na yep awh han.
Hote akananaw hah na hmu awh toteh, BAWIPA e kâpoelawknaw pou na panue awh teh na tarawi awh nahan hoi, ahmaloe vah ma ngainae pâlei awh teh, ma lungpouknae lahoi payon awh e patetlah payon laipalah,
kaie kâpoelawknaw pueng na panue awh teh na tarawi awh teh na Cathut hanelah na thoung awh nahan hottelah na sak awh han.
Kai teh nangmae Cathut lah ka o nahan, nangmouh hah Izip ram hoi ka tâcawtkhai e nangmae Cathut Jehovah doeh. Kai teh nangmae Cathut Jehovah doeh atipouh.
Levih miphun Kohath capa Izhar, ahnie capa Karah teh, Reuben miphun Eliab capa Dathan hoi Abiram, hoi Peleth capa On tinaw hah a ceikhai teh,
Isarel catoun thung hoi a min bet kamsawngnaw dawk hoi a lungkahanaw hoi lawkcengkung lah rawi e naw thung dawk hoi tami 250 touh Mosi hmalah a kangdue awh.
Mosi hoi Aron taranlahoi ahnimouh koe, hloi na lui awh toe. Bangdawk tetpawiteh a tamimaya koung a thoung awh teh, taminaw pueng koe BAWIPA ao doeh. Bangkongmaw BAWIPA e tamimaya van vah ka taluepoung lah na kâpouk roi telah atipouh.
Hot hah Mosi ni a thai toteh a tabo teh,
Korah hoi a huinaw pueng koe, tangtho vah BAWIPA ni apimaw amae lah kaawm niteh, apimaw kathoung tie a kamnue sak vaiteh, ama rek hnai hanelah ati han doeh.
Hetheh sak awh, Korah hoi na huinaw pueng ni hmai lanae tongben lat awh nateh,
tangtho vah, athung vah hmai hah tat nateh hmuitui hah BAWIPA hmalah phum awh. Hahoi BAWIPA ni a rawi e pueng teh kathounge lah ao han. Nangmouh Levih capanaw ekvoi na lui awh toe telah a ti.
Mosi ni Korah koevah, nangmouh Levih capanaw thaihaw,
BAWIPA bawknae rim dawkvah thaw a tawk teh tamimaya hmalah thaw tawk hanlah kangdout e Isarelnaw, Cathut ni ama hnai hanelah Isarel taminaw pueng koehoi a kapek e,
Levih capa na hmaunawnghanaw hoi ama hnai sak hanlah a ta e naw heh, hno kathoungcalah na pouk awh dawk maw vaihma lah onae na tawng awh rah.
Hatdawkvah, nang nama hoi na hu pueng teh BAWIPA taranlahoi na kamkhueng awh vaw. Aron heh bangpatet lae tami lah maw ao teh, ahni koevah na phuenang awh vaw telah a ti.
Mosi ni Eliab capa Dathan hoi Abiram a kaw sak, hatei ahnimouh ni ka takhang awh mahoeh.
Kahrawngum vah thei rumram hanelah sanutui hoi khoitui a lawngnae ram koehoi na tâcokhai e hah hno kathoengcae na maw, kaimouh lathueng vah bawi lah o han thouk na ngai bo aw.
Sanutui hoi khoitui a lawngnae ram dawk na ceikhai laipalah law hoi misur takha hai râw hanlah na poe kalawn hoeh. Hetnaw e mit heh ton na phuen pouh han na maw. Ka takhang awh roeroe mahoeh telah a ti.
Mosi teh a lungphuen poung teh, BAWIPA koe vah a poe awh e teh dâw pouh hanh. Ahnimae la buet touh boehai ka lat pouh hoeh. Apihai patawnae ka poe hoeh a ti.
Mosi ni Korah koevah tangtho vah nang nama hoi na huinaw pueng Aron hoi BAWIPA hmalah la awm awh.
Hahoi hmai lanae tongben rip sin awh naseh. Hmuitui koung phuen awh naseh. BAWIPA hmalah hmai lanae 250 touh hah sin awh naseh. Nang nama hoi Aron ni hai hmai na lanae tongben reirei sin roih telah atipouh.
Hahoi teh tami pueng ni hmai lanae rip a sin awh teh, hmai a ta awh teh hmuitui a phuen awh. Mosi hoi Aron teh kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang koe a kangdue roi.
Hahoi Korah ni tamimayanaw pueng hah ama taran lahoi kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang koe a pâkhueng awh. Hahoi hote tamimaya lathueng BAWIPA bawilennae a kamnue.
Hahoi BAWIPA ni Mosi hoi Aron a pato teh,
hete tamihu heh tawkkadekca dawk be a kahma thai nahanlah ahnimouh koehoi alouklah awm awh telah a ti.
Hottelah ahnimouh a tabo awh teh, Oe! Cathut takthainaw pueng e muitha Cathut, buet touh yon kecu dawk taminaw pueng koe na lungkhuek han maw telah a ti.
BAWIPA ni Mosi a pato teh,
taminaw pueng koe dei pouh. Korah hoi Dathan hoi Abiram tinaw e roenae rim dawk hoi yawng awh telah tet pouh.
Mosi a thaw teh Dathan hoi Abiram koe a cei teh, Isarel kacuenaw a kambawng awh.
Hahoi taminaw pueng koe a dei teh, hete tamikayonnaw e rim koehoi a tâco awh. Banghai tek pouh hanh awh. Hoehpawiteh a yonae pueng dawk nangmouh hai na bawk awh langvaih telah tet pouh.
Hahoi Korah hoi Dathan hoi Abiram tinaw kathum touh teh, koung a tâcawttakhai awh. Dathan hoi Abiram teh amamae rim dawk hoi a tâco roi teh, amamae rim takhang koe a yucanaw hoi a kangdue awh.
Mosi ni kai kama ngainae lahoi ka sak e nahoeh. BAWIPA ni sak hanelah na patoun e doeh tie hah hete hnonaw dawk hoi na panue awh han.
Hete taminaw niyah ayânaw due e patetlah dout boilah, taminaw pueng rek e patetlah rek pawiteh Cathut ni na patoun hoeh e han doeh.
Hatei, BAWIPA ni a katha lah hno a sak teh, talai ni a kâko ang pawiteh, amamouh hoi kâkuen e pueng koung a padoun hoiyah tangkom dawk a hringo kâen awh pawiteh, BAWIPA ni hete taminaw heh a pahnawt toe tie na panue awh han telah a ti.
Hahoi, hete lawknaw koung a dei hnukkhu hoi ahnimouh onae koe talai rak a kâbawng.
Hahoi teh talai ni a kâko a ang teh, imthung buemlahoi, Korah e taminaw pueng hoi hnopainaw pueng hoi he a payawp.
Hahoi amamouh hoi a tawn awh e naw pueng hah tangkom dawk a hringo koung a bo awh. Talai ni a kâko a cakuep teh, ka kamkhueng e naw koehoi he a kahma awh.
Hahoi a tengpam e Isarelnaw pueng teh, hotnaw e hramki lawk dawk hoi a yawng awh teh, talai ni na payawm awh langvaih telah ati awh.
Hahoi BAWIPA koehoi hmai a tâco teh hmuitui ka thueng e tami 250 touh he a kak awh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi a pato teh,
nang ni hmai hah tâkhawng nateh, vaihma Aron capa Elizur ni hmai thung e hmailanae tongben la hanelah dei pouh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, kathounge hno lah ao.
Amamouh hringnae dawk kapayonnaw e hmailanae tongbennaw hai lat nateh, khoungroe ramuk nahanelah dêi lah awm naseh. Bangkongtetpawiteh BAWIPA hmalah poe e a tho dawkvah, kathounge lah ao teh, Isarel catounnaw hanelah mitnout lah ao han telah a ti.
Hahoi Isarel catounnaw hanelah pahnim hoeh nahanelah Aron hoeh laipateh Jentelnaw BAWIPA hanlah hmuitui hmaisawi thueng hanelah a cei awh hoeh nahan,
Karah hoi a huinaw patetlah ao awh hoeh nahan, Mosi hno lahoi BAWIPA ni ahnimouh koe a dei pouh e patetlah bawknae khoungroe ramuk nahan a dêi awh.
A tangtho vah, Isarel catoun tamihu teh Mosi hoi Aron taranlahoi a phuenang awh. BAWIPA e tamihunaw na thei awh atipouh awh.
Mosi hoi Aron hah taminaw pueng ni a kamkhueng sin navah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim koelah a kangvawi awh teh, khenhaw! tâmai ni king a kayo awh teh, BAWIPA bawilennae a kamnue.
Mosi hoi Aron teh kamkhuengnae lukkareiim hmalah a tho roi.
BAWIPA ni Mosi a pato teh,
hete taminaw thung hoi aloukcalah awm awh. Tawkkadekca kahma sak nahanelah, telah atipouh. Hahoi ahnimouh teh a tabo awh.
Mosi ni Aron koevah, hmai lanae tongben sin loe, khoungroe dawk hmai hah tat, hmuitui hah phuen nateh, taminaw pueng koe karanglah cetkhaih. Ahnimouh hanlah yontha nahan sak pouh. BAWIPA koehoi lungkhueknae a tâco toe. Patawnae lacik a kamtawng toe telah atipouh.
Aron ni Mosi ni dei e patetlah a sin teh, ka kamkhueng e naw koe lah a yawng. Hahoi teh khenhaw! Lacik teh taminaw pueng koe pataw a kamtawng toe. Hmuitui a phuen teh taminaw yontha sak nahanlah a sak.
Tami kadout hoi kahring rahak a kangdue teh lacik teh a thoung.
Hottelah Korah kong dawk hoi kadoutnaw touksin laipalah, lacik lahoi kadoutnaw teh 14700.
Aron teh kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang koe Mosi koe a ban teh laciknaw pueng teh a thoung.
BAWIPA ni Mosi hah a pato teh,
Isarel catounnaw pato nateh a miphun lahoi a napanaw imthung, Isarelnaw hlaikahni touh koe kahrawikungnaw lengkaleng poe hanelah sonron hlaikahni touh na la vaiteh, amamae min hah sonron dawk lengkaleng thut pouh.
Hahoi Levih sonron dawk, Aron min na thut han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, a na pa imthung kahrawikung hanelah sonron buet touh lah rip ao han.
Kamkhuengnae lukkareiim, lawkpanuesaknae hmalah na ta han.
Kai ni ka rawi e sonron teh a dawn a pei han. Hattoteh, nangmouh roi yon ka pen e Isarelnaw e phuenangnae teh ka takhoe pouh han, telah a ti.
Hottelah Mosi ni Isarel catounnaw hah a pato teh, kahrawikungnaw ni a imthungkhu yueng lah kahrawikung buet touh ni sonron buet touh rip a sin teh, sonron hlaikahni touh hah a poe teh, Aron e sonron hai hotnaw rahak vah a bawk van.
Mosi ni kapanuekkhaikung lukkareiim dawk BAWIPA hmalah sonron hah a ta.
A tangtho vah Mosi teh kapanuekkhaikung lukkareiim dawkvah, a cei teh, Levih imthung e yueng lah Aron e sonron hah a dawn teh, a pei a muem, a pei a pei teh almond paw a paw.
Mosi ni BAWIPA hmalae sonronnaw pueng hah Isarel catounnaw pueng koe a ceikhai. A khet awh teh amamae sonron hah lengkaleng a la awh.
Oe BAWIPA ni, laikaroenaw koe lah mitnout lah ao nahanelah, Aron e sonron hah lawkpanuesaknae kung koe tat leih. Hat pawiteh doeh ahnimae phuenangnae hah ka mithmu hoi kâhat vaiteh dout awh mahoeh, telah atipouh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi lawk a thui e patetlah ahni ni a tarawi teh a sak.
Isarel catounnaw ni Mosi koevah, koung kahma awh teh, koung ka due awh toe, koung rawk awh katang toe.
BAWIPA lukkareiim kâhnai pueng ni a due awh. Koung kahmat lah due awh han namaw telah ati awh.
BAWIPA ni Aron koevah, nangmouh hoi na capanaw hoi nang koe kaawm e na pa imthungnaw ni, hmuen kathoung hoi kâkuen e payonpakainae yon teh na phu awh han. Hahoi nama hoi nang koe kaawm e na capanaw hoi vaihma lah na onae hoi kâkuen e payonpakainae yo hah na phu awh han.
Na pa miphun, Levih miphun na hmaunawnghanaw ni kapanuekkhaikung lukkareiim hmalah na capanaw koe ao navah, nang hoi thaw cungtalah rei a tawk thai nahan, nang koe na thokhai han.
Na panki e thaw hoi lukkareiim thaw a panki e naw na kabawp han. Hatei, hmuen kathoung hlaamnaw hoi bawknae khoungroe hah hnai awh hanh naseh, telah nahoeh pawiteh, ahnimouh hai nangmouh hai na due awh han.
Ahnimouh ni na kabawp awh vaiteh, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim thaw pueng hah a panki e patetlah lukkareiim thaw a tawk awh han. Hatei alawilae tami ni na hnai awh mahoeh.
Isarel catounnaw lathueng vah lungkhueknae ao hoeh nahanlah, nang nama ni hmuen kathoung thaw hoi khoungroe thaw hah na ham lah na la han.
Khenhaw! kai ni na hmaunawngha Levih taminaw hah Isarel catounnaw thung hoi ka la teh, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim koe thaw tawk hanlah, nangmouh hanlah BAWIPA koehoi poe e nangmouh koe poe e doeh.
Hatdawkvah, nang nama hoi na capanaw ni khoungroe hoi yaphni athung lae hnonaw pueng dawk vaihma na coungnae thaw heh poehno patetlah nang koe poe lah ao. Hatei, alawilae tami bawk pawiteh thei lah ao han.
BAWIPA ni Aron a pato teh, khenhaw! kai kama roeroe ni kahek thuengnae koe Isarel catounnaw poehno kathoungnaw pueng hah, nang nama hoi na capanaw e ham lah a yungyoe hane phung lah na poe.
Hmai sawi hoeh e pueng nang han hno kathoung poung lah ao han. A pasoung awh e pueng, tavai thuengnae, yon thuengnae, hoi kâtapoe thuengnae, kai koe na poe awh e hah, nang hoi na capanaw hanlah ka thoung poung lah ao han.
Tongpa pueng ni hmuen kathoung poung koe na ca awh vaiteh, nangmouh hanlah ka thoung e lah ao han.
Het hai na ham lah ao han, tavai thuengnae koe a poe awh e hno, Isarel catounnaw kahek thuengnae hnopoe pueng hah nang nama hoi na capa na canu naw hoi a yungyoe na ham lah na poe. Na im dawk tamikathoung kaawm e pueng ni a ca thai awh han.
Kahawipoung e satui hoi misur kahawipoung e hoi aluepaw BAWIPA hanlah a poe awh e hah na poe.
Ahnimae law dawk e aluepaw hmaloe ka hmin e BAWIPA hanlah a poe awh e hah nange lah ao han. Na im dawk tamikathoung kaawm e pueng ni a ca thai awh han.
Isarelnaw ni poehno e pueng teh nange lah ao han.
BAWIPA hanlah a poe awh e camoim ka paawng pasuek e pueng teh tami thoseh, saring thoseh nange lah ao han. Hatei camin teh na ratang roeroe han. Kathounghoehe saring camin hai na ratang han.
Thapa yung touh e ratang hanlah kaawm e hah ratangnae phu na to vaiteh, hmuen kathoung koe hno e sekel panga touh hoi na ratang han (sekel teh gerah 20 touh doeh).
Hatei maitotan camin hoi tu camin hoi hmae camin teh na ratang awh mahoeh. Hotnaw teh a thoung awh. A thipaling teh khoungroe dawk na kathek vaiteh, BAWIPA han hmuitui lah athaw hah hmai hoi hmaisawi thuengnae koe na sawi awh han.
Kahek thuengnae koe a takuep hoi aloung teh nange lah ao e patetlah a moi hah nange lah ao han.
Kathounge hno hoi kahek thuengnae koe Isarelnaw ni BAWIPA hanlah a poe awh e hah, a yungyoe na ham lah na poe. BAWIPA hmalah nang nama hoi na capanaw hoi na canu naw hoi yungyoe lawkkam lah ao han telah ati.
BAWIPA ni Aron koevah, a ram dawk na ham kawi banghai awm mahoeh, a thungup hai na ham kawi banghai awm mahoeh. Kai doeh Isarel catoun thung dawk na ham hoi na coe e râw lah ka o.
Hahoi Levih catounnaw teh, khenhaw! thawtawknae koe a thaw tawk awh e lukkareiim koe thaw tawk phu lah Isarel ram e pung hra pung touh pueng teh na poe awh.
Atu totouh hoi teh Isarel catounnaw ni, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim teh hnai awh roeroe hanh naseh. Telah hoehpawiteh, yonpennae phu hoi a due payon awh han doeh.
Hatei, Levihnaw ni kamkhuengnae lukkareiim koe thaw a tawk awh vaiteh, thaw abuemlahoi a la awh han. Hetnaw heh catounnaw ditouh phunglam lah ao han. Isarel catoun thung vah a ham kawi banghai awm mahoeh.
Isarel catounnaw ni pung hra pung touh BAWIPA hanlah kahek thuengnae a poe awh e hah Levihnaw hanlah râw lah ka poe toe. Hatdawkvah, ahnimouh koe Isarel catounnaw thung dawk râw a coe kawi banghai awm mahoeh telah yo ka ti pouh toung tayaw telah ati.
BAWIPA ni Mosi hah a pato teh,
hothloilah Levihnaw hah pato nateh, ahnimouh koe na râw hanlah Isarel catounnaw pung hra touh dawk pung touh na poe e hah ahnimouh koehoi na hmu awh toteh, hote pung hra pung touh e thung hoi pung hra pung touh hah BAWIPA koe kahek thuengnae na poe awh han.
Hottelah nangmae kahek thuengnae teh cangkatinnae koe cakang aluepaw hoi misurtui ahruem patetlah pouk e lah ao han.
Hottelah Isarel catounnaw koehoi pung hra pung touh na hmu awh e pueng BAWIPA hanelah kahek thuengnae koe pou na poe awh han. Hahoi BAWIPA hanelah kahek thuengnae hah Aron na poe awh han.
Na hmu awh e pueng thung hoi, kahawipoung, kathoungpounge hah BAWIPA koe kahek thuengnae na poe awh han.
Hatdawkvah ahnimouh koe, hotnaw thung dawk hoi kahawi poung e na kahek awh toteh, Levihnaw a cangkatin e dawk hoi ka tâcawt e hoi misurtui ka lawng e patetlah pouk lah ao han.
Nâ e hmuen pueng koehai koung na ca thai awh han. Nangmouh hoi na imthung ni hai, bangkongtetpawiteh, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim koe e thaw tawk phu doeh
Kahawipoung e na kahek awh toteh, yonae yon phu lah awm mahoeh. Hatei, Isarel catounnaw poehno kathounge hah na kamhnawng awh mahoeh, telah hoehpawiteh, na due awh han tet pouh telah atipouh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi hoi Aron hah a pato teh,
hethateh, BAWIPA kâlawk poe e phunglam kâlawk doeh. Isarel catounnaw hah maitola ka paling e kacuem e a laphu thueng pouh hoeh e, thokhai hanlah dei pouh.
Rapan hloilah ceikhai vaiteh, a hmalah thei thai nahanlah vaihma Eleazar koevah na poe han.
Vaihma Eleazar ni a kutcarei hoi thipaling youn touh a la vaiteh, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim hmalah, vai sari touh paloupalou a kathek han.
Hottelah maitola teh a pho, a moi, a thi hoi a ei hai a mithmu vah hmaisawi han.
Vaihma ni sidar thing hoi dingsala hoi langsan a la vaiteh, maitola hmaisawinae koe a tâkhawng han.
Vaihma ni a khohna a pâsu vaiteh, tui a kamhluk han. Hahoi roenae hmuen koe a cei han, tangmin totouh vaihma teh a khin han.
Hmai kasawikung ni hai amae khohna a pâsu vaiteh tui a kamhluk han, tangmin totouh a khin han.
Kathounge ni maitola hraba hah a kawn vai teh, rapan hloilah thoungnae hmuen koe a ta vaiteh, Isarel catounnaw, tamimaya hanlah kamthoungnae tui dawk a hno han, hethateh yon thung hoi thoungnae doeh.
Hahoi maitola hraba kakawnkung teh, a khohna a pâsu vaiteh, tangmin totouh a khin han. Hethateh Isarel catounnaw hoi ahnimouh koe kaawm e imyinnaw hanlah a yungyoe phunglam lah ao han.
Bangpatetlae tami ro nakunghai katekkung teh hnin sari touh thung a khin han rah.
Hahoi tami teh hnin thum hnin vah hraba hoi a kamthoung vaiteh, hnin sari hnin vah a thoung han. Apâthum hnin kamthoung hoehpawiteh, asari hnin totouh a khin han.
Tami bangpatet ni hai Bangpatete tami ro hai a tek awh teh kamthoung awh hoehpawiteh, BAWIPA lukkareiim kakhinsakkung lah ao teh, hote tami teh Isarel taminaw thung dawk hoi hnoun e lah ao han. Kamthoungnae tui ahnimouh koe kathek sin lah ao hoeh dawkvah, a khin han. A khinnae hah ahnimouh koe ao rah.
Tami buet touh lukkareiim dawk dout pawiteh, hetheh kâlawk lah ao han. Lukkareiim dawk kâen e pueng teh lukkareiim dawk kaawm e pueng hnin sari touh thung a khin han.
Hahoi hlaam a khuem kâkhuem hoeh e puenghai a khin han.
Hahoi tami bangpatet ni law vah, tahloi hoi a thei awh e thoseh, ao navah kadout e ro thoseh, tami kadout e hru thoseh, tangkom dawk thoseh, tek pawiteh hnin sari touh a khin han.
Hahoi kathoung hoeh naw hanlah, yon thoung nahanlah hmaisawi e, maitola hraba teh a la vaiteh, amamae tongben dawk, ka lawng e tui a ta awh han.
Hahoi kathounge ni dingsala a la vaiteh, tui dawk a padung han. Hahoi lukkareiim hlaamnaw pueng hai haw e kaawmnaw pueng hraba thoseh, ka tek e pueng teh be a kahei sin han.
Hahoi kathounge naw ni apâthum hnin hoi asari hnin vah kathoung hoeh pueng a kahei sin han, a khohna a pâsu hoi tui a kamhluk vaiteh tangmin lah teh a thoung han.
Hatei kakhin e ka kamthoung hoeh e niteh, BAWIPA e hmuen kathoung a khin sak dawkvah, hote tami teh kamkhueng e tamihu thung hoi takhoe e lah ao han. Kamthoungnae tui hah ahni koe kahei sin lah ao hoeh dawkvah, kakhin e lah ao.
Hetheh ahnimouh han a yungyoe phunglam lah ao han. Kamthoungnae tui kahei sin e pueng ni a khohna a pâsu han, hahoi a kamthoungnae tui kateknaw pueng teh tangmin totouh a khin han.
Kathounghoehe naw ni a tek e pueng teh kakhin e lah awm toung vaiteh, hot hno kateknaw pueng teh, tangmin totouh a khin han, telah a ti.
Hahoi Isarel catounnaw pueng teh, thapa yung pasuek dawkvah, Zin kahrawngum dawkvah a kâen awh. Taminaw pueng teh, Kadesh vah a hnin ao awh. Hawvah, Miriam a due teh hawvah a pakawp awh.
Hahoi taminaw pueng hanlah tui nei han awm hoeh toe. Hat toteh, haw vah Mosi hoi Aron taran lahoi a kamkhuengsin awh.
Taminaw pueng ni BAWIPA hmalah hmaunawnghanaw a due nah dout ngala boipawiteh,
bangkongmaw BAWIPA e taminaw hete kahrawngum vah kamamanaw hoi saringnaw abuemlah due hanlah na ceikhai.
Bangkongmaw het patet kahawihoehe ram dawkvah kâenkhai hanlah Izip ram hoi na tâcokhai. Tâsong, thaibunglung kung, misurkung, tale paw hai o hoeh nah koe, tui boehai nei hane ao hoeh nah koe, telah ati awh.
Mosi hoi Aron teh tamimaya koehoi kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang koe a cei roi teh, a tabo roi. Hahoi ahnimouh roi koe BAWIPA bawilennae a kamnue.
BAWIPA ni Mosi a pato teh,
sonron lat nateh, nang hoi na hmau Aron ni taminaw pâkhueng awh. Ahnimae mithmu vah lungsongpui koe lawk dei pouh. Tui a tâcosak han. Hot patetlah hoiyah, lungsongpui dawk hoi tui na tâcosak vaiteh, taminaw pueng hoi saringnaw hah na nei sak han telah ati.
Hot patetlah Mosi ni BAWIPA hmalah sonron hah kâ a poe e patetlah a la.
Mosi hoi Aron ni taminaw pueng hah lungsongpui teng a pâkhueng teh, ahnimouh koe, taran ouk ka thaw e taminaw, atu thai awh haw! hete lungsong dawk hoi nangmouh han tui ka tâcosak roeroe han maw telah atipouh.
Hahoi teh Mosi ni a kut a dâw teh, a sonron hoi lungsongpui hah vai hni touh a hem, hat toteh, tui kapap poung lah a tâco. Taminaw pueng hoi saringnaw ni a nei awh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi hoi Aron koe kai na yuem hoeh teh, Isarel catounnaw mithmu vah, kai na barilawa hoeh dawkvah, hete taminaw pueng teh kai ni na poe awh e ram dawk na kâenkhai mahoeh, telah atipouh.
Isarel catounnaw ni BAWIPA rek a cusin awh teh ahnimouh thung vah ama barilawa hanlah ao dawk hote tui teh Meribah ati awh.
Hahoi Mosi ni Kadesh hoi Edom siangpahrang koevah, patounenaw a patoun. Na hmaunawngha Isarel ni hettelah a dei. Maimouh koe ka phat e runae kathonaw pueng,
mintoenaw Izip ram a cei awh teh, moikasaw lah Izip ram vah ka o awh teh, Izipnaw ni kai koe hoi mintoenaw totouh rucatnae na poe e hah na panue.
BAWIPA koe ka hram awh e lawk hah a thai teh, kalvantaminaw a patoun teh, Izip ram hoi na tâco sak. Khenhaw, na ram hoi ka hnai poung lah, Kadesh khopui dawkvah ka o awh.
Pahren lahoi na ram thung pou na rakan sak haw. Law thoseh, misur takha thoseh, ka coungroe awh mahoeh. tuikhu dawk e tui hai ka net mahoeh. Siangpahrang lamthungpui dawk doeh ka cei awh han, na ram ka tapoung hoeh roukrak avoilah aranglah hai kampuen awh mahoeh, telah ati.
Edom ni kai ka ram dawk na cet awh mahoeh, telah hoehpawiteh, nangmouh tuk hanelah tahloi hoi kamthaw awh han, telah ati.
Isarel catounnaw ni lamthungpui dawk hoi ka cei awh vaiteh kamamouh hoi ka saringnaw ni na tui ka net awh pawiteh, aphu na poe awh han, hno alouke banghai sak laipalah, raka lah doeh pou ka raka awh ti telah atipouh awh.
Ahni ni na raka awh mahoeh atipouh. Hahoi teh, Edom teh tami moikapap hoi tami athakaawme taminaw hoi ahnimouh tuk hanlah a kamthaw awh.
Hot patetlah Isarel catounnaw teh Edom ni a ram dawk dei hanlah pasoung awh hoeh. Hahoi Isarel teh ahnimouh koehoi a kamlang takhai awh.
Hothloilah Isarelnaw pueng teh Kadesh hoi a kamthaw awh teh, Hor mon koe a pha awh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi hoi Aron teh Edom khori koe Hor mon hoi a pato teh,
Aron teh a taminaw koe ceikhai han toe. Bangtelah tetpawiteh, Isarel catounnaw koe ka poe e ram dawk kâen mahoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Meribah tui koe ka lawk taran lahoi taran a thaw awh.
Aron hoi a capa Eleazar hah Hor mon koe a luenkhai awh.
Aron e khohna rading awh nateh, a capa Eleazar kâkhu sak awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Aron teh a taminaw koe ceikhai vaiteh, haw vah a due han telah ati.
Mosi ni BAWIPA kâ poe e patetlah a sak teh, taminaw pueng e mithmu vah Hor mon vah a luen awh.
Mosi ni Aron e khohna a rading pouh teh, Eleazar a kho sak teh, Aron teh monsom vah a due. Hottelah Mosi hoi Eleazar teh monsom hoi a kum roi.
Taminaw pueng ni Aron a due tie a thai awh toteh, Isarelnaw pueng ni Aron teh hnin 30 touh a khui awh.
Kanaannaw Arad siangpahrang akalae kaawm e niyah, Isarelnaw, Atharim lam koe lah a tho awh ti a thai awh toteh, Isarelnaw hah a tuk awh teh, a tangawn san lah a man awh.
Hottelah Isarelnaw ni BAWIPA koevah lawk a kam awh teh, hetnaw heh kaimouh kut dawk na poe pawiteh, a khopui hah peng ka raphoe thai han telah ati awh.
BAWIPA ni Isarelnaw e lawk a tarawi pouh teh, Kanaannaw teh a kut dawk poe lah ao. Amamouh hoi a khopuinaw hah he a raphoe teh, hote hmuen teh Hormah telah ati awh.
Hor mon koehoi tuipui paling koelah Edom ram lawngven lahoi a cei awh. Lam ekvoi a kâhei awh dawkvah, taminaw pueng teh a lungkuep laipalah,
Cathut hoi Mosi taranlahoi kahrawngum vah due hanelah bangkongmaw Izip ram hoi na tâcokhai. Vaiyei hai awm hoeh, tui hai awm hoeh, hete vaiyei karawcap e hai ka hringnae ni a panuet toe, telah ati awh.
Hatdawkvah, BAWIPA ni hmai tahrun a thasin teh, taminaw a khue dawkvah moikapap a due awh.
Hatnavah taminaw ni Mosi koe a tho awh teh, BAWIPA hoi nang koe taranlahoi lawk ka dei e hah ka yon awh toe. Tahrunnaw hah kaimouh koehoi takhoe hanlah BAWIPA koe na kâhet pouh leih, telah atipouh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe hmai tahrun hah sak nah teh khom dawk hoi pathout pouh. Tahrun ni a khue e pueng ni hote hah a khet vaiteh a hring awh han telah atipouh.
Hahoi Mosi ni rahum tahrun hah a sak teh, khom dawk a vo. Hahoi teh tahrun ni a khue e pueng rahum tahrun hah a khet awh teh a dam awh.
Isarel catounnaw teh, pou a kâtahruet awh teh, Oboth vah a roe awh.
Oboth hoi bout a cei awh teh, Kanîtholah Moab kahrawng teng Iyeabarim vah a roe awh.
Haw hoi a cei awh teh Zered tanghling dawk a roe awh.
Haw hoi bout a cei awh teh, Amornaw e ramri hoi pou kâkuen e Arnon namran lah a roe awh. Arnon teh Moab ramri, Moab hoi Amornaw rahak vah kaawm e doeh.
Hatdawkvah, BAWIPA tarantuknae cauk dawk, Suphat hoi Vaheb Arnon, Arnon sawkcanaw hoi.
Ar kho lahoi ka lawng e sawkcanaw hai, Moab ramri lahoi a teng poe ka lawng e telah a dei awh.
Hahoi, Beer lah a cei awh. Haw teh BAWIPA ni Mosi koevah, taminaw pueng hah kaw nateh, tui ka poe han ati nae tuikhu koe doeh.
Hahoi hete la heh Isarelnaw ni a sak awh. Oe tuiphuek tâcawt haw telah la heh a phueng awh
Kahrawikungnaw a bonae tuikhu hah kâlawk kapoekung sonron hoi tai e, miphunnaw kahrawikung ni a tai e, ti hoiyah, hote kahrawng koehoi Mattanah lah a cei awh.
Mattanah hoi Nahaliel, Nahaliel hoi Bamoth,
Bamoth hoi Moab ram kaawm e tanghling, Pisgah som kho ouk khetnae hmuen, hmu thainae koe a kâtahruet awh.
Isarelnaw ni Amornaw e siangpahrang Sihon koevah, na ram dawk hoi kaimouh na rakan sak haw. Na law dawk thoseh, misur takha dawk thoseh, ka cet awh mahoeh. Na tuikhu dawk e tui hai ka net awh mahoeh.
Na ram ka tapoung hoeh roukrak, siangpahrang lamthungpui dawk doeh ka cet awh ti telah patounenaw a patoun.
Hatei, Sihon ni a ram dawk rakan sak hane pasoung hoeh. Hottelah Sihon ni a taminaw pueng a pâkhueng teh, Isarelnaw tuk hanlah kahrawngum a kamthaw awh. Jahaz vah a pha awh teh Isarelnaw hah a tuk awh.
Isarelnaw ni, kahran e tahloi hoi a tuk awh van teh a ram teh Arnon hoi Jabbok totouh, Ammon catounnaw ram totouh a la pouh awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Ammonnaw e ramri teh pou a patoup awh e doeh.
Isarelnaw ni khonaw pueng koung a la awh. Hottelah Isarelnaw teh, Ammonnaw e khonaw pueng dawk Heshbon hoi khotenaw pueng dawk kho a sak awh.
Heshbon kho teh Ammornaw e siangpahrang Sihon onae kho doeh. Ahni teh Moab siangpahrang hoi taran a kâtuk teh a kut dawk e a ram naw pueng Arnon palang kalatkung doeh.
Hatdawkvah, la ka phuengkung ni, Heshbon vah tho loe, Sihon khopui teh bout thawng awh sei, bout pathoup awh sei.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Heshbon hoi hmai a tâco teh, Sihon khopui hoi hmai a to. Moab khopui Ar kho koung a kak. Arnon hmuenrasang bawinaw hoi,
Oe Moab na yawthoe, nang teh na kahma toe. Khemosh taminaw, Amornaw e siangpahrang koevah, a capanaw yawngkhai hane hoi, a canunaw a san lah a poe awh.
Hatei, kai ni na tâ awh toe. Heshbon teh Dibon totouh a kahma. Hottelah Nophah kho totouh a raphoe teh, hot ni teh Medeba totouh a pha.
Hot patetlah Amornaw e ram koe Isarelnaw teh kho a sak awh.
Hahoi Mosi ni Jazer tuet hanlah tami a patoun. Hote kho a la teh, haw vah kaawm e Amor taminaw a pâlei awh.
A ban awh teh, Bashan lam koe lah a takhang awh. Bashan siangpahrang Og teh ahnimouh tuk hanelah ama hoi a taminaw pueng hoi Edrei hoi tuk hanelah a kamthaw awh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koevah ahni teh taket hanh loe. Ama hoi a taminaw khuehoi a ram totouh na kut dawk na poe toe. Heshbon e kaawm e Amornaw e siangpahrang Sihon koevah na sak e patetlah na sak han telah atipouh.
Hahoi teh ama thoseh, a capanaw thoseh, buet touh boehai pâhlung laipalah a taminaw pueng hoi a thei awh teh a ram teh hmawi a tawn pouh awh.
Isarel catounnaw teh pou a cei awh teh, Jeriko kho namran lah Jordan palang na ran Moab tanghling dawk a roe awh.
Zippor capa Balak ni Isarelnaw ni Amornaw lathueng a sak e naw pueng a thai.
Tamimaya hah apap poung dawkvah, Moab ni taki lah a taki katang. Isarelnaw kecu dawk Moab teh kângairu lah ao.
Hottelah Moab ni Midian a lungkahanaw koe Maito ni hram koung a ai e patetlah hete taminaw ni kaimae tengpam e taminaw pueng koung a i han doeh telah ati. Hote tueng navah Zippor capa Balak teh Moab siangpahrang lah ao.
Ahni ni khenhaw! miphun buet touh Izip ram hoi ka tâcawt e ao teh, talai dawk muen a kawi awh. Kaimouh rahak vah sut ao awh. Pahren lahoi tho nateh hetnaw heh thoebo haw. Bangkongtetpawiteh kai hane teh a thasaipoung awh.
Ahnimanaw tâ vaiteh ram dawk hoi ka pâlei thai yawkaw han kai ma. Bangkongtetpawiteh, yawhawi na poe e teh yawhawi e lah ao, thoe na bo e pueng teh thoebo lah ao tie ka panue, telah kaw hanelah na catounnaw a onae ram, palang teng vah, Pethor e Beor capa Balaam koevah patounenaw a patoun.
Hatdawkvah, Moab a lungkahanaw hoi Midian a lungkahanaw teh thoebo sak phu poe hanelah tadawnghno sin hoi a cei awh teh, Balaam koe a pha awh. Balak ni lawkthui e hah a dei pouh awh.
Ahni ni, atu tangmin lah teh awi hi vah roe awh. BAWIPA ni na dei pouh e patetlah nangmouh koe lawk na thui awh han telah atipouh. Hottelah, Moab tami kalennaw teh Balaam koe a roe awh.
Balaam koe Cathut a tho teh nang koe kaawm e taminaw heh bangpatetnaw maw, telah atipouh.
Balaam ni Cathut koevah, Zippor capa Moab siangpahrang Balak ni kai koevah,
khenhaw! Izip ram hoi ka tho e miphun ni talai dawk muen a kawi awh. Ahnimouh ka tâ vaiteh, ka pâlei thai nahanelah thoe na bo pouh haw, a titeh, taminaw a patoun e doeh telah atipouh.
Cathut ni Balaam koevah, ahnimouh koe cet hanh, hotnaw teh thoe hai bo hanh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, ahnimouh teh yawkahawi e tami doeh, telah atipouh.
Balaam teh amom a thaw teh Balak e tamikalennaw koe, na ram lah ban awh leih, bangkongtetpawiteh, BAWIPA ni nangmouh koe cei hanlah na pasoung hoeh telah ati.
Moab tamikalennaw teh, a thaw awh teh Balak koevah a cei awh. Ahni koe Balaam ni maimouh koe kâbang ngai hoeh atipouh.
Balak ni ahnimouh hlak kapap, ahnimouh hlak minhmai khet kaawm, tamikalennaw hah bout a patoun.
Balaam koevah, a pha awh teh, Zippor capa Balak ni telah ati, kai koe na kâbang hane bang ni hai na ngang hanh naseh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, barilawa kaawm lah na tawm katang han, kai koe na dei e pueng ka sak han, hatdawkvah, tho nateh hetnaw heh thoe na bo pouh haw ati telah ati.
Balaam ni Balak e sannaw hah a pathung teh ahnimouh koe Balak ni a im hoi athung vah sui ngun khakkawi lah na poe han nakunghai, BAWIPA ka Cathut lawk hloilah banghai ka sak thai hoeh.
Hatdawkvah, BAWIPA ni kai koe bangmaw bout a dei han, atu tangmin teh hi roe awh ei telah atipouh.
Hat hnin tangmin vah Balaam koe Cathut a tho teh, ahnimouh koe, hetnaw heh nang na kaw hanlah tho pawiteh, thaw nateh ahnimouh koe kâbang. Hatei nang koe ka dei e dueng na sak han, telah atipouh.
Balaam teh amom vah a thaw teh, la hah a rakueng, Moab tamikalennaw koevah a kâbang.
Hottelah, a cei kecu dawkvah, Cathut lungkhueknae a kaman teh, BAWIPA kalvantami teh ama ngang hanelah lam dawk sut a kangdue. Ama teh la dawk kâcui niteh, a san kahni touh hoi haw vah ao.
La ni BAWIPA kalvantami ni tahloi patuep hoi lam dawk a kangdue e hah a hmu teh, lam a phen teh kahrawng lahoi a cei. Hottelah Balaam ni la teh lam dawk ban hanelah a hem.
BAWIPA kalvantami teh misur takha hoi takha rahak e lam koe bout a kangdue.
La ni BAWIPA kalvantami hah bout a hmu toteh, misur takha rai lah a kâhnawn dawkvah, Balaam khok pak a kuen. Balaam ni bout a hemkhai.
BAWIPA kalvantami ni teh, a hmalah rek bout a cusin teh avoilah, aranglah kamheithaihoehnae lamceknae koe a kangdue pouh.
La ni, BAWIPA kalvantami hah a hmu teh Balaam teh rawk a tabo khai. Hahoi, Balaam a lungkhuek teh, a sonron hoi la teh a hem.
BAWIPA ni la hah a lawk a thosak. Balaam koevah nang na tak dawk bangmaw ka sak, vai thum touh totouh kai na hemkhai telah atipouh.
Balaam ni la koevah, nang ni kai na noutna hoeh teyaw, tahloi ka sin nah pawiteh, na thei han ei nan maw atipouh.
La ni Balaam koevah, sahnin totouh na kâcui e la nahoehmaw. Hettelah nang koe ouk ka sak boimaw, telah ati. Ahni ni na sak boihoeh bokheiyah telah atipouh.
BAWIPA ni Balaam mit hah a ang sak teh, BAWIPA kalvantami tahloi hoi lam dawk sut a kangdue e hah a hmu. A saling teh talai dawk minhmai rek kâbet lah a tabo.
BAWIPA kalvantami ni ahni koe, bangkongmaw, vai thum totouh la na hem. Khenhaw! na cei hoeh nahan koelah na cei kecu dawkvah, nang ngang hanlah ka tâco.
La ni na hmu teh ka hmalah vai thum touh na roun. Na roun hoehpawiteh, la teh thet hoeh vaiteh, nang nama nouh thei lah na awm ei ti heh ma, telah atipouh.
Balaam ni BAWIPA kalvantami koevah, ka yon toe, bangkongtetpawiteh, kai taranlahoi lam na kangdue tie ka panuek hoeh, hatdawkvah na lunghawihoeh pawiteh ka ban han telah atipouh.
BAWIPA e kalvantami ni Balaam koevah, hetnaw koe vah cet, hateiteh, nang koe ka dei e dueng ahnimouh koe na dei pouh han telah atipouh. Hahoi teh, Balaam teh Balak e tami kalennaw koe a cei.
Balak ni Balaam a tho tie hah a panue toteh, Arnon koelae ramri Moab khopui totouh a dawn awh.
Balak ni Balaam koevah, atangcalah nang la hanlah tami ka patoun nahoehmaw. Bangkongmaw kai koe na tho ngai hoeh. Tamikalen poung lah na coung sak thai mahoeh maw, telah atipouh.
Balaam ni Balak koevah, khenhaw! nang koe vah ka tho toe. Bang hno pueng deithainae kâ ka tawn na maw. Cathut ni ka pahni dawk a ta e dueng doeh ka dei tih, telah ati.
Hottelah Balaam teh Balak koe a cei teh, Kiriath-huzoth vah a pha awh.
Balak ni maito hoi tu hoi thuengnae a sak. Balaam hoi ama koe kaawm e tamikalennaw koe youn touh a poe.
Hahoi a tangtho vah, Balak ni Balaam a hrawi teh, tamimaya hah pâtue hanelah, Baal hmuenrasang koe a luenkhai.
Hahoi, Balaam ni Balak koevah, hivah thuengnae khoungroe sari touh na sak pouh loe. Maitotan sari touh, tutan sari touh kai hanlah na rakueng pouh loe telah a ti.
Balak ni Balaam dei e patetlah a sak. Balak hoi Balaam ni bawknae khoungroe tangkuem vah, maitotan buet touh hoi tutan buet touh a poe awh.
Balaam ni Balak koevah, nang ni hmaisawi thuengnae teng vah, pou kangdout lah a, kai teh alouk lah yo ka cet eivai, BAWIPA ni kai pato hanlah a tho thai, hahoi na dei pouh e pueng kai ni nang koe na dei pouh han telah atipouh. Hahoi kacailum e hmuenrasang koe a cei.
Cathut ni Balaam a kâhmo teh ahnimouh ni ama koe bawknae khoungroe sari touh ka sak toe. Bawknae khoungroe buet touh dawk maitotan buet touh, tutan buet touh rip ka poe toe telah a ti.
Hottelah BAWIPA ni Balaam koe pahni dawk lawk hah a ta pouh teh, ahni koe Balak koe ban nateh, hettelah patuen dei pouh telah a ti.
Hahoi ahnimouh a ban teh, khenhaw, hmaisawinae a kung koe ama hoi Moab tami kalennaw teh pou a kangdue teh,
ahni ni lawk hah a pâpho pouh teh, a ram lahoi Balak ni a ceikhai teh, Kanîtholae mon Moab siangpahrang ni tho haw, Jakop hah thoebo haw, tho haw, Isarel hah na pathoe pouh haw telah a ti.
Bangtelamaw, Cathut ni thoebo hoeh e thoe louk ka bo han, bangtelamaw, Cathut ni pathoe hoeh e louk ka pathoe han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, lungsongpui dawk ahnimouh teh ka hmu teh, monpui dawk hoi ahnimouh teh ka khet. Khenhaw! miphun louk lah doeh ao awh. Jentelnaw koe pareisin hanlah awm hoeh.
Jakop vaiphu teh apinimaw a touk thai han. Isarel pung pali pung touh teh apinimaw a touk thai han. Tamikalan due e patetlah dout van boipawiteh, ka poutnae teh a poutnae lah thoseh, telah a ti.
Balak ni Balaam koevah, na sak e teh bangtelae na maw. Ka tarannaw thoebo hanlah na hrawi teh, yawhawi dai na poe atipouh.
Ahni ni BAWIPA ni ka pahni dawk a ta e lawk ka dei mahoeh na maw telah atipouh.
Balak ni alouklah cet ei, haw hoi teh na hmu thai nahanlah a onae hmuen ram pueng be na hmu han, abuemlahoi teh be na hmawt mahoeh ei, hot hmuen koehoi ahnimouh teh thoe na bo pouh han telah a ti.
Hottelah, Zophimnaw onae Pisgah monsom dawk a luenkhai. Thuengnae khoungroe sari touh a sak teh, hote thuengnae khoungroe tangkuem dawk maitotan buet touh hoi tutan buet touh rip a poe.
Balak koevah, hawvah, BAWIPA ka kâhmo navah, hmaisawi thuengnae a kung koe pou ka kangdout loe telah atipouh.
BAWIPA ni Balaam a kâhmo teh a pahni dawk lawk a ta pouh. Balak koe ban nateh hettelah patuen dei pouh telah a ti.
Ahni koe a cei sin teh, khenhaw! hmaisawi thuengnae akung koevah, a kangdue teh, Moab tami kalennaw hai ahni koe ao. Balak ni BAWIPA ni bangtelamaw a dei telah a ti.
Hahoi teh ahni ni lawk hah a pâpho teh, thaw haw, Balak ka lawk thai haw, Zippor capa ka lawk hah thai haw.
Cathut teh laithoe ka dei e tami nahoeh. Pankângai e tami capa lahai tho hoeh. A dei e teh sak mahoeh na maw. A dei tangcoung e hah kuep sak mahoeh na maw.
Khenhaw! yawhawi poe hanelah kâlawk ka hmu teh, a yaw ahawi sak toung dawkvah, kâthung thai mahoeh toe.
Jakop koe payonpakainae hmawt hoeh niteh, Isarel hawihoehnae hmawt hoeh. Jehovah a Cathut ni a okhai teh, siangpahrang hramnae lawk ahnimouh koe ao.
Izip ram hoi a tâcokhai teh, sakraktan patetlah a thaonae a tawn.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, taân ni Jakop teh tâ thai hoeh, hmaui ni Isarel teh tâ thai hoeh. Jakop hoi Isarel koevah, Cathut hno sak e hah dei lah kaawm roeroe han.
Khenhaw! taminaw teh sendekmanu patetlah a thaw teh, sendek patetlah a dawkcawk teh, a kei awh e moi a ca hoehroukrak teh, a kei awh e moi thi a nei hoehroukrak teh duem awm awh mahoeh, telah a ti.
Balak ni Balaam koevah thoebo hanh leih. Yawhawi hai poe hanh leih, telah a ti.
Hatei Balaam ni a pathung, BAWIPA ni a dei e naw pueng teh ka sak roeroe hane doeh, telah ka dei nahoehmaw telah a ti.
Hahoi Balak ni Balaam koevah, tho haw, alouklah na ceikhai han, awi haw kangna teh Cathut ni thoe na bo sak hanelah ahawi ati ta panue maw, telah a ti.
Hottelah Balak ni Balaam teh kahrawng khetnae Peor mon som a luenkhai.
Balaam ni Balak koevah, hivah thuengnae khoungroe sari touh na rakueng pouh loe, telah atipouh.
Balak ni Balaam dei e patetlah a sak pouh teh thuengnae khoungroe tangkuem maitotan buet touh hoi tutan buet touh rip a poe.
Hot patetlah Isarel yawhawi poe e hah BAWIPA a ngainae lah doeh ao tie hah Balaam ni a panue toteh, ahmoun ouk a sak e patetlah taânnae hno hanlah cet laipalah kahrawngum lah letlang a pâtam.
Balaam ni a khet teh Isarelnaw hah ama miphun aloukcalah ao e hah a hmu. Cathut e Muitha hah ahnimouh koe a pha.
Hahoi lawk hah a pâpho teh, Beor capa Balaam mit a ang sak,
Cathut lawk hah thai hoi, Athakasaipounge kamnuenae hah a hmu hoi, ka tabawk ni teh a mit ka padai e ni,
Oe Jakop na rim teh ahawi. Oe Isarel na khosaknae teh ahawi doeh.
Tanghling patetlah a kâphai. Palang teng e takha patetlah BAWIPA ni a ung e sumpakung hoi, palang teng e Sidar thing patetlah doeh ao.
Khotui moikapap a coe vaiteh, tui apapnae koe cati a patue awh han. Agag hlak vah a siangpahrang a rasang vaiteh, a uknaeram teh tawmtakhang han.
Izip hoi Cathut ni a tâcokhai teh, sakraktan patetlah a thao awh. A taran Jentelnaw hah cat awh vaiteh, a hru hah vitpatit lah a dêi awh han. A samtang hoi pawkkayawng lah a ka awh han.
A tabut awh teh, sendekmanu patetlah a tabo teh apinimaw a pathaw ngam han. Yawhawi na kapoekung hah yawhawi poe nateh, thoe na ka bo naw hah thoebo awh telah a ti.
Hat toteh, Balaam tak dawk Balaam a lung a kâan teh, Balak ni Balaam koevah, ka taran thoebo hanlah na kaw. Hatei, khenhaw! vai thum totouh yawhawi na poe.
Hatdawkvah, na onae koe kahmakata han lah cet. Ka taluepoung e lah tawmrasang hanlah ka kâcai e doeh. Khenhaw! hatei, BAWIPA ni tawmtakhang hanlah na pasoung hoeh toe telah a ti.
Balaam teh Balak ni sui ngun yikkawi lah na ka poe nakunghai,
ahawinae koe lah thoseh, thoenae koelah thoseh, kai kama lung lahoi teh, BAWIPA lawk hloilah sak thai e banghai ka tawn hoeh. BAWIPA ni a dei e pueng ka dei han telah na patoun e patounenaw pueng koehai ka dei nahoehmaw.
Khenhaw! ka taminaw koe ka cei han toe. Tho haw hete taminaw ni, hma lae tueng dawk na taminaw koe a sak hane kong dawk pouknae na poe han telah a ti.
Ahni ni lawk hah a pâpho teh, Beor capa Balaam mit a ang sak teh,
Cathut lawk hah thai hoi, Lathueng Poung e panuenae tha panue hoi, Athakasaipounge vision a hmu teh, a tabo hoi a mit ka ang e ni
ama teh ka hmu, hatei atu nahoeh. Ama teh ka khet, hatei kahnaicalah nahoeh. Jakop koehoi Âsi a tâco han. Isarel koehoi siangpahrang sonron a tâco han. Moab ram pawkkayawng lah a cuek vaiteh, Sethnaw hai be a raphoe awh han.
A taran lah ouk kaawm e Edom hoi Seir hai a coe han. Isarel kangduenae ahawi nah thung pueng teh, kaukkung buet touh a tawn awh han.
Jakop koehoi kaukkung buet touh a tawn vaiteh, kacawirae khonaw hah a raphoe awh han.
Amalek lah kangvawi hoi lawk hah a pâpho. Amalek teh miphun kung pui lah ao eiteh, hatei hnukteng teh rawkphainae lah ao.
Kennaw lah kangvawi laihoi lawk a pâpho. Na onae hmuen teh a cak. Na tabu teh lungsong dawk na tuk.
Hatei, Ken teh, hmaisawi lah ao vaiteh, Asshur ni san lah na hrawi totouh telah a ti.
Lawk hah bout a pâpho teh, Aiyoe, Cathut ni hetheh a sak toteh apimaw ka hring thai han.
Hatei, Cyprus tuilum koehoi long phat vaiteh, Asshur hoi Eber hah runae a poe han. Amalek a kahma totouh telah a ti.
Hahoi teh Balaam a thaw teh a onae hmuen koe a ban teh, Balak hai a ban van.
Isarel teh shittim kho a sak navah, taminaw pueng teh Moab napui koe kâyo hanlah a kamtawng awh.
A cathut koe thuengnae a sak navah, ouk a coun awh. Taminaw pueng ni a canei awh teh, a cathut koe ouk a tabo awh.
Isarel teh, Peor e hmuen koe Baal hoi a kâkuet awh teh, Isarel koe BAWIPA lungkhueknae teh a kâan.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koevah takikatho poung e BAWIPA lungkhueknae teh, Isarel koe lahoi a roum thai nahanlah tamimaya kahrawinaw pueng hah a ceikhai awh teh, kanîthun vah, kâtapoenaw pueng hah BAWIPA hmalah kamcengcalah kaithi sak haw telah a ti.
Hatdawkvah, Mosi ni Isarel lawkcengkungnaw koevah, Peor hmuen koe Baal kabawknaw pueng koung thet awh telah a ti.
Khenhaw! Isarel catounnaw thung dawk tami buet touh ni kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang koe a khuika navah, Mosi mithmu hoi Isarel catoun tamimaya mithmu vah, Midian napui buet touh a hmaunawnghanaw koe a thokhai.
Vaihma Aron e capa Eleazar capa Phinahas ni a hmu toteh, tamimaya koehoi a thaw teh tahroe hah a la.
Isarelnaw teh lukkareiim thung vah a pâlei teh kahni touh roi hoi pawkkayawng lah a thut. Isarel tami hoi napui teh a vawn dawk a thut teh, Isarel catounnaw koe lacik hah a roum.
Hote lacik hoi kadoutnaw teh 24000 touh a pha.
BAWIPA ni Mosi hah a pato teh,
vaihma Aron capa Eleazar capa Phinehas ni Isarel catounnaw koe ka lungkhueknae ka roum sak toe. Bangkongtetpawiteh, ka lungkhueknae ni Isarel catounnaw a raphoe hoeh nahanelah, ahnimouh rahak ka dipmanae patetlah a kâdipma awh van han.
Hatdawkvah, khenhaw! roumnae ka lawkkam teh, ama koevah ka poe.
Ama hoi a catounnaw hanlah, a yungyoe vaihma lah a onae lawkkam lah ao han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, dipma Cathut teh, Isarel catounnaw hanlah yonthanae a sak tet awh telah a ti.
Isarelnaw Midian napui hoi a thei awh e min teh Simeonnaw thung dawk imthungkhu kahrawikung Salu capa Zimri doeh.
Midian napui a thei awh e min teh Midian imthungkhu kahrawikung Zur canu Kozbi doeh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi a pato teh,
Midiannaw teh reksaueng nateh tuk awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Peor kecu dawk lacik a tho navah, a tawncanu, Midiannaw kahrawikung canu Kozbi a thei awh e kong dawkvah, nangmouh lathueng kalanhoehe hno sak hoi na tarawk awh toe telah ati.

Lacik pawng a kâkayaw hoi BAWIPA ni Mosi hoi vaihma Aron capa Eleazar hah a pato teh,
Isarel catounnaw pueng hah kum 20 lathueng amamae miphun lahoi Isarel ram dawk e tarantuknae koe kacetthainaw pueng hah be touk loe atipouh.
Mosi hoi vaihma Eleazar ni Jeriko avanglah Jordan palang teng Moab tanghling dawk ahnimouh teh a pato teh,
BAWIPA ni Mosi hoi Izip ram hoi katâcawtnaw Isarel catounnaw koevah, kâ a poe e patetlah taminaw hah kum 20 hoi a lathueng e pueng touk loe atipouh.
Isarel e camin teh Reuben doeh. Reuben capanaw teh, Hanok hoi Hanok imthungkhu, Pallu hoi Pallu imthungkhu.
Hezron hoi Hezron imthungkhu, Karmi hoi Karmi imthungkhu,
Reuben imthungkhunaw a touk awh teh 43,730 touh a pha.
Pallu catoun hoi Eliab,
Eliab capanaw teh, Nemuel, Dathan hoi Abiram doeh. Dathan hoi Abiram teh Mosi hoi Aron ka cusin e tamimaya yueng lah doeh ao awh. BAWIPA a taran awh navah Korah hoi kambawng e lahai ao roi.
Hotnaw a due navah, talai ni rak a ang teh Korah hah koung a payawp teh, hmai ni tami 250 koung a kak navah, bangnuenae lah a coung awh.
Hatei, Korah catounnaw dout awh hoeh.
A imthungkhu lahoi Simeon capanaw teh; Nemuel hoi Nemuel imthungkhu, Jamin hoi Jamin imthungkhu, Jakhin hoi Jakhin imthungkhu,
Zerah hoi Zarah imthungkhu, Saul hoi Saul imthungkhu,
Simeon imthungnaw heh 22,200 touh a pha.
Gad capanaw hai ama imthungkhu lahoi, Zephon hoi Zephon imthungkhu, Haggi hoi Haggi imthungkhu, Shuni hoi Shuni imthungkhu,
Ozni hoi Ozni imthungkhu, Eri hoi Eri imthungkhu,
Arod hoi Arodi imthungkhu, Areli hoi Areli imthungkhu,
Hetnaw heh Gad imthungkhunaw 40,500 touh a pha.
Judah capa roi heh Er hoi Onan ei, Er hoi Onan teh Kanaan kho vah a due.
Judah capanaw ama imthungkhu lahoi, Shelah hoi Shelah imthungkhu, Perez hoi Perez imthungkhu, Zerah hoi Zarah imthungkhu,
Perez capanaw teh, Hezron hoi Hezron imthungkhu, Hamul hoi Hamul imthungkhu la ao awh.
Hetnaw heh Judah imthungkhunaw a touk awh e 76,500 touh a pha.
Issakhar capanaw a imthungkhu lahoi, Tola hoi Tola imthungkhu, Puvah hoi Puvah imthungkhu,
Jashub hoi Jashub imthungkhu, Shimron hoi Shimron imthungkhu,
Hetnaw heh Issakhar imthungkhu a touk awh e 64,300 touh a pha.
Zebulun capanaw a imthungkhu lahoi, Sered hoi Sered imthungkhu, Elon hoi Elon imthungkhu, Jahleel hoi Jahleel doeh.
Hetnaw heh Zebulun imthungkhu a touk awh e 60,500 touh a pha.
Joseph capanaw a imthungkhu lahoi, Manasseh hoi Ephraim.
Manasseh capa imthungkhunaw teh, Makhir hoi Makhir imthungkhu. Makhir ni Gilead a sak teh Gilead hoi Gilead imthungkhu lah ao.
Gilead capanaw teh, Iezer hoi Iezer imthungkhu, Helek hoi Helek imthungkhu,
Asriel hoi Asriel imthungkhu, Shekhem e Shekhem imthungkhu,
Shemida e Shemida imthungkhu, Hepher e Hepher imthungkhu,
Hepher capa Zelophehad heh a ca tongpa awm hoeh, napuinaw dueng doeh kaawm. Zelophehad canunaw e minnaw teh, Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah hoi Tirzah.
Hetnaw teh Manasseh imthungkhu a touk awh e 52,700 touh a pha.
Ephraim capanaw a imthungkhu lahoi, Shuthela hoi Shuthela imthungkhu, Bekher hoi Bekher imthungkhu, Tahan hoi Tahan imthungkhu lah ao.
Shuthela capanaw teh, Eran hoi Eran imthungkhu lah ao.
Hetnaw teh Ephraim imthungkhu a touk awh e 32,500 touh a pha awh. Hetnaw heh Joseph capa imthungkhunaw doeh.
Benjamin capanaw a imthungkhu lahoi, Bela hoi Bela imthungkhu, Ashbel hoi Ashbel imthungkhu, Ahiram hoi Ahiram imthungkhu,
Shupham hoi Shupham imthungkhu, Hupham hoi Humpham imthungkhu lah ao.
Bela capa roi teh Ard hoi Naaman doeh. Ard imthungkhu hoi Naaman hoi Naaman imthungkhunaw doeh.
hetnaw heh Benjamin imthungkhunaw a touk awh e 45,600 touh a pha.
Dan capanaw a imthungkhu lahoi, Shuham hoi Shuham imthung lah ao. Hetnaw heh doeh ahnimae imthungkhu dawk hoi Dan imthungkhu lah kaawm.
Hetnaw heh Shuham imthungkhunaw a touk awh e 64,400 touh a pha.
Asher capanaw a imthungkhu lahoi, Imnah hoi Imnah imthungkhu, Ishvi hoi Ishvi imthungkhu, Beriah hoi Beriah imthungkhu,
Beriah ca roi, Heber hoi Heber imthungkhu, Malkhiel hoi Makhiel imthung lah ao.
Asher e canu min teh Serah doeh.
Hetnaw teh Asher capanaw imthungkhu lahoi a touk awh e 53,400 touh a pha.
Naphtali capanaw a imthung lahoi, Jahzeel hoi Jahzeel imthung, Guni hoi Guni imthungkhu,
Jezer hoi Jezer imthungkhu, Shillem hoi Shillem imthungkhu lah ao.
Hetnaw heh Naphtali imthungkhu a touk awh e 45,400 touh a pha.
Hetnaw heh Isarel catounnaw a touk awh e 601,730 touh a pha.
BAWIPA ni Mosi a pato teh,
Hete ramnaw heh apap e lahoi a kârei awh han e naw doeh.
Bet kapap e teh ram bet kapap lah na poe awh vaiteh, kayoun e teh ram bet kayoun lah na poe awh han. Miphun lahoi râw teh a coe awh han.
Hatei cungpam rayu e lahoi ram teh rei lah ao han, a na mintoenaw hoi miphun min kâbang lahoi rem teh a coe awh han.
Cungpam rayu e lahoi apap hai ayoun hai a rei awh han.
Hetnaw heh Levihnaw e imthungkhu touk e lah ao. Gershon hoi Gershon imthungkhu, Kohath hoi Kohath imthungkhu, Merari hoi Merari imthungkhunaw doeh.
Hetnaw heh Levih imthungkhunaw doeh. Libni imthungkhu, Hebron imthungkhu, Mahli imthungkhu, Mushi imthungkhu, Korah imthungkhu lah ao. Kohath ni Amram a khe.
Amram e a yu min teh Jokhebed Levih canu, Izip ram hoi Levih koehoi ka tâcawt e doeh. Ahni ni Amram koehoi Aron hoi Mosi, hoi a tawncanu Miriam a khe.
Aron ni Nadab hoi Abihu, Eleazar hoi Ithamar a sak.
Hatei Nadab hoi Abihu teh BAWIPA hmalah hno hoeh kawi e hmai a hni dawk a due roi.
Ahnimae tami tongpa thapa yung touh lathueng touk e pueng teh, 23,000 touh a pha. Isarelnaw thung dawk kârei e ram ka coe hoeh hanlah ao dawkvah, Isarelnaw koe mektouksin e lah awm hoeh.
Hetnaw heh Jeriko namran, Jordan palang teng Moab tanghling dawk Isarel catounnaw touk nah Mosi hoi vaihma Eleazar ni touk e doeh.
Hatei, Sinai kahrawng e Isarelnaw Mosi hoi vaihma Aron ni a touk e naw hah tami buet touh hai awm hoeh toe.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, BAWIPA ni kahrawngum vah a due awh roeroe han ati toe. Jephunneh capa Kalep hoi Nun capa Joshua laipalah teh apihai kahring e awm hoeh toe.
Joseph capa Manasseh imthung, Makhir, ahnie capa Gilead, ahnie capa Hepher, ahnie capa Zelophehad e canu naw doeh. A canunaw e minnaw teh, Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah hoi Tirzah tinaw doeh.
Kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang koe Mosi hoi vaihma Eleazar hoi tamikalennaw kamkhuengnaw e hmalah a kangdue awh teh,
Kahrawngum vah maimae na pa a due teh, BAWIPA taranlahoi cusin hane tamihu, Korah tamihu koe bawk van hoeh. Hatei, ama yon e lahoi a due teh a capa hai tawn hoeh
Capa a tawn hoeh kecu dawkvah, bangkongmaw apa min teh miphun thung hoi a kahma han, mintoenaw thung dawkvah, ka ham kawi na poe van leih ati awh.
Hot patetlah Mosi ni hote lawk teh BAWIPA koe a pha sak.
BAWIPA ni Mosi hah a pato teh,
Zelophehad canunaw ni kathuem e a sak awh. A na pa hmaunawnghanaw rahak vah, a ham kawi na poe awh roeroe vaiteh, a na pa ham hah na poe awh han.
Isarel catounnaw koevah, tami buet touh ca tongpa tawn laipalah dout pawiteh, a râw teh a canunaw na poe han.
Hahoi a canu tawn hoehpawiteh, a râw teh a hmaunawngha na poe han.
Hmaunawngha tawn hoehpawiteh, a na pa e hmaunawngha na poe pouh han.
A na pa ni hmaunawngha tawn hoehpawiteh, a râw teh a huikonaw na poe vaiteh, ahnimouh ni a ham awh han. BAWIPA ni Mosi kâ a poe e patetlah Isarel canaw hanlah lawkcengnae phunglam lah ao han, telah dei pouh telah ati.
