BAWIPA ni Mosi koevah, Abarim mon dawkvah luen nateh, Isarel catounnaw ka poe hane ram hah radoung haw.
Hahoi na hmu toteh, na hmaunawngha Aron e a miphunnaw koevah, a ceikhai awh e patetlah nang hai na ceikhai awh han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Zin thingyei dawk taminaw pueng ni a phuenang awh navah, a mithmu vah tui dawk kai barilawa na poe nahanelah, kai ni kâ na poe e taranlahoi taran a thaw awh telah ati (hot teh Zin thingyei dawk Kadesh hoi Meribah tie lah a o).
Hahoi Mosi ni BAWIPA a pato teh,
moithangnaw pueng e hringnae kaukkung Cathut BAWIPA e taminaw hah kakhoumkung tawn laipalah tu patetlah ao hoeh nahanlah tamihu,
hmalah cei hoi ahnimouh tâcokhai hane hoi kâenkhai hane kahrawikung hah rawi seh, telah ati.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koevah, Nun capa hnotithainae ka tawn e Joshua hrawi nateh, ahni van na kut toung pouh.
Vaihma Eleazar hoi ka kamkhuengnaw hmalah kangdout sak nateh, ahnimae mithmu vah caksak.
Isarel catounnaw pueng ni a lawk a ngâi pouh thai nahan, na kâtawnnae a tangawn hah na poe han.
Ahni teh vaihma Eleazar hmalah a kangdue vaiteh, ama ni BAWIPA hmalah, Urim hno lahoi lawkkamnae a la vaiteh, ama kâ lahoi Isarel catounnaw pueng teh a tâco a kâen awh han, telah ati.
Mosi ni BAWIPA kâpoe e patetlah a sak, Joshua hah a hrawi teh, Eleazar hoi kamkhuengnaw hmalah a kangdue sak.
A lathueng vah kut a toung pouh teh, Mosi hno lahoi BAWIPA ni kâ a poe e patetlah kâtawnnae hah a poe.
BAWIPA ni Mosi a pato teh,
Isarel canaw hah kâ poe nateh, ahnimouh koe kai hanelah poe han e hmaisawi thuengnae hmuitui, kaie rawca lah kaawm e kâhruetcuetcalah hoi atueng kahmancalah na poe awh han ati tet pouh.
Ahnimouh koevah, hetheh hmaisawi thuengnae BAWIPA koe na poe hane doeh. Tutanca kum touh e, kacueme hnintangkuem kahni touh hmaisawi thuengnae pou a poe awh han.
Tuca buet touh teh amom lah na poe awh han. Alouke buet touh teh tangmin lah na poe awh han.
Tavai thueng nahane dawk a kanui e tavai, ephah pung hra pung touh, satui hin pung pali pung touh hoi kanawk e,
BAWIPA hanlah hmaisawi thuengnae hmuitui thuengnae hanlah, Sinai mon hoi pouk e hmaisawi thuengnae hah pou na poe awh han.
Tuca buet touh poenae, nei thuengnae teh pung pali pung touh han. BAWIPA hanlah misur nei thuengnae hah, hmuen kathoung koe na rabawk awh han.
Tuca kanaw buet touh teh, tangmin lah na poe awh han. Amom lah tavai thuengnae hoi hawvah, nei thuengnae patetlah BAWIPA koevah hmuitui hmaisawi thuengnae hah na poe awh han.
Hahoi sabbath hnin vah, tucatan kum touh e kacueme kahni touh hoi tavai thueng nahanelah tavaikanui ephah pung hra pung hni, satui hoi kanawk e, hawvah nei thuengnae hai na poe sin han.
Hetheh sabbath hni tangkuem vah, hmaisawi thuengnae pou na poe e, nei thuengnae touksin laipalah poe hanelah poe hane doeh.
Hahoi thapa katha tangkuem vah BAWIPA hanlah hmaisawi thuengnae na poe awh han. Maitotan kahni touh hoi tutan kum touh e, kacueme sari touh.
Maitotan tangkuem dawk tavai thueng nahanelah, tavaikanui satui hoi kanawk e ephah pung hra pung thum touh, hahoi tu buet touh dawk tavai thueng nahanelah tavaikanui satui hoi kanawk e ephah pung hra pung hni,
tuca kanaw e tangkuem tavai thueng nahanelah, tavaikanui satui hoi kanawk e, ephah pung hra pung touh, hetheh hmuitui thuengnae BAWIPA hanlah hmaisawi thuengnae doeh.
Hahoi nei thuengnae a poe awh e teh, maitotan buet touh dawk misur hin tangawn han. Tutan buet touh dawk teh, hin pung thum touh dawk pung touh. Hahoi tucanaw dawk teh, hin pung pali pung touh. Hetheh kum touh thung thapa tangkuem hmaisawi thuengnae lah ao.
BAWIPA koevah, yon thuengnae hmaetan buet touh hoi pou na poe awh e, hmaisawi thuengnae hoi nei thuengnae touksin laipalah na poe awh han.
Thapa yung pasauek, hlaipali hnin teh BAWIPA e ceitakhai pawi doeh.
Hote thapa hlaipanga hnin teh pawi hnin doeh. Hnin sari touh thung teh, tonphuenhoehe tavai hah na ca awh han.
Apasuek hnin vah, kathounge kamkhuengnae pawi na to awh han. Bang thaw hai na tawk awh mahoeh.
Hmaisawi thuengnae palei teh, BAWIPA koe na poe awh han. Maitotan kanaw e kahni touh hoi, tutan kanaw e kum touh e sari touh, kacueme han.
Tavaikanui satui hoi kanawk e tavai thuengnae hoi, maitotan buet touh dawk ephah pung hra pung thum, tutan buet touh dawk ephah pung hra pung hni touh.
Tuca kanaw e sari touh teh, tuca kanaw e buet touh dawk ephah pung hra pung touh han doeh.
Hahoi yontha nahanlah yon thuengnae hmaetan buet touh.
Hetnaw heh amom e poehno hmaisawi thuengnae pou poe e touk laipalah, na poe awh han.
Het patetlah BAWIPA han hmuitui hmaisawi poenae, ca hanlah hnintangkuem hnin sari touh thung na poe awh han. Hetheh pou poe e hmaisawi thuengnae hoi nei thuengnae touksin laipalah na poe awh han.
Asari hnin vah, kathounge kamkhuengnae na tawn vaiteh, bang thaw hai na tawk awh mahoeh.
Hahoi yat touh dawk e pawi, canga pasuek e pawi, BAWIPA hanlah hno katha tavai thuengnae hno poe hnin dawk hai, kathounge kamkhueng pawi na tawn awh han, bang thaw hai na tawk awh mahoeh.
BAWIPA hanlah hmuitui thuengnae na poe awh han. Maitotan kahni, tutan buet touh, tuca kanaw e a tan kum touh e sari touh.
Tavai thuengnae tavaikanui satui hoi kanawk e maitotan kanaw e buet touh, ephah pung hra touh dawk pung thum, tutan buet touh dawkvah, ephah pung hra pung hni.
Tuca kanaw e sari touh, tuca kanaw e buet touh tangkuem dawk, ephah pung hra pung touh .
Nangmouh yontha awh nahanlah hmaetan buet touh hah,
toun khoeroe kaawm hoeh e han. Pou poe e hmaisawi thuengnae hoi tavai thuengnae touksin laipalah, hotnaw teh nei thuengnae hoi na poe awh han.
Thapa yung sari, a hnin apasuek hnin vah, kathounge na kamkhueng awh vaiteh, thaw banghai na tawk awh mahoeh. Nangmouh hanlah mongka uengnae hnin lah ao han.
BAWIPA hmalah hmuitui thuengnae hah na poe awh han. Maitotanca buet touh, tu buet touh, tuca buet touh, kum touh ka phat e kacueme sari touh.
Tavai thuengnae dawk tavaikanui satui hoi kanawk e maitotan buet touh dawkvah, ephah pung hra pung thum.
Tutan buet touh ephah pung hra pung hni, tuca kanaw e sari touh, buet touh dawk buet touh dawk lengkaleng ephah pung hra pung touh.
Yontha nahanelah hmaetan buet touh hoi,
thaparei hnin hmaisawi thuengnae hoi hot hoi tavai thuengnae ouk a sak awh e, BAWIPA hanlah hmuitui hmaisawi thuengnae tawk sin laipalah na poe awh han.
Hahoi thapa yung sari, ahra hnin vah, kathounge kamkhueng pawi na tawn awh han. Rawca na hai vaiteh, bang thaw hai na tawk awh mahoeh.
BAWIPA koevah, hmuitui thuengnae hah na poe awh han. Maitotan kanaw e buet touh, tutan buet touh, tutan kanaw e a tan kum touh ka phat e sari touh, kacueme roeroe han.
Tavaithuengnae teh tavaikanui satui hoi kanawk e maitotan buet touh dawkvah, ephah pung hra pung thum touh, tu buet touh dawk pung hra pung hni touh hoi,
tu ca kanaw e sari touh thung vah, buet touh dawk teh ephah pung hra pung touh rip han.
Yon thuengnae hanlah hmaetan buet touh hoi yontha nahanelah yon thuengnae hoi hmaisawi thuengnae pou na poe awh e hah tavai thuengnae hoi nei thuengnae touksin laipalah, pou na poe awh han.
Thapa asari, hnin hlaipanga hnin vah kathounge kamkhuengnae na tawn awh han. Bang thaw hai na tawk awh mahoeh.
BAWIPA han hmuitui hmaisawi thuengnae na poe awh han. Maitotan kanaw e hlaikathum, tutan kahni, tuca kum touh e hlaipali, kacueme seng han.
Tavai thuengnae dawk maitotan hlaikathum, maitotan buet touh dawk tavaikanui e satui hoi kanawk e ephah pung hra pung thum, tutan kahni touh, tutan buet touh dawk ephah pung hra pung hni touh han.
tuca kanaw e hlaipali, tuca kanaw e buet touh dawk ephah pung hra pung touh han.
Yon thuengnae dawkvah, hmaetan buet touh hoi hmaisawi thuengnae pou na poe awh e, hote tavai thuengnae hoi nei thuengnae touksin laipalah, na poe awh han.
Hahoi apâhni hnin vah maitotan hlaikahni, tutan kahni, tuca kanaw e a tan kum touh ka phat e kacueme hlaipali touh na poe awh han.
Tavaithuengnae hoi nei thuengnae phung patetlah a younpap e patetlah maitotan thoseh, tutan thoseh, tuca thoseh,
yontha thuengnae hmaetan buet touh hoi hmaisawi thuengnae pou na poe awh e hah, tavaithuengnae hoi nei thuengnae touksin laipalah na poe awh han.
Hahoi apâthum hnin vah, maitotan hlaibun, tutan kahni, tutan kum touh e kacueme hlaipali,
tavai thuengnae hoi nei thuengnae hah aphung patetlah a younpap e lahoi maitotan han e thoseh, tutan hane thoseh, tuca kanaw hane thoseh,
yontha thueng nahanelah hmaetan buet touh hoi hmaisawi thuengnae dawk pou na poe awh e tavai thuengnae hoi nei thuengnae touksin laipalah na poe awh han.
Hahoi, apali hnin vah, maitotan kanaw e hra, tutan kahni, tuca kum touh ka phat e kacueme hlaipali,
tavai thuengnae hoi nei thuengnae phueng patetlah a younpap e lahoi maitotan thoseh, tutan, tuca kanaw e thoseh,
yontha thueng nahanelah hmaetan buet touh hmaisawi thuengnae dawk pou poe lah kaawm e tavaithuengnae hoi nei thuengnae touksin laipalah na poe awh han.
Hahoi, apanga hnin maitotan kanaw e tako, tutan kahni, tutanca kanaw e kum touh ka phat e kacueme hlaipali,
tavaithuengnae hoi nei thuengnae phueng patetlah a younpap e lahoi maitotan thoseh, tutan, tuca kanaw e thoseh,
yontha thueng nahanelah hmaetan buet touh hmaisawi thuengnae dawk pou poe lah kaawm e tavaithuengnae hoi nei thuengnae touksin laipalah na poe awh han.
Hahoi a taruk hnin vah maitotan taroe, tutan kahni, tutanca kanaw e kum touh ka phat e kacueme hlaipali,
tavai thuengnae hoi nei thuengnae phueng patetlah a younpap e lahoi maitotan thoseh, tutan, tuca kanaw e thoseh,
yontha thueng nahanelah hmaetan buet touh hmaisawi thuengnae dawk pou poe lah kaawm e tavaithuengnae hoi nei thuengnae touksin laipalah na poe awh han.
Hahoi asari hnin vah maitotan kanaw e sari, tutan kahni, tutanca kanaw e kum touh ka phat e kacueme hlaipali,
tavai thuengnae hoi nei thuengnae phueng patetlah a younpap e lahoi maitotan thoseh, tutan, tuca kanaw e thoseh,
yontha thueng nahanelah hmaetan buet touh hmaisawi thuengnae dawk pou poe lah kaawm e tavaithuengnae hoi nei thuengnae touksin laipalah na poe awh han.
Hahoi ataroe hnin vah ka sungrenpoung lah kamkhuengnae pawi na tawn awh han. Bang thaw hai na tawk awh mahoeh.
BAWIPA hanlah hmaisawi thuengnae na pou awh han. Maitotan kanaw e buet touh, tutan buet touh, tuca kanaw e kum touh ka pha e kacueme sari touh,
tavai thuengnae hoi nei thuengnae phueng patetlah a younpap e lahoi maitotan thoseh, tutan, tuca kanaw e thoseh, aphung patetlah a younpap lahoi,
yontha thueng nahanelah hmaetan buet touh, hmaisawi thuengnae dawk pou na poe awh e tavaithuengnae hoi nei thuengnae touksin laipalah,
lawk na kam awh e thoseh, nama ngai lahoi na poe awh e thoseh, tavaithuengnae hai thoseh, hmaisawi thuengnae thoseh, roum thuengnae thoseh, touksin laipalah, hetnaw heh atueng ka tawn e, pawi patetlah hoiyah BAWIPA koe na poe awh han tet pouh telah a ti.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe kâ a poe e naw pueng heh Mosi ni Isarel catounnaw koe a dei pouh.
Mosi ni Isarel catounnaw hanlah, a miphun kahrawikungnaw a pato teh, BAWIPA ni lawk a thui e patetlah a dei pouh.
Tongpa buet touh ni BAWIPA koe lawk kam pawiteh, thoebonae hoi mahoima thoekâbo nakunghai, akuep sak roeroe han, a lawk dei patetlah koung a sak roeroe han.
Napui teh a na pa im a naw lahun nah BAWIPA koe lawk a kam hai thoseh, thoe a kâbo laihoi a mahoima a kâkin hai thoseh,
a na pa ni a lawkkam thoseh, a lawkkin e thoseh, a panue hoi duem awm takhai pawiteh, a lawkkam thoseh, a lawkkin e thoseh a sak roeroe han.
Hatei, a na pa ni a panue nah hnin vah, pasoung hoehpawiteh, a lawkkam thoseh, a lawkkin e thoseh, a hlout thai han. A na pa ni koung a uk e a tho dawkvah, BAWIPA ni ahni teh a ngaithoum han.
Napui teh a vâ ao hai lawk kam pawiteh, amae lungthin dawk lawkkin hanelah a dei navah,
a vâ ni a panue hnin hoi roup awm takhai pawiteh, a lawkkam thoseh, a lawkkin e thoseh, a kuepsak roeroe han.
Hatei, a vâ ni a panue hnin vah pasoung hoehpawiteh, pouk laipalah lawk a kam e dawk hoi ahni teh a hlout vaiteh, BAWIPA ni a ngaithoum han.
Lahmai hoi ayâ ni amae naw teh a lawkkam thoseh, a lawkkin e thoseh, a kuepsak roeroe han.
A vâ im vah ao lahunnae lawkkam hoi lawkkin e teh,
a vâ ni a panue nakunghai roup awm takhai lah oun hoeh toung pawiteh, a lawkkin e teh a kuepsak roeroe han.
Hatei, a vâ ni a panue hnin vah, raphoe pouh lah, haw pouh pawiteh, a lawkkam hoi a lawkkin e teh bout a kâhno han.
Lawkkam hoi lawkkin e pueng teh a vâ ni hnâbo lahoi a raphoe thai.
Hatei, a vâ ni a thai teh roup awm takhai pawiteh, a lawkkam hoi a lawkkin e patetlah a kuepsak roeroe han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, a panue nah hnin hoi roup ao takhai dawkvah, a caksak toe tie lah ao han.
A thai tahma hoi raphoe hoi haw pawiteh, napui e thoesaknae teh ama ni a phu han.
Hetnaw heh tongpa hoi a yu rahak hane, na pa hoi a canu rahak, a naw nah a na pa im ao nah hane BAWIPA ni Mosi koe kâ a poe e lah ao.
BAWIPA ni Mosi a pato teh,
Isarel catounnaw hanlah Midian taminaw koevah, moipathung nateh, hahoi teh na miphunnaw koevah na ceikhai han telah a ti.
Hottelah Mosi ni taminaw pueng hah a dei pouh teh, Midian taminaw koevah, BAWIPA ni a moipathung hanelah puengcang kâmahrawk awh nateh, midiannaw tuk hanelah kamthaw naseh.
Isarel miphunnaw pueng thung dawk hoi miphun buet touh dawk hoi tarantuk hanlah tami 1,000 rip na patoun han telah a ti.
Hottelah Isarelnaw moikapap thung dawk hoi tarantuknae koe cei hanelah, miphun buet touh thung dawk hoi tami tong touh rip a tâ awh teh asumkum tami 12,000 touh a tâco sak awh.
Hottelah Mosi ni a miphun tangkuem hoiyah, 1,000 rip hoi vaihma Eleazar capa Phinehas ka thoung e hlaamnaw hoi kâhruetcuetnae mongka hah a sin awh teh, tarantuknae koe a ceisak awh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi kâ a poe e patetlah Midiannaw hah a tuk awh teh tongpa pueng a thei awh.
A thei awh e naw thung dawk Midiannaw e siangpahrang hai a bawk van. Midian siangpahrang panga, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur hoi Reba tinaw doeh. Beor capa Balaam hai tahloi hoi a thei awh.
Hahoi Isarel catounnaw ni Midian napuinaw hah san lah koung a hrawi awh. A saringhunaw pueng, a tuhunaw pueng, a hnopainaw pueng, hah lawphno lah koung a la pouh awh.
A onae khonaw pueng hoi a roenae naw pueng hmai koung a sawi pouh awh teh,
tami hoi saring, san hoi lawphnonaw pueng teh koung a ceikhai awh.
Hahoi san hoi man e naw pueng hoi lawphnonaw teh Mosi hoi vaihma Eleazar hoi Isarel catounnaw koevah, Jeriko namran Jordan palang teng Moab tanghling a roe awhnae koe a phakhai awh.
Hottelah, Mosi hoi vaihma Eleazar hoi taminaw pueng ni longkha koehoi a dawn awh.
Hatei, Mosi teh ransabawi 1,000 touh kahrawikung, 100 touh kahrawikung kacuenaw hoi tarantuknae koehoi kabannaw lathueng vah a lungkhuek.
Hottelah Mosi ni ahnimouh koe, napuinaw teh a hring lah na hlung awh na maw.
Khenhaw, Balaam khokhangnae kecu dawk Peor kong dawkvah, Isarel catounnaw ni BAWIPA taranlahoi kâtapoenae katâcawtsakkungnaw teh hete napuinaw doeh. BAWIPA e taminaw koe lacik a pha sak awh toe.
Hatdawkvah, camonaw thung dawk tongpanaw hah koung thet awh nateh, tongpanaw ni yo a ikhai e napuinaw hai thet awh.
Hatei, camohnawn e napuinaw tami ni a ikhai hoeh raenaw pueng teh, namamouh hanlah pâhlung awh.
Hahoi longkha koe hnin sari touh roe awh. Bang patetlae tami nakunghai tami ka thet e hoi tami ro kateknaw pueng teh, apâthum hnin hoi asari hnin teh namamouh hoi na sannaw hoi kamthoung awh.
Kamthoupnae pueng hoi, phaivuen hoi sak e hnonaw pueng kong dawk be na kamthoung awh han telah atipouh.
Hahoi, vaihma Eleazar ni hai tarantuknae koe ka cet e ransanaw hah a kaw teh, hethateh BAWIPA ni Mosi koevah kâ a poe e kâlawk doeh.
Sui, ngun, hoi rahum, hoi sum, samphei, hoi konlawk,
bangpatete hnonaw pueng haiyah, hmai ni a kak thai hoeh e pueng, hmai dawk pou ceisak vaiteh a thoung han. Bangpatet nakunghai yah pâsu hoi thoungthainae tui hoi pâsu vaiteh thoungsak hanlah ao. Hahoi hmai dawk phum han kahawihoehnaw pueng teh, khohna hoi tui dawk pekpâsu hanelah ao.
Hahoi asari hnin vah na hni na pâsu awh vaiteh, hahoi doeh roenae hmuen koe na kâen awh han.
BAWIPA ni Mosi a pato teh,
nang nama hoi vaihma Eleazar hoi tamihu kaukkung kahrawikungnaw hoi hnopai na lawp awh e tami hoi saring hah be touk awh.
Lawphno kahni touh lah kapek awh. Tarantuknae koe ka cet ni teh tarankatuknaw hane hoi tamimaya hanlah,
hahoi tarantuknae koe kacetnaw e a hma thung dawk hoi tami hoi, maito, hoi la, hoi tu, hoi kahring e pueng dawk hoi 500 touh dawk buet touh BAWIPA han a ham lah ta hanlah na kapek han.
Hotnaw teh lat awh nateh, BAWIPA hanlah kahek thuengnae vaihma Eleazar hah na poe awh han.
Isarelnaw ni a ham awh e a tangawn thung dawk hoi tami, maito, la, tu totouh moithang phun 50 touh dawk buet touh, na la vaiteh, BAWIPA e lukkareiim ka ring e Levihnaw hah na poe awh han, telah a ti.
Hottelah BAWIPA ni Mosi kâ a poe e patetlah Mosi hoi vaihma Eleazar ni a sak roi.
Ransanaw ni a man awh e lawphno touksin laipalah a la awh e teh, tu 675,000,
maito 72,000,
la 61,000,
napui tongpa ni a ikhai hoeh rae 32,000,
tarantuknae koe kacetnaw tangawn ni a ham awh e tu 337,500,
BAWIPA ham tu 675,
maito 36,000 touh a pha teh BAWIPA ham teh 72 touh.
La 30,500 touh a pha teh BAWIPA ham teh 61 touh.
Tami teh 16,000 touh a pha teh BAWIPA ham teh 32 touh a pha.
BAWIPA ni Mosi kâ a poe e patetlah ham, BAWIPA koe kahek thuengnae Mosi ni vaihma Eleazar a poe.
Mosi ni tarankatuknaw e a ham koung a poe. Isarelnaw e a ham teh,
tu 337,500,
maito 36,000,
la 30,500,
tami 16,000 a pha.
Isarelnaw ni a ham thung dawk hoi Mosi ni tami hoi saring 50 touh thung dawk hoi buetbuet touh pou a la teh, BAWIPA kâpoelawk patetlah BAWIPA lukkareiim kakhenyawnkung Levihnaw hah a poe awh.
Hahoi ransanaw thung dawk tami 100 kaukkungnaw, 1,000 kaukkungnaw ni Mosi koe a hnai awh teh,
Mosi koevah na sannaw niyah kaimae kut dawk kaawm tarankatuknaw hah ka touk awh teh kakuep hoeh e apihai kaawm awh hoeh.
Hatdawkvah, ka hring awh nahanlah BAWIPA hmalah yontha sak hanelah tamipueng ni lengkaleng a coe awh e sui hoi sak e, dingyin, laikaw, kuthrawt, hnongpacap, hnâpacap naw hah BAWIPA koe thueng hanelah ka thokhai awh toe telah atipouh.
Mosi hoi vaihma Eleazar ni, sui hoi sak e puengcangnaw hah a la pouh.
1,000 touh kahrawikung, 100 touh kahrawikungnaw ni BAWIPA hanelah kahek thuengnae lah a poe awh e suinaw pueng teh sekel 16,750 touh a pha.
Ransanaw ni a la awh e lawphnonaw teh amamouh hanlah lengkaleng a la awh.
Hahoi Mosi hoi vaihma Eleazar ni 1,000 kahrawikung, 100 kahrawikungnaw e sui teh a la pouh teh, Isarel catounnaw pahnim hoeh nahanlah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim dawk BAWIPA hmalah a tâcokhai awh.
Reuben hoi Gad miphunnaw ni saring moi a tawn awh teh, Jazer ram hoi Gilead ram a hmu awh toteh, a hmuen teh saring o nahan ahawipoung ati awh.
Hothateh, Gad, hoi Reuben catounnaw ni Mosi hoi Eleazar maya kahrawikungnaw hah a pato awh teh,
Isarelnaw hmalah, BAWIPA ni a ta e ram Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo hoi Beon teh,
saring pâ nahanlah kahawipoung e ram lah ao teh, na sannaw hai saring ka tawn awh.
Hatdawkvah na hnâ bawt pawiteh, hete ram heh coe hanlah na poe awh loe. Jordan namran hrumhram na takhangkhai awh hanh telah ati awh.
Mosi ni Gad hoi Reuben catounnaw koevah, na hmaunawnghanaw tarantuknae koe a cei vaiteh, nangmanaw teh hi vah sut na o awh han na maw.
Bangkongmaw, BAWIPA ni na poe awh e ram dawk kâen hanlah Isarel catounnaw ni na lungthin thung na kâhnawn awh.
Kadeshbarnea hoi ram tuet hanlah na patoun awh navah, hettelah na mintoenaw ni ati awh toe.
Eshkol ravo koe a pha awh navah, ram teh a hmu awh. BAWIPA ni na poe e ram kâen hoeh hanlah Isarelnaw a lungthin a kamlang sak awh.
Hote hno niyah, BAWIPA lung a kâan sak teh,
Izip ram hoi ka tâcawt e kum 20 lathueng pueng ni Abraham hoi Isak hoi Jakop tinaw koe thoekâbo hoi ka poe e ram teh, apinihai hmawt mahoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, kai hnukkâbang katang awh hoeh telah thoe a kâbo awh.
Keniz tami Jephunneh capa Kaleb hoi Nun capa Joshua teh BAWIPA hnuk a kâbang roi.
Isarelnaw koe BAWIPA a lung a kâan teh BAWIPA mithmu vah hno kahawihoehe kasaknaw e se pueng a kahma awh hoehroukrak kahrawngum vah kum 40 touh a kâva sak.
Khenhaw! Isarelnaw koe BAWIPA lungkhueknae takikathopoung e hah bout thapsin hanlah nangmouh sekatha tamikayonnaw ni mintoenaw yueng lah na kâsak awh.
Bangtelamaw ahni hnukkâbang laipalah na awm pawiteh hete kahrawngum vah bout na o sak awh vaiteh, hete tamimaya heh kahmasak han telah atipouh.
Hahoi rek a hnai awh teh, ahni koe awi hivah saringnaw hoi tuhunaw hanlah a im sak pouh vaiteh, canaw hanlah khothawng awh han,
hatei, kaimanaw teh, o awh nahane hmuen koe pha hoehroukrak, Isarel catounnaw hmalah cei hanelah puengcang coungkacoe kâmahrawk awh han, hete ram taminaw kecu dawk, canaw heh rapan ka tawn e kho dawk o sak awh han.
Isarel catounnaw ni a coe awh hane kawi hmuen be a coe hoehroukrak, ma im lah na ban awh mahoeh.
Bangtelamaw tetpawiteh, coe hane kawi teh, hi namran lah Jordan kanîtholah a tho dawkvah, Jordan namran hoi ahlawilae teh coekhai awh han telah ati.
Mosi ni hot patetlah na sak awh teh, tarantuk nah koevah, BAWIPA hmalah cei hanlah na kamthoup awh teh,
a hmalah a tarannaw a pâlei teh, BAWIPA hmalah ram na tâ awh hoehroukrak, nangmouh rahak puengcang kâmahrawk e naw pueng ni, BAWIPA hmalah Jordan be na raka awh pawiteh, a hnuk bout na kâbang awh vaiteh,
BAWIPA lathueng hoi Isarelnaw lathueng vah, yonpen lah na awm awh mahoeh. Hottelah ram te BAWIPA hmalah na coe awh han.
Hatei hottelah na sak awh hoehpawiteh, khenhaw!, BAWIPA koevah na yon e lah awm vaiteh, na yonnae na hmu awh roeroe han tie hah panuek awh.
Na camonaw hanlah khothawng awh nateh, na tunaw hanlah im sak pouh awh telah ati.
Hottelah Gad hoi Reuben catounnaw ni Mosi koevah, na sannaw ni mintoenaw e kâpoelawk patetlah ka sak han.
Ka yunaw hoi camonaw hoi tuhunaw hoi saringhunaw pueng teh, Gileadnaw e khoram dawk ao han.
Hatei, na sannaw tarantuk hanlah, puengcang hoi kâmahrawknaw pueng ni bawipa ni a dei pouh telah BAWIPA hmalah ka luen van awh han telah ati awh.
Mosi ni ahnimouh kong kecu dawk vaihma Eleazar hoi Nun capa Joshua hoi Isarel miphun imthung kahrawikungnaw hah kâ a poe.
Mosi ni ahnimouh koe Gad canaw hoi Reuben canaw tarantuknae puengcang kâmahrawk e pueng ni, BAWIPA hmalah Jordan tui a rakakhai han. Ram teh na la hnukkhu, Gilead ram teh a coe awh hanlah na poe awh han.
Hatei puengcang kâmahrawk hoi na cetkhai awh hoehpawiteh, Kanaan ram vah nangmouh koe a bawk van han telah ati.
Hahoi Gad canaw hoi Reuben canaw ni na sannaw koevah, BAWIPA ni a dei e patetlah ka sak han.
Puengcang kâmahrawk hoi BAWIPA hmalah, Kanaan ram takhang vaiteh kâen awh han. Hatei, coe awh hane ram teh, Jordan namran lah doeh pou coe awh ti telah a pathung awh.
Mosi ni Gad catounnaw hoi Reuben catounnaw hah Joseph capa Manasseh miphun tangawn teh, Amor siangpahrang Sihon uknaeram hoi Bashan siangpahrang, Og uknaeram kaawm e khonaw pueng hoi, a tengpam khotenaw pueng hoi koung a poe awh.
Gad catounnaw ni Dibon, Ataroth hoi Aroer,
Aroth-shonphan, Jazer hoi Jobehah,
Bethnimrah hoi Bethharan kho a thawng awh teh, rapan ka tawn e khopui hoi tu imnaw a sak awh.
Reuben catounnaw ni Heshbon, Elealeh hoi Kiriathaim,
Nebo, Baalmeon, Sibmah hah a thawng awh. Hote kho a thawng awh e hah min louk lah a phung awh
Manasseh capa Makhir catounnaw teh Gilead ram a cei awh teh a la awh. Amornaw haw kaawm pueng teh be a lawp awh.
Hatdawkvah, Mosi ni Gilead ram teh Manasseh capa Makhir koe a poe teh hawvah khosak awh.
Manasseh capa Jair ni a cei teh khotenaw hah a la dawkvah, hotnaw hah Jair telah a phung awh.
Nobah hai a cei teh, Kenath khotenaw a la teh, a min lah Nabah telah a phung awh.
Hetnaw heh Mosi hoi Aron ni hrawi e lahoi IZip ram hoi ahuhu lahoi a tâco awh teh, a ceinae doeh.
BAWIPA ni kâ poe e patetlah a tâco pasuek hoiyah, a ceinae naw hah Mosi ni koung a thut. Hetheh kahlawng cei a kamtawngnae koehoi pou a deinae doeh.
Thapa ayung pasuek, hnin hlaipanga hin vah Raameses hoi a tâco awh teh ceitakhai pawi hnin a tangtho amom vah Izipnaw e mithmu vah,
a caminnaw pueng BAWIPA ni a thei pouh e naw a pakawp awh lahun nah, Isarel catounnaw pueng lungtang lahoi a tâco awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, BAWIPA ni ahnimae cathut koehai lawk a ceng teh a rek pouh.
Hahoi teh Isarel catounnaw teh Raameses hoi a tâco awh teh, Sukkoth vah a roe awh.
Sukkoth hoi a tâco awh teh kahrawngum Etham vah a roe awh.
Etham hoi a tâco awh teh Baalzephon teng Pihahiroth lah a ban awh teh Migdol vah a roe awh.
Pihahiroth hoi a tâco awh teh talî tapoung hoi kahrawngum vah a kâen awh. Hahoi Etham kahrawng dawk hnin thum touh a cei awh teh, Marah vah a roe awh.
Marah hoi a cei awh teh, Elim lah a pha awh. Haw vah tuiphuek hlaikahni touh hoi ungkung 70 touh ao teh haw vah a roe awh.
Elim hoi a cei awh teh tuipui paling teng vah a roe awh.
Tuipui paling koehoi a cei awh teh Sin kahrawngum vah a roe awh.
Sin kahrawngum koehoi a cei awh teh, Dophkah vah a roe awh.
Dophkah koehoi a cei awh teh Alush vah a roe awh.
Alush koehoi a cei awh teh, Rephidim vah a roe awh. Hatei, hawvah tui nei hane awm hoeh.
Rephidim koehoi a cei awh teh, Sinai kahrawngum vah a roe awh.
Sinai kahrawngum koehoi a cei awh teh, Kiborthhattaavah vah a roe awh.
Kiborthhattaavah koehoi a cei awh teh, Hazeroth vah a roe awh.
Hazeroth koehoi a cei awh teh, Rithmah vah a roe awh.
Rithmah koehoi a cei awh teh Rimmonperez a roe awh.
Rimmonperez koehoi a cei awh teh Libnah vah a roe awh.
Libnah koehoi a cei awh teh Rissah vah a roe awh.
Rissah koehoi a cei awh teh Kehelathah vah a roe awh.
Kehelathah koehoi a cei awh teh Shepher mon vah a roe awh.
Shepher mon koehoi a cei awh teh Haradah vah a roe awh.
Haradah koehoi a cei awh teh Makheloth vah a roe awh.
Makheloth koehoi a kampuen awh teh Tahath vah a roe awh.
Tahath koehoi a cei awh teh Terah vah a roe awh.
Terah koehoi a cei awh teh Mithkah vah a roe awh.
Mithkah koehoi a cei awh teh Hashmonah vah a roe awh.
Hashmonah koehoi a cei awh teh Moserah vah a roe awh.
Moserah koehoi a cei awh teh Benejaakan vah a roe awh.
Benejaakan koehoi a cei awh teh Horhagidgad vah a roe awh.
Horhagidgad koehoi a cei awh teh Jobathah vah a roe awh.
Jobathah koehoi a kampuen awh teh Abronah vah a roe awh.
Abronah koehoi a kampuen awh teh Eziongeber vah a roe awh.
Eziongeber koehoi a cei awh teh Kadesh e Zin kahrawng vah a roe awh.
Kadesh koehoi a cei awh teh Edom ram poutnae Hor mon vah a roe awh.
Hor mon vah vaihma Aron hai BAWIPA e lawk patetlah a luen teh, Izip hoi Isarelnaw a tâco awh hoi kum 40, thapa yung panga apasuek hnin, hawvah a due.
Aron teh Hor mon dawk a due nah kum 120 touh a pha.
Hahoi Kanaannaw, Kanaan ram akalah kaawm e Arad siangpahrang ni Isarelnaw a tho awh e hah a thai.
Hor mon koehoi a kampuen awh teh Zalmonah vah a roe awh.
Zalmonah koehoi a kampuen awh teh Punon vah a roe awh.
Punon koehoi a kampuen awh teh Oboth vah a roe awh.
Oboth koehoi a kampuen awh teh Moab ramri Ijeabarim vah a roe awh.
Iyim koehoi a kampuen awh teh Gad Dibon vah a roe awh.
Gad Dibon koehoi a kampuen awh teh Almondiblathaim vah a roe awh.
Almondiblathaim koehoi a kampuen awh teh Nebo hma lae Abarim mon vah a roe awh.
Abarim mon koehoi a kampuen awh teh Jeriko tengpam Jordan palang teng Moab tanghling dawk a roe awh.
Jordan palang teng Bethjeshimoth koehoi Abelshittim totouh Moab tanghling dawk a roe awh.
Hahoi Jeriko tengpam Jordan palang teng Moab tanghling dawk BAWIPA ni Mosi hah a pato teh,
Isarel catounnaw hah pato nateh, ahnimouh koe Jordan tui na raka awh teh, Kanaan ram na kâen awh toteh,
hote ram dawk kaawmnaw pueng be na pâlei awh han. Ahnimae talung meikaphawknaw pueng be na raphoe pouh han, hmuenrasang hai be na raphoe pouh han.
Hahoi ram teh na coe awh vaiteh, hawvah kho na sak awh han, bangkongtetpawiteh, na coe hane ram teh na poe toe.
Hahoi a ma miphun lahoi cungpam na rayu awh vaiteh, ram teh na coe awh vaiteh, na kârei awh han, bet kapap e hah ram kakawhnawn na poe awh han. Kayoun e hah kabuenghnawn lah na poe awh han. Cungpam na rayu awh e patetlah kâvan lah na ham awh han. Na mintoenaw e phung patetlah na coe awh han.
Hatei, hote ram dawk kaawmnaw hah na pâlei awh hoeh e naw teh, na mit dawk mittanuen hoi na tak dawk pâkhing kaawm vaiteh, na onae ram dawk runae na poe awh han.
Hothloilah, ahnimouh koe sak han ka noe e hah namamouh koe letlang ka sak han tet pouh telah a ti.
BAWIPA ni Mosi hah a pato teh,
Isarelnaw hah lawkthui nateh, hetheh Kanaan ram na pha awh toteh nangmouh ni na pang awh hane Kanaan ramri doeh atipouh.
Akalah nangmae khori teh, Zin kahrawngum hoi Edom ram yunglam han, akalae khori teh palawi talî apoutnae koehoi Kanîtholae han.
Hahoi nangmae ramri teh, Akrabbim takhangnae a rahim hoi a lawngven vaiteh, Zin pou a rakan vaiteh, Kadeshbarnea a rahim totouh han, hahoi Hazaraddar lah cet vaiteh, Azmon vah pou a cei tâphai han.
Hote ramri teh Azmon Izip palang totouh lawngven vaiteh, tuipuipaling koe a pout han.
Kanîloumlah, tuipui hah khori lah na coe awh han, hetheh kanîloumlae na ramri lah ao han.
Hahoi hetheh atunglae na khori lah ao han, tuipui koehoi Hor mon pâum lahoi na sak han.
Hor mon koehoi Hamath kâennae koe totouh na sak awh han, haw hoi khori a tâconae teh Zedad koe han.
Khori teh, Ziphron pou tapoung vaiteh, Hazarenan vah a pout han, hetheh atunglae na ramri lah ao han.
Hahoi Kanîtholae na khori teh, Hazarenan hoi Shepham totouh na sak awh han.
Na khori teh Shepham hoi Riblah hoi Ain kanîtholah pou a cathuk vaiteh, haw hoi paloupalou cathuk vaiteh, Khinnereth kanîtho talîpui rai koelah a pha han.
Khori teh Jordan lah cathuk vaiteh, palawi talî koe apout han, hetheh na khori lah ao tet pouh telah a ti.
Hahoi teh, Mosi ni Isarelnaw hah kâ a poe teh, hetheh BAWIPA ni miphun tako touh hoi a tangawn poe hanelah, cungpam rayu hoi na coe awh hane ram doeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Reuben miphun catounnaw ni a imthung lahoi, Gad miphun catounnaw ni a imthung lahoi, Manasseh miphun tangawn ni a imthung lahoi a coe awh hane teh be a coe awh toe.
Hete miphun kahni touh hoi tangawn ni a coe awh hane teh, kanîtholah Jeriko tengpam, Jordan palang kanîtholah a coe awh toe telah a ti.
BAWIPA ni Mosi a pato teh,
hetnaw heh na coe awh hane ram nangmouh rahak vah kareikung min teh vaihma Eleazar hoi Nun capa Joshua doeh.
Hahoi na coe awh hane ram kareikung lah miphun tangkuem dawk hoi khobawi buet touh rip na rawi awh han ati pouh.
A minnaw teh hetnaw hah doeh. Judah catoun dawk hoi Jephunneh capa Kaleb,
Simeoncanaw dawk hoi Ammihud capa Samuel,
Benjaminnaw dawk hoi Khislon capa Elidad,
Dan canaw dawk hoi khobawi Jogli capa Bukki,
Joseph capa Manasseh canaw dawk hoi Ephod capa khobawi Hanniel,
Ephraimcanaw e catoun dawk hoi Shiphtan capa khobawi Kemuel,
Zebuluncanaw dawk hoi Parnach capa khobawi Elizaphan,
Issakharnaw dawk hoi Azzan capa khobawi Azzan,
Asher canaw dawk hoi Shelomi capa khobawi Ahihud,
Naphtalinaw dawk hoi Ammihud capa khobawi Pedahel, han atipouh.
Hetnaw heh Kanaan ram e Isarel catounnaw ram coe hane kareikung lah BAWIPA ni a poe e naw doeh.
Hahoi Jeriko teng Jordan palang teng vah Moab tanghling dawk BAWIPA ni Mosi hah a pato.
Isarel canaw hah kâpoe leih. A ram thung dawk Levihnaw o nahanlah kho poe awh naseh. Saring a pâ nahanlah kho tengpam hah Levihnaw na poe awh han.
Kho a saknae kho tawn awh vaiteh, a tengpam pueng teh a maito hoi saringnaw a paca awh e a pâ nahanlah awm naseh.
Kho tengpam Levihnaw na poe awh hane teh, kho rapan petkâkalup lah dong 1000 touh akaw han.
Hahoi tumdumnae alawilah hoi na bangnue awh vaiteh, kanîtholah dong 2000, akalah dong 2000, kanîloumlah dong 2000, atunglah dong 2000, alungui kho ao han. Hetnaw heh a ham awh e khopuinaw rapan alawilah han.
Levihnaw na poe awh hane khonaw thung dawkvah, tamikathetnaw a yawng nahane taruk touh na rawi awh han. Hothloilah kho 42 touh na thapsin han.
Levihnaw na poe hane khonaw pueng teh, a ram hoi kho 48 touh a pha han.
Isarelnaw khosak nahan na poe e teh, kapap hah kapap na poe vaiteh, kayoun hah kayoun na poe han. Tami pueng ni a coe awh e ram apap e patetlah Levihnaw kho na poe awh han.
BAWIPA ni Mosi hah a pato teh,
Isarel canaw hah pato nateh, ahnimouh koe Jordan na raka awh teh, Kanaan ram na kâen toteh,
pouk laipalah tamikathet payon e teh a yawng vaiteh a kângue nahane kho na pouk pouh han.
Tamimaya hmalah lawkceng hanlah a kangdue hoehnahlan, tamikathet payon e teh, ama a due hoeh nahanelah, hote khonaw teh moipathungkung ni a tawng navah a kângue awh nahanelah ao han.
Hottelah, nangmouh hanlah kângue nahane kho na pouk awh hane teh kho 6 touh a pha han.
Jordan namran lah kho kathum touh na pouk awh vaiteh, Kanaan ram lah kho kathum touh na pouk awh han. Kânguenae kho lah ao han.
Isarel catounnaw hoi ahnimouh koe kaawm e imyinnaw hanlah kho 6 touh hah kânguenae kho lah ao han. Awi hawvah, tamikathet payonnaw ni a yawng awh han.
Hatei, sum hoi tami hem boilah dout pawiteh, tamikathet e lah ao dawkvah, tamikathet e teh ama hai roup thei roeroe han.
Hahoi talung hoi tami kadout lah dei pawiteh, ayâ ka thet e lah ao dawkvah, ayâ ka thet e teh ama hai thei roeroe han.
Hahoi tami ni thing hoi tami kadout lah hem pawiteh, ayâ ka thet e lah ao dawkvah, ayâ ka thet e teh ama hai thei roeroe han.
Thiphu moipathungkung ni tami ka thet e teh tang a thei thai han. A hmu boum teh a thei han.
Hahoi tami a hmuhma kecu dawk puenghoi dei tanawt nakunghai thoseh, sut pawp laihoi kadout lah a dêi nakunghai thoseh,
kâoun hoi kut hoi thaw lah koe dout pawiteh, kathetkung hah thei van hane roeroe lah ao. Bangkongtetpawiteh, tamikathetkung doeh. Thipaling moipathungkung ni a hmu nah tangkuem koe a thei han.
Hatei, kâoun kâtai dawk laipalah, a tanawt payon dawk nakunghai thoseh, lam hoi a pawp dawk tho laipalah, tami awm hoeh ti hoi a panue hoehnahlan vah, taran lah hai kaawm hoeh e,
pataw nahan poe hanlah hai kâcai hoeh eiteh, talung hoi koe dêi lah dout payon pawiteh,
tamimaya ni hete lawkcengnae kâlawk patetlah kathetkung hoi thipaling moipathungkung hanlah lawk a ceng awh han.
Hahoi tamimaya ni tamikathetkung hah thipaling moipathungkung koehoi a la ring awh vaiteh, tamimaya ni a yawng nahane kânguenae kho dawk ao sak awh han. Satui kathoung hoi awi e vaihma kacue ka tawk lahun e a due hoehroukrak haw vah ao han.
Hatei, bangpatet e tueng pueng dawk hai tami ka thet e teh, a yawngnae kânguenae kho, khori hloilah cet pawiteh,
thipaling moipathungkung ni kânguenae kho hloilah hmawt boilah thet pawiteh, thipaling dawk yonpennae awm mahoeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, vaihma kacue a due hoehroukrak, kânguenae kho dawk pou o hanlah ao. Vaihma a due hnukkhu, hote tami ka thet e teh ama onae kho dawk a ban han.
Hatei, hnonaw pueng hah na catounnaw totouh na o awh nah tangkuem koe lawkceng e lah ao han.
Tami bangpatet ni nakunghai tami thet pawiteh, tamikathetkung teh kapanuekkhaikung e pahni dawk lawk a tâco sak e lawk lahoi thei lah ao han. Hatei, kapanuekkhaikung buet touh dueng e a pahni dawk e lawk pawiteh, thei khai nahanelah khout hoeh.
Tami kathetkung teh na ratang awh mahoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, due han kamcu totouh yonpen e lah ao toung dawkvah, na thei awh roeroe han.
Kânguenae kho dawk ka yawng e tami teh, hatnae tueng dawk vaihma kacue ka tawk e a due hoehroukrak a onae khoruem dawk bout ban thai nahan, ratang thai mahoeh.
Hatdawkvah, na onae ram na khin sak mahoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, thipaling ni ram hah a khin sak teh, ram a dam nahanlah, thipalawngkung e thipaling hoi dueng doeh yontha thai lah ao.
Hatdawkvah, a lungui e khosaknae na coe awh e ram teh, na khinsak awh mahoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, kai Jehovah teh Isarel catounnaw koe ka o tet pouh telah ati.
Joseph imthung dawk hoi Manasseh capa Makhir capa Gilead catoun imthung kahrawikungnaw hmalah lawk a dei awh.
Ahnimouh ni, BAWIPA ni Isarel catounnaw hah cungpam rayu hoi a coe awh hane ram poe hanlah, ka bawipa Mosi hah kâ a poe teh, hmaunawngha Zelophehad canunaw a coe hane râw hah BAWIPA ni ka bawipa koe kâ a poe toe.
Hatei, ahnimouh ni Isarel catoun thung dawk hoi miphun alouke capa koe vâ sak pawiteh, na mintoenaw e ram a coe awh e hah la pouh vaiteh, a vâ koelae ram miphun koe lah a kâthap han. Hottelah coe tangcoung e ram dawk hoi tâcokhai han.
Hahoi Isarel catounnaw e Jubili a pha toteh, a ram hah a vanaw e miphunnaw ni coe e ram lah thapsin lah ao han. Hottelah mintoenaw e miphun ram thung dawk hoi let na lawp pouh awh han telah ati.
Hatdawkvah, Mosi ni BAWIPA lawk patetlah Isarel catounnaw hah kâ a poe teh, Joseph capa hoi miphunnaw ni a dei e a thuem.
Zelophehad canunaw kong dawkvah BAWIPA ni kâ a poe e teh hettelah doeh. Ahawi ati e pueng vâ naseh, hatei a napanaw e miphun hah vâ awh naseh telah ati.
Hatdawkvah, Isarel catounnaw e ram teh, miphun alouklouk koe voutsout puen laipalah, Isarel catounnaw ni a na mintoenaw e ram teh pou a ham awh han.
Isarel catounnaw thung dawk râw ka pang hane canunaw pueng teh, Isarel catounnaw ni a na mintoenaw e ram lah kaawm e pou a ham thai nahan, a na pa miphun thung e a yu a la hanlah ao.
Ram teh miphun alouklouk koe puen thai mahoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Isarel catounnaw ni amamae ram hah pou a pang awh e lah kaawm han telah a dei.
Hottelah, BAWIPA ni Mosi kâ a poe e patetlah Zelophehad canunaw ni a sak awh van.
Zelophehad canunaw Mahlah, Tirzah hoi Hoglah, Milkah hoi Noah tinaw ni a na pa e hmaunawnghanaw e capanaw hah a vâ awh.
Joseph capa Manasseh e capa hah a vâ awh teh, a ram teh a na pa miphunnaw ni a coe e râw lah pou a kangning.
Hetnaw heh Jeriko tengpam Jordan namran Moab tanghling dawkvah, BAWIPA ni Mosi hno lahoi Isarelnaw koevah, kâ a poe e kâpoelawknaw hoi lawkcengnaenaw doeh.
Kahrawngum, Jordan palang teng, Shuph khopui, Paran khopui, Tophel khopui, Hazeroth, Dizahab khopuinaw koevah, Mosi ni Isarelnaw koe bout a dei e lawk teh:
Kadeshbarnea hateh, Seir mon lam lahoi Horeb e a onae hoi hnin 11 lamcei ahla.
Mosi ni Heshbon khopui kaawm e, Amor Siangpahrang Sihon thoseh, Edrei ram, Ashtaroth khopui kaawm e Bashan siangpahrang Og thoseh, a thei hnukkhu
Kum 40 thapa yung 11 apasuek hnin dawk Moab ram
Jordan palang teng vah, Cathut ni lawk a poe tangcoung e patetlah Isarelnaw koe bout a dei e kâlawk hateh,
Maimae BAWIPA Cathut ni, Horeb hmuen dawk, na dei pouh e teh, nangmouh ni atueng a kuep ditouh hete mon dawk na o awh toe.
Kamlang awh nateh bout kamthaw awh haw. Amor mon totouh thoseh, hote mon hoi kahnai e hmuen tanghling, akalah, tuipui teng, Kanaan ram, Lebanon mon, Euphrates tuipui totouh cet awh haw.
Hote ram teh nangmouh hmalah ka hruek toe. Cathut ni, nangmae na pa Abraham, Isak, Jakop koehoi kamtawng teh a catounnaw ka poe han telah lawk a kam e ram hah kâen nateh coe awh, telah atipouh.
Hatnavah, Kai ni nangmouh koe ka dei e thaw heh ka madueng ka phawt thai mahoeh.
Nangmae BAWIPA Cathut ni nangmouh na pung sak awh vaiteh, nangmouh teh kalvan âsi patetlah sahnin na o awh.
Nangmae na pa BAWIPA Cathut ni nangmouh teh alet 1000 lahoi na pung sak naseh. Lawk a kam e patetlah yawhawi na poe a seh.
Na tawntamnae, thawtawknae, kâyuekâounnae hnokari kai ka madueng ni bangtelamaw ka phu thai han.
A lungkaangnaw, ka thaipanueknaw, hoi ka thoumthainaw hah na miphun thung hoi rawi awh. Ahnimanaw hah ka hrawikung lah ka hruek han telah dei awh pawteh,
nangmouh ni, na dei e patetlah ahawi telah bout a dei awh.
Hatdawkvah na miphunnaw dawk mitkhet kamcu e kacuenaw panuenae ka tawn naw ka rawi hnukkhu nangmouh koe kacue thaw ka tawk hanelah 1,000 ka uk hane, 100 ka uk hane, 50 ka uk hane, 10 ka uk hane ukkungnaw hah ka rawi.
Lawkcengkungnaw hai, na hmaunawnghanaw e kamcan hah a thai awh vaiteh, hmaunawngha reira e kamcan thoseh, Jentelnaw hoi e kamcan thoseh kalancalah lawkceng awh.
Lawkcengnae dawkvah, apie minhmai hai khen hanh. Camo e lawk hah kacue e lawk patetlah pouk. Apihai taket hanh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, lawkcengnae teh Cathut e doeh. Na dei thai hoeh e kamcan hah kai koe thokhai awh. Kai ni hai ka thai han telah lawk a thui.
Nangmouh ni na sak awh hane naw hai hatnavah kâ na poe toe.
Kaimouh ni Horeb hmuen koehoi ka tâco awh teh, Amor mon totouh ceinae lam teng vah, takikathopounge kahrawngum ka cei awh teh Kadeshbarnea hmuen koe ka pha awh.
BAWIPA ni kâ na poe e patetlah hatnavah kai nihai, maimae BAWIPA Cathut ni na poe awh e Amor mon vah nangmouh ni na pha awh toe.
Nangmae BAWIPA Cathut ni ram kahawi teh nangmouh hmalah ka hruek toe. Nangmae napanaw e BAWIPA ni a dei e patetlah cet awh nateh lawm awh, taket awh hanh, na lung hai pout awh hanh telah a dei.
Hatnavah nangmanaw pueng ni kai koe na tho awh teh, kaimae hmalah taminaw ka patoun han. Ahnimouh ni hote ram hah a rip awh hnukkhu, kaimouh teh nâ lam cet pawiteh, bang khopui dawk pha awh han doeh telah a dei awh han telah a dei awh e heh,
kai ni ka ngai dawkvah miphun buet touh dawk tami buet touh, asumkum 12 touh hah na rawi awh.
Ahnimouh ni mon koe lah a kamlang awh teh Eshkol tanghling koe a pha awh teh a tuet awh.
Hote ram dawk e a paw a hrawm awh teh a thokhai navah, maimae Cathut ni na poe e ram teh kahawi e ram doeh telah a dei awh eiteh,
Nangmouh ni na cet awh laipalah, namamae BAWIPA Cathut e kâ na ek awh.
Cathut ni maimouh na hmuhma teh raphoe sak han na ngai awh dawkvah, Amornaw e kut dawk na poe hanlah, Izip ram hoi na tâcokhai awh khe.
Maimouh ni bangtelamaw cei awh han toung, hmaunawnghanaw ni hote kho dawk e taminaw teh maimouh hlak a len awh. A rasang poung awh. Kalvan ka deng e khopui, rapan hai ao. Hote kho dawk Anakim miphunnaw ka hmu awh telah maimae lungthin a raphoe toe telah nangmouh ni rimnaw dawk na taran awh toe.
Hatnavah kai ni, puen hanh awh, ahnimouh taket a hanh awh.
Nangmae hmalah ka cet e nangmae Cathut ni na hmalae Izip ram hai thoseh,
nangmouh ni na dawn e lam, hete hmuen totouh a na pa ni a ca a tapam e patetlah nangmae Cathut ni nangmouh na tapam teh, lungmanae na coenae kahrawng hai thoseh, nangmouh han a sak e patetlah nangmouh koe lah taran na kabawp awh han telah a dei nakunghai,
nangmouh ni rim tumpup nahan hmuen tawng awh nateh na cei awh nahan lam na patue hanelah karum vah hmai dawk thoseh, khodai lah tâmai dawk thoseh,
nangmae hmalah ka cet e Cathut e lawk hah hote kong dawk nangmouh ni na yuem awm hoeh toe.
Nangmae lawk Cathut ni a thai nah a lungkhuek teh,
ahnimae mintoenaw ka poe han ka tie ka lawkkam ram kahawi hah Jephunneh capa Kalep hloilah hete kathoute Miphunnaw buet touh ni boehai kâen awh mahoeh.
Ahni teh Cathut e hnuk roup a kâbang dawk a kâen. A coungroe e ram hah ahni koehoi kamtawng teh ahnie catounnaw ka poe han telah lawk ka kam .
Ahnimouh han Cathut ni, kai koehai a lungkhuek, nang teh hote ram na coe mahoeh.
Na kut rahim e Nun capa Joshua ni a coe han. Ahni teh Isarelnaw râw ka coe sak hanelah ao dawk. Ahni hah thapoe haw.
Taran ni a lawp e lah ao han na ti awh e camonaw, hatnavah thoe hoi hawi kapek thai hoeh rae canu capanaw ni, hote ram a coe awh vaiteh, kai ni ka poe e patetlah a lawp awh han.
Nangmouh teh na kamlang awh vaiteh tuipuipaling lam lahoi kahrawng lah bout cet awh ei telah a ti.
Nangmouh ni hai, kaimouh ni Cathut hah koe ka payon awh toe. Maimae Cathut ni lawk na thui awh e patetlah atu cei awh vaiteh taran tuk han telah na dei pouh teh, tami pueng puengcang rip a patuep awh teh, mon lah takhang hanelah coungkacoe ao awh.
Cathut ni hai tuk awh hanh, nangmouh koe lah kai kaawm hoeh, na tuk awh pawiteh taran hmalah na sung awh han telah kai ni ka dei e patetlah,
kai ni ka dei nakunghai nangmouh ni na tarawi awh hoeh. Cathut e kâ eknae hoi mon lah na luen awh.
Hatnavah mon dawkvah la kaawm e Amor miphunnaw ni nangmouh koe lah a tâco teh, khoi ni a rongyawn e patetlah nangmouh na kayo awh teh Seir hoi Hormah khopui totouh na thei awh.
Nangmouh hai bout na tho awh teh, Cathut hmalah na khui na ka awh. Hatei nangmae na lawk hah Cathut ni thai hoeh.
Hatdawkvah Kadesh hmuen dawk yampa na o awh e patetlah moi ka saw lah na o awh.
Cathut ni kai koe bout a dei e patetlah kaimouh ni kamlang awh vaiteh, Tuipui paling kahrawng lahoi ka cei teh Seir mon hah moi ka saw lah ka lawngven awh.
Cathut nihai, nangmouh ni atueng akuep nahan hete mon hah na lawngven awh toe.
Atunglah bout cet awh ei.
Nang ni tami pueng koe na dei pouh hane teh, na hmau Esaw miphunnaw a onae Seir ram teng vah, nangmouh na cei awh toteh ahnimouh ni a taki awh han. Hatdawkvah kâhruetcuet awh.
Rek saueng hanh awh. Ahnimae ram hah, kai ni nangmouh na poe hoeh. Na coungroenae khok hmuen tittouh hai na poe hoeh. Seir mon hateh Esaw yo ka poe toe.
Nangmouh ni na canei nahane bu hoi tui hai thoseh, ahnimouh koe tangka hoi na ran awh han.
Nangmouh ni na tawksaknae pueng dawk, nangmae Cathut ni yawhawinae a poe toe. Hete kahrawngpui dawk nangmouh na lawngven awh e a kongnaw a panue. A kum 40 touh thung nangmae BAWIPA Cathut ni nangmouh hoi cungtalah ao nah, banghai nangmouh dawk panki hoeh telah ati.
Seir ram kaawm e maimae hmau Esaw miphun koe cei awh teh, Elath khopui Eziongeber khopui hoi ka cet e lam tâphai koe ka dawn awh teh, haw hoi bout kamlang awh teh Moab kahrawng lam lahoi ka cei awh.
BAWIPA Cathut nihai, Moab khocanaw rucat poe awh hanh, tuk awh hanh, ahnimae ram kai ni na poe awh hoeh. Arab ram teh Lot miphunnaw kai ni yo ka poe toe telah ti pouh.
Ayan vah Anakim miphun patetlah ka rasang kalen e Em miphunnaw teh hote ram dawk ao awh.
Ahnimouh teh, Anakim miphunnaw patetlah ao e lah a pouk awh. Hatnavah Moab ram khocanaw ni ahnimanaw teh EM telah a kaw awh.
Ayan vah Hor taminaw teh Seir ram vah ao awh. Ahnimouh hah Esaw miphunnaw ni a thei awh teh, ahnimouh onae hmuen dawk ao awh. Hot patetlah Cathut ni a poe e ram hah Isarel miphunnaw ni ati awh.
Atu cet awh nateh Zered tui rakat awh haw telah a dei e patetlah Ahnimouh ni Zered tui a raka awh.
Kadeshbarnea hmuen koe ahmaloe phanae tueng koehoi ka tâco awh teh Zered tui rakanae tueng totouh kum 38 touh a ro. Cathut ni lawk a kam e patetlah ahmaloe e taran ka tuk thai e ransanaw pueng teh taminaw thungup hoi a due awh.
Ahnimouh raphoe hoeh roukrak, Cathut ni ahnimouh koehoi pâmit hanelah a kut a dâw.
Taran ka tuk thai e pueng tamihu thung e koung a pâmit sak hnukkhu,
Cathut ni nang teh Moab ram,
Ar ram a lungui vah sahnin na cei han.
Ammon miphunnaw teng na pha torei teh ahnimouh rucatnae poe awh hanh, reksaueng awh hanh. Ammon miphunnaw a onae ram hah kai ni nangmouh koe na poe hoeh. Hote ram teh Lot miphunnaw kai ni ka poe toe telah kai koe a dei.
Hote ram hai kalenpounge taminaw e hmuen doeh telah taminaw ni a pouk awh. Ayan e tueng dawk, hot patetlae taminaw ni ao awh. Ahnimouh hah Ammon ram khocanaw ni Zamzummim telah a kaw awh.
Hote miphun teh Anakim miphunnaw patetlah kalenpoung kapap poung e taminaw doeh.

Hot patetlah Hazrim khopui koehoi Gaza khopui totouh ouk kaawm e naw Avvimnaw hai Kaptor khopui ka tâcawt e Kaptor taminaw ni a raphoe awh teh, ahnimanaw a onae hmuen dawk ao awh.
Nangmouh na thaw awh vaiteh cet awh haw, Arnon tuipui raka awh haw. Amor miphun, Heshbon siangpahrang Sihon hoi a talai hah nangmae kut dawk ka poe toung dawkvah, khosak awh nateh hote bawi hah tuk awh.
Tâmai rahim kaawm e pueng, miphunnaw ni sahnin nangmouh tâsue taki laihoi ao nahan ka sak han. Nangmae kamthang a thai awh vaiteh, puennae, pâyawnae, runae puenghoi a kâhmo awh han telah ati.
Kai hai Kedemoth kahrawng hoi Heshbon siangpahrang Sihon koevah patounenaw ka patoun vaiteh,
Aram lungui vah na cetsak haw, na lam dawk dueng ka dawn han. Avoilah aranglah ka phen mahoeh.
Seir ram kaawm e Esaw miphun, Ar ram dawk kaawm e Moab miphunnaw ni kai dawk a sak awh e patetlah ka ca hane rawca thoseh, nei hane tui hai thoseh, tangka hoi yawt lawih.
Kai teh Cathut ni na poe e ram lah Jordan palang ka raka vaiteh ka pha hoehroukrak Seir ram lungui dawk khok hoi ka cet haw nei telah kâhuikonae lawk hoi ka dei nakunghai,
Kaimouh ka cei nahane Heshbon siangpahrang Sihon ni kâ na poe hoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, sahnin kamnue e patetlah nangmae Cathut ni hote siangpahrang nangmae kut dawk na poe hanelah, lung a tha o sak, lungpatanae lungthin a poe.
Cathut ni hai Sihon siangpahrang hoi a talai hah na poe han. Hote talai hah râw lah na pang hanelah lat lawih telah a dei.
Hatnavah, Sihon siangpahrang teh amae tami puenghoi Jahaz vah maimanaw na tuk hanelah a tâco.
Maimae Cathut ni hote siangpahrang hah maimouh koe na poe teh, ama hoi a canaw hoi tami pueng ka thei awh.

Arnon tuipui teng kaawm e Aroer khopui hoi Gilead khopui totouh, tuipui teng kaawm e pueng khopuinaw thung, ka tâ thai hoeh e buet touh hai khopui awm hoeh. Maimae Cathut ni a cawngca pueng maimouh dawk na poe.
Hatnavah Ammon miphunnaw a onae talai, Jabbok tuipui hoi talai, mon dawk e khopui hoi maimae Cathut ni na cakâ pouh e bang buet touh hai ka hnai awh hoeh.
Hatnavah kaimouh kamlang awh teh Bashan lam lah ka cei awh. Bashan siangpahrang Og hai a taminaw hoi Edrei vah kaimouh na tuk hanlah a tho awh.
BAWIPA Cathut ni ahni hah taket awh hanh. Ama hoi a taminaw hai thoseh, a talai hai thoseh, nangmae kut dawk na poe awh han. Heshbon khopui dawk kaawm e Amor siangpahrang Sihon koe na sak e patetlah hete Siangpahrang koehai na sak han telah kai koe a dei.
Hottelah maimae BAWIPA Cathut ni Bashan Siangpahrang Og hoi a taminaw pueng hah maimae kut dawk na poe vaiteh, buet touh hai hlout laipalah, ka thei awh.
Hatnavah kaimouh ni khopui 60, Argob ram, Bashan ram, Og siangpahrang e uknaeram, khopui buet touh boehai hlung laipalah ka tuk awh.
Hote khopuinaw teh, ka rasang poung e rapan, longkhanaw hoi kacakpounge khopui lah ao. Alouk lae kho moikapap hai ka la awh, ka tuk awh teh koung ka raphoe awh.
Heshbon siangpahrang Sihon koe ka sak awh e patetlah napui camo pueng koung ka thei awh.
Saringnaw hoi kho thung e hnopainaw teh kamamouh hanlah ka la awh.
Hatnavah Arnon palangpui hoi kamtawng teh, Hermon mon totouh, Jordan palang namran lah kaawm e Amor siangpahrang roi e kut dawk e Arnon yawn koehoi Hermon mon totouh e ram hah kaimouh ni ka la pouh awh.
Hermon mon hah Sidonnaw ni Sirion telah thoseh, Amornaw ni Senir telah thoseh a kaw awh.
Tanghling dawk e khopuinaw puenghoi Gilead uknaeram pueng Og siangpahrang Og khopui, Edrei khopui totouh, Bashan ram puengpa ka la pouh awh.
Kalenpounge miphun koehoi ka tho e Bashan siangpahrang Og ama duengdoeh ka hlout. Ayung dong 9, adangka dong 4 touh e sumikhun teh, Ammon ram Rabbah khopui vah ao nahoehmaw.
Hatnavah kaimouh ni la pouh e talai hah Arnon palang teng kaawm e Aroer khopui hoi kamtawng teh, Gilead mon a tangawn totouh khopuinaw hoi Reuben miphun hoi Gad miphunnaw ka poe toe.
Gilead mon a tangawn hoi Og siangpahrang ni a uknaeram kalenpounge hmuen telah kaw e Argob ram, Bashan ram pueng teh Manasseh miphunnaw atangawn ka poe toe.
Manasseh miphun Jair ni Argob ram pueng Geshur kho Maakath kho totouh a la pouh hnukkhu, Sahnin totouh amamae a min a ceisak e lahoi Havvoth- Jair ram telah a kaw awh.
Gilead khopui teh Makhir miphunnaw ka poe toe.
Reuben miphun, Gad miphunnaw teh, Gilead khopui hoi Arnon palangpui, alungui totouh Arnon ram khori Arabah palang pui totouh hai thoseh.
Jordan palang teng Kinnereth hoi Sodom talî e kanîtholah kaawm e Arabah Pisgah khopui totouh e hai thoseh ka poe toe.
Hatnavah, kai ni, nangmae BAWIPA Cathut ni hete ram heh namamouh han roup na poe toe.
Hatnavah tarankahawi e pueng ni puengcang a kâmahrawk awh teh, na hmaunawngha Isarel miphunnaw e a hmalah a cei awh han.
Cathut ni nangmouh karoumcalah na o sak awh van e patetlah hmaunawnghanaw ka poe hoeh roukrak thoseh, Jordan palang namran e nangmae BAWIPA Cathut ni na poe e talai ahnimouh ni a la hoehnahlan totouh thoseh. Na yu na canaw, saringnaw ni hai kai ni na poe e khopuinaw dawk ao awh han. Nama koe saring moi ao e kai ni ka panue. Thaw ka cum torei kai ni na la poe e patetlah nangmouh pueng teh lengkaleng na coe han kamcu e talai koe lah bout na ban awh han telah nangmouh kai ni lawk na thui awh.
Hatnavah Joshua hai, na BAWIPA ni hete siangpahrang kahni touh dawk a sak e hno pueng hah nang ni khei na hmu toe. Hot patetlah BAWIPA ni na phanae kho ramnaw dawk a sak han.
Nangmae Cathut ni nanfmouh koe lah kampangkhai dawkvah, ahnimanaw hah taket awh hanh.
Hatnavah Cathut koe ka kâhei e teh,
Oe Bawipa Jehovah, na san kai koe lentoe e hai thoseh, thaonae kut hai thoseh, sak na kamtawng toe. Nang e thaonae na kamnue sak e patetlah kalvan hoi talai dawk bang patet e cathut ni maw a sak thai han.
Kai teh Jordan palang namran lah ka raka teh, kahawipoung e ram hoi Lebanon mon koehoi kamtawng teh kahawi e monnaw na hmawt sak haw telah ka kâhei nakunghai,
Cathut ni nangmouh kecu dawk kai koe a lungkhuek dawkvah, ka lawk hah na thai pouh hoeh. Cathut ni hai a khout toe. Hete hno hoi kâseng e lawk hah bout na dei pouh hanh lawih.
Pisgah mon som dawkvah luen nateh, kanîtho, kanîloum, atung, aka lah kangvawi nateh ram hah khenhaw! Jordan tui rakat hanh.
Joshua hah lawk thui nateh, thapoe nateh ka bawm haw. Ahni ni hete miphun hmalah a cei vaiteh, na hmu e ram hah râw lah na pang sak han telah a ti.
Hottelah kaimouh teh Bethpeor namran lah kaawm e tanghling dawk ka o awh.
Oe Isarelnaw nangmouh ni na hring awh teh, mintoenaw ni a bawk e BAWIPA Cathut ni na poe e ram na coe thai awh nahan, na sak awh hane kai ni na cangkhai e phunglawknaw hoi lawkcengnaenaw thai awh haw.
Kai ni kâ na poe e lawknaw dawk, bout na thap awh mahoeh. Na rayu awh mahoeh, nangmae BAWIPA Cathut e kâpoelawknaw hah na tarawi awh han.
Cathut ni Baalpeor kecu a sak e hah nangmouh ni na mit hoi na hmu awh toe. Baalpeor kângue pueng nangmae BAWIPA Cathut ni nangmouh thung hoi be a raphoe toe.
Nangmae BAWIPA Cathut dawk kângue e pueng teh, sahnin ditouh na hring awh.
Nangmouh ni na cei awh vaiteh na coe hane ram dawk na sak awh hane kaie BAWIPA Cathut ni kâ na poe e patetlah, kai ni phunglawknaw hoi lawkcengnaenaw na cangkhai awh toe.
Hatdawkvah, hotnaw hah tarawi awh. Hottelah na sak pawiteh, phunglawk ka thai e tami pueng e hmalah nangmae lungangnae hoi panuenae a kamnue han. Ahnimouh ni hete miphunpui teh, lungangnae hoi panuenae hoi ka kawi e miphun katang doeh telah ati awh han.
Maimouh ni ratoum na pueng koe maimae BAWIPA Cathut ni na khet na yawt teh, na pahrennae coe e patetlah alouke cathut ni pahren e miphun apimouh kaawm boi.
Kai ni sahnin nangmouh koe ka ta e kâlawk patetlah, phunglawk hoi kalan lah lawkcengnae ka tawn e miphun kalen, apimouh kaawm.
Nangmouh ni Horeb mon van na Cathut hmalah, na kangdue awh navah na mit hoi na hmu awh e naw hah pahnim payon avai. Na hringyung thung na pâkuem thai awh nahan, namamouh kâhruetcuet awh. Kâyawm lahoi tarawi awh. Hotnaw hah na catounnaw hai cangkhai awh.
Hatnavah BAWIPA ni, taminaw kai koe kamkhueng sak haw. Ahnimouh ni talai van a hring na thung kai na taki thai awh nahan a catounnaw a cangkhai sak nahanelah ka lawk hah na thaisak han telah kai koe a dei e patetlah,
Nangmouh ni rek na tho awh teh mon khok koe na kamkhueng awh. Hatnavah, monsom hmai a kak teh kalvan lungui teh duktamang, tâmai hoi akawi teh duk a kamthim.
BAWIPA Cathut ni hmai thung hoi na pato, nangmouh ni a mei na hmawt laipalah lawk duengdoeh na thai awh.
Nangmouh ni na tarawi awh hane kâpoelawk 10 touh hah a dei teh, lungphen 2 touh dawk a thut.
Nangmouh ni na cei awh teh na coe awh hane ram dawk na sak awh hane nangmouh koe na cangkhai e phunglawknaw hoi lawkcengnaenaw hai Cathut ni kai koe kâ na poe.
Horeb vah Cathut ni, hmai thung hoi nangmouh koe lawk a dei navah bang e meilam hai na hmu awh hoeh dawkvah,
Nangmouh ni tami napui tongpa mei
Talai van kaawm e saring mei, kalvan kamleng e tava mei,
Talai dawk vonpui hoi kâva e saring mei, talai thung tui dawk e tanga mei, hoi kâvan e kutsak hah, nangmouh ni bout na kamlang sin awh teh, namamouh han na sak hoeh nahanelah,
Kalvan lah na khet teh, Kanî, Thapa, Âsinaw tie kalvan e hno pueng na hmu navah, nangmae BAWIPA Cathut ni, kalvan rahim kaawm e tami pueng koe a poe e hote hnonaw hah, na bawk awh nahane alouke taminaw ni na pasawt thai awh hoeh nahanelah, namahoima kâhruetcuet awh.
Nangmouh teh sahnin e patetlah BAWIPA Cathut e râw ka coe e miphun lah na o sak nahan, nangmouh teh Izip ram sum thawngnae takhuen koehoi na tâcokhai awh toe.
Hot dueng laipalah, nangmouh kecu dawk, kai koe Cathut a lungkhuek, Jordan tui namran lah rakat laipalah, na coe awh hane Cathut ni na poe e ram thung vah kâen hoeh nahanelah lawk a kam toe.
Hatdawkvah, hete ram dawk ka due han toe. Jordan tui ka rakat mahoeh nangmouh ni na raka awh vaiteh hote kahawipoung e ram na coe awh han.
Nangmae BAWIPA Cathut ni nangmouh koe na ta pouh e lawkkam na pahnim awh teh, nangmae BAWIPA Cathut ni a cakâ e kutsak na sak awh hoeh nahan, namahoima kâhruetcuet awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, nangmae BAWIPA Cathut teh ka kang e hmai, dipma Cathut doeh.
Nangmouh ni na mincanaw na sak awh teh, hote ram dawk moikasawlah na o awh hnukkhu, koung na rawk awh teh buetbuet touh e mei hoi kâlat lah kutsak na sak awh teh, nangmae BAWIPA Cathut a lung hoe na khuek sak awh pawiteh,
Jordan tui na raka awh teh na coe awh hane ram thung vah, a ro hoehnahlan na kahma awh han. Moikasawlah kho na sak awh laipalah, khoeroe na kahmakata awh han telah nangmae kong dawk na ka panuek khai e lah sahnin kalvan hoi talai ka palaw.
Cathut ni hai nangmouh teh Jentelnaw koe alouklouk lah na kâkapek sak vaiteh, hrek lah kaawm e Jentelnaw koe youn touh na cawi awh han.
Hote hmuen dawk, tami kut hoi sak e, hmawt thai hoeh, thai thai hoeh, cat thai hoeh, a hmui ka thai thai hoeh e thing cathut, talung cathutnaw hah nangmouh ni na bawk awh han.
Hateiteh, hote hmuen dawk nangmae BAWIPA Cathut hah bout tawng han na ngai awh toteh, lungthin abuemlahoi na tawng awh pawiteh na hmu awh han.
Nangmouh ni hmalae tueng dawk, rucatnae na khang awh toteh, hete hnonaw puenghoi na kâhmo awh navah, nangmae BAWIPA Cathut koe lah bout na ban awh teh, lawk na tarawi awh pawiteh,
nangmae Cathut teh pahrennae ka tawn e lah ao dawkvah, nangmanaw na pahnawt awh mahoeh, na raphoe awh mahoeh, lawk a kam e pahnim mahoeh.
Cathut ni talai dawk tami sak kamtawng hoi nangmouh na o hoehnahlan kaloum tangcoung e atueng dawk e hnonaw pueng hah, kalvan apoutnae koehoi avanglah apoutnae koe totouh pacei awh. Hettelah e kalenpounge hno kaawm boi na ou. Het patetlah e hno kamthang thai boi awh na ou.
Cathut ni hmai thung hoi a dei e lawk nangmouh ni na thai awh e patetlah alouke miphun ni a thai teh hloutnae a coe awh boi na ou.
Nangmae BAWIPA Cathut ni, Izip ram nangmae hmalah a sak e patetlah mitnout panuenae hoi, kângairu hnonaw a saknae, kâtuknae a phasaknae, thaonae kut dâwnae, taki ka tho e vision a sak e lahoi, alouke cathut ni a cei teh, miphun buet touh koehoi buet touh ama hanelah ouk a la boi ou.
BAWIPA Cathut lah a onae hai thoseh, BAWIPA hoeh laipalah teh alouke cathut a ohoehnae hai thoseh, nangmouh na panue sak hanelah, hotnaw hah nangmouh koe a kamnue sak.
Nangmouh na cangkhai awh teh, kalvan hoi lawk na thaisak toe. Talai van vah kalenpounge hmai hai na hmu sak teh, hmai thung hoi lawk hah na thai awh toe.
Nangmae mintoenaw ka pahren dawkvah, a catoun hah ka rawi toe.
Nangmouh hlak a tha a sai awh vaiteh, kapap poung e miphunnaw nangmae hmalah hoi ka pâlei teh, sahnin e boiboe lah, a ram dawk a phakhai vaiteh, râw coe sak hanelah, hnotithainae lahoi, Izip ram lahoi na hmalah a hrawi toe.
Hatdawkvah, BAWIPA Cathut teh lathueng lae kalvan hoi rahim lae talai van hai thoseh, Cathut lah ao teh, alouke cathut awm hoeh tie hah, sahnin panuek awh, na lung thung pâkuem awh.
Nangmouh hoi na catounnaw ni khosak ahawi nahan, nangmae BAWIPA Cathut ni na poe e ram dawk, hringsaw nahan thoseh, sahnin kai ni lawk na thui awh e kâpoelawknaw hah, na tarawi awh han telah Mosi ni a dei.

a yawng vaiteh, a hring hlout nahanelah Jordan palang kanîtholah khopui 3 touh Mosi ni a ta pouh.

Bashan siangpahrang Og tie Jordan tui namran lah kanîtholah, kaawm e Amon siangpahrang 2 touh a thei teh,

Mosi ni Isarelnaw a pâkhueng teh, Isarelnaw thai awh haw, na kamtu awh e kâhruetcuet lahoi na hringkhai thai awh nahan, sahnin ka dei e phunglawk hah kahawicalah thai awh haw.
Maimae BAWIPA Cathut ni Horeb mon dawk maimouh hoi, lawk a kam awh toe.
Hote lawkkam hah Cathut ni maimae mintoenaw hoi dueng a sak e tho hoeh, sahnin kahring rah niteh, hi kaawm e maimouh puenghoi hai sak e lah ao.
BAWIPA ni mon dawkvah hmai thung hoi, minhmai kadangka lah a dei toe.
Hatnavah nangmouh ni hmai na taki awh teh, mon dawk na luen ngam awh hoeh dawkvah, kai teh BAWIPA Cathut e lawk na poe e hah dei hanelah BAWIPA hoi nangmae rahak ka kangdue.
A dei e lawk hateh, nangmouh san lah na onae Izip ram hoi na ka tâcawtkhai e nangmae BAWIPA Cathut doeh.
Kai hloilah Cathut alouke na bawk mahoeh.
Kalvan hai thoseh, talai dawk hai thoseh, talai thung tui thung hai thoseh, kaawm e hoi kâvan e meikaphawk banghai namamouh han lah na sak awh mahoeh.
A hmalah tabo laihoi bawk hanh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, nangmae Cathut, Kai teh dipmasin Cathut, kai na kamaithoenaw e catoun, se thum se pali totouh a napanaw e yon hah a canaw dawk ka pathung e Cathut,
Kai hah lungpataw niteh, kaie kâpoelawk ka tarawi e a catounnaw koe a thongsang totouh pahrennae kamnuek sak e Cathut lah ka o.
Na BAWIPA Cathut e min hah laithoe koe lah na deirumram mahoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, a min laithoe lah dei e yon a tawn telah BAWIPA ni a panue.
Na BAWIPA Cathut ni lawk na thui e patetlah Sabbath hnin thoungsak hanelah ya awh.
Hnin taruk touh thung thaw na tawk han.
A hnin sari hnin teh BAWIPA Cathut e Sabbath hnin doeh, hote hnin dawk nama hoi na canaw, san napui, san tongpa, maito, la, na saring pueng, na imyin hai thaw tawk mahoeh. Longkha thung duem na o e patetlah san napui san tongpanaw ni duem ao awh han.
Nang teh Izip ram san lah na onae thoseh, na BAWIPA Cathut ni a thaonae kut a dâw teh, hote ram hoi nang na tâcokhai e pouk haw. Hote a kong dawk nang ni Sabbath hnin na ya han telah BAWIPA Cathut ni a dei.
BAWIPA Cathut ni na poe e ram dawkvah, na hring a saw teh na yawhawi nahanelah, BAWIPA Cathut ni lawk na thui e patetlah na manu hoi na pa barilawa.

Na imri e a yu lungraduek hanh. Na imri e im, law, a san napui, a san tongpa, la, maito, hoi hnopai pueng buet touh boehai noenae lungthin tawn hanh telah a ti.
Hete lawknaw heh mon dawk hoi, hmai tâmai duk kamthim e kahmot e a thung hoi BAWIPA ni puenghoi kacaipounge lawk hoi nangmouh kamkhueng e rangpuinaw koe a dei. Rek bout dei hoeh toe. Hote lawknaw haiyah lungphen kahni touh dawk a thut teh kai koe na poe.
Nangmouh ni hmo na thung e lawk na thai awh teh, Monsom hmai a kak lahun nah, nangmae catounnaw dawk e khobawinaw hoi kacuenaw kai koe a tho awh teh,
maimae BAWIPA Cathut ni a bawilennae hoi a lentoenae maimouh koe a kamnue sak toe. Hmai thung hoi lawk hah maimouh ni thai awh toe. Cathut teh tami hoi a kâhmo teh a kâpato eiteh, tami teh a hring rah tie panue awh toe.
Maimouh teh bangkongmaw atu due awh han vaw. Hete taki ka tho poung hmai ni maimouh teh na kak awh han toe. Maimae BAWIPA Cathut e lawk dei e hah bout thai awh pawiteh, due awh han doeh toe.
Ka hring Cathut ni hmai thung hoi a dei e lawk hah, maimouh ni thai awh e patetlah, apipatet e tami ni maw ka thai ni teh ka hring vaw.
Nang ni a tengpam cet nateh maimae BAWIPA Cathut ni a dei e pueng thai awh haw. Maimae BAWIPA Cathut ni kai koe na dei pouh e pueng patuen dei pouh haw. Kaimouh ni ka thai awh vaiteh ka tarawi awh han.
Hottelah nangmouh ni kai koe na dei awh e lawk BAWIPA ni a thai. BAWIPA Cathut nihai, hete miphun ni nang koe a dei e lawk ka thai, a dei e lawk pueng teh ahawi.
Ahnimouh hoi a catounnaw ni ahawinae a hmu nahanelah, kai na taki awh teh kâpoelawknaw pueng hah pou a tarawi ngainae lungthin hoi kawi awh naseh.

Hatdawkvah maimae BAWIPA Cathut ni kâ na poe e patetlah nangmouh ni na sak awh nahan, na kâhruetcuet awh han. Avoilah nakunghai, aranglah nakunghai na phen takhai awh mahoeh.

Kai ni na poe e naw, pueng hah hringyung thung na tarawi thai e hoi, na hringyung a vang sak thai nahan na cei awh vaiteh, na coe hane ram dawk, na sak awh hane kai ni na cangkhai hanlah, nangmae Cathut ni lawk na poe e kâpoelawknaw, phunglawknaw hoi lawkcengnaenaw hateh,
Oe Isarel miphun, mintoenaw e Cathut e lawkkam patetlah nang ni sanu tui, khoitui a lawngnae ram dawk na yawhawi awh teh, na pungdaw awh nahan thai awh, kâhruetcuet lahoi tarawi awh.
Oe Isarel miphun thai awh haw, maimae BAWIPA Cathut teh buet touh dueng e BAWIPA la doeh ao.
Nange BAWIPA Cathut hah, na lungthin abuemlah, na hringnae abuemlah hoi thaonae abuemlahoi lungpataw haw.
Sahnin kai ni na poe e lawk hah na lung dawk na pâkuem han.
Hote lawk hah panki lahoi na canaw na cangkhai han. Im dawk tahung nahai thoseh, cei nahai thoseh, i nahai thoseh, thaw nahai thoseh, hote lawk hah na dei pouh awh han.
Hote lawk hai na kut dawk mitnout nahanelah thoseh, na mit rahak hai thoseh na bet han.
Im takhang, khopui longkha dawk hai na thut han.
Na kangdue sak hoeh e khopuinaw hai thoseh, hnokahawi hoi kakawi e imnaw hai thoseh,

San lah na onae Izip ram lahoi nangmouh na ka tâcawtkhai e BAWIPA Cathut na pahnim awh hoeh nahan, namamouh kâhruetcuet awh.
Na BAWIPA Cathut hah na taki awh han. Hote Cathut dueng na bawk awh han. A min lahoi thoe hai na kâbo awh hanh.
Alouke Cathut, na tengpam e miphunnaw e cathut hnuk na kâbang awh mahoeh.
Nangmae Cathut teh nangmouh dawk dipma Cathut doeh. Nangmae BAWIPA Cathut teh nangmouh koe a lungkhuek vaiteh, talai van hoi na raphoe han tie taki hane ao.
Nangmouh ni Massah hmuen dawk na tanouk e patetlah na BAWIPA Cathut hah tanouk awh hanh.
BAWIPA Cathut ni na hruek pouh awh e kapanuekkhaikung, lawkkam, kâpoelawknaw hah panki lahoi na tarawi awh han.
Nang na hlout nahanelah,
BAWIPA Cathut e a lawkkam patetlah tarannaw pueng, nangmae hmalah hoi ka pâlei vaiteh, nangmae na mintoenaw koe ka kam e ram hah na coe awh vaiteh, na o sak nahan, BAWIPA Cathut hmalah kalan e hno sak awh.
Hmalae tueng dawk na canaw ni, kaimae Cathut ni na poe e lawkpanuesaknae, phunglawknaw hoi lawkcengnaenaw hah bangmaw a deingai telah na pacei awh pawiteh,
Nang ni kaimanaw Izip ram dawk Faro siangpahrang e san lah ka o awh nah BAWIPA e a thaonae kut hoi kaimanaw hah Izip ram hoi na tâcokhai awh.

Mintoenaw koe a kam e ram dawk na kâenkhai teh hmuen na poe hanelah hote ram dawk hoi na tâcokhai awh.
BAWIPA ni sahnin totouh na lungma e patetlah hringnae na hlung pouh nahanelah, maimouh hawi nahanlah hete phunglawknaw pueng tarawi han. BAWIPA Cathut taki hanelah lawk na thui awh.
Hatdawkvah, maimae BAWIPA ni kâ na poe e patetlah, hete kâpoelawknaw pueng a hmalah tarawi nahanelah, na kâhruetcuet pawiteh, lannae koe na pha awh han telah, bout na dei awh han.
Nange BAWIPA Cathut ni na coe awh hane ram dawk na kâenkhai awh vaiteh, Hit, Girgashite tami, Amor tami, Kanaan tami, Parizzite tami, Hiv tami, Jubusitnaw nangmouh hlak kalen ka rasang e miphun 7 touh hah a pâlei teh,
nangmae kut dawk bout na poe awh navah, na thei awh vaiteh capingkacailah na raphoe awh han, ahnimouh hoi lawkkamnae na sak awh mahoeh, na lungma awh mahoeh.
Ahnimouh hoi yuvâ lah na awm awh mahoeh, na canu hoi na capa, a capa hoi na canu na kâyuva sak mahoeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, ahnimouh ni na ca hah kai koe thokhai laipalah, alouke cathut bawk hanelah a pasawt awh han. Hatnavah BAWIPA lungkhueknae hoi nangmouh tang na raphoe avai.
Hatdawkvah, ahnimouh dawk bangtelamaw ka sak han, ahnimae thuengnae pueng ka raphoe han, kutsak pueng ka raphoe han. Asherahkungnaw ka tâtueng han. Thuk e meeikaphawk pueng hmai ka pau pouh han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, nang teh BAWIPA Cathut hanelah kathounge miphun doeh. Talai van kaawm e miphun hlak nange BAWIPA Cathut ni coe kamcu e miphun lah o sak nahan nang teh na rawi toe.
Nang teh alouke miphun hlak hoe na pap dawkvah, BAWIPA Cathut ni na lungpatawnae dawk na rawi e tho hoeh, nang teh Jentelnaw hlak hoe na youn.
BAWIPA Cathut ni nang na lungma dawk thoseh, na mintoenaw koe lawkkam ka raphoe han ka ngai hoeh dawk thoseh, san lah na onae Izip ram ka uk e Faro siangpahrang kut dawk hoi thaonae kut hoi nangmouh na tâcokhai awh toe.
Hatdawkvah, nangmae BAWIPA Cathut teh Cathut katang, yuemkamcu e Cathut, Bawipa ka lungpataw ni teh phunglawk katarawinaw e se a thongsang totouh lawkkam acak teh pahrennae kamnuek e Cathut,
BAWIPA kamaithoenaw raphoe hanelah, amamouh hmalah yon pathung e Cathut tie hah panuek awh. BAWIPA kamaithoenaw minhmai khen laipalah, amamae hmaitung yon moi a pathung han.
Hatdawkvah, sahnin na poe e phunglawknaw hoi kâpoelawknaw hoi lawkcengnaenaw hah na tarawi awh han.
Hote lawkcengnaenaw nang ni na tarawi hanelah, lawk na ngâi pawiteh, na BAWIPA Cathut ni na mintoenaw hanlah lawk a kam e lawkkam hoi lungmanae hah nangmae lathueng a kangning sak han.
Ahni ni nang hah na lungpataw vaiteh, yawhawinae na poe han, na pungdaw sak han. Na poe hane na mintoenaw koe lawkkam e ram dawk, na khe e na canaw hai thoseh, nange talai, a pawhik, cang, misurtui, satui, maito a pungdaw, tuhunaw hai thoseh yawhawi ka poe han.
Nang teh miphun pueng hlak yawhawinae hoe ka coe e lah na o vaiteh, nang dawk ka ting e tongpa napui buet touh hai awm mahoeh. Saringnaw dawk ka ting e tongpa napui buet touh hai awm mahoeh.
Cathut nihai, patawpanat pueng nang koehoi ka takhoe vaiteh, na panue e Izip ram e pataw kathoutnaw nang dawk ka phat sak mahoeh. Nang ka maithoe e naw koe ka pha sak han.
Nange BAWIPA Cathut ni nang dawk na poe e miphun pueng a raphoe han. Na mit ni ahnimanaw na pahren mahoeh. Ahnimae cathut na bawk mahoeh. Na bawk pawiteh, na kamthui na rawp nahanelah ao han.
Na lung thung hoi hete miphunnaw heh maimouh hlak hoe apaphnawn, bangtelamaw pâlei thai awh han na tet awh pawiteh,
ahnimouh taket hanh, BAWIPA Cathut ni Faro hoi Izip tami pueng koe a sak e hah pahnim hanh awh,
Tanouknae kalenpoung na mit hoi na hmu e naw hai thoseh, na BAWIPA Cathut ni na tâcokhai navah na patue e mitnoutnaw hai thoseh, thaonae kut a dâw e hai thoseh, kheikhei na pouk awh han. Hot patetvanlah, nang ni na taki e miphunnaw koe nange BAWIPA Cathut ni a sak han.
Hothloilah, ka cawi rah niteh, kâhrawknaw a due hoehroukrak nangmae BAWIPA Cathut ni, khoingannaw ahnimouh koe a patoun han.
Ahnimouh kecu dawk na lungpuen awh hanh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, takikathopounge nangmae BAWIPA Cathut teh nangmouh koe ao.
Nangmae BAWIPA Cathut ni hote miphunnaw teh paiyai lahoi nangmouh koehoi na pâlei pouh han. Kahrawng e sarangnaw nangmouh koe lah pung langvaih tie puen han ao teh, ahnimouh tang pâlei kawi nahoeh.
Hatnavah Cathut ni ahnimouh nangmouh koe na poe vaiteh, koung a rawk totouh kalenpounge rawknae ka pha sak han.
Ahnimae Siangpahrangnaw hai nangmae kut dawk na poe vaiteh, ahnimae min taluenae kalvan rahim vah raphoe han. Ahnimouh ka raphoe hoehroukrak nangmae hmalah apihai kang dout thai e awm mahoeh.
A sak e meikaphawknaw pueng hmai pau pouh han. Kutsak dawk kaawm e sui ngun na noe mahoeh, na lat mahoeh, na lat pawiteh yon lah ao hane ngaihri kawi ao. Nangmae BAWIPA Cathut ni a panuet.
Panuet kawi na im dawk thokhai hanh, na thokhai pawiteh, nang teh hot patetlah thoebo han kawi lah doeh na o tie taki ao. Hot patet e hno hah nang ni khoeroe na panuet han, thoebo kawi e hno doeh.
Nang teh na hring vaiteh na pungdaw nahan BAWIPA Cathut ni na mintoenaw koe kam pouh e ram dawk na cei vaiteh, na coe nahanelah, sahnin kai ni lawk na poe e kâpoelawk pueng na tarawi nahanlah na kâhruetcuet han.
Nange BAWIPA Cathut ni kâpoelawk tarawi ngainae lung na tawn hoi tawn hoeh e na tanouk awh teh, ka loum tangcoung kum 40 touh thung kahrawngum vah na hrawinae naw hah na pahnim awh mahoeh.
Hottelah na lungthin rahnoum awh teh, kahaikahlam lah na o sak navah, na panue e nahoeh, na mintoenaw ni panue boihoeh e manna hoi na kawk awh teh, tami teh vaiyei hoi dueng hring hoeh, BAWIPA e lawk lahoi doeh hring tie a panue sak.
Kum 40 touh thung hnicu hai pawn hoeh na khok hai phing hoeh.
A na pa ni a ca a toun e patetlah na BAWIPA Cathut ni na toun tie na lung hoi na pouk han.
Hatdawkvah, a lamthung na dawn teh BAWIPA taki lahoi kâpoelawknaw na tarawi han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, na BAWIPA Cathut ni kahawi e ram, tanghling, mon dawk hoi ka phuek e tuipui, sokca, tuihnu, tuiim hoi ka kawi e ram,
catun, barli, misurkung, thaibunglungkungnaw, talekung, hoi ka kawi e ram, olive satui, khoitui hoi ka kawi e ram,
voutnae awm laipalah, ka boum lah canae ram, sumtalung hoi a kawi teh, mon dawk hoi rahum tainae ram koe nangmouh hah na hrawi awh.
Kahawi poung e ram na poe awh dawkvah, kaboumcalah na ca awh toteh, na BAWIPA Cathut e a lungmanae na pholen awh han.
Sahnin kai ni na poe e kâpoelawknaw, phunglawknaw, hoi lawkcengnaenaw tarawihoehnae lahoi Cathut na pahnim awh hoeh nahanlah sahnin kai ni kâ na poe awh.

nang hah na tanouk teh, a hnukteng na pahren nahanelah, na mintoenaw ni panue boihoeh e mana hoi kahrawngum na kakawkkung nange BAWIPA Cathut hah na pahnim awh teh,

Na BAWIPA Cathut duengdoeh na pouk han, Bangkongtetpawiteh, na mintoenaw kam pouh e lawkkam hah, sahnin e patetlah caksak nahanelah, hnopai hmuthainae na kapoekung teh Cathut doeh.
Na BAWIPA Cathut na pahnim awh teh, alouke cathutnaw na hnai awh teh na bawk awh pawiteh, rawknae dawk na pha katang awh han. Sahnin kai teh nangmouh koe kapanuekkhaikung lah ka o.
Na BAWIPA Cathut e lawk hah na ngâi awh hoeh dawkvah Jentelnaw nangmae na hmalah ka raphoe e patetlah nangmouh hai na raphoe awh han.
Oe Isarelnaw thai awh haw. Nangmouh hlak a thakasai e miphun hai thoseh, kalvan kadeng e rapan hoi ka kawi e khopuinaw hai thoseh,
Anakim miphun hmalah bangtelah vai kangdue thai tie lawk na thai teh, na panue e Anakim miphun tie kalenpounge miphun hai thoseh, tuk nateh lawp hanelah atu Jordan tui raka tawmlei toe.
Hatdawkvah, na BAWIPA Cathut ni na hmalah a cei teh, ka kang e hmai patetlah ao teh, ahnimouh a raphoe vaiteh, na hmaitung vah, a tabo han tie hah na lungkuep awh. Cathut ni a dei e patetlah nang ni ahnimouh na pâlei awh vaiteh karang poung lah na raphoe awh han.
BAWIPA na Cathut ni ahnimouh nang koehoi a pâlei hnukkhu, nang ni kaie lannae dawk doeh BAWIPA ni hete ram ka kut dawk na poe telah na pouk payon vaih. Hote miphunnaw hawihoeh e dawk BAWIPA ni ka hmaitung hoi a pâlei telah pouk awh.
Na sak awh e hnokahawi dawk hai thoseh, lannae dawk hoi hai thoseh, hote ram a coe awh hane nahoeh. Hete miphunnaw hawihoeh dawk hoi thoseh, BAWIPA ni na pa Abraham, Isak, Jakop koe lawkkam e lawk hah, a caksak nahan na Cathut ni ahnimouh na hmalah hoi a pâlei e doeh.
Hatdawkvah, na BAWIPA ni nama e na hawinae dawk hoi, kahawipoung e ram na poe e nahoeh, nang teh na lahuen ka cak e miphun doeh.
Nang ni kahrawngum vah BAWIPA lung na khuek sak e hah, pahnim hanh. Izip ram hoi na tâco pasuek nah, hete hmuen koe na pha a totouh, BAWIPA koe taran lah na thaw awh.
Horeb vah BAWIPA a lung na khuek sak awh teh, nangmouh raphoe hane totouh, BAWIPA hah a lungkhuek.
BAWIPA hoi lawkkamnae thutnae talung, lungphen la hanelah, mon lah ka luen navah, hnin 40 touh thung vaiyei hoi tui ka catnet laipalah, mon vah ka o.
BAWIPA Cathut ni lungphen kahni touh Cathut e kut hoi thut e na poe. Na kamkhueng hnin vah, mon som hmai dawk hoi a dei e lawknaw ao.
Ahnin 40 arum 40 akuep navah hote lawkkam lungphen kahni touh e teh, BAWIPA Cathut ni kai koe na poe.
Hahoi BAWIPA ni Thaw nateh karang cathuk leih. Izip ram hoi na tâcokhai e taminaw a rawk awh toe, tarawi hane ka poe e lamthung a phen awh toe. Kutsak meikapawk doeh a bawk awh toe.
BAWIPA ni, hete miphunnaw ka khet nah, a lahuen mangkhak e miphunnaw doeh.
Ka madueng na awm sak awh. Ahnimouh kai ni ka raphoe han. A min hai kalvan rahim vah ka raphoe han. Nang teh ahnimouh hlak tha na sai sak vaiteh, miphun ka pungdaw sak han telah a ti.
Hatnavah lawkkam talung kahni touh ka sin teh, ka kamlang teh hmai ka kang e mon dawk hoi ka kum.
Nangmouh ni, BAWIPA Cathut koe na yon awh teh, maito meikaphawk hlun awh teh, Cathut ni lawk na poe e lamthung karang poung lah, na phen awh toe tie ka hmu navah,
Kut roi hoi ka patuep e lungphen, kahni touh e hah nangmae hmaitung vah ka raphei.
Nangmouh ni, BAWIPA lung na khuek sak nahanelah, a hmalah yonnae na sak awh e yon pueng dawkvah, yampa e patetlah BAWIPA hmalah ka tabo teh, hnin 40 rum 40 touh vaiyei hoi tui catnet laipalah ka o.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, BAWIPA ni nangmouh na raphoe hanlah, puenghoi lungkhueknae a tâco sak e kai ni ka taki. Hatnavah BAWIPA ni kaie ka lawk bout na thai pouh.
BAWIPA ni Aron raphoe hanelah a lung puenghoi a khuek dawkvah, Aron hane lahai ka ratoum.
Yonnae tie na sak awh e maitoca hah ka la teh, a tui lah kalawng sak. A kanuikapin lah rekrek ka kanawi teh, mon dawk hoi ka lawng e palang dawk ka tâkhawng.
Taberah, Messah hmuen, Kiborthhattaavah hmuen koe hai, nangmouh ni BAWIPA hah a lungkhuek nahanlah na sak awh.
Kadeshbarnea hoi BAWIPA ni cet awh nateh, kai ni na poe e ram hah lat awh. Nangmouh na patoun awh navah, nangmouh ni nangmae BAWIPA e kâ poe e na kangek awh. BAWIPA na yuem awh hoeh, lawk hai ngâi laipalah na o awh.
Ka panue hnin hoi nangmouh teh BAWIPA hah na taran awh toe.
BAWIPA ni nangmouh na raphoe han telah a dei dawkvah, kai teh yampa e patetlah hnin 40 rum 40 touh ka tabo.
BAWIPA koe, Oe Bawipa Jehovah, lentoenae hoi na ratang teh, thaonae kut hoi Izip hoi na tâcokhai e, nange râw lah kaawm e hete taminaw hah raphoe hanh loe.
Nange san Abraham, Isak, Jakop hah pahnim hanh. Hete miphunnaw teh a lungpatanae, a yonnae hoi a hawihoehnae pâkuem pouh hanh.
Hottelah hoeh pawiteh, tâconae ram dawk e taminaw ni, Cathut ni a kam pouh e ram dawk, a thokhai thai hoeh dawkvah, a hmu ngaihoeh dawk na ou, kahrawngum thei hanelah a ngai dawk na ou ati han nahoehmaw.
Hetnaw teh lentoenae hoi, na kut na dâw teh, na tâcokhai e nange râwnaw doeh telah kai ni ka ratoum.
Hat navah, Cathut ni ahmaloe e talung kahni touh e patetlah talung kahni touh bout bo e, kai ka onae koe takhang loe, thingkong hai sak loe.
Na raphei e hmaloe e talung dawk thut e lawk patetlah apâhni e talung dawk bout ka thut han rak, hote talung teh thingkong thung na hruek han ati.
Kai ni Anri thing e thingkong ka sak teh ahmaloe e talung patetlah talung kahni touh ka bo teh, hote talung ka sin teh mon lah ka luen.
Na kamkhueng awh hnin vah, BAWIPA ni mon vah hmai thung hoi a dei e kâpoelawk 10 touh hah, ahmaloe e ca thut e patetlah BAWIPA ni a thut teh kai hah na poe.
Ka kamlang teh mon hoi ka kum. Ka sak tangcoung e thingkong thung hote lungphen ka hruet teh, BAWIPA ni dei e patetlah hote thingkong thung vah atu ao.
Mon dawkvah yampa ka onae tueng patetlah hnin 40 rum 40 touh bout ka o teh, hat nahai BAWIPA ni nangmouh raphoe hoeh nahan kaie ka lawk hah a thai.
BAWIPA ni, thaw haw, hete miphunnaw koe poe hanelah, na mintoenaw koe lawkkamnae ram koe lah a cei awh vaiteh, a lawp awh nahan ahnimae hmalah cet telah ati.
