Taran tuk nahane tueng a hnai toteh, vaihmanaw ni a hnai awh vaiteh,
Oe Isarelnaw, sahnin taran tuk hanelah taran koe na hnai awh toe. Ahnimouh kecu dawk na lungpout awh hanh, taket awh hanh, pâyaw awh hanh, kalue awh hanh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, nangmouh na ka rungngang hanelah, BAWIPA Cathut teh nangmouh hoi rei a kamthaw teh, na tarannaw hah na tuk pouh telah taminaw koe dei awh naseh.
Ransa kacuenaw nihai, im katha ka sak niteh, Cathut koe kâhnawng hoeh rae awm pawiteh, ama im ban yawkaw seh, a im hah hnawng naseh. Hoehpawiteh, taran tuknae koe dout pawiteh, alouke ni im hah a hnawng han doeh tie ngaihri han ao.
Misur takha ka sak niteh, a paw ka cat hoeh rae awm pawiteh, a im ban yawkaw seh. Hoehpawiteh, taran tuknae koe dout pawiteh, alouke ni hote misur paw a ca han doeh tie ngaihrinae ao.
A yu sut ka pacei niteh, ka paluen hoeh rae awm pawiteh, a im ban yawkaw seh. Hoehpawiteh, taran tuknae koe dout pawiteh, alouke ni a paluen han doeh tie ngaihrinae ao.
Hahoi, ransa kacuenaw teh, ka taket ni teh a lung ka pout e awm pawiteh, a im ban yawkaw seh. Hoehpawiteh, ahni a lungpout e patetlah a huinaw hai a lungpout han doeh tie ngaihrinae ao telah taminaw koe a dei awh han.
Ransa kacuenaw ni hottelah a dei awh hnukkhu, kâ kapoekungnaw ni taminaw hah taran tuk hanlah a kamthaw sak han.
Kho buetbuet touh tuk hanelah na ceisin navah, roum nahanelah hmaloe na dei pouh han.
Hote kho teh, roum nahane lawk a dei teh kho longkha sut paawng pawiteh, hote kho dawk kaawm e pueng ni aphawng na poe awh vaiteh, na thaw a tawk awh han.
Roum nahane lawk hah ngâi awh hoeh lah, nangmouh na tuk awh pawiteh, hote kho hah na kalup awh vaiteh,
na BAWIPA Cathut ni nangmae kut dawk hote kho hah na poe torei, tongpa pueng hah tahloi hoi na thei han.
Napui camo saring khothung na hmu e pueng teh, nama hanelah na la vaiteh, na BAWIPA Cathut ni taran kut dawk hoi na poe e hno hah na ca han.
Hete miphun onae kho hloilah, ahlanae koe e kho kaawm e pueng koe hottelah na sak han.
Na BAWIPA Cathut ni râw lah na coe hane kawi dawk hete miphunnaw e kho dawkvah, ka kâha e tami buet touh boehai na hring sak mahoeh.
Hitnaw, Amornaw, Kanaannaw, Periznaw, Hivnaw, Jebusitnaw ni amamae cathutnaw koe a sak awh e panuettho e hno hah nangmouh na cangkhai awh teh,
na BAWIPA Cathut koe na yon hoeh nahanelah, na BAWIPA Cathut ni na cangkhai e patetlah hote tami pueng hah peng na raphoe han.
Kho buetbuet touh tuk hanelah, kasawlah na kalup pawiteh, thingkungnaw hah na tâtueng mahoeh. Talai dawk kapâw e thingkungnaw teh, tami kâkawk nahanelah ao dawkvah, a paw dueng na ca han. Kho na kalup navah akung na tâtueng mahoeh.
Hatei, cakawi hoeh e thingkungnaw teh na tâtueng vaiteh, na tuk e kho na tâ hoehroukrak, taran tuk nahanelah hnopai na sak na thai.
Na BAWIPA Cathut ni coe hanelah na poe e ram dawk kahrawng vah, tami ni a thei e ro na hmu teh kathetkung na panuek hoehpawiteh,
kacuenaw hoi lawkcengkungnaw a tho awh vaiteh, ro hoi a tengpam e khonaw hah a hnai ahla e a bangnue awh han.
Ro hoi kahnai poung e kho dawk e kacuenaw ni hno boihoeh rae maitola a hrawi awh han.
Hote kacuenaw ni, hote maitola hah, thawn hoeh rae, cati kahei hoeh rae, pou kalawng e palang koe a hrawi awh vaiteh, hote hmuen koe palang vah maitola e lahuen a tâtueng pouh awh han.
Levih miphun vaihmanaw ni a thosin awh han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, a thaw tawk hane hoi BAWIPA e min yawhawi poe sak hanelah, ahnimanaw hah BAWIPA ni a rawi toe. Ahnimae pahni dawk hoi, kâyuenae pueng hoi kutkhok payonnae pueng teh pâbaw e lah ao han.
Ro hoi kahnai poung e kho dawk e kacuenaw pueng ni, palang vah a lahuen tâtueng pouh tangcoung e maito van a kut a pâsu awh han.
Hathnukkhu ahnimouh ni a dei awh hane teh, kaimae kut ni hete a thi palawng hoeh, kaimouh ni kahmawt awh hoeh. Oe BAWIPA, na rawi teh na rungngang e na tami Isarelnaw yontha pouh haw. A yonnae kaawm hoeh e tami e a thi palawngnae yon hah na tami Isarelnaw koe bawt sak hanh loe. Thi palawngnae yon teh tha pouh loe, telah a dei awh han.
Oe! BAWIPA na ratang e na tami Isarelnaw hah pahren haw. Due kamcu hoeh e tami theinae yon teh na tami Isarelnaw koe phat sak hanh loe telah na dei han. Hottelah na tet pawiteh, tami theinae yontha lah ao han.
Hottelah nang ni BAWIPA hma lah hawinae na sak navah, due kamcu hoeh e thi teh a takhoe han.
Nang ni taran na tuk teh, na BAWIPA Cathut ni na kut dawk na poe teh na man torei teh,
na man e taminaw hah a meikahawi e napui hah na hmu teh yu lah la hane na ngai pawiteh,
nama im na kaw vaiteh, ahni ni a lû a ngaw vaiteh, a kutpatin a raimen vaiteh,
na mannae khohna a rading vaiteh, thapa yung touh thung a manu na pa rabui laihoi na im vah ao hnukkhu, na yu lah na la vaiteh, ahni teh nange yu lah ao han.
Hathnukkhu ahni hah na ngai hoeh toung pawiteh, ama ngai nah koe na cei sak han. Ahni hah na kaya sak dawkvah, tangka lah na yawt mahoeh. San lah na tat mahoeh.
Vâ ka pahren e hoi vâ ka hmuhma e yu roi ni a ca a khe roi teh, camin hah vâ ka hmuhma e capa lah awm pawiteh,
ahni ni a râw hah a rei toteh, hmuhma e capa hah pabo vaiteh, a pahren e capa hah na tawmtakhang mahoeh.
Hmuhma e capa teh camin doeh telah na pâpho vaiteh, let hni touh e râw hah na poe han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, hote capa teh na pa e tha kamtawngnae doeh. Caminnae hmuen hoi a kamcu doeh.
Na pa koe capa kathout, a lungpata ni teh manu na pa e lawk ka ngai hoeh e, manu na pa ni a yue ei, banglah ka noutna hoeh e awm pawiteh,
manu na pa ni hote capa hah a sawn vaiteh, kho thung kacuenaw onae koe kho longkha koe a ceikhai vaiteh,
kaimae capa teh ka mathout e lah doeh a o. Ka carawng ni teh yamuhri lah kaawm e doeh telah kho thung kacuenaw koe a dei pou han.
Khoca tongpa pueng ni, hote capa hah talung hoi a dei awh vaiteh, a thei awh han. Hottelah nangmouh thung hoi payonnae hah na takhoe awh vaiteh, Isarelnaw pueng ni hote kamthang hah a thai awh vaiteh a taki awh han.
Due kamcu e yon ka tawn e tami hah thing dawk na kaithi sak pawiteh,
hote ro hah thing dawk karum tuettuet na tat mahoeh. Ama hot hnin roeroe vah talai dawk na pakawp roeroe han. Thing dawk kaithi sak e tami teh thoebo lah kaawm e tami doeh. Na BAWIPA Cathut ni na pang hanelah na poe e râw hah na khin sak awh hoeh nahanlah hottelah na sak awh han.
Na hmaunawngha e maito hoehpawiteh tu kahmat e hah na hmu nahlangva laplap khen hanh.
Na hmaunawngha ahlanae koe ao e hah na panue hoeh nakunghai na im vah na hrawi pouh han. Na hmaunawngha ni a tawng hoeh roukrak na im vah na hruek pouh han. Hathnukkhu, na hmaunawngha koe bout na poe han.
La hai thoseh, hnicu hai thoseh, buetbuet touh a kahma e hah na hmawt pawiteh, laplap khen laipalah, hottelah na sak han.
Na hmaunawngha e maitotan nakunghai, la nakunghai lam dawk sut kamlet e na hmawt pawiteh, na kâhrawk takhai mahoeh. Na pathaw roeroe han.
Napui ni tongpa e khohna hah khohnat mahoeh. Hottelah ka khohnat e teh nangmae BAWIPA Cathut ni a panuet.
Lamthung teng thingkung dawk na ou, talai dawk na ou, tavacanaw hoi hoehpawiteh, a taduinaw khuehoi tavatabu na hmu teh, a manu ma ni awt boipawiteh, a canaw khuehoi a manu mek na lat mahoeh.
Nang ni hnokahawi na coe teh na hringyung vang nahanelah, a canaw na la nakunghai, a manu ma teh na tha han.
Im katha na sak navah, lemphu hah na tumdum han. Hottelah na sak pawiteh, tami buetbuet touh bawt payon pawiteh, nange im teh thipalawngnae im lah awm mahoeh.
Misur dawk kâvan hoeh e atimu na kahei mahoeh. Hottelah na kahei pawiteh, misur paw hoi atimu paw mek a rawk han.
Maito hoi la cungtalah laikawk na thawn sak mahoeh.
Pahla hoi tumuen kacokalei e khohna na khohnat mahoeh.
Na kâkayo e hni hah, arai pali touh dawk na yep han.
Tami buet touh ni a yu a Paluen teh a ikhai hnukkhu a ma teh,
kai ni hete napui teh ka yu lah ka la toe. Ka ikhai hnukkhu, ahni teh, kacuem e nahoeh tie ka panue telah ati teh, dudamnae lahoi a min mathout sak pawiteh,
hote napui e a manu hoi na pa ni, tanglakacuem lah a onae hah, kacuenaw koe kho longkha koe a thokhai awh han.
Hote napui e a na pa ni kacuenaw koe a dei hane teh, kai ni ka canu teh, hete tongpa koe a yu lah ka poe toe. Hatei, ahni ni a pahnawt.
Khen haw, nange canu teh kacuem e nahoeh ati teh, dudamnae lahoi a min a mathoe sak. Hatei, hetnaw teh ka canu tanglakacuem lah a onae doeh, telah a dei han. Ahnimouh ni kacuenaw e hmalah hni hah a kadai awh han.
Hathnukkhu, kacuenaw ni hote tongpa hah a hem awh vaiteh a yue awh han.
Ahnimouh ni ahni hah shekel 100 touh a rawng sak awh vaiteh, napui e a na pa hah a poe awh han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Isarelnaw e tanglakacuem koe min mathoenae hah a sak dawk doeh. Hote napui teh ahnie a yu lah ao han. A due hoeh roukrak hote napui hoi kampek mahoeh.
Hatei, tongpa ni a dei patetlah, awm boi, napui e tanglakacuem lah a onae patue thai hoeh pawiteh,
khothung e tongpanaw ni hote napui hah a na pa im takhang koe a tâco khai awh vaiteh, talung hoi ka dout lah a dei awh han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, a na pa im vah tak a kâyo e lahoi Isarelnaw koe min mathoenae a kamnue sak toe. Hatdawkvah, nangmouh thung hoi yonnae hah na takhoe awh han.
Tongpa buet touh teh, a vâ ka tawn e napui buet touh hoi a i roi e hah hmawt pawiteh, napui koe ka ip e tongpa hoi hote napui mek thei han. Hottelah Isarelnaw thung hoi yonnae hah na takhoe awh han.
Tanglakacuem hah tongpa ni a hâ hnukkhu, alouke tongpa ni a kho thung vah a hmu teh, ipkhai pawiteh,
hote napui ni kho thungvah a hram hoeh dawk thoseh, tongpa hai a imri e a yu thama lahoi a ikhai dawk thoseh, nangmouh ni ahni maroi hah kho longkha koe na ceikhai awh vaiteh, talung hoi kadout lah na dei awh han. Hottelah hoi nangmouh thung hoi yonnae hah na takhoe awh han.
Tongpa buet touh ni tongpa buet touh hoi sut kâhâ tangcoung e napui hah a hmu teh, a man teh hote napui hah ipkhai pawiteh, hote napui ka ipkhai e tongpa dueng hah na thei han.
Hatei, hote napui hah bangtelah hai na tet mahoeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, tongpa ni hote napui hah kahrawngum a hmu teh, a hâ tangcoung e napui ni a hram eiteh, ahni kabawm hanelah apihai ao hoeh dawkvah, hote lai teh tami reira kâthei e hoi a kâvan.
Tongpa buet touh ni hâ hoeh rah e tanglakacuem hah a hmu teh a man teh, ipkhai pawiteh,
ahni ka ipkhai e tongpa teh shekel 50 touh napui e a na pa koe a poe vaiteh, hote napui teh, hote tongpa e yu lah ao han. Ahni ni hote napui hah thama lahoi a ikhai dawk doeh. Ahni ni hote napui hah a hringyung thung kapek mahoeh.
Apinihai na pa e yu hah lat pouh mahoeh. A na pa e hni hawng pouh mahoeh.
Tuenla hoehpawiteh, tongpa e puengcang tâtueng lah kaawm e teh BAWIPA e tamihu dawk kâen mahoeh.
Cataca teh, BAWIPA e tamihu dawk kâen mahoeh. Se hra totouh kâen mahoeh.
Amon miphun hoi Moab miphun hai BAWIPA e tamihu dawk kâen mahoeh. Se hra totouh kâen mahoeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, nangmouh ni Izip ram hoi na tâco awh navah, ahnimouh ni vaiyei hoi tui a sin awh teh na dawn awh hoeh. Nangmouh thoebo sak hanelah, Mesopotamia ram, Pethor kho e Beor capa Balaam hah a hlai awh.
Hatei, nange BAWIPA Cathut ni Balaam e lawk tarawi pouh hoeh. Nang na pahren dawkvah, thoebonae hah yawhawinae lah a kâthungsak.
Nang teh ahnimae bawirengnae hoi a hnopai na hringyung thung na khen mahoeh.
Edom miphunnaw hah, na pahnawt awh mahoeh. Ahni teh nange hmaunawngha lah ao. Izipnaw hai na pahnawt mahoeh. Ahnimae ram dawk san lah ouk na o boi toe.
Ahnimae catoun teh se thum touh hnukkhu BAWIPA e tamihu dawk a kâen thainae kâ ao.
Taran tuknae koe na kamthaw nah, kamsoumhoehe hno pueng rounh.
Nangmouh thung dawk tami bangpatet hai amae a tâco dawk thounghoehnae awm pawiteh, roenae alawilah a tâco han. Roenae thung kâen mahoeh.
Tangminlasa a pha toteh tui hoi a pâsu han. Kanî a khup torei roenae thung bout a kâen han.
Vaipuen ceinae teh roenae alawilah na ta awh han. Hote hmuen koe alawilah na cei awh han.
Na hnopainaw dawk sumtaboung na tawn han. Nang ni a alawilah na tahung toteh, hot hoi tangkawm na tai vaiteh, na kamlang sin vaiteh, na vaipuen hah na pakawp han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, nange BAWIPA Cathut ni nang hah na rungngang vaiteh, na tarannaw hah nang koe na poe nahanelah, roenae thung a kâhlai toe. Hatdawkvah, BAWIPA teh nang koe a tho navah, nangmouh koe kathounghoehe hah hmawt vaiteh, nangmouh koehoi a kamlang hoeh nahanelah, roenae teh a thoung han.
A bawipa koehoi ka yawng niteh, nang koe ka tho e san teh a bawipa koe na ban sak mahoeh.
Nangmouh koe kho a sak thai nahan a ngai poung e hmuen a rawi vaiteh, ao van han. Na pacekpahlek mahoeh.
Isarel napuinaw thung takkâyawt e awm hanh naseh. Napuitongpanaw awm hanh naseh.
Takkâyonae phu hoi ui phu hah na BAWIPA Cathut e im dawk poe hanelah na sin mahoeh. Hot patetlah e hno teh, na BAWIPA Cathut hanelah panuettho e lah ao.
Na hmaunawngha koe apung la hanelah, tangka, rawca, apung la thai e hnopai pueng na cawi mahoeh.
Jentelnaw koe apung la hanelah na cawi sak awh han. Na cei awh teh na coe awh hane ram, na BAWIPA Cathut ni yawhawi na poe awh nahanelah, na hmaunawngha koe apung la hanelah na cawi sak awh mahoeh.
Nange BAWIPA Cathut koe lawk na kam pawiteh, na kam e patetlah sak laipalah awm hanh. Nange BAWIPA Cathut ni atangcalah, a hei han. Na sak laipalah na awm pawiteh, nang koe a yonae a pha han.
Hatei, lawk na kam hoehpawiteh, yon mahoeh.
Na pahni dawk hoi ka tâcawt e lawk hah na kâhruetcuet han. Na BAWIPA Cathut koe nama lungtho lahoi na kam e patetlah na sak han.
Nang teh, na imri e misur takha koe na kâen navah, misur paw na ngai totouh na ca han, hatei, na yawngya dawk hoi na phawt pouh mahoeh.
Na imri e laikawk na cei navah, na kut hoi cavui hah na pahroe thai. Hatei, na imri e cavui hah tangkoun hoi na ca mahoeh.
Tongpa buet touh ni yu a la teh, a paluen hnukkhu, yon pen hanelah ao dawkvah, a lungkuep hoehpawiteh, manae ca a thut vaiteh, a poe hnukkhu a cei sak han.
Hote napui teh a vâ im hoi a cei hnukkhu alouke tongpa e yu lah o thainae kâ ao.
Bout a vâ e ni hai hmawt ngai hoehpawiteh, manae ca a thut teh a kut dawk a poe teh, a im dawk hoi a ceisak nakunghai thoseh, a vâ kadout nakunghai thoseh,
ahmaloe e tongpa ni hote kamhnawng e napui hah a yu lah bout lat mahoeh. BAWIPA hmalah panuettho e lah ao. Na Cathut BAWIPA ni râw lah na poe ram dawk yon na thokhai mahoeh.
Yu nuengnueng ka paluen e teh taran tuknae koe cet mahoeh. Rangpui thaw hai patoun mahoeh. Kum touh thung im ao vaiteh, a yu hah a khetyawt han.
Talung sum avan lae hai thoseh, athung lae hai thoseh, apini hai laiba dawk na lat pouh mahoeh. Hottelah na lat pawiteh, a hringnae na la pouh e hoi a kâvan.
Tami ni amae hmaunawngha hai thoseh, Isarelnaw hah a paru teh san lah a ta hai thoseh, a yo hai thoseh, hote tamru hah na hmawt pawiteh, na thei awh han. Nang koehoi yonnae hah hottelah na takhoe awh han.
Hrikbei patawnae dawkvah, Levih ca vaihmanaw ni na pâtu e patetlah na sak awh han.
Nangmouh teh, Izip ram hoi na tâco awh teh, kahlawng na cei awh lahun nah, nangmae BAWIPA Cathut ni Miriam koe a sak e hno hah pouk awh.
Nang ni nama e pacanaw koe hno na cawi sak pawiteh, pâhung e hno la hanelah ahnie im thung na kâen mahoeh.
Nang teh alawilah na kangdue vaiteh, a pâhung e hno hah nang na onae koe alawilah a sin han.
Ahni teh roedeng pawiteh, a pâhung e hno poe hanelah kanî na loum sak mahoeh.
Ahni ni amae hni a kâkhu laihoi a i vaiteh, nang yawhawi na poe nahanelah, a pâhung e hno hah kanî khum pawiteh, na poe mingming han. Hottelah sak e teh, na BAWIPA Cathut hmalah kalan e hno doeh.
Paca reira thoseh, na kho dawk kaawm e Jentelnaw hai thoseh, ka roedeng e hah na rektap mahoeh.
A hnintangkuem amae thaw tawk phu hah na poe han. Poe laipalah kanî loum sak hanh. Ahni teh a mathoe dawkvah, a hmu hane aphu dawk a lungpen han. Poe laipalah na awm pawiteh, ahni ni BAWIPA koe hram vaiteh, nang koe yonpennae phat langvaih tie ngaihrinae ao.
Na pa teh capa e yon kecu dawk thoseh, capa teh na pa e yon kecu dawk thoseh, thet mahoeh. Tami pueng amae yon kecu dawk duenae a khang awh han.
Kalan lah lawkcengnae koe, Jentelnaw hoi naranaw hah na phen mahoeh.
Nang teh Izip ram vah san lah ouk na o e hai thoseh, na BAWIPA Cathut ni hote ram thung hoi na ratang e hai thoseh, na pouk han. Hatdawkvah, hete phunglawk hah na hruek pouh awh.
Nang ni na laikawk dawk cang na a toteh, na pahnim e cabong hah bout na lat mahoeh. Na tawksak e pueng dawk na BAWIPA Cathut ni yawhawi na poe nahanelah, hote cabong hah, Jentelnaw hane, naranaw hane, lahmainaw hanelah na hruek han.
Nange olive paw na karuek toteh, kacawie naw hah bout na karuek mahoeh. Jentelnaw, naranaw, lahmainaw hanelah na hruek pouh awh han.
Na misur takha dawk, misur paw na khi toteh, kacawiraenaw hah bout na khi mahoeh. Jentelnaw, naranaw, lahmainaw hanelah na hruek pouh awh han.
Nangmouh teh Izip ram vah san lah ouk na o awh e hah na pouk awh han. Hatdawkvah, hete phung lawk hah na hruek pouh awh.
Tami reira kâyue pawiteh, lawkcengim vah a cei awh vaiteh, lawkcengkung ni ahnimanaw hah lawk a ceng han. Kalan e tami hah yon hloutsak nahanelah thoseh, ka yon e teh sungsak nahanelah thoseh lawk na ceng han.
Ka yon e hah hem kamcu pawiteh, lawkcengkung ni a hmalah ao sak vaiteh, a yon hoi kamcu lah nâyittouh tie hoi a hem han.
Hatei, avai 40 hlak kapap lah na hem mahoeh. Hot hlak kapap lah na hem pawiteh, na hmaunawngha teh na hmalah yeirai a phu han doeh.
Cangkatin lahun e maito hah a pahni moum pouh hanh.
Reirei kaawm e hmaunawnghanaw thung dawkvah, buetbuet touh ni ca sak laipalah dout pawiteh, hote napui teh alouke tamikathan hoi kâyuva mahoeh. A vâ e nawngha ni a paluen vaiteh, a yu lah awm khai naseh.
Isarel miphun dawk hmau min a kahma hoeh nahanelah, camin teh, kadout e na pa kacue e min a phu han.
A nawngha ni a hmau e yu hah la hane ngai hoehpawiteh, napui ni kacuenaw onae koe, kho longkha koe a cei vaiteh, ka vâ e nawngha ni, a hmau e min hah Isarel miphun thung caksak hanelah ngai hoeh. A sak hane kawi hai sak hane ngai hoeh telah dei pawiteh,
khothung vah kacuenaw ni ahni hah a kaw awh vaiteh, a pacei awh han. Ahni ni hai hote napui hah ka lat ngai hoeh telah muentakuen lah awm pawiteh,
a hmau e yu ni kacuenaw e hmalah, ahni koe rek a cei vaiteh, ahnie khokkhawm hah a rading pouh vaiteh, a minhmai dawk a tamthawi pouh vaiteh, hmau e im kangdue sak hanlah ka ngai e tami koe hettelah ti hanelah ao telah a dei pouh awh han.
A hnukkhu vah, ahni hah khokkhawm rading e miphun telah kaw lah ao han.
Tami reira a kâyue awh navah, buet touh e a yu ni amae vâ kabawp han a ngai dawkvah, alouke tongpa e minro hah sawn pouh boipawiteh,
hote napui e kut hah tâtueng pouh han. Na pahren mahoeh.
Na yawngya dawk kalen e khinglung, kathounge khinglung tie kâvan hoeh e khinglung na awm sak mahoeh.
Nama im vah khingnae kalen kathoung na awm sak mahoeh.
Na BAWIPA Cathut ni na poe e ram dawk na hringyung a vang nahanelah, kahman e khinglung, kahman e yawcu dueng hah na hno han.
Dei tangcoung e hno ka sak e tami pueng hoi kamsoum hoeh lah ka sak tami pueng teh, nange BAWIPA Cathut ni a panuet.
Nang teh Izip ram hoi na tâco teh kahlawng na cei toteh,
na tha a baw teh na tawn lahun nah, na hnukkâbangnaw, a thakayounnaw hah Amaleknaw ni lamthung dawkvah a thei awh e hai thoseh, Cathut hah a taki awh hoeh e hai thoseh, pouk la a.
Hatdawkvah, BAWIPA Cathut ni râw lah na poe e ram dawk, na tengpam kaawm e taran pueng e kut dawk hoi na hlout sak teh yawhawi na poe toteh, Amaleknaw heh pouknae ao hoeh nahanelah, kalvan rahim vah na raphoe awh han. Hot hah na pahnim mahoeh.
Nange BAWIPA Cathut ni râw lah na poe e ram dawk, na kâen teh, na coe hnukkhu hawvah kho na sak awh toteh,
nange na BAWIPA Cathut ni na poe e na ram dawk e na khi e talai a pawhik a phunphun dawk e aluepaw na la vaiteh, tangthung dawk na raseng vaiteh, na BAWIPA Cathut e min ao nahanelah rawi e hmuen koe na ceikhai han.
Hatnae tueng dawkvah, vaihmanaw koe na cei vaiteh, ahnimouh koe na dei pouh han e teh, maimouh na poe hanelah mintoenaw koe Cathut ni a kam e ram dawk pha awh toe, telah nange BAWIPA Cathut koe sahnin ka pathang telah na dei awh han.
Vaihma ni tangthung a la vaiteh, BAWIPA e hmalah a pâhung han.
Nang ni na BAWIPA e hmalah na dei hane teh, ka kâva e Aram miphun teh kaie na pa doeh. Ahni teh Izip ram lah a ceicathuk teh, tami youn touh hoi imyin patetlah ao. Hatei, hote hmuen koevah, puenghoi a kampung awh teh, a thao awh.
Izipnaw ni kaimanaw hah na rektap awh teh, kaimouh van vah, thaw karunaw hah a toung awh.
Hat toteh, kaimouh ni BAWIPA koe ka hram awh teh, BAWIPA ni kaimae lawk hah a thai teh, kaimae runae, thatawnnae, hoi rektapnae hah na hmu pouh.
Hatdawkvah, BAWIPA ni a dâw e thaonae kut hoi, takikatho poung e hoi, mitnout hoi, kângairu hnonaw hoi kaimanaw hah Izip ram thung hoi na tâcokhai awh.
Hete khoitui hoi maito sanutui a lawngnae hmuen hah kaimouh na poe awh.
Atu khenhaw! Oe BAWIPA, nang ni na poe e ram thung e aluepaw hah na thokhai toe telah na dei awh han. Hathnukkhu, nang ni hote aluepaw hah na BAWIPA Cathut e hmalah na pâhung vaiteh, na BAWIPA Cathut e hmalah na bawk han.
Na BAWIPA Cathut ni na poe e kahawi e hno pueng dawkvah, nama hoi na imthungkhu hoi, Levihnaw hoi, nangmouh koe kaawm e imyinnaw hoi cungtalah na lunghawikhai awh han.
Nang ni, na hmu e thung dawk, hra touh dawk buet touh poenae kum a kum thum kum dawkvah, pung hra pung touh na hruek toteh, Levihnaw, imyinnaw, naranaw, hoi lahmainunaw hah na poe han. Hottelah na sak pawiteh, ahnimouh hai a von a paha van han.
Hathnukkhu, nang ni na BAWIPA Cathut e hmalah na dei hane teh, kai ni ka talue sak e poe hane hno im hoi ka takhoe teh, nang ni na dei kâpoelawknaw patetlah imyinnaw, Levih naranaw, hoi lahmainunaw hah ka poe toe. Kai teh nange kâpoelawknaw ka tapoe hoeh. Ka pahnim hoeh.
Kai teh kadoutnaw hanelah ka lungmathoe toteh, hote hnonaw hah ka cat hoeh. Ka khin nah hote hno hah kai ni ka takhoe hoeh. Kadoutnaw hanelah hote hno hah ka poe hoeh. Ka BAWIPA Cathut e lawk hah ka tarawi toe. Kai hanelah na dei pouh e patetlah ka tawksak toe.
Kathounge na onae hmuen kalvan hoi na khet navah, na tami Isarelnaw hoi kaimae mintoenaw koe lawk na kam e ram, khoitui hoi maitosanutui a lawngnae ram yawhawi poe haw telah na dei han.
Sahnin hete phunglawknaw hoi lawkcengnaenaw hah na tarawi nahanelah na BAWIPA Cathut ni na poe toe.
Sahnin vah a lamthung dawn laihoi phunglawk, kâpoelawk, lawkcengnae hoi a lawk ngâi hanelah BAWIPA teh na Cathut lah ao nahan na pathang toe.
BAWIPA ni nang teh amae miphun lah na o titeh a pathang toe. Hatdawkvah, nang ni amae kâpoelawk pueng hah na tarawi hanelah ao toe.
Hathloilah, a sak e miphun pueng e lathueng vah oupnae, kamthangnae, barinae lah na o sak han. Ama ni lawk a kam tangcoung e patetlah nang teh BAWIPA Cathut hanelah kathounge miphun lah na o han.
Hathnukkhu, Mosi hoi Isarel kacuenaw ni taminaw koe a dei awh e teh, sahnin kai ni ka hruek e kâpoelawk pueng hah tarawi awh.
Nang ni Jordan palang na raka teh, BAWIPA Cathut ni na poe e ram dawk na pha toteh, kalen e talungnaw hah ung nateh, thungpangaw hoi na hluk han.
Mintoenaw ni a bawk awh e Cathut BAWIPA ni a lawkkam ao e patetlah nang na poe e ram, khoitui hoi maitosanutui a lawngnae ram kâen hanelah na raka hnukkhu, hete kâlawk dawk e lawklung pueng hah hotnaw dawk na thut han.
Jordan palang raka hnukkhu, sahnin kai ni lawk na thui e talungnaw hah, Ebal mon dawk na ung vaiteh, mirangtalai hoi na kanan han.
Hote hmuen koehai na BAWIPA Cathut hanelah,
thuengnae khoungroe hah talung hoi na sak awh han. Sum hno laipalah, pathei hoehe talung hoi na sak han. Nang BAWIPA Cathut hah hote khoungroe dawk hmaisawi thuengnae na thueng han.
Roum thuengnae hai na thueng vaiteh, hote hmuen koe na canei awh vaiteh, a hmalah nawmnae na sak awh han.
Hote talung dawkvah, hete lawknaw hah kamcengcalah na thut han.
Hathnukkhu, Mosi hoi vaihmanaw, Levihnaw niyah, Oe Isarel miphun, kâhruetcuet laihoi thai haw. Sahnin nang teh, BAWIPA Cathut e miphun lah na o toe.
Hatdawkvah, na BAWIPA Cathut e lawknaw hah na tarawi han. Sahnin kaimouh ni patuen ka dei awh e kâpoelawknaw hoi phunglawknaw hah tarawi telah Isarelnaw pueng hah a dei pouh awh.
Mosi ni hot hnin vah, taminaw koe kâ a poe e teh,
nangmouh ni Jordan palang na raka awh hnukkhu, taminaw yawhawi poe hanelah Gerizim mon dawk ka kangdout hane naw teh: Simeon, Levih, Judah, Issakhar, Joseph, hoi Benjamin tinaw doeh.
Thoebo hanelah Ebal mon dawk ka kangdout hane naw teh: Gad, Reubeb, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, hoi Napthali tinaw doeh.
Hatnavah, Levihnaw ni Isarelnaw koe puenghoi a hramkhai hane lawk teh,
BAWIPA ni a panuet e hno, kutsak hlun e meikaphawk ka sak niteh, a kamnuehoehnae koe ka tat e tami teh yawthoenae awm lawiseh telah thoe a bo awh vaiteh, tami pueng ni Amen ati awh han.
Manu hoeh pawiteh na pa ka dudam e tami teh yawthoenae awm lawiseh telah thoe a bo awh vaiteh, tami pueng ni Amen ati awh han.
Imri e lawrilung ka puen e tami teh yawthoenae awm lawiseh telah thoe a bo awh vaiteh, tami pueng ni Amen ati awh han.
Mitdawn lam ka phen sak e tami teh yawthoenae awm lawiseh telah thoe a bo awh vaiteh, tami pueng ni Amen ati awh han.
Kalan lah lawkceng navah, miphun alouknaw, naranaw, lahmainunaw hah kamsoum hoeh lah ka sung sak e tami teh yawthoenae awm lawiseh telah thoe a bo awh vaiteh, tami pueng ni Amen ati awh han.
Na pa hoi dueng kâkuen e na pa e a yu hah ka ipkhai e tami teh yawthoenae awm lawiseh telah thoe a bo awh vaiteh, tami pueng ni Amen ati awh han.
Saringnaw buetbuet touh ka ipkhai e tami teh yawthoenae awm lawiseh telah thoe a bo awh vaiteh, tami pueng ni Amen ati awh han.
Na pa e canu, manu e canu, mae tawncanu ka ipkhai e tami teh yawthoenae awm lawiseh telah thoe a bo awh vaiteh, tami pueng ni Amen ati awh han.
Yu e manu ka ipkhai e tami teh yawthoenae awm lawiseh telah thoe a bo awh vaiteh, tami pueng ni Amen ati awh han.
Imri hah arulahoi ka thet e tami teh yawthoenae awm lawiseh telah thoe a bo awh vaiteh, tami pueng ni Amen ati awh han.
Yon ka tawn hoehe tami thei hanelah aphu ka lat e tami teh yawthoenae awm lawiseh telah thoe a bo awh vaiteh, tami pueng ni Amen ati awh han.
Hete kâlawk dawk e lawklungnaw ka cak sak hoehe teh yawthoenae awm lawiseh telah thoe a bo awh vaiteh, tami pueng ni Amen ati awh han.
Sahnin kâ na poe e kâpoelawknaw na tarawi nahanelah, na BAWIPA Cathut e lawk hah na ngai pawiteh, BAWIPA Cathut ni nang teh miphunnaw lathueng na tawm han.
Na BAWIPA Cathut e lawk hah na tarawi pawiteh, nang koe ka tho hane yawhawinaw hateh:
Nang teh khothung vah yawhawi, kahrawngum hai yawhawi lah na o han.
Canaw lahoi thoseh, talai a pawhik lahoi thoseh, saring ni a khe e a canaw lahoi thoseh, tu hoi maitonaw lahoi thoseh, yawhawi lah na o han.
Tangthung dawk thoseh, tavai kanawknae kawlung dawk thoseh, yawhawi ao han.
Na im thung na kâen nah yawhawi ao han. Alawilah na tâco nah yawhawi ao han.
Nang na ka tuk hane tarannaw hah na hmalah BAWIPA ni a sung sak han. Ahnimouh teh lamthung buet touh hoi nang koe a tho awh eiteh, lamthung sari touh hoi a yawng awh han.
Nange hnoim dawk thoseh, na tawksaknae tangkuem dawk thoseh, BAWIPA nang koe yawhawi pha sak hanelah a dei pouh awh han. BAWIPA Cathut ni na poe e ram dawk nang yawhawinae na poe han.
Nang teh na BAWIPA Cathut e kâpoelawk na tarawi teh, a lamthung dawk na dawn pawiteh, BAWIPA ni thoebo e patetlah nang hah BAWIPA hanlah, kathounge miphun lah pou na o sak han.
Nang teh, BAWIPA e min lahoi kaw lah na o tie miphun pueng ni a panue teh, na taki awh han.
BAWIPA ni nang koe na poe hanelah, mintoenaw koe thoebo e ram dawk hnopai, na canaw, saring pungdawnae hoi talai dawk a pawhik a pung sak han.
BAWIPA ni atueng a pha torei teh, nange ram dawk kho a rak sak hane thoseh, na sak nah tangkuem dawk yawhawi poe hane thoseh, kalvan hnoim a paawng han. Nang ni miphunnaw hah câwisaknae kâ ao han. Ahnimouh ni nang na cawi sak mahoeh.
BAWIPA ni nang teh a mai lah na awm sak laipalah, a lû lah na o sak dawkvah, nang teh rahim lah na awm laipalah, lathueng lah onae kâ na tawn han.
Sahnin kai ni kâ na poe e lawknaw thung hoi avoilah, aranglah phen laipalah, alouknaw e cathut bawk laipalah na awm awh pawiteh, hottelah e hawinae hah na coe awh han.
Sahnin ka dei e BAWIPA Cathut ni lawk na poe e pueng na tarawi hanelah, lawk na ngâi hoehpawiteh, na lathueng ka phat hane thoebonae hateh:
Nang teh khothung hai thoseh, kahrawngum hai thoseh yawthoe lah na o awh han.
Tangthung dawk thoseh, tavai kanawknae kawlung dawk thoseh, thoebo lah ao han.
Canaw lahoi thoseh, talai a pawhik lahoi thoseh, saring ni a khe e a canaw lahoi thoseh, tu hoi maitonaw lahoi thoseh, thoebo lah na o han.
Na im thung na kâen nah thoebo lah na o han. Alawilah na tâco nah thoebo lah ao han.
BAWIPA na pahnawt teh na sakpayon e yon kecu dawk, karang poung lah rawknae koe na pha hoehroukrak, na tawksak e pueng dawk rektapnae, tarawknae, pathoenae naw teh na lathueng vah a pha sak han.
Na cei teh na coe hane ram dawk hoi be na raphoe hoehroukrak, lacik ka pha sak han.
BAWIPA ni laheipatawnae, vairoe, ekkhu, vuenpatawnae, tahloi hoi theinae, kahlî hoi thingthairompo due saknae, ahri ni ca e lahoi thingthairompo due saknae, khokangnae naw hoi na rawk totouh, hote laciknaw ni na pâlei han.
Na lathueng e kalvan teh na lû dawk rahum patetlah thoseh, na rahim e talai hai sum patetlah ao han.
BAWIPA ni na ram dawk ka rak e kho hah lailo hoi vaiphu lah ao sak dawkvah, na rawk hoehroukrak kalvan lahoi na van a bo sak han.
Na tarannaw hmalah BAWIPA ni lacik na poe han. Lamthung buet touh dueng dawk hoi na cei sin ei, lamthung sari touh dawk hoi na yawng awh vaiteh, talai van kaawm e khoram tangkuem na kampuen awh han.
Na ro teh tavanaw, kahrawng e moithangnaw ni ca hanelah ao han. Hote moithangnaw hah apinihai pâlei mahoeh.
BAWIPA ni nang hah Izip ram e âhlut, baksa, takpatha e lahoi lacik na poe han.
Pathunae, mitdawnnae, lungpuennae lacik a pha sak vaiteh,
mitdawn ni hmonae koe a payam e patetlah nang teh kanîthun vah thupthup na payam han. Na sak e hno dawk na cum laipalah, rektapnae, lawpnae na khang vaiteh, apinihai na rungngang mahoeh.
Yu na paluen eiteh, ayânaw ni a ikhai han. Im na sak eiteh, na awm nah mahoeh. Misur na ung eiteh, a paw na khi mahoeh.
Na maito hah na hmalah a thei awh eiteh, nama ni na cat mahoeh. Nange la hah na hmalah thama lahoi a ceikhai awh eiteh, bout na poe awh mahoeh toe. Nange tunaw hah taran kut dawk poe toteh, ka rungngang hane awm mahoeh.
Na canaw teh ayâ kut dawk a pha teh, na mit ni kanîruirui a khet vaiteh, a tha a baw han. Na kut hai a tha awm mahoeh.
Na panuepaca hoeh e miphun ni na ram dawk e a pawhik hai thoseh, na tawk teh na hmu e hnonaw hai thoseh a ca awh han. Nang teh rektapnae dueng doeh pout laipalah na khang ti.
Hottelah, ma ni khei kâhmo e dawkvah, nang teh na pathu han.
BAWIPA ni na khokpakhu hoi na khok hloilah, na khoktabei koehoi kamtawng teh, na laduem koe totouh, kahmat thai hoeh e lacik a pha sak han.
BAWIPA ni nang ni na tawm e siangpahrang hah, nang hoi na mintoenaw ni a panue boihoeh e miphun koe, na thak vaiteh, nang teh alouke cathut, thing cathut, talung cathutnaw hah na bawk han.
BAWIPA ni nang na thaknae ram tangkuem dawkvah, nang teh, kângairunae, bangnuebangta nahane, pathoe hanelah na o han.
Nang ni cati moikapap laikawk koe na sin eiteh, awsinaw ni a ca dawkvah, cakang youn touh ca doeh na a ti.
Misur takha na sak teh, misur ka ung nakunghai, ahri ni a ca dawkvah, nama ni misur paw na khi mahoeh. Misur tui hai na net mahoeh.
Na onae koe olivekung ao eiteh, a paw hmin hoehnahlan a sarut dawkvah, nang teh olive satui na kâhluk mahoeh.
Canu capa na khe eiteh, ahnimouh hoi na nawm mahoeh. Taran ni san lah a man han.
Na onae ram dawkvah, thing kaawm e pueng, talai a pawhik kaawm e pueng, awsi ni a ca han.
Nang hoi rei kaawm e imyinnaw teh, rasang vaiteh, nang van a luen awh han. Nang law teh rahim lah na kum han.
Ahni ni nang na cawi sak vaiteh, nang ni ahni na cawi sak mahoeh. Ahni ni a lû lah awm vaiteh nang law teh a mai lah na o han.
Bawi ni na poe e kâpoelawknaw hoi BAWIPA e phunglawknaw hah tarawi nahanelah na BAWIPA Cathut e lawk na ngâi hoeh dawkvah, nang teh, na rawk totouh hete thoebonae teh nang lathueng phat vaiteh, na pâlei vaiteh rek na patawt han.
Nang lathueng thoseh, na catounnaw lathueng thoseh, pout laipalah mitnoutnae kângairu hno lah ao han.
Hnopai na tawn toteh, lunghawinae hoi BAWIPA Cathut e a thaw hah na tawk awh hoeh dawkvah,
BAWIPA ni a patoun e tarannaw e thaw hah vonhlam hoi, tui kahran hoi, caici lah onae hoi bangpueng dawk roedeng laihoi na tawk awh han. Na rawk awh hoehroukrak na lahuen dawk sumkahnam a bang awh han.
Ahla poungnae koe e miphunnaw hah nangmouh tuk sak hanelah, BAWIPA ni patoun vaiteh, mataw kamleng e patetlah a tho awh han.
A lawk na thai awh hoeh e miphun, kacuenaw hai ka bari hoeh e miphun, kanawnaw hai ka pahren hoeh e miphun, ka matheng e miphun lah ao awh han.
Na rawk awh hoehroukrak, taran ni na tuca, maitoca, talai a pawhik ca hane, cakang, misurtui, satui pueng nang hanelah pek mahoeh.
Na ram dawk e na kâuep e khopui rapannaw pueng a tip awh hoehroukrak, na khoram kaawm e pueng a kalup awh han. Na BAWIPA Cathut ni na poe e na ram kaawm e pueng, na khoram kaawm e pueng dawk hai thoseh a kalup awh han.
Na taran ni khik na kalup dawkvah, na BAWIPA Cathut ni na poe e canu capa camosennaw e moinaw hah na ca awh han.
Na onae kho hah taran ni khik a kalup toteh,
a nuen kahawi e tongpa ni a takang lawi vah, amae hmau, a pahren e a yu, hoi a pek e a canu capanaw patenghai yah, rei van laipalah a ca han.
Na onae kho hah taran ni khik a kalup teh runae na kâhmo toteh, a takthai a naw lawi vah, talai patenghai ka coungroe boihoeh e napui ni hai, a pahren e a vâ, a canu hoi a capa patenghai hmawt ngai mahoeh.
A khe e camonaw hoi a thunnaw patenghai arulahoi a ca awh han.
Na BAWIPA Cathut, ka lentoe ni teh takikatho poung e min hah taki hanelah thoseh, hete kâlawk dawk thut lah kaawm e hete lawklungnaw pueng hah kâhruetcuet lahoi na tarawi hoeh pawiteh,
nange lacik hoi na ca catounnaw koe ka phat hane lacik hah atueng ka saw sak vaiteh, dam thai hoeh e kângairu han kawi hah BAWIPA Cathut ni a tho sak han.
Hotnaw e hmalah, nang ni na taki e Izip ram e patawnae pueng hai BAWIPA ni nang dawk a pha sak han. Hotnaw teh nang dawk a kâbet awh han.
Hothloilah, hete kâlawk cauk dawk thut lah kaawm hoeh e patawpanatnae lacik kaawm naw pueng hai, na rawk hoehroukrak BAWIPA ni nang dawk a pha sak han.
Kalvan e âsi yit touh na kapap awh nakunghai, BAWIPA Cathut e lawk na ngâi awh hoeh dawkvah, kayounca lah na o awh han.
BAWIPA ni nangmouh hanlah hawinae sak e hoi pungdaw sak hanelah a ngai e patetlah nangmouh lathueng rawknae pha sak hane hoi nangmouh raphoe e dawk a lunghawi teh, coe hanelah na kâen sin awh e ram thung hoi phawk lah na o awh han.
BAWIPA Cathut ni talai poutnae koehoi avanglah apoutnae koe totouh, miphun pueng koe na kâkahei sak han. Hawvah, na mintoenaw ni a panue awh hoeh e thing cathut, talung cathutnaw hah na bawk awh han.
Hote miphunnaw rahak vah, nang teh roumnae awm mahoeh. Na khok kâhatnae awm mahoeh. Lungtâsuenae, mit thayounnae, hoi lungthoengnae hah BAWIPA ni na poe han.
Nang teh karum khodai pout laipalah, lungpuennae hoi, kadout han na ou, ka hlout han na ou tie panuek laipalah na o han.
Na lungthung vah takinae, na mit hoi na hmu e hno dawkvah, nang ni amom vah tangmin a pha lei saw na ti vaiteh, tangmin vah, amom a pha lei saw na ti han.
Hote lam hah bout na hmawt awh mahoeh toe ka tie lam dawk hoi BAWIPA ni nang hah Izip ram lah lawng hoi bout na thak dawkvah, hote ram dawk sanpa sannu lah o hanelah, tarannaw koe na yo awh han. Hateiteh, apinihai nang hah na ran ngaihoeh telah Isarelnaw koe a dei awh han.
Hethateh, Horeb hmuen koe Isarelnaw hoi BAWIPA ni lawkkam e hloilah, Moab ram dawk Isarelnaw hoi lawkkam hanelah, Mosi koe a dei pouh e lawkkam lawk doeh.
Mosi ni Isarelnaw pueng ama koe a kaw teh, nangmouh ni patuen bout na dei awh hane teh, Izip ram Faro siangpahrang hoi a taminaw hoi a ram pueng e lathueng na mithmu roeroe vah, BAWIPA ni a sak e pueng teh be na hmu awh toe.
Tanouknae, mitnoutnaw, hoi kângairu hnonaw hah na mit hoi roeroe na hmu awh.
Hatei, thaipanueknae lung, hmuthainae mit, thaithainae hnânaw hah sahnin ditouh na poe awh hoeh rah.
A kum 40 touh thung kahrawngum vah nangmouh na hrawi awh toe. Nangmae khohna pawn hoeh. na khokkhawm hai pawn hoeh.
BAWIPA teh nangmae BAWIPA Cathut lah ao tie na panue awh nahanelah, nangmouh ni vaiyei na cat awh hoeh, misur hoi yamu hai na net awh hoeh.
Hete hmuen koe na pha awh navah, Heshbon siangpahrang Sihon hoi Bashan siangpahrang Og tinaw teh, kaimouh na tuk hanelah a tho awh teh, kaimouh ni ka tâ awh.
Aram ka la awh hnukkhu Reuben, Gad, Manasseh miphun tangawn naw hah râw lah ka poe awh.
Na tawksak awh e hno pueng dawkvah, hawinae na coe awh nahanelah, hete lawkkam heh kuen awh nateh hringkhai awh.
Atuvah miphun kahrawikung abuemlahoi,
kacuenaw hoi kahrawikungnaw, Isarelnaw pueng, camosennaw, na yunaw, na imluennaw, na thing katâtuengnaw, na tui kadonaw totouh,
sahnin BAWIPA ni nangmouh koevah, thoebo lah kaawm e lawkkam thungvah na kâen awh thai nahane hoi,
na pa Abraham, Isak, hoi Jakop hoi nangmouh koe lawk a kam teh a dei tangcoung patetlah nangmae Cathut lah ao thai nahane hoi a tami lah na o thai nahanelah caksak lah na o awh nahan,
thoebonae hoi lawkkamnae hah nangmouh koe dueng ka sak e tho hoeh.
Sahnin BAWIPA Cathut hmalah kangdout e hoi atu hi kaawm hoeh e naw koehai a sak e doeh.
(Bangkongtetpawiteh, Izip ram vah bangtelamaw khosak awh tie hoi nangmouh ni na ceinae miphunnaw e rahak vah bangtelamaw na cei awh tie hai na panue awh.
Ahnimae panuettho e hnopainaw hoi, ahnimouh koe kaawm e thing, talung, sui, ngun naw hoi sak e ahnimae meikaphawknaw hah nangmouh ni na hmu awh toe. )
BAWIPA Cathut koehoi phen hane ngainae lungpouk na tawn awh teh, hote miphunnaw e cathutnaw koe na cei awh teh, tongpa, napui, imthung thoseh, miphunnaw hoi ka cet e, kakhat e a paw lungkhueknae a paw, a khongyang teh nangmouh dawk a paw han tie thoseh,
hot patetlae tami teh, thoebonae lawk a thai navah, a lungpata e patetlah ka sak vaiteh, tui kahrannae dawk paruinae mek bawksak nakunghai, lungmawng lah ka o han ka tet e awm langvaih tie ngaihrinae ao.
Ahni teh BAWIPA ni pasai hoeh, dipmanae, lungkhueknae hmaikhu a tâco teh, Cakathoung dawk thut e thoebonae naw ahnimae lathueng ao han. BAWIPA ni ahnie min teh, kalvan rahim a raphoe han.
Hete kâlawk cauk dawk thut e thoebonae lawkkam e patetlah Isarel miphun pueng thung hoi BAWIPA ni a kapek han.
Ram thungvah BAWIPA ni a poe hane lacik hoi patawnae hah na hnuklah ka tho hane sekatha na catounnaw hoi ahlanae koehoi ka tho hane ramlouk e taminaw ni a hmu awh toteh,
Ram thungvah gan, palawi, hoi hmaisaan, cati patue thaihoehnae, apawhik a tâcohoehnae, a lungphuennae hoi a lungkhueknae hoi BAWIPA ni a tâkhawng e Sodom hoi Gomorrah hoi Admah hoi Zeboiim patetlah a tâkhawng e a hmu awh toteh,
miphun pueng ni, bangkongmaw BAWIPA ni hete ram heh hettelah a sak. Hete kalenpounge lungkhueknae heh bang nama aw ati awh han.
Hattoteh taminaw ni, Izip ram hoi a tâcokhai navah, ahnimouh hoi lawk a kam e ahnimae mintoenaw e BAWIPA Cathut e lawkkam hah a ceitakhai awh teh,
ahnimouh hanelah banghai ka pouk thai hoeh e cathut alouke, a panue awh boihoeh e cathut thaw a tawk awh dawk doeh ati awh han.
Hete cakathoung dawk thut lah kaawm e thoebonae pueng, hete ram dawk phasak hanelah, BAWIPA a lungkhuek.
BAWIPA ni lungphuennae, puenghoi lungkhueknae, Lungphuennae hoi ahnimae ram dawk hoi ahnimouh hah a rasa teh, sahnin e patetlah alouke ram dawk a pâlei toe tie hah doeh.
Kamnuek hoeh rae naw teh BAWIPA Cathut mae doeh. Hatei, pâpho e naw teh maimouh hoi maimae canaw hanelah pout laipalah ao teh, hete kâlawknaw pueng teh tarawi nahanelah doeh.
BAWIPA Cathut ni na hreknae miphunnaw pueng koe kaawm e na hmalah ka hruek e yawhawinae hoi thoebonae hah na panue awh teh,
BAWIPA koe bout na ban awh teh, atu kâ na poe e patetlah nama hoi na canaw hoi na lungthin, hringnae abuemlahoi a lawk na tarawi awh pawiteh,
BAWIPA Cathut ni san coungnae koehoi na ban sak awh vaiteh, na pahren awh han. Hahoi BAWIPA ni miphun pueng koe kâkayeinae koehoi bout na pâkhueng awh han.
Nangmouh thung dawk talai pout totouh pâlei e awm pawiteh, BAWIPA na Cathut ni hote hmuen koehoi bout na pâkhueng awh vaiteh, hote hmuen koehoi bout na tâcokhai awh han.
Mintoenaw ni a pang e ram koelah, bout na hrawi awh vaiteh, na pang a han. Hatnavah bout na pahren awh vaiteh mintoenaw hlak hoe na pung sak han.
Na hring thai nahan, BAWIPA na Cathut hah lungthin, hringnae abuemlahoi lungpataw sak hanlah, BAWIPA na Cathut ni na lungthin hoi na catounnaw e lungthin vuensom a a pouh han.
Nang na ka taran ni teh na kapacekpahleknaw, lathueng hai thoseh, ka dei tangcoung patetlah thoebonae pueng ka pha sak han.
Bout na ban vaiteh, BAWIPA e a lawk dei e na tarawi vaiteh, sahnin na poe e kâpoelawknaw pueng na tarawi awh han.
Nang ni na BAWIPA Cathut e lawk hah na tarawi teh,
kâlawk cauk dawk thut e lah kaawm e phunglawk pueng na tarawi pawiteh, na BAWIPA Cathut koe na lungthin abuemlahoi bout na ban pawiteh, na tawk e pueng dawk tânae na hmu awh nahan hoi na canaw, saringnaw, apawhiknaw pung sak vaiteh, nang han hawinae na sak pouh han. BAWIPA teh na mintoenaw koe a lunghawi e patetlah nang dawk a lunghawi vaiteh, nang hanelah ahawinae lah a sak han.
Sahnin na poe e lawk teh na thaipanuek hoeh e lawk nahoeh.
Nang hoi kâhlat hoeh. A lawk ngâi awh teh tarawi nahanelah, kalvan vah apimouh ka luen vaiteh, maimouh koe ka thokhai tie hah pacei sak hanelah kalvan vah kaawm e nahoeh.
A lawk teh maimouh ni ngâi awh teh, tarawi awh nahan, talî apimaw ka rakat ni teh maimouh koe ka thokhai han telah ka pacei hanelah talî namran lah kaawm e nahoeh.
A lawk teh na tarawi nahanelah nang hoi a hnai poung. Na pahni dawk thoseh, na lung dawk thoseh ao.
Khenhaw! hringnae hoi hawinae, duenae hoi thoenae heh sahnin na hmalah ka hruek
Na hring teh na pungdaw nahan hoi na pang hane ram dawk na BAWIPA Cathut ni yawhawi na poe nahan na Cathut hah na lungpataw han, a hnuk na kâbang vaiteh, kâpoelawknaw, phunglawknaw, hoi lawkcengnaenaw hah tarawi loe telah lawk na thui.
Hatei, na lungthin hah alouklah a kamlang teh, lawkngai laipalah tami dumnae koelah na kamlang teh alouke cathut na bawk pawiteh,
Jordan tui na raka teh na pang hane ram dawk na hring saw mahoeh. Atangcalah rawknae koe na pha han telah sahnin kâhruetcuetnae na poe.
Hringnae hoi duenae, yawhawi poenae hoi thoebonae naw na hmalah ka hruek. Nama hoi na canaw ni hring nahanlah rawi lawih. Kapanuekkung kalvan hoi talai ka kaw.
Hatdawkvah, nang hoi na catounnaw ni na hring nahan hoi nange BAWIPA Cathut na lungpataw teh a lawk na tarawi dawkvah, hringsawnae na kapoekung BAWIPA hah na kâhnai nahan thoseh, BAWIPA ni na mintoe Abraham, Isak, Jakop koe thoebo e ram dawk o hane hoi kâvan e hringnae rawi loe telah thoseh Isarel miphun koe a dei pouh.
Mosi ni a cei teh Isarel miphun pueng koe bout a dei pouh e lawk teh,
kai kum 120 a kuep toe. Nangmouh koe ka kâhlai thai hoeh toe, BAWIPA ni hai Jordan palang na rakat mahoeh ati toe.
Nangmae BAWIPA Cathut ni na hmalah a raka teh hote khocanaw a raphoe vaiteh, ahnimae hmuen nangmouh ni na pang awh han. BAWIPA ni a dei e patetlah Joshua ni nangmae hmalah a raka han.
BAWIPA ni hai Amor siangpahrang Sihon hoi Og dawk thoseh, a raphoe e ahnimae ram dawk thoseh, a sak e patetlah hote khocanaw dawk a sak han.
BAWIPA ni ahnimouh nangmouh koe na poe vaiteh, lawk na poe e patetlah ahnimouh dawk a sak han.
Tha kâlat awh nateh, na taranhawi awh. Na lungtâsue awh hanh. Ahnimouh taket awh hanh. BAWIPA teh nangmae Cathut lah ao. Nangmouh hoi rei ka cet e teh BAWIPA doeh. Na hnoun mahoeh, na cettakhai mahoeh telah ati.
Joshua bout a kaw teh, tha kâlat nateh na taranhawi haw. Bangkongtetpawiteh, BAWIPA ni hete tami koe poe hanlah, mintoenaw koe thoebo e ram koelah ahnimouh hoi rei na cei vaiteh, râw na pang awh han.
Na hmalah BAWIPA a cei han, nang hoi rei ao han, hnuklah na kamlang takhai mahoeh, tâsue hanh, na lungpout hanh, telah Isarel miphunnaw hmalah a dei.
Mosi ni hete kâlawk a thut teh, BAWIPA e lawkkam thingkong kâkayawn e Levih miphun vaihmanaw, Isarel miphun kacuenaw koe a poe teh,
Lawk a thui e teh, kum sari akuep nah sannaw hlout nahan sut oup e lukkareiim pawi tueng a pha navah,
Nangmae BAWIPA Cathut ni rawi e hmuen koe Isarel miphun pueng teh, a ham lah kâpâtue hanelah a tho awh toteh, hete kâlawk hah tamimaya hmalah na touk pouh han.
Tongpa, napui, camonaw nangmouh koe kaawm e imyinnaw ni a thai awh teh a kamtu awh teh BAWIPA na Cathut hah a taki awh teh hete kâlawk pueng hah kâhruetcuet laihoi a hringkhai awh nahanlah,
ka thai hoeh rae a canaw ni hai a thai awh nahanlah Jordan palang namran lah cei vaiteh na pang awh hane ram dawk na o awh nathung BAWIPA na Cathut takinae a kamtu thai awh nahanlah pâkhueng loe telah kâ a poe.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe, na due nahane tueng a hnai toe, Joshua kaw nateh kamkhuengnae lukkareiim koe hnai awh. Ahni lawk ka thui han telah atipouh. Hateh Mosi hoi Joshua teh kamnue hanelah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim koe a cei roi.
BAWIPA ni lukkareiim dawk tâmaikhom hoi a kamnue pouh teh, tâmaikhom ni lukkareiim takhang koe a kangdue.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe, na mintoenaw hoi na i han toe. Hete miphunnaw ni atu a pâtam awh e ram dawk kaawm e Jentelnaw ni a bawk e cathutnaw hoi a yon awh teh kai na pahnawt awh vaiteh lawkkam a raphoe awh han.
Hat toteh, kai ka lungkhuek vaiteh, ahnimouh ka kamlang takhai han. A rawk awh vaiteh lungpoutnae hoi rucatnae puenghoi a kâhmo awh han, hatnavah ahnimouh ni Cathut ni maimouh koe ao hoeh dawk hete rucatnae maimouh lathueng a pha nahoehmaw telah a dei awh han.
Ahnimouh ni alouke cathut koe a kamlang awh e yonae dawk, kai ni minhmai ka hro han.
Hatdawkvah, hete la heh ahnimouh han thun pouh. Isarelnaw cangkhaih, Isarelnaw e kong dawk kapanuekkhaikung lah ao nahan a pahni dawk hrueng pouh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, a na mintoenaw koe thoe ka bo e sanutui hoi khoitui a lawngnae ram koe ka hrawi awh vaiteh, ka boum lah a ca awh hnukkhu a thaw awh vaiteh cathut alouke koelah a kamlang awh han. A thaw tawk awh vaiteh kai na taran awh han, ka lawkkam a raphoe awh han.
Rucatnae hoi yawthoenae pueng a kâhmo awh navah, hete la heh amamouh kapanuekkhaikung lah ao nahan a catounnaw e pahni dawk hai pahnim awh mahoeh. Kai ni thoeboe e ram dawk ka ceikhai hoehnahlan atu patenghai a pouknae ka panue toe telah ati.
Mosi ni hai hote hnin navah la a thut teh Isarelnaw a cangkhai.
Nun capa Joshua koe, tha kâlat nateh na taranhawi sak. Kai ni thoe ka bo e ram dawk Isarelnaw na kâenkhai han. Kai ni na okhai han, atipouh.
Mosi ni hete kâlawknaw cauk dawk be a pakhum hnukkhu,
Lawkkam thingkong ka hrawm e Levihnaw a kaw teh,
Hete kâlawk cauk lat awh nateh, namamouh na kapanuekkhaikung lah BAWIPA e lawkkam thingkong hmalah hrueng awh.
Nangmae miphun teh taranthawnae, lungpatanae na tawn awh tie ka panue. Khenhaw! sahnin na hringkhai nah patenghai BAWIPA na taran awh nahoehmaw. Ka due hnukkhu nah tawng teh hothlak na sak awh han rah.
Nangmae miphun dawk kacuenaw, kaukkungnaw abuemlah kai koe kamkhueng awh naseh. Hete lawknaw hah ahnimouh koe ka dei pouh vaiteh, kalvan hoi talai ka kaw han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, kai ka due hnukkhu teh, khoeroe na rawk awh vaiteh, kai ni lawk na thui e lamthung dawk hoi na phen awh han tie hah ka panue. Hmalah toteh BAWIPA hmalah yonnae na sak awh vaiteh, na kut hoi na sak awh e lahoi a lungkhueknae na hroecoe awh dawkvah, nangmouh teh runae hoi na kâhmo awh han telah kâhruetcuetnae a poe.
Hottelah Mosi ni Isarel maya thainae koe hettelah lawknaw heh apout totouh koung a dei pouh.
Oe kalvannaw thai awh haw, lawk ka dei han. Oe talai ka dei e lawk thai haw.
Kaie phunglawk teh kho patetlah masimmasim a rak han. Ka lawk teh tadamtui patetlah a bo han. Patue e naw dawk ka rak e kho patetlah thoseh, phonaw dawk moikapap e kho patetlah thoseh ao han.
BAWIPA e min teh ka pâpho, maimae Cathut lentoenae teh pâpho awh.
Ama teh lungsongpui doeh, a tawksak e akuep. Bangkongtetpawiteh, a lamthung teh a lan, yuemkamcu e Cathut, yon tawn hoeh, katang e hoi kalan e BAWIPA lah ao.
Ahnimouh a rawk awh toe. Cathut e ca lah awm awh hoeh, toun hoeh kawi lah awm awh hoeh. A lungthin a longkawi teh ka payon e miphun lah ao awh.
Oe lungangnae ka tawn hoeh e kapathunaw, BAWIPA e pahrennae hettelamaw na pathung awh han. Ka kawkhikkung na pa nahoehmaw, na sak awh teh na caksak awh hoeh maw.
Ayan e taminaw pahnim hanh awh, Se moi kaloum tangcoung e pouk awh, na pa pacei nateh na dei pouh han, kacuenaw pacei nateh ahnimouh ni a dei awh han.
Lathueng Poung ni Adam catoun lah kaawm e naw hah a kapek teh, râw a rei navah, Isarelnaw a youn a pap e hah a khet teh miphun onae hmuen a khuen pouh.
BAWIPA e ham teh a taminaw doeh. Jakop teh a coe e râw doeh.
Tami kingdinae koe sarang a hram, thingyeiyawn koe Jakop a hmu toteh, khik a vuiluk teh mitmu patetlah a ring.
Mataw ni a tabu a raphoe teh, a canaw lathueng a rathei a kadai teh, a canaw a rathei hoi a tawm e patetlah,
BAWIPA dueng ni doeh Jakop a hrawi, alouke cathut ahni koe awm hoeh.
Talai rasangnae koe hmuen a poe teh, talai a pawhik hah a ca teh, lungha dawk e khoitui hai thoseh, lungtaw dawk e satui hai thoseh,
Tuca thaw, Bashannaw e tutan, maitotan, hmae thaw, satun, kuen dawk e ahrei, maito sanutui, tu sanutui nei hane hoi misur tui thipaling na nei.
Hatei, Jeshurun teh a thâw dawk khok hoi a pâthui. Na thâw, na len, ahrei hoi na kawi dawkvah, na kasakkung Cathut na pahnawt teh rungngangnae lungsong banglahai na noutna hoeh.
Ahnimouh teh alouke cathut lahoi utsin sak awh. Panuet ka tho e hno lahoi a lungkhuek sak awh.
Cathut hoeh e kahrai, panue boihoeh e cathut, mintoenaw ni a taki awh hoeh e cathut koe thuengnae a sak awh.
Na kasakkung lungsong banglahai na ngâi awh hoeh. Na pa lah kaawm e Cathut hah na pahnim toe.
BAWIPA ni hot hah a hmu nah, a lungkhuek, a canu capanaw ni a pahnawt dawkvah.
Kai ni ka minhmai ka hro han, bangtelamaw apoutnae ao han tie ka khet han, lungkapatak e miphun, yuemkamcu hoeh e canaw lah ao awh.
Cathut lah kaawm hoeh e hno lahoi utsinnae tawn sak hanelah a sak awh toe. Ayawmyin e hnopai lahoi lung na khuek sak awh toe. Hatdawkvah, miphun lah kaawm hoeh e lahoi ahnimouh utsin sak hanelah lungkaang hoeh e miphun lahoi lungkhueksak hanelah ka sak han.
Ka lungkhuek teh hmai ka sawi. Kadung poung e sheol totouh a kak han. Talai dawk e a pawhik kamtawisak vaiteh mon kamhungnae totouh a kak han.
Ahnimouh lathueng runae ka thueng pouh han, kaie palanaw hah koung ka ka han.
Vonhlamrinci a khang awh han. Kâannae, puenghoi rawknae lahoi a rawk awh han. Sarangnaw e hâ thoseh, talai dawk kaawm e tahrunsue thoseh, ahnimouh koe ka patoun han.
Alawilah tahloi hoi duenae, imthung taki ka tho e runae ni thoundoun tangla thoseh, sanu ka net lahun e camo hoi a sam ka po tangcoung e matawng thoseh a raphoe han.
Taran kâoupnae ka taket hoeh nakunghai thoseh,
Tarannaw a kâoup awh teh, hete hnopueng BAWIPA ni sak hoeh, ka lentoe e maimae kut ni doeh a sak ati han. Kai lungpuen han ka tawn hoeh nakunghai ahnimouh hah talai pout totouh kampek sak vaiteh, apinihai a pouk hoeh nahanlah ka raphoe han telah pouknae ka tawn.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, lungangnae tawn awh hoeh, poukthainae hai tawn awh hoeh.
Lungangnae tawn awh pawiteh, hete hno heh a thaipanuek awh han ei, hmalae kong hah a pouk awh han ei telah a ti.
A kângue awh e lungsong ni ahnimouh yawt awh hoeh, BAWIPA ni ahnimouh poe hoehpawiteh, tami buet touh ni tami 1,000 touh bangtelamaw a pâlei thai han. Tami kahni touh ni tami thong hni touh bangtelamaw yawngsak thai han.
Maimae tarannaw ni a hmunae dawk teh ahnimae lungsong hoi maimae lungsong kâvan hoeh.
Ahnimae misurkung teh Sodom ram e doeh. Gomorrah talai dawk ka pâw e a kung doeh. Ahnimae misurpaw teh kakhat e a kung dawk e a paw lah ao teh, misurbomnaw teh kakhat e hoi doeh a kawi.
Ahnimae misurtui teh khorui sue, ka patawpoung e hrunthoe sue lah doeh ao.
Hothateh kai koe a pâtung toe. Hnoim dawk hruek lah awm hoehnamaw.
Moipathungnae teh kai ni ka sak hane doeh. Atueng akuep toteh ahnimae khok a tâlaw han. Ahnimouh koe runae pha nahane tueng a hnai toe. A kâhmo awh hane runae karangpounglah a tho han toe.
BAWIPA ni a taminaw hanelah lawk a ceng han. A taminaw teh bahu a baw toe, a paung e ka hlout e buet touh boehai ao hoeh e hah a hmu navah, ahnimouh pahren vaiteh,
Ahnimae cathut, ahnimouh ni a kângue awh e talung nâne ao.
Ahnimouh ni a thuengnae a thâw hah a ca awh teh, nei thuengnae misur kanetnaw teh namaw ao. Thaw awh naseh, nangmouh na kabawm awh naseh.
Kai, kama roeroe Cathut tie thoseh, kai hloilah alouke cathut awmhoeh tie thoseh, khenhaw! ka thei thai, ka hringsakthai, moihna ka thosak thai, ka damsak thai, ka kut dawk hoi apini na lawm thai mahoeh.
A yungyoe kahring e doeh telah kalvan lah ka kut ka dâw teh thoe ka kâbo.
Loukloukkaang e tahloi ka kata teh, lawkcengnae ka patuep teh, ka tarannaw koe moi ka pathung han. Kai na kahmuhmanaw koe kamculah ka pathung han.
Ka palanaw hah thipaling hoi ka paruisak vaiteh, ka tahloi ni a moi a ca han. Thei lah kaawm e sannaw e thipaling hoi taranbawinaw e a lû a ca pouh han.
Jentel miphunnaw nangmouh ni Cathut e a taminaw hoi lung rei hawi awh haw. Bangkongtetpawiteh, kaie sannaw theinae yon hoi kâki lah runae ka rek teh, a tarannaw koe yon moipathung han toe. A ram hoi a taminaw yontha pouh han.
Mosi hoi Nun capa Joshua a tho roi teh hete la lawknaw pueng hah tami pueng koe a dei pouh roi.
Hottelah hete lawknaw Mosi ni Isarelnaw koe he a dei hnukkhu,
Nangmouh koe sahnin ka pâpho e lawknaw pueng heh na lungthung pâkuem awh. Na canaw ni hete kâlawk pueng hah a tarawi awh nahanelah, ahnimouh koe bout dei pouh awh.
Hete hno heh rumram e nahoeh, nangmouh na hringnae hoi kâkuen e doeh. Jordan palang na raka awh teh na pang awh hane ram dawk hete hno na tarawi pawiteh, na hring a saw awh han telah a dei.
Hot hnin vah BAWIPA ni Jeriko namran Moab ram Abiram monrui Nebo monsom a luen teh,
Isarelnaw hah kai ni ka poe e ram hah khenhaw.
Na hmau Aron teh Hor mon vah a due teh a taminaw a kamkhuengnae koe a pha e patetlah nang hai na luennae hete mon dawk dout nateh na taminaw kamkhuengnae koe phat lawih.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, nangmouh ni Zin thingyeiyawn, Kadesh kho Meribah tui teng vah, Isarelnaw hmalah kai barinae tawn laipalah na yon awh toe.
Hatdawkvah, Isarelnaw koe ka poe e ram hah nang ni na mit hoi na hmu nakunghai, hote ram dawk na kâen mahoeh telah Mosi koe a dei pouh.
BAWIPA e tami Mosi ni a due hoehnahlan Isarelnaw yawhawi a poenae lawk hateh,
BAWIPA teh Sinai mon hoi a tho. Seir mon koehoi Isarelnaw koe kanî patetlah a tâco teh, Paran mon koehoi raeng ni pheng a tue. Tami kathoung moikapap hoi rei a tho awh. Isarelnaw hanelah aranglae kut dawk hoi kâlawk hmai a tâco.
Atangcalah BAWIPA ni a taminaw hah a lungpataw. A tami kathoungnaw pueng teh na kut dawk doeh ao awh. Ahnimouh ni na khok koe a tabo awh teh, na lawk hah a dâw awh.
Mosi ni kaimouh hanelah kâlawk na poe awh. Jakop miphunnaw e râw lah ao.
Taminaw kahrawikungnaw teh Isarelnaw hoi rei a kamkhueng awh toteh, Jeshurun khovah nang teh siangpahrang lah na o.
Reuben teh dout laipalah hring naseh. A taminaw pung naseh.
Judah miphun hanelah a dei e teh, Oe BAWIPA Judah e a lawk na thai teh a hmaunawngha aonae koe thokhai haw, a kutnaw hah thapoe haw. Tarannaw kut dawk hoi rungngang haw.
Levih miphun hanelah a dei e teh, nange Thummim hoi nange Urim teh Massah vah na tanouk teh, Meribah tui teng vah na taran e na tami kathoungnaw koe poe haw.
A manu hoi a na pa koevah ka hmawt boihoeh ka tet e ni, a hmaunawngha hah nout hoeh. A canaw hai panuek hoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, na lawk a ngâi awh teh na lawkkam hah a tarawi awh.
Ahnimouh ni nange lawkcengnaenaw hah Jakop miphun koe thoseh, na kâlawk hah Isarelnaw koe thoseh a cangkhai awh han. Ahnimouh ni hmuitui hah na hmalah thoseh, abuemlah hmaisawi thuengnae hah thuengnae khoungroe dawk thoseh a ta awh han.
