Bawipa e Bawkim ka rawk e naw pathoup nahanlah thing hoi talung kuennae hoi im a rawknae koe, a pankinae hmuen pueng koe a hno awh.
Hatei BAWIPA imthungkhu tangka a sin awh hoi BAWIPA im hanlah, ngun, rahum, hoi hmai paduenae hoi Ailo ka dung hoi mongka hoi suihlaamnaw, ngunhlaamnaw hah hote tangka hoi sak hoeh.
Hatei, thaw katawkkungnaw ouk a poe awh teh BAWIPA e im pathoup nahanlah a hno awh.
Thaw katawkkungnaw, poe hanlah tangka a kuem sak awh e naw hoi kuekluek parei pouh hoeh toe. Bangkongtetpawiteh, yuemkamculah a tawk awh.
Kâtapoe thuengnae tangka hoi yon thuengnae tangka teh BAWIPA im dawk kâen sak a hoeh. Hot teh vaihmanaw e ham doeh.
Siria siangpahrang Hazael ni, Gath a tuk. Be a la hnukkhu Hazael teh Jerusalem ban hanlah a noe.
Judah siangpahrang Jehoash ni a na pa hoi Jehoshaphat hoi Jehoram hoi Ahaziah tinaw ni ouk a poe awh e kathounge hnonaw pueng, amamouh ni thoung sak awh e hnonaw hoi BAWIPA im kaawmnaw pueng hoi siangpahrang im vah kaawm, suinaw pueng a la awh teh, Siria siangpahrang Hazael a patawn awh. Hahoi teh Jerusalem a kamlang takhai awh.
Hot patetlah, Joash a tawksaknae naw thung dawk e kaawm rae naw, a sakyoe e naw pueng teh Judah siangpahrang setouknae cauk dawkvah koung thut lah ao nahoehmaw.
Hahoi a taminaw a thaw awh teh a kâcoun awh. Joash teh Silla lah ceinae lam, Millo im vah, a hem awh teh a thei awh.
A san Shimeath capa Jozakhar koevah, Devit khopui dawk a pakawp awh teh a capa Amaziah teh a yueng lah a bawi.
Judah siangpahrang Ahaziah capa Joash a bawinae kum 23 navah, Jehu capa Jehoahaz teh Isarelnaw koe vah Samaria siangpahrang tawk a kamtawng hoi kum 17 touh a uk.
BAWIPA mithmu vah kahawihoehe hno ouk a sak. Isarel ka payonsakkung Nebat capa Jeroboam yonnae hah ouk a sak teh cettakhai hoeh.
BAWIPA lungphuennae Isarel koe a kâan teh, Siria siangpahrang Hazael kut hoi Hazael capa Benhadad kut dawk pou a poe.
Jehoahaz ni BAWIPA koe pou a kâhei teh, BAWIPA ni a lawk hah a ngai pouh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Isarelnaw repcoungroe dawkvah Siria siangpahrang ni repcoungroe e naw hah pou a hmu.
Hahoi teh, BAWIPA ni Isarelnaw hah ka rungngangkung a poe awh. Hahoi Siria kut dawk hoi a tâco awh. Yampa e patetlah Isarelnaw teh, amamouh im vah lungmawngcalah ao awh.
Hatei Isarel kapayonsakkung Jeroboam imthungkhunaw yonnae hah ceitakhai laipalah, pou a sak dawkvah, Samaria kho vah thingmeikaphawk hah pou ao rah.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Jehoahaz ni a taminaw thung dawkvah marangransanaw 50 touh hoi leng 10 touh, ransa 10, 000 touh dueng doeh a tawn. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Siria siangpahrang ni, be a raphoe pouh teh, cangkatinnae vaiphu mungpoung e patetlah doeh a kayei awh.

Elisha ni na lilava lat haw atipouh. A lilava hah a la.

Kanîtholae hlalangaw paawng haw atipouh teh a paawng pouh. Elisha ni, ka haw, atipouh teh a ka. Ahni ni BAWIPA tânae senehmaica, sirianaw tânae senehmaica doeh ka tho. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Aphek kho vah Sirianaw, be a rawk hoehroukrak na tâ han atipouh.

Hatei, ngai pouh hoeh teh, a na mintoenaw ni, BAWIPA Cathut yuem ngai laipalah, a lunglen awh e patetlah a lungpata sak awh.
A phunglam hoi a na mintoenaw koe a lawkkam ahnimouh koe a panue sak e lawk hah, banglahai noutna awh hoeh teh cungkeihoehnaw a panki awh teh, banglahai yah tho kalawn hoeh. Ahnimouh kong dawk BAWIPA ni hot patetlah sak van awh hanh telah a dei tangcoung e hah, a teng kaawm e miphunnaw ni a sak awh e patetlah a kamtu awh.
BAWIPA Cathut e kâpoelawknaw pueng hah, a hnamthun takhai awh teh, maitoca meikaphawk kahni touh a sak awh. Kalvan e kaawmnaw pueng hah a bawk awh. Baal thaw a tawk awh.
A lungphuennae a kâan sak nahanelah, a canu a capanaw hah, hmai hoi thuengnae a sak awh. Camthoumnae hoi taân a sin awh teh, BAWIPA mithmu thoenae sak hanelah ka yo awh.
Hatdawkvah, BAWIPA teh Isarelnaw koe a lungphuen poung teh a hmaitung hoi a takhoe awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Judah miphun hloilah kacawie awm hoeh toe.
Judahnaw ni hai BAWIPA Cathut e kâpoelawknaw a tarawi awh hoeh teh Isarel phunglam hah a dawn awh.
BAWIPA ni Isarel catounnaw hah a pahnawt teh a mithmu vah he kahmat lah a puen hoehroukrak a rek teh ahni katuknaw kut dawk a poe.
Isarel teh Devit imthung dawk hoi a phen teh hahoi Nebat capa Jeroboam hah siangpahrang lah a la awh. Jeroboam ni Isarelnaw e BAWIPA lam a dawn e hah lam a phen sak teh kalenpounge yonnae hah a sak sak awh.
Isarel catounnaw ni Jeroboam ni a sak e yonnae hah a sak awh. Hote hnonaw pueng teh, BAWIPA ni a profetnaw hno lahoi a dei pouh tangcoung patetlah a hmuhoehnae hmuen koe he a takhoe hoehroukrak cettakhai hoeh toe.
Hahoi Isarelnaw teh, amamouh ram koehoi Assiria ram vah a hrawi teh atu totouh ao awh.
Assiria siangpahrang ni, Babilon Kuthah, Ivvah, Hamath, Sepharvaim, hoiyah khocanaw a thokhai teh, Samaria khopui dawkvah, Isarel catoun yueng lah a lawp sak. Hottelah hoi Samaria vah kho a sak awh, a khopui a lawp awh.
Hote kho dawk ao pasuek nah, BAWIPA barilawa tawn awh hoeh. BAWIPA ni ahnimouh koe sendek a tha pouh teh tami tangawn koung a kei.
Hahoi Assiria siangpahrang koevah na takhoe awh e miphun Samaria khopui na khawng sak e naw ni hete ram dawk e cathut bawknae nuencang panuek awh hoeh. Hatdawkvah, ahnimouh koe sendek a tha sin teh khenhaw! het ram cathut bawknae nuencang a panue awh hoeh kecu dawk koung a kei telah a dei awh.
Assiria siangpahrang ni, haw e san lah a la e naw koehoi vaihma buet touh ban sak nateh Cathut bawknae nuencang pâtu naseh telah kâ a poe.
Hahoi Samaria ram hoi a ceikhai e naw thung dawk hoi vaihma buet touh hah, Bethel kho vah ao teh BAWIPA barilawa awh thai nahan a pâtu awh.
Hatei miphun tangkuem ni, amamae cathut lengkaleng a sak awh, Samarianaw ni hmuenrasang a sak awh e hah, miphun tangkuem ni amamouh onae kho tangkuem vah a ta awh.
Babilonnaw ni Sukkothbenoth a sak awh teh Kuthahnaw ni, Nergal a sak awh. Hamathnaw ni Ashima a sak awh teh,
Avvitnaw ni Nibbaz hoi Tartak a sak awh. Hahoi Sepharvaim ni Sepharvaim e cathut Adrammelek hoi Anamalek vah a canaw hah hmai a sawi awh.
BAWIPA teh barilawa a tâ awh teh, amamouh thung dawk hoi hmuenrasang vaihma hah a sak awh teh ayânaw hanlah, thuengnae a sak pouh awh.
BAWIPA teh a taki awh ngoun eiteh, a tâcotakhai awh e, amamae ram e phunglam, a cathut thaw hah ouk a tawk awh.
Ha hoehnahlan e ouk a sak awh, e patetlah atu totouh a sak awh rah. BAWIPA teh taket awh hoeh. BAWIPA ni, Jakop catounnaw, Isarel telah a phung e naw koe,
Cathut alouke taket hanh awh. Ahnimouh teh bawk hanh awh, a thaw hai tawk pouh hanh awh. Ahnimouh koe thuengnae sak hanh awh.
BAWIPA ni a lentoenae hnosakthainae hoi a dâw e kut hoi Izip ram hoi na ka hrawi e BAWIPA hah taket awh nateh bawk awh thuengnae poe awh.
Phunglawk, kâlawk, kâpoelawk yungyoe na hringkhai awh hanelah, ama ni na thut pouh e doeh. Alouke cathutnaw hah taket han awh.
Nangmouh koe ka kam e lawkkam hah na pahnim awh mahoeh. Cathut alouke hah na taket awh mahoeh.
BAWIPA Cathut na taki awh han, hahoi na tarannaw e kut dawk hoi na rungngang han telah a ti.
Hatei ahnimouh ni tarawi han ngai awh hoeh, yampa e a sak e patetlah pou a sak awh.
Hot patetlah, hete miphunnaw ni BAWIPA teh a taki awh. Hatei a sak awh e meikaphawk thaw hai a tawk awh. A catounnaw totouh, a na mintoenaw ni a sak awh e patetlah sahnin totouh pou a sak awh rah.
Isarel siangpahrang Elah capa Hosi a bawinae kum pâthum navah, Judah siangpahrang Ahaz capa Hezekiah teh siangpahrang lah ao.
Bawi a kamtawng navah, ahni teh kum 25 touh a pha. Jerusalem vah 29 a bawi teh a manu min teh Abi, Zekhariah canu doeh.
A na min Devit ni a sak e pueng a sak teh BAWIPA mithmu vah kalan e hah ouk a sak.
Hmuenrasang hah a pahnawt teh meikaphawknaw a raphoe awh. Mosi ni a sak e rahum tahrun hah rep a dei awh. Hote atueng totouh Isarelnaw ni ahni koe hmuitui a thueng awh teh, hot teh Nehushta atipouh awh.
Ahni teh Isarel BAWIPA Cathut a kângue. Hahoi ahni hnukkhu hoi Judah siangpahrangnaw thung dawk ahni patetlah apihai awm hoeh, a hnukkhu hai awm hoeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, BAWIPA hah kacaklah a kuet. A hnuk pou a kâbang. BAWIPA ni Mosi koe a kâpoelawknaw a poe e hah a tarawi.
BAWIPA ni ahni koe ao pouh, a tâco a ceio nah pueng koe a lamcawn pouh. Assiria siangpahrang hah a tuk teh a san lah awm pouh hoeh.
Filistinnaw hoiyah, Gaza totouh kacakpounge khopuinaw hoi ramvengimnaw hah koung a tâ awh.
Hezekiah siangpahrang a bawinae kum 4 navah Isarel siangpahrang Elah capa Hosi a bawinae kum 7 nah hettelah doeh ao. Assiria siangpahrang Shalmaneser ni Samaria a tuk teh king a kalup.
A kum pâthum abaw tawmlei nah a la. Hezekiah a bawi kum 6 navah Isarel siangpahrang Hosi a bawi kum 9 nah Samaria koung a la.
Isarelnaw ni BAWIPA e kâpoelawk a ngâi awh hoeh, kecu dawk Samaria teh Assiria ni a la awh. BAWIPA e san Mosi koehoi Isarelnaw hai BAWIPA e lawkkam a sak awh e teh a ek awh teh, tarawi ngai awh hoeh. Lawk ngai awh hoeh teh a lawkkam hai tarawi awh hoeh.
Assiria siangpahrang ni Isarelnaw hah, Assiria ram koung a hrawi teh, Gozan palang teng, Medes khopui Halah, Habor naw dawkvah a ta.
Siangpahrang Hezekiah ni Judah ram a uknae kum 14 nah, Assiria siangpahrang Sennacherib ni Judah ram thung rapan hoi king kalup e khopuinaw a tuk teh koung a tâ.
Lakhish ni Assiria siangpahrang koevah, Judah siangpahrang Hezekiah ni ka payon toe. Na ban takhai teh, kai van na toung e pueng teh ka tawk han telah lawk a thui. Assiria siangpahrang ni Judah siangpahrang Hezekiah koe tangka talen 300 touh hoi sui talen 30 touh a hei.
Hahoi teh, Hezekiah ni, BAWIPA im hoi siangpahrang im a ta awh e tangka hoi suinaw pueng a poe.
Hezekiah ni, BAWIPA bawkim takhang a hlun awh e Judah siangpahrang Hezekiah ni khom sui e a hlun e hah abuemlah he a la teh Assiria siangpahrang a poe.
Hahoi Assiria siangpahrang ni ransabawi Rabsaris, Rabshakeh, hoi ransa moikapap hoi Lakhish hoi Jerusalem Judah siangpahrang Hezekiah koe vah, a patoun teh, Jerusalem a pha awh. A pha toteh hnicu kapasunaw law lam tuikamuemnae kanîtholah, kaawm e tui lanae a teng vah a kangdue awh.
Siangpahrang hah a kaw a toteh, imthung kahrawikung, Hilkiah capa Eliakim hoi cakathutkung Shebna, hoi lairui kathutkung Asaph capa Joab hah ahnimouh koe a tâco.
Rabshakeh ni, Hezekiah koevah dei pouh awh, siangpahrang ka lentoe Assiria siangpahrang ni, telah a dei, apimaw na kângue teh na lungmawngkhai vaw.
Ransa thaw nahane teh, thaonae hoi khokhangthoumnae ka tawn na ti nahoehmaw. Hatei, hot teh lawk rumram na dei e doeh. Kai tuk hanelah, apimaw na kângue.
Khenhaw! kâkhoe e lungpum sonron Izip na kângue teh hot patetlae tami ngaihawi pawiteh, a kut a ruk pouh han, Izip siangpahrang Faro ka kângue e pueng teh, hot patetlah doeh ouk ao awh.
Nahoeh pawiteh, kai koevah BAWIPA Cathut hah ka kângue na teh awh pawiteh, ahni teh Hezekiah ni, Judahnaw hoi Jerusalem hanlah, Jerusalem e thuengnae khoungroe hmalah, hmuenrasang koe na bawk awh han na ka tet ni teh hote khoungroe ka raphoe e hah ahni nahoehmaw telah a ti.
Hot patetlah, ka bawipa Assiria siangpahrang hoi lawkkamnae sak awh. Avan kâcui hane na hmawt thai pawiteh, marang 2,000 touh na poe han.
Bangtelamaw marang hoi marangransanaw kecu dawk Izipnaw koe na yuemnae na patue pawiteh, bawipa e sannaw thung dawk ka thoungca e kahrawikung buet touh heh na rungngang thai han vaw.
BAWIPA laipalah hoi maw na ram heh ka tuk teh ka raphoe awh vaw. BAWIPA ni kai koevah, hete ram tuk hanlah cet haw, be raphoe haw na ti pouh dawk doeh.
Hilkiah capa Eliakim hoi Shebna hoi Joab ni Rabshakeh koevah pahren lahoi na sannaw hah, Aramaih lawk hoi ka pato awh toe. Bangkongtetpawiteh, hot teh ka thai awh ngoun. khopui kalupnae thung kaawmnaw a thai nahanlah Hebru lawk hoi na pato hanh lawih telah ati awh.
Hatei, Rabshakeh ni a hni koe, ka bawipa ni na bawipa koe nangmouh koe dueng maw, hete lawk dei hanelah, na patoun vaw. Rapan van ka tahung e amae payungpaei ka cat ka net naw koe maw na patoun vaw telah a ti.
Rabshakeh teh a kangdue teh, Hebru lawk hoi kacaipounglah a hram teh, ka lentoe Assiria siangpahrang lawk hah ngai awh haw.
Siangpahrang ni telah a dei. Hezekiah ka dum e lah awm hanh awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh ama ni, a kut dawk hoi na rungngang thai mahoeh.
Hezekiah ni, BAWIPA ni na rungngang roeroe vaiteh hete khopui heh Assiria siangpahrang kut dawk poe lah awm mahoeh telah BAWIPA hah kângue awh hanh naseh.
Hezekiah lawk hah yuem hanh awh. Assiria siangpahrang ni hettelah a dei. Kai koe roumnae sak awh nateh hi tho awh. Na ram patetlah cakang hoi misur e ram, vaiyei hoi misur takha,
Olive hoi khoitui ram, dout laipalah hringnae ram, koe na ceikhai hoehroukrak teh tami pueng ni mae misurkung dawk hoi a paw cat awh nateh tami pueng ni, mae thaibunglung dawk e a paw rip ca vaiteh tami pueng ni mae tuikhu tui rip net awh. Hezekiah ni BAWIPA ni na rungngang awh han doeh telah na ka pasawt nakunghai tang awh hanh loe.
Miphun tangkuem e cathutnaw ni, a ram teh Assiria siangpahrang koehoi ouk na rangngang awh boimaw.
Hamath hoi Arpad cathutnaw hah namaw koung ao awh vaw. Sepharvaim hoi Hena hoi Ivvah naw e cathutnaw hai namaw koung ao awh. Samaria hah kai koehoi na rungngang thai awh maw.
Ram tangkuem cathutnaw pueng thung dawk hoi apimaw kai koehoi ka rungngang thai. BAWIPA ni Jerusalem kho heh kai koehoi a rungngang han taya telah a ti.
Ahnimanaw teh duem ao awh teh kam touh boehai pathung awh hoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, siangpahrang ni kâlawk poe e patetlah ahnimanaw teh pathung awh hanh loe atipouh.
Hahoi teh, siangpahrang imthung kahrawikung Hilkiah capa Eliakim hoi cakathutkung Shebna hoi lairui kathutkung Asaph capa Joab hah a phi awh e khohna a kâmahrawksak teh, Hezekiah koevah a cei awh teh, Rabshakeh ni a dei e lawk hah a dei pouh awh.
Siangpahrang Hezekiah ni hote hah a thai toteh, a khohna hah a phi teh, burihni a kâkhu teh BAWIPA im vah a kâen.
Imthung kahrawikung Eliakim hoi cakathutkung Shebna hoi vaihma kacuenaw ni burihni a kâkhu awh teh Amos capa profet Isaiah koevah a patoun awh.
Siangpahrang ni Isaiah koevah, sahnin teh rucatnae hoi yuenae hoi pacekpahleknae hnin doeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, camo a khenae tue yo a pha ei teh khe nahane a tha awm hoeh.
A bawipa Assiria siangpahrang ni, kahring Cathut pacekpahlek hanlah, a patoun e Rebshakeh ni a dei e lawknaw pueng hah BAWIPA Cathut ni thai vaiteh BAWIPA Cathut ni a thai e lawk dawk hoi a yue thai. Hote kecu dawk kaawmnaw hanlah ratoum pouh naseh.
Hahoi teh, Siangpahrang Hezekiah e taminaw teh Isaiah koevah a cei awh.
Isaiah ni, ahnimouh koe na bawipa koe hettelah na dei awh han, BAWIPA ni hettelah a dei, na thai awh e lawk Assiria siangpahrang e taminaw ni na pacekpahlek awh e hah taket hanh awh.
Khenhaw! ahnimouh koe muitha buet touh ka patoun han. Kamthang a thai vaiteh, ama ram lah a ban han. Hahoi teh amae ram dawk roeroe vah, tahloi hoi ka kamlei sak han telah atipouh.
Hahoi Rebshakeh teh, a ban teh Assiria siangpahrang ni, Libnah a tuk nah a hmu, bangdawk Lakhish hai yo a tâco toe tie hah a thai.
Hahoi khenhaw! nang hoi kâtuk hanelah, a kamthaw toe telah, Tirhakah, Ethiopia siangpahrang kong ayâ ni a dei e hah a thai. Hahoi Hezekiah koe patounenaw bout a patoun.
Hettelah Judah siangpahrang Hezekiah koe na dei pouh han, na kângue awh e na Cathut ni, Jerusalem heh Assiria siangpahrang kut dawk poe mahoeh na ti awh e hah, telah na dum hanh naseh.
Khenhaw! Assiria siangpahrangnaw ni, ramnaw pueng koung a raphoe teh, ahnimouh lathueng a sak e naw na thai toe. Nang hah na rungngang han tangngak ma aw
Kaie mintoenaw ni a raphoe e Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, Eden tami Telassar ahnimae cathutnaw ni a rungngang awh nama aw.
Hamath siangpahrang, Arpad siangpahrang, Sepharvaim khopui siangpahrang, Hamath siangpahrang hoi Ivvah siangpahrangnaw hateh, namaw koung ao awh vaw telah atipouh.
Hezekiah ni, a patounenaw kut dawk e ca hah a hmu teh a touk pouh. Hahoi teh Hezekiah teh BAWIPA im a kâen teh BAWIPA hmalah ca teh a kadai.
Hezekiah ni BAWIPA hmalah a ratoum teh Oe Bawipa, Cherubim rahak vah kho ka sak e Isarel Cathut, nang nama dueng doeh talai van pueng uknaeram thung Cathut lah na kaawm, talai hoi kalvan hai nang ni na sak e doeh.
Oe BAWIPA, na hnâpakeng haw nateh, na thai pouh haw. Oe BAWIPA na mit padai nateh khenhaw! kahring Cathut pacekpahlek e Sennacherib ni lawk a dei e hah thai haw.
BAWIPA, Assiria siangpahrangnaw ni, miphunnaw hoi a ramnaw teh a raphoe ei.
A cathutnaw hai hmai dawk koung a phum pouh ei. Bangkongtetpawiteh, hotnaw teh cathutnaw ka tang na hoeh. Tami kut hoi sak e, thing hoi talung doeh, hatdawkvah a raphoe awh.
Hatdawkvah oe BAWIPA, kaimae Cathut nang nama dueng doeh, BAWIPA Cathut lah na kaawm tie talai uknaeramnaw pueng ni, nang na panue thai nahan, na kut hoi na rungngang lah, telah atipouh.
Hote tueng dawk Amos capa Isaiah ni, Hezekiah koevah Isarel BAWIPA Cathut ni telah a dei. Assiria siangpahrang Sennacherib taran lahoi yah, kai koe a ratoum e teh ka thai toe.
Hetheh, hot kong dawk hoi BAWIPA ni a dei e doeh. Zion canu tanglakacuem ni, pacekpahlek hoi na panuikhai e hah, Jerusalem canu ni a lû a kahek.
Apimaw a min na mathoe sak teh, na pacekpahlek. Apimaw lawk hoi na hram sin, na mit na ueng sin, Isarel tami kathoung koe kai ma.
Na patounenaw hno lahoi BAWIPA teh na pacekpahlek. Kaie rangleng moikapap hoi Lebanon ram kadung poung hoi monnaw koe ka pha teh, haw e sidar thing kahawinaw hoi hmaica thingnaw ka tâtueng vaiteh, talai ahawinae ratu, kho a rasang na koe hoe a dung nah koevah, ka kâen han.
Ram alouknaw e tui hah ka tai teh, ka tâco sak teh ouk ka nei, ka khoktabei ni Izip ramnaw pueng koung ka hak sak han telah ati.
Kai ni ayan hai ka sak e nahoehmaw, Atu teh kai ni ka sak e ti teh na panuek hoeh maw. Vaipuen lah a coung nahan raphoe e khopui rapan lah na o nahanelah, hottelah atu koung kahma sak toe.
Hatdawkvah a thung a kaawm e taminaw teh, tha a youn awh dawkvah, a yawng awh teh yeirai a phu awh.
Hatei na onae hmuen na kâen, na tâco, kai taranlahoi na lungphuen tie ka panue.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, kai taranlahoi na lungphuen pawiteh, kai koe ut na sin e teh ka hnâ koe koung a pha toe. Hatdawkvah na hnawng dawk hradang ka ta vaiteh, na pahni hah khakkhui vaiteh, hahoi na thonae koe lam hoi bout na ban sak han.
Hetheh, nang hanlah kamnuenae lah ao han. Takum teh amahmawk ka paw e hah, na khan awh vaiteh, palawng haiyah, amahmawk ka paw e na khan awh han. A kum pâthum teh, cang tu awh nateh, misur takha hah sak awh nateh a paw hah cat awh.
Judah imthungkhunaw thung dawk ka hlout ni teh kacawiraenaw ni, rahim lah khongyang a pabo vaiteh lathueng lah a paw a paw awh han.
Bangtelah tetpawiteh, kaawm e naw hah Jerusalem lahoi a ban awh han. Zion mon dawk kacawiraenaw hah a cei awh han. Ransahu BAWIPA ngaikhainae lahoi hothateh, a sak han.
Hatdawkvah BAWIPA ni Assiria siangpahrang kong teh, telah doeh a dei. Ahni teh hete khopui kâen mahoeh. Khokhu dawk pala pathui mahoeh. Khopui hmalah bahling hah patue mahoeh, kho lawi vah talai na paten mahoeh.
A thonae lam koe lahoi a ban vaiteh, khopui thung kâen mahoeh.
Kai kecu dawk hoi thoseh, ka san Devit kecu dawk hoi thoseh, hete khopui teh ka rungngang hanelah ka ring han, BAWIPA ni ati, telah tami a patoun.
Hahoi teh hote tangmin vah, BAWIPA kalvantami hah a cei teh, Assirianaw ni a roenae hmuen dawk 185,000 a thei awh. Amom maya a thaw toteh khenhaw! ro doeh patkâhai toe.
Hahoi Assiria siangpahrang Sennacherib teh, a tâco, im vah a ban teh Nineveh kho vah pou ao.
Hahoi, a cathut Nisroch im vah a bawk lahun nah a capa Adrammelek hoi Sharezer ni, tahloi hoi a thei roi teh, Ararat ram vah a yawng roi. Hahoi a capa Esarhaddon ni a yueng lah a uk.
Hote tueng nah, Hezekiah teh a pataw teh meimei a due. Hahoi Amos capa profet Isaiah a tho teh ahni koe BAWIPA ni telah a dei. Na imthungkhu hah, cingthui leih. Bangkongtetpawiteh, na due han, na hring mahoeh toe telah atipouh.
Hahoi tapang koe lah a kamlang teh BAWIPA koevah,
Oe BAWIPA na hmalah yuemkamcu e lungthin hoi ka o e hoi na mithmu vah hawinae ka sak e hah na pahnim pouh hanh, telah Hezekiah teh a khuika laihoi a ratoum.
Isaiah teh khopui lungui a pha hoehnahlan, BAWIPA e lawk hah ahni koe a pha pouh.
Ban nateh ka taminaw kahrawikung Hezekiah koevah dei pouh. BAWIPA Devit e BAWIPA Cathut ni hettelah a dei. Ratoumnae ka thai teh na mitphi ka hmu toe. Na dam sak mingming han. Apâthum hnin vah BAWIPA im vah bout na cei han.
Hahoi na hringnae hah kum hlaipanga touh ka thap sin han. Assiria siangpahrang kut dawk hoi nang nama hoi na khopui hah, ka rungngang vaiteh, kai hoi ka san Devit kecu dawk hete khopui heh ka ring han telah a ti.
Hahoi Isaiah ni, thaibunglung paw buem buet touh thokhai awh haw atipouh e patetlah, a thokhai teh, a hmâ dawk a bet teh pin ahawi.
Hezekiah ni Isaiah koevah BAWIPA ni na dam sak han, apâthum hnin vah, BAWIPA im vah bout na cei han tie mitnout teh bang han na maw telah a pacei.
Isaiah ni, BAWIPA ni a dei e hah a sak roeroe han tie nang hanlah BAWIPA koehai mitnout lah kaawm han. Tâhlip hah, lakhout hra touh luen sak maw na ngai, hoehpawiteh hra touh kum sak maw na ngai atipouh.
Hezekiah ni a pathung teh tâhlip lakhout hra touh a luen hane teh ayawica dawkvah telah teh tho na hanh seh. Tâhlip hah lakhout hra touh kum naseh telah atipouh.
Hottelah profet Isaiah ni BAWIPA hah a kaw toteh, Ahaz e kanîsuimilam dawk e a tâhlip lakhout hra touh ka cet tangcoung e hah lakhout hra touh a ban sak.
Hote tueng nah, Babilon siangpahrang Baladan capa Berodakbaladan ni ca hoi poehno hoi Hezekiah teh a patawn. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Hezekiah teh a pataw tie a panue.
Hottelah Hezekiah ni, ahnimanaw teh im a luen sak awh. Hno Aphu kaawmnaw tanae pueng hoi sui hoi ngun, hmuitui hoi, aphu kaawm poung e satui hoi tarantuknae puengcangnaw tanae imthung hoi râw onae naw pueng hai a khet sak. A im thoseh, a ram thung kaawm e thoseh, Hezekiah ni a khet sak hoeh e banghai awm hoeh.
Hote tueng nah, profet Isaiah ni, siangpahrang Hezekiah koe a cei teh, ahni koe vah, hote taminaw ni bangmaw a dei awh. Na lahoi maw a tho awh telah atipouh. Hezekiah ni kahlatpoung e ram Babilon hoi kathonaw doeh atipouh.
Ahnimouh ni, na imthungkhu bangmaw a hmu awh atipouh. Hezekiah ni ka imthungkhu kaawmnaw teh be ka patue teh, hnoim thung e ka pâtue hoeh e banghai awm hoeh atipouh.
Isaiah ni, Hezekiah koevah, BAWIPA e lawk heh thai haw.
Khenhaw! na imthungkhu kaawmnaw puenghoi sahnin totouh na mintoenaw ni a pâtung e naw heh Babilon kho vah a ceikhainae tueng ka phat han, banghai a ceitakhai e awm mahoeh telah BAWIPA ni a ti.
Hahoi na imthungkhu dawk na khe awh han rae na canaw hah a ceikhai awh vaiteh, Babilon siangpahrang im vah tuenlanaw lah a coung sak han telah atipouh.
Hezekiah ni Isaiah koevah na dei e BAWIPA lawk hah ahawi. Bangkongtetpawiteh, kaie ka se dawkvah roumnae hoi lawkkatang hah awm mahoeh toung maw atipouh.
Hot patetlah Hezekiah tawksaknae thung dawk hoi kaawm rae naw, a sakyoenae pueng tuiim hoi tui lanae a sak teh khopui thung dawk tui lanae kong teh, Judah siangpahrang setouknae cauk dawk thut lah ao nahoehmaw.
Hezekiah teh a na mintoenaw koe vah a kâhat teh a capa Manasseh ni a yueng lah a uk.
Manasseh teh siangpahrang lah ao nah, kum 12 touh a pha. Jerusalem vah kum 55 siangpahrang lah ao. A manu min teh Hephzibah doeh.
Isarel catounnaw hmalah BAWIPA ni a pâlei e miphunnaw ni panuettho e hnokahawi hoeh e ouk a sak awh e naw hah BAWIPA mithmu vah ouk a sak awh.
Bangtelane tetpawiteh, A na pa Hezekiah ni a raphoe e hmuenrasang hah bout a sak dawkvah, Isarel siangpahrang Ahab ni ouk a sak e Baal bawknae khoungroe lah bout kangdue teh thingmeikaphawk a sak awh, kalvan kaawmnaw pueng hah a bawk awh teh a thaw hah a tawk pouh awh.
BAWIPA ni Jerusalem vah ka min ka o sak han ati e patetlah BAWIPA im vah thuengnae khoungroe a sak awh.
BAWIPA bawknae im thongma kahni touh dawkvah, kalvan âsinaw bawk nahanelah thuengnae khouengroe a sak awh.
Amae a ca hah, hmaisawi thuengnae lah a sak teh kutkhetkathoumnaw a khet sak teh, sueânnae hah a hno awh. Hmaui hoi kahrainaw hah a kambawngkhai awh. Cathut e lungkhueknae hoe a kâan sak awh teh, BAWIPA hmalah yonnae kalen a sak awh.
BAWIPA ni, Devit hoi a capa Solomon koevah hete im hoi Jerusalem, Isarel miphunnaw pueng thung hoi ka rawi e dawkvah, ka min teh yungyoe ka o sak vaiteh,
Kâ na poe e pueng hoi ka san Mosi koe kâ ka poe e naw pueng patetlah na tarawi awh pawiteh, na mintoenaw koe ka poe tangcoung e, ram thungup hai Isarelnaw teh nâtuek hai a khok paheng sak mahoeh atipouh e imthung vah, thingmeikaphawk a sak awh e hah a ta awh.
Hatei banglahai noutna awh hoeh teh, BAWIPA ni Isarel catounnaw hmalah a pâlei awh e miphunnaw ni a sak awh e hlak hai ka mathout lah sak hanlah, Manasseh ni ayânaw a pasawt.
Hatdawkvah, BAWIPA ni a san profet hno lahoi a dei e teh,
Judah siangpahrang Manasseh ni, het hloi e panuettho e hno hah ayan vah Amornaw hlak hai hoe ka nut lah a sak awh teh Judahnaw hah meikaphawk hno lahoi yonnae a saksak.
Hatdawkvah Isarel BAWIPA Cathut ni, hettelah a dei, khenhaw! Jerusalem hoi Judahnaw koe kamthang ka thai tangkuem koe a hnâ kahni touh hoi hoe ka tâdeng sak han.
Jerusalem khopui koe Samaria bangnuenae rui hoi Ahab imthungnaw ka bangnue e patetlah, Jerusalem ka bangnue han. Ailo pâle hnukkhu det pakhup e patetlah ka ta han.
Kacawie hnonaw teh ka tâkhawng vaiteh a taran kut dawk ka poe pouh han. Hottelah, a na mintoenaw Izip ram hoi a tâco hnin hoi sahnin totouh ka mithmu vah, hnokathout a sak awh teh ka lungkhueknae na pahrue awh toe telah ati.
Hatdawkvah, mintoenaw ni, Izip ram hoi na tâconae hnin hoi sahnin totouh nangmae catounnaw ni kai ka hmalah, yonnae doeh pou na sak awh.
Hothloilah BAWIPA mithmu vah, hawihoehnae hah a sak awh teh Judahnaw pueng yonnae a saksak hloilah, Jerusalem avangvanglah totouh, Manasseh ni yon ka tawn hoeh naw e thi moi a palawng.
Hahoi Manasseh tawksaknae hoi kaawm rae, yon a sak e naw teh Judah siangpahrangnaw setouknae cauk dawk thut e lah ao nahoehmaw.
Manasseh teh a na mintoenaw koe a kâhat teh, Uzziah takha amae imteng vah a pakawp awh. Hahoi a capa Amon ni a yueng lah a uk.
Amon teh siangpahrang lah ao nah kum 22 touh a pha. Jerusalem vah kum 2 touh a bawi, a manu min teh Meshullemeth, Jotbah kho e Haruz canu doeh.
A na pa Manasseh ni, ouk a sak e patetlah BAWIPA mithmu vah thoenae a sak.
A na pa ni a dawn e lamnaw hah a dawn van teh, a na pa ni meikaphawk thaw a tawk e hah a tawk teh a bawk.
A na mintoenaw e BAWIPA Cathut a ceitakhai teh BAWIPA lamthung dawn hoeh.
Amon e a taminaw ni pouk a youk awh teh, siangpahrang teh ama im vah a thei awh.
Hatei hote ram e taminaw ni pouk ka youk e Amon e taminaw pueng hah be a thei awh. Hahoi teh hote ram e taminaw ni a capa Josiah teh a yueng lah siangpahrang a tawk sak awh.
Amon tawksaknae dawk hoi kaawm rae teh, Judah siangpahrangnaw setouknae cauk dawk be thut lah ao toung nahoehmaw.
Hahoi Uzzah e takha thung, amae tangkom dawkvah a pakawp awh teh a capa Josiah ni a yueng lah a uk.
Josiah teh siangpahrang a tawk nah kum 8 touh boung a pha. Jerusalem vah kum 31 touh siangpahrang a tawk. A manu min teh Jedidah, Bozkath kho e Adaiah e canu doeh.
BAWIPA mithmu vah hnokahawi pou a sak. A na pa Devit ni a dawn e lamnaw pueng a dawn teh avoilah aranglah phen hoeh.
Siangpahrang Josiah a bawi kum 18 nah hettelah ao. Meshullam capa, Azaliah capa cakathutkung Shaphan hah a patoun teh,
vaihma kacue Hilkiah koevah cet nateh, longkha karingkungnaw ni taminaw koe a la awh teh BAWIPA e im dawk a thokhai e tangkanaw hah touk naseh.
Hahoi, BAWIPA im dawk thaw katawknaw khenyawnkung koe poe nateh ahni ni a rawknae koe e pathoup nahanelah, BAWIPA im vah thaw katawknaw hoi,
thingkong kasakkung, im kasakkung hoi im rawknae kapathoupkung naw ni, a rawknae pathoup nahane dawk thing hoi talung naw ran nahanelah poe naseh, telah BAWIPA im lah a patoun.
Hateiteh tangka ka sin sak e naw ni touk hai touk awh hoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, yuemkamculah a hno awh.
Vaihma kacue Hilkiah ni cakathutkung Shaphan koevah, BAWIPA im dawk kâlawk cauk hah ka hmu telah atipouh. Hilkiah ni cauk teh Shaphan koe a poe teh ahni ni a touk.
Hahoi, cakathutkung Shaphan ni siangpahrang koe a cei teh, siangpahrang koevah kamthang ka thokhai. Na taminaw ni im dawk e tangka a hmu e naw hah BAWIPA e im dawk thaw katawknaw a poe toe telah atipouh.
Cakathutkung Shaphan ni, vaihma Hilkiah ni cauk na poe na a telah siangpahrang koe a dei pouh teh, Shaphan ni siangpahrang e hmalah a touk.
Hahoi, siangpahrang ni kâlawk cauk dawk e lawk a thai toteh angki hah a phi.
Siangpahrang ni, vaihma Hilkiah, Shaphan capa Ahikam, Mikaiah capa Akbor, cakathutkung Shaphan hoi siangpahrang e a san Asaiah koevah,
kai hoi maya hoi Judahnaw pueng hanelah, hete cauk dawk hmu e lah ao patetlah BAWIPA koe na het pouh awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, sak awh hane hete mintoenaw ni a sak hoeh kecu dawk maimouh tak dawk BAWIPA lungkhueknae teh hoe a len telah a ti.
Hahoi vaihma Hilkiah, Ahikam, Akabor, Shaphan hoi Asaiah a hnicu khenyawnkung Harhas capa Tikvah capa, Shallum napui profet Huldah koevah a cei awh teh a kâhno awh. (Ahni teh Jerusalem kho hnuklah ao)
Napui ni ahnimouh koe Isarel BAWIPA Cathut ni hettelah a dei, kai koe kapatounkung koe,
khenhaw! hete hmuen koehai thoseh, athung e kho kasaknaw koehai thoseh, Judah siangpahrang ni cauk dawk a touk e rawkphainae patetlah rawkphainae hah a pha sak han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, na ceitakhai awh teh cathut alouke koe hmuitui a thueng awh teh, a kut hoi a sak awh e ni ka lung na khuek sak awh dawkvah, hete hmuen koevah ka lungkhueknae hmai hoe ka pataw lah ka kaman sak vaiteh roum mahoeh toe.
Hatei kai koe hei hane a patoun e naw Judah siangpahrang koevah BAWIPA Cathut ni hettelah a dei. Na thai e lawk kong dawk,
hete hmuen hoi athung kaawm e taminaw heh ka rawk e hoi thoebo e lah ao awh han telah ka dei e hah na thai toe. Na lung a nem teh BAWIPA hmalah kârahoum laihoi na angki na phi teh ka hmalah na ka dawkvah, kai ni hai na lawk ka thai telah, BAWIPA ni a ti.
Hottelah, khenhaw! na mintoenaw koe na cei vaiteh na tangkom dawk karoumcalah na cei han. Hete hmuen koe rawknae kâhmo hane naw teh na mit ni koung hmawt mahoeh ati telah na dei pouh awh han telah atipouh. Hottelah kamthang teh siangpahrang koevah a dei pouh awh.
Siangpahrang ni tami a patoun teh, Judah hoi Jerusalem kacuenaw ka kamkhueng awh.
Siangpahrang teh Judah ram e tami pueng hoi Jerusalem kaawm e pueng hoi, vaihma hoi profetnaw hoi tami kathoung kalen pueng hoi BAWIPA e im lah a cei awh teh, BAWIPA im dawk a hmu awh e a lawkkamnae cauk dawk kaawm e pueng ahnimae hmalah koung ka thai lah a touk pouh.
Siangpahrang ni khomkung koe a kangdue teh cauk dawk kaawm e lawkkamnae lawk hah, caksak hane hoi lungthin abuemlahoi muitha abuemlahoi BAWIPA tarawi hane kâpoelawk poe e hoi, a panuesaknaenaw, hoi phunglawknaw tarawi hanelah BAWIPA hmalah a lawk a kam. Tami pueng ni lawkkamnae a caksak awh.
Vaihma kacue Hilkiah hoi kadounkung vaihmanaw hoi takhang karingkungnaw hah BAWIPA im thung e Baal hoi Asherah hoi kalvan kaawm e hnonaw hanelah a sak e hnopai pueng a tâcokhai hanelah kâ a poe. Jerusalem alawilah Kidron kahrawngum vah hmai a sawi teh hraba hah Bethel lah a ceikhai.
Meikaphawk ka bawk e vaihma, Judah siangpahrangnaw ni Judah ram khonaw hmuenrasangnaw hoi Jerusalem tengpam e hmuitui kasawinaw hah a pahnawt awh teh, Baal, kanî, thapa, âsi hane hoi kalvan kaawm e pueng hane hmuitui hmai ouk kasawinaw hah a pahnawt awh.
BAWIPA im dawk thing hoi meikaphawk hah Jerusalem kho lawilah Kirdron palang vah a ceikhai awh teh, Kirdron palang dawk hmai a sawi awh. Kanuikapin lah a hruek awh teh kanuikapinnaw hah mathoenaw e tangkom dawk a pasa awh.
Hahoi thing meikaphawk, hni kakawngkung napuinaw a onae hoi BAWIPA im napuitongpanaw onae imnaw a raphoe awh.
Vaihma pueng Judah khonaw koehoi a kaw sak awh teh, ahnimouh ni hmuitui hmaisawinae hmuenrasangnaw hah Geba hoi Beersheba totouh a khin sak awh teh, Jerusalem e khobawi Joshua e longkha avoilae kâennae longkha pueng be a raphoe awh.
Hmuenrasang koe e vaihmanaw hah Jerusalem BAWIPA thuengnae khoungroe koe cet awh hoeh ei teh, a hmaunawnghanaw koe tonphuenhoehe ouk a ca awh.
Apinihai amamae a canaw hah Molek cathut koe hmai hoi a thueng awh hoeh nahan, Hinnom e a ca tanghling dawk kaawm e Topheth hai a khin sak awh.
BAWIPA im alawilae siangpahrang karingkung Nathan Molek im teng e Judah siangpahrangnaw ni kanî koe a poe awh e marangnaw hah he a takhoe pouh teh, kanî rangleng hah hmai koung a sawi awh.
Ahaz im a tungtengtoe e dawk a hruek e khoungroenaw hoi Manasseh ni BAWIPA im thongma kahni touh koe a sak e khoungroenaw hah siangpahrang ni he a raphoe teh Kidron palang dawkvah a tâkhawng.
Isarel siangpahrang Solomon ni, Jerusalem kanîtholah a raphoe e aranglae mon dawk panuettho e Sidon cathut Ashtoreth, panuettho e Moab cathut, Kemosh thoseh panuettho e Ammon cathut Milkom hanelah a hmuenrasangnaw hah siangpahrang ni a khin sak.
Meikaphawknaw hah rekrek a hem teh, thing meikaphawknaw be a tâtueng hnukkhu, hote hmuen koe tami hrunaw hoi akawi sak.
Hothloilah Isarel ka payon sakkung Nebat capa Jeroboam ni Bethel vah khoungroe hoi a hmuenrasangnaw hoi khoungroe hai a raphoe pouh. Hmuenrasang hmai a sawi teh kanuikapin lah koung a hruek teh thingmeikaphawk hai hmai a sawi.
Josiah teh a kamlang teh mon dawk e phuen hah a hmu, hottelah phuen e tami hrunaw hah a la sak teh, Cathut e tami ni a pâpho e BAWIPA e lawk patetlah khoungroe dawk hmai a sawi teh, a khin sak.
Josiah ni hai kai ni ka hmu e noutnae talung teh, apie phuen namaw telah ati. Cathut e tami Judah ram lahoi ka tho e Bethel vah khoungroe dawk na sak e hno ka pâpho e phuen doeh telah a dei awh.
Siangpahrang ni apinihai a hru hah puen hanh naseh, ahnie a hrunaw hah Samaria lahoi ka tho e profetnaw e a hrunaw hoi kâbet hoeh.
Isarelnaw ni BAWIPA lungkhuek sak awh teh, a sak awh e Samaria ram dawk e hmuenrasangnaw pueng Josiah ni koung a takhoe teh, Bethel vah a sak e patetlah a sak pouh.
Hottelah haw e hmuenrasang e vaihmanaw pueng hah khoungroe van a thei teh, haw vah tami hru a pâeng teh Jerusalem lah bout a ban.
Hahoi siangpahrang ni tami pueng koe, hete lawkkamnae cauk dawk kaawm e patetlah BAWIPA, nangmae Cathut hanlah ceitakhai pawito awh telah kâ a poe.
Isarel lawkcengkungnaw ni lawk a ceng totouh hoi, Isarel siangpahrangnaw ni a uknae thung pueng hoi, Judah siangpahrang ni a uknae thung pueng haiyah ceitakhai pawito awh boihoeh.
Josiah siangpahrang a bawinae kum 18 navah, hote ceitakhai pawi teh Jerusalem vah BAWIPA hanelah a tawn awh lah ao.
BAWIPA im dawk e vaihma Hilkiah ni, a hmu e cauk dawkvah kâlawk hah caksak nahanelah, kahraithawtawknae hoi taânsinnae hoi, meikaphawk hoi, cathut meikaphawknaw, Judah ram hoi Isarel kho e hno panuettho a hmu awh e pueng hah Josiah ni koung a raphoe.
Mosi e kâlawk pueng patetlah lungthin abuemlah, muitha hoi thaonae abuemlahoi BAWIPA koe lah a kamlang teh, ahni patetlah ahni hoehnahlan siangpahrang apihai awm hoeh. Ahni hnukkhu hai ahni patetlah apihai awm mahoeh toe.
Hatei, BAWIPA ni puenghoi a lungkhueknae Manasseh ni a lungkhueksaknae naw pueng kecu dawkvah, Judahnaw taranlahoi kâan e a lungkhueknae hmai teh, roum thai kalawn hoeh.
BAWIPA ni Isarel ka puen e patetlah Judah hai ka hmuhoehnae koe ka puen van han. Hete ka rawi e Jerusalem roeroe haiyah, haw vah ka min ao han ka tie im hah ka puen han, telah a ti.
Hottelah Josiah tawksaknae thung dawk kaawm rae naw hoi, a tawk pueng teh Judah siangpahrangnaw setouknae cauk dawk a kâ thut mahoeh maw.
Siangpahrang lah ao navah, Izip siangpahrang Faro Neko teh, Assiria siangpahrang tuk hanelah, Euphrates palang vah a ceitakhang. Siangpahrang Josiah ni ahni a tuk teh ahnimouh ni ahni teh a hmu awh tahma vah, Megiddo vah a thei awh.
A taminaw ni Megiddo hoi a ro hah rangleng hoi a ceikhai awh teh, Jerusalem vah a kâenkhai awh teh amae tangkom dawk a pakawp awh. Hottelah hote khonaw ni Josiah capa Jehoahaz teh a ceikhai awh teh, satui a awi awh teh, a na pa yueng lah a bawi sak awh.
Jehoahaz teh siangpahrang a tawk navah, kum 23 touh a pha. Jerusalem vah thapa yung thum touh a bawi. A manu min teh Hamutal, Libnah kho e Jeremiah canu doeh.
A na mintoenaw ni ouk a sak awh e patetlah BAWIPA mithmu vah thoenae hah ouk a sak.
Faro Neko ni hote siangpahrang Jerusalem kho a uk thai hoeh nahanelah, Hamath ram e Riblah kho vah thongim a pabo. Hahoi Judah ram vah a pabo. Hahoi Judah ram vah ngun talen 100 touh hoi sui talen buet touh imhu a cawng sak.
Hahoi Faro Neko ni Josiah capa ELiakim hah a na pa Josiah yueng lah a bawi sak. A min hah Jehoiakim telah a thung pouh. Jehoiahaz teh Izip vah a ceikhai awh teh haw vah a due.
Jehoiakim ni Faro hah ngun tangka hoi sui a poe teh, ahnimae ram teh Faro ni kâ a poe e patetlah tangka lah poe hane tamuk a cawng van. Faro Neko koe poe hanlah, tami pueng rawng hanelah a khoe pouh e patetlah hote ram thung e khocanaw hah sui hoi tangka a rawng sak awh.
Jehoiakim teh siangpahrang a tawk navah, kum 25 touh a pha. Jerusalem vah kum 11 touh a bawi. A manu min teh Zebudah Ramah kho e Pedaiah canu doeh.
Hahoi a na mintoenaw ni a sak awh e patetlah BAWIPA mithmu vah thoenae hah a sak.
Ahnie se navah Babilon siangpahrang Nebukhadnezar ni a muk. Hatdawkvah Jehoiakim teh san lah kum thum touh a toung. Hathnukkhu, bout a kamlang teh Nebukhadnezar a tuk.
BAWIPA ni a san profetnaw hno lahoi a dei tangcoung e patetlah BAWIPA ni Khaldean tamihu, Siria tamihu, Moab tamihu hoi Ammon tamihu naw hah Judahnaw tuk hane hoi raphoe hanelah a patoun.
Manasseh ni a sak e pueng, tamikayon hoeh e naw a thi palawng e hoi, kayonhoehnaw e thi paling hoi Jerusalem akawi sak dawkvah, BAWIPA ni ngaithoum hane ngai hoeh.
Judahnaw a hmaitung hoi takhoe hanelah BAWIPA e kâpoelawk teh a pha katang.
Hottelah Jehoiakim tawksaknae thung hoi kacawiraenaw hoi a kâroenae naw pueng teh Judah siangpahrangnaw e setouknae cauk dawk thut lah ao nahoehmaw.
Jehoiakim teh mintoenaw koe a kâhat teh a capa Jehoiakhin ni a yueng lah a uk.
Izip siangpahrang teh a ram thung hoi tho hoeh toe. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Babilon siangpahrang ni Izip palangnaw koehoi a kamtawng teh Euphrates palang totouh Izip siangpahrang uknae pueng hah koung a la toe.
Jehoiakhin siangpahrang thaw tawk a kamtawng nah a kum 18 touh a pha. Jerusalem vah thapa yung thum touh a bawi. A manu e min teh Nehushta, Jerusalem kho e Elnathan canu doeh.
A na pa ni a sak e patetlah BAWIPA mithmu vah thoenae a sak.
Hatdawkvah Babilon siangpahrang Nebukhadnezar e taminaw Jerusalem lah a ceitakhang awh teh, kho king a kalup awh.
Hahoi Babilon siangpahrang Nebukhadnezar khopui dawk a tho navah a sannaw ni khopui teh koung la a kalup awh toe.
Judah siangpahrang Jehoiakhin ni a manu, a sannaw, ukkungnaw hoi a sannaw hoi Babilon siangpahrang koe a tâco awh. Hatdawkvah a bawinae kum 8 nah Babilon siangpahrang ni a man.
BAWIPA ni a dei tangcoung e patetlah BAWIPA e im dawk e hno hoi siangpahrang im dawk e hnonaw pueng koung a la teh, BAWIPA e bawkim dawk hanelah Isarel siangpahrang Solomon ni a sak e sui hnopai pueng reprep koung a dei pouh.
Jerusalem e tami pueng ka lentoe e taminaw hoi a thakaawme taminaw 10, 000 touh, hnikawng kathoumnaw hoi sumdêikathoumnaw pueng koung a hrawi. Hahoi ram thung e ka roedeng e tami hoi cungkeihoehe tami laipateh pihai cettakhai awh hoeh.
Jehoiakhin e a sannaw hoi hote ram dawk e tami thakaawme taminaw Jerusalem hoi Babilon lah santoung hanlah a ceikhai awh.
Babilon siangpahrang ni thakasai e tami 7, 000 hni kawng kathoum e hoi sumdêikathoum e tami 1, 000 touh hoi tarantuk kathoumnaw Babilon lah koung a ceikhai.
Babilon siangpahrang ni Jehoiakhin yueng lah, a panga Mattaniah hah siangpahrang thaw a tawk sak awh teh Zedekiah telah a min a palang pouh awh.
Zedekiah siangpahrang a tawk navah kum 21 touh a pha. Jerusalem vah kum 11 touh a bawi. A manu e min teh Hamutal, Libnah kho e Jeremiah canu doeh.
Jehoiakhin ni a sak e hno pueng a sak teh BAWIPA mithmu vah thoenae a sak.
Judahnaw hoi Jerusalem e taminaw e hmaitung hoi a takhoe hoehroukrak BAWIPA teh a lungkhuek. Hahoi Zedekiah ni Babilon siangpahrang a tuk.
Hahoi a bawinae kum 6 nae thapa yung 10, hnin 10 hnin vah hettelah ao. Babilon siangpahrang Nebukhadnezar hoi a ransanaw pueng hoi Jerusalem taranlahoi a tho awh teh a roe sin awh. A tengpam abuemlah tarantuknae tangkom koung a tai awh.
Hottelah siangpahrang Zedekiah a bawinae kum 11 totouh kho teh a kalup awh.
Thapa yung 4 nah hnin 9 hnin vah ram thung e taminaw hanelah rawca laipalah ka patawpoung e takang a tho.
Hahoi khopui kalupnae tapang hah vak a muk awh teh, karum lah tarankatuknaw teh siangpahrang takha teng e kalupnae tapang kahni touh e rahak kalupnae longkha koe lah a yawng awh. Khaldean taminaw ni kho hah king a ring awh teh siangpahrang teh tanghling lam koe lah a cei.
Hatei teh, Khaldean ransanaw ni siangpahrang hah pâlei awh teh, Jeriko tanghling dawk a pha awh, a ransanaw pueng ni dung a yawng takhai awh.
Siangpahrang hah a man awh teh Riblah vah Babilon siangpahrang koe a hrawi awh teh lawk a ceng awh.
Zedekiah e capa hah a mithmu vah a thei awh. Zedekiah e a mitmu hah a cawngkhawi awh teh, king a katek nalaihoi Babilon vah a hrawi awh.
Hottelah Babilon siangpahrang Nebukhadnezar a bawinae kum 9, thapa yung 5, hnin 7 hnin vah Babilon siangpahrang karingkungnaw kahrawikung, Nebuzaradan teh Jerusalem vah a kâen.
BAWIPA im hoi siangpahrang im hah hmai a sawi awh teh Jerusalem imnaw pueng im kalennaw pueng hah hmai koung a sawi awh.
Karingnaw kahrawikungnaw koe kaawm e Khaldean ransanaw pueng ni Jerusalem rapannaw pueng hah a raphoe awh.
Khopui thung kaawm rae naw pueng hoi, Babilon siangpahrang koe lah kaawm e taminaw pueng hoi, karingkungnaw kahrawikung Nebuzaradan ni san lah a hrawi awh.
Hote ram dawk e karoedengnaw, banghai cungkeihoehe naw karingkungnaw kahrawikung ni takhakatawkkungnaw hoi law kaphawnaw lah a ta awh.
Bawipa im dawk e rahum khompui hoi, rahum e tui im, tui kamhluknae naw hah Khaldean taminaw ni rakrak a hem awh teh rahum naw hah Babilon vah a sin awh.
Hlaam hoi hraba kawnnae, hmaiim, paitei, pacen hoi, rahum ailo, tongben pueng, thawngnae hnopai pueng koung a la awh.
Tongben hoi, hlaam, sui hoi ngun hoi sak e hnopainaw pueng karingkungnaw kahrawikung ni koung a la pouh.
Solomon ni BAWIPA im hanelah a sak e khom kahni touh hoi rahum tuiim hoi rahum pâhungnae amkhoung, rahum a ri e teh panue thai hanelah awm hoeh.
Khom ka rasang poung e teh dong 18 touh a pha teh, a som vah rahum khom pasum e ao. Hate rahum khom pasum e teh dong 3 touh a rasang, rahum khom pasum e dawk rahum em hoi, rahumnaw hoi akawi. Alouke khomnaw hai hottelah ao teh, rahum emnaw hoi akawi.
Karingkungnaw kahrawikung ni vaihma bawi Seraiah hoi vaihma Zephaniah hoi tho ka ring e kathum touh a man.
Taran ka tuk e ransabawi buet touh hoi siangpahrang ouk a kâhmonae khopui dawk hmu e 5 touh hoi cakathutkung hoi khopui thung hmu e naw hah ram thung e 60 touh hoi khopui thung hoi a man awh.
Karingkungnaw kahrawikung Nebuzaradan ni Riblah hoi Babilon siangpahrang koevah a ceikhai.
Babilon siangpahrang ni Hamath ram e Riblah vah a thei awh. Hahoi teh, Judahnaw teh a ram dawk hoi san lah a hrawi awh.
Hahoi Babilon siangpahrang Nebukhadnezar ni, Judah ram a ta e tami thung dawk Shaphan capa, Ahikam capa Gadaliah hah bawi lah a ta awh.
Hahoi teh, ransa kahrawikungnaw pueng hoi a kut rahim e naw ni Babilon siangpahrang ni, Gadaliah teh bawi lah a sak toe tie a panue awh toteh, Mizpah vah Gadaliah koevah a cei awh. Hotnaw teh, Nathaniah capa Ishmael, Kareah capa Johanan, Netophah tami Tanhumeth capa Seraiah, Maakath capa Jaazaniah hoi a kut rahim e naw doeh.
Gedaliah ni hote taminaw hoi a taminaw koevah, lawkkamnae a sak teh ahnimouh koe Khaldeannaw e san lah o hanelah taket hanh awh. Het ram dawk ma pou awm awh. Babilon siangpahrang kâ ngainae rahim vah awm awh nateh, namamouh hane kahawi han atipouh.
Hatei thapa yung 7 nah, siangpahrang catoun Elishama capa Nathaniah capa Ishmael ni tami 10 touh a ceikhai teh, Gedaliah teh Mizpah e Judahnaw koe kaawm e Khaldean taminaw hoi a tuk awh teh be a thei awh.
Hottelah taminaw pueng kalen, kathoung ransabawinaw hoi a tâco teh, Izip ram vah a cei awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Khaldean taminaw, a taki awh dawk doeh.
Hahoi Jehoiakhin san lah a onae kum 37, thapa 12, hnin 27 nah Babilon siangpahrang, Evilmerodak ni a bawinae kum nah Judah siangpahrang Jehoiakhin teh, thongim thung hoi a hlout sak.
Kahawicalah kho a pouk teh Babilon vah ahni koe kaawm e siangpahrangnaw hlak ka rasang poung e tungkhung a poe.
Jehoiakhin teh, thongim a bonae khohna a kâthung teh a hringyung thung pueng siangpahrang hmalah a ca a nei.
A hringyung thung hnintangkuem a ca hanelah siangpahrang ni a poe teh a coe sak.
Adam, Seth, Enosh,
Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,
Enok, Methuselah, Lamek,
Noah, Shem, Ham, hoi Japheth.
Japheth capanaw teh: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek hoi Tiras.
Gomer capanaw teh: Ashkenaz, Riphath hoi Togarmah.
Javan capanaw teh: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim hoi Rodanim.
Ham capanaw teh: Kush, Mizraim, Put hoi Kanaan.
Kush capanaw teh: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah hoi Sabteka. Raamah capanaw teh: Sheba hoi Dedan.
Kush ni Nimrod a sak teh ahni teh talai van dawk athakaawme kamtawng pasuek e lah ao.
Mizraim ni Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naptuhim a sak.
Pathrusim, Kasluhim teh Philistin hoi Kapthorim tâconae lah ao.
Kanaan ni a camin Sidon hoi Kheth,
Jebusit, Amor, Girgashite,
Khivee, Arkit hoi Sinit,
Arvad, Zemarit hoi Hamathite naw hah a khe.
Shem capanaw teh: Elam hoi Assyria, Arphaxad hoi Lud, Aram hoi Uz, Hul, Gether hoi Meshek.
Arphaxad ni Shelah hah a khe teh Shelah ni Eber a khe.
Eber ni capa kahni touh a khe, buet touh e min teh Peleg doeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, hatnae se nah talai a kârei awh e lah ao. A nawngha e min teh Joktan doeh.
Joktan ni Almodad hoi Sheleph, Hazarmaveth hoi Jerah,
Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,
Ophir, Havilah hoi Jobab. Hetnaw pueng teh Joktan e capanaw doeh.
Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,
Eber, Peleg, Reu,
Serug, Nahor, Terah,
Abram heh Abraham doeh.
Abraham capanaw teh Isak hoi Ishmael doeh.
Hetnaw teh Ishmael casaknaw doeh. Ishmael e camin teh Nebaioth doeh. Hahoi, Kedar, Adbeel hoi Mibsam,
Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,
Jetur, Naphish hoi Kedemah. Ahnimanaw teh Ishmael casaknaw doeh.
Abraham e ado Keturah ca sak naw teh Zimran hoi Jokshan, Medan hoi Midian, Ishbak hoi Shuah, Jokshan casak teh Sheba hoi Dedan.
Midian casak teh Ephah, Epher, Enok, Abida hoi Eldaah. Hetnaw teh Keturah casaknaw doeh.
Abraham ni Isak a sak. Isak casaknaw teh, Esaw hoi Isarel.
Esaw casaknaw teh Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam hoi Korah.
Eliphaz casaknaw teh, Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna hoi Amalek.
Reuel casaknaw teh, Nahath, Zerah, Shammah hoi Mizzah.
Seir casaknaw teh: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer hoi Dishan.
Lotan casak naw teh: Khori, Homam hoi Lotan tawncanu Timna.
Shobal casaknaw teh: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho hoi Onam. Zibeon casaknaw teh: Aiah hoi Anah.
Anah casak teh: Dishon. Dishon casaknaw teh: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran hoi Keran.
Ezer casaknaw teh: Bilhan, Zaavan, Jaakan. Dishon casaknaw teh: Uz hoi Aran.
Isarel catounnaw dawk siangpahrang ao hoehnahlan vah, Edom ram e siangpahrangnaw teh, Beor capa Bela ao teh a khopui min teh Dinnabah doeh.
Bela a due hnukkhu teh Bozrah koehoi Zerah capa Jobab teh ahni yueng lah a uk.
Jobab a due hnukkhu ahni yueng lah Temani ram dawk hoi Husham ni a uk.
Husham a due hnukkhu ahni yueng lah Moab ram vah Midian ka thet e Bedad capa Hadad ni a uk. A khopui min teh Avith doeh.
Hadad a due hnukkhu ahni yueng lah Masrekah hoi Samlah ni a uk.
Samlah a due hnukkhu teh ahni yueng lah Rehoboth palang hoi Sawl ni a uk
Sawl a due hnukkhu teh ahni yueng lah Akbor capa Baalhanan ni a uk.
Baalhanan a due hnukkhu ahni yueng lah Hadad a bawi. A khopui min teh Pau doeh, a yu min teh Mezahab napui Matred canu Mehetabel doeh.
Hadad a due hnukkhu Edom khobawi lah kaawmnaw teh, khobawi Timna, khobawi Alvah, khobawi Jetheth,
khobawi Oholibamah, khobawi Elah, khobawi Pinon,
khobawi Kenaz, khobawi Teman, khobawi Mibzar,
khobawi Magdiel, khobawi Iram hetnaw teh Edom khobawi lah ao.
Isarel imthung hateh Reuben, Simeon, Levih, Judah, Issakhar hoi Zebulun,
Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad hoi Asher.
Judah casaknaw teh: Er, Onan hoi Shelah. Hate kathum touh teh Kanaan napui Bathshua hoi a sak e naw doeh. Er teh Judah e camin lah ao ei, BAWIPA mithmu vah tamikathout lah ao dawkvah a due sak.
A langa Tamar ni hai ahni hanlah Perez hoi Zerah a khe pouh dawkvah, Judah casak heh abuemlah panga touh a pha awh.
Perez casaknaw teh: Khetsron hoi Hamul.
Zerah casaknaw teh: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Khalkol hoi Dara hoi abuemlah panga touh a pha awh.
Karmi casak teh Akhar doeh. Isarelnaw runae ka poe e, thoebo e ka parawt e Akhan doeh.
Ethan casak Azariah.
Khetsron casak Jerahmeel ni ahni hanlah Ram hoi Khelubai a sak pouh.
Ram ni Amminadab a sak. Amminadab ni Judah casak khobawi Nahshon a sak.
Nahshon ni Salma hah a sak teh Salma ni Boaz hah a sak.
Boaz ni Obed a sak teh Obed ni Jesi a sak.
Jesi ni a camin Eliab a sak. Apâhni lah Abinadab, apâthum lah Shimea,
apali nah Nethanel, apanga nah Raddai,
ataruk nah Ozem, asari nah Devit a sak.
A tawncanu hai ao teh Zeruiah hoi Abigail heh a tawncanu doeh. Zeruiah casak Abishai, Joab, Asahel hoi kathum touh a pha awh.
Abigail ni Amasa a sak. Amasa na pa teh Ishmael Jether doeh.
Khetsron capa Kaleb ni a yu Azubah hoi Jerioth koehoi ca a sak. Ahnie canaw teh: Jesher, Shobab hoi Ardon.
Azubah a due hoi Kaleb ni Epharath hah ama koe a la teh ahni hanlah Hur a sak pouh.
Hur ni Uri hah a sak teh Uri ni Bezalel a sak.
Hahoi Khetsron ni Gilead tami Makhir canu a ikhai teh, Khetsron hah a la teh kum 60 a pha toteh, Khetsron hanlah Segub a sak pouh.
Segub ni Jair a sak teh Gilead ram e khopui 23 touh hah ahnie lah ao.
Hatei, Geshur, Aram khocanaw hoi Jair, hotnaw thung hoi Kenath hoi a khotenaw, khopui 60 touh a la sin. Hotnaw pueng teh Gilead na pa Makhir casaknaw e doeh.
Hahoi Khetsron teh Kalebephratha kho dawk a due. Khetsron yu Abijah ni ahni hanlah Tekoa na pa Ashhur a sak pouh.
Khetsron e camin Jerahmeel casaknaw a camin Ram hoi Bunah, Oren hoi Ozem hoi Ahijah naw doeh.
Jerahmeel teh a yu bout a la teh, a min teh Onam manu Atarah doeh.
Jerahmeel camin Ram casaknaw teh Maaz, Jamin hoi Eker naw doeh.
Onam casak teh Shammai hoi Jada lah ao teh Shammai casak teh Nadab hoi Abishur lah ao.
Abishur e yu min teh Abihail doeh, ahni ni Ahban hoi Molid a sak pouh.
Nadab casak teh Seled hoi Appaimnaw doeh, Seled teh ca sak laipalah a due.
Appaim casak teh Ishi, Ishi casak teh Sheshan, Sheshan casak teh Ahlai.
Shammai e nawngha Jada casak teh Jether hoi Jonathan lah a o, Jether teh ca sak laipalah a due.
Jonathan casak teh Peleth, Zaza. Hetnaw teh, Jerahmeel casak lah ao awh.
Sheshan teh ca tongpa awm hoeh, napuinaw dueng doeh kaawm. Sheshan koevah, Izip san, a min lah Jarha ao.
Sheshan ni a canu teh a san Jarha koevah a yu lah a poe dawkvah ahni hanlah Attai a sak pouh.
Attai ni Nathan a sak teh Nathan ni Zabad a sak.
Zabad ni Ephlal a sak teh Ephlal ni Obed a sak.
Obed ni Jehu a sak teh Jehu ni Azariah a sak.
Azariah ni Helez a sak teh Helez ni Eleasah a sak.
Eleasah ni Sismai a sak teh Sismai ni Shallum a sak.
Shallum ni Jekamiah a sak teh Jekamiah ni Elishama a sak.
Jerahmeel nawngha Kaleb casak Ziph na pa Mesha hah a camin teh Mareshah casak Hebron na pa lah ao.
Hebron casak teh Korah, Tappuah, Rekem hoi Shema doeh.
Shema ni Jorkeam na pa Raham a sak teh Rekem ni Shammai a sak.
Shammai casak Moan doeh, Maon teh Bethzur na pa doeh.
Kaleb e ado Ephah ni Haran, Moza hoi Gazez a sak. Haran ni Gazez a sak.
Jahdai casak teh Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah hoi Shaaph doeh.
Kaleb e ado Maakah ni Sheber hoi Tirhannah a sak.
Madmannah na pa Shaaph, Makhbena na pa Sheva hoi Gibea na pa hai a sak. Aksah heh Kaleb canu doeh.
Hetnaw heh Kaleb casak lah ao awh. Hur casak a camin lah Epharath lah ao teh, Kiriathjearim na pa Shobal.
Bethlehem na pa Salma, Bethgader na pa Hareph hai ao.
Kiriathjearim na pa Shobal casak thung hoi Manahati tangawn, Haroehnaw hai ao rah.
Kiriathjearim casak dawkvah Ithrite hoi Puthit, Shumati, Mishraitinaw ao awh teh, hetnaw koehoi Zorath hoi Eshtaol lah a tâco.
Salma casak Bethlehem, Netophah, Atrothbethjoab hoi Manahati tangawn Zorithnaw hah doeh.
Cakathutkungnaw casak lah kaawm e teh Jabez, Tirathites, Shimeathi hoi Shukathi doeh. Hetnaw heh Rekhab imthung e a na pa Khammath koehoi ka tâcawt e Keninaw doeh.
Hetnaw heh Devit casaknaw lah ao awh. Ahni hanlah Hebron vah Jezreel Ahinoam ni a camin Amnon a sak pouh. Apâhni lah Karmel Abigail ni Daniel a sak pouh.
Apâthum nah siangpahrang Geshur Talmai canu Maakah capa Absalom, apali nah Haggith capa Adonijah.
Apanga nah Abital capa Shephatiah, ataruk nah a yu Eglah capa Ithream,
Hebron vah hete capa taruk touh heh a sak toe. Hawvah, kum sari touh hoi thapa yung taruk touh a uk teh, Jerusalem vah kum 33 touh a uk.
Jerusalem vah a sak e naw teh: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon naw doeh. Ammiel canu Bathshua hoi pali touh a sak.
Hathnukkhu, Ibhar, Elishama hoi Eliphelet,
Nogah, Nepheg hoi Japhia.
Elishama, Eliada hoi Eliphelet, tako touh a pha awh.
Hetnaw pueng teh Devit casaknaw doeh, adonaw e casaknaw hai ao rah. Hahoi Tamar teh ahnimae tawncanu doeh.
Solomon casaknaw teh: Rehoboam, Rehoboam capa Abijah, Abijah capa Asa, Asa capa Jehoshaphat.
Jehoshaphat capa Joram, Joram capa Ahaziah, Ahaziah capa Joash,
Ahaziah capa Amaziah, Amaziah capa Azariah, Azariah capa Jotham.
Jotham capa Ahaz, Ahaz capa Hezekiah, Hezekiah capa Manasseh.
Manasseh capa Amon, Amon capa Josiah.
Josiah casak teh a camin he Johanan, apâhni lah Jehoiakim, apâthum lah Zedekiah, apali lah Shallum.
Jehoiakim casaknaw dawk, Jehoiakim capa Jekoniah, Jekoniah capa Zedekiah.
San lah kaawm e Jekoniah casak dawk, Jekoniah capa Shealtiel.
Malkiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama hoi Nedabiah.
Pedaiah casak teh Zerubbabel hoi Shimei, Zerubbabel casak teh Meshullam hoi Hananiah hoi a tawncanu Shelomith.
Hashubah hoi Ohel, Berekhiah hoi Hasadiah, Jushabhesed hoi panga touh a pha awh.
Hananiah casak teh Pelatiah hoi Isaiah, Rephaiah casak, Arnon casak, Obadiah casak, Shekaniah casak.
Shekaniah casak teh Shemaiah, Shemaiah casak teh Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, Shaphat hoi taruk touh a pha awh.
Neariah casak teh Elioenai, Hezekiah, Azrikam hoi kathum touh a pha awh.
Apâthum e Elioenai casak koehoi Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, Anani hoi sari touh a pha awh.
Judah casak teh Perez, Khetsron, Karmi, Hur, Shobal.
Shobal capa Reaiah ni Jahath a sak. Jahath ni Ahumai hoi Lahad a sak. Hetnaw teh Zorath e casaknaw doeh
Etam na pa e canaw teh Jezreel, Ishma hoi Idbash doeh, a tawncanu min teh Hazzelelponi doeh.
Gedor na pa Penuel hoi Hushah na pa Ezer. Hetteh Bethlehem na pa Epharath e camin Hur casak doeh.
Tekoa na pa Ashhur heh a yu kahni touh, Helah hoi Naarah a tawn.
Ahni hanlah Naarah ni Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, Haahashtari a sak pouh. Hetnaw heh Naarah casak lah ao.
Helah casaknaw teh: Zereth, Zohar hoi Ethan.
Koz ni Anub hoi Zobebah a sak teh Harum capa Aharhel casak lah ao.
Telah ao navah, Jabez teh a hmaunawnghanaw thung dawk minhmai khet e tami lah ao. A manu ni reithai nalaihoi ka khe e doeh ati teh, a min teh Jabez a phung.
Jabez teh Isarel Cathut koevah, Yawhawi na poe roeroe haw, ka ram teh kaw sak haw, na kut hoi na awmkhai nateh, lungmathoenae kai koe a pha hoeh nahanelah, yonnae thung hoi na hlout sak haw, telah a hram teh, ahni ni a hei e hah a poe.
Shuhah e a nawngha Kelub ni Eshton na pa Mehir a sak.
Eshton ni Bethrapha, Paseah, Nahash khopui na pa Tehinah a sak. Hetnaw heh Rekah taminaw doeh.
Kenaz casaknaw teh: Othniel, Seraiah. Othniel casak teh Hathath.
Meonothai ni Ophrah a sak teh Seraiah ni Gekharashim na pa Joab a sak.
Jephunneh capa Kaleb casak teh Iru, Elah hoi Naam, Elah e capa teh Kenaz doeh.
Jehallelel casak teh Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria hoi Asarel.
Ezrah casak teh Jether, Mered, Epher, Jalon doeh. Miriam ni Shammai hoi Eshtemoa na pa Ishbah a khe pouh.
Ahnie yu Jehudijah ni Gedor na pa Jered, Sokoh na pa Heber, Zanoah na pa Jekuthiel a sak. Hetnaw teh Mered ni a la e Faro canu Bithiah canaw doeh.
Hodiah yu casak teh Karmi Keilah na pa Naham tawncanu hoi Maakath Eshtemoa doeh.
Shimon casak teh Amnon, Rinnah, Benhanan, Tilon. Ishi casak teh Zoheth hoi Benzoheth.
Judah capa Shelah casak teh Lekah na pa Er, Mareshah na pa Laadah doeh. Ashbe imthung dawk teh loukloukkaang e lukkarei ka sak thai e hai ao.
Jokim hoi Kozeba tami hoi Joash, Moab vah yu ka lat e Seraph hoi Jashubilehem. Palang thut e naw doeh.
Hetnaw teh Netaim hoi Gederah vah kho ka sak e hlaam ka bo e naw doeh, siangpahrang koe tawngtang kho a sak awh.
Simeon casak teh Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Sawl.
Sawl capa Shallum, Shallum capa Mibsam, Mibsam capa Mishma.
Mishma casak lah, Mishma capa Hammuel, Hammuel capa Zakkur, Zakkur capa Shimei.
Shimei te capa hlaitaruk touh hoi canu taruk touh ao awh ei, a hmaunawnghanaw teh ca moi tawn awh hoeh. Hatdawkvah, ahnimae canaw pueng teh Judah casak patetlah la pung awh hoeh.
Beersheba, Moladah, Hazarshual,
Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad,
Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag,
Bethmarkaboth, Hazarsusim, Bethbiri, Shaaraim vah kho a sak awh. Hetnaw heh Devit a bawi nah totouh ahnimae khopui lah ao.
Ahnimae khotenaw teh Etam, Ayin, Rimmon, Tokhen, Ashan hoi kho panga touh.
Ahnimae khote pueng teh khopui tengpam vah Baal totouh ao awh. Hetnaw teh khosaknae lah ao awh teh, a napanaw e konglam thut e hai a tawn awh.
Meshobab, Jamlekh hoi Amaziah capa Joshah.
Joel hoi Asiel casak Seraiah, Joshibiah capa Jehu.
Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel hoi Benaiah.
Shiphi capa Ziza, Allon capa Shiphi, Jedaiah capa Allon, Shimri capa Jedaiah, Shemaiah capa Shimri.

Shiloh e a camin Asaiah hoi ahnie casaknaw,
Zerah casak Jeuel hoi a hmaunawngha 690 touh a pha awh.
Benjamin casak Hassenuah capa Hodaviah, Hodaviah capa Meshullam, Meshullam capa Salu.
Jeroham capa Ibneiah, Uzzi capa Elah, Mikhri capa Uzzi, Shephatiah capa Meshullam, Reuel capa Sephatiah, Ibnijah capa Reuel.
Ahnimanaw teh a hmaunawnghanaw 956 a pha awh. Hetnaw pueng teh, miphun dawkvah imthung kahrawikungnaw doeh.
Vaihmanaw teh Jedaiah, Jehoiarib hoi Jakhin.
Cathut im dawk kahrawikung lah kaawm awh e Ahitub capa Meraioth, Meraioth capa Zadok, Zadok capa Meshullam, Meshullam capa Hilkiah, Hilkiah capa Azariah.
Jeroham capa Adaiah, Pashhur capa Jeroham, Malkhijah capa Pashhur, Adiel capa Maasai, Jahzerah capa Adiel, Meshullam capa Jahzerah, Meshillemith capa Meshullam, Immer capa Meshillemith.
Ahnimouh a hmaunawnghanaw hai a napanaw e imthung dawk a lû lah kaawmnaw doeh. Hotnaw teh Cathut im dawk thaw ka tawk thai awh e lah ao awh teh, tami 1760 touh a pha awh.
Levih, Merari casaknaw teh Hasshub capa Shemaiah, Azrikam capa Hasshub, Hashabiah capa Azrikam.
Bakbakkar Heresh hoi Galal, Mikha capa Mattaniah, Zikhri capa Mikha, Asaph capa Zikhri.
Shemaiah capa Obadiah, Galal capa Shemaiah, Jeduthun capa Galal, Asa capa Berekhiah, Elkanah capa Asa teh Netophah kho dawk kho a sak awh.
Longkha karingkungnaw teh Shallum, Akkub, Talmon hoi Ahiman. Shallum teh lû lah ao.
Ahni teh ha hoehnahlan vah, atunglah kaawm e lah ao. Ahnimouh teh Levih e catounnaw roenae hmuen longkha karingkungnaw lah ao awh.
Kore capa Shallum, Ebiasaph capa Kore, Korah capa Ebiasaph hoi a hmaunawnghanaw. Mintoenaw e BAWIPA im dawk thaw katawknaw, kâennae longkha karingkungnaw lah ao awh.
Eleazar capa Phinehas teh BAWIPA ni a okhai teh kahrawikung lah ao.
Meshelemiah capa Zekhariah teh kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang ka ring e lah ao.
Longkha ka ring hanelah a rawi e naw teh, 212 touh a pha awh. Devit hoi Samuel ni a tawk awh hane a pouk e naw teh, mae kho lengkaleng a tâconae patetlah separuinae dawk thut e lah ao.
Hettelah amamouh hoi a catounnaw haiyah BAWIPA e lukkareiim longkha ka ring hanelah ao awh.
Kanîtho, kanîloum, atunglah, akalah, petkâtue lah longkha karingkungnaw thaw poe lah ao.
Khote lae a hmaunawnghanaw teh hnin sari touh thung hanelah hnin touh hoi hnin touh, a kâhlai awh vaiteh, meng a tho awh hane doeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, longkha karingkungnaw pali touh teh Levihnaw doeh. Cathut e im dawk a hruek awh e hnopai karingkung lah ao awh.
Hottelah amom tangkuem longkha paawng e hah thaw poe e lah ao dawkvah, Cathut e im petkâkalup lah a roe awh.
Tangawn ni thaw tawknae puengcangnaw a ring awh, a kuem awh, a la awh, ouk a touk awh.
Tangawn teh hnopai hmuen kathoung dawk e puengcangnaw hah, tavai, misur, satui, hmuitui a kuemyawt awh teh a ring awh.
Vaihma capa tangawn ni hmuitui hah ouk a sak awh.
Korah tami Shallum e capa kacuepounge Levih tami Mattithiah teh vaiyei karê thaw a tawk.
Kohath capanaw thung dawk hoi a hmaunawngha tangawn teh Sabbath hnintangkuem hanelah, vaiyei ka rakueng e lah ao.
Hetnaw heh la ka sak e Levihnaw a na pa imthung kahrawikung, bawkim rakhan karingnaw, lah ao awh teh, alouke thaw kâbet awh hoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, karum khodai thaw katawknaw lah ao awh.
Levih imthung kacuenaw teh, amamae se dawk kacue e lah Jerusalem vah pou ao awh.
Gibeon na pa Jeiel, Jeiel teh Gibeon vah kho a sak teh, a yu min teh Maakah doeh.
A camin teh Abdon doeh. Hahoi Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner hoi Nadab.
Gedor, Ahio, Zekhariah hoi Mikloth naw a sak.
Mikloth ni Shimeah a sak. Ahni hai Jerusalem vah a hmaunawnghanaw koe ao.
Ner ni Kish a sak, Kish ni Sawl a sak, Sawl ni Jonathan, Malkhishua, Abinadab hoi Eshbaal a sak.
Jonathan casak Meribbaal doeh, Meribbaal ni Maikah a sak.
Maikah casak teh Pithon, Melek hoi Tahrea.
Ahaz ni Jarah a sak, Jarah ni Alemeth, Azmaveth hoi Zimri a sak. Zimri ni Moza a sak.
Moza ni Binea a sak teh Binea capa Rephaiah, Rephaiah capa Eleasah, Eleasah capa Azel.
Azel teh capa taruk touh a tawn. A minnaw teh: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah hoi Hanan doeh. Hetnaw teh Azel capanaw doeh.
Filistinnaw ni Isarelnaw a tuk awh teh, Isarelnaw teh tarannaw hmalah a yawng awh teh, Gilboa mon dawk thengpatheng lah a kamlei awh teh a due awh.
Filistinnaw ni Sawl hoi a capa hah, phat a pâlei awh teh, Sawl capa Jonathan, Abinadab, Malkhishua hah a thei awh.
Sawl teh a tarannaw ni rek a pâlei awh teh, licung ka kathoum e ni pala hoi a ka awh teh hmâ a ca sak awh.
Sawl ni amae senehmaica ka patuem e koevah, na tahloi hah rayu nateh, pawkkayawng lah na thun. nahoeh pawiteh, vuensom ka a hoehnaw ni lung na paroum nah awh langvaih atipouh. Hateiteh, amae senehmaica ka patuem e ni thun ngai hoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, a taki. Hatdawkvah, Sawl ni amahoima tahloi a vai teh a tabosin.
Senehmaica ka patuem e ni Sawl a due toe tie hah, a hmu torei teh, ahni hai amahoima tahloi hoi a kâthei van.
Sawl hoi a capanaw kathum touh a due awh.
Tanghling dawk kaawm e Isarelnaw pueng teh, a yawng awh. Sawl hoi a capanaw a due toe tie a thai awh torei teh, kho a tâco takhai awh teh, a yawng awh. Hot dawkvah Filistinnaw ni ao na awh.
A tangtho vah Filistinnaw ni a thei awh e naw dawk, senehmaica hah la hanelah a cei awh navah, Gilboa mon dawk Sawl hoi a capanaw kadout e hah a hmu awh.
Senehmaica hah a rading awh teh, a lû hoi senehmaicanaw hah meikaphawk imnaw hoi a taminaw e meikaphawknaw koe pathang hanelah kamthang a pathang awh.
A senehmaica teh amamae cathut im dawk a hruek awh teh, a lû teh dagon im dawk a vo awh.
Sawl dawk Filistinnaw ni a sak e naw hah Jabesh Gilead kaawmnaw pueng ni a thai awh torei teh,
tami tarankahawinaw ni a kamthaw sin awh teh, Sawl hoi a capa e ro hah a la awh teh, Jabesh kho lah a ceikhai awh teh, a hruhrawngnaw hah kathen kung rahim vah a pakawp awh. Hnin 7 touh thung rawcahai laihoi ao awh.
BAWIPA taranlahoi a sak e, yuemkamcu lah ao hoeh kecu dawk Sawl teh a due. Bangkongtetpawiteh, BAWIPA e lawk hah tarawi laipalah, khueyuenu koe pouknae a hei.
Hateiteh, BAWIPA koe teh pouknae a hei hoeh dawkvah, ahni hah a due sak teh, a uknaeram hah Jesi capa Devit koe a poe pouh.
Isarelnaw pueng teh Hebron kho koe a tho awh. Khenhaw! kaimanaw teh na hru hoi na tak lah ka o awh.
Hnuk lae atueng dawk Sawl a bawi nah haiyah, Isarelnaw ka tâcawtkhai e hoi kâenkhai e lah na o. BAWIPA Cathut ni nang koevah, ka tami Isarel tukhoumkung lah na o vaiteh, kahrawikung lah na o han ati telah atipouh awh.
Hatdawkvah, Isarel kacuenaw pueng teh Hebron kho siangpahrang koe a tho awh teh, Devit ni Hebron kho BAWIPA e hmalah, ahnimouh hoi lawkkamnae a sak. Samuel hno lahoi BAWIPA e lawk patetlah Isarel siangpahrang hanelah Devit teh satui a awi awh.
Devit hoi Isarelnaw pueng teh Jubusitnaw khosaknae Jerusalem lah a cei awh. Jerusalem teh Jebusitnaw khosaknae doeh.
Jebusit kho kaawmnaw ni Devit hi vah khoeroe kâen hanh, telah atipouh awh. Hateiteh, Devit ni Zion rapanim a lawp pouh teh Devit khopui tie lah ao.
Devit ni Jubusitnaw hmaloe ka tuk e teh, ransabawi hoi kahrawikung lah ao han telah ati. Hatdawkvah, Zeruiah capa Joab teh hmaloe poung lah a cei teh kahrawikung kacue lah a sak.
Devit teh rapanim thung lah kho a sak dawkvah, Devit khopui ati awh.
Millo e hmuen koehoi khopui petkâkalup lah rapan teh a kangdue. Joab ni khopui pueng hah a pathoup.
Hatdawkvah, Devit teh hoehoe a len teh, ransahu BAWIPA ahni koevah ao.
Hetnaw teh Devit ni a tawn e thakaawme taminaw doeh. Isarelnaw pueng hoi ama hoi a uknaeram hanlah amamouh hoi amamouh tha a kâpoe awh teh, Isarel kong dawk BAWIPA e lawk patetlah siangpahrang o thai nahanelah kangdoutkhainaw doeh.
Hetheh Devit ni a tawn e tami athakaawme taminaw doeh. Hakmonite tami e capa Jashobeam, tami 30 touh e hu kahrawikung, tahroe a patuep teh vai touh hoi tami 3,00 ka thet e doeh.
Ahni hnukkhu hoi Aho tami Dodo e capa Eleazar tami athakaawme taminaw 3 touh dawkvah, buet touh lah ao.
Ahni teh Pasdammim e hmuen Devit koevah ao. Hawvah Filistinnaw teh, tarantuk hanelah a kamkhueng awh teh, hawvah catun hoi kakawi e tanghling ao. Taminaw pueng teh Filistinnaw e hmalah a yawng awh.
Hatei, ahnimouh teh, law lungui hmuen a la teh Filistinnaw a thei awh. Hottelah BAWIPA ni kalentoenaw, tânae a kamnue sak.
Ransa 30 touh thung dawk e tami a thakasai e tami 3 touh teh Adullam lungngoum, Devit onae lungsong koe a cathuk awh.
Hatdawkvah, Devit teh rapanim thungup ao. Filistin ransanaw teh Bethlehem vah ao awh.
Devit ni a rabuipoung teh, Bethlehem tuikhu dawk e tui, rapan longkha teng e hah ka nei hanelah na ka poe thai e awm pawiteh, ka ngaipoung eite telah a ti.
Ransa kathum touh ni Filistin ransanaw a roenae hah pat a rakan awh teh, rapan longkha teng e Bethlehem tuikhu dawk e tui hah a do awh teh, Devit koevah a thokhai awh. Hateiteh, Devit ni net ngai hoeh. BAWIPA hanelah a rabawk.
Ahni ni, Oe BAWIPA hethateh khoeroe ka net mahoeh. Athakaawme taminaw kathum touh ni a sak e hno doeh.
Joab e a nawngha Abishai teh, kathum touh thung dawk e kacue lah ao. Tami 300 touh hah tahroe hoi a thei dawkvah, tami kathum touh thung dawk e a min kamthang e lah ao.
Tami kathum touh thung dawk ahni teh kahni touh hlak oup hanelah ao. Hatdawkvah kacuepoung lah ao. Hateiteh, hmaloe e kathum touh dawkvah bawk hoeh.
Jehoiada e capa Benaiah teh, Kabzeel kho e tami thakaawme capa hno moikapap ka sak e lah ao. Ahni ni sendek patetlah athakaawme Moab tami tarankahawi e kahni touh a thei. Hahoi bout a cei teh, tadamtui a bo nah a khu dawk kaawm e sendek buet touh bout a thei.
Ka rasang katang e Izip tami dong 5 touh e hah a thei. Izip tami e kut dawk hni kawng kalawng tittouh e tahroe hah a patuep. Benaiah sonron hoi a yawng sin teh, Izip tami e kut dawk e tahroe hah a lawp teh hote tahroe hoi letlang a thei.
Hete hnonaw hah Jehoiada e capa Benaiah ni a sak e, tami a thakasai kathum touh dawkvah barinae a poe awh.
Tami 30 touh hlakvah bari kamcu lah ao katang. Hateiteh, hmaloe kathum touh koe bawk thai hoeh. Hahoi Devit ni ama karingkungnaw thung dawk kacuelah a ta.

Kish capa Sawl koehoi Devit a yawng teh Ziklag kho ao nah, ahni koe ka tho e naw teh, hetnaw hah doeh. Ahnimouh teh tarantuknae koe lah ama kabawm e tami athakaawme taminaw doeh.
Likathoumnaw lah ao awh teh, samtang ka pathui thai e, tâyai ka dei thai e, avoilah aranglah hoi ka thoum e naw lah ao awh. Ahnimanaw teh Benjamin taminaw, Sawl e a imthungnaw lah ao awh.
Ahnimouh kahrawikung lah Ahiezer doeh. Ahni hnuk Gibeah tami Shemaah casak Joash, Jeziel, Azmaveth casak Pelet, Berakah, Anathoth tami Jehu.

Tami 30 lathueng hoi 30 rahak dawk e athakaawme Gibeon tami Ishmaiah, Jeremiah hoi Jahaziel, Johanan hoi Gederath tami Jozabad.
Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah, Haruph tami Shephatiah.
Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer hoi Korah tami Jashobeam.
Joelah hoi Gedor tami Jeroham capa Zebadiah.
Gad taminaw dawk hoi athakaawme taminaw, taran ka tuk thai, saiphei hoi tahroe ka hno thai tangawn hah kahrawngum e rapanim dawk kaawm e Devit koe a kâhmoun awh.
Apasueke teh Ezer, apâhni e teh Obadiah, apâthum e teh Eliab.
Apali e teh Mishmannah, apanga e teh Jeremiah.
Ataruk e teh Attai, asari e teh Eliel.
Ataroe e teh Johanan, atako e teh Elzabad.
A hra e teh Jeremiah, a hlaibun e teh Makhbannai.
Hetnaw teh Gad casaknaw thung hoi e doeh. Ahnimouh thung dawk hoi a thakayoun e tami 100 tabang ao. A thakaawme 1000 tabang ao.
Hotnaw teh thapa yung pasueknae dawk Jordan palang tuiko muenkawi nah ka rakat thai e naw, hahoi tanghling dawk kaawm e pueng kanîtholah hoi kanîloumlah ka yawng sak e naw doeh.
Benjamin hoi Judah casaknaw thung hoi rapanim koe Devit teng a tho awh.
Devit ni ahnimouh dawn hanelah a cei teh, roumnae hane dawkvah, kabawp hanelah na tho awh pawiteh, ka lungthin na poe awh han. Hateiteh, ka kut ni runae banghai sak hoeh tie na panue nalaihoi, kai pahnawt hanelah na tho awh pawiteh, mintoenaw e Cathut ni na khet vaiteh lawk na ceng awh naseh, telah atipouh.
Hottelah tami 30 touh thung dawk e kahrawikung Amasai tak dawk muitha a tho teh, Devit na tami lah ka o awh. Jesi capa nang koe lah kampang e naw doeh. Nang dawk roumnae awm naseh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, na Cathut ni na kabawp tet loe atipouh. Hatdawkvah, Devit ni ahnimouh a la teh ransahu ka hrawi e lah ao sak.
Filistinnaw hai Sawl tuk hanelah a cei awh navah, Manasseh e tami tangawn hai Devit koelah a cei awh. Ama hoi a taminaw ni Filistinnaw koelah kabawm awh hoeh. Amamae bawi Sawl koelah kamlang awh vaiteh, maimae lû tâkhawng payon langvaih telah a kâpan awh teh a ban sak awh.
Ziklag a cei awh navah, Manassehnaw thung hoi ransa 1000 ka hrawi e Adnah hoi Jozabad, Jediael hoi Michael, Jozabad, Elihu hoi Zillethai naw teh ahni koe ao awh.
Hetnaw teh Devit taran tuk navah, kabawm e naw lah ao awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, abuemlah hoi athakaawme taminaw teh, kahrawikungnaw lah ao awh.
Hatnae tueng dawk hoi Devit kabawm hane hnin touh hoi hnin touh meng a tho awh teh, Cathut e ransahu patetlah kalenpounge ransahu lah a coung.
BAWIPA e lawk patetlah Sawl uknaeram hah Devit koe lah a kamlang teh, Hebron vah Devit koe e tarantuknae puengcang kâmahrawk hanelah kacetnaw teh, hettelah ao.
Judah capanaw puengcang kâmahrawknaw, saiphei hoi tahroe ka patuem e tami 6, 800 touh a pha awh.
Simeon e capanaw tarantuknae koe athakaawme taminaw teh 7, 100 a pha awh.
Levih e casaknaw 4, 600.
Jehoiada teh Aron imthung kahrawikung lah ao teh, ahni koe tami 3700 touh ao awh.
Thoundoun Zadok teh tami athakaawme, a imthung dawk ransanaw kahrawikung 22 touh ao.
Benjamin e capanaw Sawl imthung lah kaawm e 3000 touh a pha. Ha hoehnahlan vah ka paphnawn teh Sawl koelah a kampang awh.
Ephraim capanaw tami athakaawme hoi tarankahawi imthung dawk hoi 20, 800 touh a pha awh.
Manasseh casak tangawn dawk hoi Devit siangpahrang lah ao thai nahane ka tho e naw teh 18, 000 touh a pha.
Issakhar capa tueng navah, ka panuek thai e hoi, Isarel ni bangmaw a sak hane telah ka panuek thai e, kahrawikung 200 touh a pha. A hmaunawngha abuemlah amae uknae rahim vah ao awh.
Zebulun imthungnaw dawk hoi taran ka tuk thai e, senehmaica ka patuem ni teh ka bouk thai e 50, 000 a pha awh teh lungthin kacue e lah ao awh.
Naphtalinaw imthung hoi ransa ka hrawi e 1, 000 touh, saiphei, tahroe ka patuem e 37, 000 touh a pha.
Dan imthung dawk hoi senehmaica ka patuem e 28, 600 touh a pha.
Asher imthung dawk hoi taran ka tuk thai e, bouk ka thoum e 40, 000 touh a pha.
Jordan namran e Reuben taminaw, Gad taminaw hoi Manasseh casak tangawn koehoi hai puengcang phunkuep hoi kamthoup e tami 120, 000 touh a pha.
Hotnaw pueng teh taran ka tuk e, bouk ka thoum e naw lah ao awh. Devit teh Isarelnaw pueng dawkvah, siangpahrang lah ao hane lungthin buet touh lah a tawn teh, Hebron lah a cei awh. Isarel alouknaw pueng nihai, Devit teh siangpahrang lah o sak hanelah lungthin buet touh lah ao awh.
Devit koevah, hnin thum touh thung a canei awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, a hmaunawnghanaw ni a rakueng pouh e doeh.
Hothloilah, imthung hmaunawnghanaw, Issakhar, Zebulun hoi Naphtali la hoi kalauk hoi marang, maitotan naw, ca hane vaiyei, hoi thai pawnaw, misurtui hoi satuinaw, a phu awh teh, maitotan hoi tu, moikapap a thokhai awh. teh Isarel ram dawk lunghawinae a kawi.
Devit ni kahrawikungnaw pueng koe, 1, 000 kaukkungnaw hoi, 100 touh kaukkungnaw koe pouknae a hei.
Devit ni kamkhueng e Isarelnaw koe, ahawi na tet awh boilah, BAWIPA Cathut a ngainae awm pawiteh, Isarel ram thung e hmaunawngha kaawm e naw pueng, tengpam e kho kaawm e pueng, vaihmanaw hoi Levih taminaw hai maimouh koe cungtalah kamkhueng hanelah, coun awh sei atipouh.
Cathut e thingkong hah maimouh koe bankhai awh sei. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Sawl a bawi hoi teh, a lawkpui lah pouk awh hoeh toe telah ati.
Kamkhueng e pueng ni hottelah sak e hah hnâ rip a bo khai. Bangkongtetpawiteh, hot teh tami pueng pouknae dawk ka kalan e doeh.
Hatdawkvah, Devit ni Izip palang Shihor, hoi Hamath kâennae totouh Isarelnaw hah Kiriathjeaream e Cathut e thingkong hah bankhai hanelah a kamkhueng sak awh.
Hatdawkvah, Devit hoi tami pueng teh, Judah ram e Baalah Kiriath-Jeaream ati awh e koevah, cherubim dawkvah, ka tahung e BAWIPA min a onae lawkkam thing kong la hanelah a cei awh.
Cathut e thingkong teh, Abinadab im e hah leng ka tha hoi a ceikhai awh. Uzzah hoi a hui ni leng teh a mawng.
Devit hoi Isarelnaw pueng ni la sak na laihoi ratoung hoi tamawi hoi mawngleng hoi cecak hoi mongka hoi Cathut hmalah a thaonae puenghoi a tumkhawng awh.
Kidron cangkatinnae koe a pha awh navah, maitonaw ni thingkong a kâhuet sak dawkvah, Uzzah ni thingkong hah kuet hanelah a kut a kâyap.
BAWIPA e lungkhueknae teh Uzzah tak dawk vai touh hoi a pha teh, thingkong a kuet kecu dawkvah a thei teh, Cathut hanlah a due.
Uzzah tak dawk BAWIPA e lungkhueknae a pha dawkvah, Devit teh a lungkhuek. Hote hmuen teh sahnin totouh Perezuzzah telah a phung awh.
Hat na hnin hoi Devit ni Cathut teh a taki. Bangtelah hoi maw Cathut e thingkong teh ka bankhai thai han telah ati.
Devit ni thingkong teh Devit khopui a ma koe hrueng laipalah Git tami Obededom im vah a hruek.
Cathut e thingkong teh Git tami Obededom imthung vah thapa yung thapa yung thum touh ao. Obededom e a tawn e naw pueng teh BAWIPA ni yawhawinae a poe.
Taire siangpahrang Hiram ni, Devit koevah patounenaw a patoun. Ahni hane im sak pouh hanelah, Sidar thing hoi talungdêikathoum e, hoi im sak ka thoum e naw hah a patoun.
Isarelnaw dawk siangpahrang lah BAWIPA ni a caksak tie hah Devit ni a kâpanue. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Isarelnaw kecu dawkvah, a uknaeram hah ka rasang poung lah tawmrasang e lah ao.
Devit ni Jerusalem vah a yu alouknaw hai a la teh, ca napui tongpa moi a sak.
Jerusalem vah a sak e a canaw teh Shammua, Shobab, Nathan hoi Solomon.
Ibhar, Elishua hoi Eliphelet.
Nogah, Nepheg hoi Japhia.
Elishama, Beeliada hoi Eliphelet.
Filistinnaw ni Devit teh Isarelnaw e siangpahrang lah satui awi lah ao toe tie a thai awh torei teh, Filistinnaw pueng ni Devit tawng hanelah a cei awh. Devit ni a thai toteh, ahnimouh tuk hanelah a kamthaw.
Filistinnaw hah Rephaim tanghling dawk a yawng awh.
Devit ni Filistinnaw tuk hanelah ka cei han maw, ka kut dawk na poe han maw, telah BAWIPA a pacei. BAWIPA ni cet leih, ahnimouh teh na kut dawk na poe han telah atipouh.
Hatdawkvah, Baalperazim vah a cei awh teh, Devit ni ahnimouh teh a tuk teh a tâ awh. BAWIPA ni ka tarannaw teh tuicapa ka thaw e a roum sak e patetlah be a raphoe telah ati. Hatdawkvah, hote hmuen teh Baalperazim telah min a phung.
Hete hmuen koe meikaphawknaw hah a cettakhai awh. Devit ni kâ a poe teh, hmai koung koung a sawi pouh awh.
Filistinnaw teh tanghling dawk bout a yawng awh.
Hahoi Devit ni Cathut koe bout a pacei teh, ahnimanaw pâlei hanelah cet hanh. Kingkalup awh nateh, batuekung koe pawm awh.
Hahoi hettelah ao han. Batuekung e a van a cei awh e a pâlawk na thai awh toteh, tuk hanelah na tâco awh han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Filistinnaw roenae tuk hane na hmalah Cathut a tho tie hah na panue han atipouh.
Cathut ni kâ a poe e patetlah Devit ni a sak teh, Filistin e ransanaw hah, Gibeon hoi Gezer totouh a pâlei awh.
Hottelah ram pueng dawk Devit e min a kamthang teh, BAWIPA ni ama takinae hah miphun tangkuem koe a kamthang sak
Devit ni Devit khopui vah ama hane im a sak teh Cathut e thingkong ao nahane hmuen hah a rakueng pouh teh lukkareiim a yap pouh.
Devit ni Cathut e thingkong heh Levihnaw hoeh laipalah teh, apinihai kâkayawn thai mahoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Cathut e thingkong teh meng kâkayawt hane hoi a thaw ka tawk hanelah BAWIPA ni a rawi e naw doeh telah a ti.
Devit ni BAWIPA e thing kong ta nahane a rakueng pouh e hmuen koevah, ceikhai hanelah Jerusalem vah Isarelnaw pueng a pâkhueng.
