Na nei vaiteh be na yawn han. Manang na kâbang sak vaiteh, a sanu hah hawng pouh han, bangkongtetpawiteh kai ni ka dei toe telah Bawipa Jehovah ni a dei.
Hatdawkvah Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei. Kâ na poe na hnin teh na kamlang takhai dawkvah, na cuknae hoi na kâyonae phu hah na phu hanelah ao.
Hothloilah BAWIPA ni kai koe lawk bout na dei pouh, tami capa Oholah hi Oholibah teh lawk na ceng han na maw. Panuet a thonae hah ahnimouh koe na pâpho han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, a uicuk awh, a thi hah a kut dawk a kâhluk teh, amamae meikaphawk koe a kâyo awh. Kai hanelah a khe e a capanaw hah, ahnimouh koe hmaisawi thueng hanelah a poe awh.
Hothloilah kai koe hetheh a sak awh, ahnimouh ni ka min kathoung hah a khin sak awh teh, kaie sabbath hai a tapoe awh.
Amamae meikaphawk hanelah a canaw a thei awh hnukkhu, a mamanaw letlang hah, kaie hmuen kathoung kamhnawng sak hanelah a kâen awh. Khenhaw, hettelah ka imthung roeroe vah ouk a sak awh.
Hat dueng nahoeh rah, kho hlanae koe kaawm e hah a tho nahan lawk na thui awh teh, patoune hah na patoun awh. Khenhaw a tho awh teh, ahnimouh kecu dawk na kamhluk teh, na mit dawk puk na hluk teh, aphunphun lah kamthoupnae hoi na kamthoup.
Kahawi e tahungnae dawk na tahung teh, a hmalah caboi na hung teh hmuitui hoi satui hah hote hmuen koe na pâhung.
A nawmnae lahoi taminaw a hramnae hai ka thai. Alouke taminaw hoi kahrawng hoi rei a tho awh teh, a kut dawk laikaw, a lû dawk kahawipoung e bawilakhungnaw a kâmuk, yamu ka parui e hai a thokhai awh.
Kai ni ka uicuk tangcoung e napui hah a yonkhai ngai awh han na maw telah ka ti.
Kâyawtnaw koe a cei awh toteh, ahnimouh koe mingming doeh a kâen awh. Hottelah ka cuk e napui Oholah hoi Oholibah koe a kâen awh.
Hateiteh, tamikalan ni ka uicuk e hoi kaawm e napui hoi ka tami ka thet e napui lawkceng e patetlah lawk a ceng awh han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, ka uicuk e hoi kaawm e a kâbet .
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei. Nangmouh taran e lahoi tamihu hah ka coun han. Na lawp awh vaiteh, ka patawpoung lah na katin sak han.
Hahoi kamkhueng e tamihu ni talung hoi na dei awh han. Tahloi hoi na bouk awh vaiteh, a canunaw hoi a capanaw a thei awh han. A imnaw hai hmai be a sawi pouh.
Napuinaw pueng ni, cuknae hah sak hane nahoeh tie a panue thai awh nah, het patetlah cuknae hah ram thung hoi ka pahma han.
Namamae lathueng na cuknae hah a moi na pathung awh vaiteh, meikaphawk yonnae hah na khan awh han. Hahoi kai heh Bawipa Jehovah lah ka o tie na panue awh han telah a ti.

Saringnaw thung dawk e kahawipoung e hah lat nateh, a rahim vah thing kapappoung rahawng, moi hah hlakhlak tangdawk naseh, a hrunaw hah dik hmin naseh.
Hatdawkvah Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei. Tami ka thet e khopui, ka tangdawk e moi hlaam ka ekko ni teh kaawm rae hlaam teh a yawthoe. Moituen buet touh hnukkhu buet touh rasat haw.

Moipathung hanelah lungkhueknae a tâco thai nahane lahoi ramuk e lah ao hoeh nahan, thipaling e hah lungsong dawk ka awi toe.
Hatdawkvah, Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei. Thi ka palawng e khopui teh a yaw a thoe, kai ni hai moikapap lah thing ka rahawng sin han.
Hmai sut patawi sin awh nateh, thing moikapap lah rahawng sin awh. Moi hah dik kahmincalah thawng awh, a moi hah katuipoung lah a hru pueng hai he kang naseh.
Hmai patawi e van hlaam hah ahrawng lah khueng haw.
Hmawtcei totouh ka thawng nakunghai, moikapap lah sumei tâcawt mahoeh. Hmai ni hai kang thai hoeh.
Na kamhnawngnae teh na cuknae lah ao teh, na pâsu ei, na thoung kalawn hoeh dawkvah, na lathueng vah ka lungkhueknae pueng a pha hoehroukrak teh, nâtuek haiyah na kamhnawngnae koehoi thoung sak e lah na awm mahoeh toe.
Kai BAWIPA ni yo ka dei toe. Ka phat roeroe han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, kai kama ni ka sak han, hnuklah kâhnawn mahoeh. Ka pasai mahoeh, pankângai mahoeh, na hringnuen hoi na tawksak e hoi kamcu lah Bawipa Jehovah ni a dei telah tet pouh telah ati.

tami capa khenhaw! vaitalahoi na mitkhet khuektinae hah na takhoe pouh han. Na kângaikâthung mahoeh. na kap hai na kap mahoeh. Na mitphi hai bawt mahoeh.
Arulahoi cingou haw. Tamikadout hanelah khui hanh. Luhuem huem nateh, khokkhawm hah khawm haw. Na pahni huem hanh, ka roedengnaw e bu hai cat hanh telah ati.
Hottelah amom lah tamimaya koe lawk ka dei teh, tangmin lah ka yu teh a due, amom lah kâ na poe e patetlah ka sak.
Tami ni hettelah a sak e heh kaimouh hanelah, bang a ngainae ne, na dei pouh mahoeh maw telah ati.

Isarel imthung koevah dei pouh, Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei. Thai haw, kaie hmuen kathoung, nangmae na thaonae na kâoupnae nangmouh ni na khet han na ngai awh e, na kâoup e kai ni kakhin sak vaiteh, na canaw hoi hnukkhu lah na cei takhai awh e hah tahloi hoi a due awh han.

Na canu hah kahrawngum vah tahloi hoi a thei awh han. Nang na rungngang nahanelah rapan hah a sak awh vaiteh, nang na tuk nahanelah ravo a sak awh vaiteh, ahnimouh taranlahoi bahlingnaw a sin awh han.
Nang e rapannaw avanglah takhang a raphoe nahanelah a sak awh vaiteh, cakâ hoi imrasang hah a raphoe awh han.
Kapappoung e marang kecu dawk, vaiphu hoi muen ramuk e lah ao han, raphoe e khopui dawkvah, tami ouk a kâen e patetlah na takhang dawk a kâen awh han, na takhang dawk a kâen awh navah, marangransanaw e pawlawk hoi tarantuknae leng pawlawk dawk rapan rasang hah a kâhuet han.
Na lamthungnaw hah marang khoksamen hoi be a katin awh vaiteh, na taminaw hah tahloi hoi a thei awh han. Ka rasang e na rapan hah talai dawk be a rawp awh han.
Na tawntanae hah lawphno lah koung a la awh han, na hnopai pueng be a rawk han, na rapan hah a tip vaiteh, kahawipoung e na im hah a raphoe awh han, na thing, na talung hoi na talai kahawinaw hah tui dawk be a tâkhawng awh han.
La na sak pawlawk hah ka roum sak vaiteh, na ratoung pawlawk thai e lah awm mahoeh toe.
Ka ke e lungsong lah ka coung sak han, tamlawk yangda hanelah ka coung sak vaiteh, na kangdout sak mahoeh toe. Bangkongtetpawiteh, kai BAWIPA ni ka dei toe telah Bawipa Jehovah ni a dei.

Talî dawk e kahrawikungnaw pueng ni a tungkhung dawk hoi a kum awh han, ka sungren poung e a hnicunaw hah a hruek awh vaiteh, a kamthoupnae be a rading awh han. Pâyawnae hah kamthoup awh vaiteh, talai dawk tahung laihoi pou a pâyaw awh han, kângairupoung awh han.

Ayan e tami kadungpoung e tangkom dawk ka cet tangcoung e koevah, na ceisak awh han, talai thung vah, ayan hoi kingdi e kadungpoung e tangkom thung ka cet tangcoung e koevah, kho na sak han, apihai nangmouh thung vah kho a sak hoeh nahan hoi, taminaw koehoi bawilennae hah na hmu hoeh nahanelah,

nange hno karankung Javan, Tubal, Mesheknaw teh nange hno yorankung doeh. Rahum hlaam hoi hnopai na tawn nahanelah, na ran pouh awh.

Nange na hno karankung teh Dedannaw doeh. Talî rai e hmuen tangkuem koe na hno yonae hmuen lah ao. Kasaino hoi Eboni nang koe a yonae hmuen lah ao.
Hnopai moikapap na tawn awh dawkvah, Edom teh nang koe kâkuen e lah ao. Emerald talung aphu kaawm e hni paling pathoup e hni, loukloukkaang e, dingyin, âthi talung a yoran awh.

Hnopai moikapap a tawn kecu dawkvah, Damaskas hah nang koe yorankung lah ao. Helbon misurtui hoi tumuen hoi a kâthung awh.
Uzal misurtui hah a sin awh teh, na hnopainaw hah a ran awh. Loukloukkaang e sum, nakzik hoi kacing hai a yoran awh e lah ao.
Dedan kho teh, marang ka kâcui e ransanaw ni a hno hane kahawipoung e hnopai nang koe a yo awh.
Arabia hoi Kebar siangpahrang hah nama koe a yoran lahoi a yo awh. Tuca hoi tutan, hmaetannaw hoi a yoran awh.
Sheba hoi Raamah hno kayawtnaw doeh. Hmuitui, kahawipoung e naw hoi talung aphu kaawm e phunkuep hoi sui hoi a yoran awh.
Haran, Kanneth, Eden, Sheba hno kayawtkungnaw doeh. Assiria hoi Kilmad hno kayawtkung hah nang koe yorannae kasaknaw doeh.

Tarshish long hah na hnopai kaphawtkung doeh. Moikapap na pâkhueng teh, talî dawkvah bawilennae hah na hmu.
Nange long kamawngkung ni, talî tuicapa dawk a kâenkhai teh, Kanîtholae kahlî ni talî lungui vah kahmat lah a palek.
Nang teh na rak hnin vah, na hnopainaw hoi hno na yonae naw hoi, na long dawk e taminaw long kamawngkung hoi, taminaw hoi kasakkung hno kayawtnaw hoi a ransanaw, nang koe kaawm e hoi a thung kaawm e pueng hoi, talî lungui be na bo awh han.
Nange long kamawngnaw a hramnae pawlawk dawkvah, nang koe kaawm e hah a pâyaw awh.
Long mawngnae ka kuen e pueng hoi, long dawk e taminaw hoi, talî dawk lam ka patue e pueng hah, a kum awh teh, tuiteng vah a kangdue awh.
Nange kong dawk ka thai lah, lawk kacaipounglah lungmathoe laihoi a ka awh han. A lû dawk vaiphu kâphuen awh laihoi, vaiphu dawk a kâkaawk awh han.
A samnaw hai a ngaw awh vaiteh, burihni a kâkhu awh vaiteh, lung ka mathout poung lahoi nang hanelah puenghoi a khuika awh han.
Talai a lungui karawk e, khopui Taire kho api kho hoi maw a kâvan.
Nang e hnopai pueng teh, talî lam lahoi a ceikhai navah, taminaw a lungtang sak awh, moikapap e hno na hnopai lahoi siangpahrangnaw na bawi sak.
Atu teh, nang teh talî dawk thoseh, na yo han e hnopainaw hai thoseh, tuicapa e lungui a kâkhoe teh nang koe kaawmnaw pueng be a rak awh.
Tuilum e tami pueng teh, hote hno dawk a kângai a ru awh. Siangpahrangnaw teh, a minhmai a paling awh teh, a pawngmuen rueng a thaw awh.
Alouklouke hno kayawtnaw ni nang na pacekpahleknae lawk a dei awh. Nang teh taki na tho poung toe, bout na kamphawng mahoeh toe, telah na khui na ka khai awh han, telah a ti.
BAWIPA e lawk kai koe bout a pha.
Tami capa Taire bawi koevah dei pouh haw, Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei, na lungthin na kâpouk teh, Cathut lah ka o. Talî lungui vah cathut a tahungnae dawk ka tahung telah na ti, hateiteh, tami rumram lah doeh na o, cathut lungthin lah na kâpouk eiteh, cathut nahoeh.
Thaihaw Daniel hlak na lunganghnawn, nang koe lawk hro thai kawi lah awm hoeh.
Na lungangnae hoi kho na poukthainae ni na bawi sak teh, na râw bawm dawkvah sui hoi ngun na pâkuem.
Ka lentoe poung e na lungangnae hoi na yorannae lahoi, na mek poung teh na tawnta dawkvah na lungthin na kâoup.

Khenhaw! takikatho poung e alouke miphunnaw hah nang koe ka patoun han, ahnimouh ni nange lungangnae ka lentoe e hah tahloi hoi a bouk vaiteh, na bawilennae a raphoe han.
Ka dungpoung e tangkom thung na pabo awh vaiteh, talî lungui e ro patetlah na due han.
Na hringnae ka thet e hmaitung vah, cathut lah ka o na ti han rah na ou, a hmâ na ka paca e kut dawk teh cathut lah na awm hoeh, tami rumram lah doeh na o.

Hothloilah, BAWIPA e lawk kai koe a pha teh,
tami capa Taire siangpahrang khuinae kalungla hah phueng nateh, ahni koevah hettelah Bawipa Jehovah ni a ti, ahawinae ka kuep, lungangnae hoi ka kawi e, kamcupoung e meilam hoi ka kuep,
Eden hmuen takha dawk na o toe, na i dawk talung aphu kaawm e aphunphun hoi na kamthoup. Sardis, topaz, diamon, beril, onyx, jasper, saphir, sarakdin, karbokul, phunphun hoi, sui hoi sak e cecak, vovit, naw haiyah na khe tahma vah nang hane sut rakueng e lah ao toe.
Nang teh na karingkung cherubim hoi satui awi e lah na o. Cathut e mon kathoung dawkvah na o sak. hmaito hoi kâvan e talung phukaawm koe na kâhlai.
Na khe hnin hoi na yonnae a kamnue hnin totouh, na sak e pueng dawk na kuep e lah na o,

Kum hlaikahni, thapa yung pasuek, hnin hlaipanga hnin BAWIPA e lawk teh kai koe a pha teh,
tami capa Izip tamihu hah puenghoi khui haw, ama hoi a min kamthang e, miphun canu tangkom dawk kakumnaw koevah, adungpoungnae dawk bawt awh naseh.
Nang teh ayâ alouke hlak na meihawi maw, vuensom ka a hoeh e taminaw hoi rei ip lawih.
Talai hoi thei tangcoung e naw koevah, a rawp awh han, tahloi koe poe e lah ao toe, ama hoi a tami pueng hah he sawn lawih.
Athakaawme ni sheol thung hoi ahni hoi ahni kabawmkungnaw hah a pato awh han, tahloi hoi thei e vuensoma hoeh e naw a kum awh teh pou a yan awh.
Hote hmuen dawk Assiria hoi a taminaw ao awh, a phuennaw ni a ma hah a kalup awh, abuemlahoi tahloi hoi a thei teh, kadoutnaw doeh.
Tangkom teh kadungpoung e a khu dawkvah ao teh, petkâkalup lah a taminaw hah ao. Abuemlahoi tahloi hoi thei e karawmnaw ka hring ram dawk takinae kaawmsakkungnaw doeh.
Hote hmuen dawk Elam hoi tangkom petkâkalup lah, a taminaw ao awh teh, abuemlahoi tahloi hoi thei e teh karawmnaw, vuensoma laipalah talai rahim ka kum e, kahring e ram dawk takinae kaawmsakkung, yeiraiponae tangkom thung kakumkhaikungnaw doeh.
Thei e naw thung dawk ama hoi a taminaw inae a sak pouh teh, phuen hah ama petkâkalup lah ao. Abuemlahoi vuensom ka a hoeh e, tahloi hoi thei e naw doeh. Lungpuennae teh, ka hring e ram dawkvah, lungpuennae hah doeh. Hatei, tangkom thung kakumnaw hoi yerai a po awh teh thei e naw koe ao sak.
Hawvah, Meshek hoi Tubal naw hai ao awh. Phuennaw teh petkâkalup lah ao teh, abuemlahoi vuensoma hoeh, tahloi hoi thei e naw doeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, a hringnae ni ka hring e ram dawk lungpuen hah ouk a tho sak awh.
Vuensom a hoeh e tami athakaawme ka rawm e, tarantuknae puengcang hoi sheol dawk ka kum e, tahloi hah a lû rahim a hruek teh, a hrunaw dawk amamae yon ao, bangkongtetpawiteh, ahnimouh teh ka hring e ram dawk e tami thasai, lungpuennae kaawmsakkungnaw doeh.
Vuensom ka a hoeh e koevah, na rek vaiteh, tahloi hoi kadoutnaw koe na i han.
Hawvah, Edom siangpahrangnaw hoi a bawi pueng, a thasai awh eiteh, tahloi hoi a thei e naw koevah a yan sak awh. Vuensom ka a hoeh e tangkom thung vah, kakumnaw koe a yan awh.
Hawvah, a tung lae bawi pueng, Sidonnaw a thei awh e thung dawk ka kum e ao awh. A thasainae ni tami koe lungpuennae a tho sak eiteh, a kaya awh. Vuensom a laipalah, tahloi hoi a thei e naw koevah, a yan awh teh, tangkom thung kakumnaw hoi yeirai a po awh.
Faro ni a hmu vaiteh, a tamihu pueng a lungmawngsaknae dawk a hno awh han. Faro hoi a ransahu pueng tahloi hoi a thei e hai telah Bawipa Jehovah ni a dei.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, ka hring e ram dawk lungpuennae hah ka o sak teh, vuensom ka a hoeh e tahloi hoi a thei e naw koevah, Faro hoi a tamihunaw a yan awh han.
BAWIPA e lawk kai koe a pha teh,
tami capa, na miphun na catoun koe lawk dei haw. Ram dawk tahloi ka pha sak teh, ram dawk e taminaw ni amamouh thung dawk e tami buet touh a la awh teh, ramveng lah a hruek awh toteh,
ram dawk tahloi a pha e a hmu toteh, mongka hah ueng laihoi taminaw hah kâhruetcuetnae poe pawiteh,
mongka ueng e pawlawk ka thai e pueng ni kâhruetcuet lai hoi awm laipalah, tahloi hoi a due nakunghai, a thipaling phu teh a ma ni a khang han.
Mongka lawk a thai nahlangva, kâhruetcuet poenae banglahai a noutna hoeh dawkvah, a thipaling phu teh a khang han. Hateiteh, a lawkpui lah hrueng pawiteh, a hringnae a rungngang han.
Hateiteh, ramveng ni tahloi a pha e hah a hmu teh, mongka ueng hoeh lah, taminaw hah kâhruetcuetnae poe laipalah, ka phat e tahloi ni ahnimouh thung e tami buetbuet touh dout sak pawiteh, payonnae dawk a due han. A thipaling phu teh ramveng koe ka suk han telah dei pouh.
Hot patetlah nang tami capa, Isarel imthung hanelah, ramveng lah na rawi, hatdawkvah, ka pahni dawk hoi ka tâcawt e lawk hah na thai teh, kai hanelah kâhruetcuetnae na poe awh han.
Tamikathout koe, Oe! tamikathout na due roeroe han, telah ka ti toteh, tamikathout teh a hringnuen kamlang khai hanelah, kâhruetcuetnae na poe hoeh, haw e tamikathout teh a yon dawk dout pawiteh, a thipaling phu teh nang koe na suk han.
Nahoeh pawiteh, tamikathout teh a hringnuen ceitakhai hanelah kâhruetcuetnae na poe ei, a hringnuen cettakhai hoeh boilah, a payonnae dawk a due han, nang teh na hringnae na rungngang lah ao han.
Hatdawkvah, tami capa Isarel imthung koevah, hettelah dei haw, ka sak e yonnae hoi lawkeknae ni na ratet, hote hno kecu dawk ka rawknae lah awm pawiteh, bangtelamaw ka hring thai awh han, telah na ti awh.
Bawipa Jehovah ni a dei e teh, kai ka hring e patetlah tamikathout teh, a duenae dawk ka lunghawinae ka tawn hoeh, tamikathout ni a hringnuen a ceitakhai e doeh kai ka lunghawinae lah ao.
Kahawi hoeh e na hringnuen koehoi ban awh. Ban awh, Oe! Isarel imthungnaw bang dawk ne na due awh han, telah ati. Hatdawkvah, nang tami capa na taminaw koe dei haw. Tamikalan teh rawm pawiteh a lannae ni a rungngang thai mahoeh. Tamikathout ni thoenae hah roun pawiteh, ahmaloe e a thoenae kecu dawk rawknae koe phat mahoeh. Tamikalan teh a yonnae hnin dawk hring thai kalawn mahoeh.
Tamikalan koevah na hring roeroe han telah ka ti navah, a lannae kâuep hoi yonnae sak pawiteh, lannae a sak e hah buet touh hai panue pouh e lah awm mahoeh, yonnae a saknae dawkvah a due han.
Tamikayon koevah na due roeroe han, bout ka ti pouh teh, a yonnae kamlang takhai pawiteh, thoungnae hoi lannae a sak toteh,
Tamikayon na hung e hno hah a pâban teh, a paru e hah bout a poe, hringnae a phunglam hah a tarawi payonnae banghai sak hoehpawiteh, a hring roeroe han, dout mahoeh.
Yonnae a sak tangcoung e hah nâtuek hai pâkuem pouh mahoeh toe. Thoungnae hoi lannae a sak toung dawkvah, a hring roeroe han.
Hateiteh, na taminaw ni BAWIPA hno sak e lan hoeh ati awh toteh, a sak awh e hah a lan hoeh dawk doeh.
Tamikalan ni a lannae kamlang takhai teh yonnae sak pawiteh, hote kecu dawk a due han.
Tamikayon ni a yonnae a kamlang takhai teh, thoungnae hoi lannae sak pawiteh, hote lahoi a hring han.
Hateiteh, BAWIPA hnosaknae heh, lan hoeh telah na ti awh, Oe! Isarel imthungnaw, tami pueng amamae a hringnae patetlah lawkceng han telah a ti.
Kaimouh santoungnae kum hlaikahni, thapa yung hra, hnin panga hnin vah, Jerusalem hoi ka yawng e tami buet touh kai koe a tho teh, khopui teh tâ e lah ao toe telah a ti.
Hote ka yawng e a pha hoehnahlan tangminlah, BAWIPA ni kaie lathueng a kut a toung, amom lah kai koe a tho navah, ka pahni yo na ang sak toe. Hottelah ka pahni ka ang teh, lawk ka dei thai laipalah ka o.
BAWIPA e lawk kai koe a pha teh,
tami capa ka rawk e Isarel ram dawk kaawm rae ahnimouh ni Abraham teh buet touh dueng eiteh, ram teh a ring. Maimouh teh moipap awh teh ram râw lah na poe awh toe nahoehmaw, telah ati awh.
Hatdawkvah, ahnimouh koe Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei. Moi hah a thi hoi na ca awh teh, meikaphawknaw koe na mit na um sak awh, tami na thei awh, nangmouh ni ram hah na coe awh han na maw.
Na tahloi na kâuep awh teh, panuettho e hno hah na sak awh. Na imri e yunaw na yonkhai awh, nangmouh ni ram hah na coe han na maw.
Hettelah ahnimouh koe na dei pouh han, Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei, Kai ka hring e patetlah ka rawk e ram dawk kaawm e hah tahloi hoi a due roeroe han, kahrawngum kaawm e hah, sarang ni a ca hanelah ka poe han. Kacake rapanim hoi talung kâko dawk kaawm e hah lacik patawnae hoi a due awh han.
Ram pueng kingdi vaiteh, takikathopounge lah ka o sak han, a hnotithainae a kâoupnae hah a baw han toe. Isarel mon teh kingdi vaiteh, apinihai cet awm awh mahoeh toe.
Panuet ka tho e hno a sak awh kecu dawkvah, a ram teh ka raphoe vaiteh, takikathopounge lah ka o sak hnukkhu, kai teh BAWIPA lah ka o tie a panue awh han.
Hathnukkhu nang, tami capa, tapang teng e takhangnaw koe, na taminaw hoi pou na dei awh vaiteh, tami pueng ni a hmaunawngha koevah, tho awh haw, BAWIPA koe e lawk thai awh haw sei, telah ati awh han.
Kaie tami patetlah nang koe a tho vaiteh, kaie ka tami patetlah na hmalah a tahung awh vaiteh, nange na lawk a thai nakunghai yah, tarawi awh mahoeh. Ngai ka tho poung e mitnoutnae hah a pahni hoi a kamnue sak nakunghai, a lungthin ni talai hno dueng hah a pouk awh han.
Khenhaw! nang teh ahnimae lah pahrennae la, kahawipoung lah sak e hoi kahawicalah kueng e lah na o han, na lawk a thai awh han, hatei tarawi awh mahoeh.
Hattoteh a pha han toe, khenhaw! a pha torei teh, ahnimouh koe profet ao tie hah ahnimouh ni a panue awh han telah, tet pouh telah a ti.
BAWIPA e lawk kai koe a pha teh,
tami capa Isarel tukhoumnaw taranlahoi pâpho haw. Pâpho nateh, ahnimouh tukhoumnaw koe hettelah Bawipa Jehovah ni a dei, Isarel tukhoumnaw, mahoima dueng kâkawknaw teh lungmathoe hanlah a o, tukhoumnaw ni tu hah a kawk awh mahoeh na maw.
Nangmouh ni a thaw hah na ca awh teh, a muen hah na kâkhu awh. Kathâw kathâw e na thei awh, hatei, tunaw teh na kawk awh hoeh toe.
A thayoun e tha na poe awh hoeh, kapatawnaw na dam sak awh hoeh, a khok kâkhoenaw na kawm pouh awh hoeh. Pâlei e naw bout na bankhai awh hoeh. Kahmat e hai na tawng awh hoeh. Thama thama lahoi lawkkahram lah na hram sin awh.
Kakhoumkung ao hoeh dawkvah, tunaw teh a kâkayei awh. A kâkayei toteh, sarangnaw e rawca lah ao awh.
Kaie tunaw teh mon tangkuem koe a kâva awh, kaie tu hah talai pueng koe a kâkayei teh khopouk pouh kung hoi katawngkung awm hoeh, telah dei haw telah a ti.
Hatdawkvah, tukhoumnaw BAWIPA e lawk thai awh haw.
Kai ka hring e patetlah Bawipa Jehovah ni a dei. Tukhoumnaw awm hoeh. Tukhoumnaw ni kaie tunaw hah a tawng awh hoeh dawkvah, kaie tunaw kahrawng e sarangnaw e rawca lah ao awh teh, kaie tunaw hah sarang ni kei hanelah ao awh. Tukhoumnaw ni amahoima a kâkawk awh teh, kaie tuhu hah kawkhik awh hoeh.
Hatdawkvah, nangmouh tukhoumnaw BAWIPA e lawk thai awh haw.
Hettelah Bawipa Jehovah ni a dei. Khenhaw! tukhoumnaw ka taran, a kut thung e tunaw hah ka lawp vaiteh kaie tukhoumnae koehoi kâhat sak han. Tukhoumnaw teh amahoima kâkawk awh mahoeh toe, bangkongtetpawiteh, tuhunaw hah a râwca lah ao hoeh nahanelah a pahni dawk hoi ka tunaw hah ka la pouh han toe, telah a ti.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei. Khenhaw! kai kama roeroe ni ka tunaw hah ka tawng vaiteh ka hmu han.
Tukhoumkung ni tuhu kâkayei e tunaw a tawng e patetlah ka tunaw hah ka tawng han, tâmai hoi hmonae hmuen koe pueng hai ka tawng han.
Ram tangkuem koehoi ka la vaiteh ka pâkhueng han, amamae ram roeroe dawk ka ceikhai han. Isarel ram thung hoi tanghling, khosaknae hmuen pueng koevah ka kawk han.
Ramhringnae koe ka pâ sak vaiteh, a im hah Isarel mon rasangnae koe ao han, kahawi e takha dawkvah a tabo awh vaiteh, Isarel mon dawk hrâmnaw a onae koe a pâ awh han.
Kai kama roeroe ni ka tunaw hah ka kawkhik han, karoumcalah ka tabo sak han, telah Bawipa Jehovah ni a ti.
Kahmat e ka tawng vaiteh, pâlei e bout ka bankhai han. A khok kâkhoe hah ka kawm pouh vaiteh, a patawnae hah kahawi sak han. Hateiteh, kathâw e hoi a thasai e hah ka thei vaiteh, lawkcengnae koe ka pha sak han, telah BAWIPA ni a ti.
Bawipa Jehovah ni a dei e teh, Oe! ka tunaw, saring alouklouknaw thoseh, tutannaw hoi hmaetannaw thoseh, kai ni ka kapek han.
Nangmouh teh kahawie hram kanaw e hmuen koe na ca awh e dueng laipalah, kacawie tui hah na khok hoi na pânut sak hane teh, kathoengcae hno doeh, telah na pouk awh na maw.
Nangmouh ni na coungroe e phokungnaw thoseh, na khok hoi na pânut sak e tui hai thoseh, kaie tunaw ni a canei awh han na maw.
Hatdawkvah, Bawipa Jehovah ni ahnimouh koe hettelah a dei, kathâw e saringnaw hoi kamsoe e saringnaw hah kai ni lawkceng han.
Nangmouh ni a thakayoune tunaw hah hmuen tangkuem koe kâkayei sak hanelah na loung hoi na en awh teh, na ki hoi na deng awh.
Hatdawkvah, ka tunaw ka rungngang vaiteh, ahnimouh teh sarang ni a kei rumram e lah awm mahoeh toe. Tunaw e a rahak vah lawk ka ceng han.
Tukhoumkung buet touh ka rawi pouh vaiteh, ahni ni a kawk han. Kaie ka san Devit ni ahnimouh a kawk vaiteh, ama teh kakhoumkung lah ao vaiteh a kawkhik han.
Kai BAWIPA teh ahnimae Cathut lah ka o vaiteh, ka thaw katawkkung Devit teh ahnimae lathueng kahrawikung lah ao han, kai BAWIPA roeroe ni yo ka dei toe.
Hahoi, ahnimouh hoi roumnae lawkkamnae hah ka sak vaiteh, sarang kathout hah ram thung hoi ka baw sak han, kahrawngum vah karoumcalah kho a sak vaiteh, ratu thungvah karoumcalah a i awh han.
Ahnimouh thoseh kaie mon petkâkalup lah kaawm e hai thoseh, yawhawi ka poe vaiteh, amae atueng dawk kho ka rak sak vaiteh, yawhawinae khotui a rak han.
Ram thung e thingnaw ni a pawra han, talai ni hai apaw a tâco sak han, khocanaw ni karoumcalah ao awh han, ahnimouh ni a phu awh e kahnam rui ka a pouh vaiteh, thama thama lah ka rek e ahnimae kut dawk hoi ka tâco sak toteh, kai teh BAWIPA lah ka o tie a panue awh han.
Jentelnaw ni bout lawm awh mahoeh toe, ram dawk e sarang ni hai kei awh mahoeh toe. Apihai takinae poe mahoeh toe, ahnimouh teh karoumcalah ao awh han toe.
A min kamthang e takha hai ahnimouh hanelah kai ni ka sak pouh han, a ram dawk takangnae, kahai lah onae bout awm mahoeh toe. Jentelnaw e dudamnae khang awh mahoeh toe.
Ahnimae Bawipa Jehovah teh ahnimouh hoi rei o e thoseh, Isarel imthungnaw hai ka tami lah ao e hai thoseh, a panue awh han telah Bawipa Jehovah ni a dei.
Nangmouh ka tuhu hoi saring pânae hmuen dawk e ka tuhu hah ka tami na o awh. Kai hai nangmae Cathut ka ka o, telah Bawipa Jehovah ni a dei telah a ti.
BAWIPA e lawk kai koe bout a pha teh,
tami capa Seir mon taranlahoi kangdout sin nateh, ahni koe pâpho haw.
Ahni koe Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei, Khenhaw! Seir mon nang teh na taran, na lathueng vah ka kut ka dâw han, na raphoe vaiteh takikathopoung e lah na o sak han.
Nange khopui ka raphoe vaiteh, nang teh tami kingdi lah na o vaiteh, kai teh BAWIPA lah ka o e hah na panue han.
Nang tarannae pou ao vaiteh, Isarel imthung dawk runae a thonae tueng yon kecu dawk khangnae tueng a poutnae dawk, ahnimae hringnae hah tahloi hoi na thei awh dawkvah,
Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei teh, kai ka hring e patetlah a hringnae thei e hah nang dawk kai ni ka sak vaiteh, thipaling ni na pâlei han, a thipaling hah nang ni na hmuhma hoeh dawkvah, a thipaling ni na pâlei awh han.
Hottelah Seir mon hah kingkadi sak vaiteh, kai ni ka raphoe vaiteh, ka cet e ka tâcawt e naw hah ka raphoe han.
Nange monnaw hai nange ronaw hoi ka kawi sak han. monnaw, tangkomnaw, tuipuiteng tahloi hoi thei e naw hoi king ka kawi han.
Be na thei awh vaiteh, nange khopuinaw dawk apihai awm mahoeh, kai teh BAWIPA lah ka o tie na panue awh han.
Haw vah, BAWIPA ao eiteh, hete miphun kahni touh hoi ram kahni touh teh, kaie lah ao teh, kai ni ka tawn han na ti dawkvah,
kai ka hring e patetlah BAWIPA ni a dei. Na lungkhueknae hoi na maithoe kecu dawk, utsinnae na kamnue sak e patetlah nang dawk ka sak van han, nange kong ka dei torei teh, ahnimouh koe ka kamnue sak han.
Nang ni Isarel monnaw a rawk teh, kaimanaw ca hane kawi lah na o awh, telah dudamnae lawk dei e lawk pueng hah BAWIPA ni be ka panue a tie na panue han.
Kai taranlahoi na pahni hoi na kâoup teh kâtaran lahoi na dei e lawk ka thai toe telah ati.
Hettelah Bawipa Jehovah ni a dei, na raphoe navah, talai pueng heh a lunghawi han.
Isarel imthung ni coe e râw a rawk e hah na lunghawikhai dawkvah, hot patetlah nang e lathueng ka sak han. Oe! Seir mon hoi Edom pueng he a rawk vaiteh, BAWIPA lah ka o tie a panue awh han.
Tami capa Isarel mon koevah, lawk hah pâpho haw, nangmouh Isarel monnaw BAWIPA e lawk hah thai awh haw.
Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei, taran ni haha! BAWIPA e monnaw teh maimae kut dawk a pha awh toe, telah nangmouh koe lah a dei awh dawkvah,
lawk hah pâpho haw, Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei, nangmanaw na raphoe awh teh, hmuen pueng koe hoi na payon awh dawkvah, tami ni na dei hane, dudam hanlah na o awh dawkvah,
hatdawkvah, nangmouh Oe! Isarel monnaw Bawipa Jehovah e lawk hah thai haw, Bawipa Jehovah ni monnaw, monruinaw, tui lawngnae, tanghlingnaw, kahrawngum hoi, ceitakhai e khopui, petkâkalup lah kaawm e miphun pueng lawp e hoi, hnephnap e naw koevah, hettelah a dei.
Hatdawkvah, Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei, kacawirae miphunnaw hoi Edomnaw pueng lunghawinae lungthin, noutnahoehnae lawp hanelah kâsak e naw koevah, lungkhuek laihoi lawk ka dei.
Hatdawkvah, Isarel ram e kong dawkvah, lawk pâpho haw, monpui monrui, tui lawngnae ravo hoi tanghling koevah, Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei, khenhaw! miphunnaw ni na panuikhai e na khang dawkvah, lungkhuek hoi ka dei toe.
Hatdawkvah, Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei. Petkâkalup lah kaawm e miphunnaw ni, amae yeirainae a phu roeroe han telah, ka kut ka dâw teh thoe ka bo.
Hateiteh, Oe! Isarel monnaw, a kang na tho vaiteh ka tami Isarelnaw hanelah, apaw na paw awh han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, bout na tho awh nahan a hnai toe.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, nangmouh koelah doeh ka kampang katang, nangmouh koelah kamlang vaiteh, phaw e lah o vaiteh, cati tu e hah na o han.
Nangmae lathueng vah tami kamphung sak vaiteh, Isarel imthung pueng abuemlahoi ahnimouh teh khopui dawk ao awh vaiteh, ka rawk e hmuennaw hah bout ka pathoup han.
Nangmae lathueng vah tami hoi saring kamphung sak han. A kamphung awh vaiteh, catoun lah pou ao awh han. Ahmaloe onae hmuennaw dawk kai ni hmuen ka poe han, apuengcue e kai ni ka sak e patetlah ka o sak han, kai teh BAWIPA lah ka o e hah a panue awh han.
Nangmae lathueng taminaw hah kaie ka tami Isarel miphunnaw teh, a ceio awh nahanelah. kai ni ka sak han, ahnimouh ni, na coe e hah a la awh vaiteh, a coe awh e raw lah na o han, nangmouh kecu dawk camo na sung awh mahoeh toe.
Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei, nang tami ka cat e hoi khocanaw e camo meng na ka thet e na ti pouh awh dawkvah,
tami na cat mahoeh toe, na miphunnaw hai na raphoe mahoeh toe, telah Bawipa Jehovah ni a dei.
Miphunnaw dudamnae na thai sak awh mahoeh toe. Taminaw e tamthoe na khang boi mahoeh toe. Na ram hai na rawm sak mahoeh toe telah Bawipa Jehovah ni a dei telah ati.
Bawipa Jehovah e lawk kai koe bout a pha teh,
tami capa Isarel imthungnaw teh, amae ram dawk ao awh teh, amamouh lungpouk a tawksak e lahoi, hote ram a khin sak awh. A hringnuen teh napui kampheng lahun e hringnae patetlah ao.
Hote ram dawk tami theinae yon, meikaphawk hoi kâkhinsaknae yon dawkvah, ka lungkhueknae a lathueng vah ka awi toe.
Miphunnaw koe ka kâkayeisak, ram tangkuem dawk a kâkayei awh teh, a hringnuen hoi a tawksak awh e patetlah ahnimouh lathueng lawk ka ceng.
A cei awh nah tangkuem dawk a phanae ram koevah, ka min ka thoung a khin sak awh. Ayâ ni ahnimouh koe hetnaw heh BAWIPA e taminaw doeh, hateiteh, a ram dawk hoi ka tâcawt e naw doeh telah ati awh.
Hateiteh, Isarel imthung ni, a ceinae miphunnaw koevah, a khinsak awh e ka min ka thoung heh ka pasai poung.
Hatdawkvah, Bawipa Jehovah ni Isarel imthung koe hettelah a dei. Oe! Isarel imthungnaw nangmouh kecu dawk nahoeh, na ceinae ram dawk ka min ka thoung na khin sak awh kecu dawk doeh hetheh ka sak.
Miphunnaw koevah nangmouh ni na kamhnawng sak e, kaie ka min hah ka tawmrasang han. Nangmae hmaitung vah nangmouh lahoi kai na tawmrasang e lah ka o toteh, kai teh Jehovah lah ka o tie nangmouh ni na panue awh han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh nangmouh teh ram tangkuem hoi kai ni na kaw awh teh, na pâkhueng awh vaiteh, ahmaloe na onae ram dawk na ceikhai han.
Nangmae lathueng vah kathounge tui na kathek sin awh vaiteh, nangmouh teh a khinnae pueng koehoi meikaphawk thung hoi na kamthoung sak awh han.
Lungthin katha na poe awh han, na thung vah muitha katha ka hruek han, nangmae tak thung e talung lungthin hah ka la vaiteh, tak lungthin na poe awh han.
Kai e Muitha hai nangmae thung ka hruek han, nangmouh ni kâlawk na poe e na tarawi awh vaiteh, kai ni na dei pouh e naw hah na hringkhai awh han.
Mintoenaw koe ka poe e ram dawk nangmouh ni na o awh vaiteh, ka tami lah na o awh han, kai hai nangmae Cathut lah ka o han.
Na kamhnawng awh e thung hoi na tâco sak han. Cakang hah kâ ka poe vaiteh, ka pungdaw sak han. Nangmae lathueng vah takang ka tho sak mahoeh toe.
Thingthai rompo ka pungdaw sak vaiteh, na law dawk rawca ka tâco sak han. Hottelah takang a tho e kecu dawk, hnehnapnae na khang awh mahoeh toe.
Kahawi hoeh e na hringnuen hoi kahawihoehe na tawksak e hah na kâpanue awh vaiteh, panuetthonae hoi na hawihoehnae kecu dawk, na mithmu roeroe vah namahoima na kâpanuet awh han.
Nangmouh kecu dawk hetheh ka sak e nahoeh tie pahnim awh hanh awh telah Bawipa Jehovah ni a dei. Oe! Isarel imthungnaw kahawihoehe na hringnuen kecu dawk, kayak awh nateh, kângairu lah awm awh.
Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei, na hawihoehnae pueng dawk hoi kai ni na thoung sak hnin dawk teh, khopui dawk kho na sak sak awh vaiteh, ka rawk tangcoung e bout sak e lah ao han.
Kacetnaw kaawmnaw e hmaitung vah, pahnawt tangcoung e talai dawk laikawk bout na kanawk awh han.
Hat toteh, taminaw ni ahmaloe pahnawt e hete talai teh, Eden takha patetlah ao toe, be raphoe e khopuinaw hai, kacak niteh, khocanaw hai a kuep awh toe telah a dei awh han telah ati.
Hat toteh, ka rawk e hmuennaw hah kai BAWIPA ni ka pathoup e thoseh, pahnawt e talai dawk laikawk kanawk e thoseh, namae tengpam kaawm e pueng Jentelnaw ni a panue awh han telah, kai BAWIPA ni ka dei e patetlah ka sak roeroe han.
Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei. Isarel imthung hanelah, hete hno ka sak nahanelah, ahnimouh ni kai koe na kâhei awh han. Tuhunaw patetlah a taminaw kamphung sak han.
Kathounge thuengnae koe poe e, saringnaw hoi, Pawi hnin dawk hane Jerusalem tuhu patetlah ka rawk e khopui teh, tamihu moikapap e hoi akawi han. Hottelah kai heh BAWIPA lah ka o tie hah a panue awh han telah tet pouh ati.
BAWIPA e kut teh kaie lathueng ao teh. BAWIPA e Muitha lahoi alawilah na tâcokhai teh, tanghling lungui hrunaw dueng hoi kingkawi e koe kai hah na hruek.
Ahnimouh koe na ceikhai, hote tanghling dawk moikapap e hrunaw hah ao teh, ahnimouh teh khik a ke awh.
BAWIPA ni kai koevah, tami capa hete hrunaw a hring thai han na maw, telah ati, Kai ni hettelah ka dei pouh, Oe! Bawipa Jehovah nang ni na panue, telah ka ti.
BAWIPA ni hai hete hrunaw lathueng vah lawk dei haw, ahnimouh koe Oe! hrukenaw BAWIPA e lawk hah thai awh haw.
Hete hrukenaw koevah Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei. Khenhaw! nangmouh dawk kâha ka pakhum vaiteh, na hring awh han.
Nang mamouh dawk tharui ka hruek han, takthai hoi ka pacawp awh vaiteh, vuen hoi ka ramuk awh han, nangmae thung vah kâha ka pakhum vaiteh, na hring awh han. Kai teh BAWIPA lah ka o tie na panue awh han telah a ti.
Hottelah kâ ka poe e patetlah ka pâpho teh, thaihaw! ka pâpho lahun nah, dongdengca dawk hrunaw hah amamouh a onae hmuen tangkuem dawk a kâpatawp awh.
Ka khet navah, khenhaw! ahnimouh dawk tharui ao teh, takthai ni a pacawp teh, vuen ni a ramuk, hateiteh, hring awh hoeh rah.
BAWIPA ni kai koevah, kahlî koe lawk dei haw, tami capa kahlî koe pâpho e roeroe haw, telah Bawipa Jehovah ni ati. Oe! kahlî talai takin pali touh koe hoi tho awh haw, kadoutkaronaw a hring thai awh nahanelah, ahnimouh lathueng pakhum haw telah a ti.
Hottelah kâ ka poe e patetlah ka dei teh kahlî teh ahnimouh thung a kâen teh a hring awh, amamae khok hoi lengkaleng a kangdue awh teh, ransahupui lah a coung awh.
BAWIPA ni kai koevah, tami capa ahnimouh ni hrunaw heh Isarel imthungnaw doeh, ahnimouh ni kaimae hrunaw be a ke teh, ka ngaihawinae hai be ka kahma tangngak awh toe telah a dei katang awh.
Hatdawkvah, lawk hah pâpho nateh, ahnimouh koe Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei, khenhaw! nangmae tangkomnaw ka paawng han, Oe! ka taminaw na tangkomnaw dawk hoi na rasa awh vaiteh, Isarel ram dawk na kâenkhai awh han.
Nangmae tangkomnaw ka paawng teh na tangkomnaw dawk hoi na rasa awh toteh, kai teh BAWIPA lah ka o tie na panue awh han.
Hahoi nangmae na thung ka muitha ka pakhum han, hring awh vaiteh, namamae na ram dawk roeroe na hruek awh han, kai BAWIPA ni yo ka dei toung dawkvah, hot hah ka sak tie na panue awh han, telah BAWIPA ni a dei telah a ti.
BAWIPA e lawk kai koe bout a pha teh,
nang tami capa sonron buet touh lat haw, a van vah Judah hoi Isarel miphunnaw telah thun haw, sonron alouke hai lat nateh Joseph, Ephraim, Isarel imthungnaw telah thun haw.
Hote sonron kahni touh e hah buet touh lah pacawng nateh, hahoi na kut dawk buet touh lah ao han.
Na taminaw ni hete hno heh bangmaw a dei ngainae, kai koe dei kawi hoeh namaw telah a pacei navah,
Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei, khenhaw! Joseph e sonron Ephraim hoi Isarel miphun kut dawk kaawm e hah ka la han, Hothateh, Judah e sonron hoi ka pacawng vaiteh, buet touh lah ao han toe, ati, telah na ti pouh han.
A van vah na thut e sonron hah ahnimae a mithmu vah na kut dawk ao han.
Hahoi ahnimouh koe Bawipa Jehovah hettelah a dei, khenhaw! miphunnaw a onae hmuen koehoi, ka hrawi vaiteh, hmuen tangkuem koehoi ka pâkhueng vaiteh, amamae ram dawk ka kâenkhai han.
Hahoi Isarel mon dawk miphun buet touh lah ka sak han, uknaeram kahni touh lah awm mahoeh toe.
Ahnimae meikaphawknaw hoi panuettho e hno hoi, kâtapoenae dawkvah, kâkhinsak awh mahoeh toe. A rawpnae ouk a yonae pueng thung hoi ka rungngang vaiteh, ka thoung sak han, hat torei teh, ka tami lah ao awh vaiteh, ahnimae Cathut lah ka o han.
Kaie thaw katawkkung Devit hah ahnimae lathueng siangpahrang lah ao han. Ahnimouh pueng e a lathueng dawk tukhoumkung buet touh ao han, kaie kâpoe e hah tarawi awh vaiteh, kaie phunglam hah a pâkuem awh vaiteh a hringkhai awh han.
Kaie thaw katawkkung Jakop koevah, ka poe e ram na mintoenaw kho ouk a sak boi dawkvah, kho a sak awh han, amamouh hoi a canaw a catounnaw hai kho pou a sak awh han, hahoi ka thaw katawkkung Devit hah ahnimae a lathueng bawi lah ao han.
Hothloilah, ahnimouh koe roumnae lawkkamnae ka sak han, ahnimouh hanelah a yungyoe lawkkamnae lah ao vaiteh, ahnimouh koe ka poe han. Ahnimanaw teh a pungdaw awh vaiteh, ahnimouh koe a yungyoe totouh, kaie hmuen kathoung hah ka kangdue sak han.
Kaie lukkareiim hai ahnimouh koe ao vaiteh, ahnimae Cathut lah ka o vaiteh, ahnimouh hai kaie taminaw lah ao awh han.
Hottelah hmuen kathoung teh ahnimouh koe a yungyoe a cak toteh, Bawipa Jehovah ni Isarel miphun hah a thoung sak toe telah Jentel miphunnaw ni a panue awh han telah a ti.
BAWIPA e lawk kai koe a pha teh,
tami capa Magog ram e Rosh hoi Meshek hoi Tubal kahrawikung kacuepounge Gog taranlahoi kangdout sin haw, ahni taranlahoi pâpho haw.
Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei. Khenhaw! Rosh, Meshek, hoi Tubal bawi Gog, nang hateh na taran.
Na ban sak vaiteh, na pâkha dawk hradang hoi na sawn han, na ransanaw hoi marangnaw, marangransanaw hoi puengcang hoi, kamthoupnaw, bahling, bahling kathoeng a sin awh teh, tahloi kasinnaw hah ka thokhai han.
Persia, Ethiopia, Libia hoi abuemlah bahling hoi sumluhuem kaawmnaw hah,
Gomer hoi a ransahu hahoi Togarmah, imthung hoi atunglae ram a poutnae, ransahu pueng hoi nang koe kaawm e tami moikapap hoi a kâbang awh han.
Kâhruetcuet, coungkacoe kârakueng lahoi awm, nang nama hoi nang koe kamkhueng e tamihunaw hoi ahnimouh karingkung lah awmh.
Hnin moi a loum hnukkhu, nang teh uknae kâ na tawn han, tahloi dawk hoi na hlout vaiteh, miphunnaw thung hoi rasa e khoca moikasawlah kingdi lah kaawm e, Isarel monnaw lathueng, bout a tâcokhai e khocanaw ao awhnae koe, hma lae tueng dawk nang ni na tuk han. Hote khocanaw teh, miphunnaw thung dawk hoi tâcokhai e lah ao teh ram pueng karoumcalah ao toteh,
hahoi na luen vaiteh, tûilî patetlah na tho han, nang koe kaawm e ransahu pueng hoi, nang koevah tami moikapap e hah tâmai ni ram muen kayo e patetlah na o awh han.
Hahoi Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei, hote hnin dawk teh, nang ni bangpueng na pouk vaiteh, kahawihoehe pouknae na tawn vaiteh,
rapan ka tawn hoeh e kho hoi ram hah ka lawp han, karoumcalah kaawm rumram e hah la ao awh vaiteh, rapan tawn laipalah kho ka sak e longkha hoi tarennae sum ka tawn hoeh e hah, ka tuk han telah na lung dawk hoi na ti han.
Nangmae na hnopainaw na lawp awh han. Ahmaloe kingdi ni teh, atu tami a onae hmuennaw hah miphun pueng thung hoi na pâkhueng vaiteh, saring hoi hnopai moikapap a tawn awh teh, ram lungui dawk kaawmnaw thoseh, ka tuk han telah na pouk han.
Sheba hoi Dedan, Tarshish hno kayawtnaw hoi Sendektancanaw ni, nang koevah hnopai la hanelah na tho toung maw, hnopainaw lawp hanelah na tamihunaw na pâkhueng toe khe. Ngun hoi sui saringhu hoi hnopai moikapap lawp pouh vaiteh, na ka lat pouh hane doeh khe, na ti pouh han telah ati.
Hatdawkvah, tami capa lawk pâpho haw, Gog koevah, Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei, hote hnin, ka tami Isarelnaw karoumcalah ao awh nahane hnin hah na panuek hoeh na maw.
Atunglae ram a poutnae koe e hmuen koehoi nang hoi nama koe tami moikapap, marang dawk kâcui e ka lentoe e tamihu, athakaawme ransahu hoi a tho awh han.
Tâmai ni ram muen a ramuk e patetlah ka tami Isarelnaw taranlahoi na tho han, atueng a hnukteng toteh, kaie ram tuk hanelah na ceikhai awh han, Oe! Gog ahnimae hmaitung nang dawk thoung sak e lah ao toteh, miphunnaw ni na panue awh han.
Hahoi Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei, ayan hoi kaie thaw katawkkung Isarel profetnaw, hatnae kum moikasaw lah lawk ouk ka dei boi e naw ni, ahnimouh tuk hanelah ka ceikhai awh nahane kong ouk a dei awh e hateh nang raw na maw.
Hote hnin dawkvah, Isarel ram tuk hanelah Gog a tho toteh, ka lungkhueknae ka minhmai ka kamnue sak han, telah Bawipa Jehovah ni a dei.
Ka lungkhuek lahun nah, hote hnin dawk teh, Isarel ram dawk Tâlî pueng hoi a no han.
Talî dawk e tanga hoi kalvan tavanaw hoi moithang hoi talai van dawk a vonpui hoi kâva e saringnaw hoi talai dawk e tami pueng ka hmalah a pâyaw awh han. Mon hah rahnoum sak e lah ao vaiteh, lungha hah a tip han, kalupnae rapan pueng talai dawk koung a tip han, telah ka dei.
Kaie monnaw dawk Gog tuk hanelah tahloi hah ka kaw vaiteh, tami pueng e tahloi ni a hmaunawngha hah a thut han telah Bawipa Jehovah ni a dei.
Kâtheinae lacik patawnae lahoi runae ka poe han. Ama hoi a ransahu hoi ama koe e tami moikapap e lathueng vah, puenghoi ka nung e khotui hoi roun kalenpounge hmai hoi ganhmai kho lah ka rak sak han.
Hottelah kai teh, kama hoi kama kâsungren sak vaiteh, kama hoi kama kâthoung sak han, kai teh BAWIPA lah ka o tie a panue awh han.
Hatdawkvah, nang tami capa, Gog taranlahoi lawk pâpho haw, Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei, khenhaw! Oe! Gog, Rosh, Meshek hoi Tubal naw e bawi, nang teh na taran.
Hnukhma lah na palang vaiteh, atunglae apoutnae koehoi, na tâcokhai vaiteh, Isarel mon dawkvah na phakhai han.
Avoilae na kut dawk e licung hah ka khoe vaiteh, aranglae na kut dawk e palacung hah ka khoe han.
Nang nama hoi na ransanaw nang koe kaawm e tamihu hoi, Isarel mon dawk na rawp awh han. Moi ka cat e kalvan e tavanaw hoi sarangnaw kei sak hanelah na poe awh han.
Kahrawngum vah na rawp awh vaiteh na due awh han. Kai ni yo ka dei toe telah Bawipa Jehovah ni a dei telah a ti.
Magog hoi talî rai lae karoumcalah kho kasaknaw koevah, hmai ka tâco sak han, hahoi kai teh BAWIPA lah ka o tie hah a panue awh han.
Hottelah ka tami Isarelnaw dawk ka min kathoung hah ka panue sak vaiteh, ka min kathoung khin sak e ka pasoung mahoeh toe, hottelahoi miphunnaw ni kai teh BAWIPA, Isarel miphunnaw e tami kathoung lah ka o tie a panue awh han.
Khenhaw! a pha toe, kuepsak e lah ao roeroe han telah Bawipa Jehovah ni a dei. Hete hnin doeh telah yo ka la dei tangcoung e hah.
Isarel khopui dawk kho kasaknaw hah a tâco awh vaiteh, tarantuknae puengcang, bahling kathoeng kalen, licung hoi samtang, tahroe hoi bongpai naw hah kum sari touh thung hmai a sawi awh han.
Hatnae tueng dawk takha dawk thing phawt mahoeh, ratu thung e tâtueng awh mahoeh, tarantuknae puengcangnaw hoi hmai a patawi awh han, ka raphoekungnaw hah a raphoe awh han. Kalawmkungnaw e hnopai a lawp awh van han, telah Bawipa Jehovah ni a dei.
Hote hnin torei teh, Gog hanelah Isarel ram dawkvah, pakawp nahane hmuen ka poe han, talî, kanîtholah Abarim tanghling hah Gog hoi a taminaw a pakawp awh han dawkvah, hote hnin teh, kahlawng kacetnaw e a hnawng a tabuem awh han, hatdawkvah, hote hmuen hah Hamon-gog tanghling telah ati awh han.
Isarelnaw ni amamae ram a thoung sak thai nahanelah, thapa yung sari touh thung a pakawp awh han.
Khocanaw pueng ni a ven awh vaiteh, talai dawk a pakawp e lahoi, kai na pholennae hnin dawk ka min kamthangnae lah ao awh han telah Bawipa Jehovah ni a dei.
Hahoi amamae ram a thoung sak nahanelah, pakawp hoeh e naw hah a tawng awh teh, kapakawmkungnaw hah a rawi awh han, ahnimouh ni thapa yung sari aloum hnukkhu tawng hane a kamtawng awh han.
Ram katinnaw ni a katin awh navah, tami hru hmawt awh pawiteh, Hamon-gog tanghling dawk kapakawmkungnaw ni a pakawp awh hoehroukrak teh mitnoutnae a ung awh han.
Khopui e min hai Hamonah telah a phung han, hottelahoi ram hah a thoung sak awh han telah a ti.
Hahoi nang tami capa Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei, tava phunkuep hoi moithang phunkuep koevah, lawk dei, kamkhueng awh nateh tho awh.
Athakaawmnaw moinaw hah na ca awh vaiteh, talai e kahrawikungnaw e a thi hah na nei awh han, tutan hoi tuca, hmae, Bashan ram e maitotannaw e thipalingnaw hoi,
nangmouh hanelah bu lawngnae ka sak e athaw hah kingboum lah na ca vaiteh, a thi hah nget ka parui lah a nei awh han.
Hottelah marang hoi leng ka kâcuinaw, athakaawme taminaw, hoi tarantuk pueng hah kaie bu lawng na koe ka boum lah na ca awh han, telah Bawipa Jehovah ni a dei.
Ka bawilennae hai Jentel miphunnaw koe kai ni ka hruek han. Lawk ka dei tangcoung e hoi ahnimouh dawk ka kut ka toung e hah Jentel miphun pueng ni a hmu awh han.
Kai teh ahnimae BAWIPA heh Cathut lah ka o tie Isarel imthungnaw ni hote hnin koehoi a panue awh han.
Isarel imthungnaw ni amamae yon kecu dawk santoungnae hah Jentelnaw ni a panue awh han. Kai koe a yon awh dawk, ka minhmai ka thung vaiteh, a tarannaw e kut dawk ka poe vaiteh, ahnimouh pueng teh tahloi hoi koung a due awh.
A kamhnawngnae hoi kâtapoenae patetlah ahnimae a lathueng ka sak teh, ahnimouh koe ka minhmai ka thung.
Hatdawkvah, Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei. Atuvah, Jakop sankatoungnaw hah ka bankhai vaiteh, Isarel imthungnaw pueng koevah pahrennae ka tawn han. Ka min kathoung hane dawkvah, ka lung a cak han.
Na lungpuensak hane apihai awm laipalah, amamae ram dawk ao awh nah, kai koe a yonnae, kaie lathueng lawkeknae hoi, yeiraiponae hah a phu awh han.
Ahnimouh teh miphun pueng koehoi ka bankhai vaiteh, a tarannaw e kut dawk hoi ka pâkhueng toteh, miphunnaw hmaitung vah ahnimouh teh a thoung awh hah.
Miphunnaw koevah san lah kaawmsakkung kecu dawk thoseh, hateiteh buet touh boehai san lah cettakhai laipalah, amamae ram dawk roeroe vah, bout ka bankhai e dawkvah, kai teh Bawipa Jehovah lah ka o tie a panue awh han.
Ahnimouh koe ka minhmai ka thung mahoeh toe, bangkongtetpawiteh, Isarel imthungnaw e a lathueng vah ka muitha ka awi toe telah Bawipa Jehovah ni a dei telah a ti.
Santoungnae kum 25, kum kamtawngnae thapa hnin hra hnin vah, khopui raphoe lah ao hnukkhu kum hlaipali nah, hote hnin roeroe dawk BAWIPA e kut teh kai van ao teh, hawvah na ceikhai.
Cathut a kamnuenae vision lahoi Isarel ram dawk na ceikhai teh, mon ka rasang poung e van na hruek, hote mon e teng vah akalah khopui patetlae hah ao.
Hawvah na ceikhai, khenhaw! tami buet touh a o, rahum patetlah a meilam a o, pahla hoi bangnuenae cakui a sin teh, longkha koe a kangdue.
Ahni ni tami capa, takuetluet khenhaw! na hnâpakeng haw, kai ni na patue e naw hah na lungthung paen haw. Kai ni na patue hane kong dawk, hivah na thokhai e doeh. Na hmu e pueng hah Isarel imthung koe na pâpho han telah a ti.
Khenhaw! bawkim petkâkalup lah rapan hah ao. Tami ni bangnuenae lahoi dong taruk touh kasawe cakui a sin teh rapan a tha e teh cakui yung touh, a rasang e hai cakui yung touh a pha.
Kanîtholah kangvawi e takhang koe a cei teh, khalai dawk hoi a luen, takhang kâennae rakhan hah a bangnue teh cakui yung touh a kaw.
Takhang e rakhannaw teh cakui yung touh hoi adangka cakui yung touh, rakhan buet touh hoi buet touh e rahak teh, dong panga touh doeh. Hahoi impui lae takhang alawilae takhang kâennae rakhan teh cakui yung touh doeh.
Imthungkhu e takhang rai imkalae takhang hai a bangnue teh cakui yung touh a pha.
A thung lae takhang, alawilae hai a bangnue teh dong taroe touh a pha, takhang khomnaw teh dong hni touh a tha, longkha alawilae hah athunglah ao awh.
Hma lae longkha phekkadangka lae dawk rakhan kathoenge kathum touh rip a o, yung adangka rei kâvan, rasang e hai rei a kâvan.
Takhang kâennae hai a bangnue teh adangka dong hra, rasang dong hlaikathum a pha.
Rakhan kathounge a hmalah avangvanglah thingphek ka tha e dong touh ao. Avangvanglah kaawm e rakhan kathoungnaw teh a yung, a phen dong taruk touh rip a pha.
Kâennae tâconae longkha hah a bangnue teh, a lathueng e rakhan hoi avanglae rakhan totouh dong 25 touh a kaw, takhang hoi takhang be a kâkuet.
Hahoi longkha khom a bangnue teh dong 60 touh a rasang. Kâennae tâconae, thongma petkâkalup e hah longkha e a rahim lah kaw sak e lah ao.
Hahoi longkha alawilah, tengkatoe e hoi takhang athungpoung lae rahak teh dong 50 touh a pha.
Hahoi takhang imthungkhu lah petkâkalup lah paawng thai hoeh e hlalangaw ao. A rahak e khom hoi im e alawilah haiyah, athunglah haiyah, petkâkalup lah hlalangaw ao teh, a khom dawkvah, samtuekung meikaphawknaw ao awh.
Thongma lae alawilah, na ceikhai teh, thongma petkâkalup e dawk rakhan hoi talung phai e a o, talung phai e van vah, rakhan 30 touh ao.
Longkha teh talung hoi phai e doeh, longkha hoi kâvan lah phai e doeh, talung phai e teh a rahimhnawn lah doeh.
Hathnukkhu, a rahim lae takhang apasuek koe hoi athunglah hoi thongma alawilah totouh, a bangnue teh a kaw e teh kanîtho lahoi atung lah dong 100 touh rahak ao.
Thongma alawilae ni hai, kâen tâconae atunglah a kangvawi teh, rasang hoi adangka a bangnue.
Karingkung e rakhan avangvanglah kathum touh ao teh, longkha rahim lae hoi kâen tâconae takhang koe kaawm e naw patetlah doeh ao awh. A yung dong 50, adangka dong 25 touh doeh.
Rakhan kalenpounge hoi hlalangawnaw hoi samtuekung meinaw hah Kanîtholae longkha koe kaawmnaw patetlah doeh ao awh. Longkha totouh, luennae lakhout sari touh ao teh, rakhan vaikhap teh a thung lah ao.
Kanîtholah kaawm e patetlah atunglae longkha phekkadangka lae thung rapan longkha ao. Takhang buet touh hoi buet touh dong 100 touh a kâhla.
Hathnukkhu akalah na ceikhai teh, akalae longkha ka hmu, khomnaw vaikhapnaw bangnue teh alouke lae hoi rei kâvan lah ao awh.
Ahmaloe e hlalangaw patetlah hlalangawnaw, vaikhapnaw ao awh teh, ayung dong 50, adangka dong 25 touh a pha.
Lakhout sari touh dawk hoi luen e lah a o, vaikhapnaw teh, khalai hoi sue touh lah ao awh. Avangvang lae khomnaw dawk samtuekung mei a thuk awh.
Akalah a kangvawi lahoi athung kâen tâconae longkha ao. Akalae kâen tâconae longkha rahak a bangnue teh dong 100 touh a kâhla.
Akalae kâen tâconae athung lae thongma dawk na kâenkhai teh, bangnuenae hoi akalae longkha hah a bangnue.
Rakhan kathoungnaw, khomnaw, vaikhapnaw teh ahmaloe e hoi rei a kâvan awh. Hlalangawnaw ao teh petkâkalup lah vaikhap hai ao. A yung dong 50, adangka dong 25 touh a pha.
Petkâkalup e vaikhapnaw hai ayung dong 25, adangka dong 5 touh a pha.
Vaikhapnaw ni alawilah thongma koelah a kangvawi awh teh, khomnaw dawk samtuekung mei a thuk awh, Lakhout taroe touh dawk hoi luen e lah ao.

Vaikhapnaw teh alawilah thongma koelah a kangvawi awh teh, avangvang lae khomnaw dawkvah, samtuekung mei hah a thuk awh. Lakhout taroe touh dawk hoi luen e lah ao.

Takhang khomnaw, vaikhapnaw teh alawilah thongma koelah a kangvawi awh, takhang rahim, hi lahoi avanglah samtuekung mei hah ao. Lakhout taroe touh dawk hoi luen e lah ao.
Hmaisawi e saring hah tui hoi pâsu nahane rakhannaw, kâennae naw teh, hote takhang e vaikhap dawkvah ao.
Hmaisawi thuengnae, yontha thuengnae, kâtapoe thuengnae sathei thei hanelah, kâennae takhangnaw teh hote vaikhap avangvanglah caboi kahni touh lengkaleng ao.
Atunglae longkha koe luennae alawilah caboi kahni touh ao. Vaikhap koe takhang avangvanglah haiyah caboi kahni touh lengkaleng ao.
Takhang avangvanglah caboi pali touh a o, avanglah hai caboi pali touh bout a o, thuengnae sathei ouk theinae teh caboi taroe touh a pha.
Hmaisawi thuengnae sathei hanelah, caboi pali touh e naw teh, talung hoi sak e, ayung dong touh hoi khap touh, adangka dong touh hoi khap touh, a rasang dong touh a pha, hote caboi van vah, hmaisawi thueng nahane sathei thei nahane puengcangnaw hah a van a hruek awh.
Caboi van petkâkalup lah a kaw e kuttabei hlawk touh a rai pou a yep awh teh, caboi van vah thueng hane sathei hah a hruek awh.
Hahoi athung e thongma dawkvah, na kâenkhai, khenhaw, athung e thongma dawk imrakhan kahni touh ao. Rakhan buet touh e teh, atunglae takhang teng ao teh akalah a kangvawi. Rakhan buet touh e teh akalae takhang teng ao teh atunglah a kangvawi.

Hathnukkhu, im e tapang a bangnue teh, dong taruk touh a tha, a takin tangkuem koe imrakhan dong pali touh kaw e hah im petkâkalup lah ao.

Ateng e rakhannaw teh, hoehoe a rasang teh, hoehoe a kaw van, bangkongtetpawiteh, tapangnaw teh hoe a kâhnai teh, rakhan a rahim poung e hoi a lathueng poung dawk, cei hanelah a lungui e hah ceitakhai a ngai.
Hahoi im petkâkalup e dawk, talung ka coum e ka hmu, a teng e rakhan adu ungnae teh a bangnue nah dong taruk touh ka saw e cakui yung touh bang a kaw, a rasang e hoi kâvan lah a rasang.
Ateng lae rakhan, alawilae tapang teh, dong panga touh a tha. Bawkim teng alawilae rakhan tapang hloilah dong panga touh, hmuen ka houng e ao rah.
Im petkâkalup dawk e rakhan naw teh im e rakhan a rahak vah dong 20 touh a kâhla.
Ateng lae imrakhan e takhang hah a houngnae hmuen koe lahoi paawng e lah ao, buet touh takhang teh atunglah a kangvawi, buet touh takhang teh akalah a kangvawi. Petkâkalup lah hmuen ka houng e teh dong panga touh a pha.
Kanîloumnae koe impui a hnuklah hmuen ka houng e a hloi lae im a kaw e teh ayung dong 70 touh a pha. Hahoi im e tapang teh petkâkalup lah dong panga touh a tha, ayung dong 90 touh a pha.
