Hothloilah Isaiah ni, kalvan ransabawi yungyoe kahring e Cathut ni maimouh hanlah catoun pek hoehpawiteh, Sodom hoi Gomorrah khopui hoi doeh kâvan awh ti telah sut a dei e patetlah ao.
Telah pawiteh, maimouh bangtelamaw dei awh han toung. Lannae ka pâlei hoeh e Jentelnaw ni lannae teh a coe awh toe. Hothateh, yuemnae lahoi coe e lannae lah ao.
Lannae hoi kâkuen e phung coe hanelah ka pâlei e Isarel miphun naw teh hote phung hah phat thai awh hoeh.
Bangkongmaw a pha thai awh hoeh. Yuemnae hoi laipalah tawksaknae dawk hoi kâyawm e lah ao dawk doeh. Ahnimouh teh talung dawk kamthui teh a tâlaw awh toe.
Khenhaw! Zion vah tâlawnae lungsong, payonsakkung talung hah kai ni ka hruek. Apihai ama ka yuem e tami pueng teh kayak mahoeh telah Cakathoung dawk thut e patetlah ao.
Ka hmaunawnghanaw Isarelnaw ni rungngang lah ao thai nahanelah ka ngaikhai poung dawkvah Cathut koe pou ka ratoum.
Ahnimouh ni Cathut hanelah puenghoi a lungthao awh e hah kai ni ka kampangkhai. Hatei, ahnimae a lungthaonae teh panuenae katang lah awmhoeh.
Ahnimouh ni Cathut e lannae a lamthung panuek a hoeh. Amamae lannae caksak hanelah a tawng awh dawkvah, Cathut e lannae dawk kâen thai a hoeh.
Kayueme tami pueng ni lannae koe pha thai awh nahanlah Khrih teh kâlawk poutnae doeh.
Mosi ni kâlawk lahoi kâkuen e lannae kong dawk a thut e teh, apihai hote kâlawk ka tarawi e pueng teh hotnaw lahoi a hring han, a ti.
Yuemnae lahoi coe e lannae teh, nange na lungthung vah kalvan lah apimaw ka luen han tet hanh. A deingainae teh Khrih hah kum khai han ti ngainae doeh.
Nahoeh pawiteh, adungpoungnae koe apimaw ka kum han telah hai tet hanh. A dei ngainae teh Khrih hah duenae koehoi tâcokhai han tinae doeh.
Bout a dei e teh phung lawk teh na teng vah ao. Na pahni dawk hai, na lungthung hai ao ati. Het hateh kaimouh ni ka pâpho awh e yuemnae lawk hah doeh.
Jisuh teh Bawipa doeh telah na pahni hoi na dei teh, na lungthung hoi Cathut ni ahni teh duenae koehoi a thaw sak toe telah na yuem pawiteh rungngang lah na o han.
Lannae koe pha hanelah lungthin hoi yuem han, rungngangnae koe pha hanelah pahni hoi pâpho han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Cakathoung ni, hote talung ka yuem e pueng teh kayak mahoeh a ti.
Het dawkvah Judahnaw hoi Griknaw rahak kapeknae awmhoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh tami pueng ka uk e Bawipa buet touh dueng ao teh Ama ka kaw e pueng teh yawhawinae kakhoutlah a poe.
Bangkongtetpawiteh Bawipa min ka kaw e pueng rungngang lah ao han.
Hateiteh ma ni yuem hoeh e Bawipa hah bangtelamaw kaw thai han vaw. Na thai boihoeh e Bawipa hah bangtelamaw na yuem thai han vaw. Kapâphokung awm laipalah bangtelamaw thai thai han vaw.
A tami patoun laipalah bangtelamaw pâpho thai han vaw. Hot patetlah Cakathoung dawk thut e patetlah, roumnae kamthang kahawi ka pâpho e, lunghawinae kamthang kadeikungnaw e khok teh a meihawipoung.
Hateiteh, tami pueng ni lunghawinae kamthang thai ngai awh hoeh. Profet Isaiah ni a dei e teh, Oe! Cathut kaimae kamthang kahawi apinimaw a yuem han, a ti.
Hatdawkvah yuemnae teh thainae koehoi a tho teh, thainae teh Khrih e a lawk lahoi doeh a tho.
Hatei, pacei han ka ngai e teh, ahnimouh ni thai awh hoeh maw. A thai toung te., Ahnimae hramnae lawk teh talai van pueng a kamthang teh ahnimae a lawk teh talaivan a pout totouh a pha, telah a dei.
Bout na pacei ngai e teh Isarelnaw ni panuek awh hoeh maw. Ahmaloe vah Mosi ni nâyittouh hoeh e miphun lahoi nangmouh koe utnae lungthin ka tâco sak teh, panuenae ka tawn hoeh e miphun lahoi yah, na khang thai hoeh hane totouh ka tâco sak han a ti.
Profet Isaiah nihai, kai ka tawng hoeh e naw ni kai hah na hmu awh. Kaie kong ka pacei hoeh e naw koe kamahoima kamphawng pouh han telah taranhawi laihoi a ti.
Hatei, Isarelnaw hoi kâkuen lah, lawk ka ngâi hoeh e, ka taran lah kaawm e naw koe kai ni kanîruirui kut ka na sin toe atipouh.
Telah pawiteh, Cathut ni amae miphunnaw a pahnawt toung telah na pacei pawiteh pahnawt hoeh, kai hai Isarel miphun, Abraham koehoi ka tho e, Benjamin catoun lah ka o.
Cathut ni sut a panue tangcoung e taminaw pahnawt hoeh. Profet Elijah ni, Isarelnaw Cathut koe a thaisak navah Cakathoung dawk bangtelamaw a thut tie na panuek awh hoeh maw.
Ahni ni, Oe Cathut, ahnimouh teh Bawipa nange profetnaw hah a thei awh toe. Bawipa nange thuengnae khoungroenaw a raphoe awh toe. Kai buet touh dueng doeh kaawm toe. Kai hai thei hanelah na tawng awh toe telah a dei.
Hatei, Cathut ni bangtelamaw a dei pouh tetpawiteh, Baal hmalah khok cuengkhuem hoeh e tami thong sari touh kama hanelah ka pek toe telah atipouh.
Hot patetvanlah atu tueng haiyah, lungmanae lahoi rawi e acawinaw ao rah.
Hatei, lungmanae lahoi boipawiteh tawksaknae lahoi nahoeh toe. Hoehpawiteh lungmanae teh lungmanae lah awm mahoeh.
Hottelah pawiteh bangtelamaw. Isarel miphunnaw ni panki laihoi a tawng awh e hno hah hmawt a hoeh. Rawi e lah kaawm naw ni dueng doeh a hmu awh. Aloukenaw teh a lungpata awh.
Cathut ni ahnimouh koevah atu totouh a lungthin pueng a ramuk pouh. Ka hmawt thai hoeh e mit, ka thai thai hoeh e hnânaw hah a poe telah Cakathoung dawk a thut e patetlah atu a kuep toe.
Devit ni hai a dei e teh, ahnimae caboi teh tangkam patung e lah, karap patung e lah, payonsakkung lah, moipathung hanelah awm naseh telah a ti.
Ahnimanaw e mit teh hmu thai hoeh totouh dawn naseh. Ahnimae keng hai hnamkhun yungyoe seh telah a ti.
Hat pawiteh, Isarelnaw ni a rawp totouh a kamthui awh toung maw telah na pacei. Telah nahoeh. Ahnimouh payonnae lahoi Jentelnaw koe rungngangnae a pha teh, Isarelnaw ni utsinnae a tawn awh nahane doeh.
Hatei, ahnimae payonnae ni talaivan taminaw hanelah yawhawinae a tâcokhai. Ahnimae sungnae ni Jentelnaw hanlah yawhawinae tâcawtkhai pawiteh, ahnimae kuepnae ni teh banghloimaw hawinae hoe a tâcokhai han.
Hottelah ka ti nah, kai teh Jentelnaw koe patoun e guncei lah ka o e patetlah,
hote thaw tawknae dawk kâoup teh, ka miphunnaw e pouknae hah buetbuet touh lahoi utsinnae a tawn awh vaiteh rungngang lah ao awh thai nahanelah ka ngaihawi.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, ahnimouh pahnawt lah a onae teh talaivan taminaw hanlah bout kâmaihawi lah awm pawiteh, ahnimouh bout coenae teh kadout tangcoung naw hanlah duenae koehoi bout hringnae lah kaawm han nahoehmaw.
Aluepaw lah thueng e tavai teh thoung pawiteh abuemlah a thoung han. A khongyang thoung pawiteh, a kang naw pueng hai a thoung han.
A tangawn e a kang naw teh tâtueng vaiteh, kahrawng e Olivekung lah kaawm e nang hah hote a kangnaw dawkvah, pacawng laihoi Olive khongyang dawk e tui na kahmawng e lah na awm pawiteh,
hote cakang naw e lathueng kâoupnae lungthin tawn hanh. Na kâoup han na ngai pawiteh, nang ni a khongyang na doun hoeh, khongyang ni doeh nang teh na doun.
Hattoteh nang ni kai hah na pacawng nahanelah a kangnaw teh bouk lah ao na ti han doeh.
Bokheiyah. Ahnimouh a yuem hoeh dawk tâtueng lah ao teh, nang teh yuemnae lahoi doeh na cak. Kâoupnae tawn hanh, takinae tawn haw.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Cathut ni apasuek e a kangnaw pasai hoehpawiteh, nangmouh hai na pasai mahoeh.
Hatdawkvah Cathut ni lawkcengnae hoi lungmanae hah khenhaw! Lawkcengnae teh ka rawm e taminaw lathueng ao teh, Cathut lungmanae teh nang ni hote lungmanae dawk pou na awm pawiteh, nang koevah ao. Pou na awmhoeh pawiteh nang haiyah tâtueng lah na o han.
Ahnimanaw pueng hai yuemhoehnae tâkhawng awh pawiteh, a kang dawk patawp lah ao awh han. Bangkongtetpawiteh ahnimanaw pueng bout patawp hanelah Cathut ni a sak thai.
Bangkongtetpawiteh nang teh kahrawng e Olivekung dawk hoi tâtueng e lah na o teh, kahawi e Olivekung dawk kaawm boihoeh e patawp e lah na awm pawiteh, kaawm boi e Olive kangnaw teh a kung karuem dawk banghloimaw bout patawp hanelah a yawi han.
Hmaunawnghanaw nangmanaw, kâoupnae lungthin na tawn hoeh nahanelah, Jentelnaw pueng a kâen hoehnahlan totouh Isarel tami tangawn teh hmonae ni a ramuk e hrolawk heh panuek laipalah na o sak hanelah na ngaikhai awh hoeh.
Hote Cakathoung dawk e patetlah Isarelnaw pueng rungngang lah ao awh han. Cakathoung ni a dei e teh, ka hloutkhaikung Bawi teh Zion mon dawk hoi a tho vaiteh, Jakop e miphun dawk hoi tami kahawi hoeh naw koung a raphoe han.
Ahnimouh a yonnae pueng ka tâkhawng pouh toteh ahnimouh koe kai ni ka poe hane lawkkam doeh telah Ca Kathoung dawk thut e patetlah ao.
Ahnimanaw teh kamthang lawkkahawi kecu dawk nangmae taran lah kaawm nakunghai rawinae dawk teh mintoenaw pawlawk dawk pahren lah ao awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Cathut e poehnonaw hoi kawnae teh bout kâthung hoeh.
Nangmouh pueng teh ahmaloe vah Cathut e lawk na ngâi awh hoeh eiteh, atuteh ahnimae lawkngâihoehnae ni pahrennae na coe sak toe.
Hot patetvanlah nangmouh ni na coe e pahrennae lahoi yah, ahnimanaw hai pahrennae a coe thai nahan, atuvah ahnimanaw teh lawkngai laipalah ao awh.
Cathut ni tami pueng pahrennae tawn thai nahanlah taminaw lawk ngaihoehnae dawk a paung.
Cathut e lungangnae hoi poukthainae a dungkawnae teh a dungkaw tangngak doeh. Lawkcengnae naw apinimaw koung a panue thai han. A lamthungnaw tawng nakunghai hmawt thai hoeh.
Cathut e a pouknae apimaw ka panuek, BAWIPA hoi apimaw ka kâpan.
Kahawi hno saknae pathung thai nahan, a yungyoe Cathut dawk apine hnokahawi ka sak.
Hno cawngca pueng teh Bawipa koehoi, Bawipa lahoi, Bawipa hanelah ao awh. Bawipa teh a yungyoe bawilennae awm lawiseh. Amen.
Hatdawkvah, hmaunawnghanaw nangmouh na hroecoe ngainae teh Cathut pahren lahoi nangmae na tak teh, Cathut ngai e lah kaawm e kathoung ni teh kahring e sathei lah thueng awh. Hethateh, nangmouh ni na tawk kawi lah kaawm e muitha koelae thaw doeh.
Nangmouh teh, talaivan meilam kâmahrawk awh hanh. Cathut ni ngai e lah kaawm e kahawi e hno, ngai kaawm e hno, ka kuep e hnonaw hah kapek teh panue thai nahanlah lungthin katha pathoupnae lahoi meilam kâthungnae tawn awh.
Cathut lungmanae lahoi na poe lah kaawm e nangmouh koe dei hanlah ka ngai e teh, mahoima hoe kârasang laipalah Cathut ni thaw buetbuet touh na rei tangcoung e patetlah pouk awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, tak buet touh dawk puengcang moikapap lah ao eiteh, hote puengcangnaw ni thaw buet touh e dueng rip tawk a hoeh.
Hot patetlah moikapap e maimouh teh Khrih thung tak buet touh lah o awh teh lengkaleng a cakang lah o awh.
Hottelah na poe e poehnonaw aphunphun coe awh e patetlah, aloukloukcalah coe awh dawkvah, sutdeilawk ka coe e lah awm pawiteh yuemnae a coe e patetlah pâpho naseh.
Ayâ hanlah thaw ka tawk hanelah na awm pawiteh, hottelah tawk hanelah ao. Kacangkhaikung saya hanelah na awm pawiteh cangkhainae thaw tawk hanelah ao.
Kahroecoekung hanelah na awm pawiteh hroecoenae thaw tawk hanelah ao. Poe pasoung hanelah na awm pawiteh lungtho thahmei lahoi poe pasoung hanlah ao. Ka ukkung hanelah na awm pawiteh lungtho tha patung laihoi uk hanlah ao. Kabawp hanelah na awm pawiteh lungthocalah hoi kabawp hanlah ao.
Lungpatawnae teh kâsaknae awmhoeh. Kathout e hno panuet awh. Kahawi hno dawk lungpen awh.
Hmaunawngha lungpatawnae dawk buet touh hoi buet touh kâlungma awh. Kâbari awh nateh, ayânaw kai hlak bet ahawi telah pouk awh.
Pangak laipalah na thahmei sak awh nateh, lungkânging lahoi Bawipa e thaw tawk awh.
Ngaihawinae dawk lunghawi awh. Rucat na kâhmo awh nah panguep awh. Ratoum yungyoe awh.
Tami kathoungnaw e a pankinae hah poe pasoungnae hoi ka bawm awh nateh, imyinnaw kahawicalah khenyawn awh.
Nangmouh na ka rektap e naw hanelah ratoum pouh awh. Yawhawi poe awh nateh thoebo awh hanh.
A kokanawmnaw hoi cungtalah konawm awh. Kakhuikapnaw hoi cungtalah khuikap awh.
Buet touh hoi buet touh lungthin kânging awh. Kâoupkâpawi laipalah, sue touh lah kâkhen awh. Namahoima kathoum ka thai kâtet awh hanh.
Apihai bout pathung a hanh awh. Taminaw hmalah nangmouh ni bari kaawm e sak hanlah kâcai awh.
A coung thai totouh tami puenghoi kâpolah awm awh.
Ka pahrennaw, nama ni pathung laipalah a lungkhueknae kut dawk hnawng awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh Cathut ni a dei e teh, pathungnae teh Kaie doeh ati. Kai ni ka pathung han ati telah Cakathoung dawk thut e lah ao.
Hatdawkvah kut pathung laipalah, na taran vonhlam pawiteh pacapanei awh. Tui kahran pawiteh tui pânei awh. Hottelah na sak e lahoi ahnie lû dawk hmaisaan na pâpawp pouh han.
Kathout e lahoi ta awh laipalah, kahawi e hno hoi kathoute hah tâ haw.
Lathueng lae ukkungnaw e kâ teh tami pueng ni ngai awh naseh. Cathut koehoi laipalah kâtawnnae tie awmhoeh. Atu kaukkungnaw heh Cathut ma ni a poe e doeh.
Kaukkungnaw ka taran e teh Cathut ni kâ poe e ka taran e lah ao. Hottelah ka taran e naw teh yon lawkcengnae ama ni a kâhmo awh han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, kaukkungnaw heh hawinae ka sak e taminaw hanelah taki hane awmhoeh. Hno kahawihoeh ka sak naw hanelah doeh taki hanelah ao. Hottelah na sak pawiteh ahnie oupnae na pang han.
Hatdawkvah ahnimouh teh nang hane hnokahawi kasakkung Cathut e san doeh. Hatei hno kathout na sak pawiteh takinae tawn lawih. Ahnimouh teh tahloi ayawmlah patuem awh hoeh. Ahni teh hno kathout ka sak naw hanlah a lungkhueknae yon lawkcengkung Cathut e san doeh.
Hat pawiteh, a lungkhueknae dawk dueng laipalah thoehawi panue e lahoi hai ngâi awh.
Het kecu dawk nan ou, tamuk naw hai na poe awh. Nangmouh teh Cathut e thaw katawknaw lah na o awh teh hote thaw doeh pou na tawk awh.
Hatdawkvah tami tangkuem hai poe kamcu e hah poe awh. Tamuk poe kamcu e naw hah tamuk poe awh. Cawng e poe tueng e naw hah cawng pouh awh. Taki tueng e naw hah taket awh. Bari kamcu e naw hah bari awh.
Lungpatawnae hloilah, bang patet e laiba hai tawn awh hanh. Ayâ lung ka pataw e ni kâlawk a kuep sak toe.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, uicuk hanh, tami thet hanh, parawt hanh, radueknae lung tawn hanh tie kâpoelawk koehoi kamtawng teh, alouke kâlawk bangpatet hai, nama hoi kâkuen e hah nama hoi kâvan lah lungpataw tie kâlawk dawk koung a kâkuet.
Lungpatawnae ni teh a tengpam huiko naw koe, hawihoehnae sak hoeh. Hatdawkvah, lungpatawnae teh, kâlawk ka kuepsakkung lah ao.
Nangmanaw ni, a tue teh na panue awh. Nangmouh inae koehoi kâhlaw nahane tueng a pha toe. Bangdawk ne tetpawiteh atu maimae rungngangnae teh maimouh yuemnae hnin hlak hoehoe a hnai toe.
Karum meimei aloum teh, kho meimei a dai toe. Hatdawkvah maimanaw teh ka hmawt e nuencangnaw takhoe vaiteh angnae nuencang naw khohnat awh sei .
Caneinawmnae, yamuhrinae, kamsoumhoehe napui tongpa yonnae hoi takngainae, kâpokâdanghoehnae hoi kâutnae dawk pawngpa laipalah khodai ceio e patetlah mitkhet kamcu lah khosak awh sei.
Bawipa Jisuh Khrih hah khohnat awh. Takthai lungradueknae thap sin hanelah kâcai awh hanh.
Yuemnae dawk a tha ka youn e taminaw hah dâw awh. Pouknae aphunphun dawk oun awh hanh.
Tami tangawn ni bangpuengpa ca thai tie a yuem awh. Hatei, yuemnae dawk a tha kayoun e naw teh anhla dueng doeh a ca awh.
Ka cat e ni ka cat hoeh e naw hnephnap hanh naseh. Ka cat hoeh naw ni hai ka cat naw lawkceng hanh naseh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Cathut ni ahni teh a coe toe.
Namahoima hah banglah maw na kângai teh, ayânaw e san hah lawk na ceng vaw. Ahni a kangdue hai thoseh, a rawp hai thoseh, a Bawipa hoi doeh a kâkuet. Hatei, ahni teh a kangdue han, bangkongtetpawiteh, Cathut ni a kangdue sak thai.
Tami tangawn ni ahnin hnin touh heh alouke hnin naw hlak hoe a talue ati awh. Tangawn ni a hninnaw pueng teh suetouh doeh ati awh. Tami pueng ama ni a pouk e hno dawk a lungkuep naseh.
A hnin ka ya e ni Bawipa hanlah ya naseh. Ka cat e ni hai Bawipa hanlah cat naseh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, ahni ni Cathut koe a lunghawi. Ka cat hoeh e ni hai Bawipa hanlah cat laipalah Cathut koe lunghawi naseh.
Maimouh dawk ma hanlah ka hring e buet touh hai awmhoeh. Ma hanlah kadout e buet touh hai awmhoeh.
Maimouh ni hring pawiteh Bawipa hanlah hring awh teh, dout pawiteh Bawipa hanlah due awh. Hatdawkvah, maimanaw teh hring hai thoseh, due hai thoseh Bawipa e lah o awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Khrih teh kadout tangcoungnaw hoi kahringnaw han ukkung Bawi lah ao hanlah duenae koehoi bout a thaw toe.
Telah pawiteh, bangkongmaw nang ni na hmaunawnghanaw hah lawk na ceng teh na dudam vaw. Maimouh pueng teh Khrih e lawkcengnae tungkhung hmalah koung kangdue awh han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, BAWIPA ni a dei e teh kai kahring dawk tami pueng ni ka hmalah a khokcuengkhuem awh han. Tami pueng e pahni ni Cathut hah a pholen awh han, telah Cakathoung dawk a thut.
Hettelah dawkvah, maimouh pueng ni Cathut hmalah mae nuencang lengkaleng dei awh han.
Hatdawkvah, maimouh buet touh hoi buet touh lawkkâceng awh hanh sei. Hahoi, hmaunawngha tâlaw nahan hoi lam payon nahanlah hno sak awh hanh sei.
Amahmawk kathounghoehe hno buet touh hai awmhoeh tie Bawi Jisuh dawk kacailah ka panue. Hatei, hno buetbuet touh thoung hoeh telah ka pouk e tami hanlah teh hote hno teh thoung hoeh.
Rawca kecu dawk na hmaunawngha lung mathout sak pawiteh, lungpatawnae dawk na hring hoeh. Khrih ni na due pouh e lungmanae hah nange rawca kecu dawk na hmaunawnghanaw, rawksak awh hanh.
Nangmouh hanlah hno kahawinaw hah yonpen e lah awm sak awh hanh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Cathut uknaeram teh caneinae dawk hoi kangdout hoeh. Kathoung Muitha lahoi coe e roumnae, lannae hoi lunghawinae hah doeh.
Hatdawkvah, hettelah hoi Khrih thaw katawkkungnaw teh Cathut hmalah ngai kawi e lah ao teh, taminaw hmalah hai yuemkamcu e tami lah ao.
Hatdawkvah, roumnae ka tâcawt sak e hnonaw hoi buet touh hoi buet touh hoe kamhlawm thai nahan panki awh sei .
Rawca kecu dawk Cathut thaw hah raphoe awh hanh. Atangcalah hno puengpa teh a thoung. Hatei, buetbuet touh e caneinae ni ayâ hanlah tâlawnae lah awm pawiteh, hot hateh yonnae lah ao.
Hmaunawngha, kamthui nahanelah awm pawiteh, moi ca hoeh e, yamu neihoehe hoi bangpueng sakhoehe ahawihnawn.
Nang ni na tawn e yuemnae teh Cathut e hmalah hrueng awh. Atang titeh coe e hno dawk amae lungthin panuenae kathounge tami teh a lunghawi.
Hatei, lungthounghoehnae hoi na cat pawiteh yuemnae lahoi a tho hoeh dawkvah, yon lawkcengnae hah a khang. Hahoi, bangpueng yuemnae laipalah sak e pueng teh yonnae doeh.
Maimouh a tha kaawmnaw ni ma ngai e patetlah awm laipalah a thakayounnaw e hnokari hah dounrouk awh sei .
Maimouh ni hmaunawnghanaw, ahawi nahan sak awh sei. Ahnimouh yuemnae hoe a roung nahane pouk hanelah ao.
Khrih ni ama hane dueng kâkaram hoeh. Bawipa kadudamnaw e a lawk teh kai van vah a bo telah Cakathoung dawk a kâthut.
Cakathoung dawk thut e naw pueng teh, maimouh na cangkhai nahanelah thut e lah ao teh, Cakathoung dawk a thut e panguepnae hoi lung kâpahawinae lahoi maimouh ni ngaihawinae tawn awh sei .
Khrih Jisuh e lamthung na panue laihoi lungthin buet touh lah coung thai nahan, panguepnae hoi lung kâpahawinae Bawi, Cathut ni nangmouh na kabawm lawiseh.
Hottelah doeh lungkângingcalah hoi Bawipa Jisuh Khrih e Pa hah pholen thai awh han.
Khrih ni Cathut lentoenae a kamnue sak teh, nangmouh na dâw e patetlah nangmouh ni buet touh hoi buet touh kâ dâw awh.
Bout ka dei e teh, Jisuh Khrih teh Cathut e lawkkatang kamnue sak nahanlah vuensom ka a naw e san lah ao. Hottelah a onae teh mintoenaw koe poe e lawkkam caksak nahane hoi,
Jentelnaw ni hai lungmanae lahoi Cathut lentoenae a pholen awh nahane doeh. Hatdawkvah Cakathoung ni, kai teh Jentelnaw koehoi nang hah na pholen vaiteh na min teh la hoi ka oup han telah a thut.
Hahoi, Jentelnaw pueng, Cathut e taminaw hoi cungtalah na konawm awh bout a ti.
Hathnukkhu, Jentelnaw pueng Cathut teh pholen awh. Miphun pueng ni Bawipa teh pholen awh telah bout a ti.
Hahoi Isaiah nihai, Jesi e a catoun koehoi a dâwn a sai han. Ahni teh Jentelnaw uk hanlah ka tâcawt e lah ao. Jentelnaw ni a ngaihawi a vaiteh a kâuep a han telah a dei.
Kathoung Muitha bahu hoi ngaihawinae kuep nahanelah, ngaihawinae Bawi, Cathut teh yuemnae koehoi ka tho e lunghawinae hoi roumnae puenghoi nangmouh koe kawi lawiseh.
Hmaunawnghanaw nangmouh teh hawinae hoi na kawi awh teh lungangnae aphunphun na tawn awh. Buet touh hoi buet touh na kâ cangkhai awh tie kaimanaw ni ka panue.
Hateiteh hete cauk dawk bout na panue sak hane ka ngai e a konglam hah taranhawi laihoi ka thut. Ka taranhawinae teh Cathut e thaw tawk pouh hanlah Jisuh Khrih e patoun e lah na o sak.
Jentelnaw teh Cathut ni coe han kamcu lah thuengnae lah o thai nahan, Kathoung Muitha lahoi Cathut koe poe e lah ao thai nahan, Cathut koehoi ka tho e kamthang lawk deinae dawk vaihma patetlah ka o.
Hatdawkvah Khrih Jisuh thung bawilennae dawk hoi Cathut e thaw tawknae ka kâuepkhai.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Jentelnaw hrawi thai nahane teh, Jisuh ni kai hah na hno teh, phunglawk lahoi tawknae dawk hai thoseh,
Mitnoutnaw hoi kângairunae bahu hoi thoseh, Cathut e Kathoung Muitha hoi sak e hnonaw laipateh taranhawi laihoi alouke banghai ka dei ngai hoeh. Hatdawkvah kai teh Jerusalem kho hoi Illirikum ram totouh ka cei teh Khrih e kamthang kahawi kakueplah ka pâpho.
Hottelah ka pâpho navah kai teh ayâ ni a pabo tangcoung e dawk bout ung hoeh nahanlah Khrih kong ka thai bawi hoeh rae ram koevah, kamthang kahawi dei hanlah ka lungtho thahmei laihoi ka panki.
Cakathoung ni, Bawipa e kong dei pouh boihoeh rae naw ni a hmu awh teh, ka thai boihoeh e naw ni a thaipanuek awh han telah a thut e patetlah ao.
Nangmouh koe tho hoeh nahanlah katarawkkung moi apap.
Hateiteh, atu hie hmuen koe o nahane hmuen ao hoeh e dueng laipalah, nangmouh koe tho hanlah kum moikasaw kâcai toe.
Hatdawkvah Spain ram lah ka cei torei teh nangmouh koe tawngtang ka tho vaiteh, nangmouh koe dongdeng ka o han. Hahoi nangmouh ni na thak awh vaiteh hote ram koelah tawngtang ka cei han telah ka ngaihawi.
Hatei atuvah dongdeng Jerusalem khopui lah ka cei vaiteh tami kathoung naw e thaw ka tawk pouh han rah.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Masidonia ram hoi Akhaia ram e naw ni, Jerusalem vah kaawm e taminaw thung dawk e ka roedeng e naw hnopai hoi kabawp hanelah a lungtho awh.
Ahnimanaw ni lungthonae a tawn awh e patetlah, ahnimouh koe lahoi hai a kabawp awh hanelah atueng van. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Judah naw koe e muitha koelah e hnonaw hah Jentelnaw ni coe awh van pawiteh, hnopai lahoi hai ahnimae thaw tawk pouh hanelah ao.
Hote hno ka cum hoi hete hnopainaw heh ahnimouh koe kahawicalah ka poe vaiteh, nangmouh koe lam lahoi Spain ram lah tawngtang ka cei han.
Nangmouh koe ka tho toteh Khrih e kamthang yawhawinae kuep hoi ka tho han tie ka panue.
Hmaunawnghanaw, maimae Bawipa Jisuh Khrih hoi Muitha ni na poe e lungpatawnae lahoi nangmouh koe kâhei han ka ngai.
Kai teh Judah ram e kayuemhoehnaw e kut dawk hoi kahlout teh, Jerusalem hanelah ka tawk e thaw hah, tami kathoungnaw e hmalah, ngai kawi kaawm lah ao nahan,
Cathut ni a ngai e patetlah lunghawi laihoi nangmouh koe ka tho vaiteh, nangmouh hoi cungtalah lungpahawinae ka coe nahan, panki laihoi kai hane hai ratoum awh loe.
Lungmawngnae Bawi lah kaawm e Cathut teh nangmouh pueng koe reirei awm lawiseh. Amen.
Kenkhrea kho kaawm kawhmoun thung e thaw katawkkung, ka tawncanu Phoebe heh nangmouh koe panue sak han ka ngai.
Tami kathoungnaw ni sak kawi kamcu e patetlah Cathut dawkvah ahni hah nangmouh koe awm sak awh nateh, a panki e pueng kabawm awh. Atangcalah ahni hateh kama koehoi kamtawng teh ayânaw pueng hai kabawm e doeh.
Khrih Jisuh thung kai hoi thaw rei ka tawk roi e Priscilla hoi Aguila hah kutman pouh awh.
Hringnae a kâhmoun hoi kai hai na khetyawt toe. Kai dueng laipalah, Jentelnaw e kawhmounnaw pueng ni hai a lunghawikhai awh.
Ahni im e kawhmoun hai kutman pouh awh. Asia ram vah Khrih hanelah aluepaw lah kaawm e ka pahren e Epenetas hai kutman awh.
Nangmouh hanlah thaw ka panki poung e Meri hai kutman awh.
Kaie miphun lah kaawm e kai hoi thongim rei ka bawt roi e Adronika hoi Junia hai kutman awh. Ahnimouh teh gunceinaw rahak vah a min kamthang e naw a tho teh, kai hlak hai Khrih thung hmaloe kaawm e taminaw doeh.
Bawipa dawkvah ka pahren e Ampliatus hah kutman awh.
Khrih thung cungtalah thaw tawk hui Urbanus hoi ka pahren e Satakhi hai kutman awh.
Khrih thung yuemkamcu e Apelles, hai kutman awh. Aristobulas imthungkhu naw hai kutman awh.
Ka miphunnaw Herodion hoi Nasisa imthungnaw hai kutman awh.
Bawipa dawkvah thaw ka panki e Triphaena hoi Triphosa tinaw hai kutman awh. Bawipa dawk thaw ka panki e ka pahren e Persis hai kutman awh.
Bawipa dawk rawi lah kaawm ni teh ka manu lahai kaawm e Rufus e manu hai kutman awh.
Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, tinaw hoi ahnimouh koe kaawm e hmaunawnghanaw hai kutman awh.
Filolokus, Julia, Nereus hoi a tawncanu, Olimpas hoi ahnimouh koe kaawm e Bawipa e tami kathoungnaw pueng hai kutman awh.
Buet touh hoi buet touh kathounge kâpaconae hoi kutman awh. Khrih e kawhmounnaw pueng ni nangmanaw kut na man awh.
Hmaunawnghanaw panue tangcoung e cangkhai e naw hah sak awh nateh, kampek sak e hoi payonnae ka pung sak e taminaw hah kâhruetcuet awh nateh roun awh ti teh na hroecoe awh.
Bangtelah tetpawiteh, Bawipa Jisuh Khrih thaw tawk awh laipalah, amamae vonpui thaw dueng a tawk awh teh, ouphlawpnae lawk hoi na tawmpalue awh teh, kamawngramenaw hah a dumyen awh.
Nangmae lawkngainae tami pueng koe a kamthang dawkvah nangmouh koe ka lunghawi. Hattelah dawkvah kahawi hno dawk lungang awh nateh, kahawihoehe dawk teh yon kanuenhoehe lah awm awh.
Roumnae Bawi lah kaawm e, Cathut ni a ro hoehnahlan Setan teh nangmae khok rahim vah reppasei lah ao sak han. Maimae Bawipa Jisuh Khrih e lungmanae teh nangmouh hoi cungtalah awm lawiseh.
Kai hoi thaw tawk hui lah kaawm e Timote, ka miphun Lusius, Jason hoi Sosipater tinaw ni kut na man awh.
Hete ca na ka thut pouh kung kai Teratias ni Bawipa dawk nangmanaw kut na man awh.
Kawhmoun abuemlah kamkhuengnae imkung Gaius ni hai kut na man awh. Kho thung e tangka kuen e Erastas hoi hmaunawngha Quartus ni hai nangmanaw kut na man awh.
Maimae Bawipa Jisuh Khrih e lungmanae teh nangmouh puenghoi rei awm lawiseh. Amen.
Kai ni ka dei e kamthang kahawi hoi Jisuh Khrih e a kong ka dei dawkvah thoseh,
talaivan a kamtawng hoi hro lah ao eiteh, atuteh ayungyoe Cathut e kâpoelawk lahoi yah profetnaw e cauknaw dawk a kamnue toung dawkvah, yuemnae hoi kâkuen e lawkngainae ao nahanelah, miphun pueng koe panue sak e, hrolawk pâphonae dawk hoi thoseh,
lungangnae hoi ka kawi e buet touh dueng e Cathut dawk Jisuh Khrih lahoi a yungyoe bawilennae awm lawiseh. Amen.
Kai Pawl, Cathut ngainae lahoi Jisuh Khrih e guncei lah kaawm e hoi ka nawngha Sosthenes ni,
maimae Bawipa Jisuh Khrih min ka kaw e kho tangkuem kaawm e taminaw hoi, tami kathoung lah kaw lah kaawm e Kawrin kho e Khrih Jisuh thung thoungsak lah kaawm e, Cathut e kawhmoun ca na patawn awh. Bawipa teh ama ka kaw e naw puenghoi kaimae Bawipa lah ao.
Maimae Pa Cathut hoi Bawipa Jisuh Khrih koe e lungmanae hoi lungmawngnae teh nangmouh koe awm lawiseh.
Khrih Jisuh lahoi na poe e Cathut e lungmanae dawkvah, nangmouh hanelah ka Cathut koe lunghawilawk pou ka dei.
Nangmanaw teh hote Khrih lahoi lawk dei thainae, panue thainae, bangpueng dawk na bawi awh toe.
Khrih hoi kâkuen e lawkpanuesaknae teh nangmouh dawk a cak toe.
Hatdawkvah, nangmouh teh Bawipa Jisuh Khrih bout a kamnuenae ngaihawi laihoi ring awh navah, poehno roeroe na toum a mahoeh.
Maimae Bawipa Jisuh Khrih e hnin dawk nangmouh teh apinihai tounhoehe lah o nahan, Bawipa ni nangmouh teh apout totouh na caksak han.
Ama e Capa, Jisuh Khrih e huikonae thungvah, nangmouh na ka kaw e Cathut teh yuemkamcu lah ao.
Hmaunawnghanaw Bawipa Jisuh Khrih min lahoi pahrennae kahei. Lungthin suetalah awm awh. Kâ kapeknae tawn awh hanh. Pouknae buet touh dawk kâracui awh.
Hmaunawnghanaw Khaloe imthung ni, pou a kâtaran awh a ti.
Nangmouh ni kai teh Pawl e vaica doeh, kai teh Apollos e vaica doeh, kai teh Piter e vaica doeh, Kai teh Khrih e vaica doeh na ti awh.
Khrih teh a kâkapek na maw. Pawl na ou nangmouh han thingpalam dawk ka dout. Nahoeh pawiteh Pawl e min dawk na ou baptisma na coe awh.
Crispus hoi Gaius hloilah apihai baptisma ka poe hoeh dawk Cathut koe ka lunghawi.
Hatdawkvah kai Pawl e min dawk baptisma ka coe e apihai awmhoeh.
Stiven imthung baptisma ka poe, alouknaw baptisma ka poe vaimoe ka panuek hoeh.
Baptisma poe hanlah Khrih ni na patoun hoeh. Kamthang kahawi pâpho hane doeh na patoun. Tami lungang thoumnae dawk nahoeh, telah pawiteh Khrih thingpalam hnosakthainae ayawmyin han doeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, thingpalam kamthang kahawi heh kahmat naw hanelah teh pathunae lah doeh ao, rungngang lah kaawm e maimouh hane teh Cathut e bahu doeh.
Cakathoung ni, a lungkaangnaw e thoumnae ka raphoe pouh han. Pouknae ka rasang naw e pouknae hai ka pahnawt pouh han.
A lungkaangnaw teh nâne ao. Cakathutkungnaw teh nâne ao. Laidei kathoumnaw te nâne ao. Talaivan lungangnae teh Cathut ni pathunae lah a coung sak toung nahoehmaw.
Talaivan lungangnae lahoi Cathut a panue thai awh hoeh dawkvah, Cathut ni pâpho e pathunae lawk lahoi ka yuem e naw rungngang hane a ngainae ao.
Judahnaw ni mitnoutnae naw a hei awh. Griknaw ni lungangnae lahoi a tawng awh.
Maimouh teh thingpalam dawk pathout lah kaawm e Khrih e kamthang pâpho awh. Hete kamthang kahawi teh Judahnaw kamthuinae lah ao teh, Jentelnaw hanlah pathunae lah ao.
Hatei, Judah thoseh, Griknaw thoseh, Cathut ni a kaw e taminaw hanelah, Khrih teh Cathut e bahu hoi lungangnae lah ao.
Cathut e pathunae teh taminaw lungangnae hlak a lunganghnawn rah. Cathut thayounnae teh, taminaw thasainae hlak a thasaihnawn.
Nangmouh na kawnae pouk a haw. A kaw e thung dawk ka thoumthai kapap awm hoeh. Athakaawme kapap awm hoeh. Ka talue e kapap awm hoeh.
Cathut ni ka thoumthai naw kaya sak nahan talaivan koe lah ka pathu naw a rawi. Athakaawme taminaw kaya sak nahan, talai koe lah tha kayoun naw a rawi.
Ka tangreng naw kaya sak nahan, talaivan koe lah ka roedeng e, khet kamcu hoeh e, bang ka cungkeihoehe naw Cathut ni a rawi.
Hatdawkvah Cathut hmalah apihai kâoup thai hoeh.
Nangmouh teh Cathut pawlawk dawk Khrih Jisuh thung na o awh. Khrih teh maimouh hanlah Cathut koehoi ka tho e maimae lungangnae, thoungnae, lannae hoi ratangnae lah o.
Hatdawkvah Cakathoung ni a dei patetlah ka kâoup e tami teh Bawipa dawk ma kâoup naseh.
Ka hmaunawnghanaw, nangmouh koe Cathut e lawkpanuesaknae kadung kakaw pâpho han ka tho nah kathoumthainaw ni a hno awh e lawk ka hno a hoeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, thingpalam dawk kadout e, Jisuh Khrih hoi thingpalam kong laipalah teh, banghai panue sak hane na ngaikhai awh hoeh.
Nangmouh hoi rei ka o nah, ka thayoun teh lungpuen taki hoi doeh ka o.
Ka lawk dei e hoi lawk ka pâpho e hai tami thoumthainae hoi nahoeh, Muitha hnotithainae bahu lahoi doeh.
Nangmae na yuemnae teh taminaw e lungangnae dawk awm laipalah Cathut e bahu dawk o nahane doeh.
Hatei, a lungkahanaw koe lungangnae lawk ka dei. Hottelah ka ti navah talai lungangnae nahoeh. Kahmat hane talai ka ukkungnaw e lungangnae nahoeh.
Het talai ao hoehnahlan, maimae bawilennae lah ao nahan, Cathut ni a sak tangcoung e lungangnae hrolawk, Cathut e lungangnae doeh kaimouh ni ka pâpho awh.
Hote lungangnae hah talai ukkungnaw buet touh ni boehai panuek awh hoeh. Panuek awh pawiteh ka Bawilen poung e Bawipa thingpalam dawk thet a mahoeh ei.
Cakathoung dawk thut e patetlah, mit ni a hmu boihoeh, hnâ hoi thai boihoeh e, lung ni hai a pouk boihoeh e hah Cathut ni a lungpataw e naw hanlah sut a rakueng pouh toe.
Cathut ni maimouh koe hote hno hah Muitha lahoi a pâpho toe. Muitha ni hro e hnonaw koehoi hnocawngca pueng pheng a pâphue.
Tami hoi kâkuen e naw hah, tami thungvah kaawm e muitha laipalah apinimouh a panue han. Hot patetvanlah Cathut hoi kâkuen e hnonaw hah, Cathut e Muitha hloilah apinihai panuek thai hoeh.
Maimouh teh talaivan e muitha coe awh hoeh. Cathut ni ayawmlah na poe e hno panue thai nahan Cathut koehoi e Muitha doeh coe awh.
Cathut ni na poe e naw ka pâpho awh navah, tami lungangnae ni cangkhai e lahoi nahoeh. Kathoung Muitha ni na cangkhai e lawk lahoi doeh ka pâpho awh.
Muitha ka tawn hoeh e ni teh Cathut e Muitha koehoi ka tho e hnonaw panuek thai hoeh. Ahni hane lateh hot naw hah pathunae lah ao. Muitha koelae hno lah ao dawkvah kapekkaboe thai hoeh.
Muitha tami ni teh hote hnonaw pueng a kapek teh panue thai. Hateiteh hote tami teh apinihai panuek thai hoeh.
Apimaw Cathut lung pouknae ka panuek ni teh Cathut hah ka cangkhai han vaw. Maimouh teh Khrih e lungthin tawn awh.
Hmaunawnghanaw, muitha taminaw koe ka dei e patetlah nangmouh koe ka dei hoeh. Camonaw koe dei pouh e patetlah doeh ka dei.
Atu sittouh bu kate na ca thai hoeh rah dawk kai ni na paca awh hoeh. Sanutui doeh na pânei awh rah. Atu sittouh bu kate na cat thai awh hoeh rah.
Bangkongtetpawiteh nangmouh teh, takthai tami lah doeh na o awh rah. Nangmouh koe utsinnae hoi kâounnae a onae teh, nangmouh teh takthai hoi na o awh teh, tami rumram patetlah na hring awh dawk doeh.
Buet touh ni kai Pawl e avai ca, buet touh ni Apollos e avai ca, lengkaleng na tet awh pawiteh nangmouh teh takthai tami lah na o a rah.
Pawl heh apimaw. Apollos teh api na maw. Nangmouh na yuem thai awh nahan, Bawipa ni thaw a poe e san reira doeh.
Kai ni ka ung, Apollos ni tui a bu. A kung ka paw sak hoi ka roungsakkung teh Cathut doeh.
Kapatuekung hoi tui kabukung hnotithainae tawn hoeh. Cathut ni doeh a paw sak.
Kapatuekung hoi tui kabukung teh buet touh doeh. A tawk roi e patetlah tawkphu reirei a coe roi han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, kaimouh teh Cathut e thaw reirei ka tawk e lah ka o awh. Nangmouh teh Cathut e takha, Cathut e im lah na o awh.
Cathut e a lungmanae ka coe e, im kasakkung patetlah kai ni adu ka ung. Alouke tami ni hote adu dawk im patuen a sak. Hatei im kasakkung ni bangtelae im maw ka sak tie hah kâhruetcuet naseh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Jisuh Khrih tie adu ung hnukkhu teh apinihai alouke adu ung thai mahoeh toe.
Apihai hote adu e van, sui, ngun, talung phu kaawm, thing, caphon, padi naw hoi im patuen sak pawiteh,
hote a sak e teh kamnuek han doeh. A kamnue nahane teh hmai hoi a kamnue han. Tami tangkuem ni a sak e im teh bangtelamaw a sak tie hmai ni a tanouk pouh han.
Hote adu van patuen ka sak e ahnie thaw teh kangning pawiteh tawkphu a hmu han.
Hatei im a sak e kang pawiteh, a sung han. Ama ngoun teh hmaikak thung hoi ka hlout e patetlah rungngang lah ao han.
Nangmouh teh Cathut e bawkim lah na o awh. Cathut e Muitha nangmouh thung ao tie na panuek awh hoeh maw.
Apinihai Cathut e bawkim raphoe pawiteh, Cathut ni ahni hai a raphoe van han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Cathut e bawkim teh a thoung. Hote bawkim teh nangmanaw doeh.
Api nang hai namahoima kâdum awh hanh. Nangmouh thung dawk kai teh a lungkaang e tami doeh tetpawiteh, tami lungkaang lah ao nahan, tamipathu lah awm na ei seh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, talaivan lungangnae teh Cathut hmalah teh pathunae la doeh ao. Cathut ni a lungkaangnaw hah amamae pathunae lahoi a man telah Cakathoung dawk thut e lah ao.
Hahoi, tami lungkaangnaw e pouknae teh ahrawnghrang doeh tie Bawipa ni ka panue telah bout a dei.
Hatdawkvah, tami dawk kâoup han awmhoeh. Hno pueng teh nangmae doeh.
Pawl hai, Apollos hai, Cephas hai, talaivan hai, hringnae hai, duenae hai, atu e a tue hai, hmalae a tue hai, hnocawngca pueng teh nangmouh hane doeh.
Nangmouh hai Khrih ni na tawn awh, Khrih hai Cathut ni a tawn.
Hatdawkvah ayâ ni maimanaw teh Khrih e san hoi Cathut e hrolawk hno ka kuemkung lah na pouk awh naseh.
Hno kuemkung teh yuemkamcu telah ayâ ni panue e tami han.
Nangmouh hoi alouknaw ni hai kai hah lawkkam na cak hoeh telah lawk na ceng awh e heh hno kathoenge doeh. Kai teh kamahoima hai lawk ka ceng hoeh.
Ka pouknae a thoung. Hatei, hottelah ka o dawkvah kai teh tamikalan telah khoe e lah kaawm hoeh. Kai lawkcengkung teh Bawipa doeh.
Hatdawkvah, atueng a pha hoehnahlan, apihai lawkceng awh hanh. Bawipa a tho totouh ring awh. Ahni ni hmonae koe hro e pueng angnae dawk a kamnue sak vaiteh, tami e pouknae puenghai a kamnue sak han. Hattoteh tami pueng ni Cathut koehoi oupnae a coe awh han.
Hmaunawnghanaw, Cakathoung dawk thut lah kaawm e tapuet laihoi ayânaw bari kawi nahoeh tie lawk hah kaimouh roi koehoi kamtu thai awh nahan, buet touh ni buet touh e lathueng na kâoup awh hoeh nahan, kai hoi Apollos bangnue lahoi hete hnonaw hah nangmouh hanelah ka pâpho.
Apini maw nangmouh na talue sak awh. Na kamtu e laipalah ahmaloe hoi na thung kaawm e hno ao maw. Na kamtu e lah awm pawiteh na kamtu hoeh e patetlah bangkongmaw na kâoup vaw.
Na kuep awh toe. Na bawi awh toe. Kaimouh laipalah na uk awh toe. Kaimouh hah nangmouh hoi rei uk thai nahanelah na uk awh katang pawiteh ahawi.
Kai niteh, thei hane naw patetlah Cathut ni kaimouh gunceinaw a hnukteng koe lah na ta awh toe telah ka pouk. Bangkongtetpawiteh, kalvantaminaw hmalah, hoi talai taminaw hmalah, talaivan abuemlah ni khet han kawi lah ka o awh.
Kaimouh teh Khrih hanelah tamipathu lah ka o awh. Hatei nangmouh teh Khrih dawk na lungang awh. Kaimouh teh ka thayoun awh. Hatei nangmanaw teh na thao awh. Nangmouh teh bari kaawm e lah na o awh. Hatei kaimouh teh hnephnap e lah ka o awh.
Kaimouh teh atu raw vonhlamrinci hoi, caici lah o hoi, rektap e lah ka o awh teh, im laipalah,
mae kut hoi thaw ka tawk awh. Na pathoe awh navah yawhawinae lah ka pouk awh. Rektapnae kâhmo navah ka panguep awh.
Na dudam awh torei teh, lungpatawnae kamnue sak pouh awh. Atu sittouh tami pueng ni na takhoe awh, talaivan e songnawng patetlah na pouk awh.
Nangmouh kaya sak nahanlah ka ngai dawk hete ca ka thut e nahoeh. Ka pahren e ka canaw patetlah na kâhruetcuet awh nahanlah hete ca na thut pouh e doeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh nangmouh dawk Khrih kong na ka cangkhai e thong hra touh kaawm nakunghai, na pa moipap hoeh. Khrih Jisuh dawkvah kamthang kahawi lahoi na khe awh.
Hatdawkvah, kaie nuen na out awh nahanlah na hroecoe awh.
Hot kecu dawkvah, Bawipa dawk yuemkamcu e ka pahren e ka capa Timote nangmouh koe ka patoun. Ahni ni kho tangkuem e kawhmoun pueng koe kai ni ka cangkhai e patetlah Khrih Jisuh dawk kai ni ka dawn e lamthung hah nangmouh bout na panue sak awh han doeh.
Kai nangmouh koe tho mahoeh telah tami tangawn ni a pouk awh teh, a kâoup awh.
Bawipa ni a ngainae awm pawiteh karanglah ka tho han. Hat toteh, ahnimouh kâoupnae dawk laipalah, ahnimae bahu hah ka panue han doeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Cathut uknaeram teh lawk dawk kaawm e nahoeh, bahu dawk doeh ao.
Bangmaw na ngaihnawn awh, bongpai hoi na ou ka tho han, lungpatawnae, lungdolungnemnae hoi na ou ka tho han.
Nangmouh koe, a na pa e yu a yonkhai ti e, kayuemhoehnaw koehai kaawm boihoeh e napui tongpa kamsoum hoeh e yonnae ao tie ka thai.
Nangmouh ni lungmathoe lahoi, hottelah kaawm e tami pâlei hane hlak na kâoupkhai awh.
Kai teh nangmouh koe takthai lahoi kaawm hoeh ei, muitha lahoi teh nangmouh koe ka o dawkvah, hote hmuen koe kaawm e patetlah hote lai hah ka tâtueng toe.
Bawipa Jisuh Khrih min lahoi nangmouh cungtalah na kamkhueng awh navah, kaie muitha hai maimae Bawipa Jisuh Khrih e bahu lahoi nangmouh hoi rei ao van.
Ahnie muitha teh Bawipa e hnin dawk rungngang lah ao nahan, a takbuem teh rawknae koe a pha nahanlah setan kut dawk ka poe toe.
Nangmouh na kâoupnae teh hawihoeh. Ton titca ni tahawn abuemlah a po sak tie na panuek awh hoeh maw.
Tonphuenhoehe vaiyei lah na o awh e patetlah ton karuem teh tâkhawng awh, Bangtelah tetpawiteh, ceitakhai pawi nah thueng hane tuca tie Khrih hateh, maimouh han thueng e lah ao toe.
Hatdawkvah karuem e ton lah kaawm e hawihoehnae, hmuhmanae naw hoi tho laipalah, tonphuenhoehe lah kaawm e thoungnae lawkkatang lahoi ceitakhai pawito awh sei .
Nangmouh teh kamsoumhoehe napui tongpa yonnae ka sak e naw hoi kâhuiko hoeh nahanelah ca ka thut teh na patawn awh.
Kamsoumhoehe napui tongpa yonnae hoi hounlounnae, tami ca ngainae, meikaphawk ka bawk e talaivan hoi khoeroe na ka huiko mahoeh ka ti ngainae nahoeh. Telah pawiteh hete talai na ceitakhai hane la doeh awm ti.
Nangmouh koe ca ka thut ngainae teh, hmaunawngha lah ka o ati ei, kamsoumhoehe napui tongpa yonnae ka sak e, ka hounloun e, meikaphawk ka bawk e, tami ka pathoe e, yamuhri lah kaawm e, tami ka cat ngai e naw hoi kâhuiko awh hanh, bu hai cungtalah cat awh hanh tie hah doeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh kawhmoun alawilah kaawmnaw lawkceng hanelah kai hoi bangmaw a kâseng. Athung e taminaw hah nangmouh ni lawk na ceng awh mahoeh maw.
Alawilah kaawm e naw teh Cathut ni lawk a ceng han. Hote tamikathout hah alawilah pâlei awh.
Nangmouh dawk buet touh ni alouke tami buetbuet touh hoi lumlai awm pawiteh, tami kathoungnaw hmalah na dei laipalah, cathutlaipa e talai bawinaw koe lawk na kâcengsak awh bo vaw.
Tami kathoungnaw ni talaivan lawkceng han tie na panuek awh hoeh maw. Talai lawkceng hanelah na awm awh pawiteh kathoengpoung e hno dawk hai lawkceng awh mahoeh na ou.
Kalvantaminaw lawkceng a han tie na panuek awh hoeh maw. Hatdawkvah talai hno dawk lawkceng hanelah kamcu hoeh na maw.
Hatdawkvah nangmouh teh talai e lai dei hane awm pawiteh kawhmoun thungvah bari kaawm hoeh e taminaw hah lawkcengkung lah rawi awh.
Na kaya awh nahane lah het heh ka dei. Nangmouh thung dawk hmaunawngha rahak lai ka dei thai kawi buet touh boehai awmhoeh maw.
Atuteh, hmaunawngha reira na kâtoe awh dueng laipalah, hote hah, kayuemhoehnaw e hmalah na kâtoe awh.
Hottelah buet touh hoi buet touh na kâtoe awh e teh na sungnae doeh toe. Bangkong toe laipalah, rektapnae maha na khang awh hoeh. Dumyennae maha bangkong na khang a hoeh.
Nangmouh ni ayâ na dumyen awh, kamsoumhoehe hno na sak awh. Na hmaunawnghanaw, koehai telah na sak awh.
Tami kalan hoeh naw ni Cathut uknaeram coe thai mahoeh tie na panuek awh hoeh maw. Alouklah pouk awh hanh. Kamsoumhoehe napui tongpa yonnae, meikaphawk ka bawk e naw, ayâ yu ka yonkhai e naw, tongpa reira napui reira yonnae ka sak e naw,
kaparawtnaw, ka hounloun e naw, yamuhri lah kaawm e naw, tami ka pathoe e naw, tami ka catnet ngai e naw teh Cathut uknaeram coe thai mahoeh.
Hottelah doeh nangmouh thung dawk e tami tangawn teh na o awh. Hatei maimouh teh Cathut e Muitha dawk, hahoi Bawipa Jisuh Khrih min dawk pâsu e lah o awh teh na lan toe telah na khoe awh toe.
Hnopueng sak thainae kâ ka tawn ei, hnopueng teh hawinae koung awmhoeh. Hno pueng ka ti thai, hatei bang hnopai e san lahai kaawm hoeh.
Rawca heh vonpui hanlah ao teh, vonpui hai rawca hanelah ao. Hatei ahnimouh roi teh Cathut ni reirei a raphoe han. Tak teh kamsoumhoehe napui tongpa yonnae sak nahane nahoeh. Bawipa hane doeh. Bawipa hai tak hane doeh.
Cathut ni amae bahu lahoi Bawipa teh a thaw sak toe. Hot patetlah maimouh hai amae bahu lahoi na thaw sak van han.
Nangmae takthai teh Khrih e a puengcang lah o awh tie na panuek awh hoeh maw. Hat pawiteh Khrih e a puengcang hah la vaiteh kâyawt e puengcang lah o sak awh han na maw. Khoeroe awm sak awh mahoeh.
Kâyawt e hoi cungtalah kaawm e teh kâyawt e hoi tak buet touh lah ao tie na panuek awh hoeh maw. Kahni touh roi teh buet touh lah ao han tie patetlah doeh.
Hatdawkvah Khrih hoi kâkuen e teh Muitha dawk tak buet touh lah ao roi.
Kamsoumhoehe napui tongpa yonnae roun awh, tami ni yonnae ouk a sak e naw teh tak e alawilah doeh ao. Kamsoumhoehe napui tongpa yonnae teh amae tak dawk roeroe yon ka sak e lah ao.
Bang telah maw. Nangmae na tak teh Cathut koe hoi na coe awh e, nangmouh thung vah kaawm e Kathoung Muitha e bawkim doeh tie hoi nama ni na tawn e nahoeh toe tie hah na panuek awh hoeh maw.
Nangmouh teh aphu hoi ran e lah na o awh toung dawkvah, nangmae na takthai dawk Cathut bawilen sak awh.
Nangmouh ni kai na poe e ca dawk kaawm e naw teh, tongpa teh napui hoi tak hmawng hoehpawiteh ahawi ei,
kamsoumhoehe napui tongpa yonnae sak hoeh nahanelah, tongpa pueng a yu tawn naseh. Napui pueng amae vâ tawn naseh.
Tongpa ni a yu koe yuvâ lah onae kuep sak naseh. A yu ni hai a vâ dawk kuep sak naseh.
Yu ni amae tak dawk kâtawnnae tawn hoeh, vâ ni doeh a tawn. Hot patetvanlah, vâ ni amae tak dawk kâtawnnae tawn hoeh, yu ni doeh a tawn.
Ratoum nahan atueng dawngdeng kahawicalah hno thai nahanelah, buet touh hoi buet touh hnâbonae awm laipalah, alouklouk lah awm awh hanh. Hottelah na awm awh pawiteh, Setan ni na tacuek awh hoeh nahanlah cungtalah reirei bout awm awh.
Hottelah ka dei navah, nangmouh ni na tarawi hane la doeh ka dei. Kâpoelawk na poe e nahoeh.
Tongpa pueng kai patetlah o sak hane ka ngai. Hatei tami pueng ni Cathut koe e poehno teh rip coe awh. Buet touh ni alouke a tawn, alouke buet touh ni hai alouke a tawn van.
A yu ka lat hoeh e tongpanaw hoi, a vâ ka sak hoeh e lahmai napuinaw koe, kai ni ka dei e teh, kai patetlah na awm awh pawiteh ahawi.
Hatei, namahoima na ka cakuep thai hoehpawiteh, yu lat van awh naseh. Kâcakuep thai hoeh e hlak teh yu la vâ sak e ahawihnawn.
Yuvâ lah kaawm naw koe, kai ni laipalah, Bawipa koehoi e kâ poe, kai ni na poe awh e teh, yu ni a vâ mat hanh naseh.
Mat pawiteh vâ sak laipalah awm lawiseh. Nahoeh pawiteh apasuek e vâ hoi bout kâmaihawi naseh. Vâ ni hai a yu mat nahanh seh.
Alouke taminaw hanelah Bawipa ni a dei e nahoeh, kai ni ka dei e teh, hmaunawngha buet touh ni ka yuem hoeh e napui a yu navah, hote napui ni a vâ hoi pou o hane ngai pawiteh, a yu a ma hanelah awmhoeh.
Hot patetvanlah, napui buet touh ni ka yuem hoeh e a vâ navah, hote tongpa ni a yu hoi pou o hane ngai pawiteh, napui ni mat hanh naseh.
Ka yuem hoeh e tongpa teh a yu hanelah a thoung. Ka yuem hoeh e napui hai, yuemnae ka tawn e a vâ hanelah a thoung. Telah nahoeh pawiteh, a canaw thoung mahoeh. Atuteh a thoung awh.
Hatei ka yuem hoeh e ni, kamphei hanlah ngai pawiteh, cettakhai lawiseh. Hot patet e dawk teh ka yuem e tongpa hai, ka yuem e napui hai kateknae awmhoeh.
Napui nang na vâ na rungngang han, rungngang mahoeh tie bangtelamaw na panue thai han. Tongpa nang na yu rungngang hane hoi rungngang hoeh hane bangtelamaw na panue thai han.
Cathut ni a kaw teh Bawipa ni thaw a poe e dawkvah tami pueng ni a hring na thungvah awm awh naseh. Het heh kawhmounnaw pueng koe ka poe e lawk doeh.
Kaw lah kaawm e tongpa, vuensom ka a tangcoung e teh, vuensom ka a hoeh e tami patetlah awm hanh naseh. Kaw lah ao nah vuensom ka a hoeh e tami teh, vuensoma sak awh hanh lawih.
Vuensoma e heh alawkpui nahoeh. Cathut e kâpoelawk doeh alawkpuihnawn.
Cathut ni a kaw e patetlah tami pueng ama a onae hmuen dawk awm awh naseh.
Kaw e lah ao nah san lah na awm pawiteh, hot ni lungpuennae tawn sak hanh naseh.
Hateiteh, Bawipa ni a kaw navah san lah kaawm e teh Bawipa dawk kahlout e tami lah ao. Hot patetlah a kaw nah kahlout e teh, Khrih e san lah ao.
Nangmouh teh aphu hoi ran e lah na o awh dawk taminaw koe san lah awm a hanh lawih.
Hmaunawnghanaw, kaw lah kaawm e tami pueng teh, a tawk e thaw hah Cathut hmalah tawk naseh.
Tanglakacuem hoi kâkuen e dawk, Bawipa kâpoelawk na poe e ka coe hoeh eiteh, Bawipa e lungmanae ka coe teh, yuemkamcu e lah ka o dawkvah, kai ni hettelah lawk na poe awh.
Atu e rektapnae kecu dawkvah, vâ na tawn hoehpawiteh ahawi. Tongpa hai atu ao e patetlah awm pawiteh ahawi.
Yuvâ lah na awm awh toung pawiteh, kâkapek awh hanh lawih. Yuvâ lah na awm awh hoeh rah pawiteh, yu tawng awh hanh lawih.
Hatei yu na lat toung pawiteh, het heh yonnae nahoeh. Tangla ni vâ sak pawiteh, yonnae nahoeh. Hatei ahnimanaw teh talai runae a kâhmo awh han. Kai ni teh hote runae dawk hoi hlout sak hanlah na ngaikhai a dawk doeh.
Hmaunawnghanaw, dei ka ngai e teh, a tue abaw tawmlei toung dawkvah, atu hoi teh yu ka tawn ni yu ka tawn hoeh patetlah,
Ka khuikap e ni khuikap hoeh e patetlah a kokanawm ni a kokanawm hoeh e patetlah, hnopai ka ran e ni bangcahai ka tawn hoeh e patetlah ao awh han.
Talaivan hnopai ka hnonaw ni hai ka hno hoeh e patetlah awm naseh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, talai hoi a thung e hnopai pueng teh be kahmat han.
Kai ni nangmouh lungpuen hane na ngaikhai a hoeh. Yu ka tawn hoeh e tongpanaw ni teh Bawipa lunghawi nahanlah Bawipa dawk doeh a lungpuen awh.
Yu ka tawn e tongpa ni teh yu bangtelane lunghawi sak thai han, titeh talaivan hno dawk a kâhruetcuet.
Hot patetlah doeh, vâ ka tawn hoeh e napui hoi tanglakacuem teh, tak hoi muitha thoungsak thai nahanlah Cathut e thaw dawk a kâhruetcuet awh. Hatei, vâ ka tawn e napui teh a vâ lunghawi nahanelah talaivan hno hah ouk a pouk.
Hettelah ka dei ngainae teh, nangmouh ahawi nahane lah doeh ka dei. Nangmouh khak na cakâ hane ka ngai dawk nahoeh. Kahawi e hno sak awh nateh lungthin katang hoi Bawipa koe na kâpoe thai awh nahane lah doeh.
Tangla teh vâ sak laipalah, vâ sak tue lawn pawiteh hawihoeh telah tangla katawnkung ni pouk pawiteh, vâ sak hanelah hai kâvoe pawiteh, vâ sak naseh. Yon nahoeh.
Hatei, a lungthung lawk tâtuengnae a tawn hnukkhu, a counghoeh dawk vâ sak laipalah, a kâcakuep thai dawk vâ sak laipalah awm thai pawiteh ahawi.
Hatdawkvah, hote tangla hah vâ ka sak sak e tami teh hnokahawi a sak. Vâ ka sak sak hoeh e tami hai hnokahawi hoe a sak.
Yu teh a vâ a hring nathung vâsaknae phung ni a katek. Hatei, a vâ dout pawiteh a ngai e tongpa koe vâ sak hanelah Bawipa dawk kâ ao.
Hote napui ama o lah duem awm pawiteh yawhawinae hoe ao telah ka pouk. Kai koehai Cathut e Muitha ao telah ka pouk.
Meikaphawk hmalah thueng e sathei canei kong dawk, kapek thainae be na tawn awh tie ka panue. Hatei, thoumthainae ni a kâoup sak. Lungpatawnae ni a roung sak.
Ka panue toe ka tet e ni panue hane yit touh panuek hoeh rah.
Cathut ka lungpataw e tami teh, Cathut ni a panue.
Meikaphawk hmalah thueng e sathei canei kong hoi kâkuen lah, meikaphawk teh talaivan dawk banglahai awmhoeh. Cathut buet touh dueng doeh kaawm tie panue awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh cathutnaw, bawipanaw telah kaw e patetlah talai hoi kalvan vah cathutnaw telah kaw e moikapap ao ei,
maimouh hane teh Pa Cathut buet touh dueng doeh kaawm. Ahni koehoi hnocawngca pueng a tho teh, maimanaw hai Cathut dawk hring awh. Maimae Bawipa tie Jisuh Khrih buet touh dueng doeh kaawm, ahni koehoi hnocawngca pueng a tho teh, maimouh teh hote Bawipa dawk hring awh.
Hatei, panuethainae tami pueng ni tawn awh hoeh. Tami tangawn teh, meikaphawk bawknae nuen a lungthung ao rah dawkvah, thueng e sathei a canei nah thoehawi panuenae a thayoun dawkvah kakhin e lah ao awh.
Rawca lahoi Cathut hmalah minhmai kahawi hmu e na hoeh. Ca dawkvah bet ahawinae awmhoeh, ca hoeh dawk hai bet hawihoehnae awmhoeh.
Hatei, nangmouh na hloutnae teh, a thakayounnaw hanlah, kamthuinae lah ao hoeh nahan kâhruetcuet awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, kapek thainae na tawn nahlangva, meikaphawk bawkim dawk e na ca awh e hah, tami alouke ni hmawt pawiteh, thoehawi panuenae a thakayounnaw niteh, meikaphawk hmalah thueng e sathei moi ca hanelah taranhawi awh mahoeh na maw.
Nange lungangnae ni, tha kayoun e hmaunawngha, Khrih ni ahnimouh hanlah a due ei, rawknae koe a phakhai toe.
Hettelah hmaunawngha lathueng vah na yon awh navah ahnimanaw panuenae kayoun ca e naw hmâ na paca awh toe. Hatdawkvah Khrih koe na yon awh toe.
Hatdawkvah, canei e ni hmaunawngha kamthui sak pawiteh ahnimouh a rawp hlak teh, maito moi ka hai han toe.
Tami kahlout lah kai kaawm hoeh namaw. Guncei lah kaawm hoeh na maw. Maimae Bawipa Jisuh Khrih teh ka hmawt boihoeh namaw. Nangmouh teh Bawipa dawk kai ni ka tawk e thaw lah na awm awh hoeh namaw.
Alouknaw koe guncei lah kaawm hoeh nakunghai, nangmouh koe guncei lah ka o. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Bawipa dawk nangmouh teh kai guncei lah ka onae kapanuekkhaikung lah na o awh.
Kai akung kakheinaw koe hettelah na dei pouh awh.
Ca thai, nei thainae kâ ka tawn awh hoeh na maw.
Piter hoi Bawipa e hmaunawnghanaw koehoi alouke gunceinaw patetlah ka yuem e yu hah hrawi thai hoeh na maw.
Barnabas hoi kai teh thaw tawk hanlah awmhoeh na ti awh bo ma.
Apimaw mae lamvon hoi ransa thaw ka tawk. Apimaw misur takha ka sak ni teh cat laipalah kaawm. Apimaw tu ka khoum ni teh sanutui net laipalah kaawm.
Talai hmunae lahoi ka dei e na ou. Kâlawk ni hai telah doeh a dei.
Mosi e cangkhainae dawk telah a thut. Cabong katin e maito a pahni moum pouh hanh. Cathut ni a dei ngainae teh maito hane doeh na ti maw.
Hoehpawiteh maimouh hanelah maw a dei. Atangcalah maimouh hane doeh a dei. Bangkongtetpawiteh law ka sak nihai, ngaihawi laihoi a sak dawkvah, katin e ni hai ngaihawi laihoi a katin van.
Kaimouh ni nangmouh dawk muitha cati ka patûe a dawk nangmouh koehoi talai hnopai ka coe awh e heh ka tapuet awh e na maw.
Alouknaw ni patenghai nangmouh koe e coe awh pawiteh, kaimouh te hoe kapap coe hanlah kamcu hoeh namaw. Hatei, hnotithainae ka hno awh hoeh. Khrih kamthang kahawi kangangkung lah ao hoeh nahan bangpueng dawk ka panguep awh.
A thaw katawknaw ni bawkim dawk e rawca a ca awh teh, thuengnae kasaknaw ni khoungroe dawk e a canei awh tie na panuek awh hoeh maw.
Hot patetvanlah, kamthang kahawi kadeinaw hai kamthang kahawi pâpho e lahoi kâkawk awh han telah Bawipa e kâ poe doeh.
Hatei, hete heh ka hno awh hoeh. Nangmouh ni kaimouh koe hettelah na sak awh nahanlah ka thut e nahoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, kâoupnae heh alouknaw ni a raphoe hlak teh kadout pawiteh bet ahawihnawn.
Kai teh kamthang kahawi ka pâpho nakunghai kâoupkhai hane awmhoeh. Pâpho laipalah kaawm thai hoeh. Pâpho laipalah kaawm pawiteh yawthoenae doeh.
Thahmeicalah hoi kamthang kahawi ka pâpho pawiteh aphu ao. Thahmeicalah hoi ka pâpho hoehpawiteh kai koe na poe lah kaawm e ka pâpho rumram e la doeh awm ti.
Pawiteh, kaie tawkphu teh bangmaw, kamthang kahawi ka pâpho e ayawm doeh. Hatdawkvah kâtawnnae ka hno hoeh. Khrih e kamthang kahawi kathainaw ni aphu pâbaw laipalah awm pawiteh kai han aphu ao.
Kai teh tami pueng e hmalah kahlout e lah ka o ei, tami hoe kapap ka la thai nahanelah, tami pueng e san lah ka o.
Judahnaw ka la thai nahan, Judahnaw koe Judah tami patetlah ka o. Kâlawk rahim kaawm hoeh ei, kâlawk rahim kaawm naw ka la thai nahan, kâlawk rahim kaawm naw koe, kâlawk rahim kaawm e patetlah ka o.
Kai teh kâlawk hoi kahlat e nahoeh. Khrih e kâlawk rahim ka o ei, kâlawk hoi kâhlat e taminaw ka la thai nahanelah, kâlawk hoi kâhlatnaw koe kâlawk hoi kâhlat e patetlah ka o.
Tha kayounnaw ka la thai nahan, a thakayounnaw koe a tha kayoun e patetlah ka o. Tami tangawn ka rungngang thai nahan, tami pueng koe aphunphun lah ka o.
Nangmouh hoi kamthang kahawi rei hmawng thai nahan, kamthang kahawi kecu hottelah ka onae doeh.
Yawng kâtânae koe a yawng awh ei, buet touh ni dueng doeh suh a hmu tie na panuek awh hoeh maw. Suh rip na hmu thai awh nahanlah yawng awh.

Ahnimouh canei hanelah a tahung awh. Hahoi lamtu hanlah a thaw awh telah Cakathoung dawk a thut e patetlah, nangmanaw teh meikaphawk kabawke ahnimanaw patetlah awm awh hanh.
A tangawnnaw ni kamsoumhoehe napui tongpa yonnae a sak awh e patetlah maimouh teh kamsoumhoehe napui tongpa yonnae sak a hanh sei. Tami tangawn ni kamsoumhoehe napui tongpa yonnae a sak awh kecu dawk, hnin touh dawk 23,000 touh a due awh.
Tami tangawn ni Cathut a tanouk awh e patetlah maimouh teh Khrih hah tanouk awh hanh sei. Hottelah a tanouk awh dawkvah, tahrun ni a khue awh teh a due awh.
Tami tangawn teh a phuenang awh e patetlah maimouh teh phuenang awh hanh sei. Hottelah ka cingou e naw hah kalvantaminaw ni a due sak awh.
Hetnaw hateh, maimouh ni khetsin hanelah ahnimouh koe ka phat e doeh. A tue poutnae koe lah kaawm e maimouh kâhruetcuet nahanelah ao.
Hatdawkvah, kacaklah kangdue thai ka tet nang, na rawp hoeh nahanlah kâhruetcuet.

Isarel taminaw khenhaw! sathei ka cat e naw teh thuengnae khoungroe hoi kâkuen e lah awm hoeh maw.

Tongpa teh, napui dawk hoi ka tâcawt e nahoeh. Napui doeh tongpa dawk hoi ka tâcawt.

Hatdawkvah, kalvantaminaw khet lahoi napui ni kâtawnnae mitnoutnae lah a lû huem naseh.

Rei na kamkhueng awh navah Bawipa e pawi hmawng hanlah na kamkhueng a hoeh.
Na canei awh nah na kâring awh laipalah, na canei awh, tami tangawn a vonhlam, tami tangawn teh khak na ca awh.
Na canei nahan im na tawn awh hoeh na maw. Cathut e kawhmoun na dudam awh teh, karoedengnaw na kaya sak awh. Bangtelane bout dei han. Hete dawk kai ni na oup a han namaw. Na oup a mahoeh.

Hote Muitha lahoi alouke tami buet touh koe yuemnae a poe. Hote Muitha lahoi alouke tami buet touh koe patawnae roum sakthainae poehno a poe.
Alouke tami buet touh koe kângairuhno sakthainae a poe. Alouke tami buet touh koe sutdeilawk, alouke tami buet touh koe muithanaw kapek teh panuethainae a poe. Alouke tami buet touh koe alouk lawkpanthainae, alouke tami buet touh koe hote alouk lawk tâhlat thainae a poe.

Hatdawkvah, puengcang moiapap ei, tak buet touh doeh.
Mit ni kut koe, mit nang na panki hoeh tet thai pouh hoeh, lû ni khok koe, lû nang na panki hoeh tet thai pouh hoeh.
Hothloilah, tha hoe ka youn e puengcangnaw hah, hoe panki e puengcang lah ao.

Nangmouh teh Khrih e a tak lah na o awh, lengkaleng a puengcang lah na o awh.
Kawhmoun thungvah Cathut ni gunceinaw apasuek a kaw. Apâhni lah profetnaw, apâthum lah kacangkhainaw, hathnukkhu kângairuhno kasakthainaw, hahoi teh patawnae ka roum sakthainaw, kabawmthainaw, ukthainaw, alouk lawk kapekthainaw hah a poe.
Abuemlahoi guncei lah koung ao maw, kaawm e pueng ni profet lah be o a maw. Maimouh pueng teh kacangkhaikung lah be o a maw. Maimouh pueng teh kângairuhno koung sak thai a maw.
Maimouh pueng ni patawnae roum sakthainae poehno koung tawn a maw. Maimouh pueng ni alouke lawk be pan thai a maw. Maimouh pueng ni alouke lawk be tâhlat thai a maw.

Hno cawngca a ramuk thai. Hno cawngca a yuem, hnocawngca a ngaihawi, hnocawngca a panguep.

Nangmouh pueng alouke lawk koung pan sak hanlah na ngaikhai awh. Profet lawk dei hanelah hoe na ngaikhai awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, alouke lawk kapan e tami teh kawhmoun a roung nahan deicainae tawn hoehpawiteh, ahni hlak profet lawk ka pâpho e aphu o hnawn.

Hatdawkvah alouke lawknaw teh, kayuemnaw han mitnout lah awm hoeh. Kayuemhoehnaw hane mitnout lah ao. Profet lawk deinae, kayuemhoehnaw hane nahoeh. Kayuemnaw hane la doeh.
Kawhmoun thung cungtalah a kamkhueng nah, alouke lawk hoi a dei awh navah, ka yuem hoeh e, lawk ka panuek hoeh e kâen pawiteh, kapathunaw ati a han nahoehmaw.
Nangmouh ni lawk na pâpho awh navah, ka yuem hoeh e lawk ka panuek hoeh e tami kâen pawiteh, ahnimouh hah nangmouh ni kahawicalah na dei pouh e lahoi, tamikayon lah ka o tie a kâpanue han.
Ahnimae lungthin dawk kamphawng hoeh e naw bout a kamphawng vaiteh, a tabo lahoi Cathut a bawk han. Cathut teh nangmouh koe ao katang telah a kampangkhai han.
Hmaunawnghanaw, na kamkhueng awh toteh, Sam la ka sak ngai e, ka cangkhai ngai e, alouke lawk kapan ngai e, pâpho lawk ka dei ngai e, ka deicai thai e lengkaleng na o awh dawk, bangpuengpa kawhmoun a roung nahanlah sak awh.
Alouke lawk kapan e tami awm pawiteh, kahni touh nakunghai, kathum touh nakunghai, kapap poung lah kathum touh ni buet touh hnukkhu buet touh ni a dei han, hatnavah buet touh ni dei ngainae kamnuek sak seh.
Ka dei cai e tami awm hoehpawiteh, kadeikung teh, kawhmoun thung lawkkamuem lah awm naseh, ama hoi Cathut rahak dueng pan naseh.
Profet kahni kathum touh ni a dei e hah alouknaw ni kahawicalah noumcai awh naseh.
Ka tahung e tami koe buetbuet touh kâpâpho pawiteh, hmaloe ka dei e teh lawkkamuem lah duem awm naseh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, tami pueng kamtu hanelah thoseh, tami pueng teh lungmawng nahanelah thoseh, nangmouh pueng teh patuen patuen lawk na pâpho thai awh.
Profetnaw hai, amamae lungthin muitha a kâcakuep thai awh.
Cathut teh kâponae ka sak e doeh. Tami kathoung naw e kawhmounnaw thungvah kâponae lah kaawm e Cathut doeh.
Napuinaw kawhmounnaw thung lawkkamuem lah awmseh. Ahnimouh dei thainae kâ tawn awh hoeh. Phung lawk ni a dei e patetlah ahnimouh teh tongpa uknae rahim awm naseh.
Yunaw buetbuet touh kamtu han ngai awh pawiteh, im vah a vanaw koe pacei naseh. Yu ni kawhmoun dawk lawk dei pawiteh yeirai pui doeh.
Cathut e a lawk nangmouh koehoi maw a tâco. Nahoeh pawiteh nangmouh koe ka phat e na ou.
Kai ni nangmouh koe na poe e lawknaw heh Bawipa e kâpoelawk doeh tie hah, profet lah kaawm e, muitha poehno ka coe e ni teh oe tet naseh, panuek hoehpawiteh a panue hoeh e patetlah awm naseh.
Lawk racuinae lah, hmaunawnghanaw nangmouh profet lawk dei han ngainae kalenpoung tawn a loe.
Alouke lawk lahoi pâphonae hai cakâ pouh hanh awh.
Hno cawngca a lamthung patetlah kamcu lah sak hanelah ao.
Hmaunawnghanaw, nangmouh koe ka pâpho awh e kamthang kahawi, nangmouh ni na coe awh teh na kangduekhai awh e, bout panue sak hanelah na ngaikhai awh.
Nangmouh koe ka pâpho e lawk heh, kacaklah na kuen awh pawiteh, hote kamthang kahawi lahoi nangmouh rungngang e lah na o awh.
Kai kama ni ka coe e patetlah nangmouh koe ahmaloe na poe awh e teh Cakathoung ni a dei e patetlah Khrih teh maimouh yon kecu dawk a due toe.
Pakawp hnukkhu Cakathoung ni a dei e patetlah apâthum hnin bout a thaw toe.
Cephas ni Bawipa a hmu hnukkhu, hlaikahni touh e naw ni hai a hmu awh.
Hathnukkhu, hmaunawngha cum panga touh hlai koe bout a kamphawng pouh. Ahnimouh thung dawk a tangawn teh atu sittouh a hring awh rah. A tangawn naw teh a i awh toe.
Hat hoi, Jem koe a kamnue.
Hathnukkhu gunceinaw pueng koe a kamphawng pouh. A hnuktengpoung thapa kuep laipalah ka khe e patetlah kaawm e kai koehai a kamnue van.
Kai heh, alouke gunceinaw thung dawk kathoengpounge lah ka o teh, Cathut e kawhmoun ka pacekpahlek dawk, guncei ti hanelah kamcu hoeh.
Hatei Cathut e lungmanae lahoi, kai teh kai lah ka o. Ka coe e a lungmanae hai ayawmyin ka coe hoeh. Hatdawkvah, alouke gunceinaw pueng hlak kai hoe kâyawmnae ka tawn. Hatei kai nahoeh. Kai dawk kaawm e Cathut lungmanae hoi doeh.
Kai ni hai ahnimouh ni hai het doeh a pâpho awh. Het doeh ka yuem awh.
Khrih teh duenae koehoi bout a thaw toe tie ka pâpho toung pawiteh, bangtelamaw a tangawn ni duenae koehoi boutthawnae awmhoeh na ti awh vaw.
Duenae koehoi boutthawnae awmhoeh pawiteh, Khrih hai duenae koehoi thaw van mahoeh.
Khrih teh duenae koehoi bout thaw hoehpawiteh, kaimouh ni ka pâpho e ahrawnghrang lah awm vaiteh, nangmouh ni na yuemnae hai ahrawnghrang han doeh.
Hothloilah kaimouh teh Cathut e thaw dawk kamsoumhoeh e kapanuekkhaikung lah doeh kaawm awh tih. Cathut ni kadout tangcoungnaw bout thaw sak hoehpawiteh, Cathut ni a thaw sak hoeh e Khrih hah Cathut ni a thaw sak toe telah laithoe ka dei e lah doeh awm awh tih.
Bangtelah tetpawiteh, kadoutnaw boutthawnae awmhoeh pawiteh, Cathut ni Khrih hai thaw sak mahoeh.
Khrih duenae koehoi bout thaw hoehpawiteh, nangmae yuemnae teh banglahai tho hoeh. Yonnae a rahim doeh na o a rah.
Telah pawiteh Khrih thung kaip tangcoungnaw hai kahmakata awh toe.
Atu hring nahane dueng, Khrih thung ngaihawinae tawn pawiteh, tami pueng hlak pahren ka tho poung la doeh o awh.
Atuteh Khrih duenae koehoi a thaw katang toung dawk kaipnaw thung dawk aluepaw lah ao.
Hatdawkvah duenae teh tami buet touh koehoi a tho, boutthawnae hai tami buet touh dawk hoi a tho van,
Tami pueng Adam dawk hoi duenae koe pha awh e patetlah tami pueng Khrih thung hoi bout hringnae koe pha awh han.
Hatei a taminaw pueng amamae atueng a pha torei a thaw awh han. Khrih teh aluepaw doeh. Hathnukkhu Khrih a tho toteh a taminaw bout thaw awh han.
Hathnukkhu a poutnae teh a pha han. Hattoteh Khrih ni uknae pueng, kâtawnnae pueng, hoi bahu pueng apout sak vaiteh, Cathut uknaeram hah Na pa koe a poe han.
A tarannaw pueng a khok rahim a hruek hoehroukrak Khrih ni a uk han.
A hnuktengpoung e taran tie duenae teh poutnae koe ka phat han.
Hno cawngca tami Capa e khok rahim a hruek toe telah Cakathoung dawk thut lah ao. Hno cawngca a khok rahim a hruek ti navah, hnocawngca khok rahim kahruengkung ama teh bawk hoeh tie a kamceng.
Hetnaw be a sak hnukkhu Cathut teh a cawngca dawk a cawngca lah ao thai nahan, hnocawngca pueng hah tami Capa e khok rahim ka tat pouh kung e uknae rahim vah Capa ma roeroe hai ao han.
Kadout tangcoungnaw boutthawnae khoeroe awmhoeh pawiteh, kadoutnaw e yueng lah baptisma ka coe naw bangtelamaw ti han toung. Kadoutnaw e yueng lah bangkongmaw baptisma a coe a vaw.
Maimouh hai bangkongmaw hnintangkuem runae kâhmo a vaw.
Hmaunawnghanaw maimae Bawipa Khrih Jisuh thung nangmouh kecu ka coe e kâoupnae lahoi hnintangkuem ka due telah ka dei.
Kadoutnaw boutthawnae awm hoehpawiteh, Efisa kho tami pouknae sarang taki ka tho poung hoi kâtuknae hai kai hanlah bangmaw aphu kaawm. Cat awh sei, net awh sei, tangtho due a han toe.
Alouklah pouk awh hanh. Tami kahawihoehnaw hoi kamyawngnae lahoi nuen kahawi a rawk thai.
Lannae koe lah yongvak awh haw. Yonnae sak awh hanh. Taminaw tangawn teh Cathut panuek a hoeh. Hottelah ka ti nah nangmouh kaya nahanelah doeh ka dei.
Tami tangawn ni, bangtelamaw tami kadout tangcoung e bout a thaw han. Bangpatetlae tak hoi maw a thaw han telah na pacei thai.
Na pathu maw. Na patûe e cati ni dout hoehpawiteh hring mahoeh.
Na patûe nah a kung na patûe hoeh. Catun nakunghai, cang nakunghai, a mu roeroe doeh na patûe awh.
Cathut ni a ngainae patetlah a kung a paw sak. Cati pueng hai amamouh phun patetlah a kung a paw sak.
Moi pueng koung kâvan hoeh. Tami moi alouk, moithangnaw e moi alouk, tanga moi alouk, tava moi alouk, alouklouk lah ao awh.
Kalvan tak ao teh talai tak hai ao. Hatei, kalvan tak e bawilennae phun louk, talai e bawilennae hai phun louk lah ao.
Kanî e bawilennae alouk, thapa e bawilennae alouk, âsi e bawilennae alouk, alouklouk lah doeh ao awh. Âsi buet touh rip e a bawilennae hai kâvan hoeh.
Hot patetvanlah kadoutnaw e boutthawnae teh ao. Tak teh patûe navah ka pawk thai e lah ao. Thaw toteh ka pawk thai hoeh e lah bout a thaw han.
Patûe navah bari awm hoeh. Bout thaw toteh a bawilen. Patûe navah tha a youn, bout thaw toteh bahu a o.
Pakawp navah talai tak lah a o, bout thaw toteh muitha tak lah ao. Talai tak alouk, muitha tak alouklah ao.
Cakathoung ni, apasueke tami Adam teh kahring e lah ao. A hnukteng e Adam teh kahringsakkung Muitha doeh.
Muitha tak ahmaloe awmhoeh. Talai tak hmaloe ao. Hathnukkhu muitha tak ao.
Ahmaloe e tami teh vaiphu hoi sak e talai tami doeh. Apâhni e tami teh kalvan kho hoi ka tho e Bawipa doeh.
Vaiphu hoi sak e tami teh hote vaiphu tami patetlah ao awh. Kalvanlae taminaw teh hote kalvanlae tami patetlah ao awh han.
Maimouh teh vaiphu tami e meilam sin e patetlah kalvanlae meilam hai sin van awh han.
Hmaunawnghanaw, thi hoi tak ni Cathut uknaeram coe thai mahoeh. Ka pawk thai e ni ka pawk thai hoeh e coe thai van mahoeh.
Hrolawk na dei pouh han, maimouh pueng koung ip a mahoeh.
Hatei, a hnukteng e mongka ueng torei teh, tawkkadekca dawk maimouh pueng teh mitpalap vah koung kâthung awh han. Mongka ueng lawk thai toteh kadout tangcoungnaw ka pawk thai hoeh e lah a thaw awh han. Maimouh pueng hai koung kâthung awh han.
Atu ka pawk thai e ni ka pawk thai hoeh e a khohna han. Kadout thai e ni kadout thai hoeh e a kâmahrawk han.
Ka pawk thai e ni ka pawk thai hoeh e lah, kadout thai e ni kadout thai hoeh e a kâmahrawk toteh, duenae teh tânae ni a payawp toe telah Cakathoung ni a dei e a kuep han.
Oe duenae nange sue teh nâ ne. Oe phuen, nange tânae teh nâne ao.
Duenae sue teh yon doeh. Yon thaonae teh kâlawk doeh.
Maimae Bawipa Jisuh Khrih dawk hoi, maimouh tânae na ka poe kung, Cathut teh pholen awh.
Hatdawkvah, ka pahren e hmaunawnghanaw, Cathut thaw na tawk awh e aphu a talue poung tie na panue awh dawkvah, na lungcak sak awh. Rawm laipalah Cathut e thaw dawk thapatho nateh panki awh.
Tami kathoungnaw han pasoumhno na patung e dawkvah Galati ram e kawhmounnaw lawk ka thui e patetlah nangmouh sak van a loe.
Kai ka tho nah, bout cawng toung laipalah, hnin sari touh dawk apasuek hnintangkuem vah namamouh ni yawhawi na coe awh e patetlah na hnopai sut pâkhueng awh.
Kai ka tho torei, na ngai awh e tami koe, ca ka thut vaiteh nangmae poehno Jerusalem kho thak sak hanelah ka patoun han.
Kai hai cei hanelah awm pawiteh ahnimouh hoi rei ka cei han.
Masidonia ram lahoi nangmouh koe ka tho han, bangkongtetpawiteh, Masidonia ram lahoi doeh ka cei han.
Nangmouh koe dawngdeng ka o han rah. Kasik thapa thung teh nangmouh koe ka o han mue. Nangmouh ni na thak awh han doeh telah ka pouk.
Atu dueng nangmouh na hmu hanelah ka ngai e nahoeh. Bawipa ni atueng na poe pawiteh nangmouh hoi ka saw lah ka o hane ka ngaihawi.
Pentikos hnin totouh Efisa kho ka o han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, aphu kaawm poung e thaw ka tawk thai nahanlah kai hanlah takhang paawng lah ao. Hatei na ka ngang e taminaw hai ao.
Timote nangmouh koe tho pawiteh, takinae a tawn hoeh nahan, khenyawn awh. Ahni hai kai patetlah Bawipa e thaw doeh a tawk.
Api nang ni hai hnephnap awh hanh. Kai koe bout a pha thai nahan kahawicalah thak awh. Ahni hoi hmaunawngha alouknaw kai ni ka ngaihawi han.
Ka nawngha Apollos teh, hmaunawnghanaw, hoi nangmouh koe cei hanelah, pasawt laihoi ka dei pouh ei, atu cei hanelah khoeroe ngaihoeh. Hmalah kâvoe pawiteh a cei han doeh.
Kâhruetcuet lahoi ring awh. Yuemnae dawk kacaklah kangdout awh. Tongpa katang lah awm awh. Na thasai sak awh.
Bang hno na sak e pueng lungpatawnae lahoi sak awh.
Hmaunawnghanaw, Stiven imthung teh Akhaia ram thung dawk aluepaw lah ao teh, tami kathoungnaw e thaw tawknae dawk a kâhmoun e hah na panue awh.
Ahnimanaw e uknae hai thoseh, kaimouh hoi thaw rei ka tawk e tami pueng e uknae hai thoseh na panue awh nahanlah ka kâhei.
Stiven, Fortunatas, Akhaikas tinaw a tho awh dawkvah ka lunghawi.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, nangmouh ni na khetyawt awh teh, kuepcing hoeh rae naw, bout na kuep sak awh dawkvah, kai hoi nangmae lung tha a dam sak awh toe. Hot patetlah e taminaw hah dâw awh.
Asia ram e kawhmounnaw ni nangmouh kut na man awh. Aquila hoi Priscilla ni ama im kaawm e kawhmoun hoi Bawipa dawk nangmouh pueng kut na man awh.
Hmaunawngha pueng ni kut na man awh. Buet touh hoi buet touh kathounge kâpaconae lahoi kut kâman awh.
Kai Pawl ni kut mannae ca hah ka kut hoi ka thut.
Apihai Bawipa Jisuh Khrih lungpataw hoeh pawiteh, ahni teh thoebo lah awmseh. Oe! Bawipa tho leih.
Maimae Bawipa Jisuh Khrih e lungmanae teh nangmouh koe awm lawiseh.
Kaie lungpatawnae teh Khrih Jisuh thung kaawm e nangmouh pueng koe awm lawiseh. Amen.
Kai Pawl, Cathut ngainae lahoi Jisuh Khrih e guncei lah kaawm e, hoi ka nawngha Timote ni Kawrin kho kaawm e Cathut e kawhmoun hoi Akhaia ram pueng dawk kaawm e tami kathoungnaw koe ca na patawn awh.
Maimae Pa Cathut koehoi Bawipa Jisuh Khrih koe e lungmanae hoi roumnae teh nangmouh koe awm lawiseh.
Maimae Bawipa Jisuh Khrih e Pa Cathut pahrennae hoi ka kawi e maimae na Pa, kabawmkung Bawi lah kaawm e Cathut teh yawhawinae awm lawiseh.
Maimouh ni reithainae a phunphun khang awh navah, lung na pahawi awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh maimouh ni coe awh e lungpahawinae hoiyah reithainae aphunphun kakhangnaw hah lungpahawi thai nahane doeh.
Hote Khrih ni a khang e reithainae teh moipap dawkvah, Khrih kecu dawk maimouh ni coe e lungpahawinae hai moipap van.
Maimouh ni reithai patang khang awh pawiteh nangmouh lungpahawinae hoi rungngangnae doeh. Kaimouh ni hawinae ka hmu awh e hai nangmouh ni hawinae na hmu awh nahane doeh. Hote hawinae teh kaimouh ni ka hmu e reithainae koe nangmouh ni lungdonae hoi khang thai nahan thaonae lah ao.
Hatdawkvah nangmouh koe ka ngaihawinae a cak. Bangkongtetpawiteh, nangmouh ni reithai khangnae na phukhai e patetlah ahawinae hai reirei na khangkhai awh, tie ka panue awh.
Hmaunawnghanaw, Asia ram vah kaimouh koe runae ka phat e hah, nangmouh panuek laipalah o sak han ka ngai hoeh. Kaimouh ni a rucatnae khang thai hoeh totouh ka kâhmo awh dawk hring hane patenghai ngaihawinae awmhoeh.
Kaimouh due han totouh lawk a tâtueng awh toe telah ka panue. Hatei telah bout onae teh kaimouh ni mahoima kâuepnae tho laipalah kadoutnaw kathâw sakkung, Cathut kângue nahane doeh.
Cathut ni hettelah e taki kaawm e duenae koehoi kaimouh na hlout sak. Hmalah hai bout na hlout sak han telah Bawipa dawk ka ngaihawi.
Nangmouh ni hai ratoumnae hoi kaimouh hah na kabawp teh, taminaw e ratoumnae dawk kaimouh ni ka hmu awh e poehnonaw khet navah, taminaw ni kaimae yueng lah lunghawinae lawk a dei awh han.
Kaimouh ni kâoup kawi e teh talaivan lungangnae laipalah Cathut e lungmanae dawk Cathut koehoi ka tho e lungthin thoungnae hoi kahring awh e hah lawkpanuesaknae lung ni na panue sak.
Kaimouh ni nangmouh koe ca ka thut awh navah, nangmouh ni na touk thai hane hoi na thai thai nahane hloilah alouke ka thut hoeh.
Atuvah nangmouh ni kaimouh be na panuek awh hoeh ei, maimae Bawipa Jisuh e hnin nah kaimouh teh nangmouh hanlah kâoupnae lah na o awh e patetlah, nangmouh hai kaimouh hanelah, kâoupnae lah na o awh e hah na panue awh han telah ka ngaihawi.
Hettelah mangkhak katang dawkvah nangmouh teh hawinae bout na coe awh hanlah nangmouh koe ahmaloe ka tho han telah ka kâcai.
Nangmouh koe lah ka cei vaiteh Masidonia ram lah ka cei hnukkhu, haw hoi nangmouh koe ka tho vaiteh, Judah ram totouh nangmouh ni na thak a han telah ka pouknae ao.
Hottelah ka kâcai e heh a vanlong lah ka pouk e maw. Hoe pawiteh talai ngainae dawkvah ka titeh, Oe teh Oe hoi, nahoeh teh nahoeh telah ka tet boi e na maw.
Cathut teh yuemkamcu e patetlah nangmouh koe ka dei awh e lawk teh vai touh dawk, bokheiyah hoi, nahoeh telah nahoehmaw.
Kaimouh hoi Silvanas, Timote tinaw ni nangmouh koe ka dei awh e Cathut Capa Jisuh Khrih dawk vai touh hoi, Oe hoi Oe nahoeh telah awm laipalah Bawipa dawk, Oe telah doeh ao.
Hote Bawipa dawk Cathut e a lawk kam e naw pueng teh maimouh kecu dawk a bawilennae a kamnue nahanlah, Oe telah ati, Amen telah ati.
Nangmouh hoi kaimouh teh Khrih thung na o sak teh satui kaawikung teh Cathut doeh.
Hote Cathut ni maimouh hah tacik na kin teh maimae lungthung vah lawkawm lah Kathoung Muitha na poe toe.
Cathut teh kai kampangkhai e lah ao. Ama ni ka lungthin teh a panue. Kawrin kho lah cei hoeh nahan kho ka pouk teh nangmouh hane malam ka pouk dawk doeh.
Kaimouh ni nangmae na yuemnae dawk kâ ka tawn awh hoeh. Nangmouh ni lunghawi nahanlah nangmouh hoi cungtalah thaw ka tawk awh e doeh. Nangmouh teh yuemnae hoi na kangdue thai awh toe.
Hatdawkvah, kai nangmouh koe ka tho navah, nangmouh lungmathoe sak hanelah ka tho hoeh telah lawk ka tâtueng.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, kai ni nangmouh lung na mathout sak pawiteh, kai kecu dawk a lung ka mathout e hloilah, apinimaw kai lung na hawi sak thai han va.
Kai ka tho navah, ka lung na kahawi sak e taminaw koe lungmathoenae sak hoeh nahanelah ca na patawn e doeh. Kai ka lung hawinae teh, nangmouh na kaawm e naw pueng lunghawinae lah ka tho han telah nangmouh abuemlahoi kâkuen lah kai ka yuem teh ka lung a kuep toe.
Nangmanaw lungmathoe sak hanlah tho laipalah, nangmouh na tak dawk lungpatawnae ka tawn e hah na panue thai nahanelah, lungmathoe, lung reithai, mitphi vailong hoi nangmouh koevah ka thut e doeh.
Lungmathoenae katâcawtsakkung ni lungmathoenae a tâco sak navah, kai ka tak dawk tâco sak e tho laipalah nangmanaw abuemlah dawk doeh lung a mathoe sak awh.
Tami moikapap ni reknae teh, ahni hanelah a khout toe. Ama e a yonnae ngaithoum hane hoiyah,
lung na pahawi hanelah ao, a lung hloi mathout pawiteh a lungpout langvaih.
Hat dawkvah nangmanaw ni ahnimouh koe lungpatawnae na kamnue sak nahanelah nangmanaw kai ni na kâ awh.
Nangmanaw teh bangpueng dawk lawk na ngâi ou, ngai hoeh ou ti panue nahanlah nangmanaw tanouk hanelah hoiyah hote ca teh kai ni na patawn awh e a tho.
Nangmouh na ka ngaithoum e hah kai ni hai ka ngaithoum van. Kai ni buetbuet touh ka ngaithoum pawiteh nangmouh hanelah Jisuh Khrih hmalah ka ngai thoum e doeh.
Hoehpawiteh Setan ni na tâ langvaih tie ngaihrinae ao. Maimouh teh ahnie a kâcainae naw hah panue awh.
Kai teh Khrih kamthang kahawi pâpho hanelah Troas khovah Bawipa ni takhang na paawng pouh eiteh,
ka nawngha Titu ka hmu hoeh dawk ka lung nawm hoeh, ahnimanaw kut kaman hnukkhu, Masidonia ram lah ka ceitakhai.
Maimanaw teh Khrih thung tânae pawi pou to thai nahanelah, hote Bawipa panuenae hmuitui hah maimouh lahoi kho tangkuem koe, kâkahei thai nahanelah ka sak pouh e Cathut lungmanae teh pholennae awm naseh.
A lamthung teh maimouh teh rungngang lahun e naw hoi kahmat e naw koe Cathut hmalah Khrih e hmuitui lah o awh.
Kahmatnaw hanlah duenae koe a ka phat sak e duenae hmuitui lah ao teh rungngang lah kaawmnaw hanelah teh hringnae hmuitui lah ao. Hat boipawiteh hetnaw heh api hoi maw a kamcu.
Cathut e lawk pakhuppathan e taminaw patetlah maimouh ni dei hoeh niteh, Cathut ngainae patetlah lungthin kathoung hoi Cathut hmaitung vah Khrih thung pâpho awh.
Hottelah dei awh navah, mahoima kâphokâlennae lah maw o awh han. Hettelah nahoeh pawiteh, maimouh ni alouknaw patetlah ayâ ni lungkuepkhai e, nahoeh pawiteh, nangmouh ni lungkuepkhai e ca hah a panki maw.
Nangmouh teh kaimae lungthung thut lah kaawm e, tamipueng ni a touk awh teh a panue awh e, kaimae ca lah na o awh.
Nangmouh teh kaimouh ni thut lah kaawm e Khrih e ca lah na o awh tie hah a kamnue. Hote ca teh cahang hoi thut e nahoeh, kahring e Cathut e Muitha lahoi thut lah ao teh, lungphen dawk laipalah, tami e lungthin dawkvah thut e lah ao.
Maimouh ni Cathut hmalah Khrih kecu dawk hoi hot patetlah e yuemnae teh tawn awh.
Hatnavah, maimouh teh mae bahu lahoi ma ngainae patetlah hno buetbuet touh pouk teh sak thai e nahoeh. Cathut kâuep laihoi sak thai e doeh.
Cathut ni maimouh hanlah lawkkam katha e thaw tawk sak thai nahanlah thaonae na poe. Hote lawkkam katha teh thut e kâlawk nahoeh, Muitha hah doeh. Thut e kâlawk ni teh duenae a tâcokhai. Hatei, Muitha ni teh hringnae a thokhai.
Lungphen dawk thut e duenae hoi kâkuen e kâlawk patenghai yah, bawilennae hoi a tho teh, Mosi e minhmai dawk hoi ka tâcawt e kahmatthaie bawilennae dawkvah Isarelnaw ni ahnie minhmai hah khen thai awh hoeh pawiteh,
Muitha thawtawknae teh banghloine bawilennae hoi hoe a kawi han.
Hatdawkvah, yonphukhangnae dawk patenghai bawilennae awm pawiteh, lannae thaw dawk hane natawng teh banghloimaw hoe bawilennae ao han.
Atanglah, yampa kaawm e bawilennae hah atu e bawilennae ni bang hoeh lah a coung sak.
Dongdeng hane dawk patenghai bawilennae awm pawiteh, a yungyoe han dawk natawng teh hoe ao han.
Maimouh teh hete ngaihawinae ao dawkvah, taranhawinae hoi tawk awh.
Mosi ni angnae a roum hnukkhu, Isarelnaw ni ka minhmai khen langvaih ati teh lukkarei hoi a minhmai a ramuk e patetlah maimouh teh awm awh hoeh.
Ahnimae a lungthin teh puenghoi a pata dawkvah sahnin totouh lawkkam karuem touk awh navah, hote lukkarei teh pou a ramuk lah ao awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Khrih lahoi dueng doeh hote lukkarei teh takhoe thai.
Sahnin totouh Mosi e Cakathoung a touk awh navah ahnimae lungthin teh hote minhmai huemnae lukkarei ni a ramuk pouh rah.
Hateiteh, Bawipa koe lah a kamlang awh toteh, hote minhmai ramuknae lukkarei teh takhoe lah ao han.
Bawipa ti navah Muitha doeh deingai nah. Bawipa e muitha aonae koe hloutnae ao.
Maimouh pueng ni minhmai ramuknae hawng a vaiteh, hlalang kâkhet e patetlah Bawipa e bawilennae heh khet awh vaiteh, Muitha lawkkam e Bawipa ni raeng a patoun e patetlah a bawilennae dawk meilam kâthungnae teh coe awh.
Hatdawkvah, maimouh teh a pahrennae coe e lahoi thaw tawk e lah o awh dawkvah, ka lungpout a hoeh.
Maimouh ni arulahoi kaya ka tho e hnosakenaw pahnawt awh. Huenghai awm awh hoeh. Cathut lawk hai tami dum nahanlah pâpho a hoeh. Lawkkatang doeh kacairoecalah pâpho awh. Hottelah hoi Cathut hmalah, taminaw e thoehawi panuenae lungthin dawk mamouh hoi mamouh kamnue sak awh.
Maimouh ni pâpho e kamthang kahawi heh, ramuk lah awm pawiteh, rawknae dawk kaawm lahun e naw koe doeh ramuk lah awm tih.
Ahnimouh hoi ka kâkuen lah dei han tetpawiteh, Cathut e meilam lah kaawm e Khrih e bawilennae hoi kahawi e kamthang kahawi angnae hah, a hmu thai awh hoeh nahanlah het talai ka uk e cathut ni kayuemhoehnaw a lungmit a dawn sak pouh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, maimouh ni mamae kong pâpho a hoeh. Khrih teh Bawi lah ao tie pâpho awh. Kaimouh roeroe heh Khrih hanlah, nangmae san lah ka o awh.
Hmonae thungvah, angnae awmseh telah kâ ka poe e Cathut ni Jisuh Khrih minhmai ka ang e Cathut bawilennae hah, panue thai nahane raeng poe hanelah, maimae lungthin dawk a ang sak toe.
Hateiteh, a thaonae hno sakthainae teh, maimae nahoeh. Cathut amae lah ao dawkvah, a bahu a kamnue sak. Hote hno teh talai hlaam thung a ta teh maimouh dawk ao.
Maimanaw teh avoivang lahoi na ka tarawk nakunghai, thayoun awh hoeh. Kângairunae lah kaawm nakunghai, lungpout awh hoeh.
Rektapnae kâhmo nakunghai, hnoun e lah awm awh hoeh. Rahim lah pabonae kâhmo nakunghai, poutnae koe phat awh hoeh.
Bawipa Jisuh Khrih teh a hring tie heh, maimae tak dawkvah a kamnue sak hanelah, Khrih e duenae teh pout laipalah maimae tak dawk sin awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Khrih hringnae teh, maimae tak dawk kamnue thai nahanelah, Jisuh kecu dawk maimouh kahring e naw heh duenae kut dawk pout laipalah, poe e lah o awh.
Hatdawkvah, duenae ni maimouh dawk thaw a tawk teh, hringnae ni nangmouh dawk thaw a tawk.
Ka yuem dawkvah, ka pâpho telah thut e patetlah yuemnae hoi ka kâkuen e Muitha hah maimouh ni tawn awh teh, maimouh hai yuem dawkvah pâpho awh.
