Bangkongtetpawiteh, Jisuh ka thaw sak e Cathut ni maimouh hai Jisuh hoi rei na thaw sak teh, nangmouh hoi cungtalah a hmalah na thokhai han tie panue awh.
Hno cawngca pueng teh, nangmouh hane doeh. Hethateh, ahnimanaw koe, lungmanae hoe a pung teh Cathut e bawilennae kamnuesak nahanelah lunghawilawkdeinae teh hoe a kuep.
Hatdawkvah, kaimouh teh lungpout awh hoeh. Kaimae a lawi lae tami teh, ka kumcathuk nakunghai, thung lae tami teh hnin touh hnukkhu hnin touh sak katha e lah pou ao.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, maimouh ni dongdeng rucatnae khangnae naw ni maimouh hanlah a yungyoe bawilennae lah ao sak.
Hatdawkvah, maimouh teh hmu thai e hno khen awh hoeh. Hmu thai hoeh e hnonaw doeh khet awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh hmuthai e hnonaw teh dongdeng ca hanelah ao teh, hmuthaihoehe hnonaw teh a yungyoe a kangning.
Rim lah kaawm e maimae talai im a ro torei teh, kalvannaw dawk tami kut hoi sak hoeh e, Cathut ni a sak e yungyoe im ao tie hah panue awh.
Maimanaw ni talai im dawk o awh nateh, kalvan im dawk pha hanlah cingou awh.
Hote hmuen koe pha awh toteh, hmuen tawn laipalah awm a mahoeh.
Het talai rim dawk o awh navah, hnokari phu hoi cingou awh. Hottelah cingounae teh, hote rim hah ceitakhai han ngai dawk nahoeh. Kadout thai e tak heh hringnae koe pha hane hoi kangning e dawk kâen hane ngai dawk doeh.
Hettelah, na ka rakueng pouh e Bawi teh Kathoung Muitha hah lawkawm lah na ka poe e Cathut doeh.
Hatdawkvah, maimouh teh pout laipalah yuemnae tawn awh. Hete tak dawk o awh lahun nah Bawipa hoi kâhla awh tie panue awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, maimouh teh mithmu e hno tho laipalah, yuemnae lahoi doeh hring awh.
Maimouh teh yuem awh toung dawkvah, tak hoi kampek vaiteh Bawipa hoi rei o hanlah hoe ngai awh.
Hatdawkvah maimouh teh takthai dawk o awh nakunghai, kâhla awh nakunghai, Bawipa ni a ngai e tami lah o awh nahanlah panki awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, tak dawk thoehawi sak e pueng hmu awh nahanelah, maimouh pueng teh Khrih e lawkcengnae tungkhung hma lah koung kamnue awh han.
Hatdawkvah, Cathut takinae teh panue awh dawkvah taminaw hah pâhlawp awh. Maimae kong teh Cathut hmalah a kamnue toung dawkvah, nangmae lungthin haiyah a kamnue toe telah ka ngaihawi.
Kaimouh teh kamamouh hoi kamamouh hmalah kâoup awh e nahoeh. Hatei, lungthin khen laipalah, alawilae meilam dueng khet hoi kâoup e taminaw e lawk hah nangmouh ni bout na pathung awh thai nahanlah kaimouh hoi kâkuen lah kâoupnae hmu awh nahanlah doeh nangmouh na poe awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh tamipathu lah ka onae teh Cathut hane doeh. Tami lungkaang lah kaawm awh pawiteh nangmouh hane doeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Khrih e a lungpatawnae ni maimouh teh muen na kayo awh. Tami buet touh ni tami pueng hanelah dout pawiteh tami pueng hai a due a van toe.
Hottelah tami pueng hane Bawipa ni a duenae teh, kahring e naw ni ma hanelah hring toung laipalah, ahnimouh hanelah kadout ni teh bout ka thaw e Bawipa hanelah a hring awh nahane doeh.
Hatdawkvah atu hoi teh, apihai takthai koe lahoi panuek awh hoeh toe. Maimouh ni Khrih hah takthai koe lahoi hmaloe panue awh nakunghai atuvah hottelah panuenae awmhoeh toe.
Hatdawkvah apipatet hai Khrih thung awm pawiteh sak katha e lah ao. Hno karuem pueng a kahma teh hnocawngca pueng teh a katha toe.
Hetnaw pueng teh Cathut koehoi e doeh. Cathut ni Jisuh Khrih lahoi maimanaw teh ama hoi bout na kâmaihawinae sak awh toe. Hote bout kâmaihawinae thaw hah maimouh koe na poe awh.
Hote kamthang teh Cathut ni Khrih thung ao teh, talaivan e yon hah pâkuem pouh hoeh toe. Taran a roum sak teh, ama hoi bout na kâmaihawinae sak toe. Hote bout kâmaihawinae hah maimouh koe na poe awh.
Hatdawkvah, maimouh teh Khrih e laicei lah o awh. Cathut hoi bout kâmaihawi awh leih titeh Khrih yueng lah kaimouh ni na hroecoe awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Cathut ni yon ka tawn hoeh e hah maimouh hane kecu dawk yon ka tawn e lah ao sak. Hot hateh, maimouh pueng ni Khrih lahoi Cathut e lannae koe pha thai nahane doeh.
Kaimouh teh Cathut hoi thaw ka tawk e lah ka o a awh dawkvah, Cathut e lungpatawnae aphu kaawm hoeh lah na o sak awh hoeh nahanlah na thaisak awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, kai ka ngainae tueng dawkvah, na lawk na thai pouh toe. Rungngangnae hnin nah na kabawp teh na rungngang toe telah Bawipa ni ati. Khenhaw! atu doeh ngai kaawm e tueng toe. Atu raw doeh rungngangnae hnin toe.
Kaimouh ni a thaw tawknae koe ayâ ni a toun hoeh nahan, ayânaw koe tarawknae ka sak awh hoeh.
Rektapnae, roedengnae, hlout thai hoeh e runae hoi kâhmonae,
hemnae, thongim bonae, ruengruengtinae, yonpennae, ihmuhnapahlanae, kahaionae,
lungthoungnae, lungangnae, lungsawnae, hawinae, Kathoung Muitha coenae, kâsak laipalah atangcalah lungpatawnae,
Lawkkatang pâphonae, Cathut e bahu kamnue saknae, lannae puengcang avoilah aranglah kâmahrawknae,
barinae hoi barihoehnae, oupnae hoi pathoenae, dumyen e patetlah kaawm ei nakunghai hmantang e tami,
Apinihai panue hoeh e patetlah kaawm ei nakunghai min kamthang e tami, thei e patetlah kaawm ei nakunghai kahring e tami, yue e patetlah kaawm ei nakunghai theinae hoi kahlout e tami,
a lung ka mathout e patetlah kaawm nakunghai a lung pou kahawi e tami, ka roedeng e patetlah kaawm ei nakunghai tami moikapap ka bawi sak e tami, bangcahai ka tawn hoeh e patetlah kaawm ei nakunghai a cawngca ka tawn e tami lah ka o dawkvah, Cathut ni na ta e a thaw katawkkung katang lah ka o tie hah bangpueng dawk kamcengcalah kamnue sak awh.
Kawrin kho kaawm e hmaunawnghanaw kaimae pahni teh nangmouh hanlah a kamawng toe. Kaimae lungthin hai sut a kamawng toe.
Kaimouh dawk na khawk awh hoeh. Nangmae lung dawk doeh na khawk awh.
Hatdawkvah na pathungnae lahoi nangmae lungthin ka kaw lah paawng awh, telah ka canaw koe lawk ka dei pouh e patetlah na dei pouh.
Kayuemhoehnaw hoi cungtalah kânging hoeh e yawcu hrawm awh hanh. Lannae hoi kamsoumhoehe hah bangtelamaw a hmawng thai han vaw. Angnae teh hmonae hoi bangtelamaw reirei ao thai han vaw.
Khrih hoi Belial teh bangtelamaw lungkânging thai han vaw. Kayuem hoi ka yuem hoeh ni bangmaw cungtalah a coe han vaw.
Cathut bawkim hoi meikaphawknaw teh bangtelamaw khuet a kâkuet han vaw. Cathut ni a dei e teh ahnimouh koe ka o han. Ahnimae Cathut lah ka o han. Ahnimouh hai kaie tami lah ao a han ati e patetlah nangmouh teh kahring Cathut e bawkim lah na o awh.
Hatdawkvah ahnimouh thung hoi tâcawt awh nateh, aloukcalah awm awh, telah Cathut ni ati. Ka khin e hnonaw hah na kut hoi boehai tek awh hanh. Hottelah na tetpawiteh nangmouh kai ni na dâw awh han.
Kai teh nangmae Pa lah ka o vaiteh, nangmouh hai Kaie canu capa lah na o awh han telah Athakasaipoung e Bawipa ni ati.
Ka pahren e naw, maimouh koe het patetlah lawkkamnae ao dawkvah, takthai hoi lungthin dawk khinnae pueng teh mahoima kâcai sak vaiteh, Cathut taki laihoi thoungnae hoi kawi a sei.
Kaimanaw na dâw a loe. Kaimouh ni api koehai ka payon awh hoeh. Apipatethai ka rawk sak awh hoeh. Api koehai huenghai hoi ka cat awh hoeh.
Nangmanaw yon na pen ngai dawk hettelah ka dei e nahoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh ka dei tangcoung patetlah nangmouh hoi rei hring hane hoi due hanelah ngainae totouh kaimouh ni nangmouh lung na pataw awh.
Kai ni nangmanaw hah na yuem awh dawkvah nangmouh kecu dawk ka kâoup. Kai teh lungpahawinae ka coe dawkvah kaimouh ni ka khangnae rucatnae pueng dawk lunghawinae hoi ka kawi.
Masidonia ram ka pha navah kâhat nahan tueng kahmawt laipalah alawilah kâtuknae, a thung lah takinae ao teh a voivang hoi rektapnae ka khang awh.
Hatei, a thakayounnaw lung ka pahawikung, Cathut ni Titu a tho e lahoi kaimanaw lung na pahawi awh.
Titu a tho e dawk hoi dueng lungpahawi e nahoeh. Titu ni nangmouh koehoi a coe e lungpahawinae lahoi lung na pahawi awh. Alouke lahoi dei pawiteh, nangmouh ni na rabui awh e, na lungmathoe awh e, hoi kai koe pahrennae na tawn awh e naw hah Titu ni na dei pouh dawkvah ka ko a nawm.
Ka thut e ca ni nangmouh, lungmathoenae na kapoekung lah kaawm nakunghai thoseh ka lung mathout hoeh. Hote ca teh, nangmouh koe dongdeng lung ka mathout sak nakunghai atuteh lunghawinae bout ka tawn toe.
Kai ni na patawn e ca ni nangmouh lung na mathoe sak eiteh lunghawihoehnae ka tawn hoeh. Hote ca ni nangmouh dongdeng lung na mathoe sak awh e hah ka hmu navah ka lunghawi hoeh. Hatei nakunghai, atu ka lung ahawi. Hottelah ka ti navah nangmouh na lungmathoe sak dawkvah ka lunghawi e nahoeh. Nangmae lungmathoenae ni nangmouh pan na ka ngai sak dawk doeh. Atangcalah nangmouh teh Cathut ngainae patetlah na lungmathoe awh dawkvah, kaimouh kecu dawk bangcahai na sung awh hoeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Cathutlae lahoi khang e lungmathoenae ni teh rawkphai koe lah awm sak laipalah rungngangnae hmu nahan koe lah pan na kângainae lah doeh ao. Talaivan lungmathoenae teh duenae ka tâcawtkhai e lah ao.
Khenhaw! Cathutlae lahoi lungmathoenae ni nangmouh thungvah hoe tawknae, caisaknae, khang thaihoehnae, takinae dounnae, lungthawgnae a tâcokhai. Hahoi, kamsoum lah lawkcengnae kong naw dawk hoi yon thoung nahanelah hno puengpa dawk na hringnae kamnue sak awh toe.
Hottelah, kai ni nangmouh koe ka thut e ca teh yonnae ka sak e tami hanelah nahoeh, yon ka khang e hai nahoeh, maimae lathueng nangmae lung thahmeinae naw hah Cathut hmalah namamouh ni roeroe na hmu hanelah doeh ka thut.
Hatdawkvah maimouh teh lungpahawinae coe awh. Maimae lungpahawinae coe e Titu e a lungthin teh nangmouh abuemlah kecu dawk lunghawi hmu e lah ao teh ahnie lunghawinae dawk hoi maimouh teh puenghoi konawm awh.
Kai ni nangmae kong hah Titu koevah kâoupkhai e yeirai awmhoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh nangmouh koe kaimouh ni ka dei awh e naw pueng teh, lawkkatang lah ao dawkvah, Titu kâoupkhai e naw hai atang e lah a onae a kamnue toe.
Titu ni nangmae lawk a ngâi teh nangmouh ni takinae hoi na dawn awh e heh pouk navah nangmanaw hah lung hoe na pataw awh.
Kai ni bangpueng dawk nangmanaw na tang awh dawkvah ka konawm.
Hmaunawnghanaw, Masidonia ram e Kawhmounnaw koe Cathut ni a poe e lungmanae hah nangmouh koe dei hanelah ka ngai.
Ahnimouh teh roedengnae hoi puenghoi tanouknae a khang awh ei, ahnimae lunghawinae hoi roedengnae pueng teh, ahnimae pasougngamnae dawk bawinae lah a coung sak.
Kai ni kampangkhai e teh, ahnimouh ni amamae a coung thai awh e hlak acawilah a poe awh teh,
tami kathoung kawkhik e lahoi coe hane yawhawinae hah ka coe awh van nahan, poehno hah na dâw pouh awh loe titeh na kâ awh.
Ahnimouh teh kaimouh ni ka ngaihawi e hloilah, Cathut ngainae patetlah Bawipa koe amamouh hoi amamouh hmaloe a ka poe, a hnukkhu kaimouh koehai a ka poe awh.
Hatdawkvah, Titu ni hote lungmanae hah nangmouh koe a kamtawng e patetlah a pout totouh a sak nahanlah kaimouh ni ahni hah ka hroecoe awh.
Nangmouh teh yuemnae dawk hai thoseh, pâphonae dawk hai thoseh, lungangnae dawk hai thoseh, lungtangnae dawk hai thoseh, kaimouh koe na tawn awh e nangmae lungpatawnae hai thoseh, bangpueng dawk na kuepcing awh e patetlah hnokahawi saknae dawk haiyah na kawi awh naseh.
Hottelah khet navah, kâpoelawk lah ka dei e nahoeh. Ayânaw e lungthonae hoiyah nangmae lungpatawnae ka tanouknae doeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh nangmouh teh, maimae Bawipa Jisuh Khrih e lungmanae heh panue awh. Bawipa teh a bawi ei ahnie roedeng e lahoi nangmouh na bawi awh nahanelah, nangmouh han roedengnae a khang.
Hete kahawi hno sak e hoi kâkuen lah, pouknae kahawi na poe han. Hete pouknae teh kaloum tangcoung e kum dawk hoi hete hno kamtawng awh e lahoi tawk hanelah lungthonae ka tawn e nangmouh hanlah aphu ao.
Nangmouh ni lungthonae hmaloe na tawn awh e patetlah atu hoi namamouh na coung thai awh e patetlah tawksak a nateh hete thaw hah abaw totouh tawk awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, lungthonae awm pawiteh, kaawm hoeh e hno khen laipalah, kaawm hno dawk hoi ngai hane kawi lah ao.
Hete a kong dawk hoi alouknaw bet ahawi sak vaiteh nangmouh runae poe hane na hoeh. Reikâvan lah sak hane doeh.
Atu tueng dawk nangmae tawnnae hah ahnimae pankinae koe na poe awh pawiteh ahnimae tawnnae hoi nangmae pankinae koe thap e lah kaawm van han.
Hatnavah, kapap lah ka hmawt e haiyah cawi hoeh. Kayoun lah ka hmawt e hai vout hoeh telah Cakathoung dawk thut e patetlah sue kâvan lah ao han.
Nangmae lathueng kaie lungthonae teh Titu lungthin dawk kaawm sak e Cathut teh ka pholen.
Titu teh kaimae thapoenae lawk a ngai hloilah ama lungthonae hoe a tawn dawkvah nangmouh koe ka tho e lah ao.
Titu hoi hmaunawngha buet touh teh kaimouh ni ka patoun awh. Ahni ni kahawi e kamthang a hramkhai navah kawhmounnaw pueng koehoi pholen e tami lah ao hloi lah,
Cathut amae bawilennae hoi kaimae lungthonae hah kamnue sak thai nahanlah thoseh, kaimouh hoi thaw ka tawk e hete poehnonaw hah, kaimouh hoi cungtalah cei sak hanelah, Kawhmounnaw ni na rawi awh teh coungkacoe lah ka o awh.
Kaimouh ni hote poehno moikapap dawk, tounnae awm laipalah, ayânaw koehoi pathoenae ao hoeh nahanlah ka kâhruetcuet awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, kaimouh teh, Bawipa e hmalah dueng tho laipalah, talai taminaw e hmalah hai bari kaawm e dueng doeh ka tawk awh.
Ahnimouh hoi cungtalah, kaimae alouke hmaunawngha buet touh ka patoun awh. Kaimouh ni ahni teh atuhoitu noumcai hnukkhu hno puengpa dawk a lungthahmei e tami lah a onae hah ka hmu awh. Ahni teh, nangmae lathueng yuemkamcu lah ao dawkvah, atu hai hoe lungtho e lah ao.
Titu hoi kâkuen lah dei pawiteh ahni heh kaie ka hui lah ao teh nangmouh hanelah kai hoi cungtalah thaw ka tawk e lah ao. Maimae hui, hmaunawnghanaw hoi kâkuen lah dei pawiteh ahnimouh teh kawhmoun e patounenaw, Khrih bawilennae lah kaawm e lah na o awh.
Hatdawkvah nangmae pahren lungmanae hoi nangmae kong dawk kaimouh ni kâoupkhai hane kongnaw hah kawhmounnaw e hmalah hoi ahnimouh koe kamnuek sak awh.
Tami kathoungnaw kawkhiknae hoi kâkuen lah, kai ni nangmouh ca na patawn awh hanelah ngai hoeh toe.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, nangmae lungthonae teh ka panue. Hote lungthonae dawkvah Masidonia ram kaawm e hoi Akhaia ram e naw koe coungkacoe a ta toe tie nangmae kong hah kâoupkhai awh. Hatdawkvah nangmae na lungthin thahmeinae ni na tahrue awh.
Hatdawkvah hete kong hoi kâkuen lah, nangmouh koe kai ni kâoupkhai e teh, ayawmlah awm laipalah kai ni ka dei e patetlah nangmanaw coungkacoe na kâhruetcuet awh nahanlah hmaunawnghanaw hah ka patoun.
Telah nahoeh pawiteh, Masidonia taminaw nangmouh koe ka thokhai navah, nangmouh ni banghai na hrueng awh hoehpawiteh, kaimouh ni yo ka kâoupkhai awh tangcoung e hah kaya ka tho han doeh.
Hatdawkvah, nangmouh ni na poe awh e poehno hah ngangngang cawng e patetlah tho laipalah, lungthocalah hoi poe e hno lah coungkacoe ao nahan, hmaunawnghanaw ni nangmouh koe hmaloe a thao awh vaiteh, hote poehno hah hmaloe kuep sak hanelah, kai ni na hroecoe awh laipalah o kawi nahoeh telah ka pouk.
Cati younca ka tu e ni younca a a han, moikapap ka tu ni moikapap a a han tie hah panuek awh.
Tami pueng ni amahmawk pasoung naseh. Paawtnae lungthin hoi pasoung awh hanh. Poe laipalah awm mahoeh tie lungthin hoi pasoung awh hanh. Lungthonae lahoi ka pasoung e dueng doeh Cathut ni a ngai.
Cakathoung ni a dei e patetlah ahni teh a pasoung toe. Karoedengnaw hai a poe toe.
Ahnie a lannae teh a yungyoe a cak, het hateh, Ahni ni karoedengnaw hanelah poehno a pasoung toe. A lannae teh a yungyoe kangning ati e Cakathoung dawk a thut e patetlah lah doeh ao.
Cati ka patûenaw teh a patûe e patetlah rawcarawnei kapoekung ni ahnimouh hane cati a poe vaiteh a pungdaw sak han. Nangmae na lannae haiyah a pungdaw sak vaiteh a paw a paw sak han.
Hottelah nangmouh teh lungthocalah hoi, a cawngca na pasoung awh nahanelah a cawngca dawk na tawnta awh dawkvah, maimouh dawk hoi Cathut e lungmanae teh lunghawilawk dei hanelah ao.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, tami kathoungnaw kabawpnae ni ahnimouh hanlah yawhawinae lah ao hloilah Cathut koe lunghawilawkdeinae a pungdaw sak.
Nangmouh teh Khrih kamthang kahawi na hringkhai awh e thoseh, tami kathoungnaw hoi alouke taminaw pueng hai barilawanae na poe awh e thoseh, ahnimouh ni a pouk awh toteh hete khetyawtnae khetsin lahoi Cathut a pholen awh han.
Hothloilah nangmouh lathueng ka phat e Cathut e ka talue e lungmanae kecu dawk ahnimouh ni na rabui awh vaiteh na ratoum pouh awh han.
Deilekhoeh e poehno kecu dawkvah Cathut teh pholen lah awm lawiseh.
Nangmouh hoi rei o nateh banghai na dei ngam awh hoeh, ahlanae koehoi taran kahawi na ti awh e kai Pawl ni Khrih e lungdo lungnemnae lahoi na thaisak awh.
Nangmouh koe ka pha awh navah, talai ngainae patetlah o hoeh nahan na kâ awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, talai ngainae patetlah ao ati e a kamnue hoeh nahan lah.
Kaimouh ni kâtuk nah ka hno e puengcang teh talai tak ngainae dawk hoi ka tuk e lah tho hoeh.
Kaimouh ni kâtuknae koe ka hno awh e senehmaica teh takthai na hoeh. Cathut e thaonae dawk hoi kho rapanimnaw ka raphoe thai e senehmaica doeh.
Hote senehmaica hoiyah taminaw e pouknae, Cathut panuenae kangangkung kâoupnae pueng a raphoe teh, a cawngca e lungpouknae pueng hah a man a katek teh, Khrih lawk a ngâi sak awh.
Nangmouh ni lawk na ngâi awh toteh, lawk ka ngai hoeh e naw pueng teh hmantang vah lawkceng hanelah coungkacoe lah ka o.
Nangmouh ni hnopai pueng a vanlong doeh na khet awh. Apinihai mahoima Khrih dawk ka o tie na yuem pawiteh ahni ni Khrih dawk ao e patetlah ahnimouh ni Khrih dawk onae hah bout pouk hanlah a ngai.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, nangmanaw hah raphoe hanelah tho laipalah roung sak hanelah Bawipa ni na poe e kâtawnnae a kong dawk, kâoup payon nakunghai kayak mahoeh.
Kai ni nangmouh ca na patawn e teh pakhinae lah pouk sak hane na ngaikhai hoeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Pawl e canaw teh ari teh bahu a tawn ei, ama kâhmo awh toteh a tha kayoun e hoi a pâpho e hai banghai bari hane kawi awmhoeh ka tet e tami na o awh.
Hottelah ka dei e naw ni lamhla hoi ka thut e ca hoi nangmouh koe ka o nah ka tawk ka sak hane heh banghai kâvaihoehnae awmhoeh tie hah panuek naseh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, kaimouh teh ahnimouh hoi ka bangnue ngam awh hoeh. Ahnimouh teh buet touh hoi buet touh a ka bangnue awh teh, ka pathu e lah ao awh.
Kaimouh teh kamamae coungnae hloilah ka pholen awh hoeh. Cathut ni na hmoun pouh e a thaw dawk dueng doeh kâoup awh. Hote thaw teh nangmouh koe totouh ka tawk awh.
Nangmouh koe totouh phat hoehpawiteh, kaimouh ni ka tapuet lah ka sak awh hoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Khrih kamthang dei laihoi nangmouh koe totouh ka pha awh toe.
Hatdawkvah Cathut ni na hmoun pouh e thaw hloilah tami alouknaw ni a tawk e thaw hah ka noe awh hoeh. Kaimouh ka ngaihawi e teh na yuemnae a roung vaiteh Cathut ni na hmoun pouh e khori thungvah hoe ka kaw lah thaw tawk han tie hah doeh.
Nangmae ram hloilah kamthang kahawi ka dei hanelah ka ngaihawi awh. Ayânaw ni a tawk tangcoungnae hmuen koe kaimouh ni ka kâoup awh hoeh.
Hatdawkvah kâoup han ka ngai e tami teh Cathut dawk kâoup naseh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, yuemkamcu e tami teh amahoima kâtalue e tami nahoeh, Cathut ni a lungkuep e tami hah doeh.
Kaie pathunae hah dongdeng na panguep awh nahanlah na ngaikhai awh. Dongdeng na panguep awh haw.
Cathutlae dipmasin e patetlah nangmouh hanelah ka dipma. Nangmouh teh kathounge tanglakacuem patetlah Khrih koe poe hanlah, hote buet touh dueng e vâ koe na ham sak toe.
Tahrun ni amae huengo e lahoi Evi a dumyen e patetlah Khrih lung na patawnae lungthin yout na kâhat awh langvaih tie ka tâsue.
Nangmanaw koe ka tho e taminaw ni kaimouh ni ka pâpho awh hoeh e alouke Jisuh kong a dei awh nakunghai thoseh, nangmouh ni na coe awh hoeh rae muitha a coe awh nakunghai thoseh, na thai boi awh hoeh rae kamthang na thai awh nakunghai thoseh, ahni hah panguep hanlah ao.
Kai teh kalenpounge gunceinaw hlak bet ka rahnoum hoeh mue ka ti.
Lawk deinae koelah kathoumhoeh nakunghai thoumthainae koe lah ka rahnoum hoeh. Nangmouh koe bangpueng dawk kacaipinlah kamnue sak toe.
Nangmouh ni na oup awh nahanlah ka ka rahnoum teh, Cathut e kamthang kahawi hah nangmouh koe ayawmlah pâpho e lahoi ka payonpakai e o maw.
Nangmae thaw ka tawk hanelah alouke kawhmounnaw koehoi kutphu hei laihoi nangmouh na lawp a maw.
Nangmouh hoi rei o teh buet buet touh ka panki nah apihai ka tarawk hoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Masidonia ram lahoi ka tho e hmaunawnghanaw ni ka panki e naw na poe awh. Nangmouh tarawk laipalah doeh ka o. Hmalah haiyah poe ka kâhruetcuet han.
Khrih e a lawkkatang kai thung ao e patetlah Akhaia ram dawkvah, hettelah kai ka kâoupkhai e heh apinihai cakâ thai hoeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, kai ni nangmouh lung na pataw hoeh dawk maw. Nangmouh kai ni lungpataw e hah Cathut ni a panue.
Kâoup han kangainaw ni a kâoup awh hoeh nahanelah, kâoupnaw ni hai kai patetlah hmantang a sak awh nahanelah, ka sak tangcoung e patetlah pou ka sak han rah.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, ahnimanaw teh guncei kaphawknaw doeh. Khrih e guncei patetlah a kâsak awh teh, dumyennae thaw katawknaw lah ao awh.
Hetheh kângairukhai hane na hoeh, Setan patenghai ka ang e kalvantami boiboe lah a kâsak.
Hat pawiteh, ahnimae sayanaw hai lannae kamthang ka pâpho e lah kâsak pawiteh, bangmouh dei han kaawm. Ahnimouh teh amamouh ni a tawk awh e patetlah a hnukteng e hnin navah a tawk e patetlah a khang awh han doeh.
Kai ni bout ka dei e teh, apinihai tamipathu tet hanh naseh. Kai kâoupnae younca ao thai nahan, tamipathu patetlah na pouk awh nateh panguep awh.
Hettelah kai ni ka dei e lawk heh Bawipa ni a dei e patetlah ka dei e nahoeh. Ka pathu e patetlah taranhawi laihoi kâoup teh ka dei e doeh.
Tami pueng ni teh talai ngainae dawk kâoupkâpawi dawkvah kai haiyah kâoupkâpawi van e doeh.
Nangmouh teh na lungang awh dawkvah, tamipathunaw hah lunghawicalah na panguep thai awh.
Ayânaw ni nangmanaw pueng san lah na ta awh, na yo awh, hnopai na lawp awh, na yue awh, na tambei awh navah, na panguep awh.
Kai teh hot patetlah ka tawk sak hoeh nahanlah ka tha a youn tangngak. Hatei tami buetbuet touh ni hno buetbuet touh dawk kâoupkhai pawiteh, kai hai kâoupkhai van han telah kapathunaw e patetlah ka dei.
Ahnimanaw teh Hebru tami namaw. Kai hai doeh. Isarel taminaw maw. Kai hai doeh. Abraham catounnaw maw. Kai hai doeh.
Khrih e a san maw, ahnimanaw hlak vah kai teh ka taluehnawn lah ka o telah ka pathu e patetlah hoi ka dei. Ahnimanaw hlak hoe ka panki teh, avai moikapap thongim na pabo awh, moikapap na hem awh, due han totouh khangnae atuhoitu ka kâhmo.
Judahnaw kut dawk hoi avai 40 vaitouh vout hemnae vai panga touh ka khang toe.
Ruitaboung hoi vai thum touh na hem awh. Talung hoi vai touh na dêi awh. Long vai thum touh a kamko teh tui van hnin touh hoi rum touh ka o.
Kahlong voutsout ka ceinae koe tuipui rakanae koehoi runae, dingcanaw koehoi runae, ka miphunnaw koehoi runae, Jentelnaw koehoi runae, kho thung kâhmo e runae, kahrawngum kâhmo e runae, tuipui dawk kâhmo e runae, hmaunawngha lah ka kâsaknaw koehoi runae, het patetlah e runae naw ka ka hmo.
Thapatungnae hoi patangnae, atuhoitu ihmuhnapahlanae, kahaikahlam lah onae, pâding ni karuemnae, caicinae hai ka kâhmo.
Hote runae hloilah kawhmounnaw hanelah lungpuennae ni hai hnintangkuem na ratet.
Ayânaw a thayoun navah ka thayoun laipalah ka o thai han maw. Ayânaw a payonpakai navah ka lungpuen laipalah ka o thai han namaw.
Kai ni kâoup pawiteh kama e ka thayounnae dawk ka kâoup han.
Kai teh laithoe ka dei hoeh tie teh Bawipa Jisuh Khrih e napa, a yungyoe yawhawinae katawnkung, Cathut ni a panue doeh.
Damaskas kho kaawm e siangpahrang Aretas kut rahim kaawm e khobawi ni kai na man sak hanlah a kâcai navah, longkha khoup a khan awh.
Khobawi e kut dawk hoi hlout thai nahanlah, a hnukkâbangnaw ni tapawm thung na ta awh teh kho thung hoi rapan alawilah na pabo awh teh, na yawng sak awh.
Kâoup e heh kai hanlah meknae awmhoeh. Hateiteh, Bawipa ni vision na patue e heh bout ka dei ei nei.
Hnuk lae kum hlaipali touh nah, Khrih thung kaawm e tami buet touh teh, kalvan dot thum e dawk tawm lah ao e hah ka panue. Hatnavah ahni dawk tak hoi maw, tak laipa maw tie teh ka panuek hoeh.
Cathut ni a panue. Ahni teh paradis totouh tawm lah ao teh, tami ni a dei kawi hoeh e lawk, a thaithai hoeh e lawk hah a thai e hah ka panue.
Hatnavah ahni dawk takthai hoi maw, a takthai hoi nahoehmaw tie teh ka panuek hoeh. Cathut ni a panue.
Hot patet e tami hah ka kâoupkhai han. Hatei, kai dawk teh, ka thayounnae hloilah kâoupkhai hane awmhoeh.
Kai teh kâoup han ka ngai nakunghai, lawkkatang dueng dei hanlah ao dawkvah, ka pathu e nahoeh. Hatei, apipatet ni hai kai na hmu e hlak, kaie kamthang a thai e hlak, kai dawk na pouk payon awh hoeh nahanelah, kâoup laipalah ka o han.
Kai ni ka hmu e vision teh a lentoe poung dawkvah, ka kâoup hoeh nahanlah ka thung vah Setan e patoune lah kaawm e, ka tak dawk na ka ruk hanelah pâkhing hah na poe.
Hote reithainae dawk hoi kahlout nahanelah Bawipa koe vai thum touh ka ratoum.
Hatei, Bawipa ni kaie lungmanae teh nang hanelah a khout. Bangkongtetpawiteh, kaie thaonae teh thayounnae dawkvah ouk a kuep sak telah a dei. Hatdawkvah, Khrih e bahu teh kai dawkvah pou ao thai nahanelah, kai teh ka thayounnae dawkvah lunghawi laihoi hoe ka kâoupkhai han.
Hatdawkvah Khrih kecu dawk ka khang e katha ohoehnae, dudamnae, rucatnae, ka pacekpahleknae, hoi het patet e khangnae hah ka ngai. Bangkongtetpawiteh, kai ka tha ayoun nah bahu hoi na kawi sak.
Kai teh tamipathu lah ka o toe. Nangmouh ni kai teh khak katek e lah na o sak awh. Atanglah kai teh nangmouh ni na oup awh hanlah ao. Bangkongtetpawiteh, kai teh banglahai kaawm hoeh nakunghai gunceinaw hlak hoe ka rahnoum hoeh.
Atangcalah kaie guncei lah ka onae mitnoutnaw teh, kângairunae hoi thaonae hah doeh.
Kai teh nangmouh hanelah hnokari lah ka o hoeh e hloilah, nangmouh koe alouke kawhmounnaw hlak hoe rahnoum nahane bangcahai ao maw. Hot patet e dawk teh na ngaithoum awh loe.
Atu nangmouh koe, avai pâthumnae tho hane coungkacoe ka o. Hatei, nangmouh tarawk hanelah pouknae awmhoeh. Nangmae hnopai ka ngai e nahoeh. Namamouh doeh na ngai awh. Canaw ni manu na pa hanlah hnopai pâkhueng e na hoeh. Manu na pa ni doeh canaw hanlah pâkhueng e lah ao.
Kai ni nangmae lungthin muitha hanlah lunghawicalah hoi kama e hno hah ka hno teh kama e tak hai abuemlah ka hno han. Namamouh dawk kai ni lungpatawnae kampung pawiteh, nangmouh ni kai dawk lungpatawnae a kamyawt han maw.
Kai teh nangmouh hanlah hnokari lah kaawm ei nakunghai, arulahoi nangmouh koehoi a dâw toe na tet awh pawiteh,
arulahoi nangmouh koe tami ka patoun e naw koehoi nangmae hno hah ouk ka la boimaw.
Kai ni Titu hah nangmouh koe a tho hanelah ka hroecoe nah, ahni hoi cungtalah alouke hmaunawngha buet touh ka patoun. Titu ni nangmouh koe dumyennae lahoi nangmae hno a la maw. Kaimouh teh lungkânging lahoi thaw ka tawk awh hoeh maw. Lam buet touh dawk ka dawn awh hoeh maw.
Kaimanaw ni nangmouh hmalah mahoima yon hlout nahanlah lawk a dei awh telah na pouk awh na maw. Kaimouh teh Khrih thung hoi Cathut hmalah doeh lawk ka dei awh. Pahren e ka huikonaw, ka tawk e hnonaw heh nangmouh roung nahane doeh.
Ka tho torei teh, nangmouh heh kai ni hmungaihoehenaw, kai hai nangmouh ni na hmungaihoehe lah o han tie hoi, nangmouh dawk kâyuenae, kâtânae, lungkhueknae, kâounnae, kaya saknae, tamcuek lawk deinae, kâoup kâpawinae, buet touh hoi buet touh kâtoenae lah o han tie hoi,
yampa vah yon awh teh kamhnawngnae, kamsoumhoehe napui tongpa yonnae, hounlounnae sakpayon teh, sahnin ditouh pankângai hoeh naw kecu dawk cingou awh teh, nangmouh hmalah Cathut ni kai hah na ka rahnoum sak han tie hah tâsuenae ao.
Atu apâthum lah nangmouh koe ka tho han. Cakathoung ni a dei e patetlah, yon kâhnei navah, kapanuekkhaikung kahni kathum touh e lawk hah caksak lah ao han.
Yampouh yonnae na ka sak e naw hoi alouke taminaw hai, apâhni ka tho navah ka dei e patetlah bout ka tho pawiteh nangmouh buet touh hai minhmai ka khen mahoeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Khrih ni kai dawk hoi lawk a dei tie na panue awh nahane doeh. Bawipa teh nangmouh koe a thayoun hoeh. Nangmouh thungvah bahu hoi akawi.
Telah boipawiteh, Bawipa teh a thayounnae lahoi thingpalam dawk a pathout awh nakunghai Cathut e bahu lahoi bout a hring. Hot patetvanlah maimanaw haiyah Bawipa dawk thayoun nakunghai, Cathut e bahu lahoi Bawipa hoi hring awh han.
Nangmouh teh yuemnae dawk na o awh maw, na awm awh hoeh maw tie hah namamouh hoi namamouh akung kâkhei awh. Nangmouh thung vah Jisuh Khrih ao tie hah na panuek awh hoeh maw. Telah hoehpawiteh tanouknae dawk ka sung e tami lah namaw, na o awh toung hah vaw.
Kaimouh teh tanouknae dawkvah ka sung awh hoeh tie hah na panue a han ti teh ka ngaihawi.
Nangmanaw teh kahawihoehe bangcahai na sak awh hoeh nahanelah Cathut koe na ratoum pouh awh. Hottelah ka tinae teh tanouknae ka tâ awh toe tie kamnue sak nahanelah nahoeh. Maimouh teh tanouknae dawk ka sung e patetlah o awh lahunnah vah nangmouh teh bari kaawm e na sak thai awh nahane doeh.
Maimouh teh lawkkatang khoeroe ngang thai awh hoeh. Lawkkatang koe lah kampang lah doeh kampangkhai thai awh.
Kaimouh katha ayoun teh nangmouh na tha a sai awh navah, kaimouh ka lunghawi awh. Nangmouh na kuep awh nahane doeh na ngaikhai awh.
Hatdawkvah raphoe nahane nahoeh, sak nahanlah Bawipa ni na poe e kâtawnnae patetlah ka tho toteh rek han ka ngai hoeh dawkvah, atu nangmouh hoi ahlanae koe ka o lahunnah hettelah ca na patawn awh.
Ahnoungpoung lah dei han ka ngai e teh, hmaunawnghanaw nangmouh koe yawhawinae awm lawiseh. Kuepnae hoi lunghawinae awm lawiseh. Lung buet touh lah awm awh nateh, kâponae hoi lungpatawnae lah kaawm e Cathut teh nangmouh koe cungtalah na okhai han.
Buet touh hoi buet touh kathounge kâpaconae hoi kut kâman awh.
Tamikathoungnaw pueng ni kut na man awh.
Kai Pawl hoi kai koe kaawm e hmaunawngha abuemlah ni, Galati ram kaawm e kawhmounnaw ca na patawn awh.
Kai teh guncei lah ka o nahanlah tami ni na patoun e hoi tha e hai nahoeh. Jisuh Khrih duenae koehoi kathawsakkung Cathut ni na kaw e lah doeh ka o.
Maimae Pa Cathut hoi Bawipa Jisuh Khrih koe e lungmanae hoi roumnae teh nangmouh koe awm lawiseh.
Atu e se kathout thung hoi maimouh teh hlout sak hanelah maimae Cathut hoi na Pa ni a ngai e patetlah ama teh maimae yon kecu a kâhmoun.
Cathut teh pout laipalah a yungyoe bawilennae awm lawiseh! Amen.
Nangmouh teh, Khrih e lungmanae dawk hoi na kakawkung Bawipa e kamthang kahawi hloilah, alouke kamthang lawk koe tang na kamlang awh dawkvah ka ka ngai lah a ru.
Hote kamthang lawk teh kamthang kahawi nahoeh. Nangmanaw tarawk hane hoi Khrih e kamthang kahawi hah bungling hanelah a ngai a dawk doeh.
Hatei, kaimouh thung dawk hoi nakunghai, kalvan hoi ka tho e kalvantami nakunghai, kaimouh ni ka dei awh e kamthang kahawi patetlah ka dei hoeh e teh thoebo e lah awmseh.
Ahmaloe, kaimouh ni ka dei awh tangcoung e patetlah atu hai bout ka dei e teh, apipatet ni hai nangmouh ni na dâw tangcoung e kamthang kahawi hoi kâvan laipalah, ka pâpho e tami teh thoebo lah awmseh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, atuvah kai heh tami e minhmai kahawi hmu hanelah ka kâyawm e na ou. Cathut koe e minhmai kahawi hmu hanelah kâyawm e na ou. Nahoeh pawiteh, tami ngainae dawk kâyawm e na ou. Tami ngainae lahoi kâyawm pawiteh Khrih san lah kaawm e nahoeh.
Hmaunawnghanaw kai ni ka dei e kamthang kahawi heh tami koe lahoi ka coe e nahoeh tie teh koung na panue thai nahan na ngaikhai awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, hot hateh tami koehoi kai ni ka coe e nahoeh. Cangnae dawk hai nahoeh. Jisuh Khrih e a kâpâphonae dawk hoi kai ni ka coe e doeh.
Judah phunglah kahring navah Cathut e kawhmoun hah ka rektap teh raphoe hanelah ka kâyawm.
Mintoenaw e cangkhainae dawk ka lung atang teh, ka huikonaw hlak Judah phung hoe ka tarawi e hah na panue awh.
Hatei anu vawn thung ka o na patenghai yah, Capa e kamthang kahawi pâpho hanelah, amae lungmanae lahoi kai hah na ka rawi niteh, na kakaw e Cathut niyah,
hote Capa hah kai koe pâpho hanelah a ngainae ao navah, Capa e kong Jentelnaw koe pâpho hanlah, kai teh ka takthai hoi ka kapan hoeh.
Ahmaloe e gunceinaw aonae koe Jerusalem hai ka cet laipalah, Arabia ram lah hmatara ka cei teh Damaskas kho bout ka ban.
Hahoi kum thum touh a kuep hnukkhu Cephas (Cephas teh Piter tinae) hoi kâhmo hanlah ka ngai dawkvah, Jerusalem lah ka cei teh ahni koe hnin hlaipanga touh ka o.
Ahni hoi Bawipa Jisuh e a nawngha Jem laipalah alouke guncei buet touh hai ka hmawt hoeh.
Ka thut e heh laithoe awmhoeh, atangcalah ao e heh Cathut ni a panue.
Hathnukkhu vah, Siria ram hoi Cilicia ram lah vah ka cei.
Khrih thung kaawm ni teh Judah ram e kawhmounnaw ni kai na panuek awh hoeh rah.
Ahmaloe vah, maimouh na ka rektap e tami ni raphoe hanlah ouk a kâyawm e yuemnae hah atu teh a kampangkhai toe tie dueng hah thai lah ao toung dawkvah,
ahnimouh ni kai kecu dawk Cathut bawilennae teh a pholen awh.
Hahoi, kum hlaipali touh aloum hnukkhu, kai ni Titu hah ka kaw teh Barnabas hoi Jerusalem kho lah bout ka cei.
Pâpho e patetlah hoi doeh ka cei teh, Jentelnaw koe ka dei e kamthang kahawi hah hatnavah ka dei pouh. Hottelah ka ti nah ka tawk tangcoung e thaw hoi hmalah bout ka tawk hane thaw hah ayawmyin lah o hoeh nahan kacue lah ka kâpouknaw hanelah doeh duem ka dei.
Hat navah, kai hoi rei kaawm e Jentel miphun Titu hah kuekluek vuensoma sak awh hoeh.
Telah ka dei ngainae teh arulahoi ka tho niteh, hmaunawngha lah kakâsaknaw ao dawk doeh telah ka dei. Ahnimanaw ni kaimanaw san lah na o sak hane a ngai teh, Khrih Jisuh thung hoi hmu e maimae hloutnae hah tuet hane la doeh a tho awh.
Hatei lawkkatang kamthang kahawi nangmouh dawk ao thai nahanelah kaimouh ni, ahnimanaw ni a dei e lawk dawngdengca boehai ka thai pouh awh hoeh.
Kacue lah ka kâpouk e taminaw pueng ni bangpatet e tami lah maw ao awh tie kai hoi kabet hoeh. Cathut ni tami e minhmai khen hoeh. Hote taminaw hoi ka kambawng teh hnokahawi buet touh hai kahmawt hoeh.
Hatdawkvah, vuensom ka a naw hane kamthang kahawi teh Piter koe poe lah ao teh vuemsom ka a hoeh naw hane kamthang kahawi teh kai Pawl koe poe lah ao tie na panue awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh vuensom ka a e Piter koevah thaw poe e patetlah vuensom ka a hoeh e Jentelnaw koe kai Pawl heh guncei lah Cathut ni na hmoun e lah ao.
Kâuepkhai e Jem, Piter hoi Jawhan tinaw hai kai ni ka coe e lungmanae a panue navah, ahnimanaw teh vuensom ka a naw koe cei hane hoi kaimouh teh Jentelnaw koe cei hanelah Barnabas hoi kai ni hnâ ka bokhai.
Karoedengnaw maimouh ni pahnim hoeh nahanelah ahnimouh a ngainae buet touh ao. Hote thaw hah kai ni puenghoi tha ka patho.
Hatei, Piter teh Antiok kho a pha navah toun hane kawi ao dawk a ma roeroe hah kai ni ka ngang.
Bangkongtetpawiteh Jem koehoi taminaw a pha hoehnahlan vah, Piter teh Jentelnaw hoi bu cungtalah rei a ca. Ahnimanaw a tho hnukkhu Piter ni vuensom ka a e taminaw a taki dawkvah hnuklah a kâhnawn teh alouklah ao.
Hat torei teh ka yuem e Judahnaw pueng ahni hoi cungtalah tami kahawipoung patetlah a kâsak teh Barnabas ni hai ahnimae moi a out teh a hnukkhu a kâbang van toe.
Kamthang kahawi lawkkatang lam kalan dawn awh hoeh toe tie ka hmu navah, ahnimae a hmalah Piter hanelah, nang teh Judah tami doeh, hateiteh, Jentel tami patetlah na o, Judah tami lah na awmhoeh, hatdawkvah, bangtelamaw Jentelnaw hah Judah tami patetlah na o awh han telah ngangngang na ti pouh vaw telah ka ti pouh.
Maimouh teh coungnae lahoi Judah lah o awh teh, Jentel tamikayon lah awm awh hoeh.
Jisuh Khrih yuem e lahoi lannae dawk pha awh e hah yon kamnuek e Jentelnaw laipalah, takthai koe lah Judah tami lah kaawm e maimouh teh rek panue e patetlah, kâlawk dawk hoi lannae koe phat awh hoeh. Khrih Jisuh yuemnae lahoi doeh lannae dawk pha awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, a pihai kâlawk tarawinae lahoi lannae dawk phat awh thai hoeh, Khrih yuemnae lahoi doeh pha thai awh.
Khrih lahoi lannae koe pha hanelah, maimanaw ni kâyawm nahlangva, yonnae bout kamnuek pawiteh Khrih teh yonnae kathokhaikung maw.
Telah coung thai hoeh kai ni apasuek ka raphoe tangcoung e hah bout ka sak pawiteh, yon ka tawn e hah kaimouh ni ka kamnue sak.
Hothloilah, Cathut koe lah ka hring thai nahanelah, kâlawk koe lah, kâlawk lahoi ka due toe.
Kai teh Khrih hoi thingpalam dawk rei ka due toe, hatei ka hring rah. Hattelah ka ti navah kai roeroe ka hring hoeh toe, Khrih teh kai dawk a hring, ka tak dawk a tu ka hringnae teh Cathut e Capa yuemnae lahoi doeh, Capa ni kai lung na pataw teh kai hanelah amahoima hringnae a kâpasoung.
Cathut e lungmanae ka pahnawt hoeh, kâlawk kâuepnae lahoi lannae koe phat thai pawiteh Khrih teh ayawmyin la doeh a due toe.
Galati tamipathunaw, thingpalam sawi pathout lah kaawm e Jisuh Khrih heh nangmae mithmu laplap kamnue sak e hah, lawkkatang na tarawi awh hoeh nahanlah apinimaw nangmouh na ân awh.
Nangmouh koehoi ka panue han ka ngai e teh nangmouh ni kâlawk hoi kâkuen lah tawknae dawk hoi Muitha na coe awh e na ou. Nahoeh pawiteh yuemnae hah thainae lahoi na ou na coe awh.
Nangmouh teh hettelah totouh na pathu awh rah maw. Muitha dawk hoi na kamtawng awh teh takthai koe lah maw na pâpout a han toung.
Nangmouh ni rucatnae hettelah totouh na khang awh e hah ayawmyin lah maw na khang awh vaw. Hettelah totouh rucatnae hah ayawmyin lah maw na khang awh toung vaw. Ayawmyin la maw ao han toung vaw.
Hatdawkvah Muitha heh nangmouh koe na poe e kângairuhno ka kuep lah ka sak e Bawipa teh nangmae kâlawk tarawi e lahoi maw a sak. Nahoeh pawiteh nangmouh ni na thai teh na yuem e lahoi maw a sak.
Abraham teh Cathut a yuem dawkvah hote yuemnae teh ahnie lannae lah khoe pouh lah ao.
Hatdawkvah, Abraham e catoun katang teh yuemnae ka tawn e naw doeh tie hah na panue awh hanlah ao.
Cathut ni Jentelnaw teh yuemnae lahoi a lan toe ti nahanelah, Cakathoung ni sut a dei tangcoung toe. Hatdawkvah, Cakathoung ni kamthang teh Abraham koe a dei tangcoung e patetlah nangmouh kecu dawk hoi Cathut ni talai tami pueng yawhawinae a coe han telah a ti.
Hatdawkvah yuemnae ka tawn e naw teh, ka yuem e Abraham hoi cungtalah yawhawinae a coe awh.
Kâlawk ka kâuepnaw teh thoebo e rahim kaawm e lah o awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Cakathoung ni kâlawk dawk e naw pueng abuemlahoi koung ka tarawi hoeh e naw teh Cathut thoebo e lah ao telah a ti.
Tami kalan teh yuemnae lahoi a hring hanelah ao dawkvah, kâlawk tarawi e lahoi apihai Cathut hmalah tamikalan lah awm thai hoeh tie hah kamcengcalah a kamnue.
Hatei kâlawk teh yuemnae hoi kâkuen hoeh. Kâlawk ka tarawi e tami teh kâlawk lahoi a hring han a ti.
Khrih ni maimouh hanelah thoebonae a khang dawkvah kâlawk e thoebonae thung hoi maimouh teh na ratang awh toe. Bangkongtetpawiteh thing sawi pathout lah kaawm e pueng teh thoebo e tami lah ao.
Hottelah na ratangnae teh Abraham ni a coe e yawhawinae teh Khrih Jisuh lahoi Jentelnaw koe a pha dawkvah, lawkkam pouh e Muitha hah yuemnae lahoi maimouh ni coe nahanelah doeh.
Hmaunawnghanaw tami e singyoe lahoi ka dei vai, taminaw ni lawkkin e patenghai yah apinihai raphoe hoeh, bout thap sin yaw maw.
Cathut ni Abraham hoi ahnie a catoun koe lawkkam a poe navah kapap e lah catounnaw tet pouh laipalah buet touh dueng dei ngainae lah na catoun atipouh. Ahni teh Khrih hah doeh.
Ka dei ngainae teh hettelah doeh, kum 430 aloum hnukkhu hoi ka tâcawt e kâlawk ni sut dei tangcoung e Cathut lawkkam teh raphoe thai hoeh. Hothloilah hnoun hai hnoun thai mahoeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh râw pangnae teh kâlawk dawk kamtue pawiteh, lawkkam e dawk kamtue hoeh toe. Hateiteh, Cathut ni hote râw hah lawkkamnae lahoi Abraham koe a poe toe.
Hottelah pawiteh, kâlawk teh bangmaw hawinae kaawm vaw, tetpawiteh, lawkkam ka coe hane catoun a tâco hoehnahlan yonnae kecu dawk poe e lah doeh ao. Kâlawk teh kalvantaminaw koehoi patuen laicei lahoi hruek e lah ao.
Laicei tie teh avoivang lahoi a kâkuet, Cathut teh buet touh duengdoeh.
Hottelah pawiteh, kâlawk teh Cathut e lawkkam hoi a kâtaran maw. Kâtaran roeroe hoeh. Poe lah kaawm e kâlawk ni na hring sak thai katang pawiteh, lanae teh hote kâlawk lahoi coe e lah doeh awm ti.
Hatei Jisuh Khrih yuemnae lahoi ka kâkuen e lawkkamnae teh ka yuem e taminaw koe poe nahanelah Cakathoung ni tami pueng hah yon thongim thung a paung.
Hatnavah yuemnae phung a tho hoehroukrak, kâlawk lahoi na hrawi awh teh, yuemnae phung a tho ditouh, kâlawk kut dawk maimouh teh na paung awh.
Hatdawkvah maimouh teh yuemnae lahoi na lan toe tie coe awh thai nahanelah, kâlawk teh Khrih koe maimouh na kathakkung, hoi na kakhoumkung lah doeh ao.
Hatei yuemnae phung a tho toung dawkvah maimouh teh na ka khoumkung kâlawk e kut rahim awm awh hoeh toe.
Bangkongtetpawiteh nangmouh pueng teh Khrih Jisuh na yuem awh e lahoi Cathut e ca lah na o awh toe.
Khrih thung baptisma ka coe e tami pueng teh Khrih a khohna awh toe.
Nangmouh pueng teh Khrih Jisuh thung buet touh lah na o awh dawkvah, Judah miphun, Grik miphun tie awmhoeh, san hoi tami kahlout awmhoeh, tongpa hoi napui tie hai awmhoeh.
Nangmouh teh Khrih e lah na awm awh pawiteh, Abraham catoun lah na o awh hloilah, lawkkam e patetlah râw kacoekung lah na o awh.
Atuvah, ka dei ngai e teh râw ka coe hane ni râwnaw pueng teh a coe hanlah ao ei, a camo nah thung teh san patetlah ao.
A na pa ni atueng khoe e a pha hoehnahlan hno ka kuem kayawtnaw hoi ka khenyawnnaw e kut rahim vah ao.
Hot patetvanlah maimouh hai camo lah o awh nateh talaivan cangkhainae rahim vah san lah o awh.
Hatei, atueng kuep torei teh Cathut ni a Capa hah a patoun. Ahni teh napui buet touh koehoi kâlawk rahim vah a khe.
Hote kâlawk rahim kaawm e taminaw hah a ratang dawkvah maimouh teh cacoungnae coe awh nahane doeh.
Hottelah nangmouh teh ca lah na o awh dawkvah Cathut ni Abba A Pa telah ka kaw thai e Capa e Muitha hah nangmae lungthin thung a patoun.
Hatdawkvah nangmouh teh san nahoeh toe. A ca lah o awh toe. A ca lah o awh toung dawkvah Khrih lahoi Cathut e râw kacoekung lahai o awh.
Cathut na panue awh hoehnahlan teh cathutnaw lah kaawm hoeh e naw koe san lah na o awh.
Atuteh nangmanaw ni Cathut yo na panue toe. Phunlouk lahoi dei pawiteh Cathut ni nangmouh hah na panue awh toe. Hat pawiteh, hno sakthainae ka tawn hoeh e ahmaloe e phunglawk dawk bangkongmaw san lah bout kamlang hane na ngai a vaw.
Nangmanaw ni a hnin, a tha, atueng hoi a kumnaw hah na ya awh.
Nangmouh han kâyawm laihoi ka tawk e ayawmyin lah awm payon vaih tie na tâsue khai awh.
Hmaunawnghanaw kai patetlah awm awh ti teh na kâ awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh kai hai nangmouh patetlah doeh ka o. Nangmouh ni kai koe kahawihoehe hno banghai na sak awh hoeh.
Nangmouh koe kamthang kahawi hmaloe ka pâpho pasuek nah ka takthai dam hoeh tie na panue awh.
Hottelah kaie ka rucatnae teh nangmouh hanlah tarawk lah kaawm nakunghai nangmanaw ni kai na hmuhma awh hoeh, na pahnawt awh hoeh. Cathut e kalvantami hoi Khrih Jisuh patetlah kai hah na pouk awh.
Hottelah na coe awh nahlangva, na coe awh e yawhawinae teh bangtelane. Coung thai pawiteh, na mitnaw patenghai cawngkhawi vaiteh kai na poe han na ngai a han doeh tie ka kampangkhai.
Lawkkatang ka dei kecu dawk atuvah nangmae taran lah maw ka o toung.
Alouknaw ni nangmouh hanelah hawinae ka sak e patetlah ao awh eiteh, a pouknae hawihoeh. Kai hoi nangmanaw kampek vaiteh nangmanaw teh ahnimouh koe lah kambawng hane a ngai a dawk doeh.
Hatdawkvah nangmouh koe kai ka o na dueng tho laipalah nâtuek hai thoseh hnokahawi hah kampangkhai e teh ahawi.
Ka lungpataw e ka canaw Khrih mei nangmouh koe a kamnue hoehroukrak, camo khe nah khang e patetlah ka khang.
Nangmanaw oupvoutnae ka tawn dawkvah, kama ni roeroe na kâhmo vaiteh alouke lawk dei hane ka ngai.
Nangmouh kâlawk rahim o hane na ka ngai e naw, dei haw, kâlawk ni a dei ngainae na thai panuek awh hoeh maw.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Abraham ni capa kahni touh a tawn. Buet touh teh a sannu e ca lah ao teh buet touh e teh kahlout e napui e ca lah ao telah Cakathoung ni a ti.
Sannu ni takthai coungnae lahoi capa a khe teh kahlout e napui ni lawkkamnae lahoi capa a khe.
Hotnaw teh hmusaknae lah ao. Bangkongtetpawiteh, napui kahni touh teh lawkkam phun hni touh e hmusaknae lah ao. Phun touh e teh Sinai mon hoi ka tho ni teh sannaw hah a khe. Ahni teh Hagar doeh.
Hagar teh Arabia ram e Sinai mon hmu saknae lah a tho teh, atu Jerusalem hoi a kâvan. Bangkongtetpawiteh ahni teh amae a canaw hoi san lah ao awh.
Hatei, lathueng lah kaawm e Jerusalem khopui kahlout e tie teh maimouh pueng e manu lah ao.
Bangkongtetpawiteh cakaroe e napui na konawm haw. Camokhe patawnae ka khang boihoeh e napui na lawk na tawn e puenghoi hramki haw. Bangkongtetpawiteh, pahnawt e napui teh a vâ ka tawn e napui hlak a ca kapap na khe toe telah a thut.
Hmaunawnghanaw, nangmanaw teh Isak patetlah lawkkam e canaw lah na o awh.
Hatei, takthai coungnae lahoi khe e capa ni Muitha hoi khe e ca a rektap e patetlah atu hai ao.
Hatdawkvah Cakathoung ni bangtelamaw a dei. Sannu hoi a ca teh pâlei leih. Bangkongtetpawiteh, sannu e a ca ni kahlout e napui e a ca hoi cungtalah râw rei coe thai mahoeh telah a ti.
Atuteh hmaunawnghanaw, maimouh teh sannu e ca lah awm awh hoeh kahlout e napui e canaw lah o awh.
Hloutnae hmu nahanlah Khrih ni maimanaw teh na hlout sak awh toe. San coungnae ni bout na man hoeh nahanlah kacakcalah awm awh.
Thai awh haw, kai Pawl ni nangmouh koe ka dei e teh nangmouh ni vuensomanae na coe awh toung pawiteh Khrih teh nangmouh hanlah aphu awmhoeh.
Vuensom ka a awh e naw pueng, kai ni lawkpanuesaknae na poe awh. Kâlawk naw pueng koung tarawi hanlah ao.
Kâlawk lahoi lannae coe hanlah ka pouk e nangmanaw teh, Khrih koehoi takhoe lah na o awh teh, lungmanae dawk hoi na cei payon awh toe.
Maimanaw teh yuemnae lahoi lannae dawk pha han tie lungmanae hah Muitha lahoi ngaihawi awh teh ring awh.
Khrih Jisuh dawk vuensoma e aphu awmhoeh. A hoeh e hai aphu awmhoeh. Lungpatawnae dawk hoi kaawm e yuemnae doeh aphu kaawm.
Nangmouh teh kahawicalah na yawng awh toe. Lawkkatang na tarawi awh hoeh nahanelah apinimaw na ngang awh vaw.
Hete tacueknae teh nangmouh na kakawkung koehoi ka tho e nahoeh,
Yitca e tawn ni tahawnbu koung a paw sak.
Nangmanaw teh kâkapeknae lungthin na tawn awh mahoeh telah ka pouk. Cathut min lahoi nangmanaw teh kai ni na yuem teh na kâuep awh. Nangmanaw lungmawng hoeh nahanlah ka tâcawt sak e teh apipatet hai lawkcengnae a khang han.
Hmaunawnghanaw kai teh vuensomanae phunglawk bout ka pâpho rah pawiteh, bangkongmaw rektapnae bout ka kâhmo rah vaw. Hottelah pawiteh, kamthuinae lah kaawm e thingpalamnae teh takhoe lah ao toe.
Nangmouh lam na ka payonsakkung taminaw hah takhoe vaiteh pâlei hanelah doeh kai ni na ngaikhai awh.
Hmaunawnghanaw hlout hanlah na kaw awh e doeh toe. Hatei na hloutnae teh takthai ngainae dawk hno laipalah buet touh hoi buet touh lungpatawnae lahoi thaw tawk awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh kâlawk ni yah, namahoima na lungpataw e patetlah na hui lungpataw tie lawk buet touh dawk he a kâracut.
Hatei, nangmanaw ni buet touh hoi buet touh na kâkei, na kâpayawp awh pawiteh rawknae koe na pha a han tie hah na ngaihri khai dawkvah kâhruetcuet awh.
Kai ni ka dei ngainae teh Muitha lahoi hring awh. Telah pawiteh takthai noenae hah khoeroe tarawi laipalah na o awh han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh takthai ngainae hoi Muitha ngainae teh a kâtaran. Muitha ni takthai hoi kâtaran e hno a doun. Hattelah dawk doeh ahnimouh teh buet touh hoi buet touh a kâtaran awh teh nangmouh ni sak han na ngai e na sak thai awh hoeh.
Hattelah pawiteh Muitha e lamhrawinae dawk na cet vaiteh nangmouh teh kâlawk rahim na awm a mahoeh.
Takthai coungnae hoi kâkuen e saknae naw teh reng a kamnue. Hotnaw teh uicuknae, khinnae, takthaingainae,
meikaphawk bawknae, sueânnae, kâsaveknae, kâpohoehnae, utnae, lungkhueknae, kâkaramnae, lungkânginghoehnae, kâkapeknae,
hmuhmanae, yamuhrinae, phuvounnepnae, pawitonae naw hah doeh. Hot patet e hno ka sak e, katarawinaw pueng teh Cathut uknaeram râw pang awh mahoeh titeh ahmaloe ka dei tangcoung patetlah atu hai nangmanaw koe bout ka dei.
Muitha e a paw teh: lungkâpatawnae, lunghawinae, lungmawngnae, lungsawnae, kâpahrennae, hawinae, yuemkamcunae, lungdolungnemnae,
mahoima kâcakuepnae naw hah doeh. Hotnaw teh bang patet e kâlawk hoi hai kâtaran hoeh.
Khrih Jisuh hoi kâkuennaw ni takthaingainae teh radueknae hoi cungtalah thingpalam dawk mek a het awh toe.
Maimouh teh Muitha lahoi hring awh toung dawkvah Kathoung Muitha hoi pou kâkuetnae dawk khok takan awh lawi sei.
Lunglennae a kâen teh buet touh hoi buet touh kâtarannae lungthin, buet touh hoi buet touh kâ hmuhmanae lungthin tawn laipalah awm awh lawi sei.
Hmaunawnghanaw, tami buet touh ni yonnae buetbuet touh koe sak pawiteh, muitha koe lah na kaawm awh e nangmouh ni, lungdo lungnemnae lahoi yah, ahni hah khenyawn awh. Namamouh hai yon dawk na bo awh hoeh nahanlah kâhruetcuet awh.
Buet touh hoi buet touh e hnokari kâhlai awh. Hottelah na tawk awh e lahoi Khrih e phung teh na kuep sak awh han.
Apihai banglah ao hoeh nahlangva, a mahoima kârasang sak pawiteh, ahni teh a mahoima kâdum e lah ao.
Tami pueng ni a tawk awh e thaw hah noumcai naseh. Hat pawiteh ayâ dawk dei laipalah ama dawk kâoupkhai hane ao han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh tami pueng mae thaw tawk awh han.
A lawk kamtu e tami ni kacangkhaikung hah hnokahawi kaawm e pueng poe naseh.
Alouklah pouk awh hanh. Cathut teh dudam e lah awm mahoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, tami ni cati buetbuet touh patûe pawiteh ama ni bout a a han.
Takngainae lahoi ka patûe e tami teh takngainae lahoi rawknae hah a a han. Muitha dawk ka patûe e tami teh Muitha koehoi a yungyoe hringnae a a han.
Maimouh ni kahawi e hno sak navah lungpout thayounnae tawn laipalah awm a sei. Bangkongtetpawiteh, lungpout awh laipalah awm awh pawiteh atueng a kuep toteh a awh han.
Hatdawkvah maimouh teh atueng kahawi hmu navah tami pueng e lathueng alawkpui lah yuemnae imthungkhunaw koevah, kahawi e hnonaw hah sak a sei.
Kai ni nangmouh koe ka kut hoi ka thut e ca heh banghloimaw a len tie teh na hmu awh.
Talai mithmu dawk khet kamcu ka ngai e taminaw teh, Khrih e thingpalam kecu dawk rektapnae khang hane a ngai awh hoeh dawk doeh, nangmouh vuensoma sak hanlah ngangngang a dei awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh vuemsom ka a naw ni hai kâlawk tarawi thai awh hoeh. Nangmouh koe a kâoup awh nahanelah doeh nangmouh hah vuensoma sak hanelah a ngai awh.
Kai teh Maimae Bawipa Jisuh Khrih e thingpalam dawk kâoupnae hloilah alouke kâoupkhai hane awmhoeh. Kai koe lahoi teh talaivan heh hote thingpalam dawk pathout tangcoung lah ao teh talai koe lahoi hai kai teh thingpalam dawk pathoup lah ka o toe.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, vuensoma nakunghai, a hoeh nakunghai, alawkpui nahoeh. Sak kathanae dawk doeh alawkpui lah ao.
Hete kâhrawinae ka tarawi e pueng lathueng hai, Cathut e tami Isarelnaw lathueng hai, lungmawngnae hoi pahrennae awm lawiseh.
Atu hoi teh api nang ni hai na tarawk awh hanh lawih. Bangkongtetpawiteh Jisuh e hmâ teh ka tak dawk pou ka sin toe.
Hmaunawnghanaw maimae Bawipa Jisuh Khrih e lungmanae teh nangmae lungthin muitha thung awm lawiseh. Amen.
Kai Pawl, Cathut e ngainae lahoi Khrih Jisuh e guncei lah kaawm e ni, Jisuh Khrih dawk yuemkamcu ni teh Efisa kho kaawm e tami kathoungnaw koe ca na patawn awh.
Jisuh Khrih hoi maimae Pa Cathut koe e lungmanae hoi lungmawngnae teh nangmouh koe awm lawiseh.
Khrih dawk kalvanlae Muitha yawhawinae kaawm e puenghoi Khrih dawk yawhawinae na ka poe e maimae Jisuh Khrih e Pa Cathut teh pholen lah awm lawiseh.
Maimouh teh amae hmalah thoung awh teh tounnae ao hoeh nahan talaivan a sak hoehnahlan vah Khrih dawk na rawi awh toe.
Jisuh Khrih lahoi maimouh teh cacoungnae coe awh nahan, a pahrennae dawk a ngainae patetlah hmoun lah o awh toe.
Hottelah na hmounnae teh maimouh koe na poe e ka lentoe poung, a pahrennae hah pholen awh nahane doeh.
Puk ka cawi lae a lungmanae lahoi yah, yon a ngaithoum teh a thipaling hoi na ratang awh.
Hothateh lungangnae abuemlah, thaipanueknae abuemlah maimouh koe na poenae doeh.
Cathut ni a ngainae lahoi Khrih dawk a noe e hrolawk hah maimouh koe na panue sak.
Kuepnae tue a pha toteh kalvan kaawm e hoi talai van kaawm e abuemlah Khrih e rahim vah cungtalah o sak nahane doeh.
Ama e ngainae patetlah bangpuengpa ka sak e ni pouknae a tawn e patetlah maimouh teh Jisuh Khrih lahoi râw kacoekung lah o awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Khrih dawk hmaloe ka ngaihawi e kaimouh ni a bawilennae hah pholen awh nahane doeh.
Nangmouh hai rungngangnae kamthang lawk kahawi, lawkkatang lawk hah na thai awh teh, hote Jisuh Khrih hah na yuem awh navah Kathoung Muitha hoi noutnae tacik na kin awh toe.
Hote Kathoung Muitha teh a bawilennae pholen hanelah ama koe na ratang hoehroukrak, pang han kawi râw e lawkawm lah ao.
Hatdawkvah, nangmouh ni Jisuh Khrih na yuem awh e hoi tami kathoungnaw na lungpataw awh e hah ka thai hnukkhu teh:
Nangmouh hanelah Cathut koe lunghawinae lawk dei e hoi ratoumnae ka pâpout hoeh.
Ouk ka ratoum e teh, maimae Bawipa Jisuh Khrih e Pa Cathut, ka lentoe poung e a ma panue thai nahanelah, lungangnae hoi thaipanueknae na poe awh nahan,
na kaw e dawk ngaihawinae teh bang hah maw tie hoi tami kathoungnaw ni a coe awh e râw teh banghloimaw a len ti e, hoi
maimouh ka yuem e naw koe na patue awh e thao thasainae teh banghloimaw a len tie hah nangmouh ni na panue awh nahanlah panuenae mit a ang sak nahan ouk ka ratoum.
Hote bahu teh Khrih hah duenae koehoi a thaw sak teh Khrih dawk a sak e a thaonae patetlah ao.
Uknae abuemlah, kâtawnnae abuemlah, atu e tue dawk dueng tho laipalah hmalae tue dawk kaw lah kaawm e minnaw pueng e lathueng, kalvanlae amae aranglah a rasang poungnae koe Khrih teh tahungnae hmuen a poe toe.
Cathut ni a khok rahim hnocawngca pueng a ta pouh teh Kawhmoun hanelah hnocawngca e lathueng vah lû lah ao sak.
Hote amae tak hateh hnocawngca hah hnocawngca hoi ka kuep sak e ni a kuepnae Khrih e a tak lah ao.
Nangmouh teh ahmaloe vah namamae yon hoi sakpayon e yonnaw dawk na due awh teh,
kahli dawk kâtawnnae kapatuemkung, lawkngainae katawnhoehnaw koe atu thaw ka tawk e muitha ngainae patetlah het talaivan phung patetlah hote yonnae dawkvah na hring awh.
Maimouh pueng haiyah ahmaloe teh, ahnimanaw patetlah hring awh teh, ma takngainae dawkvah hring awh. Takngainae hoi lungngainae patetlah kâroe awh teh, alouknaw patetlah a lungkhueknae ka khang e lah o awh.
Hatei lungmanae hoi kakawi Cathut ni, maimouh a lungpatawnae kalenpoung kecu dawkvah,
sakpayon e yonnaw dawk kadout awh e maimouh hah, Khrih hoi cungtalah na hring sak awh toe. Nangmouh teh a lungmanae lahoi rungngang lah na o awh.
Hathnukkhu, Khrih Jisuh thung maimouh hah Khrih hoi cungtalah na thaw sak awh teh, kalvanlae tahungnae hmuen na poe awh toe.
Hethateh, maimouh lung na patawnae hah Khrih Jisuh thung a kamnue sak teh lungmanae hoi kawi e hah hmalae tuengnaw dawk a kamnue sak nahane doeh.
Lungmanae dawk doeh yuemnae lahoi rungngang lah o awh. Hnokahawi sak e dawk hoi rungngang lah o e nahoeh. Cathut e poehno doeh ka tho.
Ma ni kahawi hno sak e dawk nahoeh. Hatdawkvah apihai kâoup thai hoeh.
Hno kahawinaw sak awh nahanlah, Khrih Jisuh thung sak katha e lah o awh. Maimouh ni hnokahawi sak awh hanelah Cathut ni sut na rakueng toe.
Hatdawkvah, nangmouh teh Jentel lah na o awh teh, kut hoi takthai dawk vuensoma lah kaawm e naw ni nangmouh teh vuensom ka a hoeh e naw ati awh e hah panuek awh.
Hatnavah, Isarel miphun lahai na awm awh hoeh. Lawkkamnae hoi hai na kabet awh hoeh. Ngaihawinae hai na tawn awh hoeh. Talaivan Cathut laipalah na o awh e hah panuek awh.
Nangmouh teh ahmaloe vah na kahlat awh nakunghai, atuteh Khrih Jisuh thung Khrih e thipaling lahoi na hnai awh toe.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, na ka taransakkung rapanpui hah a raphoe teh miphun kahni touh hah miphun buet touh lah a coung sak toe. Bawipa teh maimae roumnae lah ao.
Phunglawknaw dawk kaawm e kâpoelawknaw hoi kâkuen e kâlawk hah amae a tak dawk hoi a raphoe toe. Miphun kahni touh e hah miphun buet touh dueng e tami katha lah a sak teh a kâmaihawi sak toe.
Thingpalam dawk taran a raphoe teh, thingpalam lahoi hote miphun kahni touh teh tak buet touh thung Cathut hoi bout kâmaihawi awh toe.
Hote Khrih ni a tho teh, ahlanae koe kaawm e nangmouh hoi a hnainae koe kaawm e kaimouh teh roumnae kamthang kahawi hah na pâpho pouh.
Hottelah Khrih lahoi maimouh roi teh, lungthin muitha buet touh lah o awh teh, Pa koe kâen thainae kâ hmu awh toe.
Hatdawkvah, nangmouh teh miphun alouke nahoeh toe. Imyin lahai na awm awh hoeh toe. Tami kathoungnaw e miphun lah na o awh teh Cathut e imthung lahai na o awh toe.
Bangtelamaw tetpawiteh, adu lah kaawm e gunceinaw hoi profetnaw e van vah, patuen pacoung sin teh sak e lah na o awh. Khrih Jisuh ama teh a takinlung lah ao.
Hote takinlung hoi koung ka kâkuen lah a roung teh Bawipa hanelah kathounge bawkim lah a coung.
Hote hmuen teh Cathut ni a Muitha lahoi ao nahanelah nangmouh teh kaimouh hoi cungtalah sak e lah o awh.
Hote kong dawk, kai Pawl teh nangmouh Jentelnaw hane dawkvah Khrih Jisuh e thongkabawt lah ka o.
Nangmouh ni na thai tangcoung e patetlah kai koe na poe e Cathut lungmanae teh nangmouh hane dawk doeh kai ni ka khang.
A lungmanae kai koe panuesaknae lahoi lathueng lah youn touh ka thut tangcoung e patetlah, Cathut ni a pâphonae lahoi yah, hrolawk hah na panue sak.
Hote ca na touk awh pawiteh Khrih e hrolawk ka panue e hah na panue awh han.
Hote hrolawk hah tami kathoungnaw, gunceinaw hoi profetnaw koe atu e se nah Muitha lahoi a pâpho e patetlah alouke senaw dawk taminaw koe pâpho hoeh.
Hote hrolawk teh Jentelnaw ni kamthang kahawi lahoi Isarelnaw hoi cungtalah râw a coe awh teh tak buet touh lah a onae lahoi Khrih Jisuh lahoi lawkkamnae hah cungtalah a hmawng van awh.
Hnosakthainae lahoi poehno a lungmanae hah kai koe na poe toe. Kai teh hote kamthang kahawi ka pâpho e san lah ka o.
Pâphue teh ka baw thai hoeh e Khrih e kuepnae kamthang kahawi hah Jentelnaw koe dei pouh hanelah,
hnocawngca pueng hah Khrih lahoi yah, ka sak e Cathut dawkvah ayan e se pueng dawk hro lah kaawm e hote hrolawk hah tami pueng koe pâpho pouh hanelah kai teh tami kathoungnaw thung dawk, kathoungpounge naw hlak hai hoe kathounge lah ka o.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, maimae Bawipa Khrih Jisuh dawk a yungyoe pouknae a tawn e patetlah,
kalvanlae bahunaw hoi hnosakthainae dawkvah, Cathut e kângairu a lungangnae hah Kawhmoun lahoi atuvah panue awh nahane doeh.
Maimouh ni hote Bawipa yuemnae lahoi lungtang awh teh, Cathut koe kâhnai thainae tawn awh toe.
Hatdawkvah, nangmae bawilennae hanlah ka khang e reithainae hah na hmu awh navah na lungpout awh hanh.
Hete kongnaw dawkvah, khok ka cuengkhuem laihoi,
kalvan hoi talai kaawm e imthungkhu abuemlae a kungpui lah kaawm e, maimae Bawipa Jisuh Khrih e Pa hmalah ouk ka ratoum.
Ouk ka ratoum e teh, Muitha lahoi yah, nangmae thung lae tami thao thasainae hoi a cak vaiteh,
yuemnae lahoi Khrih ni nangmae lungthin thungvah ao nahan, lungpatawnae dawk patue e, tangpha a payang teh,
tami kathoungnaw patetlah hnosakthainae na tawn awh teh, Khrih e lungpatawnae adung, asaw, arasang, akaw e hah kapek teh na panue thai awh nahan,
maimae panuenae lahoi panue thai hoeh e Jisuh Khrih e a lungpatawnae hah panue thai awh nahanlah Cathut e kuepnae hoi kawi awh nahan ouk ka ratoum.
Maimouh dawk kamnuek e a bawilennae patetlah maimouh ni pouk teh hei e hlak acawilah ka sak thai e Cathut ni,
Khrih Jisuh lahoi Kawhmoun dawk talai apout hoehroukrak a yungyoe bawilen lawiseh. Amen.
Nangmouh teh kaw lah na onae hoi ka kamcu lah na hring awh nahan Bawipa hanelah thongkabawt e kai ni tha na poe awh teh na hroecoe awh.
Bangpueng koehai kârahnoumnae, lungdo lungnemnae, lungsawnae, lungkâpatawnae hoi buet touh hoi buet touh kângaithoum awh.
Lungmawngnae hoi na katekkung Muitha dawk buet touh lah onae hah a cak nahanelah panki awh.
Tak buet touh dueng doeh kaawm. Muitha buet touh dueng doeh kaawm. Ngaihawinae buet touh dueng dawk doeh nangmouh teh na kaw awh.
Bawipa buet touh dueng doeh kaawm. Yuemnae buet touh dueng doeh kaawm. Baptisma buet touh dueng doeh kaawm.
Maimouh pueng e Pa, Cathut buet touh dueng doeh kaawm. Ahni teh maimouh pueng e lathueng vah ao teh, maimouh pueng lahoi ao teh, maimouh pueng e thung vah ao.
Hatei Khrih ni poehno na poe awh e patetlah mama ham lengkaleng rip coe awh.
Hatdawkvah, Cakathoung dawk thut e teh, a rasangnae koe a luen navah man e san hah a hrawi teh, taminaw koe poehnonaw a poe.
A luen ti navah ahmaloe talai thungvah a kum e hah a dei ngainae nahoehmaw!
Ka kum e teh alouke nahoeh. A cawngca pueng kuep sak hanlah kalvannaw pueng a tapuet teh ka luen takhang e hah doeh.
Khrih e a tak hah sak awh teh, Cathut e a taminaw ni a thaw tawk awh thai nahanelah a pathoup awh han.
A tangawn teh gunceinaw lah, atangawn teh profetnaw lah, atangawn teh evangelistnaw lah, atangawn teh pastornaw hoi kacangkhaikungnaw lah thaw lengkaleng a poe.
Hottelah a poenae teh maimouh kaawm e pueng ni yuemnae dawk hai, Cathut Capa panuenae dawk hai, cungtalah roung awh teh, Khrih e kuepnae hmuen koe totouh pha awh nahane doeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, taminaw e dumyennae hoi yonnae koe lah tacueknae, cangkhainae kahlî aphunphun ni avoivang lah a palek e camo patetlah bout awm awh laipalah,
lungkâpatawnae dawkvah lawkkatang hah dei awh nateh bangpuengpa dawk lû lah kaawm e Khrih dawk roung awh nahane doeh.
Hote lû koehoi doeh tak abuemlah ni a kâkuet awh teh, kâletlout koe kaawm e pueng ni hai tha hoi akawi awh. Puengcang kaawm e pueng ni mamae thaw lengkaleng a tawk awh teh lungpatawnae dawk lengkaleng a roung awh.
Hatdawkvah paletpalut lah ka pouk awh ni teh kahring awh e Jentelnaw patetlah bout na hring awh hoeh nahan Bawipa e kâ lahoi lawk na thui awh.
Ahnimouh teh lungthin mit a dawn awh. Lungthin patanae lahoi khoeroe a panue awh hoeh dawkvah Cathut hringnae hoi a kâkapek awh.
Ahnimouh teh kayayeirai panuek awh hoeh. Noenae dawk a sawtaw awh teh kakhin e hno aphunphun hah hoehoe a sak awh nahanlah mahoima radueknae kut dawk a kâpoe awh toe.
Hot patetlah na o awh nahan Khrih e cangkhainae hah na kamtu awh hoeh.
Jisuh dawk lawkkatang ao e patetlah a lawk hah na thai awh teh na kamtu awh.
Ahmaloe na hringnae, dumyen hounlounnae, lungthin hoi rawknae koe ka phat e tami karuem hah na rading awh nahan cangkhai lah na o awh.
Hottelah cangkhai lah na onae teh a katha e lungthin na tawn awh nahane doeh.
A katang e lannae hoi thoungnae dawk Cathut hoi kâvan lah sak lah kaawm e tami katha hah khohnat awh.
Hatdawkvah, laithoe e lawk hah takhoe awh nateh, lawkkatang dueng hah buet touh hoi buet touh kâdei awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, maimouh pueng teh tak buet touh e puengcang lah o awh.
Na lungkhueknae dawk yon bawk sak awh hanh. Na lungkhueknae roum laipalah kanîloum sak awh hanh.
Kahraimathout hanelah hmuen poe awh hanh.
Ouk ka parawt e ni bout parawt laipalah karoedengnaw a poe thai van nahan a kut hoi thaw kahawi tawk naseh.
Kakhin e lawk kam touh boehai nangmae pahni dawk hoi tâcawt sak awh hanh. Ka thai e taminaw hanelah ahawinae ao nahan a panki e patetlah roung nahane lawk dueng mah dei awh.
Ratangnae hnin totouh hanelah nangmouh tacikkinkung Cathut e Kathoung Muitha hah a lung mathout sak awh hanh.
Lungduemnae, Lungphuennae, Lungkhueknae hramkinae, tami minhmai ka mathout lah lawk deinae, hounroenae pueng hah takhoe awh.
Buet touh hoi buet touh kahawi hno saknae, kâpahrennae, Cathut ni Khrih thung vah nangmae yon a ngaithoum e patetlah buet touh hoi buet touh yon kângaithoum awh.
Hottelah nangmouh teh Cathut ni pahren e a ca lah na o awh dawkvah, Cathut koe kamtu awh.
Cathut koe hmuitui lah ao thai nahan Khrih ni amae a tak hah a kâhnawng teh thuengnae a sak e lahoi maimouh lung na pataw e patetlah lungpatawnae dawkvah hring awh.
Hatei, kamsoumhoehe napui tongpa yonnae, kakhin lah hringnae abuemlah, hounlounnae hah tami kathoungnaw ni a roun kawi e lah ao e patetlah lawk hoi boehai dei awh hanh.
Ka kamcukamnat hoeh e lawk, panuilai, thangpoutlai, dei e patetnaw hai takhoe awh nateh pholennae lawk hah dei awh.
Kamsoumhoehe napui tongpa yonnae ka sak e tami, kakhin lah ka hring e tami, meikaphawk bawknae lah kaawm e hounlounnae hoi kahring e tami apipatet haiyah, Khrih hoi Cathut uknaeram dawk bangpatet e râw boehai coe mahoeh tie teh na panue awh.
Apipatet koehai ayawmyin e lawknaw hoi kâdum sak awh hanh. Hotnaw kecu dawk Cathut lungkhueknae teh lawk ka ngai hoeh e naw koevah a pha.
Hatdawkvah, ahnimouh hoi rei kambawng awh hanh.
Ahmaloe vah, nangmouh teh hmonae dawk na o awh. Atuteh Bawipa dawk angnae lah na o awh dawkvah, angnae canaw patetlah hring awh.
Angnae a pawnaw teh hawinae, lannae hoi lawkkatang dawk hringnae hah doeh.
BAWIPA Cathut ni a ngai e hno teh bangne tie hah kamtu awh.
Ahawinae banghai kaawm hoeh e hmonae thawnaw hoi kâbet laipalah hotnaw hah letlang pâpho pouh awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, arulahoi sak e hnonaw dei e ca patenghai kaya a tho rah.
Yon pueng teh angnae lahoi doeh a kamnue. Ka kamnuek sak e hno haiyah angnae doeh.
Hatdawkvah, hettelah a dei awh. Ka ip nang kâhlaw leih, duenae koehoi thaw leih, hottelah na sak pawiteh Khrih ni angnae na poe han.
Hatdawkvah tamipathu patetlah awm laipalah, tami a lungkaang patetlah kheikhei na tarawi awh nahan kâhruetcuet awh.
Atu e a hninnaw teh a mathoe toung dawkvah atueng hno panuek awh.
Hatdawkvah, pathu a hanh leih. Bawipa ni a ngai e hno hah kapek nateh ka panuek e tami lah awm awh leih.
Sak payonnae kampaisakkung, misurtui hoi paruinae hah roun awh nateh Muitha hoi kawi awh.
Sam la, pholennae la, hoi muitha hringnae koe lah tha kâpoenae lanaw hoi buet touh hoi buet touh kâdei awh nateh lunghawi nalaihoi Bawipa pholennae la sak awh.
Pa Cathut koevah Bawipa Jisuh Khrih min lahoi hnocawngca dawk pout laipalah lunghawinae lawk dei awh.
Cathut barinae lahoi buet touh hoi buet touh e rahim kârahnoum awh.
Yunaw, Bawipa e uknae rahim na o awh e patetlah vanaw e uknae rahim vah awm awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Khrih teh Kawhmoun e lû lah ao e patetlah vâ teh yu e lû lah ao. Ahni teh tak rungngangkung lah ao.
Kawhmoun teh Khrih e uknae rahim a kâhnawng e patetlah yunaw teh bangpueng dawk vanaw e uknae rahim vah kâhnawng van awh.
Vânaw: Khrih ni Kawhmoun a lungpataw teh amahoima a kâhmoun e patetlah, yunaw hah lungpataw awh.
Hottelah yon thoung lah ao teh khinnae awmhoeh. Vuen cipeinae awmhoeh. Ka kamcu e hah Khrih ni ama koe a hnawng nahanelah,
lawkkatang tui hoi a pâsu teh thoungsak nahan hote Kawhmoun hanelah a hringnae a kâpasoung toe.
Hot patetvanlah, vanaw, namamouh hoi namamouh na lungpataw awh e patetlah yunaw hah lungpataw awh. A yu ka lungpataw e tami teh amahoima hai a lungpataw.
Ma e takthai ka hmuhma e api buet touh hai awmhoeh. Khrih ni Kawhmoun hah a kawkhik e patetlah tami pueng ni amahoima e tak teh a kawkhik awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, maimanaw teh amae a takthai, a hruhrawng lah o awh dawkvah a takthai e puengcang lah o awh.
Hete kong dawkvah, tongpa ni a na pa hoi a manu a ceitakhai vaiteh a yu hoi tak a hmawng dawkvah kahni touh roi teh tak buet touh lah a coung han.
Hethateh, hrolawk doeh. Hettelah ka ti navah, Khrih hoi Kawhmoun ka dei ngainae a tho.
Hatdawkvah, nangmouh ni namamae takthai lungpataw awh e patetlah yu hah lungpataw awh. Yu ni hai vâ hah bari van naseh.
Canaw: Bawipa ngainae patetlah nupanaw e lawk hah ngâi awh. Hot teh kamsoum e doeh.
Manu hoi na pa hah bari awh. Hotteh apasuek e kâpoelawk hoi lawkkam lah ao.
Hottelah na sak pawiteh, nang teh talai van hringsawnae hoi hawinae na coe han tie lawkkam teh apasuek poung e lawkkam e kâlawk lah ao.
Panaw, canaw hah a lungphuen sak awh hanh. Bawipa e cangkhainae patetlah cingthui awh nateh kawkhik awh.
Sannaw, Khrih e lawk na ngâi awh e patetlah talai bawinaw e lawk hai taki nalaihoi lunghringnae tawn laipalah ngâi awh.
Mithmu dueng taminaw e lung karoumsak e lah awm laipalah, Khrih e san patetlah Cathut ngainae hah lungtho nalaihoi tarawi awh.
Tami e san lah kaawm e patetlah dueng pouk laipalah, Bawipa e a san lah kaawm e patetlah bari nalaihoi a san lah awm awh.
Kahawi e hno ka sak e tami teh san nakunghai, tami kahlout nakunghai, Bawipa koehoi a tawk e patetlah bout hmu han tie hah panuek awh.
Bawinaw, namamae sannaw koe hot patetvanlah sak awh. Nangmae Bawipa teh kalvan ao tie hoi ahni teh apie minhmai hai khen hoeh tie hah panuek awh.
A hnuktengpoung lah ka hmaunawnghanaw, Bawipa lahoi thoseh, thaonae bahu lahoi thoseh, kacaklah awm awh.
Kahraimathout e dumyennae na ngang thai awh nahan, Cathut ni na pathoup pouh e puengcang hoi kamthoup awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, takthai hoi kaawm e taran hoi kâthe awh hoeh. Uknaenaw, kâtawnnaenaw, talai hmonae ka ukkungnaw, kalvanlae muitha kathoutnaw hoi doeh kâthe awh.
Hatdawkvah, atueng kamathout e hnin dawk kacaklah na kangdue thai nahan, thaw na cum teh na ngang thai awh nahan, Cathut e puengcang kakuep e hah sin awh.
Lawkkatang taisawm kâyeng awh. Lannae saiphei hah kho awh.
Lungmawngnae kamthang kahawi pâpho nahanlah khokkhawm hah khawm awh.
Kahrai ni na ka e hmaisene hah na ngang thai awh nahan yuemnae bahling hah senehmaicanaw e a van vah patuem sin awh.
Rungngangnae sumluhuem hah huem awh nateh, Cathut e lawk Muitha tahloi hai patuem awh.
Pout laipalah ratoumnae a phunphun lahoi ratoum awh. Hottelah na ratoum awh navah nâtuek hai na thathout awh hanh. Na lungpout awh hanh. Kai hane hoi tami kathoungnaw hane hai ratoum awh nateh khenyawn awh.
Hete kamthang kahawi e laicei lah ka o dawk doeh sumbawtarui hoi na katek awh. Hote kamthang kahawi hah lungtang nalaihoi ka dei thai nahan,
kamthang kahawi hrolawk hateh pâpho hane roeroe lah ao dawkvah taranhawi nalaihoi ka pâpho thai nahan kai hane hai ratoum awh.
Kai dawk ka tho e hnonaw hoi ka sak e hnonaw hah na panue thai awh nahan, Bawipa koe yuemkamcu lah thaw ka tawk e ka pahren e ka nawngha Taisikas ni abuemlahoi nangmouh koe a pâpho han doeh.
Nangmouh ni kaimae kamthangnaw hah na panue awh nahan, ahni ni nangmouh lung na pahawi nahanlah ahni hah nangmouh koe ka patoun e doeh.
Hmaunawnghanaw nangmouh koe lungmawngnae awm lawiseh. Pa Cathut hoi Bawipa Jisuh Khrih ni na poe e yuemnae hoi lungpatawnae teh nangmouh koe awm lawiseh.
Maimae Bawipa Jisuh Khrih lungpataw katangnaw koe a lungmanae awm lawiseh. Amen.
Kai Pawl hoi Timote, Jisuh Khrih e a san lah kaawm e ni Filippi kho kaawm e bishopnaw hoi hotunaw, Khrih Jisuh thung tami kathoungnaw pueng koe ca na patawn awh.
Maimae Pa Cathut hoi Bawipa Jisuh Khrih koehoi e lungmanae hoi roumnae teh nangmouh koe awm lawiseh.
Nangmouh na pouk nah tangkuem, Cathut koe lunghawinae lawk ouk ka dei.
Ka ratoum tangkuem nangmouh hanlah lunghawinae lungthin hoi pou ka ratoum.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, nangmouh teh apasueke hnin koehoi atu totouh a thaw kahawi dawk cungtalah rei ka tawk e lah na o awh.
Nangmouh koe hnokahawi ka kamtawng e Cathut ni Jisuh Khrih e hnin totouh thaw na cum sak a han doeh ti yuemnae ka tawn.
Nangmanaw hoi ka kâkuen lah hettelah pouknae ka tawn e heh kahawi e lah ao. Nangmanaw pueng ni kai thongim ka bo nah thoseh, kamthang kahawi deinae dawk thoseh, kai hoi a lungmanae cungtalah rei ka hmawng awh e lah na o awh dawkvah nangmouh teh ka lungthin dawk pou na o awh.
Nangmouh teh Jisuh Khrih e lungpatawnae lahoi na rabuipoung awh tie na kapanuekkhaikung teh Cathut doeh.
Nangmae lungpatawnae teh a tang e lungangnae hoi pouknae aphunphun dawk hoehoe kuep teh,
Ka lentoe e hno hah kapeknae na tawn thai awh nahan hoi Jisuh Khrih e hnin nah kathoung lahoi toun awm laipalah na o thai awh han.
Jisuh Khrih lahoi lannae apaw dawk na kuep thai awh teh Cathut lentoe kamnue thai nahane hoi a bawilennae na pholen thai awh nahan ka ratoum.
Hmaunawnghanaw kai dawk kaphate hnonaw ni kamthang kahawi hoe a kampai sak tie na panue thai awh nahanlah na ngai khai awh.
Hatdawkvah, Khrih kecu dawk kateknae ka khang e heh, siangpahrang im koe dueng laipalah, hmuen tangkuem a kamnue.
Kapap e hmaunawnghanaw ni kai ni kateknae ka khang kecu dawk Bawipa dawk yuemnae a cak awh teh, takinae tawn laipalah taranhawi laihoi kamthang lawk a dei awh.
Tangawn ni teh hmuhmanae lungthin hoi kâtaran hanlah Khrih kamthang a dei awh.
A lungpatawnae lungthin hoi ka dei e taminaw ni kahawi e kamthang heh Bawipa ni na poe e thaw doeh ti a panue dawk pahrennae lungthin katang hoi a pâpho awh.
Alouknaw ni teh kai katek lah ka onae dawkvah, runae hoehoe kâhmo seh tie ngai lahoi yah, kâtânae lung hoi Khrih e kamthang kahawi teh a dei awh.
Telah pawiteh bangtelamaw dei awh han, kâsak laihoi nakunghai, lawkkatang lahoi nakunghai, Khrih kong dei lah ao dawk ka konawm. Hmalah hai ka ko bout a nawm han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, nangmae ratoumnae naw hoi Jisuh Khrih e Muitha koehoi kabawpnae naw hoi hetnaw teh, kai ka hloutnae lah ao han telah ka panue.
Kai teh bangpatet hno dawk hai kayayeirai takinae awm hoeh. Yampa e patetlah atu hai taranhawinae hoi ka kawi lahun, ka hring hai thoseh, ka due hai thoseh ka takthai dawk hoi Khrih teh pholen lah ao han tie ngaihawinae kalenpoung ka tawn.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, kai kahringnae teh Khrih doeh, ka due haiyah meknae lah ao.
Hahoi ka hring rah pawiteh aphu kaawm e thaw bout ka tawk thai nahanlah bangmaw ka rawi han ti ka panuek hoeh.
Hatdawkvah kai teh hno kahni touh e rahak vah ka o. Kai teh talai hringnae ceitakhai vaiteh Khrih hoi o hanelah ka ngai toe, hot teh hoe kahawi e doeh.
Hateiteh, hete tak hoi kai roup kaawm rah pawiteh nangmouh hanlah hoe pankinae lah ao.
Hatdawkvah yuemnae a roung nahan hoi lunghawi nahanlah kahring rah pawiteh nangmouh hoi cungtalah rei o han tie hah yuemnae lahoi ka panue.
Hat nah nangmouh koe bout ka tho toteh kai hoi Jisuh Khrih dawk na lunghawinae hoe apap han.
Bangtelah nakunghai nangmouh teh Khrih e kamthang kahawi hoi kamcu lah khosak awh. Hottelah na hring awh pawiteh Muitha buet touh dawk kacaklah na kangdout e lah awm vaiteh, lungkânging lahoi Khrih e kamthang kahawi yuemnae dawk thaw rei ka tawk e lah na o awh han. Na ka taran e naw kong dawk, takinae banghai awmhoeh tie hah, nangmouh hoi ka kâhmo nakunghai, kamphei nakunghai ka panue thai han.
Hottelah takihoehnae teh ahnimouh hanlah rawk kahmanae lah ao. Nangmouh hanelah teh rungngangnae lah ao teh Cathut koehoi ka tho e lah ao.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Khrih thaw tawk e hateh ama yuem e dueng laipalah, ama hanelah runae khang sin hanelah hai na poe sin e a tho dawkvah,
kai ni ka kâhmo e hai na panue awh. Atu hai kai ni ka kâhmo e patet e hah nangmouh ni na kâhmo awh.
Hatdawkvah Khrih dawk thapoenae, lungpatawnae, Muitha hoi kâhuikonae, kâpahrennae tie buetbuet touh awm pawiteh,
nangmouh ni buet touh hoi buet touh lungkâpataw awh nateh, lungthin kâkapeknae tawn laipalah lungthin cungtalah pouknae lahoi ka lunghawinae kuep sak awh.
Kâtaran ngainae lungthin, kâoupkapawinae lungthin tawn laihoi bangpatet e hno hai sak awh hanh. Ayânaw kai hlak ahawi telah buet touh hoi buet touh kârahnoumnae lungthin hoi khosak awh.
Ma hane ahawinae dueng pouk laipalah ayâ louk hane hai pouk pouh van awh.
Khrih Jisuh thung kaawm e lungthin hah nangmouh koehai awm sak van awh.
Hote Bawipa teh Cathut coungnae hoi a kuep ei teh Cathut hoi kâvannae thama lahoi lawp hanelah pouknae tawn hoeh.
Amae a reng a ceitakhai teh san coungnae a kâmahrawk teh tami patetlah a khe.
Hottelah tami coungnae hoi a kuep teh thingpalam dawk duenae totouh a khang teh amahoima a kârahnoum.
Hatdawkvah Pa Cathut ni Bawipa teh a lathueng poung lah a tawm teh min pueng hlak ka talue poung e min a poe.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Jisuh min barinae lah kalvan kaawm e, talai dawk kaawm e, talai thung kaawm e kâroe tako pueng ni khok a cuengkhuem vaiteh,
Jisuh Khrih teh Bawipa doeh telah pahni hoi a kampangkhai teh, Pa Cathut a bawilennae a kamnue sak nahane doeh.
Hatdawkvah ka pahren e naw, lawk pou na ngâi awh e patetlah nangmouh teh ka mithmu lawk na ngâi e dueng laipalah, kai hoi na kâhla nahai lawk na ngâi awh teh, takinae lung hoi nangmae rungngangnae hah kamnuek sak awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, nangmouh teh ngainae tawn sak han e, tawk sak han e, nangmae thung lungthocalah hoi thawtawkkung teh Cathut doeh.
Bang patet e thaw dawk hai phuenangnae tawn laipalah tawk awh.
Hottelah na tetpawiteh tami kadumyennaw hmalah nangmouh teh tounhoehe hoi ayâ runae ka poe hoeh e Cathut e ca lah na o awh han. Hringnae lawkkatang hah kacaklah na patuep awh vaiteh, kalvan lah kaawm e hmaiangnaw patetlah ahnimae thung pheng a tue pouh han.
Hottelah hoiyah kai teh ayawmyin lah ka yawng hoeh tie hoi ayawmyin lah ka kâyawm e nahoeh tie hah Khrih e hnin a pha toteh ka konawm han.
Hot dueng laipalah nangmae yuemnae hoi kâkuen e bawknae, hoi thuengnae naw dawk kai na thueng awh han ati awh nakunghai, ka lunghawi vaiteh nangmouh pueng hoi cungtalah ka konawm han.
Hot patetvanlah nangmouh hai na lunghawi awh, kai hoi cungtalah konawm awh.
Nangmae akongnaw ka thai navah ka tha hoe ao. Nangmouh koe Timote tang ka patoun thai nahanelah, Jisuh Khrih dawk ngaihawinae ka tawn.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Timote patetlah kai hoi lungkânging niteh, nangmae hawi nahanelah, ka pouk katang e tami buet touh hai kai koe awmhoeh.
Taminaw pueng teh Khrih Jisuh ahawi nahan tawng awh hoeh, ma hawi nahan dueng doeh a tawng awh.
Hatei Timote teh kai hoi cungtalah, a capa hoi a na pa patetlah kamthang kahawi hanelah thaw ka tawk roi katang doeh tie ahni ni a kamnue sak e nangmouh ni na panue awh.
Hatdawkvah kai dawk bangtelah ao han tie ka panue nah ahni teh nangmouh na o koe tang ka patoun han telah pouknae ka tawn.
Kama roeroe hai palang ka tho thai han doeh telah Bawipa dawk yuemnae ka tawn.
Ka nawngha Epaphroditus teh nangmouh koe atu patoune hane a panki telah ka pouk. Ahni teh kai hoi thaw tawk hui, ransa hui lah ao.
Bangkongtetpawiteh ahni patounnae a kong nangmouh ni na thai a dawk doeh. Ahni ni nangmanaw pueng na rabui lawi vah a lung nawm hoeh.
Ahni teh meimei kadout lah a pataw, hatnavah Cathut ni ahni teh a pahren, ahni dueng a pahren e nahoeh, kai ka lung boutbout a mathoe hoeh nahanelah, kai hai na pahren e lah ao.
Hatdawkvah nangmouh teh ahni hah bout na hmu awh nah konawm sak nahan, kai hai ka lung tha a dam nahan, ahni teh hoe a kâyawm dawkvah ka patoun.
Hatdawkvah Bawipa khet lahoi lunghawinae lahoi ahni teh dâw awh. Hot patetlah e taminaw bari awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, ahnimouh ni kai na khetyawt awh, ka kuep hoeh rae thaw hah ahni ni a kuep sak hanelah ka hringnae kâhmoun teh Khrih e a thaw kecu dawk duenae koe meimei ka pha toe.
Ahnoungpoung lah ka hmaunawnghanaw, Bawipa dawk na konawm awh. Kai ni boutbout ka thut nakunghai ka patang hoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh nangmouh teh karoumlah na o awh han.
Uinaw roun awh. Tami kahawi hoeh e naw hah roun awh. Vuensoma e lah ka kâsaknaw roun awh.
Maimouh ni Cathut heh Muitha lahoi bawk dawkvah maimouh teh vuensoma katang e lah o awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, maimouh teh talai dawk kamngawi awh laipalah, Khrih Jisuh thung konawm e lah o awh.
Hatei takthai koe lahoi kâoupkhai hane ka tawn van. Alouknaw ni kâoupkhai hane ao tet awh pawiteh kai dawk hoe ao.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, kai teh aphung patetlah ataroe hnin vuensoma lah ka o. Hebrunaw thung dawk Hebru, Isarel miphun Benjamin catoun Farasi lah ka o.
Lungthonae koe lahoi pawiteh, kawhmoun karektapkung lah ka o. Kâlawk dawk e lannae lahoi teh tounhoehe lah ka o.
Hatei hete hnonaw pueng teh Khrih dawkvah banglahai ka pouk hoeh toe.
Maimae Bawipa Khrih Jisuh panuenae aphu kaawm e hno dawk bangpueng ka sung sak e lah ka pouk. Hote Bawipa kecu dawk bangpueng hai ka hnoun teh eivoi patetlah doeh ka pouk.
Ka lannae heh kâlawk dawk hoi laipalah Khrih thung yuemnae lahoi doeh ka coe, hote lannae teh Cathut koehoi e yuemnae lahoi doeh.
Kai ka ngainae teh Khrih panue hane hoi a ma boutthawnae panue vaiteh a ma a khangnae khang van han hoiyah a ma patetlah due van hane doeh.
Ka ngaihawinae teh, duenae koehoi boutthawnae koe pha hane doeh.
Kai teh ka kuepcing toe ka ti ngainae tho hoeh. Khrih Jisuh ni hote thaw tawk thai nahanelah, kai hah na man dawkvah, kai ni hai hote thaw ka tawk thai nahanelah ka kâyawm.
Hmaunawnghanaw, kai ni ka kuet toe ka tie nahoeh. Hatei buet touh ka sak e hno teh, hnuk lae naw ka pahnim teh, hmalae hnonaw koe lah ka kâyap.
Khrih Jisuh thung Cathut ni lathueng lahoi na kaw teh na poe hane suh hah ka hmu thai nahanlah kawntung koe kâyawm laihoi ka yawng.
Hatdawkvah kacue e tami pueng ni teh het patetlah e lungthin tawn hanelah ao. Nangmouh dawk pouknae alouklouk na tawn awh pawiteh, hot patenghai Cathut ni a pâpho han.
Bangtelah nakunghai, maimouh ni atu totouh pha awh e patetlah hmalah hoe cet awh sei .
Hmaunawnghanaw kaie khosaknae hah out awh. Kaimouh koehoi out kawi e patetlah katarawinaw hai nangmouh ni khen sin awh.
Kai ni hete kong dawk ka dei e patetlah atu hai ka mitphi bout a bo. Bangkongtetpawiteh Khrih e thingpalam hah ka taran e tami moi apap.
Ahnimouh teh rawknae koe a hringnae a pâpout awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh ahnimae Cathut teh vonpui doeh. Ahnimouh ni kaya kawi e hnopai dawkvah a kâoup awh teh talai hno dawk a lungpen awh.
Hatei maimanaw teh, kalvanlae tami lah o awh. Hote hmuen koehoi ka tho hane Rungngangkung, Bawipa Jisuh Khrih hah maimouh ni ngaihawi awh.
